lady-lovakengj-s-favour-talking-to-jorra.text: Martin warned me this would happen. The Council are trying to silence us!

lady-lovakengj-s-favour-talking-to-jorra.speaker: Jorra
lady-lovakengj-s-favour-talking-to-jorra.text: It's not safe for me here. I need to get back to Lovakengj. Here, this should hopefully give you what you need.
Jorra gives you a declaration from the Kourend Council.

lady-lovakengj-s-favour-talking-to-jorra.speaker: Jorra
lady-lovakengj-s-favour-talking-to-jorra.text: You have what you need human. Now I need to get back to Lovakengj.

lady-lovakengj-s-favour-talking-to-lady-.speaker: Lady Vulcana Lovakengj
lady-lovakengj-s-favour-talking-to-lady-.text: Oh, it's the human. Hello human.

lady-lovakengj-s-favour-talking-to-lady-.player: I have a declaration from the Council that I think you should see.

lady-lovakengj-s-favour-talking-to-lady-.text: You show the declaration to Lady Lovakengj.

lady-lovakengj-s-favour-talking-to-lady-.speaker: Lady Vulcana Lovakengj
lady-lovakengj-s-favour-talking-to-lady-.text: The Council wanted to remove me from power? They can't do that! It's not their right!

lady-lovakengj-s-favour-talking-to-lady-.player: I'm sorry. Do you now see why we need to stop them?

lady-lovakengj-s-favour-talking-to-lady-.speaker: Lady Vulcana Lovakengj
lady-lovakengj-s-favour-talking-to-lady-.text: Yes... I understand. I will support this Royal Accord.

lady-lovakengj-s-favour-talking-to-lady-.player: And do you wish to be considered for the throne?

lady-lovakengj-s-favour-talking-to-lady-.speaker: Lady Vulcana Lovakengj
lady-lovakengj-s-favour-talking-to-lady-.text: Oh... No. Leave that for someone else.

lady-lovakengj-s-favour-talking-to-lady-.player: Very well. Thank you Lady Lovakengj. I'd better go and speak with the others.

lady-lovakengj-s-favour-talking-to-lady-.speaker: Lady Vulcana Lovakengj
lady-lovakengj-s-favour-talking-to-lady-.text: Oh, it's the human. Hello human.

lady-lovakengj-s-favour-talking-to-lady-.player: Is there anything else I can do for you?
Fair enough. I'll go speak with the others.

lady-piscarilius-favour-talking-to-mori.speaker: Mori
lady-piscarilius-favour-talking-to-mori.text: Hello again. Thank you for everything you did for Thana. You are a good friend to the people of Arceuus.

lady-piscarilius-favour-talking-to-mori.player: It's not a problem. Anyway, there was something I was hoping you could help me with.

lady-piscarilius-favour-talking-to-mori.speaker: Mori
lady-piscarilius-favour-talking-to-mori.text: Of course. What do you need?

lady-piscarilius-favour-talking-to-mori.player: I have a situation with the Disciples of Yama. I hear you've been looking into them.

lady-piscarilius-favour-talking-to-mori.speaker: Mori
lady-piscarilius-favour-talking-to-mori.text: Well... Yes, I have, but that research was meant to be a secret...

lady-piscarilius-favour-talking-to-mori.speaker: Mori
lady-piscarilius-favour-talking-to-mori.text: Ah well, you're trustworthy I suppose. What can I help you with?

lady-piscarilius-favour-talking-to-mori.player: What do you know of their leader, Yama?

lady-piscarilius-favour-talking-to-mori.speaker: Mori
lady-piscarilius-favour-talking-to-mori.text: He's a bit of a mystery. He's a demon of some sorts, but he doesn't seem to have any actual presence in Kourend yet. In fact, until recently, he had no connection to the cult.

lady-piscarilius-favour-talking-to-mori.player: The Disciples of Yama once had no connection to Yama?

lady-piscarilius-favour-talking-to-mori.speaker: Mori
lady-piscarilius-favour-talking-to-mori.text: It does sound odd, but back then they were known as the Disciples of Chaos. They were just a small Zamorakian cult of little note.

lady-piscarilius-favour-talking-to-mori.player: Interesting. So if Yama has no presence among his followers, how does he communicate with them?

lady-piscarilius-favour-talking-to-mori.speaker: Mori
lady-piscarilius-favour-talking-to-mori.text: Through another demon called the Voice of Yama.

lady-piscarilius-favour-talking-to-mori.player: So if I killed this Voice of Yama, the cultists would lose their connection to Yama?

lady-piscarilius-favour-talking-to-mori.speaker: Mori
lady-piscarilius-favour-talking-to-mori.text: For a time, though I imagine the Voice of Yama would be quickly replaced. However, if you wanted to remove that connection, I do have another idea...

lady-piscarilius-favour-talking-to-mori.speaker: Mori
lady-piscarilius-favour-talking-to-mori.text: After what happened with Thana, I volunteered to help out with the Dark Altar investigations. The device used there was redirecting power from the Altar, but a similar device could block a magical connection entirely.

lady-piscarilius-favour-talking-to-mori.player: Ah, I see. So we could use a device like that to block the connection between the Voice of Yama and Yama himself?

lady-piscarilius-favour-talking-to-mori.speaker: Mori
lady-piscarilius-favour-talking-to-mori.text: That's right. We never tried it before because the Dark Altar issues were more pressing, but I don't see why it wouldn't work.

lady-piscarilius-favour-talking-to-mori.player: Alright. So where can I get one of these devices?

lady-piscarilius-favour-talking-to-mori.speaker: Mori
lady-piscarilius-favour-talking-to-mori.text: I should be able to make you one. I'll need some molten glass and a dark essence block.
If the player already has the required materials:

steps.player: I have those right here.

steps.speaker: Mori
steps.text: Huh... Fair enough.
You give Mori some molten glass and a dark essence block.

steps.speaker: Mori
steps.text: Right. You'll need to hide this somewhere in the Chasm of Fire. Here you go.
Mori gives you a Dark Nullifier.

steps.player: Alright. Thanks Mori.

lady-piscarilius-favour-talking-to-mori.text: If the player doesn't have the required materials:

steps.player: Where can I get a dark essence block?

steps.speaker: Mori
steps.text: You can mine dense essence blocks from the mine north east of here. They can be turned into dark essence blocks using the Dark Altar.

steps.player: Okay, I'll come back once I have what you need.
I can get those for you. I'll come back once I have them.

lady-piscarilius-favour-talking-to-mori-.speaker: Mori
lady-piscarilius-favour-talking-to-mori-.text: Hello again. Do you have some molten glass and a dark essence block yet?

options.text: Where can I get a dark essence block?
Not yet. I'll come back once I have them.

steps.player: Not yet. I'll come back once I have them.

lady-piscarilius-favour-talking-to-mori-.speaker: Mori
lady-piscarilius-favour-talking-to-mori-.text: Hello again. Do you have some molten glass and a dark essence block yet?
You give Mori some molten glass and a dark essence block.

lady-piscarilius-favour-talking-to-mori-.speaker: Mori
lady-piscarilius-favour-talking-to-mori-.text: Right. You'll need to hide this somewhere in the Chasm of Fire. Here you go.
Mori gives you a Dark Nullifier.

lady-piscarilius-favour-talking-to-mori-.player: Hello Mori. What should I be doing with this device?

lady-piscarilius-favour-talking-to-mori-.speaker: Mori
lady-piscarilius-favour-talking-to-mori-.text: You just need to hide it somewhere in the Chasm of Fire.

lady-piscarilius-favour-talking-to-mori-.player: Hello Mori. Do you think you could make me another one of those devices?

lady-piscarilius-favour-talking-to-mori-.speaker: Mori
lady-piscarilius-favour-talking-to-mori-.text: I have enough supplies for another. Here, you'll need to hide it somewhere in the Chasm of Fire.
Mori gives you a Dark Nullifier.

lady-piscarilius-favour-entering-the-cha.speaker: Disciple of Yama
lady-piscarilius-favour-entering-the-cha.text: Ah, there you are. Our master foresaw your arrival.

lady-piscarilius-favour-entering-the-cha.speaker: Disciple of Yama
lady-piscarilius-favour-entering-the-cha.text: And you have the device as well. How wonderful.
You suddenly find yourself feeling very tired.

lady-piscarilius-favour-entering-the-cha.speaker: Disciple of Yama
lady-piscarilius-favour-entering-the-cha.text: Oh look at you. You need a good rest. Here, have a lie down.
You wake up in the forest.

lady-piscarilius-favour-entering-the-cha.player: Well that's the device hidden. Those Disciples of Yama won't be a problem anymore. I'd better tell Lady Piscarilius.

lady-piscarilius-favour-talking-to-lady-.speaker: Lady Shauna Piscarilius
lady-piscarilius-favour-talking-to-lady-.text: Have you dealt with the Disciples of Yama yet?

lady-piscarilius-favour-talking-to-lady-.player: Absolutely. They won't be a problem anymore.
So will you now support this Royal Accord?

lady-piscarilius-favour-talking-to-lady-.speaker: Lady Shauna Piscarilius
lady-piscarilius-favour-talking-to-lady-.text: Yes, but it's still a stupid idea. And don't even think about trying to put me in charge or something. I'll have no more part in this.

lady-piscarilius-favour-talking-to-lady-.player: I don't think you need to worry about that. Now, I'd better go and speak with the others.

lady-piscarilius-favour-talking-to-lady-.speaker: Lady Shauna Piscarilius
lady-piscarilius-favour-talking-to-lady-.text: Good. I've had enough of talking with you.

lady-piscarilius-favour-talking-to-lady-.player: Fine. I need to speak with the others anyway.

options.text: I hear your father has an office here.

steps.player: I hear your father has an office here.

steps.speaker: Pandur Hosidius
steps.text: Office? What office?

steps.player: A secret one, I'm guessing?

steps.speaker: Pandur Hosidius
steps.text: There can't be any secret offices here. I'd have noticed. I notice lots of things, you know.

steps.player: Well in that case, have you noticed your father doing anything interesting here in the past?

steps.speaker: Pandur Hosidius
steps.text: He sometimes comes to inspect the wine barrels. I like to inspect them myself sometimes.

steps.player: More than inspect, by the looks of things. Thanks for the help.

steps.speaker: Pandur Hosidius
steps.text: You're welcome.

options.text: What are these farming patches for?

lord-shayzien-s-favour-talking-to-lord-s.speaker: Lord Shiro Shayzien
lord-shayzien-s-favour-talking-to-lord-s.text: Hello there, citizen. Have you found that journal?
You show the journal to Lord Shayzien.

lord-shayzien-s-favour-talking-to-lord-s.speaker: Lord Shiro Shayzien
lord-shayzien-s-favour-talking-to-lord-s.text: Not to worry, I should be able to take care of that. When the time comes to finalise the Royal Accord, I will have the information we need to decide upon a new ruler.

lord-shayzien-s-favour-talking-to-lord-s.player: Alright. Thank you, Lord Shayzien. I should speak to Commander Fullore.

lord-shayzien-s-favour-talking-to-lord-s.speaker: Lord Shiro Shayzien
lord-shayzien-s-favour-talking-to-lord-s.text: Hello there, citizen. Thank you for your help earlier. I am ready to support this Royal Accord!

lord-shayzien-s-favour-talking-to-lord-s.player: Alright. I'll go and talk with Commander Fullore.

the-new-royal-accord-rose-s-accord.speaker: Commander Fullore
the-new-royal-accord-rose-s-accord.text: Come with me. There's something you need to see.

the-new-royal-accord-rose-s-accord.speaker: Commander Fullore
the-new-royal-accord-rose-s-accord.text: Just come.
A cutscene plays. Commander Fullore and the player discover Councillor Orson has died outside Xeric's Lookout.

the-new-royal-accord-rose-s-accord.speaker: Commander Fullore
the-new-royal-accord-rose-s-accord.text: Yup.

the-new-royal-accord-rose-s-accord.speaker: Commander Fullore
the-new-royal-accord-rose-s-accord.text: I've no idea.

the-new-royal-accord-rose-s-accord.player: You don't think he was pushed, do you?

the-new-royal-accord-rose-s-accord.speaker: Commander Fullore
the-new-royal-accord-rose-s-accord.text: I don't think so.

the-new-royal-accord-rose-s-accord.speaker: Commander Fullore
the-new-royal-accord-rose-s-accord.text: What can we do? Even Lord Arceuus can't bring back the dead. He's gone, and that's that.

the-new-royal-accord-rose-s-accord.speaker: Commander Fullore
the-new-royal-accord-rose-s-accord.text: Why did any of this have to happen?

the-new-royal-accord-rose-s-accord.player: We can't undo what's been done, but we can still put an end to all this.

the-new-royal-accord-rose-s-accord.speaker: Commander Fullore
the-new-royal-accord-rose-s-accord.text: Does that mean you have good news?

the-new-royal-accord-rose-s-accord.player: Kind of. I think I've managed to convince all the leaders to sign the Accord. That said, I have no idea who they'll pick to rule.

the-new-royal-accord-rose-s-accord.speaker: Commander Fullore
the-new-royal-accord-rose-s-accord.text: Well, we'll just have to make it work somehow. Maybe then we can finally end this nightmare.

the-new-royal-accord-rose-s-accord.speaker: Commander Fullore
the-new-royal-accord-rose-s-accord.text: I'll deal with this mess. Once I'm done, let's gather everyone downstairs again.
The scene transitions to the basement, where the leaders of the five Houses, bar Hosidius and Shayzien, appear.

the-new-royal-accord-rose-s-accord.speaker: Lady Shauna Piscarilius
the-new-royal-accord-rose-s-accord.text: Shall we get on with this then?

the-new-royal-accord-rose-s-accord.player: Not yet. Where's Lord Hosidius and Lord Shayzien?

the-new-royal-accord-rose-s-accord.speaker: Lord Trobin Arceuus
the-new-royal-accord-rose-s-accord.text: Lord Hosidius requested a private word with Lord Shayzien outside. I'm sure they'll be here soon.

the-new-royal-accord-rose-s-accord.speaker: Lord Trobin Arceuus
the-new-royal-accord-rose-s-accord.text: In fact, I think I hear them now.
Lord Hosidius and Shayzien arrive to the meeting.

the-new-royal-accord-rose-s-accord.speaker: Commander Fullore
the-new-royal-accord-rose-s-accord.text: Now that everyone is here, I think we can begin.

the-new-royal-accord-rose-s-accord.speaker: Lord Kandur Hosidius
the-new-royal-accord-rose-s-accord.text: What of the Councillor? Is he not joining us?

the-new-royal-accord-rose-s-accord.speaker: Commander Fullore
the-new-royal-accord-rose-s-accord.text: Councillor Orson is dead.

the-new-royal-accord-rose-s-accord.speaker: Lord Trobin Arceuus
the-new-royal-accord-rose-s-accord.text: Dead? What happened?

the-new-royal-accord-rose-s-accord.speaker: Lady Shauna Piscarilius
the-new-royal-accord-rose-s-accord.text: Jumped from the top of the tower, probably. It doesn't matter, the world won't miss him. Let's move on.

the-new-royal-accord-rose-s-accord.speaker: Commander Fullore
the-new-royal-accord-rose-s-accord.text: Not the attitude I'd take, but it's true that we can't dwell on this. We need to focus on stopping Councillor Andrews.

the-new-royal-accord-rose-s-accord.speaker: Lord Kandur Hosidius
the-new-royal-accord-rose-s-accord.text: Between the five of us, we can remove the Council from power with little violence. But what then? Are we willing to support a new Royal Accord?

the-new-royal-accord-rose-s-accord.speaker: Commander Fullore
the-new-royal-accord-rose-s-accord.text: Lord Arceuus, let's start with you. What will it take for a new Royal Accord to gain your support?

the-new-royal-accord-rose-s-accord.speaker: Lord Trobin Arceuus
the-new-royal-accord-rose-s-accord.text: My position is a unique one. As such, I feel it would be inappropriate for me to involve myself too heavily in this. That said, I will gladly support the decision made by this group.

the-new-royal-accord-rose-s-accord.speaker: Commander Fullore
the-new-royal-accord-rose-s-accord.text: You would not wish to rule yourself?

the-new-royal-accord-rose-s-accord.speaker: Lord Trobin Arceuus
the-new-royal-accord-rose-s-accord.text: I will gladly advise the next ruler in any way I can, but it should not be me who takes the throne. I would recommend you look to Lord Hosidius or Lord Shayzien for that.

the-new-royal-accord-rose-s-accord.speaker: Commander Fullore
the-new-royal-accord-rose-s-accord.text: Very well. Lady Piscarilius?

the-new-royal-accord-rose-s-accord.speaker: Lady Shauna Piscarilius
the-new-royal-accord-rose-s-accord.text: For the record, I think this is all a bad idea. Still, you're all clearly set on it, so I won't try and stop you.

the-new-royal-accord-rose-s-accord.speaker: Lady Shauna Piscarilius
the-new-royal-accord-rose-s-accord.text: However, I stand by what I said before. The people should have a say. Anything we decide here should not be finalised until the people have voted on it.

the-new-royal-accord-rose-s-accord.speaker: Commander Fullore
the-new-royal-accord-rose-s-accord.text: Any thoughts from anyone?

the-new-royal-accord-rose-s-accord.speaker: Lord Trobin Arceuus
the-new-royal-accord-rose-s-accord.text: I would be happy to see the people have a say.

the-new-royal-accord-rose-s-accord.speaker: Lord Kandur Hosidius
the-new-royal-accord-rose-s-accord.text: It could be a risky move.

the-new-royal-accord-rose-s-accord.speaker: Lady Shauna Piscarilius
the-new-royal-accord-rose-s-accord.text: And? Without it, I'm not signing your precious document. If I don't sign, you get nothing.

the-new-royal-accord-rose-s-accord.speaker: Lord Kandur Hosidius
the-new-royal-accord-rose-s-accord.text: Hmm. Very well.

the-new-royal-accord-rose-s-accord.player: Assuming the people agree to the new Accord, who do you think should rule the kingdom?

the-new-royal-accord-rose-s-accord.speaker: Lady Shauna Piscarilius
the-new-royal-accord-rose-s-accord.text: Well not me, that's for sure. I can't imagine anything worse. Get one of these fools to do it.

the-new-royal-accord-rose-s-accord.speaker: Commander Fullore
the-new-royal-accord-rose-s-accord.text: Lady Lovakengj?

the-new-royal-accord-rose-s-accord.speaker: Lady Vulcana Lovakengj
the-new-royal-accord-rose-s-accord.text: Huh? Me?

the-new-royal-accord-rose-s-accord.speaker: Commander Fullore
the-new-royal-accord-rose-s-accord.text: Yes. What do you think?

the-new-royal-accord-rose-s-accord.speaker: Lady Vulcana Lovakengj
the-new-royal-accord-rose-s-accord.text: Well... This is all quite something. I suppose the Council have to go though, don't they?

the-new-royal-accord-rose-s-accord.player: Would you be willing to take over?

the-new-royal-accord-rose-s-accord.speaker: Lady Vulcana Lovakengj
the-new-royal-accord-rose-s-accord.text: Oh... No, I don't think so. I think I'll have a sherry instead.

the-new-royal-accord-rose-s-accord.speaker: Commander Fullore
the-new-royal-accord-rose-s-accord.text: Lord Shayzien. What are your thoughts?

the-new-royal-accord-rose-s-accord.speaker: Lord Shiro Shayzien
the-new-royal-accord-rose-s-accord.text: Well... I think the Royal Accord of Twill is a good starting point, but we'll need to make some changes for it to work.

the-new-royal-accord-rose-s-accord.speaker: Lord Shiro Shayzien
the-new-royal-accord-rose-s-accord.text: Lady Piscarilius wants the support of the people. Right now, they cry for a king. That means whoever takes the throne should take on the title of king or queen.

the-new-royal-accord-rose-s-accord.speaker: Lord Shiro Shayzien
the-new-royal-accord-rose-s-accord.text: I also feel the act of transferring rulership from one house to the next - as in the original Accord - isn't going to work for us. What we need is consistency.

the-new-royal-accord-rose-s-accord.speaker: Commander Fullore
the-new-royal-accord-rose-s-accord.text: Would you be open to taking on the role yourself?

the-new-royal-accord-rose-s-accord.speaker: Lord Shiro Shayzien
the-new-royal-accord-rose-s-accord.text: Err... No, I don't think that would be wise.

the-new-royal-accord-rose-s-accord.speaker: Lady Shauna Piscarilius
the-new-royal-accord-rose-s-accord.text: What?

the-new-royal-accord-rose-s-accord.speaker: Commander Fullore
the-new-royal-accord-rose-s-accord.text: Are you sure? You seem to be a perfect candidate.

the-new-royal-accord-rose-s-accord.speaker: Lord Shiro Shayzien
the-new-royal-accord-rose-s-accord.text: I don't feel I would be best placed for it. It would be better if I kept my focus on the important task of protecting Kourend.

the-new-royal-accord-rose-s-accord.speaker: Lord Shiro Shayzien
the-new-royal-accord-rose-s-accord.text: I suggest we make Lord Hosidius the new ruler of Kourend.

the-new-royal-accord-rose-s-accord.speaker: Lady Shauna Piscarilius
the-new-royal-accord-rose-s-accord.text: What the...

the-new-royal-accord-rose-s-accord.speaker: Commander Fullore
the-new-royal-accord-rose-s-accord.text: Lord Hosidius?

the-new-royal-accord-rose-s-accord.speaker: Lord Kandur Hosidius
the-new-royal-accord-rose-s-accord.text: Thank you, Lord Shayzien. Taking the throne is not a duty to be considered lightly, but I believe my family and I have what it takes to shoulder this responsibility.

the-new-royal-accord-rose-s-accord.speaker: Commander Fullore
the-new-royal-accord-rose-s-accord.text: This decision will forever change the future of Kourend. If we go forward with this, the Hosidius family will be the new royal family of Kourend.

the-new-royal-accord-rose-s-accord.speaker: Lady Shauna Piscarilius
the-new-royal-accord-rose-s-accord.text: Well... This isn't quite what I expected, but sure. Let the idiot have his throne. As long as the people agree.

the-new-royal-accord-rose-s-accord.speaker: Lady Vulcana Lovakengj
the-new-royal-accord-rose-s-accord.text: He can do it, I suppose.

the-new-royal-accord-rose-s-accord.speaker: Lord Trobin Arceuus
the-new-royal-accord-rose-s-accord.text: Lord Hosidius would be a fitting choice for the role, assuming no one else here is willing.

the-new-royal-accord-rose-s-accord.player: Are you sure about this Lord Shayzien?

the-new-royal-accord-rose-s-accord.speaker: Lord Shiro Shayzien
the-new-royal-accord-rose-s-accord.text: I... I am.

the-new-royal-accord-rose-s-accord.player: Then it sounds like we have an agreement.

the-new-royal-accord-rose-s-accord.speaker: Lord Kandur Hosidius
the-new-royal-accord-rose-s-accord.text: My friends, thank you for putting your trust in me. This kingdom has suffered through much of late, but now it is time for that suffering to end.

the-new-royal-accord-rose-s-accord.speaker: Lord Kandur Hosidius
the-new-royal-accord-rose-s-accord.text: In honour of her sacrifice, I name this declaration Rose's Accord. With it, the Kingdom of Great Kourend will no longer be a kingdom divided.

the-new-royal-accord-rose-s-accord.speaker: Lord Kandur Hosidius
the-new-royal-accord-rose-s-accord.text: I promise not to let you down.
The cutscene ends.

the-new-royal-accord-rose-s-accord.speaker: Commander Fullore
the-new-royal-accord-rose-s-accord.text: So... What just happened there?

the-new-royal-accord-rose-s-accord.player: It seems we might have a new king.

the-new-royal-accord-rose-s-accord.speaker: Commander Fullore
the-new-royal-accord-rose-s-accord.text: But Lord Shayzien? He seemed like a perfect candidate, but he didn't even want to be considered. What happened?

the-new-royal-accord-rose-s-accord.player: I think I might have some idea, but I'm still a bit confused to be honest.

the-new-royal-accord-rose-s-accord.speaker: Commander Fullore
the-new-royal-accord-rose-s-accord.text: Well, Lord Hosidius wants to have a word with you. Perhaps he can shed some light on all of this. He's downstairs.

the-new-royal-accord-rose-s-accord.player: I'll go and speak to him.

the-new-royal-accord-talking-to-lord-hos.speaker: Lord Kandur Hosidius
the-new-royal-accord-talking-to-lord-hos.text: Hello there. No doubt you have questions about what just occurred.

the-new-royal-accord-talking-to-lord-hos.speaker: Lord Kandur Hosidius
the-new-royal-accord-talking-to-lord-hos.text: I'm sorry for keeping you in the dark, my friend. It wasn't anything against you. I just couldn't afford to take any risks.

the-new-royal-accord-talking-to-lord-hos.player: You planned this all along, didn't you? That's why you kept the Royal Accord of Twill.

the-new-royal-accord-talking-to-lord-hos.speaker: Lord Kandur Hosidius
the-new-royal-accord-talking-to-lord-hos.text: It was inevitable that one day the Council would fall. Their rule has always been fragile.

the-new-royal-accord-talking-to-lord-hos.player: So you made sure that you'd be the one to replace them.

the-new-royal-accord-talking-to-lord-hos.speaker: Lord Kandur Hosidius
the-new-royal-accord-talking-to-lord-hos.text: It gives me no pleasure, but this was needed for the safety of all of Kourend. Apart from Lord Shayzien, the other rulers had no interest in the throne. It was always going to be him or me.

the-new-royal-accord-talking-to-lord-hos.player: And you didn't want it to be him?

the-new-royal-accord-talking-to-lord-hos.speaker: Lord Kandur Hosidius
the-new-royal-accord-talking-to-lord-hos.text: It was for the safety of Kourend. Lord Shayzien has a good military mind, but he is no ruler. After all, you saw what he did with Phileas.

the-new-royal-accord-talking-to-lord-hos.speaker: Lord Kandur Hosidius
the-new-royal-accord-talking-to-lord-hos.text: To Lord Shayzien, family name is everything. Above all else, he craves glory for himself and his house. Under him, war would have been inevitable.

the-new-royal-accord-talking-to-lord-hos.speaker: Lord Kandur Hosidius
the-new-royal-accord-talking-to-lord-hos.text: Varlamore, the kingdom to the south. Our two kingdoms were in conflict less than a hundred years ago, and relations remain sour. It would take very little for that conflict to be reignited.

the-new-royal-accord-talking-to-lord-hos.player: You really think Lord Shayzien would have declared war?

the-new-royal-accord-talking-to-lord-hos.speaker: Lord Kandur Hosidius
the-new-royal-accord-talking-to-lord-hos.text: I can't say for sure, but it was a risk I did not intend to take.

the-new-royal-accord-talking-to-lord-hos.player: I see. So how did you do it?

the-new-royal-accord-talking-to-lord-hos.speaker: Lord Kandur Hosidius
the-new-royal-accord-talking-to-lord-hos.text: A while ago, I managed to acquire the old journal of King Shayzien VII. I knew that I could use it to discredit Lord Shayzien and his family, so I made some arrangements.

the-new-royal-accord-talking-to-lord-hos.player: Phileas' mystery parcel! That was you? You acted like you didn't even know him earlier!

the-new-royal-accord-talking-to-lord-hos.speaker: Lord Kandur Hosidius
the-new-royal-accord-talking-to-lord-hos.text: Apologies for the misdirection. It was indeed me who sent that parcel.

the-new-royal-accord-talking-to-lord-hos.speaker: Lord Kandur Hosidius
the-new-royal-accord-talking-to-lord-hos.text: Had I revealed the contents of the journal myself, I would likely have just been dismissed as trying to create a rift between our two houses. Phileas was the perfect third party.

the-new-royal-accord-talking-to-lord-hos.player: But then Lord Shayzien had Phileas captured before he could reveal too much. This is all starting to make sense. You know, he actually blamed you for that!

the-new-royal-accord-talking-to-lord-hos.speaker: Lord Kandur Hosidius
the-new-royal-accord-talking-to-lord-hos.text: Phileas' disappearance was an interesting twist. I hadn't expected something like that. Still, it actually made things even easier in the end. Once Phileas was safe, I told Lord Shayzien and gave him a choice.

the-new-royal-accord-talking-to-lord-hos.player: Oh I see. You let him pick between supporting you or being exposed.

the-new-royal-accord-talking-to-lord-hos.speaker: Lord Kandur Hosidius
the-new-royal-accord-talking-to-lord-hos.text: Exactly. The truth about Phileas would have lost him the support of his people and ruined his reputation.

the-new-royal-accord-talking-to-lord-hos.player: So in the end, you never actually needed to discredit him at all. What about the journal? Lord Shayzien sent me to steal it from you, but surely he already had it.

the-new-royal-accord-talking-to-lord-hos.speaker: Lord Kandur Hosidius
the-new-royal-accord-talking-to-lord-hos.text: I didn't want to risk losing the real journal. The one I sent to Phileas was a copy, with many bits removed. While I covered my tracks well, Lord Shayzien must have worked out I was involved.

the-new-royal-accord-talking-to-lord-hos.player: And he sent me to recover the real journal.

the-new-royal-accord-talking-to-lord-hos.speaker: Lord Kandur Hosidius
the-new-royal-accord-talking-to-lord-hos.text: Yes. Unfortunately for him, the one you stole was a fake. The real one is somewhere much safer.

the-new-royal-accord-talking-to-lord-hos.player: You really thought of everything didn't you? How about the Accord? That was essential to your plans. I'm guessing it was no accident that Artur found it.

the-new-royal-accord-talking-to-lord-hos.speaker: Lord Kandur Hosidius
the-new-royal-accord-talking-to-lord-hos.text: I can't take too much credit from Artur there. He did do most of the work himself. I'd been looking into the Accord for a while when Artur found my research.

the-new-royal-accord-talking-to-lord-hos.speaker: Lord Kandur Hosidius
the-new-royal-accord-talking-to-lord-hos.text: When he went missing, I feared the worst. It was a nice surprise when you not only brought him back, but the Accord as well.

the-new-royal-accord-talking-to-lord-hos.player: This is a lot to take in. I don't know if I like any of it.

the-new-royal-accord-talking-to-lord-hos.speaker: Lord Kandur Hosidius
the-new-royal-accord-talking-to-lord-hos.text: Nor do I like it myself. However, when it comes to politics, there are no perfect options. Instead, all we can do is pick the best option we have.

the-new-royal-accord-talking-to-lord-hos.speaker: Lord Kandur Hosidius
the-new-royal-accord-talking-to-lord-hos.text: Anyway, we will have plenty of time to discuss this later. For now, the Council needs to be dealt with. You should speak with Commander Fullore.

the-new-royal-accord-talking-to-lord-hos.speaker: Lord Kandur Hosidius
the-new-royal-accord-talking-to-lord-hos.text: We will have to talk more later my friend. For now, the Council needs to be dealt with. You should speak with Commander Fullore.

the-new-royal-accord-talking-to-lord-arc.speaker: Lord Trobin Arceuus
the-new-royal-accord-talking-to-lord-arc.text: Hello there. It's time for us to deal with the Council. You should speak with Commander Fullore.

the-new-royal-accord-talking-to-lord-arc.player: Will do. I just need to talk to Lord Hosidius first.

the-new-royal-accord-talking-to-lord-arc.speaker: Lord Trobin Arceuus
the-new-royal-accord-talking-to-lord-arc.text: Hello there. It's time for us to deal with the Council. You should speak with Commander Fullore.

the-new-royal-accord-talking-to-lord-sha.player: What happened there? Why didn't you put yourself forward to become king?

the-new-royal-accord-talking-to-lord-sha.speaker: Lord Shiro Shayzien
the-new-royal-accord-talking-to-lord-sha.text: Well... It was a complex choice, citizen. I wouldn't worry about it. We're all ready to deal with the Council. Let's focus on that.

the-new-royal-accord-talking-to-lady-lov.speaker: Lady Vulcana Lovakengj
the-new-royal-accord-talking-to-lady-lov.text: Oh, it's the human. Shouldn't you be speaking with Commander Fullore?

the-new-royal-accord-talking-to-lady-lov.player: Actually I need to go talk to Lord Hosidius.

the-new-royal-accord-talking-to-lady-lov.speaker: Lady Vulcana Lovakengj
the-new-royal-accord-talking-to-lady-lov.text: Oh, it's the human. Shouldn't you be speaking with Commander Fullore?

the-new-royal-accord-talking-to-lady-pis.player: Fine. I need to speak with Lord Hosidius anyway.
Fine. I need to speak with Commander Fullore anyway.

the-new-royal-accord-talking-to-commande.speaker: Commander Fullore
the-new-royal-accord-talking-to-commande.text: Lord Hosidius wants to have a word with you. He's downstairs.

the-new-royal-accord-talking-to-commande.player: I'll go and speak to him.

the-new-royal-accord-talking-to-commande.speaker: Commander Fullore
the-new-royal-accord-talking-to-commande.text: How did your chat with Lord Hosidius go?

the-new-royal-accord-talking-to-commande.player: It was definitely illuminating. It seems there was only ever really one option for Kourend's new ruler.

the-new-royal-accord-talking-to-commande.speaker: Commander Fullore
the-new-royal-accord-talking-to-commande.text: We'll have to talk about that later. It's time to pay a visit to the Council.

the-new-royal-accord-talking-to-commande.speaker: Commander Fullore
the-new-royal-accord-talking-to-commande.text: We'll join the five leaders and head to the castle. There, we'll tell the councillors everything we know and present Rose's Accord to them.

the-new-royal-accord-talking-to-commande.player: Do you think they'll come quietly?

the-new-royal-accord-talking-to-commande.speaker: Commander Fullore
the-new-royal-accord-talking-to-commande.text: They won't have a choice. Lord Shayzien commands the Shayzien Army, and I command the Royal Guard. They'll have no one to protect them.

the-new-royal-accord-talking-to-commande.speaker: Commander Fullore
the-new-royal-accord-talking-to-commande.text: They'll be imprisoned. It will be for the new ruler to decide their fates. As for that, we'll aim to hold the vote Lady Piscarilius requested as soon as possible.

the-new-royal-accord-talking-to-commande.speaker: Commander Fullore
the-new-royal-accord-talking-to-commande.text: Assuming the people support Rose's Accord, we can have Lord Hosidius crowned within a few days.

the-new-royal-accord-talking-to-commande.player: Do you think they'll support it?

the-new-royal-accord-talking-to-commande.speaker: Commander Fullore
the-new-royal-accord-talking-to-commande.text: I think so. Many are already calling out for a king, and Lord Hosidius is popular across the whole kingdom.

the-new-royal-accord-talking-to-commande.player: Sounds like we have everything covered, then. When do we depart?

the-new-royal-accord-talking-to-commande.speaker: Commander Fullore
the-new-royal-accord-talking-to-commande.text: As soon as you're ready. From what I hear, the protest is getting close to breaking point. We can't waste any more time.

options.text: I need to do something first.

the-council-s-end-dealing-with-the-counc.speaker: Commander Fullore
the-council-s-end-dealing-with-the-counc.text: Ready to pay the Council a visit?

steps.player: Let's do this.

steps.speaker: Captain Rachelle
steps.text: Hold the line! Under no circumstances can this castle be breached!

steps.speaker: Guard
steps.text: But Captain... They're citizens...

steps.speaker: Captain Rachelle
steps.text: Did you not hear me? Hold the line!

steps.speaker: Protester
steps.text: That's right, hold the line! Show everyone who you really serve!

steps.speaker: Captain Rachelle
steps.text: We serve Great Kourend! You are all in violation of the laws of this kingdom!

steps.speaker: Protester
steps.text: Laws set by your false Council! If you really served Kourend, you wouldn't be here defending those monsters!

steps.speaker: Captain Rachelle
steps.text: Step back citizen!

steps.speaker: Protester
steps.text: Or what? You'll kill me? Go on! I dare you to do it! See what happens!

steps.speaker: Protester
steps.text: Yeah! You can't kill us all!

steps.speaker: Captain Rachelle
steps.text: Stand back! I'm warning you!
Lord Shayzien, Lord Hosidius, Commander Fullore, and the player arrive at Kourend Castle.

steps.speaker: Lord Shiro Shayzien
steps.text: Stand down, Captain Rachelle. This situation is now under my command.

steps.speaker: Captain Rachelle
steps.text: Lord Shayzien? What's going on?

steps.speaker: Lord Shiro Shayzien
steps.text: These citizens are to be protected. Ensure they do not enter the castle, but do not allow any harm to come to them.

steps.speaker: Captain Rachelle
steps.text: As you wish, Lord Shayzien. It will be done.

steps.speaker: Lord Shiro Shayzien
steps.text: Thank you, Captain. Now, myself and the other leaders will go and speak with the councillors. This situation will be resolved soon.
The scene transitions to the leaders of the five Houses meeting with Councillor Andrews.

steps.speaker: Councillor Andrews
steps.text: Ah, Lord Shayzien. It's good to have you here. Hopefully with your support we can get this protest under control.

steps.speaker: Councillor Andrews
steps.text: Though I must say, I'm a bit confused as to why everyone else is here. Is something happening?

steps.speaker: Lord Shiro Shayzien
steps.text: That would be one way to describe it Councillor. Lord Hosidius.

steps.speaker: Lord Kandur Hosidius
steps.text: Councillor Andrews, Councillor Unkar. We are here to present a joint declaration from the five houses of Great Kourend.

steps.speaker: Councillor Andrews
steps.text: Declaration? I don't understand.

steps.speaker: Lord Kandur Hosidius
steps.text: We, the leaders of the five houses of Great Kourend, declare that the Kourend Council is no longer fit to rule. As such, you are relieved of your positions with immediate effect.

steps.speaker: Councillor Andrews
steps.text: What the... What is this?

steps.speaker: Lord Kandur Hosidius
steps.text: Furthermore, you will both hand yourselves over to Lord Shayzien's soldiers. They will take you into custody where you will await your trial.

steps.speaker: Councillor Andrews
steps.text: Trial? Have you gone mad? Trial for what?

steps.speaker: Lord Shiro Shayzien
steps.text: For the crimes of murder and high treason. Along with the now-deceased Liam Orson and Sophia Hughes, the two of you successfully conspired to murder King Kharedst IV and Crown Princess Rose.

steps.speaker: Councillor Unkar
steps.text: Liam's... dead?

steps.speaker: Councillor Andrews
steps.text: This is insanity! Guards! Arrest them at once!

steps.speaker: Commander Fullore
steps.text: Soldiers of the Kourend Royal Guard, you serve the rightful ruler of Kourend! That is not this man. Stand down and step aside!
The royal guards leave.

steps.speaker: Councillor Andrews
steps.text: No! You can't do this!

steps.speaker: Councillor Unkar
steps.text: David... It's over...

steps.speaker: Councillor Andrews
steps.text: Over? Only I decide when it's over! I am the rightful ruler of this kingdom and you all answer to me!

steps.speaker: Lord Shiro Shayzien
steps.text: Guards.

steps.speaker: Councillor Andrews
steps.text: Stay away from me! This is my throne! I worked too hard for you to just take it away! I'd rather die!

steps.speaker: Lord Shiro Shayzien
steps.text: Do it.

steps.speaker: Councillor Andrews
steps.text: No!
The guards knock out Councillor Andrews.

steps.speaker: Lord Shiro Shayzien
steps.text: Take them away.
The cutscene ends.

options.text: I need to do something first.

steps.player: I need to do something first.

steps.speaker: Commander Fullore
steps.text: Don't take too long. Let me know when you're ready.

the-council-s-end-coronation-ceremony.text: The cutscene transitions from Councillor Andrews's arrest to the Kourend Castle Courtyard. Here, a big banquet has been laid out in the courtyard. Attendees include the leaders of the five Houses bar Lord Shayzien, the Hosidius family, Martin Holt, Captain Ginea, Commander Fullore, Duke Horacio, Queen Ellamaria, King Roald, Sir Amik Varze, Sir Tiffy Cashien, King Lathas/Thoros, Queen Zyanyi Arkan, and her royal guards, the Kualti.

the-council-s-end-coronation-ceremony.speaker: Martin Holt
the-council-s-end-coronation-ceremony.text: Well, look who it is!

the-council-s-end-coronation-ceremony.player: Good to see you Martin.

the-council-s-end-coronation-ceremony.speaker: Martin Holt
the-council-s-end-coronation-ceremony.text: Can you believe it? The coronation of a king! Truth be told, there were times I wondered if this day would ever come.

the-council-s-end-coronation-ceremony.player: And is it everything you hoped for?

the-council-s-end-coronation-ceremony.speaker: Martin Holt
the-council-s-end-coronation-ceremony.text: Everything and more, my friend. And to think they even let us vote on it as well! Fantastic!

the-council-s-end-coronation-ceremony.player: Well the King certainly seems to have attracted plenty of guests.

the-council-s-end-coronation-ceremony.speaker: Martin Holt
the-council-s-end-coronation-ceremony.text: Indeed. Seems that everyone wants to congratulate him... Or maybe they're just here for the food.

the-council-s-end-coronation-ceremony.speaker: Martin Holt
the-council-s-end-coronation-ceremony.text: Either way, this will be an event for the ages.

the-council-s-end-coronation-ceremony.player: Are all the leaders here as well?

the-council-s-end-coronation-ceremony.speaker: Martin Holt
the-council-s-end-coronation-ceremony.text: Most of them. Lord Shayzien was here earlier but he left. To be honest, he didn't look to be enjoying himself.

the-council-s-end-coronation-ceremony.player: That's not too suprising. Things weren't exactly straightforward between him and the King when this was all arranged.

the-council-s-end-coronation-ceremony.speaker: Martin Holt
the-council-s-end-coronation-ceremony.text: Yes, I heard there was a bit of drama here and there. Still, that's Kourend for you.

the-council-s-end-coronation-ceremony.speaker: Martin Holt
the-council-s-end-coronation-ceremony.text: Now, I'll let you go and mingle. I'm sure the King himself will want a word with you at some point as well.

the-council-s-end-coronation-ceremony.player: Alright. Have fun Martin.

the-council-s-end-coronation-ceremony.text: The player walks towards Lord Arceuus.

the-council-s-end-coronation-ceremony.player: Hello Lord Arceuus.

the-council-s-end-coronation-ceremony.speaker: Lord Trobin Arceuus
the-council-s-end-coronation-ceremony.text: Good to see you friend.

the-council-s-end-coronation-ceremony.player: Any word on Xamphur?

the-council-s-end-coronation-ceremony.speaker: Lord Trobin Arceuus
the-council-s-end-coronation-ceremony.text: Nothing yet. However, we did manage to search his lair in Molch.

the-council-s-end-coronation-ceremony.player: Find anything interesting?

the-council-s-end-coronation-ceremony.speaker: Lord Trobin Arceuus
the-council-s-end-coronation-ceremony.text: Most of it had been cleared out before we arrived. There was some research left behind though. Notes on potential new spells.

the-council-s-end-coronation-ceremony.speaker: Lord Trobin Arceuus
the-council-s-end-coronation-ceremony.text: Some are far too dangerous to use, but others we've found to be safe. We're preparing a tome of all the ones that are suitable. I'll make sure you get a copy once we're done.

the-council-s-end-coronation-ceremony.player: That's very kind of you.

the-council-s-end-coronation-ceremony.speaker: Lord Trobin Arceuus
the-council-s-end-coronation-ceremony.text: It's the least we can do after all you have done for us. Anyway, I won't keep you. Enjoy the coronation.
The player walks towards Commander Fullore.

the-council-s-end-coronation-ceremony.speaker: Commander Fullore
the-council-s-end-coronation-ceremony.text: There you are! I was worried you'd miss all the fun.

the-council-s-end-coronation-ceremony.player: No chance. It's not every day you crown a new king.

the-council-s-end-coronation-ceremony.speaker: Commander Fullore
the-council-s-end-coronation-ceremony.text: You can say that again. You should have seen all the preperations needed. Food, drinks, entertainment, invitations... The list goes on.

the-council-s-end-coronation-ceremony.speaker: Commander Fullore
the-council-s-end-coronation-ceremony.text: You'd think security would be one of the hard parts, but I actually reckon our bit is pretty straightforward in comparison.

the-council-s-end-coronation-ceremony.player: On that note, how does it feel to be serving a king now?

the-council-s-end-coronation-ceremony.speaker: Commander Fullore
the-council-s-end-coronation-ceremony.text: I don't think it's quite sunk in yet. It still feels like it was only this morning that Councillor Hughes escaped. So much has happened in such a short time.

the-council-s-end-coronation-ceremony.player: Tell me about it. Had I known how this would go when Martin first recruited me, I'd have probably considered running for the hills as fast as possible.

the-council-s-end-coronation-ceremony.speaker: Commander Fullore
the-council-s-end-coronation-ceremony.text: Well, I for one am glad you didn't. We'd have never reached this point without your help.

the-council-s-end-coronation-ceremony.player: It wouldn't have been possible without you or Martin either. Have you two spoken yet?

the-council-s-end-coronation-ceremony.speaker: Commander Fullore
the-council-s-end-coronation-ceremony.text: Oh, I'm going to need a lot to drink before I'm ready for that conversation.

the-council-s-end-coronation-ceremony.player: Fair enough.

the-council-s-end-coronation-ceremony.speaker: Commander Fullore
the-council-s-end-coronation-ceremony.text: Anyway, have you seen our special guest?
The scene pans towards the front banquet table.

the-council-s-end-coronation-ceremony.speaker: King Kandur Hosidius
the-council-s-end-coronation-ceremony.text: It's a pleasure to finally welcome you to Great Kourend, Queen Zyanyi. You are very welcome here.

the-council-s-end-coronation-ceremony.speaker: Queen Zyanyi Arkan
the-council-s-end-coronation-ceremony.text: The pleasure is all mine. From today, the sun will shine on our two kingdoms once more. The mistakes of the past are now behind us.

the-council-s-end-coronation-ceremony.player: Who is she?

the-council-s-end-coronation-ceremony.speaker: Commander Fullore
the-council-s-end-coronation-ceremony.text: Zyanyi Arkan, the Sun Queen. She's the ruler of Varlamore, the kingdom in the south. This is her first visit to Kourend.

the-council-s-end-coronation-ceremony.player: First visit?

the-council-s-end-coronation-ceremony.speaker: Commander Fullore
the-council-s-end-coronation-ceremony.text: Indeed. The King personally invited her. He's keen to put an end to the animosity between the two kingdoms. Rumor has it she feels the same way.

the-council-s-end-coronation-ceremony.player: Who are the knights with her?

the-council-s-end-coronation-ceremony.speaker: Commander Fullore
the-council-s-end-coronation-ceremony.text: Her royal guard, the Kualti.

the-council-s-end-coronation-ceremony.player: They look fancy.

the-council-s-end-coronation-ceremony.speaker: Commander Fullore
the-council-s-end-coronation-ceremony.text: They do. If the stories are true, they're the best fighters in Varlamore.

the-council-s-end-coronation-ceremony.player: Not jealous are you?

the-council-s-end-coronation-ceremony.speaker: Commander Fullore
the-council-s-end-coronation-ceremony.text: Not of that armour, that's for sure. It looks very uncomfortable.
Queen Zyanyi Arkan and her Kualti begin to leave.

the-council-s-end-coronation-ceremony.speaker: Commander Fullore
the-council-s-end-coronation-ceremony.text: Ah, looks like they're done. You should go and see the King. He was pretty keen to speak to you.

the-council-s-end-coronation-ceremony.player: Okay. I'll see you later.

the-council-s-end-coronation-ceremony.text: The player approaches King Kandur Hosidius.

the-council-s-end-coronation-ceremony.player: Good to see you, Your Majesty. Congratulations on your coronation.

the-council-s-end-coronation-ceremony.speaker: King Kandur Hosidius
the-council-s-end-coronation-ceremony.text: Thank you my friend. Of course, none of this would have been possible without you. Let it be known that you will always be a friend of this kingdom.

the-council-s-end-coronation-ceremony.player: Thank you, I'm very honoured.

the-council-s-end-coronation-ceremony.speaker: King Kandur Hosidius
the-council-s-end-coronation-ceremony.text: As am I. In fact, I think this calls for a toast.

the-council-s-end-coronation-ceremony.speaker: King Kandur Hosidius
the-council-s-end-coronation-ceremony.text: Gather around honoured guests! It's time for me to bore you all with a speech!
The guests approach King Kandur Hosidius.

the-council-s-end-coronation-ceremony.speaker: King Kandur Hosidius
the-council-s-end-coronation-ceremony.text: Friends, thank you all for joining me on this special day. This is the beginning of a new chapter for Kourend, and I could not be more grateful to have you all here to celebrate with me.

the-council-s-end-coronation-ceremony.speaker: King Kandur Hosidius
the-council-s-end-coronation-ceremony.text: Still, let us not forget the hard road that led us here, nor those who were brave enough to walk along it.

the-council-s-end-coronation-ceremony.speaker: King Kandur Hosidius
the-council-s-end-coronation-ceremony.text: Martin Holt, Lydia Fullore, [player name]. Without you, we would all still be living in ignorance. You opened our eyes to the truth, and ensured a strong future for Kourend.

the-council-s-end-coronation-ceremony.speaker: King Kandur Hosidius
the-council-s-end-coronation-ceremony.text: Now, let us all raise our glasses to these three. We are forever in their debt.
The scene fades to black, and transitions to one with King Kandur Hosidius and the player alone behind Kourend's throne.

the-council-s-end-coronation-ceremony.speaker: King Kandur Hosidius
the-council-s-end-coronation-ceremony.text: Ah, there you are.

the-council-s-end-coronation-ceremony.player: You wanted to speak to me?

the-council-s-end-coronation-ceremony.speaker: King Kandur Hosidius
the-council-s-end-coronation-ceremony.text: I did. Sorry to take you away from the festivities. With everyone else celebrating, I thought it would be a good chance to talk in private. Don't worry. It won't take long.

the-council-s-end-coronation-ceremony.player: It's not a problem. What did you want to discuss?

the-council-s-end-coronation-ceremony.speaker: King Kandur Hosidius
the-council-s-end-coronation-ceremony.text: The councillors are behind bars and Kourend has a new ruler. On the surface, all is well again. Of course, that's not quite the case in reality.

the-council-s-end-coronation-ceremony.player: You mean Xamphur?

the-council-s-end-coronation-ceremony.speaker: King Kandur Hosidius
the-council-s-end-coronation-ceremony.text: Yes. The Council did not act alone. In fact, they weren't even the true orchestrators in this. We need to find and deal with the real foe before it's too late.

the-council-s-end-coronation-ceremony.player: I'd be happy to help in any way I can. Xamphur and I have unfinished business.

the-council-s-end-coronation-ceremony.speaker: King Kandur Hosidius
the-council-s-end-coronation-ceremony.text: I was hoping you'd say that. This is a serious threat we're facing, and I need people I can trust.

the-council-s-end-coronation-ceremony.player: So, what do you need me to do?

the-council-s-end-coronation-ceremony.speaker: King Kandur Hosidius
the-council-s-end-coronation-ceremony.text: Nothing for now. I just wanted to make sure you were on board. Once we have more information on Xamphur, I will let you know.

the-council-s-end-coronation-ceremony.speaker: King Kandur Hosidius
the-council-s-end-coronation-ceremony.text: Now, we should head back downstairs before we are missed.
A knife is launched at the king's back.

the-council-s-end-coronation-ceremony.player: Is everything alright, Your Majesty?

the-council-s-end-coronation-ceremony.speaker: King Kandur Hosidius
the-council-s-end-coronation-ceremony.text: I... I can't...
The king falls, and an assassin is revealed to the player.

the-council-s-end-coronation-ceremony.speaker: Assassin
the-council-s-end-coronation-ceremony.text: Kandur Hosidius. You have been marked for death.
The assassin teleports away, and the cutscene ends.

the-council-s-end-coronation-ceremony.player: Hey Lydia. How are you doing?

the-council-s-end-coronation-ceremony.speaker: Commander Fullore
the-council-s-end-coronation-ceremony.text: It's been a rough few days since the coronation, as you can probably imagine. One moment we were crowning a new king, that next we were burying him. I'm doing okay, though. Work is a good distraction.

the-council-s-end-coronation-ceremony.player: And how's that going?

the-council-s-end-coronation-ceremony.speaker: Commander Fullore
the-council-s-end-coronation-ceremony.text: Well Artur Hosidius is now the King of Great Kourend. I'm sorry you couldn't be there for the ceremony. After what happened, they felt something small would be best.

the-council-s-end-coronation-ceremony.player: That's fine. I think one coronation was enough for me. Any word on the killer?

the-council-s-end-coronation-ceremony.speaker: Commander Fullore
the-council-s-end-coronation-ceremony.text: There's no shortage of potential suspects, but nothing solid. We've had the murder weapon sent over to Lovakengj to be examined. They have a theory, but want to do more work before they confirm it.

the-council-s-end-coronation-ceremony.player: Well let me know once they have something. I want to find whoever did this.

the-council-s-end-coronation-ceremony.speaker: Commander Fullore
the-council-s-end-coronation-ceremony.text: We will.

the-council-s-end-coronation-ceremony.player: Anything else I can do in the meantime?

the-council-s-end-coronation-ceremony.speaker: Commander Fullore
the-council-s-end-coronation-ceremony.text: I don't think so. Lord Arceuus is trying to find out more about Xamphur, but he doesn't have anything yet. For now, all we can do is wait.

the-council-s-end-coronation-ceremony.speaker: Commander Fullore
the-council-s-end-coronation-ceremony.text: And on that note, I wanted to give you a little something to thank you for all that you've done. Not just for Kourend, but for me as well.

the-council-s-end-coronation-ceremony.speaker: Commander Fullore
the-council-s-end-coronation-ceremony.text: This is a bad situation we're in, but without you things would be a whole lot worse. Lord Arceuus also sent something over for you. He said you'd know what to do with it.

the-council-s-end-coronation-ceremony.speaker: Commander Fullore
the-council-s-end-coronation-ceremony.text: Now, I'll let you get going. Thanks again, for everything.
Congratulations! Quest complete!

options.text: What am I meant to be doing again?

steps.player: What am I meant to be doing again?

steps.speaker: Mysterious Stranger
steps.text: Enter the Theatre and beat the challenges within. Doing so would cause great embarrasment to Verzik, and my associates would very much appreciate it.

options.text: Can I get those teleport crystals you mentioned?

steps.player: Okay, thanks.
What's all this really about?

steps.speaker: Mysterious Stranger
steps.text: What do you mean?

steps.player: Well you don't really expect me to believe you're just here to embarrass Verzik do you? What's really going on?

steps.speaker: Mysterious Stranger
steps.text: My associates prefer to keep their intentions to themselves. However, if you were to assist us with another matter, I might be able to share more.

steps.prompt: Start the A Night at the Theatre quest?

steps.player: What do you need?

steps.speaker: Mysterious Stranger
steps.text: Your suspicions are correct. My role here is not to embarrass Verzik Vitur. Instead, my associates have a long history with Verzik, and have sent me here to keep an eye on her.

steps.player: So you're spying on her? Then why are you asking people to go and 'embarrass' her?

steps.speaker: Mysterious Stranger
steps.text: Research.

steps.player: Research?

steps.speaker: Mysterious Stranger
steps.text: Yes. As you're aware, of all those that go into the Theatre, the vast majority never come out. That said, some have managed to succeed. Of course, the vampyres would never let the citizens know this.

steps.speaker: Mysterious Stranger
steps.text: Thanks to these successes, I've been able to gather information on Verzik and her abilities.

steps.player: Ah, so they're the ones that have been doing the spying. Still, that doesn't explain what this is all for.

steps.speaker: Mysterious Stranger
steps.text: Verzik has abilities unlike any other vampyre. However, she did not always possess these abilities. My associates are keen to discover how she obtained them.
If the player has beaten Verzik before:

steps.player: You mean that thing she does where she turns into a spider?

steps.speaker: Mysterious Stranger
steps.text: Exactly.

steps.player: Right, I think I understand now. So where do I come in?

steps.speaker: Mysterious Stranger
steps.text: These were recently recovered from within the Theatre. Take a look at them.
The Mysterious Stranger shows you some eggs.

steps.player: Eggs?

steps.speaker: Mysterious Stranger
steps.text: Not just any eggs. These are the eggs of a nylocas, one of Verzik's arachnid pets.

steps.speaker: Mysterious Stranger
steps.text: Normally this wouldn't be anything special. After all, Verzik has hundreds of nylocas. However, these eggs are from a variant we've never encountered before.

steps.speaker: Mysterious Stranger
steps.text: What's more interesting than that though is how they were obtained. For lack of a better description, the mercenary who recovered them claimed they 'fell out' of Verzik herself.

steps.player: Verzik laid some eggs?

steps.speaker: Mysterious Stranger
steps.text: Apparently so.

steps.player: How lovely. I think you've safely put me off my food for the rest of today. So you think these eggs are somehow connected to her unique abilities?

steps.speaker: Mysterious Stranger
steps.text: It would line up with some suspicions my associates have had for a while.
If the player hasn't beaten Verzik before:

steps.player: And I suppose you want me to look into this?

steps.text: If the player has beaten Verzik before:

steps.player: Not to mention the whole turning into a spider thing I guess. I suppose you want me to look into this?

steps.speaker: Mysterious Stranger
steps.text: That is correct. I also believe you have a friend who can help.

steps.player: I have a friend?

steps.speaker: Mysterious Stranger
steps.text: A dead one.

steps.player: Ah, that sounds about right. Which dead friend are we talking about here?

steps.speaker: Mysterious Stranger
steps.text: Ranis Drakan.

steps.player: Right... And how's a dead vampyre going to help us exactly?

steps.speaker: Mysterious Stranger
steps.text: My kind have the ability to relive our memories as if they are happening again. We can also relive the memories of others if we are able to make physical contact with them. I could show you if you want?

steps.player: Please don't go poking through my memories. Also, what do you mean by 'your kind'?

steps.speaker: Mysterious Stranger
steps.text: I am not at liberty to say.

steps.player: Of course. How silly of me. And you want to relive Ranis' memories I'm guessing? Will that even work now that he's dead?

steps.speaker: Mysterious Stranger
steps.text: We are lucky that vampyre corpses deteriorate slower than many other species. Enough of his brain should still be intact for me to work with.

steps.player: Err... Nice. What's he got to do with these eggs though?

steps.speaker: Mysterious Stranger
steps.text: Ranis and Verzik were close friends. He interacted with her more than anyone else did. Getting close enough to Verzik to observe her own memories will be... problematic. He is the next best option.

steps.speaker: Mysterious Stranger
steps.text: Within his memories we can hopefully learn more about Verzik and her abilities. As for the eggs, they are our catalyst.

steps.speaker: Mysterious Stranger
steps.text: It would take years to search through all of Ranis' mind, but I can use these eggs to help us find relevant memories much faster.

steps.speaker: Mysterious Stranger
steps.text: Now, I must remain here. That means you will need to recover Ranis for us.

steps.player: And where can I find him?

steps.speaker: Mysterious Stranger
steps.text: Luckily for us, Ranis always loved the Theatre. As such, he is actually buried deep below it. You can use the staircase to the north east to access his crypt.

steps.speaker: Mysterious Stranger
steps.text: Be careful, it's well guarded. Even other vampyres are not allowed in. I suggest you take that flail of yours.

steps.speaker: Mysterious Stranger
steps.text: Also, you don't need to bring his whole body back of course. That wouldn't be very subtle. We only need his brain.

steps.player: Brains are generally attached to the body you know.

steps.speaker: Mysterious Stranger
steps.text: I know. That's why I'd recommend you take a saw.

steps.player: Oh... Oh god.

steps.speaker: Mysterious Stranger
steps.text: Good luck.

steps.player: Actually, I'm not that interested.

steps.speaker: Mysterious Stranger
steps.text: As you wish. Return to me if you change your mind.

options.text: Can I get those teleport crystals you mentioned?

steps.player: Not yet.

steps.speaker: Mysterious Stranger
steps.text: Return to me when that changes.

starting-off-if-the-player-has-cleared-t.player: Yes! After beating all of her challenges, she chose to face me herself. I couldn't fully defeat her though. She just transformed into a bat and flew away.

starting-off-if-the-player-has-cleared-t.speaker: Mysterious Stranger
starting-off-if-the-player-has-cleared-t.text: Very impressive. I had a feeling you would have what it takes.

starting-off-if-the-player-has-cleared-t.speaker: Mysterious Stranger
starting-off-if-the-player-has-cleared-t.text: Verzik will be back soon enough. Death will not come easy for her. However, you have still been of great use to my associates.

options.text: Can I get those teleport crystals you mentioned?

options.text: What's this thing you need from me?

steps.player: Where can I find Ranis?

steps.text: You can use the staircase to the north east to access his crypt. Remember, you don't need to bring his whole body back. We only need his brain. I'd recommend you take a saw.

options.text: Can I get those teleport crystals you mentioned?

entering-ranis-crypt-obtaining-ranis-hea.player: Well this is probably one of the more disgusting things I've ever done. Here goes nothing...

entering-ranis-crypt-obtaining-ranis-hea.text: You get to work on removing Ranis' head.
You successfully remove the head of Ranis Drakan.

entering-ranis-crypt-obtaining-ranis-hea.player: Hey there Ranis. Didn't expect to see you again. How are you doing?
Well I think I might be at my lowest point in life right now. I really need to find a hobby or something.

entering-ranis-crypt-searching-coffin-wi.text: You search the coffin and find the head of Ranis Drakan, but you don't have enough room to take it.

entering-ranis-crypt-searching-coffin-wh.text: You search the coffin and find the headless body of Ranis Drakan. Lovely.

entering-ranis-crypt-getting-the-head-ag.text: You search the coffin and find the head of Ranis Drakan.

talking-to-the-mysterious-stranger-after.speaker: Mysterious Stranger
talking-to-the-mysterious-stranger-after.text: You again. What can I do for you?

options.text: I managed to recover Ranis' head.

steps.player: I managed to recover Ranis' head.

steps.speaker: Mysterious Stranger
steps.text: Good work. Hand it over.
If the player lost the head:

steps.player: Well... I seem to have lost it.

steps.speaker: Mysterious Stranger
steps.text: You should probably go and find it again then.
You give Ranis' head to the Mysterious Stranger.

steps.speaker: Mysterious Stranger
steps.text: Hmm... Yes, I think this will work.

steps.player: So what now?

steps.speaker: Mysterious Stranger
steps.text: It seems that Ranis has many memories of these eggs, or at least of something very similar. Thanks to my abilities, we can view these memories. Hopefully they will reveal the truth about Verzik.

steps.speaker: Mysterious Stranger
steps.text: Now, I suggest we start at the beginning. Take my hand.

steps.player: Why are you making this weird?

steps.speaker: Mysterious Stranger
steps.text: I require physical contact to share the memory with you.

steps.player: Oh... Fair enough.

steps.speaker: Mysterious Stranger
steps.text: Prepare yourself!
The first of Ranis' memories are displayed in the player's mind. Ranis Drakan, at The Maiden of Sugadinti's chamber, is seen with a vyrewatch.

steps.speaker: Ranis Drakan
steps.text: Do you have them?

steps.speaker: Vyrewatch
steps.text: Right here, my lord.

steps.speaker: Ranis Drakan
steps.text: Excellent. I will take them from here.

steps.speaker: Vyrewatch
steps.text: Of course.
Ranis Drakan walks towards Verzik Vitur.

steps.speaker: Verzik Vitur
steps.text: Ranis my dear, how wonderful to see you.

steps.speaker: Ranis Drakan
steps.text: And you Verzik.

steps.speaker: Ranis Drakan
steps.text: I see you've wasted no time in introducing our new guest to the Theatre.

steps.speaker: Ranis Drakan
steps.text: I must say, I find the name you've given her to be quite interesting. Not the kind of thing I'd have expected from you.

steps.speaker: Verzik Vitur
steps.text: Well I thought it would be quite humorous.

steps.speaker: Ranis Drakan
steps.text: I see. So you intend to use her as a new challenge?

steps.speaker: Verzik Vitur
steps.text: It seemed an ironically fitting role for her, given that fun little narrative you came up with. Besides, with all the work you put in, it would have felt wrong to just abandon her.

steps.speaker: Ranis Drakan
steps.text: You should not have worried about that. The things we learnt from her down in the labs more than made up for the effort.

steps.speaker: Verzik Vitur
steps.text: Well either way, I'm glad she's here. I've found her to be quite the inspiration. Thanks to her, I've decided to give the whole place a bit of a sprucing up.

steps.speaker: Ranis Drakan
steps.text: You're replacing all the challenges?

steps.speaker: Verzik Vitur
steps.text: Absolutely! Those old ones were getting dull. It's time for some fresh excitement in this place.

steps.speaker: Ranis Drakan
steps.text: Well perhaps I have something that can help with that. I have a gift for you.

steps.speaker: Verzik Vitur
steps.text: A gift? Oh Ranis you do spoil me!

steps.speaker: Ranis Drakan
steps.text: You can thank Lowerniel for this one. He found these eggs in an arachnid nest north of Darkmeyer. He thought you might be able to use them in your nylocas breeding program.

steps.speaker: Verzik Vitur
steps.text: How exciting! Do pass on my thanks. He is always welcome to come and pay me a visit himself, of course.

steps.speaker: Ranis Drakan
steps.text: The Theatre has never really been his thing.

steps.speaker: Verzik Vitur
steps.text: Oh Ranis, I do love your brother, but he is such a bore! He needs to learn to live a little!

steps.speaker: Verzik Vitur
steps.text: Anyway, tell me more about this nest.

steps.speaker: Ranis Drakan
steps.text: The arachnids there are highly unique. Lowerniel thinks their queen might be of a higher power.

steps.speaker: Verzik Vitur
steps.text: A higher power? He doesn't think that silly stone he used to have is involved, does he?

steps.speaker: Ranis Drakan
steps.text: No, he suspects something more natural.

steps.speaker: Verzik Vitur
steps.text: Really? Well either way, if he's right, these eggs could be key to some very exciting new nylocas.

steps.speaker: Ranis Drakan
steps.text: I look forward to seeing the results.

steps.speaker: Verzik Vitur
steps.text: As do I...
The cutscene ends.

steps.speaker: Mysterious Stranger
steps.text: Interesting... Very interesting...

steps.player: That was Verzik?

steps.speaker: Mysterious Stranger
steps.text: It was. However, the memory was from many years ago, before she gained her unique abilities.

steps.player: I see. So what's our next step?

steps.speaker: Mysterious Stranger
steps.text: The eggs in that memory were very similar to the ones in my possession, but they were not identical. It sounded like Verzik intended to use them to breed new nylocas.

steps.player: Perhaps that breeding is what led to the eggs you have.

steps.speaker: Mysterious Stranger
steps.text: And perhaps it was also the starting point for Verzik's abilities.

steps.player: How can we be sure?

steps.speaker: Mysterious Stranger
steps.text: We will need to recover some of those eggs for ourselves. With them, we may be able to find further relevant memories.

steps.player: Ranis said they came from a nest north of Darkmeyer. I'll see if I can find it.

steps.speaker: Mysterious Stranger
steps.text: Good idea. I will remain here.

steps.player: Any reason why you're not able to join me?
Actually, let me guess. Your associates...

steps.speaker: Mysterious Stranger
steps.text: My associates would prefer I remain here.

steps.player: I'm not sure why I asked. I'll be back once I've explored this nest.

options.text: Can I get those teleport crystals you mentioned?

talking-to-the-mysterious-stranger-after.speaker: Mysterious Stranger
talking-to-the-mysterious-stranger-after.text: You again. What can I do for you?

options.text: So what are we doing with Ranis' head?

steps.player: So what are we doing with Ranis' head?

steps.speaker: Mysterious Stranger
steps.text: It seems that Ranis has many memories of these eggs, or at least of something very similar. Thanks to my abilities, we can view these memories. Hopefully they will reveal the truth about Verzik.

options.text: Can I get those teleport crystals you mentioned?

talking-to-the-mysterious-stranger-after.speaker: Mysterious Stranger
talking-to-the-mysterious-stranger-after.text: You again. What can I do for you?

steps.player: So about that memory...

steps.speaker: Mysterious Stranger
steps.text: What about it?

steps.player: That was Verzik?

options.text: Can I get those teleport crystals you mentioned?

talking-to-the-mysterious-stranger-after.speaker: Mysterious Stranger
talking-to-the-mysterious-stranger-after.text: You again. What can I do for you?

options.text: Where can I find that nest?

steps.player: Where can I find that nest?

steps.speaker: Mysterious Stranger
steps.text: It's supposedly just north of Darkmeyer. Go there and see if you can find any eggs matching the ones Ranis gave to Verzik.

steps.player: Alright. I'll be back once I've explored this nest.

options.text: Can I get those teleport crystals you mentioned?

the-strange-spider-eggs-attempting-to-op.text: You try to rip open to egg sac, but it's too strong.

the-strange-spider-eggs-searching-the-sk.text: If the player has inventory space:

steps.text: You search the skeleton and find a sticky note.

the-strange-spider-eggs-searching-the-sk.text: If the player has no inventory space:

steps.text: You search the skeleton and find a sticky note, but you don't have enough room to take it.

steps.player: Got any sulphuric acid?

steps.speaker: Daer Krand
steps.text: What? What for?

steps.player: Well I was exploring a cave west of here and I think I found your assistant.

steps.speaker: Daer Krand
steps.text: I was wondering where she got to. Where is she now?

steps.player: Ah yes... About that...

steps.speaker: Daer Krand
steps.text: Well?

steps.player: Well... she's dead I'm afraid. Looks like the spiders in the cave killed her. Ate most of her as well...

steps.speaker: Daer Krand
steps.text: What a disaster! It's going to take forever to find a new willing assistant who's competent as well.

steps.player: Yeah... Oddly enough I can't imagine many people will be queueing up to go get themselves eaten by spiders for you.
Still, if it helps, it looks like she did find what she was after. There's an egg sac near where I found her. If I had some sulphuric acid, I could melt through it.

steps.speaker: Daer Krand
steps.text: Well I suppose I can give you some. Consider it a thank you for bringing me the news about my assistant.
If the player has no inventory space:
Daer Krand tries to give you some sulphuric acid, but you don't have enough room to take it.

steps.speaker: Daer Krand
steps.text: Come back when you have some room for it.
If the player has inventory space:
Daer Krand gives you some sulphuric acid.

steps.player: Thanks! Want me to bring you some of those eggs?

steps.speaker: Daer Krand
steps.text: No, it's fine. I'll send my new assistant to get me some... Once I find a new assistant anyway.

steps.player: Got any sulphuric acid?

steps.speaker: Daer Krand
steps.text: Yes, here you go.
If the player has no inventory space:

steps.speaker: Daer Krand
steps.text: Come back when you have some room for it.
If the player has inventory space:
Daer Krand gives you some sulphuric acid.

steps.player: Thanks!
Got any sulphuric acid?

steps.text: If the player still has the acid:

steps.speaker: Daer Krand
steps.text: Looks like you already have some.

steps.player: Oh... So I do. Thanks.

steps.speaker: Daer Krand
steps.text: Did I not already give you some?

steps.player: Maybe?

steps.speaker: Daer Krand
steps.text: Oh... Well I suppose I can spare some.
If the player has no inventory space:
Daer Krand tries to give you some sulphuric acid, but you don't have enough room to take it.

steps.speaker: Daer Krand
steps.text: Come back when you have some room for it.
Daer Krand gives you some sulphuric acid.

steps.player: Thanks!

the-strange-spider-eggs-opening-the-egg-.text: You use the acid to melt through the egg sac.
You take some strange spider eggs from within the egg sac.

the-strange-spider-eggs-taking-the-egg-s.text: If the player has no inventory space:

steps.text: You search the egg sac and find some strange spider eggs, but you don't have enough room to take them.

the-strange-spider-eggs-taking-the-egg-s.text: If the player has inventory space:

steps.text: You search the egg sac and find some strange spider eggs.

talking-to-the-mysterious-stranger-after.speaker: Mysterious Stranger
talking-to-the-mysterious-stranger-after.text: You again. What can I do for you?

options.text: I found some of those eggs.

steps.player: I found some of those eggs.

steps.speaker: Mysterious Stranger
steps.text: Excellent. Let's have a look at them.
If the player lost the eggs:

steps.player: I don't actually have them with me.

steps.speaker: Mysterious Stranger
steps.text: Well I'll need you to bring them here. They could be key to understanding Verzik's abilities.
You give the strange spider eggs to the Mysterious Stranger.

steps.speaker: Mysterious Stranger
steps.text: Hmm... How curious...

steps.speaker: Mysterious Stranger
steps.text: I believe I can use these new eggs to help us find more memories of note. Hopefully they will start to present a clearer picture for us.

steps.player: Well that would be nice. I'm still a bit lost to be honest... Then again, I guess that's just the norm for me.

steps.speaker: Mysterious Stranger
steps.text: Once we're done, I'll also have the eggs sent to my associates. Assuming they do have a connection to Verzik's abilities, they will come in very useful.

steps.player: Your associates aren't trying to replicate her powers are they?

steps.speaker: Mysterious Stranger
steps.text: Oh quite the opposite. Their hope is to find a way to counteract them.

steps.player: Interesting...

steps.speaker: Mysterious Stranger
steps.text: Anyway, I think I have found a new memory for us.

steps.player: Let's take a look.

steps.speaker: Mysterious Stranger
steps.text: Prepare yourself!
Ranis' second memory is viewed. Ranis, alongside Verzik, meet in the Pestilent Bloat's chamber.

steps.speaker: Ranis Drakan
steps.text: Bloat? Not the most elaborate of names, is it?

steps.speaker: Verzik Vitur
steps.text: A crude name for a crude creation.

steps.speaker: Ranis Drakan
steps.text: Well it's most definitely crude... Quite disgusting as well.

steps.speaker: Verzik Vitur
steps.text: Turns your stomach, does it Ranis? I'm surprised you'd find anything disgusting after what you did to that girl.

steps.speaker: Ranis Drakan
steps.text: I just think it's important to take a bit of pride in your work. This is a Theatre, Verzik. We should be producing art!

steps.speaker: Verzik Vitur
steps.text: Ranis darling, I couldn't agree more. Come have a look at this.
Ranis and Verzik walk towards a Nylocas Athanatos.

steps.speaker: Ranis Drakan
steps.text: A new nylocas?

steps.speaker: Verzik Vitur
steps.text: The athanatos! Isn't it magnificent!

steps.speaker: Ranis Drakan
steps.text: It's quite a sight to behold.

steps.speaker: Verzik Vitur
steps.text: I have you and Lowerniel to thank for this one. This is the result of those eggs you gave me.

steps.speaker: Ranis Drakan
steps.text: I'm glad you were able to make good use of them.

steps.speaker: Verzik Vitur
steps.text: Oh I've been able to work wonders with them, and I'm not done yet. If all goes well, the athanatos will be just the beginning...
The cutscene ends.

steps.speaker: Mysterious Stranger
steps.text: So Verzik did manage to use those eggs to create new nylocas. However, something is still missing.

steps.player: Is there another memory that could tell us more?

steps.speaker: Mysterious Stranger
steps.text: Yes, I believe there is. Let us see what it can tell us.

steps.speaker: Mysterious Stranger
steps.text: Prepare yourself!
Ranis' third memory is viewed. Ranis, alongside Verzik, meet in the nylocas chamber.

steps.speaker: Ranis Drakan
steps.text: My my... You've really outdone yourself this time.

steps.speaker: Verzik Vitur
steps.text: Ranis you flatterer!

steps.speaker: Ranis Drakan
steps.text: So was this one also the result of those eggs?

steps.speaker: Verzik Vitur
steps.text: Much more boring I'm afraid. I still have plans for those eggs, but I'm missing a key aspect right now. Don't worry, I'm sure I'll get it worked out.

steps.speaker: Ranis Drakan
steps.text: Perhaps I can help. What are you missing?

steps.speaker: Verzik Vitur
steps.text: Oh Ranis, you're not trying to steal my thunder are you?

steps.speaker: Ranis Drakan
steps.text: Verzik, you know I wouldn't...

steps.speaker: Verzik Vitur
steps.text: Just joking Ranis! I know you're far too noble for that.

steps.speaker: Verzik Vitur
steps.text: The thing I need is something with the ability to regenerate. Nylocas are strong in numbers, but far too weak on their own.

steps.speaker: Ranis Drakan
steps.text: Hmm... I think I know just the thing. When we created the Maiden, we experimented heavily in that area.

steps.speaker: Verzik Vitur
steps.text: Ah, of course. You and your haemalchemy.

steps.speaker: Ranis Drakan
steps.text: Well in the end it wasn't actually haemalchemy that gave us the answer. It came in the form of a gift from the old queen.

steps.speaker: Verzik Vitur
steps.text: Not another of her plants was it?

steps.speaker: Ranis Drakan
steps.text: Precisely that! Specifically the hespori. Their bark has wonderful regenerative abilities.

steps.speaker: Verzik Vitur
steps.text: I see... Yes, I think that might just work. Thank you, Ranis.
The cutscene ends.

steps.speaker: Mysterious Stranger
steps.text: Hespori... Of course.
If the player has grown a hespori before:

steps.player: I've grown a hespori before!

steps.text: If the player hasn't grown a hespori before:

steps.player: What's a hespori?

steps.speaker: Mysterious Stranger
steps.text: They are remarkable plants with a will of their own. Not to mention their many unique properties...

steps.speaker: Mysterious Stranger
steps.text: They were grown here back when this place was still known as Hallowvale. The Saradominist Queen of the region used them as weapons against the vampyres.

steps.player: You know your history.

steps.speaker: Mysterious Stranger
steps.text: More than most.

steps.speaker: Mysterious Stranger
steps.text: It sounds like the vampyres found multiple uses for the hespori. Not only did they play a part in the creation of the Maiden of Sugadinti, but they were also potentially used to make a new nylocas.

steps.player: I'm guessing this is the bit where I retrieve some hespori bark for us.
