steps.speaker: Mysterious Stranger
steps.text: You are correct. However, I'd suggest you collect some from a naturally occuring hespori rather than one you've grown yourself.

steps.player: Do you know where I can find one?

steps.speaker: Mysterious Stranger
steps.text: They are native to Morytania, but they are quite rare. I'm afraid I'm not an expert on nature.

steps.player: Hmm... I know of a nature spirit who lives in the swamp. He can probably help.

steps.speaker: Mysterious Stranger
steps.text: Perfect. I will await your return.

options.text: Can I get those teleport crystals you mentioned?

talking-to-the-mysterious-stranger-after.speaker: Mysterious Stranger
talking-to-the-mysterious-stranger-after.text: You again. What can I do for you?

options.text: So we have the eggs. Now what?

steps.player: So we have the eggs. Now what?

steps.speaker: Mysterious Stranger
steps.text: I believe I can use these new eggs to help us find more memories of note. Hopefully they will start to present a clearer picture for us.

options.text: Can I get those teleport crystals you mentioned?

talking-to-the-mysterious-stranger-after.speaker: Mysterious Stranger
talking-to-the-mysterious-stranger-after.text: You again. What can I do for you?

options.text: That memory didn't tell us too much.

steps.player: That memory didn't tell us too much.

steps.speaker: Mysterious Stranger
steps.text: It seems Verzik did manage to use those eggs to create new nylocas. However, something is still missing.

steps.player: Is there another memory that could tell us more?

options.text: Can I get those teleport crystals you mentioned?

talking-to-the-mysterious-stranger-after.speaker: Mysterious Stranger
talking-to-the-mysterious-stranger-after.text: You again. What can I do for you?

steps.player: That memory seemed more useful.

steps.speaker: Mysterious Stranger
steps.text: Indeed. It seems a hespori is key to our next steps.
If the player has grown a hespori before:

steps.player: I've grown a hespori before!

steps.text: If the player hasn't grown a hespori before:

steps.player: What's a hespori?

options.text: Can I get those teleport crystals you mentioned?

talking-to-the-mysterious-stranger-after.speaker: Mysterious Stranger
talking-to-the-mysterious-stranger-after.text: You again. What can I do for you?

options.text: Where can I find a hespori?

steps.player: Where can I find a hespori?

steps.speaker: Mysterious Stranger
steps.text: I'm not sure. They are native to Morytania, but they are quite rare. You mentioned a nature spirit who could help.

steps.player: That's right! He lives in the swamp.

steps.speaker: Mysterious Stranger
steps.text: Then you should go and speak to him. I will await your return.

options.text: Can I get those teleport crystals you mentioned?

the-hespori-bark-talking-to-the-nature-s.speaker: Nature Spirit
the-hespori-bark-talking-to-the-nature-s.text: Welcome back, my friend. I sense that you need my help with something.

the-hespori-bark-talking-to-the-nature-s.player: That's right! I'm looking for a hespori. I was hoping you might know where one is.

the-hespori-bark-talking-to-the-nature-s.speaker: Nature Spirit
the-hespori-bark-talking-to-the-nature-s.text: Ah, a hespori. They're wonderful plants. Why are you looking for one?

the-hespori-bark-talking-to-the-nature-s.speaker: Nature Spirit
the-hespori-bark-talking-to-the-nature-s.text: I see... Well do be very careful. Hespori are rare enough as it is without people damaging them.

the-hespori-bark-talking-to-the-nature-s.player: Yeah... I'm definitely not going to damage it in any way.

the-hespori-bark-talking-to-the-nature-s.speaker: Nature Spirit
the-hespori-bark-talking-to-the-nature-s.text: Yes! I can sense the presence of a hespori near here. It's to the north east, on a small island in the swamp.

the-hespori-bark-talking-to-the-nature-s.speaker: Nature Spirit
the-hespori-bark-talking-to-the-nature-s.text: For you my friend, it is no problem at all.

the-hespori-bark-talking-to-the-nature-s.speaker: Nature Spirit
the-hespori-bark-talking-to-the-nature-s.text: Welcome back, my friend. Did you find that hespori?

the-hespori-bark-talking-to-the-nature-s.player: Can you remind me where it is?

the-hespori-bark-talking-to-the-nature-s.speaker: Nature Spirit
the-hespori-bark-talking-to-the-nature-s.text: I can sense it to the north east, on a small island in the swamp.

the-hespori-bark-chopping-the-hespori.text: If the player does not have a proper axe:

steps.text: To chop the hespori, you'll need an axe that you have the Woodcutting level to use.

the-hespori-bark-chopping-the-hespori.text: If the player has not previously killed the Hespori:

steps.text: (The Hespori attacks.)

the-hespori-bark-chopping-the-hespori.text: If the player has no inventory space:

steps.text: Your inventory is too full to do that.

the-hespori-bark-chopping-the-hespori.text: If the player does not already have bark:

steps.text: You chop some bark from the hespori.

the-hespori-bark-chopping-the-hespori.text: If the player already has bark:

steps.text: You already have some hespori bark.

talking-to-the-mysterious-stranger-after.speaker: Mysterious Stranger
talking-to-the-mysterious-stranger-after.text: You again. What can I do for you?

steps.player: I found a hespori.

steps.speaker: Mysterious Stranger
steps.text: Perfect. Do you have some bark from it?
If the player does not have the bark:

steps.player: Not yet.

steps.speaker: Mysterious Stranger
steps.text: Then you should go and recover some. Be careful, for it will likely fight back. I will await your return.
You give the hespori bark to the Mysterious Stranger.

steps.speaker: Mysterious Stranger
steps.text: Excellent. This is just what we needed.

steps.player: Can it help us find more memories?

steps.speaker: Mysterious Stranger
steps.text: Yes, I think so. Let me see what I can find...

steps.speaker: Mysterious Stranger
steps.text: Ah, here we go. I believe we're getting close now.

steps.speaker: Mysterious Stranger
steps.text: Prepare yourself!
Ranis' fourth memory is viewed. Ranis, alongside Verzik, meet in Sotetseg's chamber.

steps.speaker: Verzik Vitur
steps.text: Power over the Shadow Realm you say? That takes me back to the old empire.

steps.speaker: Ranis Drakan
steps.text: That was the inspiration. Alas, the experiments didn't really go anywhere in the end.

steps.speaker: Verzik Vitur
steps.text: Such a pity. Still, he will make for a fine new challenge here. As always Ranis, you are far too generous.

steps.speaker: Ranis Drakan
steps.text: Speaking of experiments, did you think any more on my hespori suggestion for that new nylocas?

steps.speaker: Verzik Vitur
steps.text: That I did. It's going very well so far. Still too early to be sure, but I think this could be the one.

steps.speaker: Ranis Drakan
steps.text: The one?

steps.speaker: Verzik Vitur
steps.text: Absolutely! The nylocas to end all nylocas.

steps.speaker: Ranis Drakan
steps.text: That's quite the ambition. So when do we get to see the results?

steps.speaker: Verzik Vitur
steps.text: Patience now Ranis. You can't rush perfection. It won't be long now, I'm sure of it...
The cutscene ends.

steps.speaker: Mysterious Stranger
steps.text: Interesting, but not overly illuminating. Still, we are not far off now.

steps.speaker: Mysterious Stranger
steps.text: There is one final memory. Let us hope it provides the answers we seek.

steps.player: Alright. Let's take a look.

steps.speaker: Mysterious Stranger
steps.text: Prepare yourself!
Ranis' fifth and final memory is viewed. Ranis, alongside Verzik, meet in Xarpus' chamber.

steps.speaker: Verzik Vitur
steps.text: The last King of the yarasa... I never thought I'd see one of their kind again.

steps.speaker: Verzik Vitur
steps.text: Does this mean Lowerniel finally found a way home?

steps.speaker: Ranis Drakan
steps.text: It would seem so, but he did not enlighten me on how he did it.

steps.speaker: Verzik Vitur
steps.text: Fascinating...

steps.speaker: Verzik Vitur
steps.text: Anyway, I have something you simply have to see. Come take a look.

steps.speaker: Ranis Drakan
steps.text: Is this...?

steps.speaker: Verzik Vitur
steps.text: This is the one Ranis. This is my new Queen Nylocas. All that work has finally paid off.

steps.speaker: Ranis Drakan
steps.text: It's very small.

steps.speaker: Verzik Vitur
steps.text: Oh don't worry darling, it will grow. I'll have to come up with a fancy name as well.
The spider bites Verzik, and dies.

steps.speaker: Verzik Vitur
steps.text: Ouch! You little...

steps.speaker: Verzik Vitur
steps.text: Oh...

steps.speaker: Ranis Drakan
steps.text: Not what you were expecting?

steps.speaker: Verzik Vitur
steps.text: I really thought this was the one...

steps.speaker: Verzik Vitur
steps.text: Back to square one I guess. What a waste.
The cutscene ends.

steps.player: That was it? She made a new nylocas, it bit her and it just died?

steps.speaker: Mysterious Stranger
steps.text: We have still gained a lot here. That bite almost certainly led to her abilities, and we know how the nylocas variant responsible was created.

steps.speaker: Mysterious Stranger
steps.text: We even have the relevant materials as well. Between them and the knowledge we now have, my associates should be able to begin work on new weapons and techniques to use against Verzik.

steps.player: But who knows what may have happened after that bite... What if we're missing some key information?

steps.speaker: Mysterious Stranger
steps.text: I admit, while hopefully not essential, clarity on what happened next would be very useful. However, Ranis has no further memories of use to us. There's likely to only be one place to find the truth now.

steps.player: You mean Verzik herself?

steps.speaker: Mysterious Stranger
steps.text: Correct. But for me to gain access to Verzik's memories, I'd need to make physical contact with her. That would require us to enter the Theatre, something I was quite keen to avoid.
If the player has completed a Theatre of Blood raid previously:

steps.player: I've made it through the Theatre before. I could do it again.

steps.text: If the player has not completed a Theatre of Blood raid previously:

steps.player: I've never made it through the Theatre before, but I'm sure I can manage it.

steps.speaker: Mysterious Stranger
steps.text: True, but I am no fighter. However...

steps.player: What is it?

steps.speaker: Mysterious Stranger
steps.text: I know that there have been times when groups have entered the Theatre and had members not actually participate in the challenges.

steps.speaker: Mysterious Stranger
steps.text: Provided the more able members of the group succeed, these individuals are still considered to have beaten the challenge.

steps.player: So you want me to 'carry' you through the Theatre?

steps.speaker: Mysterious Stranger
steps.text: That is an apt way of putting it. If you can get me to Verzik, I should hopefully be able to extract the memories we need. The moment of defeat will be my best opportunity, when she is weakest.

steps.player: Okay, I think we can make this work.

steps.text: If the player has completed a Theatre of Blood raid previously:

steps.prompt: As you've completed the Theatre of Blood before, you can choose to skip this section if you wish.

steps.speaker: Mysterious Stranger
steps.text: You can still take other people in as well of course. Just use the notice board to set up a party and find suitable allies. Once you're ready, I will join you in the Theatre.

steps.player: In that case, I'll see you in there.

options.text: Can I get those teleport crystals you mentioned?

talking-to-the-mysterious-stranger-after.speaker: Mysterious Stranger
talking-to-the-mysterious-stranger-after.text: You again. What can I do for you?

options.text: Can we use this bark to find more memories?

steps.player: Can we use this bark to find more memories?

steps.speaker: Mysterious Stranger
steps.text: Yes, I think so. Let me see what I can find...

options.text: Can I get those teleport crystals you mentioned?

talking-to-the-mysterious-stranger-after.speaker: Mysterious Stranger
talking-to-the-mysterious-stranger-after.text: You again. What can I do for you?

options.text: Do you have any more memories for us to look at?

steps.player: Do you have any more memories for us to look at?

steps.speaker: Mysterious Stranger
steps.text: There is one final memory. Let us hope it provides the answers we seek.

options.text: Can I get those teleport crystals you mentioned?

talking-to-the-mysterious-stranger-after.speaker: Mysterious Stranger
talking-to-the-mysterious-stranger-after.text: You again. What can I do for you?

options.text: This Verzik business kind of feels like it's been a waste of time.

steps.player: This Verzik business kind of feels like it's been a waste of time.

steps.speaker: Mysterious Stranger
steps.text: How so?

steps.player: Verzik made a new nylocas, it bit her and it just died. That was it.

steps.speaker: Mysterious Stranger
steps.text: We have still gained a lot here. That bite almost certainly led to her abilities, and we know how the nylocas variant responsible was created.

options.text: Can I get those teleport crystals you mentioned?

talking-to-the-mysterious-stranger-after.speaker: Mysterious Stranger
talking-to-the-mysterious-stranger-after.text: You again. What can I do for you?

steps.player: Ready to enter the Theatre?

steps.speaker: Mysterious Stranger
steps.text: I am. Remember, you need to get me all the way to Verzik herself and then defeat her. When she is at her weakest, I should be able able to extract the memories we need.

steps.speaker: Mysterious Stranger
steps.text: Don't forget you can use the notice board to find suitable allies to join us if you don't feel comfortable doing this alone. I will join you inside once you are ready.

options.text: Can I get those teleport crystals you mentioned?

a-night-at-the-theatre-after-each-wave.speaker: Mysterious Stranger
a-night-at-the-theatre-after-each-wave.text: You fought well. Now, let us move on. We have to reach Verzik so that I can extract her memories.

a-night-at-the-theatre-the-maiden-of-sug.speaker: Mysterious Stranger
a-night-at-the-theatre-the-maiden-of-sug.text: The Maiden of Sugadinti. Such an ironic name.

a-night-at-the-theatre-the-maiden-of-sug.player: What do you know about her?

a-night-at-the-theatre-the-maiden-of-sug.speaker: Mysterious Stranger
a-night-at-the-theatre-the-maiden-of-sug.text: Not much more than you probably know yourself. Hers is a tragic tale of misguided hope.

a-night-at-the-theatre-the-maiden-of-sug.speaker: Mysterious Stranger
a-night-at-the-theatre-the-maiden-of-sug.text: You might find it useful to know that she's a powerful user of magic. Unsurprisingly, blood magic is her specialism. I hear she also has a habit of using nylocas to further increase her power.

a-night-at-the-theatre-pestilent-bloat.speaker: Mysterious Stranger
a-night-at-the-theatre-pestilent-bloat.text: The Pestilent Bloat. What a disgusting monstrosity.

a-night-at-the-theatre-pestilent-bloat.speaker: Mysterious Stranger
a-night-at-the-theatre-pestilent-bloat.text: Nothing fancier than some crude necromancy. Still, that doesn't mean it's not dangerous. Don't even try to take it head on. Wait for the perfect moment and attack while it is weak.

a-night-at-the-theatre-nylocas.speaker: Mysterious Stranger
a-night-at-the-theatre-nylocas.text: Some types. Alone they're not overly dangerous, but you'll never encounter them alone. Their power is in numbers.

a-night-at-the-theatre-nylocas.player: So how do I overcome that?

a-night-at-the-theatre-nylocas.speaker: Mysterious Stranger
a-night-at-the-theatre-nylocas.text: Different variants have different weaknesses. Prioritise your targets, and ensure you use the right weaponry against them.

a-night-at-the-theatre-sotetseg.speaker: Mysterious Stranger
a-night-at-the-theatre-sotetseg.text: Sotetseg. One of the greater mysteries of this Theatre.

a-night-at-the-theatre-sotetseg.speaker: Mysterious Stranger
a-night-at-the-theatre-sotetseg.text: He's some sort of modified dark beast. No dark beasts have ever been encountered in Morytania, so who knows how the vampyres got him here. Perhaps he is not of this world at all...

a-night-at-the-theatre-sotetseg.speaker: Mysterious Stranger
a-night-at-the-theatre-sotetseg.text: Be careful, for he has a strong affinity with the shadow realm. He will almost certainly use it against you. Expect the unexpected.

a-night-at-the-theatre-sotetseg.speaker: Mysterious Stranger
a-night-at-the-theatre-sotetseg.text: Yes. Survivors of the Theatre have spoken of some sort of strange shadowy maze.

a-night-at-the-theatre-xarpus.speaker: Mysterious Stranger
a-night-at-the-theatre-xarpus.text: The once great King of the yarasa. This prison is such a sad end for Xarpus.

a-night-at-the-theatre-xarpus.speaker: Mysterious Stranger
a-night-at-the-theatre-xarpus.text: Death would be preferable to a life of imprisonment. The Theatre is a testament to that.

a-night-at-the-theatre-xarpus.speaker: Mysterious Stranger
a-night-at-the-theatre-xarpus.text: Anyway, we are close now. Defeat Xarpus, and the path to Verzik is clear.

a-night-at-the-theatre-xarpus.speaker: Mysterious Stranger
a-night-at-the-theatre-xarpus.text: He will attempt to power himself up before he fights. Try and stop that where you can. Once the fight begins, be careful of his highly poisonous attacks.

a-night-at-the-theatre-verzik-vitur.speaker: Mysterious Stranger
a-night-at-the-theatre-verzik-vitur.text: You fought well. Now, only Verzik awaits. Remember, you must fully defeat her for me to have a chance to extract her memories. Let us proceed once you are ready.

the-final-memory-talking-to-the-mysterio.speaker: Mysterious Stranger
the-final-memory-talking-to-the-mysterio.text: You again. What can I do for you?

options.text: Did you manage to get any useful memories from Verzik?

steps.player: Did you manage to get any useful memories from Verzik?

steps.speaker: Mysterious Stranger
steps.text: Yes and no. I have a memory that I believe has answers for us. However, it is not Verzik's memory.

steps.player: What?

steps.speaker: Mysterious Stranger
steps.text: I think it's best if I just show you.

steps.speaker: Mysterious Stranger
steps.text: Prepare yourself!
The memory plays. Verzik, flying from the ceiling, appears.

steps.speaker: Verzik Vitur
steps.text: Doctor... are you still there?

steps.speaker: Vulcan Orvoros
steps.text: I'm right here, my lady. I was just finishing my notes.

steps.speaker: Verzik Vitur
steps.text: I feel... I feel... wrong.

steps.speaker: Vulcan Orvoros
steps.text: My lady, as I've already said, we really should take you to my surgery in Darkmeyer. Whatever that nylocas did, it was no normal bite.

steps.speaker: Verzik Vitur
steps.text: No! This is my home! You will not take me!

steps.speaker: Vulcan Orvoros
steps.text: I understand. My notes are finished now. I will leave you in peace.

steps.speaker: Verzik Vitur
steps.text: Peace? Yes...
The doctor leaves.

steps.speaker: Verzik Vitur
steps.text: Doctor... It's... inside me!

steps.speaker: Vulcan Orvoros
steps.text: My lady?

steps.speaker: Verzik Vitur
steps.text: I can feel it! Help me!
Verzik explodes and blood splatters about. In her place, the Nylocas Queen and many nylocas appear.

steps.speaker: Vulcan Orvoros
steps.text: What...

steps.speaker: Nylocas Queen
steps.text: Come... Come my pretties...

steps.speaker: Nylocas Queen
steps.text: Destroy the witness... Let us dine on his corpse!

steps.speaker: Vulcan Orvoros
steps.text: No!

steps.speaker: Nylocas Queen
steps.text: The rule of the vampyres is over... The rule of the nylocas has begun...
As the cutscene fades to black, spiders can be heard attacking the doctor, killing him. The memory ends here.

steps.player: Verzik... She died!

steps.speaker: Mysterious Stranger
steps.text: We feared the worst, but we never anticipated something like this.

steps.player: But does this mean... the Verzik in the Theatre...

steps.speaker: Mysterious Stranger
steps.text: ...is really just that nylocas in disguise. We must inform my master at once.

steps.player: Your master? So these associates you've been going on about... they don't actually exist do they?

steps.speaker: Mysterious Stranger
steps.text: They do not. My master preferred that I keep his involvement a secret, but I feel you are now trusted enough to meet him.

steps.player: Meet him? Where?

steps.speaker: Mysterious Stranger
steps.text: In a similar way to how my kind can relive our memories, we can also communicate across great distances.

steps.speaker: Mysterious Stranger
steps.text: Another of my kind is with my master. Through the two of us, you will be able to speak with him.

steps.player: Okay, I think I understand.

steps.speaker: Mysterious Stranger
steps.text: Prepare yourself!
The player and the stranger enter their mind threshold.

steps.player: Well this is weird.

steps.speaker: Mysterious Stranger
steps.text: It can take some getting used to. Now, I will contact my master and inform him of what we have discovered. Once I am done, I expect he will want to speak with you.

steps.speaker: Mysterious Stranger
steps.text: There. Now, when I next speak, it will be my voice you hear. However, the words are from my master.

steps.player: Okay...

steps.speaker: Mysterious Master
steps.text: Greetings my child. It is good that we are finally able to speak, for you have done a great service to me and my disciples.

steps.player: It would be nicer if we could speak in person.

steps.speaker: Mysterious Master
steps.text: If that were possible, we would make it so. There are many constraints upon us. Still, these constraints are often to our benefit.

steps.player: How so?

steps.speaker: Mysterious Master
steps.text: We share many common enemies, you and I. Enemies that infest Hallowvale like a disease.

steps.speaker: Mysterious Master
steps.text: By remaining far away from this disease, I keep us all safer. Instead, my disciples act as my eyes, ears, and hands upon Gielinor. They are the harbingers of my will.

steps.player: So where are you then?

steps.speaker: Mysterious Master
steps.text: Home.

steps.player: Right... And what's your connection to Verzik?

steps.speaker: Mysterious Master
steps.text: She was an old foe. We will not weep for her demise.

steps.player: What about this nylocas that's replaced her?

steps.speaker: Mysterious Master
steps.text: A concerning development. However, you have gathered all that we need to overcome it when the time is right.

steps.player: When the time is right?

steps.speaker: Mysterious Master
steps.text: When the time is right.

steps.player: So there's nothing further for us to do now?

steps.speaker: Mysterious Master
steps.text: No. For now, we must wait. But once again, you have my thanks. My disciple will ensure you are suitably rewarded. Know that you are now a friend of Sugadinti.
The player returns to Ver Sinhaza.

options.text: Can I get those teleport crystals you mentioned?

the-final-memory-talking-to-the-mysterio.speaker: Mysterious Stranger
the-final-memory-talking-to-the-mysterio.text: You again. What can I do for you?

steps.player: Verzik... She died!

options.text: Can I get those teleport crystals you mentioned?

claiming-quest-rewards-with-inventory-sp.speaker: Mysterious Stranger
claiming-quest-rewards-with-inventory-sp.text: You again. My master is very impressed with your work. On his behalf, allow me to reward you.
4 Antique lamp (A Night at the Theatre)

starting-out-searching-the-notice-board.text: You search through the notice board...

starting-out-searching-the-notice-board.player: 'Damaged roof tiles for sale'... 'Come on down to Bob's Axes'... 'Contributions welcomed to Ned's New-Window Fund'...

starting-out-searching-the-notice-board.text: 'Keen fighter sought to deal with troublesome monster. Reward offered. Speak to Sarah at the South Falador Farm for details.'

starting-out-searching-the-notice-board.player: This could be worth looking into.

starting-out-searching-the-notice-board.prompt: Start the A Porcine of Interest quest?

steps.player: Right, let's go and see what Sarah has in mind.

starting-out-searching-the-notice-board-.text: You search through the notice board but find nothing more of interest.

starting-out-talking-to-sarah-initial-co.speaker: Sarah
starting-out-talking-to-sarah-initial-co.text: Hello. How can I help you?

steps.player: I've come about the bounty.

steps.speaker: Sarah
steps.text: Oh thank Saradomin! It's about time someone responded, something needs to be done!

steps.player: Can you explain what happened?

steps.speaker: Sarah
steps.text: Of course. I was making my monthly delivery to The Sheared Ram in Lumbridge, heading east near the Draynor Village crossroads.

steps.speaker: Sarah
steps.text: Suddenly, out of the trees came a hulking monster! It chased me for a short distance, but luckily Rosie managed to spook it enough to give me a headstart.

steps.player: Sounds like it must have given you quite the scare!

steps.speaker: Sarah
steps.text: It certainly did. I even lost my cart full of farm produce!

options.text: What did the monster look like?

steps.player: What did this monster look like?

steps.speaker: Sarah
steps.text: I didn't get a very good look at it I'm afraid. It was getting dark and as soon as I saw it charging at me, I ran.

steps.speaker: Sarah
steps.text: I can still hear the sound, though. A horrible grunting... squealing...

steps.speaker: Sarah
steps.text: Is there anything else you wanted?

options.text: Any tips on finding this thing?

steps.player: Any tips on finding this thing?

steps.speaker: Sarah
steps.text: Tips...? You're supposed to be the professional monster slayer!

steps.speaker: Sarah
steps.text: Although, I suppose a good place to start would be checking the area I was attacked. See if you can find the remains of my cart.

steps.player: Ok, yes that could work.

steps.speaker: Sarah
steps.text: Is there anything else you wanted?

steps.player: Whereabouts were you attacked again?

steps.speaker: Sarah
steps.text: I remember being somewhere near the crossroads, north of Draynor Village.

steps.speaker: Sarah
steps.text: Sorry that I'm not much help. It happened so fast, the whole thing is a bit of a blur.

steps.player: That's okay. Crossroads north of Draynor... At least I have somewhere to start.

steps.speaker: Sarah
steps.text: Is there anything else you wanted?

steps.player: You mentioned that Rosie spooked the monster. Who's that?

steps.speaker: Sarah
steps.text: Oh, that'll be our lady over there by the fire. She's such a good dog, always accompanies me on deliveries.

steps.speaker: Sarah
steps.text: You can pet her if you like. She's very friendly.

steps.speaker: Sarah
steps.text: Is there anything else you wanted?

options.text: I think that'll be all for now.

steps.player: I think that'll be all for now.

steps.speaker: Sarah
steps.text: Excellent! Best of luck to you, I'll be waiting right here with your reward.

starting-out-talking-to-sarah-subsequent.speaker: Sarah
starting-out-talking-to-sarah-subsequent.text: Hello. How can I help you?

options.text: What did the monster look like?
Any tips on finding this thing?
I think that'll be all for now.

investigating-the-crossroads-damaged-car.text: It seems as though the monster was trying to run off with some of Sarah's produce. From the looks of things, it was heading north-east.

investigating-the-crossroads-cabbages.text: The cabbage is damaged and has begun to yellow.

investigating-the-crossroads-carrots.text: The carrot has been slightly gnawed on.

investigating-the-crossroads-carrots.player: Weird... What sort of monster charges at someone and then steals a bunch of carrots?

investigating-the-crossroads-potatoes.text: These potatoes seem to have been largely untouched.

investigating-the-crossroads-potatoes.player: Would you look at that... Apparently our monster is picky.

investigating-the-crossroads-broken-dead.player: Something pretty big must have come running through here to knock this over.

investigating-the-crossroads-strange-hol.text: If the player does not have a rope in their inventory:

steps.player: This looks like the place. It's a long way down, though... I'll need to tie something onto the edge.

investigating-the-crossroads-strange-hol.text: If the player has a rope in their inventory:

steps.text: You tie the rope tightly around a protruding rock.

inside-the-cave-investigating-pile-of-ro.player: Huh... there's a rope already down here. I hope noone else has got to this monster first.

inside-the-cave-talking-to-sarah-after-f.speaker: Sarah
inside-the-cave-talking-to-sarah-after-f.text: Hello. How can I help you?

steps.speaker: Sarah
steps.text: Oh it's you, my monster slayer! How goes the quest?

steps.player: I'm still working on it... I've managed to find its lair though.

steps.speaker: Sarah
steps.text: Sounds like you're making progress. Take care!

inside-the-cave-investigating-the-skelet.text: The skeleton seems fresh. It looks like the bones have been gnawed clean fairly recently.

inside-the-cave-investigating-the-skelet.player: There's also a scrawled note. It's barely readable...

inside-the-cave-investigating-the-skelet.text: A level 37 Pig Thing appears behind the player.
The Pig Thing sprays acid at the player.
If the player is not wearing Gnome goggles:

steps.player: Argh! My eyes!

inside-the-cave-investigating-the-skelet.text: If the player is wearing Gnome goggles:

steps.player: Argh! My eyes! The goggles do nothing!

inside-the-cave-investigating-the-skelet.speaker: Spria
inside-the-cave-investigating-the-skelet.text: Well then, what do we have here?
Spria approaches the player's unconscious body.

inside-the-cave-investigating-the-skelet.speaker: Spria
inside-the-cave-investigating-the-skelet.text: Seems I came at just the right time.

inside-the-cave-investigating-the-skelet.speaker: Spria
inside-the-cave-investigating-the-skelet.text: We'd better get you out of here before that thing returns.
The player wakes up in Spria's house in Draynor Village

inside-the-cave-attempting-to-enter-the-.player: I think I find out more about that monster from Spria in Draynor Village before heading back down there.

the-sourhog-talking-to-spria-initial-con.player: Who are you? How did I end up here?

the-sourhog-talking-to-spria-initial-con.speaker: Spria
the-sourhog-talking-to-spria-initial-con.text: My name's Spria and I'm a slayer master. You've had a nasty encounter with a Sourhog.

the-sourhog-talking-to-spria-initial-con.player: A Sourhog? You mean the giant pig monster?

the-sourhog-talking-to-spria-initial-con.speaker: Spria
the-sourhog-talking-to-spria-initial-con.text: Precisely. You're extremely lucky that I found you. Another few hours and you'd have been hog chow.

the-sourhog-talking-to-spria-initial-con.speaker: Spria
the-sourhog-talking-to-spria-initial-con.text: Were you responding to Sarah's bounty too?

the-sourhog-talking-to-spria-initial-con.player: Yes... It sounded like an easy few coins...

the-sourhog-talking-to-spria-initial-con.speaker: Spria
the-sourhog-talking-to-spria-initial-con.text: I thought as much. I found you on the floor of the cave, you must have been knocked unconscious.

the-sourhog-talking-to-spria-initial-con.player: That thing caught me completely off-guard. Normally I can handle myself in a fight, but its spitting attack is pretty fearsome!

the-sourhog-talking-to-spria-initial-con.text: If the player's inventory is full:

steps.speaker: Spria
steps.text: I have an item for you that will help you on your quest, but you don't seem to have enough space. Come and see me again when you've cleared some room.

the-sourhog-talking-to-spria-initial-con.text: If the player's inventory is not full:

steps.speaker: Spria
steps.text: The beast's saliva is extremely acidic and your eyes are most vulnerable. It'll cause terrible injuries and leave you unable to attack or defend yourself very well.

steps.player: So how am I supposed to handle that?

steps.speaker: Spria
steps.text: Luckily, the Slayer skill provides us with an array of useful equipment and techniques for dealing with... special foes.

steps.speaker: Spria
steps.text: In the case of our Sourhog, you'll be needing these.
Spria hands you a pair of Reinforced Goggles.
Reinforced goggles

steps.speaker: Spria
steps.text: This eyewear will protect you from the spitting attack, allowing you to fight the monster on equal terms.

steps.speaker: Spria
steps.text: Most enemies have a weakness, too. The Sourhog's thick hide provides excellent protection against slashing and insulates it from magic damage.

steps.speaker: Spria
steps.text: You'd be best trying to pierce it with arrows or a stabbing weapon.

steps.speaker: Spria
steps.text: Go now, the bounty is all yours to claim. I suggest you recoup your strength and head back to fight it using your new goggles.

steps.speaker: Spria
steps.text: If you make it out alive, collect your bounty and then come see me so that we can speak further.

steps.player: Why are you helping me?

steps.speaker: Spria
steps.text: Well, I suppose I could have left you in there to be eaten...

steps.speaker: Spria
steps.text: But you know what that'd make me? A monster. And as a slayer master, that's really not a great look.

steps.speaker: Spria
steps.text: Besides, my father always taught me that knowledge is worth more than gold. I'm happy to sacrifice a few coins in order to pass my experience on to you.

steps.player: Well, I sure am glad you were there to lend a hand. Thank you!

steps.speaker: Spria
steps.text: Don't mention it. Was there something else?

options.text: How did I end up back in Draynor Village?

steps.player: How did I end up back in Draynor Village?

steps.speaker: Spria
steps.text: I carried you out and dragged you back here to my house to recover, it really wasn't easy. You're welcome to rest here for as long as you need.

steps.speaker: Spria
steps.text: Was there something else?

options.text: You said you were a slayer master. What's that?

steps.player: You said you were a slayer master. What's that?

steps.speaker: Spria
steps.text: There are many of us. We're experts in the ancient art of monster slaying. People from across Gielinor come to us for tasks and advice.

steps.speaker: Spria
steps.text: Well... actually, I'm fairly new to this. I've been learning from my father, Turael, for many years. We decided it was finally time for me to continue the family profession.

steps.speaker: Spria
steps.text: Was there something else?

options.text: Can I have another pair of Reinforced Goggles?

steps.player: Can I have another pair of Reinforced Goggles?

steps.text: If the player has a pair equipped:

steps.speaker: Spria
steps.text: No, you're still wearing the last pair I gave you!

steps.speaker: Spria
steps.text: Was there something else?
If the player has a pair in their inventory:

steps.speaker: Spria
steps.text: You've still got the last one I gave you, it's there in your inventory! Those things aren't cheap, you know.

steps.speaker: Spria
steps.text: Was there something else?
If the player has a pair in their bank:

steps.speaker: Spria
steps.text: I know many people all across Gielinor, and my sources tell me you still have the last one in your bank.

steps.speaker: Spria
steps.text: Was there something else?
If a player does not have a pair in their inventory or bank:

steps.speaker: Spria
steps.text: Sure, I have another going spare. Please try to take better care of these.
"Spria hands you another pair of Reinforced Goggles."

steps.speaker: Spria
steps.text: Was there something else?

options.text: What can you tell me about the Sourhog?

steps.player: What can you tell me about the Sourhog?

steps.speaker: Spria
steps.text: Well, I'm not much of a history buff... But I'll tell you what I know.

steps.speaker: Spria
steps.text: Many years back, before even I was around, there were two rival family farms not far from where we're standing.

steps.speaker: Spria
steps.text: Every year the village would hold a 'Finest Swine in Show' prize at the annual faire.

steps.speaker: Spria
steps.text: The same farmer would win year after year without fail. Driven mad with jealousy, his rival decided to hire a dodgy dark wizard to give him an edge over the competition.

steps.speaker: Spria
steps.text: The wizard attempted to alter the pig's appearance. I'm sure you can guess how well that went!

steps.speaker: Spria
steps.text: Long story short, the mutant, what we now know as a Sourhog, went on a brief rampage and escaped.

steps.speaker: Spria
steps.text: It must have somehow managed to reproduce, because people have reported seeing them in groups.

steps.speaker: Spria
steps.text: Up until now, so long as they were left alone, they'd keep to themselves. Rumours are, they live in deep underground caverns, scavenging what they can find.

steps.speaker: Spria
steps.text: But if they're living so close-by and attacking people on roads, then... they must be getting bold and trying to resurface.

steps.speaker: Spria
steps.text: Was there something else?

options.condition: If the player has gone through any of the above choices:

steps.player: That'll be all for now.

steps.speaker: Spria
steps.text: Very well. Good luck, slayer.

options.text: How did I end up back in Draynor Village?
You said you were a slayer master. What's that?
Can I have another pair of Reinforced Goggles?
What can you tell me about the Sourhog?

the-sourhog-attempting-to-enter-the-hole.player: I don't want to go back down there without wearing the right equipment!

the-sourhog-climbing-the-blockage.player: I don't think Spria will be rescuing me this time. If I go in there, I'm fighting this thing to the death!

steps.text: The player climbs over the blockage.

the-sourhog-attempting-to-climb-the-rope.player: Before I leave, I should go and collect a foot from that dead Sourhog as proof of my kill.

the-sourhog-taking-the-sourhog-s-foot.text: If the player doesn't have a knife or slash weapon:

steps.text: You try to pull a foot off with your bare hands, but to no avail.

steps.player: Perhaps I should go and get something sharp.

the-sourhog-taking-the-sourhog-s-foot.text: If the player uses something other than a knife or slash weapon:

steps.player: I don't think that's sharp enough to cut a foot off...

the-sourhog-taking-the-sourhog-s-foot.text: If the player has a knife or slash weapon:

steps.text: You slice a foot off and place it inside your backpack.

the-sourhog-taking-the-sourhog-s-foot.text: If the player has a Sourhog foot in their inventory:

steps.player: I've already collected a foot from this thing. I should take it to Sarah.

the-sourhog-attempting-to-re-enter-the-s.player: I don't need to go back down there right now. I should take the foot to Sarah and collect my reward.

collecting-the-bounty-talking-to-spria.speaker: Spria
collecting-the-bounty-talking-to-spria.text: 'Ello, and what are you after then?

collecting-the-bounty-talking-to-spria.player: I did it! I killed the Sourhog!

collecting-the-bounty-talking-to-spria.speaker: Spria
collecting-the-bounty-talking-to-spria.text: Nicely done. Did you collect your reward from Sarah?

collecting-the-bounty-talking-to-spria.speaker: Spria
collecting-the-bounty-talking-to-spria.text: Go and collect your reward and then come and speak with me.

collecting-the-bounty-talking-to-sarah.speaker: Sarah
collecting-the-bounty-talking-to-sarah.text: Hello. How can I help you?

steps.player: That monster certainly won't be troubling you from now on.

steps.speaker: Sarah
steps.text: Oh that's fantastic news! I'm so relie-

steps.speaker: Sarah
steps.text: Wait, how do I know you're not just saying that to get the bounty?
If the player doesn't have the sourhog foot:

steps.player: I guess I'll go and get you some proof.

steps.text: If the player has the sourhog foot:

steps.player: How about this as proof?

steps.text: You pull the foot out of your backpack and show it to Sarah.

steps.speaker: Sarah
steps.text: Eugh! Yes, that certainly looks about right!

steps.player: Indeed, the smell is... something quite special.

steps.speaker: Sarah
steps.text: I'll probably just give it to the dog.

steps.speaker: Sarah
steps.text: I'm glad you made it back. Some strange woman in a hood came asking about the job shortly after you left. I didn't really want her back in here.

steps.speaker: Sarah
steps.text: Anyway, thank you so much! Here's your reward.
Sarah hands you a heavy pouch of 5,000 coins.

steps.player: Perhaps I should speak with Spria and tell her that the monster's been dealt with.

finishing-up-talking-to-sarah-before-tel.speaker: Sarah
finishing-up-talking-to-sarah-before-tel.text: Hello. How can I help you?

steps.player: Feeling better now that the monster's gone?

steps.speaker: Sarah
steps.text: Very much so! Thanks again. What was it, anyway?

steps.player: It was a Sourhog. A giant bipedal pig creature!

steps.speaker: Sarah
steps.text: Oh crumbs... I think I've heard of those... My grandfather was always rambling on about them.

steps.speaker: Sarah
steps.text: Nevermind... that's all history now. Weren't you heading off to see Spria?

steps.player: Yes, I suppose I should get going.

steps.speaker: Sarah
steps.text: Safe travels!

finishing-up-talking-to-spria.speaker: Spria
finishing-up-talking-to-spria.text: 'Ello, and what are you after then?

finishing-up-talking-to-spria.player: I did it! I killed the Sourhog and collected the bounty from Sarah.

finishing-up-talking-to-spria.speaker: Spria
finishing-up-talking-to-spria.text: Very impressive, slayer. I'm glad that the goggles served you well.

finishing-up-talking-to-spria.speaker: Spria
finishing-up-talking-to-spria.text: Although, these Sourhogs often live in primitive tribes. I fear that where there's one, there's likely to be more to follow.

finishing-up-talking-to-spria.speaker: Spria
finishing-up-talking-to-spria.text: We may have to monitor that lair from time to time to keep their population in check.
If the player has unlocked the ability to craft the slayer helmet:

steps.speaker: Spria
steps.text: I've noticed that you've unlocked the ability to craft slayer helms. From now on, when assembling one, fasten a pair of Reinforced Goggles to the eye holes to gain their benefit.

steps.speaker: Spria
steps.text: While we're on the topic, I can upgrade any of your existing slayer helms now.
The screen briefly fades to black

steps.speaker: Spria
steps.text: That should do the trick.

finishing-up-talking-to-spria.text: If the player does not have a slayer task:

steps.speaker: Spria
steps.text: By the way, you seem to have a natural talent for killing monsters. Would you like a new slayer task now?

steps.prompt: Do you want a slayer task from Spria?

steps.text: Player receives a Slayer task.

steps.speaker: Spria
steps.text: Very well, come back if you change your mind.

finishing-up-talking-to-spria.text: If the player has a slayer task:

starting-off-attempting-to-rescue-a-dog.text: You have nowhere to send this lost dog...

starting-off-talking-to-chase.player: Do you have any dogs up for adoption?

starting-off-talking-to-talia.speaker: Talia
starting-off-talking-to-talia.text: Welcome to our dog shelter! I'm Talia and I run it alongside my husband, Chase.

starting-off-talking-to-talia.player: You don't seem to have many dogs. Where are the rest?

starting-off-talking-to-talia.speaker: Talia
starting-off-talking-to-talia.text: I wish I could tell you they'd all been adopted... but I'd be lying to myself.

starting-off-talking-to-talia.player: So they were never here to begin with?

starting-off-talking-to-talia.speaker: Talia
starting-off-talking-to-talia.text: We're trying. The monks from the Monastery believe in our cause. That's why they granted us this land.

starting-off-talking-to-talia.speaker: Talia
starting-off-talking-to-talia.text: But belief, sadly, won't help keep us open.

starting-off-talking-to-talia.player: What would you need to keep the shelter open?

starting-off-talking-to-talia.speaker: Talia
starting-off-talking-to-talia.text: We need more strays to rescue. If people know they can find a companion here, they'll come.

starting-off-talking-to-talia.player: Can't you go out to look for strays then?

starting-off-talking-to-talia.speaker: Talia
starting-off-talking-to-talia.text: It can take one of us hours just to coerce a puppy out of hiding.

starting-off-talking-to-talia.speaker: Chase
starting-off-talking-to-talia.text: And the shelter doesn't run itself.

starting-off-talking-to-talia.speaker: Talia
starting-off-talking-to-talia.text: By the time we got back, we'd still need to clean the kennels, feed the dogs we do have, repair the fences...

starting-off-talking-to-talia.speaker: Talia
starting-off-talking-to-talia.text: Plus, there was no one to keep the cats and dogs separate.

starting-off-talking-to-talia.player: I thought this was a dog shelter?

starting-off-talking-to-talia.speaker: Talia
starting-off-talking-to-talia.text: What we really need is someone worldly who can bring strays back for us.
If the player does not meet the quest's requirements:

steps.player: Sounds like it. No luck in finding anyone then?

steps.speaker: Talia
steps.text: Sadly not.

starting-off-talking-to-talia.text: If the player meets the quest's requirements:

steps.prompt: Start the A Ruff Situation quest?

steps.player: Lucky for you, I enjoy wandering.

steps.speaker: Chase
steps.text: I can smell it.

steps.speaker: Talia
steps.text: So you'll help us out?

steps.player: I'd be happy to. Any ideas where I could start?

steps.speaker: Talia
steps.text: We've met so many people that might be able to...

steps.speaker: Chase
steps.text: Gertrude.

steps.speaker: Talia
steps.text: Yes, Gertrude! She was a great help with the cats.

steps.speaker: Chase
steps.text: Not much for dogs.

steps.speaker: Talia
steps.text: Right, but I'm sure she can point you in the right direction. You'll find her house near the western entrance to Varrock.
If the player hasn't completed Gertrude's Cat:

steps.player: Sure, I can check in with her.

steps.text: If the player has completed Gertrude's Cat:

steps.player: Excellent idea. I've helped her out before. I can check in with her.

steps.speaker: Talia
steps.text: Wonderful! Good luck!

steps.player: I'm afraid I can't help you at the moment.

starting-off-talking-to-talia-again.speaker: Talia
starting-off-talking-to-talia-again.text: Adventurer, have you come to help us?

starting-off-talking-to-talia-again.player: What did you need of me again?

starting-off-talking-to-talia-again.speaker: Talia
starting-off-talking-to-talia-again.text: We need someone worldly to bring back stray dogs for us. Would you be willing to help us?

starting-off-talking-to-talia-again.prompt: Start the A Ruff Situation quest?

starting-off-talking-to-chase-after-star.player: How are the dogs doing? Keeping them healthy?
Man of few words I see.

starting-off-talking-to-talia-after-star.player: Who did you want me to check in with?

starting-off-talking-to-talia-after-star.speaker: Talia
starting-off-talking-to-talia-after-star.text: Yes, she may know of some dogs that need help.

starting-off-talking-to-talia-after-star.speaker: Talia
starting-off-talking-to-talia-after-star.text: You'll pass her house on the way into Varrock from here, just outside the western entrance to the city.

starting-off-trying-to-rescue-other-stra.player: I should finish helping Talia with my current task before bringing back another stray.

steps.text: If Gertrude's Cat has been completed:

steps.player: Hello there, Gertrude.

steps.speaker: Gertrude
steps.text: Hello, adventurer! How can I help you today?

steps.player: I've come to ask a favour, if you don't mind?

steps.speaker: Gertrude
steps.text: Of course, anything for the hero who returned Fluffs to me.

steps.player: Talia sent me to you. She said you helped them with their dog shelter?

steps.speaker: Gertrude
steps.text: It's just a dog shelter now? I don't blame them... They had trouble keeping the cats and dogs separate. How have they been getting on?

steps.player: Not well. They barely have any dogs in for adoption.

steps.speaker: Gertrude
steps.text: Oh dear... I suppose that's why you're here?

steps.player: Precisely! They thought you might know of some dogs in the city I could rescue.

steps.speaker: Gertrude
steps.text: Well, it would be nice for someone to do something about those mangy stray dogs you see in Varrock.

steps.player: I wouldn't call them mangy... They just need some love.

steps.speaker: Gertrude
steps.text: They're covered in fleas and they're everywhere. They always beg for food when I walk through the city.

steps.player: Sounds like the kind of rescue Talia would be looking for...

steps.speaker: Gertrude
steps.text: I'd be happy to see them go. I always see them near the west entrance to the city.

steps.player: I'll start my search there then. You've been a great help!

steps.text: If Gertrude's Cat hasn't been completed:

steps.player: Hello, are you Gertrude by chance?

steps.speaker: Gertrude
steps.text: Yes, I am. However, I'm in no mood to entertain guests today.

steps.player: I just have a few questions to ask. I've been told you're good with animals.

steps.speaker: Gertrude
steps.text: Well, I have a missing cat, if that's what you mean...

steps.player: Talia sent me to you. She said you helped them with their dog shelter?

steps.speaker: Gertrude
steps.text: It's just a dog shelter now? I don't blame them... They had trouble keeping the cats and dogs separate. How have they been getting on?

steps.player: Not well. They barely have any dogs in for adoption.

steps.speaker: Gertrude
steps.text: Oh dear... I suppose that's why you're here?

steps.player: Precisely! They thought you might know of some dogs in the city I could rescue.

steps.speaker: Gertrude
steps.text: Well, it would be nice for someone to do something about those mangy stray dogs you see in Varrock.

steps.player: I wouldn't call them mangy... They just need some love.

steps.speaker: Gertrude
steps.text: They're covered in fleas and they're everywhere. They always beg for food when I walk through the city.

steps.player: Sounds like the kind of rescue Talia would be looking for...

steps.speaker: Gertrude
steps.text: I'd be happy to see them go. I always see them near the west entrance to the city.

steps.player: I'll start my search there then. You've been a great help!

steps.speaker: Gertrude
steps.text: If only someone cared about my Fluffs as much as those mutts...

steps.player: Where did you say you saw some stray dogs again?

steps.speaker: Gertrude
steps.text: Just head to the west entrance of Varrock. I'm sure you'll run into one before long.

gertrude-talking-to-talia-again.speaker: Talia
gertrude-talking-to-talia-again.text: Excellent! Was she able to point you in the right direction?

gertrude-talking-to-talia-again.player: She mentioned there are some stray dogs in Varrock that might need help.

gertrude-talking-to-talia-again.speaker: Talia
gertrude-talking-to-talia-again.text: Great! You should head in that direction and take a look around!

stray-dog-talking-to-the-guard-or-intera.speaker: Guard
stray-dog-talking-to-the-guard-or-intera.text: I have no idea. She just started barking at me.

stray-dog-talking-to-the-guard-or-intera.player: Something has her upset. Has she ever been like this before?

stray-dog-talking-to-the-guard-or-intera.speaker: Guard
stray-dog-talking-to-the-guard-or-intera.text: No, normally she's very friendly, although we haven't seen her for a few weeks...

stray-dog-talking-to-the-guard-or-intera.player: Whatever it is, she is being very persistent.

stray-dog-talking-to-the-guard-or-intera.speaker: Guard
stray-dog-talking-to-the-guard-or-intera.text: Maybe she wants one of us to follow her. I can't leave my post. Could you go?

stray-dog-talking-to-the-guard-or-intera.player: Hmm... This is the kind of situation Talia would have me intervene with...
Of course I can! Where did you want to go, girl?

stray-dog-talking-to-the-guard-or-intera.speaker: Varrock Guard
stray-dog-talking-to-the-guard-or-intera.text: You'd better be quick! She's already on the move.

stray-dog-talking-to-the-guard-again.speaker: Varrock Guard
stray-dog-talking-to-the-guard-again.text: You'd better be quick! She's already on the move.

stray-dog-interacting-with-the-dog.player: Something is wrong. I should follow her and find out what she wants.

stray-dog-upon-approaching-the-stray-dog.text: The stray dog moves closer towards its home.

at-the-dog-s-house-interacting-with-the-.player: I've followed you here like you wanted. What do you want to show me?

at-the-dog-s-house-interacting-with-the-.text: The stray dog indicates towards her makeshift den.

at-the-dog-s-house-inspecting-the-torn-n.text: You inspect the scraps on the floor...
They've been ripped up by something with small teeth.

at-the-dog-s-house-inspecting-the-chewed.text: You notice some chew marks on the corner.

at-the-dog-s-house-inspecting-the-rough-.text: You notice a large indentation and three smaller ones.

at-the-dog-s-house-after-inspecting-all-.player: I think I'm starting to understand what's got you so upset.

at-the-dog-s-house-after-inspecting-all-.text: The stray dog looks at you with a sad look in her eye.

at-the-dog-s-house-after-inspecting-all-.player: It appears some puppies were playing here at one point...

at-the-dog-s-house-after-inspecting-all-.text: The stray dog nods in agreement.

at-the-dog-s-house-after-inspecting-all-.player: But they're gone now and you don't seem too happy about it.

at-the-dog-s-house-after-inspecting-all-.text: The stray dog cocks her head and begins to sniff the air.

at-the-dog-s-house-after-inspecting-all-.player: What's wrong? Have you caught their scent?

at-the-dog-s-house-interacting-with-the-.player: She must have caught the scent of her puppies. I should follow her.

at-the-dog-s-house-talking-to-the-guard.player: I figured out what's wrong with the stray dog!
After looking around her den, I think she's had some puppies.

at-the-dog-s-house-talking-to-the-guard.speaker: Guard
at-the-dog-s-house-talking-to-the-guard.text: That explains why she went missing for so long. Are the puppies still there?

at-the-dog-s-house-talking-to-the-guard.speaker: Guard
at-the-dog-s-house-talking-to-the-guard.text: Then why are you here talking to me. Go help her find them!

at-the-dog-s-house-upon-entering-the-ban.speaker: Banker
at-the-dog-s-house-upon-entering-the-ban.text: Oi, get that mutt out of my bank!

at-the-dog-s-house-upon-approaching-the-.speaker: Guard
at-the-dog-s-house-upon-approaching-the-.text: No mutts allowed in the Grand Exchange! Keep that dog away.

cutscene.player: Hey, is that one of your puppies?

cutscene.text: The stray puppy approaches its mother, followed by a goblin.
If the player has no inventory space:

steps.player: Hang on, let me take something out of my pockets first.

cutscene.player: Yes of course, let's get you out of danger first, little guy.

cutscene.text: The player picks up the stray puppy.

cutscene-after-the-cutscene.player: We arrived at the right time.
Are there any more puppies we need to find?

cutscene-after-the-cutscene.text: If the player does not have a follower:

steps.text: The stray dog barks in the direction the goblin ran off in.

steps.player: Let's go find them then! Follow me!

cutscene-after-the-cutscene.text: If the player currently has a follower:

steps.text: The stray dog can't follow you at the moment.

cutscene-interacting-with-the-stray-dog.player: Do you remember which way the goblins went?

cutscene-interacting-with-the-stray-dog.text: The stray dog sniffs the air...
The stray dog barks in the direction of the scent.

cutscene-dismissing-the-stray-dog.player: I need to do something else. Can you wait for me at your den?

cutscene-talking-to-the-guard-again.text: With the stray dog following you:

steps.text: The guard is standing watch and doesn't have time to chat.

cutscene-talking-to-the-guard-again.text: Without the stray dog following you:

steps.player: Has the stray dog come back this way? I can't find her.

steps.speaker: Guard
steps.text: I think I saw her heading towards her den, north of the Apothecary.

cutscene-going-too-far-from-varrock-with.text: The stray dog won't go too far from her den. She will wait for you there.

cutscene-talking-to-talia-again.player: I found a stray dog in Varrock, but her puppies have gone missing.

cutscene-talking-to-talia-again.speaker: Talia
cutscene-talking-to-talia-again.text: Oh dear! You must help her! Please, return to her at once!

cutscene-returning-to-the-dog-after-leav.player: My apologies, I'm ready to continue the search for your puppies.

cutscene-interacting-with-the-goblins-wi.player: I should have the stray dog with me before I interrupt these goblins.

goblins.speaker: Toetaller
goblins.text: What mean Picklenose lose other dog?

goblins.speaker: Toetaller
goblins.text: Ooh, big big! Toetaller understand now.

goblins.player: Ahem!

goblins.speaker: Toetaller
goblins.text: It not big as Nosorog... Picklenose lie.

goblins.player: It bigger before.
Picklenose not lie! Dog bigger before.
Excuse me!

goblins.speaker: Toetaller
goblins.text: Human rude. Goblins busy. Speak quick.

goblins.player: Why did you steal these puppies? You need to give them back.

goblins.speaker: Toetaller
goblins.text: Sorry, human. We have big plan. Keep village safe.

goblins.player: Puppies will keep your village safe?

goblins.speaker: Toetaller
goblins.text: Very silly. Puppy too weak. We wait 'till puppy big, strong.

goblins.speaker: Picklenose
goblins.text: Big, strong, scary dog keep village safe.

goblins.player: You're just going to wait here till the puppy is fully grown?

goblins.speaker: Toetaller
goblins.text: Yes. Not take long Toetaller think.

goblins.player: I'm afraid puppies don't work like that.
You know you have to feed dogs to keep them alive?
They also have a lot of energy they need to burn off.
You need to play with them, take them for walks...
I wouldn't expect a dog to sit and guard your village all day either.
It's a dog. It needs attention and caring for. It won't just sit still for hours.
Maybe a guard dog isn't the best idea?

goblins.speaker: Toetaller
goblins.text: No, Toetaller still want guard dog. We make this one guard dog without all that.

goblins.player: If you don't feed it, it will die.
Oh, here we go...

goblins.speaker: Picklenose
goblins.text: Human find goblins dog that no need all that... extra stuff, then goblins give human this useless dog.

goblins.player: I don't think a dog like that exists...
Wait, wait! Could I make you something?
Maybe I could make something with some fur...?

goblins.speaker: Toetaller
goblins.text: Remember dog need be big... huge!

goblins.speaker: Picklenose
goblins.text: Yes, huge and scary. Defend village from outsiders.

goblins.player: ... Then I suppose I'd need to stuff it with something, maybe grain...?

goblins.speaker: Toetaller
goblins.text: Dog intimidate invaders, save goblin lives.

goblins.speaker: Picklenose
goblins.text: Human even listen to goblins now?

goblins.speaker: Toetaller
goblins.text: More like Picklenose not worth listening to.

goblins.player: ... Then a needle and thread to put it together...
Okay, I think I can make something better for you.

goblins.speaker: Toetaller
goblins.text: Human be quick. Goblins low attention span.

goblins-interacting-with-the-goblins-aga.player: I should have the stray dog with me before I talk to these goblins again.

goblins-talking-to-the-goblins-again-or-.speaker: Picklenose
goblins-talking-to-the-goblins-again-or-.text: You got big dog for goblins?

goblins-talking-to-the-goblins-again-or-.player: Not yet. Do you remember what I needed?

goblins-talking-to-the-goblins-again-or-.speaker: Toetaller
goblins-talking-to-the-goblins-again-or-.text: Human useless. You came up with idea.

steps.player: Yes.
No.
Yes.
No.

goblins-talking-to-the-goblins-again-or-.text: Human got needle or costume needle:

steps.player: Yes.

goblins-talking-to-the-goblins-again-or-.text: Human not got needle or costume needle:

steps.player: No.

goblins-talking-to-the-goblins-again-or-.text: Human got thread or costume needle:

steps.player: Yes.

goblins-talking-to-the-goblins-again-or-.text: Human not got thread or costume needle:

steps.player: No.

goblins-talking-to-the-goblins-again-or-.text: If the player is missing one or more of the items:

steps.speaker: Picklenose
steps.text: Human go finish shopping trip then.

goblins-talking-to-the-goblins-again-or-.text: If the player has all the items:

steps.speaker: Picklenose
steps.text: Human got everything human need then. Waste goblin time by asking. Goblin time very important, can't waste.

goblins-talking-to-the-goblins-again-or-.speaker: Toetaller
goblins-talking-to-the-goblins-again-or-.text: Human not survive long in village if goblin.

stuffed-dog-trying-to-make-the-stuffed-d.text: You do not have the required items to make a stuffed dog. You need grain, some fur, a needle and some thread.

steps.text: You create a stuffed dog. It will probably convince the goblins.

stuffed-dog-crafting-a-stuffed-dog-with-.prompt: Which item would you like to craft?

stuffed-dog-trying-to-craft-another-stuf.text: You already have a stuffed dog.

back-to-the-goblins-with-the-stuffed-dog.player: I should have the stray dog with me before I talk to these goblins again.
Has the stray dog come this way? I can't find her.

back-to-the-goblins-with-the-stuffed-dog.speaker: Guard
back-to-the-goblins-with-the-stuffed-dog.text: No, I haven't seen her. What was the last thing you did with her?

back-to-the-goblins-with-the-stuffed-dog.player: Her puppies were stolen by some goblins west of the Cooks' Guild. I was trying to get them back.

Only his voice. So far he has said to me, 'Why should I, Tolna, be trapped in such a wretched place? Feel my ANGER!', 'It's so quiet and dark. I FEAR I may never escape this horrid place. Mum, help me!', 'Where
am I? How long have I been here? Am I still the person I once was? I hate my CONFUSION' and 'What's the point? Why do I defy such HOPELESSNESS? No-one will ever help me'.

talking-to-tolna-on-the-surface.text: I managed to find the remnants of the ancient civilisation that the stories talked about. It seems people used to worship a god there years ago in numbers far greater than a simple cult following. Sadly there is little

steps.text: Great! Now, in case you didn't know, the castle before you is Ver Sinhaza. It's home to the Theatre of Blood.

steps.speaker: Garth
steps.text: Every day, vampyres from across Morytania come to the Theatre to watch as citizens attempt the various challenges within.

steps.text: The Theatre is run by a famous vampyre noble, Lady Verzik Vitur. She has promised that any citizen of Meiyerditch who survives the Theatre will be freed of the vampyre blood tithes.

steps.player: I suppose that must be rather tempting to a lot of people. So who's this Serafina?

steps.speaker: Garth
steps.text: The Theatre has been around for many years and thousands of people have tried their luck against it. However, in all that time, only one person has ever survived until the end.

steps.player: Serafina?

steps.speaker: Garth
steps.text: Exactly. Serafina's younger brother was very ill and he wasn't going to survive many more blood tithes. She couldn't just let him die, so she did what no other person ever had.

steps.speaker: Garth
steps.text: She entered the Theatre and succeeded in every challenge she faced. They say that Verzik wasn't too happy about that, but she kept her promise. Serafina and her brother were freed.

steps.player: Sounds like you're a big fan of her.

steps.speaker: Garth
steps.text: Well of course. When she survived the Theatre, she provided hope to every person in Meiyerditch. Hope that they can one day follow in her footsteps.

steps.player: So what happened to her in the end?

steps.text: Well I suppose she left Meiyerditch. Can't imagine any free person wanting to stick around here.

steps.speaker: Garth
