steps.speaker: Battle mage (Guthix)
steps.text: Feel the wrath of Guthix.

steps.npc: Hello Effendi! How can I help you?

steps.player: What is this place?

steps.npc: This is the camp of the Bedabin. Talk to our leader, Al Shabim, he'll be happy to chat. We can sell you very reasonably priced water...

steps.player: Where is the Shantay Pass?

steps.npc: It is North East of here effendi, across the trackless desert. It will be a thirsty trip, can I interest you in a drink?

options.text: What do you have to sell?

steps.player: Okay, thanks

steps.npc: Hello Effendi! How can I help you?

steps.player: What is this place?

steps.npc: This is the camp of the Bedabin. Talk to our leader, Al Shabim, he'll be happy to chat.

steps.player: Where is the Shantay Pass?

steps.npc: It is north-east of here effendi, across the trackless desert. It will be a thirsty trip!

steps.player: Okay, thanks

standard-dialogue-if-the-player-has-not-.npc: Sorry, but you can't use the tent without permission. Orders of Al Shabim.

standard-dialogue-if-the-player-has-comp.npc: Sorry, but you can't use the tent without permission. But thanks for all your help with the Bedabin people.

steps.player: Hello.
So how's life as a pirate?

steps.npc: What kind of question is that? How's life as a... I dunno. Whatever it is that you do for a living.

steps.player: I'm a freelance troubleshooter.

steps.npc: What does that entail then?

steps.player: Mostly killing things for money and delivering items around the planet for people.
I collect stuff.

steps.npc: So how's that life?

steps.player: Can't complain, can't complain...

steps.npc: Well, there you go.

steps.player: Hello.
Aren't you a little short for a pirate?

steps.npc: My mother was a gnome. Apparently it was a very painful birth.

steps.player: More info than I wanted, thanks!
Hello.
You know, I've always wondered what life as a pirate actually entails.

steps.npc: Well, at the moment it mostly involves being asked random questions by a stowaway.

steps.player: I'm not a stowaway! I was invited aboard! By Lokar! Ask him!

steps.npc: Hey, whatever [love/pal]. Just make sure the captain doesn't catch you, pirates don't like stowaways much.

steps.player: Hello.

steps.npc: Ah, good day to you [milady/sirrah]! Your face is unfamiliar, did you perhaps join us aboard the ship at Lunar Isle?

steps.player: No, Lokar offered me a lift in Rellekka actually.

steps.npc: Oh, really? You don't look like a Fremennik to me!

steps.player: Well... I kind of am, and I kind of aren't. It's a long story.

steps.npc: Sorry I don't have time to hear it then! See you around young fremennik-who-is-not-really-a-fremennik!

steps.player: 'Bye.
Hello.
Brrrr! Its cold up here!

steps.npc: You think this is cold? Up by Acheron it gets so cold that when you talk you see the words freeze in the air in front of you!

steps.player: REALLY?

steps.npc: Nah, not really. I was exaggerating for humourous effect. It is very very cold though!

steps.player: Hello.

steps.npc: Hello to you too.

steps.player: Yar! We be pirates, yar! Avast, ye scurvy land-lubbing lychee!

steps.npc: Please don't talk like that, it is extremely irritating.
Also, please don't call me a lychee, whatever that may be.

steps.player: Oh. Okay. Sorry.
Hello.

steps.npc: ARGH! SOUND THE ALARM! STOWAWAY ON BOARD! STOWAWAY ON BOARD!

steps.player: No! I'm not a stowaway! Honest! I was invited here!

steps.npc: Oh, sorry, my mistake then.
You must admit you do look a lot like a stowaway though.

steps.player: Why, what do they usually look like?

steps.npc: Erm... I've never actually met one...

steps.player: Okay then...
Hello.

steps.npc: Hello.

steps.player: So... You're a pirate, huh?

steps.npc: It's what it says on my pay-packet at the end of the month.

steps.player: How's that working out for you?

steps.npc: Pretty good so far. All the grog and loot that we can plunder, plus full medical including dental.

steps.player: You mean you have insurance?

steps.npc: Not as such. If any of us get sick we kidnap a doctor and don't let him go until we're better.
You'd be surprised what an incentive for expert health care that is.

steps.player: I can imagine.
Hello.

steps.npc: Hello there. So what brings you aboard the Lady Zay?

steps.player: Well, I was planning on visiting the Moon Clan, but I have to say your ship is very impressive.

steps.npc: Aye, she's a beauty alright! The Lady Zay has been my home for many hard months, through storm and sun, and she always gets us to here we were headed!

steps.player: Yes, she's certainly one of the finest boats I've seen on my travels!

steps.npc: That she is [lad/lass], that she is.

steps.player: Hello.

steps.npc: Sorry, can't stop, the Captain will have my guts for garters if he catches me slacking off talking to the stowaway.

steps.player: I'm not a stowaway! I was invited aboard!

steps.npc: Yeah, whatever [guy/lady], it doesn't really matter who you are I'll get in trouble!

standard-dialogue.npc: I'm sorry to bother you, [player name], but I need some help with a bee hive.

options.text: Ooh, a bee hive. I'll help you.

steps.player: Ooh, a bee hive. I'll help you.

steps.text: Player is teleported to a field of beehives

steps.player: Buzz off!

continuation-after-being-teleported.npc: Ah, [player name]. I'm sorry to drag you away like this, but I need some help building a new hive for my bees.

continuation-after-being-teleported.player: What do you expect me to do?

continuation-after-being-teleported.npc: All the parts of the beehive are jumbled up. You've got to put them in the correct order for building a hive.

continuation-after-being-teleported.player: Oh, very well. Let's take a look...

options.text: First remind me of what I'm doing.

steps.player: First remind me of what I'm doing.

steps.npc: All the parts of the beehive are jumbled up. You've got to put them in the correct order for building a hive.

steps.text: (The Bee keeper's beehive interface opens.)

options.text: Yeah, let me get on with it.

steps.player: Yeah, let me get on with it.

steps.text: (The Bee keeper's beehive interface opens.)

after-building-the-beehive-wrong-first-t.npc: No, that doesn't look right. You have to put the parts in the right order, otherwise it'll be no good as a beehive.
I'll let you have 5 more tries.

after-building-the-beehive-wrong-twice.npc: No, that doesn't look right. You have to put the parts in the right order, otherwise it'll be no good as a beehive.
I'll let you have 4 more tries.

after-building-the-beehive-wrong-three-t.npc: No, that doesn't look right. You have to put the parts in the right order, otherwise it'll be no good as a beehive.
I'll let you have 3 more tries.

after-building-the-beehive-wrong-four-ti.npc: No, that doesn't look right. You have to put the parts in the right order, otherwise it'll be no good as a beehive.
I'll let you have 2 more tries.

after-building-the-beehive-wrong-five-ti.npc: No, that doesn't look right. You have to put the parts in the right order, otherwise it'll be no good as a beehive.
I'll let you have one more try.

after-building-the-beehive-wrong-six-tim.npc: Uh-oh, the bees are fed up with waiting for you to build them a home!

after-building-the-beehive-wrong-six-tim.text: Three bee swarms start stinging the player, while the player runs around for a while and attempts to defend themself helplessly.

steps.player: Ooch!
Eek!
Beees!
Ow!

after-building-the-beehive-wrong-six-tim.text: The bee keeper starts casting a tele-other spell.
The player is still briefly being stun by bees.
Player is teleported back to their original location, with no reward and no losses.

after-building-the-beehive-correctly.npc: That's perfect! I'll get some bees moved in immediately.
Now, I'm sure I must have something to offer you for all your help...

after-building-the-beehive-correctly.text: Player is teleported back to their original location
the Bee keeper random event reward(s)

talking-to-bee-keeper-looking-for-anothe.npc: Sorry, you're not the person I need.

overhead-dialogue.text: Upon spawning in for the player & waiting for a response by the player:

steps.npc: Hello, [player name]?
Please help me, [player name].
I need your help, [player name]!
Can I borrow you for a minute, [player name]?

overhead-dialogue.text: If the player does not respond in time:

steps.npc: Maybe later.

standard-dialogue.npc: Hello, it seems you've found a wild bee hive. I'll pay you to help me rehome them.

steps.npc: Oh, well, if you ever want to find out how to help, just ask.
It's easy, simply add logs to the unfinished bee boxes I create. Most common types of log work just fine.
Once a bee box is completed I will start a new one, let's see how many of these bees we can save.
I'll find a nice new home for those bees.
Come with me little bees I'll keep you safe.

overhead-dialogue-before-he-leaves.npc: Well, I must be getting on now.

standard-dialogue-after-royal-trouble.npc: If only that gigantic snake hadn't moved in.

standard-dialogue-with-a-catspeak-amulet.player: Hello puss.

standard-dialogue-with-a-catspeak-amulet.npc: Hello human.

standard-dialogue-with-a-catspeak-amulet.player: Would you like a fish?

standard-dialogue-with-a-catspeak-amulet.npc: I don't want your fish. I hunt and eat what I need by myself.

standard-dialogue.npc: Hello human.
This guild contains minerals that haven't been found anywhere else. I'm here to try and identify them.
If you come across any unusual minerals when mining here I'll take them off your hands. Don't worry, I'll make it worth your while.
I've also been digging out this cave recently. I found a bunch of amethyst in there.

steps.player: What can you offer me?

steps.npc: I have some gloves that will help you when Mining. When you wear these gloves you'll find that some rocks will instantly respawn.

steps.player: How do they do that?

steps.npc: Magic!
Beyond that, I could consider letting you access this new cave. It seems to contain even more minerals.
So, what would you like?

options.text: I'd like to view the shop.
I'd like access to the cave.
options.condition: If the player has not been granted access to the diary amethyst mine:

steps.player: I'd like access to the cave.

steps.npc: Now hold on. There's a lot of minerals in there, and digging out the cave was hard work. Only a true friend of Falador would be allowed in there.

steps.text: If the player has not completed the Elite Falador Diary:

steps.npc: You don't seem like you're quite there yet. Come speak to me again once you have completed the Elite Falador Achievement Diary.

steps.text: If the player has completed the Elite Falador Diary:

steps.npc: And you truly are a friend of Falador. Well done on completing the Elite Falador Achievement Diary. Go on in, you may access the cave.

options.text: I don't want to receive minerals.
options.condition: If the player is currently receiving unidentified minerals:

steps.player: I don't want to receive minerals.

steps.npc: Very well. You'll no longer find any minerals when you mine here. If you change your mind just let me know.

options.condition: If the player is currently not receiving unidentified minerals:

steps.player: I'd like to receive minerals.

steps.npc: As you wish. You'll now find minerals when you mine here. Let me know if you want to change this.

options.text: Can you combine my mining gloves?

steps.player: Can you combine my mining gloves?

steps.npc: I guess I could combine some Mining gloves with some Superior mining gloves. These new gloves would require 70 Mining to equip.
It wouldn't be free though. I'd want 40 minerals in return.

steps.text: If the player does not have all the items needed to create expert mining gloves:

steps.npc: You don't have any gloves for me to combine. You'll need to bring me some Mining gloves and some Superior mining gloves.

steps.text: If the player does not enough unidentified minerals:

steps.npc: You don't have enough minerals. You need at least 40.

steps.text: If the player has all the items needed to create expert mining gloves:
expert mining gloves

steps.npc: There you go. I've combined your gloves into some Expert mining gloves. Enjoy.
Fair enough. I'll be here if you change your mind.

attempting-to-enter-the-diary-amethyst-m.npc: Hey, you! You're not allowed in there! Come speak to me first.

WhNt-5.npc: Don't forget to come to me if you find any minerals.

willow-the-archaeologist-talking-to-will.player: Hello there. What are you doing all the way out here?

willow-the-archaeologist-talking-to-will.speaker: Willow
willow-the-archaeologist-talking-to-will.text: No... I found something. A door.

willow-the-archaeologist-talking-to-will.player: A door? I see doors all the time. What makes this one so special?

willow-the-archaeologist-talking-to-will.speaker: Willow
willow-the-archaeologist-talking-to-will.text: It's buried beneath a tonne of rocks. Could be the entrance to some ancient ruins...

willow-the-archaeologist-talking-to-will.player: Wow! Ancient ruins? Are you an archaeologist or something?

willow-the-archaeologist-talking-to-will.speaker: Willow
willow-the-archaeologist-talking-to-will.text: Of course I am! I'm the greatest archaeologist of our time. The name's Willow! Have you not heard of me?

willow-the-archaeologist-talking-to-will.player: I'm afraid I haven't. Are you looking for a way into the ruins?

willow-the-archaeologist-talking-to-will.speaker: Willow
willow-the-archaeologist-talking-to-will.text: You bet I am, but I don't think there's any other way in.

willow-the-archaeologist-talking-to-will.player: Oh dear. Do you have another plan to get in?

willow-the-archaeologist-talking-to-will.speaker: Willow
willow-the-archaeologist-talking-to-will.text: Potentially, but I won't be able to do it on my own. Nor can I leave the area. If I'm not here to guard the entrance, some other archaeologist might come along and steal the glory from me!

willow-the-archaeologist-talking-to-will.speaker: Willow
willow-the-archaeologist-talking-to-will.text: Maybe you could give me a hand? There could be untold riches inside the ruins!

steps.player: A chance to uncover ancient ruins doesn't happen every day! Of course I'll help! I'm [player name] by the way. How do you plan to get in?

steps.speaker: Willow
steps.text: The entrance is covered in rocks and rubble - I don't think mining them will work.

steps.speaker: Willow
steps.text: We'll need something stronger. Who knows what could be inside the ruins. There could be traps, or even monsters!

steps.speaker: Willow
steps.text: No, I think we'll need to get my old crew...

steps.speaker: Willow
steps.text: ...I mean, excavation team together. But you'll need to convince them to help us. We didn't part on the best of terms.

steps.player: What happened?

steps.speaker: Willow
steps.text: We had a falling out after a, uhm... dig, went wrong.

steps.player: Where can I find your old team, and how will they help?

steps.speaker: Willow
steps.text: To get into the ruins we'll need to blow up all the rocks blocking the entrance.

steps.player: That doesn't sound too safe. What if we damage the ruins? Surely it's better to go slower and preserve as much as we can?

steps.speaker: Willow
steps.text: No! We need to get in there as soon as possible! Burntof the dwarf will do it. He's a master with explosives.

steps.speaker: Willow
steps.text: From what I can remember, he's a fan of his drink. His favourite pub being the Rising Sun Inn, in Falador - I'd look there first.

steps.speaker: Willow
steps.text: After we've blown the rocks away, we'll need someone to move all the rubble. Someone strong.

steps.player: I could do it! I'm quite strong myself.

steps.speaker: Willow
steps.text: Ha ha ha! I don't think so. We need a real [strongman/strongwoman] - someone with muscles. An old friend of mine, Checkal, should be able to do all the heavy lifting.

steps.player: Oh okay... Where can I find him?

steps.speaker: Willow
steps.text: Hmm... We had quite a rough falling out when we last spoke, but I heard he's hanging around Barbarian Village.

steps.speaker: Willow
steps.text: Lastly, if my hunch is correct, this place will be covered in traps. We'll need my pal Marley to disarm them. He's the best thief I know. Been doing it for years.

steps.speaker: Willow
steps.text: I have no idea where he is these days. But his cousin Charlie in Varrock may know. You should talk to him. He's normally somewhere near the Blue Moon Inn.

steps.player: You have a rather interesting group of friends... but if they get us into the ruins, I'm all for it.

steps.speaker: Willow
steps.text: Good luck. Once you've recruited one of the team, I'll meet them at the entrance. It's on the west side of the mountain.

steps.player: Seems like you're in a bit of a pickle. Have fun with that.

willow-the-archaeologist-talking-to-will.speaker: Willow
willow-the-archaeologist-talking-to-will.text: Back again? What can I help you with?

steps.player: Where can I find Marley?

steps.speaker: Willow
steps.text: Marley is an elusive one, to be honest. I have no idea where to find him. You should try talk to his cousin Charlie near the Blue Moon Inn in Varrock. Maybe he will know.

steps.speaker: Willow
steps.text: Need help finding anyone else?

steps.player: Where can I find Checkal?

steps.speaker: Willow
steps.text: Last I heard Checkal was hanging around Barbarian Village. Maybe you should head there to find him?

steps.speaker: Willow
steps.text: Need help finding anyone else?

steps.player: Where can I find Burntof?

steps.speaker: Willow
steps.text: Burntof likes to hang out at the Rising Sun Inn located in Falador.

steps.speaker: Willow
steps.text: Need help finding anyone else?

options.text: Where can I find the entrance to the ruins?

steps.player: Where can I find the entrance to the ruins?

steps.speaker: Willow
steps.text: On the western side of Ice Mountain. There's no way up on this side so you'll need to head east of here first and go around the dwarf colony to get there.

steps.player: Okay.
Nothing, thanks.

steps.speaker: Willow
steps.text: Hurry up! It's not exactly exciting standing out here all day.

checkal-the-strongman-talking-to-checkal.player: Hello there. I'm [player name] and I'm looking for a man named Checkal.

checkal-the-strongman-talking-to-checkal.speaker: Checkal
checkal-the-strongman-talking-to-checkal.text: That would be me [sir/miss]. What can I do for you?

checkal-the-strongman-talking-to-checkal.player: I was told to come find you. Willow has found a new digsi...

checkal-the-strongman-talking-to-checkal.speaker: Checkal
checkal-the-strongman-talking-to-checkal.text: Stop right there [sir/miss]. You can tell Willow she can do the heavy lifting herself.

checkal-the-strongman-talking-to-checkal.speaker: Checkal
checkal-the-strongman-talking-to-checkal.text: Willow does not appreciate the amount of work that goes into building my physique. I would not help her lift a shrimp.

checkal-the-strongman-talking-to-checkal.speaker: Checkal
checkal-the-strongman-talking-to-checkal.text: I take great pride in these muscles and it hurts me to the core to hear such insults!

checkal-the-strongman-talking-to-checkal.player: But we need your help! She's found a new archaeological digsite and needs you to help clear the entrance.

checkal-the-strongman-talking-to-checkal.speaker: Checkal
checkal-the-strongman-talking-to-checkal.text: Archaeological digsite? Why is Willow interested in starting a digsite?

checkal-the-strongman-talking-to-checkal.player: She said there could be some ancient ruins, even an untouched hoard of gold and treasure!

checkal-the-strongman-talking-to-checkal.speaker: Checkal
checkal-the-strongman-talking-to-checkal.text: Ah that makes sense. *Sighs* You poor [lad/lass]...

checkal-the-strongman-talking-to-checkal.speaker: Checkal
checkal-the-strongman-talking-to-checkal.text: Nothing. Look, I will help you. But first you must prove your strength to me.
If the player has 99 Strength:

steps.player: Well Checkal, I don't mean to brag, but there are few people in Gielinor stronger than me.

steps.speaker: Checkal
steps.text: Hmm... I will see about that.

steps.speaker: Checkal
steps.text: Yes... you do have tremendous muscle mass.

steps.speaker: Checkal
steps.text: Your legs are strong as steel, too.

steps.speaker: Checkal
steps.text: Well [player name], I have to say you are the definition of strength.

steps.player: I do try.

steps.speaker: Checkal
steps.text: But a [strongman/strongwoman] doesn't stop when they reach the top. They always push themselves.

checkal-the-strongman-talking-to-checkal.text: If the player doesn't have 99 Strength:

steps.player: Well that shouldn't be too hard. I'm pretty strong.

steps.speaker: Checkal
steps.text: That is true. But are you strong in both body and mind?

steps.player: Uhm... yes?

steps.speaker: Checkal
steps.text: To be a true [strongman/strongwoman], you do not just need big muscles. No, you must have self control and an unrelenting desire to push yourself to become stronger.

steps.player: Oh, I'm not sure about that...

checkal-the-strongman-talking-to-checkal.speaker: Checkal
checkal-the-strongman-talking-to-checkal.text: I would ask you to train with my old friend and trainer, Atlas, one of the strongest barbarians I know. You can find him in the hall north of here.

checkal-the-strongman-talking-to-checkal.speaker: Checkal
checkal-the-strongman-talking-to-checkal.text: If you can survive his rigorous training program, I shall offer you my help.

checkal-the-strongman-talking-to-checkal.player: How do you know he'll train me?

checkal-the-strongman-talking-to-checkal.speaker: Checkal
checkal-the-strongman-talking-to-checkal.text: Tell him I sent you and he will train you.

checkal-the-strongman-talking-to-checkal.player: Alright then, I'll go speak to Atlas. Farewell.
I seem to have forgotten where Atlas is. Can you remind me?

checkal-the-strongman-talking-to-checkal.speaker: Checkal
checkal-the-strongman-talking-to-checkal.text: Atlas can be found in the hall to the north of us.

checkal-the-strongman-talking-to-checkal.speaker: Checkal
checkal-the-strongman-talking-to-checkal.text: No problem at all.

checkal-the-strongman-talking-to-atlas.player: I've just come to talk to you. Checkal said you could train me. He said you're the strongest barbarian he knows.

checkal-the-strongman-talking-to-atlas.speaker: Atlas
checkal-the-strongman-talking-to-atlas.text: Oh did he now? What makes you think I will train you?

checkal-the-strongman-talking-to-atlas.speaker: Atlas
checkal-the-strongman-talking-to-atlas.text: Come on then! Out with it already!

checkal-the-strongman-talking-to-atlas.player: Well uh, he said he wouldn't...

checkal-the-strongman-talking-to-atlas.speaker: Atlas
checkal-the-strongman-talking-to-atlas.text: I'm just pulling your leg! Any friend of Checkal is a friend of mine.

checkal-the-strongman-talking-to-atlas.player: Please don't scare me like that.

checkal-the-strongman-talking-to-atlas.speaker: Atlas
checkal-the-strongman-talking-to-atlas.text: It's a force of habit. It comes with the barbarian lifestyle. But to apologise, I'll give you a free lesson!

checkal-the-strongman-talking-to-atlas.player: Oh really? How much would this usually cost?

checkal-the-strongman-talking-to-atlas.speaker: Atlas
checkal-the-strongman-talking-to-atlas.text: No price is too much for a good workout. Are you ready to start your training session?

steps.text: Training session begins.

steps.speaker: Atlas
steps.text: If you want to become a [strongman/strongwoman], you need to get into shape!

steps.speaker: Atlas
steps.text: It's not all about strength! You need to get some cardio in, too.

steps.speaker: Atlas
steps.text: You need to be tough to be a [strongman/strongwoman]! Show me what you've got! Come on!

steps.speaker: Atlas
steps.text: Every [strongman/strongwoman] was once a beginner who refused to give up.

steps.speaker: Atlas
steps.text: You need to push yourself!

steps.speaker: Atlas
steps.text: Always strive to be the best that you can be! That is the [strongman/strongwoman] way.

steps.speaker: Atlas
steps.text: I'm very proud of you. You've shown grit, determination and an iron will. You are a true [strongman/strongwoman] at heart.

steps.player: That was exhausting... I've never worked so hard in my life!

steps.speaker: Atlas
steps.text: And for that, I am proud. Now, show us what you're made of and flex those muscles!
You have unlocked the flex emote!
Training session ends.

steps.speaker: Atlas
steps.text: My work is done. Return to Checkal and show him your new-found muscles.

steps.player: Not right now, I am a bit busy.

steps.speaker: Atlas
steps.text: No problem. Come back when you are ready.

checkal-the-strongman-talking-to-atlas-a.speaker: Atlas
checkal-the-strongman-talking-to-atlas-a.text: You're back. Would you like to start that training session now?

checkal-the-strongman-talking-to-atlas-a.speaker: Atlas
checkal-the-strongman-talking-to-atlas-a.text: Well done, little one. You've proven your worth.

checkal-the-strongman-talking-to-atlas-a.player: It was fun, I'd like to do it again.

checkal-the-strongman-talking-to-atlas-a.speaker: Atlas
checkal-the-strongman-talking-to-atlas-a.text: You're the first person to ask me that [player name]. I suppose I could train you again, but I will have to charge you the full 25,000 coins this time.

steps.player: Let's do this, I'm ready.

steps.text: If the player has 25000 coins on them:

steps.speaker: Atlas
steps.text: It's not going to be any easier my friend!

If the player doesn't have 25000 coins on them:

steps.speaker: Atlas
steps.text: Hold it there little one, you don't have enough money to pay for the lesson.

steps.player: Oh, sorry I was too excited...

steps.speaker: Atlas
steps.text: No worries friend, come back when you can afford the session.

checkal-the-strongman-talking-to-atlas-a.player: Thanks for that workout. I can see why you normally charge people so much.

checkal-the-strongman-talking-to-atlas-a.speaker: Atlas
checkal-the-strongman-talking-to-atlas-a.text: Back again I see, here for another workout?

checkal-the-strongman-talking-to-atlas-a.speaker: Atlas
checkal-the-strongman-talking-to-atlas-a.text: You must take your training very seriously [player name]. This is the second time you'll have done this workout and paid full price!
Pay Atlas 25,000 coins to train again?

checkal-the-strongman-subsequent-trainin.speaker: Atlas
checkal-the-strongman-subsequent-trainin.text: Back again I see, here for another workout?

checkal-the-strongman-subsequent-trainin.speaker: Atlas
checkal-the-strongman-subsequent-trainin.text: You take your training very seriously [player name]. You know you've done this workout [times done] times, are you sure you want to do it again?
Pay Atlas 25,000 coins to train again?

checkal-the-strongman-talking-to-checkal.speaker: Checkal
checkal-the-strongman-talking-to-checkal.text: So have you completed your training session with Atlas?

checkal-the-strongman-talking-to-checkal.player: Just about, but it was a real struggle.

checkal-the-strongman-talking-to-checkal.speaker: Checkal
checkal-the-strongman-talking-to-checkal.text: It always is, but I can see you are standing taller and looking stronger already.

checkal-the-strongman-talking-to-checkal.speaker: Checkal
checkal-the-strongman-talking-to-checkal.text: Now, show me your muscles and I will judge if you're ready to receive my help.
Show your strength by flexing your muscles.

checkal-the-strongman-talking-to-checkal.speaker: Checkal
checkal-the-strongman-talking-to-checkal.text: My goodness, those muscles are exquisite. I will definitely help a [man/lady] who shows that much dedication to their physique.

checkal-the-strongman-talking-to-checkal.player: Fantastic! Willow said she'd meet you by the entrance, on the west side of Ice Mountain.

checkal-the-strongman-talking-to-checkal.speaker: Checkal
checkal-the-strongman-talking-to-checkal.text: Thank you my friend, I will meet you there.
If this was not the last member the player needed to recruit:

steps.player: What an exhausting workout. I hope the others aren't as much effort to recruit.

checkal-the-strongman-talking-to-checkal.text: If this was the last member the player needed to recruit:

checkal-the-strongman-talking-to-checkal.player: What did you want me to do again?

checkal-the-strongman-talking-to-checkal.speaker: Checkal
checkal-the-strongman-talking-to-checkal.text: I want you to prove your strength by showing me your muscles!
Show your strength by flexing your muscles.

checkal-the-strongman-talking-to-checkal.speaker: Checkal

checkal-the-strongman-talking-to-checkal.speaker: Checkal
checkal-the-strongman-talking-to-checkal.text: Do not worry my friend. If you stay dedicated and keep working everyday, you'll be able to achieve anything you dream of.

checkal-the-strongman-talking-to-checkal.speaker: Checkal
checkal-the-strongman-talking-to-checkal.text: One last thing - be careful when we go inside. You never know what will happen.

You give the steak sandwich to Marley.

marley-the-thief-returning-to-marley.speaker: Marley
marley-the-thief-returning-to-marley.text: Aaah... not quite as good as the usual, but it hit the spot.

marley-the-thief-returning-to-marley.speaker: Marley
marley-the-thief-returning-to-marley.text: Yes [sir/miss] I am. I'll honour my side of the deal and head off to find Willow.

marley-the-thief-returning-to-marley.player: Finally! You can find her on the west side of Ice Mountain.

marley-the-thief-returning-to-marley.speaker: Marley
marley-the-thief-returning-to-marley.text: Excellent! I'll be on my way then.
If this was not the last member the player needed to convince:

steps.player: Marley is certainly an interesting character. Hopefully the next team member is more respectable.

marley-the-thief-returning-to-marley.text: If this was the last member the player needed to convince:

marley-the-thief-returning-to-marley-tal.speaker: Marley
marley-the-thief-returning-to-marley-tal.text: Ah, my new favourite chef. Have you got another sandwich for me?

marley-the-thief-returning-to-marley-tal.speaker: Marley
marley-the-thief-returning-to-marley-tal.text: Woah! Alright there, calm down. Was only a joke.

marley-the-thief-returning-to-marley-tal.player: I don't find being your errand boy very funny.

marley-the-thief-returning-to-marley-tal.speaker: Marley
marley-the-thief-returning-to-marley-tal.text: You need to lighten up a little, my friend.

the-ruins-of-camdozaal-talking-to-willow.player: That's everyone gathered. Interesting company for an archaeologist to keep...

the-ruins-of-camdozaal-talking-to-willow.speaker: Willow
the-ruins-of-camdozaal-talking-to-willow.text: Shrugs* How many archaeologists do you actually know?

the-ruins-of-camdozaal-talking-to-willow.speaker: Willow
the-ruins-of-camdozaal-talking-to-willow.text: Exactly. So who are you to judge? Anyway, we're all here and ready to break in... Um, I mean excavate... the entrance.

the-ruins-of-camdozaal-talking-to-willow.speaker: Willow
the-ruins-of-camdozaal-talking-to-willow.text: Are you ready? Who knows what's inside the ruins?

steps.player: I'm ready as I'll ever be. Let's head in.

steps.text: Cutscene begins.

steps.speaker: Willow
steps.text: Right, that's everyone gathered. Thank you, [player name], for all your help.

steps.player: Oh it was no pro...

steps.speaker: Willow
steps.text: Okay everyone, we've wasted enough time. Let's crack this door open. Burntof, you're up!

steps.speaker: Willow
steps.text: Try not to blow the entire mountain up this time...

steps.speaker: Burntof
steps.text: Yesh ma'am, let'sh get this rock out the way.
Screen fades to black.

steps.speaker: Burntof
steps.text: Jusht got to plashe thish here...

steps.speaker: Burntof
steps.text: ... little bit of dyn-*hic*-amite here...

steps.speaker: Burntof
steps.text: ... and there we go!

steps.speaker: Burntof
steps.text: Now we light the fushe!
Screen returns to normal.

steps.speaker: Burntof
steps.text: What are you doin' standin' there?!

steps.player: What do you mean?

steps.speaker: Burntof
steps.text: Everyone'sh ran for cover [lad/lass]. You'd best do the shame.

steps.player: Wait, what?!

steps.speaker: Burntof
steps.text: Clock'sh ticking [lad/lass]!
The player runs off screen, and the rocks blow up, clearing the way to the ruins.

steps.speaker: Marley
steps.text: Bloomin' 'eck, Burntof!

steps.speaker: Checkal
steps.text: That was a tad too explosive I think.

steps.player: My ears are still ringing!

steps.speaker: Burntof
steps.text: Quit yer moanin', it did the job didnae it?

steps.speaker: Willow
steps.text: He's right, the rock's been broken up. Checkal, it's your turn.

steps.speaker: Checkal
steps.text: Of course ma'am, I will get to work.
Screen fades to black.
Checkal sets to work clearing out the rubble...
Screen returns to normal.

steps.speaker: Checkal
steps.text: The work is done, Willow. My apologies if it took too long.

steps.speaker: Willow
steps.text: Don't be sorry, Checkal. Gotta put those muscles to use somehow.

steps.speaker: Willow
steps.text: Alright Marley, in you go. Let us know if you find anything.

steps.speaker: Marley
steps.text: Right, in I go. Wish me luck [player name].

steps.player: Try not to die...

steps.text: Cutscene shifts to Marley, inside the ruins.

steps.speaker: Marley
steps.text: Right, let's see what hidden surprises you have in store for me.

steps.speaker: Marley
steps.text: Hmm...
Marley disables a trap.

steps.speaker: Marley
steps.text: That would have been nasty.

steps.speaker: Marley
steps.text: Is that it? I thought this place would be better protected.
Marley avoids a tripwire.

steps.speaker: Marley
steps.text: Now to disarm it...

steps.speaker: Marley
steps.text: Maybe this will work?

steps.speaker: Marley
steps.text: That got it!

steps.speaker: Marley
steps.text: Alright guys! It's safe to come in! I think...
Screen fades to black; the player and everyone are now inside the ruins.

steps.player: Wow, this place is amazing. I can't believe this was hidden away.
I wonder how long it's been left untouched for.

steps.speaker: Willow
steps.text: You're impressed? There's nothing here but dust and fallen rocks.

steps.speaker: Burntof
steps.text: Yaaa*hic*aawn

steps.player: You don't find it exciting? As an archaeologist, I thought you would be thrilled at this discovery?

steps.speaker: Willow
steps.text: Thrilled? What's there to be excited about? I don't see any gold, diamonds, rare gems or piles of lost treasure!

steps.speaker: Burntof
steps.text: Hmm...

steps.player: It's not about the money though, right? We've potentially discovered the long lost ruins of an ancient civilisation!

steps.speaker: Willow
steps.text: Of course it's about the money. It's always been about money, you fool.

steps.player: I don't understand...

steps.speaker: Willow
steps.text: We're not a team of archaeologist, you idiot. We're grave robbers looking for their next score.

steps.speaker: Burntof
steps.text: Theshe markings look familiar...

steps.player: So this entire time, you've just been using me to help break into these ruins in hopes of finding someone else's treasures.

steps.speaker: Willow
steps.text: Yep, and you were surprisingly easy to convince. I'll admit, you have been a tremendous help, [player name].

steps.speaker: Willow
steps.text: But your usefulness has come to an end I'm afraid. I can't simply let you leave here.

steps.player: Why not?

steps.speaker: Willow
steps.text: I can't risk you running to the authorities and telling them about our little gang. We're wanted in quite a few large cities across Gielinor.

steps.speaker: Burntof
steps.text: I've sheen thish before...

steps.speaker: Willow
steps.text: I'm afraid this is the end of the road for you, [player name]. This ruin is about to become your tomb.
Burntof steps on a tile, setting something off.

steps.speaker: Burntof
steps.text: hic* Woops...

steps.speaker: Willow
steps.text: What was that noise?

steps.speaker: Burntof
steps.text: Uh... it wasn't me!
The ground shakes.

steps.speaker: Willow
steps.text: Whats happening?!
The ground stops shaking.

steps.speaker: Willow
steps.text: It feels like the quaking has finally stopped...
The rocks by the big doors come to life, becoming an Ancient Guardian.

steps.speaker: Willow
steps.text: Holy Zamorak! What is that thing?! Checkal, take it down!

steps.speaker: Checkal
steps.text: I'm a muscle man, not a fighter.

steps.speaker: Marley
steps.text: I think we should get out of here, Willow!

steps.speaker: Willow
steps.text: You're right, Marley. Burntof, we're leaving!
Screen fades to black and the cutscene ends.

steps.player: I can't believe they ran so quickly. I suppose I should take care of this thing.
I need a little bit more time to prepare.

steps.speaker: Willow
steps.text: Hurry up then! We've waited long enough.

the-ruins-of-camdozaal-talking-to-willow.speaker: Willow
the-ruins-of-camdozaal-talking-to-willow.text: Are you finally ready to crack these ruins open?

finishing-up.player: That monster showed up at the perfect time. I would have been toast if Willow and her gang had their chance to attack.
Speaking of which, maybe they left something behind I can salvage some kind of reward from.
Looks like Willow left a bag behind. Maybe there's something in it I could take.

finishing-up.text: You rummage through Willow's bag...

finishing-up.player: Those will do nicely!

finishing-up.text: A sound of doors opening occurs.

finishing-up.player: What was that noise? Please don't be another rock monster...
What the!

finishing-up.speaker: Ramarno
finishing-up.text: Bless my beard...

post-quest-dialogue-ramarno.speaker: Note
post-quest-dialogue-ramarno.text: The player will automatically speak to Ramarno upon closing the quest completion interface.

post-quest-dialogue-ramarno.player: Wow. I honestly didn't expect to see a dwarf in these ruins.

post-quest-dialogue-ramarno.speaker: Ramarno
post-quest-dialogue-ramarno.text: It's been so long since I've heard another person's voice.

post-quest-dialogue-ramarno.player: To be honest, it was all a bit of an accident.
There was a gang of... well, I thought were archaeologists, but it turned out they were grave robbers.
I helped them clear the entrance to these ruins and we worked our way inside, only to wake up a monster! They ran off and left me to defeat it.

post-quest-dialogue-ramarno.speaker: Ramarno
post-quest-dialogue-ramarno.text: That was one of the guardians of this once great city.

post-quest-dialogue-ramarno.speaker: Ramarno
post-quest-dialogue-ramarno.text: Yes! Camdozaal, home of the Imcando Dwarves.

post-quest-dialogue-ramarno.speaker: Ramarno
post-quest-dialogue-ramarno.text: These halls once bustled with life, but that was a long time ago. I'm the only one left now. The name's Ramarno.

post-quest-dialogue-ramarno.player: Well Ramarno, I'm [player name], and you have me at a loss for words! I'd have never even imagined there would be a whole city down here.

post-quest-dialogue-ramarno.speaker: Ramarno
post-quest-dialogue-ramarno.text: Not much of a city anymore, I suppose.

post-quest-dialogue-ramarno.player: I guess I didn't help with that. Sorry about breaking into your home and killing your guardian.

post-quest-dialogue-ramarno.speaker: Ramarno
post-quest-dialogue-ramarno.text: We have plenty more. No real harm done. That said, I do think I might have a way for you to make up for it. There'll likely be something in it for you as well.

post-quest-dialogue-ramarno.speaker: Ramarno
post-quest-dialogue-ramarno.text: My workshop is just north of here. Meet me there and we'll talk further.

post-quest-dialogue-ramarno-using-any-it.text: Ramarno still looks shocked. Perhaps you should talk to him first.

post-quest-dialogue-willow.player: So this is where you scampered off to after the monster awoke?

post-quest-dialogue-willow.speaker: Willow
post-quest-dialogue-willow.text: Look [player name], it was a simple misunderstanding, that's all...

post-quest-dialogue-willow.player: Oh really? You threatening to kill me was just a misunderstanding?

post-quest-dialogue-willow.speaker: Willow
post-quest-dialogue-willow.text: Things got a little heated down there, but we all made it out alive, right?

post-quest-dialogue-willow.player: Barely... I had to defeat that monster on my own!
What are you doing out here, anyway?

post-quest-dialogue-willow.speaker: Willow
post-quest-dialogue-willow.text: We thought you'd rat us out to the authorities, so we came out here to hide.

post-quest-dialogue-willow.speaker: Willow
post-quest-dialogue-willow.text: Plus, we heard there are some sealed tombs in the desert that haven't been touched in hundreds of years...

post-quest-dialogue-willow.player: Ah, of course... scoping out your next grave to rob.

post-quest-dialogue-checkal.speaker: Checkal
post-quest-dialogue-checkal.text: [player name], I am so glad to see you are safe.

post-quest-dialogue-checkal.player: Hello, Checkal. Why didn't you tell me about Willow?

post-quest-dialogue-checkal.speaker: Checkal
post-quest-dialogue-checkal.text: I am sorry [player name]. I do respect you and your love for the muscle. But sadly I needed the money. These muscles don't pay the bills on their own.

post-quest-dialogue-checkal.speaker: Checkal
post-quest-dialogue-checkal.text: Please do not let this incident divert you from your path of becoming a [strongman/strongwoman]! I truly believe in you.

post-quest-dialogue-burntof.player: How you holding up Burntof? Must have had quite the fright when you woke that monster.

post-quest-dialogue-burntof.speaker: Burntof
post-quest-dialogue-burntof.text: You're right [lad/lass]. It did give me a little fright.

post-quest-dialogue-burntof.speaker: Burntof
post-quest-dialogue-burntof.text: But I saw some interesting things down in the ruins...

post-quest-dialogue-burntof.speaker: Burntof
post-quest-dialogue-burntof.text: Some of the markings on the wall look very familiar to me. I've seen them before.

post-quest-dialogue-burntof.player: Well, when I defeated the monster, an Imcando dwarf opened the barred door...

post-quest-dialogue-burntof.speaker: Burntof
post-quest-dialogue-burntof.text: An Imcando dwarf! I thought they were all but extinct! You've found something truly amazing [player name]!

post-quest-dialogue-burntof.speaker: Burntof
post-quest-dialogue-burntof.text: I wish I had a drink to celebrate, but this desert is bone dry.

post-quest-dialogue-marley.player: Wow, the desert really suits you Marley.

post-quest-dialogue-marley.speaker: Marley
post-quest-dialogue-marley.text: [player name] my old pal! How are you doing?

post-quest-dialogue-marley.player: Better now I don't have to deal with you. Enjoying life in the desert?

post-quest-dialogue-marley.speaker: Marley
post-quest-dialogue-marley.text: Not really. I'm not suited to such harsh climates. No steak sandwiches here either...

post-quest-dialogue-marley.player: Oh what a shame! Poor Marley's going to starve as he doesn't have anyone to make his sandwiches... So sad.

wqyOMP.player: Well, that's everyone. I guess I should head off the entrance on the west side of Ice Mountain.

starting-off-talking-to-jamila.speaker: Jamila
starting-off-talking-to-jamila.text: Hello there. Looking to buy some of my wares? I also have a special item in stock that I reckon you'll love!

steps.player: What's this special item?

steps.text: If the player does not meet the quest requirements:

steps.speaker: Jamila
steps.text: Oh... I seem to have misplaced it. Sorry about that. If you come back later, I might have found it.
You do not meet all of the requirements to start the Beneath Cursed Sands quest.
If the player has no inventory space:

steps.speaker: Jamila
steps.text: Oh it's fantastic! However, before we go into the details, you should make some room to carry it.

steps.player: Make some room? But I've not even decided if I want this... whatever it is.

steps.speaker: Jamila
steps.text: I just know that once you see it, you'll want it!

steps.player: Okay... I'll be back soon then.

steps.speaker: Jamila
steps.text: Oh it's fantastic! It's an exclusive item just for you! Consider it a thank you for all you've done for our city.
If the player is lower than level 85 combat:
Before starting this quest, be aware that your combat level is lower than the recommended level of 85.

steps.prompt: Start the Beneath Cursed Sands quest?

steps.player: Okay, let's have a look.

steps.text: Jamila shows you a gold ring.

steps.player: A ring?

steps.speaker: Jamila
steps.text: Isn't it wonderful! Here, try it on!
Jamila tries to put the ring on your finger. As she does, she slips you a message.

steps.speaker: Jamila
steps.text: Ah, it seems the ring is too small. Never mind.

steps.player: Wait... what?

steps.speaker: Jamila
steps.text: Well, time for me to get on with my work. Come back soon.

steps.player: Thanks for the offer, but I'll pass.

steps.speaker: Jamila
steps.text: Oh, I see. Well come back if you change your mind.

starting-off-talking-to-jamila-talking-t.speaker: Jamila
starting-off-talking-to-jamila-talking-t.text: Hello there. Looking to buy some of my wares?

steps.player: About that special item...

steps.speaker: Jamila
steps.text: Oh I think you're going to love it!
Jamila shows you a gold ring.

starting-off-talking-to-jamila-talking-t.speaker: Jamila
starting-off-talking-to-jamila-talking-t.text: Hello there. Looking to buy some of my wares? I also have a special item in stock that I reckon you'll love!

steps.player: About that special item...

steps.speaker: Jamila
steps.text: Yes, I'm sorry the ring didn't fit. Still, nothing lost and nothing gained, right?
If the player lost the message:

steps.player: Maybe I should try it on again.

steps.text: If the player has no inventory space:

steps.speaker: Jamila
steps.text: Well, I suppose you can. But first, you should make some room to carry it.

steps.speaker: Jamila
steps.text: Fair enough.
Jamila tries to put the ring on your finger. As she does, she slips you a message.

steps.speaker: Jamila
steps.text: Still too small I'm afraid. Now, it's time for me to get on with my work. Come back soon.
If the player did not lose the message:

steps.player: But what about...

steps.speaker: Jamila
steps.text: Sorry, but I have a lot to do. Come back soon.

starting-off-talking-to-maisa.player: I know you! You're Maisa, that spy from Al Kharid. But you're meant to be in Menaphos!

starting-off-talking-to-maisa.speaker: Maisa
starting-off-talking-to-maisa.text: I told Osman I was done with that posting, and I meant it.

starting-off-talking-to-maisa.player: But how did you get out of the city?

starting-off-talking-to-maisa.speaker: Maisa
starting-off-talking-to-maisa.text: The same way I helped those citizens of yours. Even with the quarantine, Menaphos are still sending their dead to Sophanem.

starting-off-talking-to-maisa.player: So you hid yourself among them? I see. Why are you out here though? And why did you send me that message?

starting-off-talking-to-maisa.speaker: Maisa
starting-off-talking-to-maisa.text: Because there's something very strange going on. I intend to work out what, but I need your help.

starting-off-talking-to-maisa.speaker: Maisa
starting-off-talking-to-maisa.text: My list of allies grows shorter every day, but you actually seem to care about what's happening out here. You also seem to know what you're doing.

starting-off-talking-to-maisa.player: Brave of you to assume that I ever actually know what I'm doing.

starting-off-talking-to-maisa.speaker: Maisa
starting-off-talking-to-maisa.text: Well I'm sure you can't be worse than Osman. You might even have the guts to take some action if needed.

starting-off-talking-to-maisa.player: Right... so what are these strange happenings?

starting-off-talking-to-maisa.speaker: Maisa
starting-off-talking-to-maisa.text: Citizens from Menaphos have been disappearing. Guards as well. They've been leaving the city, despite the quarantine.

starting-off-talking-to-maisa.player: They've been bypassing the quarantine? How?

starting-off-talking-to-maisa.speaker: Maisa
starting-off-talking-to-maisa.text: No idea, but I have managed to find out where they've been going.

starting-off-talking-to-maisa.speaker: Maisa
starting-off-talking-to-maisa.text: South of here, to the old necropolis. They're excavating something there, but I don't know what. There's also something strange going on with them.

starting-off-talking-to-maisa.speaker: Maisa
starting-off-talking-to-maisa.text: I went to this excavation of theirs to have a look around, and the way they're acting is very unusual. It's like nothing I've seen before.

starting-off-talking-to-maisa.player: Interesting. I think I need to see this for myself.

starting-off-talking-to-maisa.speaker: Maisa
starting-off-talking-to-maisa.text: Well let me know when you're ready, and I'll take you down there.

steps.player: Let's go.

steps.text: A cutscene starts. The player and Maisa arrive at the necropolis. Citizens can be seen mining and excavating, watched by Menaphite Guards.

steps.player: Look at them! How long have they been doing this?

steps.speaker: Maisa
steps.text: I'm not sure, but they're at it both day and night.

steps.player: So they never rest?

steps.speaker: Maisa
steps.text: Doesn't seem so.

steps.player: How weird. Can we get a closer look?

steps.speaker: Maisa
steps.text: Should be able to. When I came to investigate before, I was able to walk right up to them. They didn't even seem to care. It was like they were in some sort of trance.

steps.player: Hmm...

steps.text: The cutscene ends.

steps.player: I'm going to have a look around.

steps.speaker: Maisa
steps.text: I'll keep watch here. Try to keep a low profile.

steps.player: I'll try, but low profile isn't really one of my specialties.

steps.speaker: Maisa
steps.text: Oh good. I'll prepare for violence then.

options.text: I need to do something first.

starting-off-talking-to-maisa-talking-to.player: What are these strange happenings you mentioned?

starting-off-talking-to-maisa-talking-to.speaker: Maisa
starting-off-talking-to-maisa-talking-to.text: Citizens from Menaphos have been disappearing. Guards as well. They've been leaving the city, despite the quarantine.

starting-off-talking-to-maisa-talking-to.speaker: Maisa
starting-off-talking-to-maisa-talking-to.text: Ready to go and investigate the excavation?

steps.player: Let's go.

options.text: I need to do something first.

starting-off-talking-to-jamila-after-tal.speaker: Jamila
starting-off-talking-to-jamila-after-tal.text: Hello there. Looking to buy some of my wares?

starting-off-talking-to-maisa-at-the-nec.speaker: Maisa
starting-off-talking-to-maisa-at-the-nec.text: Be careful. There's something creepy about all of this.

starting-off-inspecting-the-blocked-entr.text: The entrance is completely blocked. There doesn't seem to be any way through.
The entrance is completely blocked. However, the blockage looks to have happened fairly recently. Perhaps it occurred during the excavation.
If the player has already talked to a citizen or guard:

steps.player: Interesting. I'd better report back to Maisa.

steps.text: Guard cutscene begins.

starting-off-talking-to-a-citizen.text: If the player has already talked to a guard or citizen:
If the player has not inspected the blocked entry:

steps.player: Hmm... this seems familiar...

starting-off-talking-to-a-citizen.text: If the player has already inspected the blocked entry:

steps.player: Hmm... this seems familiar... I'd better report back to Maisa.

steps.text: Guard cutscene begins.

starting-off-talking-to-a-menaphite-guar.text: If the player has already talked to a guard or citizen:
If the player has not inspected the blocked entry:

steps.player: Hmm... this seems familiar...

starting-off-talking-to-a-menaphite-guar.text: If the player has already inspected the blocked entry:

steps.player: Hmm... this seems familiar... I'd better report back to Maisa.

steps.text: Guard cutscene begins.

starting-off-guard-cutscene.text: A cutscene plays. The player is approached by a Head Menaphite Guard and two Menaphite Guards.

starting-off-guard-cutscene.speaker: Head Menaphite Guard
starting-off-guard-cutscene.text: The work cannot be disturbed... the mistress commands it...

starting-off-guard-cutscene.player: Mistress? You mean the Devourer! This is all her doing, isn't it? I'd recognise her work anywhere.

starting-off-guard-cutscene.speaker: Head Menaphite Guard
starting-off-guard-cutscene.text: You know too much... you must be removed...
Maisa attacks a Menaphite Guard, killing them instantly.

starting-off-guard-cutscene.speaker: Maisa
starting-off-guard-cutscene.text: Looks like you need a hand.
The cutscene ends, and the fight begins with the Head Menaphite Guard.

starting-off-guard-cutscene-using-an-ove.speaker: Head Menaphite Guard
starting-off-guard-cutscene-using-an-ove.text: Your false gods will not protect you!

starting-off-guard-cutscene-talking-to-m.speaker: Maisa
starting-off-guard-cutscene-talking-to-m.text: Come on. We'd better get back down there.

starting-off-talking-to-maisa-after-defe.speaker: Maisa
starting-off-talking-to-maisa-after-defe.text: Nice job keeping things low profile.

starting-off-talking-to-maisa-after-defe.player: To be fair, I did warn you.

starting-off-talking-to-maisa-after-defe.speaker: Maisa
starting-off-talking-to-maisa-after-defe.text: I suppose. Were you able to discover anything?

starting-off-talking-to-maisa-after-defe.player: Sort of. I still don't know why these people are here, but I do know who sent them.

starting-off-talking-to-maisa-after-defe.speaker: Maisa
starting-off-talking-to-maisa-after-defe.text: Who?

starting-off-talking-to-maisa-after-defe.speaker: Maisa
starting-off-talking-to-maisa-after-defe.text: What? The goddess? You're joking!

starting-off-talking-to-maisa-after-defe.speaker: Maisa
starting-off-talking-to-maisa-after-defe.text: It's just quite the claim. How do you know it's her?

starting-off-talking-to-maisa-after-defe.player: She has hypnotic powers. She's the one that put them in this trance! I know it better than most. I was unlucky enough to experience it myself back in Sophanem.

starting-off-talking-to-maisa-after-defe.speaker: Head Menaphite Guard
starting-off-talking-to-maisa-after-defe.text: Urgh...

starting-off-talking-to-maisa-after-defe.speaker: Maisa
starting-off-talking-to-maisa-after-defe.text: Perhaps this one can give us something more to go on.

starting-off-talking-to-maisa-after-defe.speaker: Head Menaphite Guard
starting-off-talking-to-maisa-after-defe.text: What's happening? Help me...

starting-off-talking-to-maisa-after-defe.player: You were hypnotised, but you're free now. Do you remember anything about what happened to you?

starting-off-talking-to-maisa-after-defe.speaker: Head Menaphite Guard
starting-off-talking-to-maisa-after-defe.text: It's all so unclear... I can't remember...

starting-off-talking-to-maisa-after-defe.player: I know what you're going through. Try to think back to before you were hypnotised. What's the last thing you remember?

starting-off-talking-to-maisa-after-defe.speaker: Head Menaphite Guard
starting-off-talking-to-maisa-after-defe.text: We were told we had an audience with Pharaoh Kemesis, but when we arrived at the palace he wasn't there. It was just this woman.

starting-off-talking-to-maisa-after-defe.speaker: Maisa
starting-off-talking-to-maisa-after-defe.text: What woman?

starting-off-talking-to-maisa-after-defe.speaker: Head Menaphite Guard
starting-off-talking-to-maisa-after-defe.text: I don't know. I just remember her eyes, her deep red eyes...

starting-off-talking-to-maisa-after-defe.speaker: Maisa
starting-off-talking-to-maisa-after-defe.text: Do you remember anything after that?

starting-off-talking-to-maisa-after-defe.speaker: Head Menaphite Guard
starting-off-talking-to-maisa-after-defe.text: We came here to find something... I think. A tomb! We unblocked the entrance, and she went inside. There were others with her.

starting-off-talking-to-maisa-after-defe.player: What does she want from the tomb?

starting-off-talking-to-maisa-after-defe.speaker: Head Menaphite Guard
starting-off-talking-to-maisa-after-defe.text: I don't know... We never saw the inside. The entrance collapsed again after she went in.

starting-off-talking-to-maisa-after-defe.player: That's okay. You've been a great help.

starting-off-talking-to-maisa-after-defe.speaker: Head Menaphite Guard
starting-off-talking-to-maisa-after-defe.text: Wait! I remember one more thing... there were these monsters helping her! They walked like humans, but they had the heads of insects!

starting-off-talking-to-maisa-after-defe.player: That sounds like those scarab creatures from the tunnels below Sophanem.

starting-off-talking-to-maisa-after-defe.speaker: Maisa
starting-off-talking-to-maisa-after-defe.text: Scabarites! Do you know where they came from?

starting-off-talking-to-maisa-after-defe.speaker: Head Menaphite Guard
starting-off-talking-to-maisa-after-defe.text: Some ruins... To the north east...

starting-off-talking-to-maisa-after-defe.speaker: Maisa
starting-off-talking-to-maisa-after-defe.text: I think that's all we're learning from this one. I'll get him some medical attention. Meet me back at my camp.

starting-off-talking-to-maisa-after-defe.speaker: Citizen
starting-off-talking-to-maisa-after-defe.text: The work must be completed... the mistress commands it...

starting-off-talking-to-maisa-after-defe.speaker: Menaphite Guard
starting-off-talking-to-maisa-after-defe.text: The work must be completed... the mistress commands it...
The entrance is completely blocked. There doesn't seem to be any way through.

the-ruins-of-ullek-talking-to-maisa.speaker: Maisa
the-ruins-of-ullek-talking-to-maisa.text: So that was... interesting. A hypnotising goddess wasn't quite what I expected.

the-ruins-of-ullek-talking-to-maisa.player: You sound like you still don't believe me.

the-ruins-of-ullek-talking-to-maisa.speaker: Maisa
the-ruins-of-ullek-talking-to-maisa.text: You have to admit, it's a lot to take in. Still, I guess it doesn't change our next steps.

the-ruins-of-ullek-talking-to-maisa.speaker: Maisa
the-ruins-of-ullek-talking-to-maisa.text: That guard gave us two leads to look into. Hopefully one of them will give us some answers as to what's so important about that tomb.

the-ruins-of-ullek-talking-to-maisa.player: Should we reach out to Osman about this?

the-ruins-of-ullek-talking-to-maisa.speaker: Maisa
the-ruins-of-ullek-talking-to-maisa.text: Osman? Why? That man won't be of any help. He'd have happily left me to rot in Menaphos, just like how he sent Kaleef to his death!

the-ruins-of-ullek-talking-to-maisa.player: Kaleef? He was the spy that was meant to relieve you, right? I thought you didn't even know him?

the-ruins-of-ullek-talking-to-maisa.speaker: Maisa
the-ruins-of-ullek-talking-to-maisa.text: What? Oh, right.

the-ruins-of-ullek-talking-to-maisa.speaker: Maisa
the-ruins-of-ullek-talking-to-maisa.text: Look, we don't need Osman. We can handle this ourselves.

the-ruins-of-ullek-talking-to-maisa.player: Fair enough... so what are our leads?

the-ruins-of-ullek-talking-to-maisa.speaker: Maisa
the-ruins-of-ullek-talking-to-maisa.text: First up we have Kemesis, Pharaoh of Menaphos.

the-ruins-of-ullek-talking-to-maisa.player: What do you know about him?

the-ruins-of-ullek-talking-to-maisa.speaker: Maisa
the-ruins-of-ullek-talking-to-maisa.text: Truth be told, not a lot. He's probably the most powerful man in the Kharidian Desert, but he's incredibly reclusive. He's rarely seen in public.

the-ruins-of-ullek-talking-to-maisa.player: If he's under Amascut's control, that could be a big problem. Do you know how we could get to him?

the-ruins-of-ullek-talking-to-maisa.speaker: Maisa
the-ruins-of-ullek-talking-to-maisa.text: Even without the quarantine, it would be incredibly difficult. His palace is a fortress.

the-ruins-of-ullek-talking-to-maisa.speaker: Maisa
the-ruins-of-ullek-talking-to-maisa.text: It isn't. While there may be ways out of Menaphos, I don't know of any way back in again, let alone a way into the Pharaoh's own palace.

the-ruins-of-ullek-talking-to-maisa.player: We'll leave that lead for now then. What about the other one?

the-ruins-of-ullek-talking-to-maisa.speaker: Maisa
the-ruins-of-ullek-talking-to-maisa.text: The guard mentioned some scabarites. Perhaps we can learn something from them. He said they came from some ruins north east of the necropolis.

the-ruins-of-ullek-talking-to-maisa.player: That would put the ruins directly east of here. All I see are cliffs.

the-ruins-of-ullek-talking-to-maisa.speaker: Maisa
the-ruins-of-ullek-talking-to-maisa.text: Maybe there's something on the other side of them?

the-ruins-of-ullek-talking-to-maisa.player: Could be worth exploring, I guess.

the-ruins-of-ullek-talking-to-maisa.speaker: Maisa
the-ruins-of-ullek-talking-to-maisa.text: Right, so we have our leads. One seems impossible to follow, but the other might have some promise. While I think about how we can access Menaphos, do you want to look into these ruins?

the-ruins-of-ullek-talking-to-maisa.player: Sure, but where do you even plan to start?

the-ruins-of-ullek-talking-to-maisa.speaker: Maisa
the-ruins-of-ullek-talking-to-maisa.text: If we're ever going to get close to the Pharaoh, the Menaphos quarantine has to end. Kemesis himself has made it clear that will only happen when the plagues in Sophanem are eradicated.

the-ruins-of-ullek-talking-to-maisa.speaker: Maisa
the-ruins-of-ullek-talking-to-maisa.text: From what I hear, they've managed to deal with most of them now. That just leaves the pox they're all infected with.

the-ruins-of-ullek-talking-to-maisa.player: So what, you're going to cure the pox?

the-ruins-of-ullek-talking-to-maisa.speaker: Maisa
the-ruins-of-ullek-talking-to-maisa.text: Exactly.

the-ruins-of-ullek-talking-to-maisa.player: Surely if it were that simple, the High Priest would have done it by now.

the-ruins-of-ullek-talking-to-maisa.speaker: Maisa
the-ruins-of-ullek-talking-to-maisa.text: Have you met that man? He can try to present himself as a wise leader all he wants, but it's just a facade. The lizards around here have bigger brains than him, and that's probably still an insult to the lizards.

the-ruins-of-ullek-talking-to-maisa.speaker: Maisa
the-ruins-of-ullek-talking-to-maisa.text: He didn't even have the guts to get rid of the plagued animals. The guards had to put them down themselves. And it's not like they can do that to the citizens!

the-ruins-of-ullek-talking-to-maisa.player: Well, they could. But I imagine that would be considered quite rude.

the-ruins-of-ullek-talking-to-maisa.speaker: Maisa
the-ruins-of-ullek-talking-to-maisa.text: Anyway, I reckon I might have a chance of succeeding where the High Priest failed. I have an old friend in Nardah named Zahur. She's a herbalist. I think she might be able to help.

the-ruins-of-ullek-talking-to-maisa.speaker: Maisa
the-ruins-of-ullek-talking-to-maisa.text: While I go and visit her, you see if you can find these ruins. Remember, they should be just east of here. Meet me in Nardah once you have something.
Maisa leaves the camp.

the-ruins-of-ullek-talking-to-maisa-talk.player: So what are these leads you mentioned?

the-ruins-of-ullek-talking-to-maisa-talk.speaker: Maisa
the-ruins-of-ullek-talking-to-maisa-talk.text: First up we have Kemesis, Pharaoh of Menaphos.
