close-encounters-with-vyre-kind-attempti.text: You already have a sketch of the castle from this angle; you don't need a second one.

close-encounters-with-vyre-kind-talking-.player: Hey, I've finished at the castle.

close-encounters-with-vyre-kind-talking-.speaker: Safalaan Hallow
close-encounters-with-vyre-kind-talking-.text: Good work. Do you have the sketches then?

close-encounters-with-vyre-kind-talking-.player: Err... No.

close-encounters-with-vyre-kind-talking-.speaker: Safalaan Hallow
close-encounters-with-vyre-kind-talking-.text: Sounds like you're not finished after all then. Please return once you have the sketches.

close-encounters-with-vyre-kind-talking-.player: Hey, I've finished at the castle. It was a close one though. I was attacked by Vanstrom!

close-encounters-with-vyre-kind-talking-.speaker: Safalaan Hallow
close-encounters-with-vyre-kind-talking-.text: What?

close-encounters-with-vyre-kind-talking-.player: He came out of nowhere! I tried to fight back, but I just couldn't hurt him.

close-encounters-with-vyre-kind-talking-.speaker: Safalaan Hallow
close-encounters-with-vyre-kind-talking-.text: Brave, very brave. He didn't follow you here did he?

close-encounters-with-vyre-kind-talking-.player: No, I'm pretty sure I wasn't followed. So anyway, during the fight, Vanstrom knocked me to the floor and I thought I was done for. But then a woman named Sarius showed up.

close-encounters-with-vyre-kind-talking-.speaker: Safalaan Hallow
close-encounters-with-vyre-kind-talking-.text: Sarius? Vanescula Drakan's servant? Hmmm, interesting. Was Vanescula herself nearby?

close-encounters-with-vyre-kind-talking-.player: No, I saw Vanescula earlier, but when I saw Sarius arrive, Vanescula wasn't around. Sarius told Vanstrom that Vanescula wanted to interrogate me. So Vanstrom got angry and flew away.
Sarius then told me about a message which was meant for you. Something about 'smoke and statues'? She said that Vanescula was interested in you for some reason?

close-encounters-with-vyre-kind-talking-.speaker: Safalaan Hallow
close-encounters-with-vyre-kind-talking-.text: Well, [player name], you certainly seem to have had a very close call. Thanks for letting me know all of this. It's all highly interesting.

close-encounters-with-vyre-kind-talking-.speaker: Safalaan Hallow
close-encounters-with-vyre-kind-talking-.text: Oh, and I almost forgot. Do you have the sketches?
You give the sketches to Safalaan.
castle sketch 1, castle sketch 2, castle sketch 3

close-encounters-with-vyre-kind-talking-.speaker: Safalaan Hallow
close-encounters-with-vyre-kind-talking-.text: You have my gratitude, friend! Myreque prevail! I need to take a good look at these and see what we can learn.

close-encounters-with-vyre-kind-talking-.player: What should I do now?

close-encounters-with-vyre-kind-talking-.speaker: Safalaan Hallow
close-encounters-with-vyre-kind-talking-.text: Hmm, good question. Didn't you mention something about Sarius and a message?

close-encounters-with-vyre-kind-talking-.player: That's right. If I remember correctly, she said it was hidden 'behind tiles where smoke is carried away from the depiction of statuesque evil'.

close-encounters-with-vyre-kind-talking-.speaker: Safalaan Hallow
close-encounters-with-vyre-kind-talking-.text: A riddle? Clearly she doesn't want the message to be easily found. I'd appreciate it if you could look into this further.

close-encounters-with-vyre-kind-talking-.player: I'll see what I can do.

in-search-of-statuesque-evil-talking-to-.player: Hey, I've returned.

in-search-of-statuesque-evil-talking-to-.text: Myreque prevail!

in-search-of-statuesque-evil-talking-to-.player: What should I do now?

in-search-of-statuesque-evil-talking-to-.speaker: Safalaan Hallow
in-search-of-statuesque-evil-talking-to-.text: Hmm, good question. Didn't you mention something about Sarius and a message?

in-search-of-statuesque-evil-talking-to-.player: That's right. If I remember correctly, she said it was hidden 'behind tiles where smoke is carried away from the depiction of statuesque evil'.

in-search-of-statuesque-evil-talking-to-.speaker: Safalaan Hallow
in-search-of-statuesque-evil-talking-to-.text: A riddle? Clearly she doesn't want the message to be easily found. I'd appreciate it if you could look into this further.

in-search-of-statuesque-evil-talking-to-.player: I'll see what I can do.

Your sickle is the wrong shape for this. Maybe you should use something more conventional.
You carefully use your knife on the loose tile and find a message hidden behind it.
You've already levered the loose tile away. There is nothing else to use a knife on here.
You've already levered the loose tile away.
This fireplace looks pretty old. It certainly hasn't been dusted recently. You see a loose tile with an empty compartment behind it.
This painting is a little odd. It seems to depict the statue of a female vampyre holding a key.
Your sickle is the wrong shape for this. Maybe you should use something more conventional.
You slash the painting and find a large ornate key hidden inside.
The painting has already been slashed.
This painting has been slashed. It looks like something was once hidden inside it. It's empty now though.
There's a large ornate key hidden inside the painting. You take it.

in-search-of-statuesque-evil-talking-to-.speaker: Safalaan Hallow
in-search-of-statuesque-evil-talking-to-.text: Myreque prevail!

in-search-of-statuesque-evil-talking-to-.speaker: Safalaan Hallow
in-search-of-statuesque-evil-talking-to-.text: Hmm, good question. Didn't you mention something about Sarius and a message?

in-search-of-statuesque-evil-talking-to-.player: Ah yes. I have it here.

in-search-of-statuesque-evil-talking-to-.text: You show the message to Safalaan.

in-search-of-statuesque-evil-talking-to-.speaker: Safalaan Hallow
in-search-of-statuesque-evil-talking-to-.text: Hmm, interesting. This message gives details of some sort of laboratory. Maybe there is some information there which could help us.

in-search-of-statuesque-evil-talking-to-.speaker: Safalaan Hallow
in-search-of-statuesque-evil-talking-to-.text: We should keep an eye out for this place. In fact, it would be great if you could look for it for us. Keep the message. It may help you to locate the laboratory.

in-search-of-statuesque-evil-talking-to-.player: Hey, I've returned.

in-search-of-statuesque-evil-talking-to-.speaker: Safalaan Hallow
in-search-of-statuesque-evil-talking-to-.text: Myreque prevail!

in-search-of-statuesque-evil-talking-to-.player: What should I do now?

in-search-of-statuesque-evil-talking-to-.speaker: Safalaan Hallow
in-search-of-statuesque-evil-talking-to-.text: Well that message you brought me had some details regarding a laboratory. Maybe there is some information there which could help us.

in-search-of-statuesque-evil-talking-to-.player: Where do you think this laboratory could be?

in-search-of-statuesque-evil-talking-to-.speaker: Safalaan Hallow
in-search-of-statuesque-evil-talking-to-.text: It's a good question, but not one I have an answer for. The message seemed to have some hints though. If you get a chance could you look into this for us?

in-search-of-statuesque-evil-talking-to-.player: I'll see what I can do.

in-search-of-statuesque-evil-using-the-m.text: You show the message to Safalaan.

in-search-of-statuesque-evil-using-the-m.speaker: Safalaan Hallow
in-search-of-statuesque-evil-using-the-m.text: Yes, you've shown me this before. It's an interesting message and it's really great that you found it. Please keep it so that it will help you to locate the laboratory.

in-search-of-statuesque-evil-gaining-acc.text: You slash the tapestry down the middle.
You insert the key into the lock but it gives you an electric shock.

The statue seems to depict some sort of female vampyre. Her hands are lifted up in the air as if they're holding something invisible. Closer inspection shows that the hands are smoother than other parts of the statue.
You carefully place the large ornate key into the statue's hands. You hear a grinding sound as the hands move downwards, then a mechanical click to the north.
The statue seems to depict some sort of female vampyre. Her hands are lowered, holding an ornate golden key.

in-search-of-statuesque-evil-talking-to-.player: Hey, I think I've found that laboratory.

in-search-of-statuesque-evil-talking-to-.speaker: Safalaan Hallow

in-search-of-statuesque-evil-talking-to-.player: I haven't found anything yet.

in-search-of-statuesque-evil-talking-to-.speaker: Safalaan Hallow

1 {{x}} law rune, 3 {{x}} fire rune, 3 {{x}} air rune, 1 {{x}} water rune, 1 {{x}} mind rune

in-search-of-statuesque-evil-talking-to-.player: Safalaan. I have something you might be interested in. I found it in the laboratory.

Haemalchemy volume 1

in-search-of-statuesque-evil-talking-to-.speaker: Safalaan Hallow
in-search-of-statuesque-evil-talking-to-.text: You've done well, [player name], very well indeed. I can't decipher much of it, but from what I can tell, this tome contains research notes on the vampyres' weaknesses.

in-search-of-statuesque-evil-talking-to-.player: Well, whatever it is, someone went to a lot of trouble to try and hide it.

in-search-of-statuesque-evil-talking-to-.speaker: Safalaan Hallow
in-search-of-statuesque-evil-talking-to-.text: I can believe that, [player name]. Once again you have our gratitude. For my part, your arrival has not come soon enough. I have a feeling that your efforts in our struggle are not yet over.

in-search-of-statuesque-evil-talking-to-.speaker: Safalaan Hallow
in-search-of-statuesque-evil-talking-to-.text: I for one would be grateful for your continued assistance. Together we can pull back the darkness of Hallowvale.

in-search-of-statuesque-evil-talking-to-.player: I'll do what I can, Safalaan. You have my support.

in-search-of-statuesque-evil-talking-to-.speaker: Safalaan Hallow
in-search-of-statuesque-evil-talking-to-.text: Then I must beg you for one more small task, to return to Veliaf with a message to advise him of what has transpired here.

in-search-of-statuesque-evil-talking-to-.speaker: Safalaan Hallow
in-search-of-statuesque-evil-talking-to-.text: I realise that bearing messages seems somewhat lowly, but your ability to pass in and out of the city without being detected makes you perfect for this assignment.

in-search-of-statuesque-evil-talking-to-.speaker: Safalaan Hallow
in-search-of-statuesque-evil-talking-to-.text: I also have some information which should help with your journeys through Meiyerditch. There are two doors, one is in sector one and the other is in sector two. You can use them to reach this hideout faster.
Safalaan teaches you how to unlock the doors and gives you a sealed message. It's addressed to Veliaf.
sealed message

in-search-of-statuesque-evil-talking-to-.player: Very well, I'll return to Veliaf. Farewell.

in-search-of-statuesque-evil-talking-to-.speaker: Safalaan Hallow
in-search-of-statuesque-evil-talking-to-.text: Farewell and good luck, my friend!

in-search-of-statuesque-evil-talking-to-.player: What should I do again?

in-search-of-statuesque-evil-talking-to-.speaker: Safalaan Hallow
in-search-of-statuesque-evil-talking-to-.text: Take the message that I gave you to Veliaf. He should be able to explain everything to you when you get there.

in-search-of-statuesque-evil-talking-to-.player: What should I do again?

in-search-of-statuesque-evil-talking-to-.speaker: Safalaan Hallow
in-search-of-statuesque-evil-talking-to-.text: Take the message that I gave you to Veliaf. He should be able to explain everything to you when you get there.

in-search-of-statuesque-evil-talking-to-.player: But I've lost that message. Can I have another one please?

in-search-of-statuesque-evil-talking-to-.speaker: Safalaan Hallow
in-search-of-statuesque-evil-talking-to-.text: Well, okay, but please don't lose this one.
Safalaan gives you a sealed message. It's addressed to Veliaf.

in-search-of-statuesque-evil-attempting-.text: The message is sealed and addressed to Veliaf. It would be rude of you to open it.

in-search-of-statuesque-evil-talking-to-.player: Hello, Veliaf. I have some news for you.

in-search-of-statuesque-evil-talking-to-.speaker: Veliaf Hurtz
in-search-of-statuesque-evil-talking-to-.text: Well met, [player name]. It's good to see you again.

in-search-of-statuesque-evil-talking-to-.player: I've spoken to Safalaan. He gave me a message to give to you but I've misplaced it!

in-search-of-statuesque-evil-talking-to-.speaker: Veliaf Hurtz
in-search-of-statuesque-evil-talking-to-.text: Well, that's not particularly good is it? You'll have to go back and ask him if he can rewrite the message for you.

in-search-of-statuesque-evil-talking-to-.player: Hello, Veliaf. I have some news for you.

in-search-of-statuesque-evil-talking-to-.speaker: Veliaf Hurtz
in-search-of-statuesque-evil-talking-to-.text: Well met, [player name]. It's good to see you again.

in-search-of-statuesque-evil-talking-to-.player: I have a message for you from Safalaan.

in-search-of-statuesque-evil-talking-to-.speaker: Veliaf Hurtz
in-search-of-statuesque-evil-talking-to-.text: Really? Well, let's see it then!
You show the message to Veliaf.

in-search-of-statuesque-evil-talking-to-.speaker: Veliaf Hurtz
in-search-of-statuesque-evil-talking-to-.text: Well, it seems that you have more than proven yourself worthy, [player name]. Safalaan himself has recommended you for a promotion to the rank of a private within the Myreque!

in-search-of-statuesque-evil-talking-to-.speaker: Veliaf Hurtz
in-search-of-statuesque-evil-talking-to-.text: You've done well. I'd say you've earnt a break. Before you go though, here's a little something to thank you for your hard work.
Congratulations! Quest complete!

post-quest-talking-to-veliaf-hurtz-after.speaker: Veliaf Hurtz

steps.npc: Hello, young adventurer. What brings you to the Museum's paleontology floor?

steps.player: What's paleontology?

steps.npc: I'm glad you asked! Paleontology is the study of prehistoric lifeforms in Gielinor through the examination of fossils.
We use fossils to try determine several things: information about what fossil belonged to, what the environment was like, and try to uncover secrets of Gielinor's past.
What else would you like to know?

options.text: Where do these fossils come from?

steps.player: Where do these fossils come from?

steps.npc: Ah, brilliant question. Fossils of creatures are found in sedimentary rock, we use specialised tools to carefully remove the unwanted rock only leaving only the fossil behind.
If you're looking for fossils yourself, I hear there is a voyage to a mysterious island to discover new types of fossil.
You should speak to the Curator as he knows more about it than I.
Is there anything else you need help with?

options.text: What can I do with these fossils?

steps.player: What can I do with these fossils?

steps.npc: Any fossils you find can be added to the surrounding display cases.
If you manage to complete display case, the Museum will ensure you are rewarded for your efforts.
Also, if you find any rare fossils on your travels, make sure you hold onto them. Something tells me they will be very valuable in the future...
Do you have any other questions?

steps.player: What can you tell me about some of the fossil displays?

standard-dialogue.npc: Hello mortal. Have you come to retrieve something you lost when you died?

steps.player: How does that work?

steps.npc: When you die, you often drop things you were carrying. In most cases, a gravestone appears near where you died, and your items can be retrieved there.
However, gravestones do not last for long. When your gravestone collapses, your items come here, to me. I can return them to you - though I charge a fee for my services.
Aside from that, if you bring me your unwanted possessions, and sacrifice them into my Coffer here, I'll count their value against any future fees I charge you.
I don't accept just any junk, but I'll try to give you a good price for anything decent.
So do you need to retrieve something you lost when you died?

steps.player: What is this place?

steps.npc: As you should be able to see, I am Death. The Grim Reaper. The Inexorable One. The Inescapable Grasp of Mortal Destiny. And this is my little office. Nice, isn't it?

steps.player: It's lovely.

steps.npc: Thank you. I feel the colour scheme suits my style. Now, can I help you retrieve something you lost when you died?

options.text: Your decorations leave a bit to be desired.

steps.player: Your decorations leave a bit to be desired.

steps.npc: Sometimes it's hard to care for beauty when one's very existence is just seen as a curse upon the world. Now, do you actually want to retrieve something from me?

options.text: Yes, have you got anything for me?

options.text: Can I choose a different-looking gravestone?

options.text: Yes, I understand other people won't often see it.

upon-losing-any-items-while-dying-for-th.npc: So, mortal... you have died, as all mortals do. As you have suffered the loss of some items on this occasion, I have brought you here to explain for you how that works.

upon-losing-any-items-while-dying-for-th.player: I lost items? Can I get them back?

upon-losing-any-items-while-dying-for-th.npc: Let me explain... Across most of the land of Gielinor, when you die, some of the items you're carrying are dropped.

upon-losing-any-items-while-dying-for-th.text: A gravestone appears on the ground near where you died. You can go there and retrieve your items by clicking on it.
Your gravestone would be marked with an arrow to help to spot it. A grave icon appears on the world map too, if your grave is in a mapped area.
Gravestones charge a small fee to return especially valuable items, but most things are returned free of charge. Conveniently, a gravestone can take its fee straight from your bank.
A gravestone does not last forever. After about 15 minutes, a gravestone will collapse. Anything in it will be sent here, to me.

upon-losing-any-items-while-dying-for-th.npc: I will look after such items, without a time limit. However, I do charge more for my services. It would be cheaper to retrieve them from the gravestone directly, if you can reach it in time.

starting-the-quest.speaker: Patzi
starting-the-quest.text: Good day! I don't suppose I could trouble you for the briefest of moments?

starting-the-quest.text: If the player meets the quest requirements:

steps.player: Good day to you! I could consider being troubled, for the right reasons.

steps.speaker: Patzi
steps.text: How does access to a rather fancy party sound as a motivator?

steps.player: Well, just as long as I get to actually enjo-

steps.speaker: Patzi
steps.text: I'm sure I can also rustle up some payment to encourange you, if you have any reservations.

steps.speaker: Patzi
steps.text: You may even find some... exciting opportunities inside, given the presence of some of Aldarin's wealthiest citizens!

steps.player: So if you're going to this party, would you also be one of Aldarin's wealthiest citizens?

steps.speaker: Patzi
steps.text: Alas, I am, quite unfortunately, not rich in money. What I do possess is a certain wealth...

steps.speaker: Patzi
steps.text: ... of talent! For you see I am... an actor! Patzi the Grand, they'll call me... eventually.

steps.player: They call me [player name]... just [player name]. So if you're not rich in money, how am I going to get paid, assuming I agree to help you with... whatever it is you want.

steps.speaker: Patzi
steps.text: Cutting words, but you need not worry. While you won't be getting paid upfront, I have a feeling that if all goes well, I will soon find myself with more than enough wealth to handsomely reward you.

steps.speaker: Patzi
steps.text: And besides, if nothing else, I'm sure you'll have a wonderful time at the party!

steps.prompt: Start the Death on the Isle quest?

steps.player: I suppose I could do with letting my hair down a little. Alright, I'm in.

steps.speaker: Patzi
steps.text: Wonderful!

steps.player: So whose party are we going to?

steps.speaker: Patzi
steps.text: Well, that's complicated...

steps.player: You don't know?

steps.speaker: Patzi
steps.text: Sometimes a man has to follow his heart... and a second hand invitation saying there's a party at Villa Lucens tonight.

steps.player: Villa Lucens?

steps.speaker: Patzi
steps.text: Yes! The villa is home to an almighty patron of the arts! He even has his own theatre atop the cliffs behind the villa! In fact, the whole reason for this party is because he's showing his new play!

steps.player: And yet you don't actually know who he is?

steps.speaker: Patzi
steps.text: This opportunity came about quite suddenly. As such, I'm unfortunately not as prepared as I otherwise would be. However, an actor like myself can't turn down the chance to meet with a man like him.

steps.speaker: Adala
steps.text: Not to mention the chance to enjoy a good party.

steps.speaker: Patzi
steps.text: Well said, Adala. Oh that reminds me, [player name], this is Adala. She's also helping me out today!

steps.player: If you have her, why do you need me?

steps.speaker: Patzi
steps.text: She advertised herself as a bag carrier, so she's here to move my bag around. There's a lot of costumes and props that I travel with, so it's nice to have someone else carry them.

steps.speaker: Adala
steps.text: I'm not going to say no to going to a fancy party, even as the help.

steps.speaker: Patzi
steps.text: As for your part in all this, [player name], with this being a fancy party and all, I'm going to need a butler to help me fit in.

steps.player: A butler?

steps.speaker: Patzi
steps.text: You know, serving me wine and tending to my needs. Fancy suit and all?

steps.player: Right... So I don't actually get to enjoy the party at all, do I?

steps.speaker: Patzi
steps.text: Oh I'm sure you will. You'll just have to act a little here and there!

steps.player: I see... You mentioned a fancy suit. You wouldn't happen to have a butler outfit in that bag you mentioned?

steps.speaker: Patzi
steps.text: I don't believe I do. I don't really take roles like that these days.

steps.player: Well, in that case, any idea where I might get one, preferably free of charge?

steps.speaker: Adala
steps.text: Lots of the villas around here will have butlers, and butlers mean uniforms.

steps.player: Are you suggesting I steal one?

steps.speaker: Adala
steps.text: I suppose you could always put it back once you're done.

steps.player: And I'm sure whoever I take it from will be overjoyed to have had someone else wearing their uniform.

steps.speaker: Patzi
steps.text: Hmm... Maybe I should add a butler's uniform to my vast array of costumes after all.

steps.speaker: Adala
steps.text: I doubt they'll ever even realise. Anyway, I remember seeing some uniforms through a window on the way over here. They were in a villa to the north.

steps.player: Right... I guess I'm off to find a uniform then.

steps.speaker: Patzi
steps.text: Good luck!

steps.player: I'm not really a party person these days, I'm afraid.

steps.speaker: Patzi
steps.text: Quite unfortunate. In that case, please make sure to keep an eye out for me at your local theatre. I'll be a star soon!

inside-villa-lucens-investigating-the-ma.text: Do you have any relevant qualifications?

inside-villa-lucens-investigating-the-ma.speaker: Stradius
inside-villa-lucens-investigating-the-ma.text: Wait... are we meant to have...

inside-villa-lucens-investigating-the-ma.speaker: Hutza
inside-villa-lucens-investigating-the-ma.text: After all, training to be a butler must have taken a long time.

inside-villa-lucens-investigating-the-ma.player: But I'm not even a butler! I got hired to act like one!

inside-villa-lucens-investigating-the-ma.speaker: Hutza
inside-villa-lucens-investigating-the-ma.text: Right, now I have to put murder back on the table! Who are you?

inside-villa-lucens-investigating-the-ma.player: I'm just [player name]. I got hired by Patzi to be a butler for this evening, alongside a lady called Adala.

inside-villa-lucens-investigating-the-ma.speaker: Stradius
inside-villa-lucens-investigating-the-ma.text: Adala? Do we know an Adala?

inside-villa-lucens-investigating-the-ma.speaker: Hutza
inside-villa-lucens-investigating-the-ma.text: Yes, I believe she's accounted for.

inside-villa-lucens-investigating-the-ma.player: You ran into her?

inside-villa-lucens-investigating-the-ma.speaker: Hutza
inside-villa-lucens-investigating-the-ma.text: She came in shortly after we arrested you. Your friend, Patzi, mentioned she'd been sorting out some of his costumes.

inside-villa-lucens-investigating-the-ma.player: You mean she was only accounted for after the murder took place?

inside-villa-lucens-investigating-the-ma.speaker: Stradius
inside-villa-lucens-investigating-the-ma.text: Why do I get the feeling we're not doing a good job of actually investigating this?

inside-villa-lucens-investigating-the-ma.speaker: Hutza
inside-villa-lucens-investigating-the-ma.text: It isn't just you.

inside-villa-lucens-investigating-the-ma.player: Again, maybe I could be an extra pair of hands here.

inside-villa-lucens-investigating-the-ma.speaker: Hutza
inside-villa-lucens-investigating-the-ma.text: Have a potential suspect investigate the murder? It wouldn't be orthodox, but it might work...

inside-villa-lucens-investigating-the-ma.speaker: Stradius
inside-villa-lucens-investigating-the-ma.text: I'm not sure I like the implication that we can't solve it ourselves.

inside-villa-lucens-investigating-the-ma.speaker: Hutza
inside-villa-lucens-investigating-the-ma.text: I agree, but we're not actually very qualified for this. We normally just guard drunk people, not solve murders!

inside-villa-lucens-investigating-the-ma.speaker: Stradius
inside-villa-lucens-investigating-the-ma.text: You make a fair point, Hutza.

inside-villa-lucens-investigating-the-ma.speaker: Hutza
inside-villa-lucens-investigating-the-ma.text: [player name], if you promise not to leave, can you help us work out what's happened here?

inside-villa-lucens-investigating-the-ma.player: I... promise not to flee the scene?

inside-villa-lucens-investigating-the-ma.speaker: Stradius
inside-villa-lucens-investigating-the-ma.text: Perfect! Shall we get to investigating then?

inside-villa-lucens-investigating-the-ma.player: Where should I start?

inside-villa-lucens-investigating-the-ma.speaker: Hutza
inside-villa-lucens-investigating-the-ma.text: The victim was Livius, the lead actor in tonight's play. His body is still down in the cellar, so you should probably go and inspect it, along with the rest of the crime scene.

inside-villa-lucens-investigating-the-ma.speaker: Stradius
inside-villa-lucens-investigating-the-ma.text: No doubt you'll also want to question everyone. We'll keep them busy for you until you're ready. We'll also give you a case file to track your notes in!

inside-villa-lucens-investigating-the-ma.player: Okay, let's get to it.

inside-villa-lucens-investigating-the-ma.text: Player is transported outside of the room.

inside-villa-lucens-attempting-to-open-t.speaker: Hutza
inside-villa-lucens-attempting-to-open-t.text: And where do you think you're going?

inside-villa-lucens-talking-to-hutza-or-.speaker: Stradius
inside-villa-lucens-talking-to-hutza-or-.text: I'm afraid we can't just let you go. Not without an investigation.

the-investigation-talking-to-hutza-or-st.player: Could you give me any tips for this investigation?

the-investigation-talking-to-hutza-or-st.speaker: Hutza
the-investigation-talking-to-hutza-or-st.text: You'll want to have a look down in the wine cellar I imagine. We made sure that nobody went down there after we arrested you, so everything should be as it was when the murder occurred.

the-investigation-talking-to-hutza-or-st.speaker: Stradius
the-investigation-talking-to-hutza-or-st.text: You'll probably also want to do a bit of questioning up here as well.

the-investigation-talking-to-hutza-or-st.player: Are you going to help with any of this?

the-investigation-talking-to-hutza-or-st.speaker: Hutza
the-investigation-talking-to-hutza-or-st.text: We'll keep an eye on everyone for you.

the-investigation-talking-to-hutza-or-st.player: What if the actual murderer is still in the cellar somewhere?

the-investigation-talking-to-hutza-or-st.speaker: Hutza
the-investigation-talking-to-hutza-or-st.text: We'll come looking for you if you're gone too long. It's not like there's anywhere for them to escape to!

the-investigation-talking-to-hutza-or-st.speaker: Stradius
the-investigation-talking-to-hutza-or-st.text: You will probably be dead by then though...

the-investigation-talking-to-hutza-or-st.speaker: Hutza
the-investigation-talking-to-hutza-or-st.text: On the bright side, it would prove your innocence.

the-investigation-talking-to-adala-or-pa.speaker: Patzi
the-investigation-talking-to-adala-or-pa.text: Oh, this is exciting isn't it!

the-investigation-talking-to-adala-or-pa.player: I got arrested for murder because you sent me into that cellar!

the-investigation-talking-to-adala-or-pa.speaker: Patzi
the-investigation-talking-to-adala-or-pa.text: Did you at least manage to find what I sent you down there for?

the-investigation-talking-to-adala-or-pa.player: The Principum Red? Of course. Constantinius has a nice large container of it. However, I'm not sure if that's the most...

the-investigation-talking-to-adala-or-pa.speaker: Adala
the-investigation-talking-to-adala-or-pa.text: What self-respecting man would have a wine cellar without such a historic wine in it?

the-investigation-talking-to-adala-or-pa.speaker: Patzi
the-investigation-talking-to-adala-or-pa.text: It's a shame we're locked down up here. I'd love to try it! I came so close too, if it weren't for that actor...

the-investigation-talking-to-adala-or-pa.player: Are you blaming Livius for his own murder?

the-investigation-talking-to-adala-or-pa.speaker: Patzi
the-investigation-talking-to-adala-or-pa.text: Of course not! I'm just ruing a missed chance to try that wine...

the-investigation-talking-to-constantini.speaker: Constantinius
the-investigation-talking-to-constantini.text: Oh poor Livius! Where am I to find another actor of his calibre?

the-investigation-talking-to-constantini.player: Was he by any chance the one you mentioned earlier? The one who was starting to get too expensive for you?

the-investigation-talking-to-constantini.speaker: Constantinius
the-investigation-talking-to-constantini.text: I may have had some quibbles with how expensive his performances were, but he always made a profit!

the-investigation-talking-to-constantini.speaker: Constantinius
the-investigation-talking-to-constantini.text: I can only hope his understudy is capable of filling the gap that's going to be left. Livius always kept her in the shadows, though he did say that she was nearly ready for a leading role of her own...

the-investigation-talking-to-cozyac.player: You didn't happen to know Livius, did you Cozyac?

the-investigation-talking-to-cozyac.speaker: Cozyac
the-investigation-talking-to-cozyac.text: I'm familiar with his work, but not the man himself. He's been Constantinius' preferred actor for a few years now.

the-investigation-talking-to-cozyac.player: Did he ever come and join the parties? Perhaps you crossed paths during the festivities?

the-investigation-talking-to-cozyac.speaker: Cozyac
the-investigation-talking-to-cozyac.text: I'm almost certain we didn't. The actors spend the entire party getting ready, and then I usually fall asleep by the end of the play!

the-investigation-talking-to-cozyac.player: The plays are that good are they?

the-investigation-talking-to-cozyac.speaker: Cozyac
the-investigation-talking-to-cozyac.text: I'm an older man. I need a good early night to keep myself going. I am partial to a puzzle though, so solving this crime could keep me up all night!

the-investigation-talking-to-pavo.speaker: Pavo
the-investigation-talking-to-pavo.text: You know, it's a surprisingly sobering moment when someone's murdered beneath your feet.

the-investigation-talking-to-pavo.speaker: Pavo
the-investigation-talking-to-pavo.text: We were once drinking fellows. The things I've seen him drink without even breaking a sweat...

the-investigation-talking-to-pavo.player: Did you drink with him today?

the-investigation-talking-to-pavo.speaker: Pavo
the-investigation-talking-to-pavo.text: I don't remember... It seems likely that I would've though. He never liked to prepare for a performance without at least a small drink.

the-investigation-talking-to-pavo.player: Assuming you did, where would you have had a drink with him?

the-investigation-talking-to-pavo.speaker: Pavo
the-investigation-talking-to-pavo.text: Probably down in the cellar. That was always where he preferred to go.

the-investigation-talking-to-pavo.player: So you admit that you may well have been down there with him today. Do you think something might've happened whilst you were drinking?

the-investigation-talking-to-pavo.speaker: Pavo
the-investigation-talking-to-pavo.text: I'd like to think that I would remember something so terrible happening in front of my eyes.

the-investigation-talking-to-pavo.player: And yet you can't actually remember if you'd been drinking with him.

the-investigation-talking-to-pavo.speaker: Pavo
the-investigation-talking-to-pavo.text: Oh, that's a good point... In that case, I don't know...

the-investigation-talking-to-xocotla.speaker: Xocotla
the-investigation-talking-to-xocotla.text: Quite an unfortunate turn of events, isn't it?

the-investigation-talking-to-xocotla.player: I'm not sure it's unfortunate so much as a tragedy surely?

the-investigation-talking-to-xocotla.speaker: Xocotla
the-investigation-talking-to-xocotla.text: Well, I believe the play was actually intended to be a comedy. I'm hopeful they have an understudy who can fill in for today.

the-investigation-talking-to-xocotla.player: The play's still going ahead? Are we just going to ignore that a man was murdered?

the-investigation-talking-to-xocotla.speaker: Xocotla
the-investigation-talking-to-xocotla.text: I'd rather not think about it, personally.

the-investigation-talking-to-xocotla.player: Okay... So Livius wasn't a customer of yours then?

the-investigation-talking-to-xocotla.speaker: Xocotla
the-investigation-talking-to-xocotla.text: Would he have reason to have been?

the-investigation-talking-to-xocotla.player: Actors seem to have a lot of costumes to move around the place. Maybe a shipping magnate such as yourself would make good money off of them.

the-investigation-talking-to-xocotla.speaker: Xocotla
the-investigation-talking-to-xocotla.text: I'm afraid I can't help you there. Good tip about the actors though. I'll have to visit the College of Bards next time I'm in Tempestus.

the-investigation-investigating-the-anti.player: I think it's probably best if I don't mess around with this again.

the-investigation-investigating-broken-s.player: Why would Constantinius keep a broken stool around... Unless it was only just broken?

the-investigation-investigating-small-bo.player: It appears to be a box full of blank wine labels. I suppose they like to keep things well organised.

the-investigation-inspecting-livius.player: A few cuts and scrapes... No stab wound... Poison perhaps?
Maybe there's something nearby that could give me a better idea of what happened.

the-investigation-inspecting-livius-agai.player: A few cuts and scrapes... No stab wound... Poison perhaps?

the-investigation-investigating-broken-p.player: It looks like someone's dropped this. I wonder if there was a fight?

the-investigation-investigating-wine-sto.player: It's only half full. Someone must've been drinking from it.

the-investigation-investigating-jug.player: I wonder why this jug's been tucked away in the corner... Was someone trying to hide it?

the-investigation-talking-to-hutza-or-st.speaker: Hutza
the-investigation-talking-to-hutza-or-st.text: How's your investigation going?

options.text: I think I've found everything there is to find so far. What now?

steps.player: I think I've found everything there is to find so far. What now?

steps.speaker: Hutza
steps.text: Are you sure you've investigated everything?

steps.prompt: You may not have investigated all possible clues.

steps.player: Yes.

steps.speaker: Stradius
steps.text: Do you think you could pin down a suspect?

steps.player: I'm not sure. Oddly enough, no one is admitting to having done it, and given they were all here together, I'm pretty sure they'd be each other's alibis.

steps.speaker: Stradius
steps.text: What if they hired someone to do it for them?

steps.speaker: Hutza
steps.text: Stradius... That's actually a good point.

steps.player: Maybe the butlers?

steps.speaker: Hutza
steps.text: You mean more of them might be fake like you?

steps.player: Well, thanks to the masks and uniforms, they're all anonymous. It's also very hard to keep track of how many there are.

steps.speaker: Stradius
steps.text: Have we been keeping tabs on all the butlers? What if one's escaped! The killer might already be in the wind!

steps.speaker: Hutza
steps.text: Both of you are missing that there's no window in which they could've left that cellar.

steps.speaker: Stradius
steps.text: Ah, yes. We came down when we heard the commotion. They wouldn't have been able to get out before then.

steps.speaker: Hutza
steps.text: It seems we're back to square one again, [player name], unless you can think of anything else to investigate?

steps.player: I could try stealing from the suspects? Perhaps one of them will be carrying something incriminating.

steps.speaker: Stradius
steps.text: You probably shouldn't mention that in front of us.

steps.speaker: Hutza
steps.text: I suppose we can always return things to them later.

steps.speaker: Stradius
steps.text: Hutza!

steps.player: I'll be subtle.
No.

steps.speaker: Hutza
steps.text: No worries. We'll keep everyone under control here while you continue your investigation.

steps.player: I'm not finished yet.

steps.speaker: Hutza
steps.text: No worries. We'll keep everyone under control here.

the-investigation-talking-to-hutza-or-st.speaker: Stradius
the-investigation-talking-to-hutza-or-st.text: How is your pocket checking going?

the-investigation-talking-to-hutza-or-st.speaker: Stradius
the-investigation-talking-to-hutza-or-st.text: Well, keep up the good work.

the-investigation-failing-to-pickpocket-.text: You attempt to pick Adala's pocket, but clumsily bump into her.

steps.player: Oh, I'm so clumsy! Are you okay?
Just sneaking by! Excuse me!

the-investigation-pickpocketing-adala.text: You pull some wine labels out of Adala's pocket.

the-investigation-pickpocketing-adala.player: I wonder what these are for...

the-investigation-pickpocketing-adala-ag.text: There doesn't seem to be anything of note in Adala's pocket.

Just sneaking by! Excuse me!

the-investigation-pickpocketing-cozyac-a.text: There doesn't seem to be anything of note in Cozyac's pocket.

the-investigation-pickpocketing-pavo.player: Well, I suppose that's not surprising.

steps.player: Oh, I'm so clumsy! Are you okay?
Just sneaking by! Excuse me!

the-investigation-pickpocketing-xocotla.player: I wonder what this is for...

the-investigation-pickpocketing-xocotla-.text: There doesn't seem to be anything of note in Xocotla's pocket.

the-investigation-inspecting-drinking-fl.text: It's a flask for holding alcohol. There's a small amount of liquid in the bottom, but you can't tell what it is.

the-investigation-inspecting-threatening.text: The letter is from Cozyac to Livius. It describes an outstanding debt.

the-investigation-inspecting-shipping-co.text: The contract is between Livius and Xocotla. It's for the shipping of an undescribed object.

the-investigation-inspecting-wine-labels.text: It's a set of labels for marking wine jugs. They look very similar to the ones on the jugs in Constantinius' cellar.

the-investigation-talking-to-hutza-or-st.player: I've had a little look through some pockets. I think all of the guests might be lying.

the-investigation-talking-to-hutza-or-st.speaker: Stradius
the-investigation-talking-to-hutza-or-st.text: All of them?

the-investigation-talking-to-hutza-or-st.player: Well, maybe not Pavo. They just had this old drinking flask. Xocotla and Cozyac on the other hand both had things on them that revealed they had direct dealings with Livius.
Here, have a look at what I found for yourselves.

the-investigation-talking-to-hutza-or-st.text: You hand over the note, contract, flask and labels.

the-investigation-talking-to-hutza-or-st.speaker: Hutza
the-investigation-talking-to-hutza-or-st.text: Interesting... What about these labels?

the-investigation-talking-to-hutza-or-st.speaker: Stradius
the-investigation-talking-to-hutza-or-st.text: She was the one who wasn't accounted for when the murder took place, right?

the-investigation-talking-to-hutza-or-st.speaker: Hutza
the-investigation-talking-to-hutza-or-st.text: That's right. She's the one who came here with Patzi. Like [player name] here, both were uninvited.

the-investigation-talking-to-hutza-or-st.speaker: Stradius
the-investigation-talking-to-hutza-or-st.text: Perhaps one of them is responsible... or indeed both of them.

the-investigation-talking-to-hutza-or-st.player: It's possible I suppose, but Patzi doesn't seem capable of pulling this off.

the-investigation-talking-to-hutza-or-st.speaker: Hutza
the-investigation-talking-to-hutza-or-st.text: It seems we still don't have anything conclusive. What do you think we should do?

the-investigation-talking-to-hutza-or-st.player: We could get them all together. Put pressure on them with some accusations and see who breaks?

the-investigation-talking-to-hutza-or-st.speaker: Stradius
the-investigation-talking-to-hutza-or-st.text: You think that'll work?

the-investigation-talking-to-hutza-or-st.player: Only one way to find out I suppose.

the-investigation-talking-to-hutza-or-st.speaker: Hutza
the-investigation-talking-to-hutza-or-st.text: It's not the worst thought, and I guess whatever happens, there's a good chance that some more of the truth will come out.

the-investigation-talking-to-hutza-or-st.speaker: Hutza
the-investigation-talking-to-hutza-or-st.text: Alright, [player name], just let us know when you want everyone gathered and we'll take them upstairs for you.

steps.player: I'm ready.

steps.speaker: Stradius
steps.text: Perfect! Let's get everyone upstairs!

options.text: I want to review the evidence a bit more.

steps.player: I want to review the evidence a bit more.

steps.text: Good idea. Just let us know when you're ready.

the-investigation-talking-to-hutza-or-st.speaker: Hutza
the-investigation-talking-to-hutza-or-st.text: So what are these labels you found?

the-accusation-talking-to-hutza.speaker: Hutza
the-accusation-talking-to-hutza.text: You take the lead here, [player name]. We'll be on hand to support you where needed.

the-accusation-talking-to-stradius.speaker: Stradius
the-accusation-talking-to-stradius.text: This bit's all up to you, [player name].

the-accusation-constantinius.player: Constantinius, you knew Livius well, didn't you?

the-accusation-constantinius.speaker: Constantinius
the-accusation-constantinius.text: I'd sponsored him for years, yes.

the-accusation-constantinius.player: How was that sponsorship working out for you?

the-accusation-constantinius.speaker: Constantinius
the-accusation-constantinius.text: Well, I can't say I wasn't profiting from it. Although I do admit that he'd become a little... excessive with his spending in recent times.

the-accusation-constantinius.player: So you'd almost benefit from him being out of the way, letting you find someone new to sponsor?

the-accusation-constantinius.speaker: Constantinius
the-accusation-constantinius.text: The thought has crossed my mind, but he was still profitable, and it's not like I couldn't just sponsor a second actor in addition to him anyway.

steps.text: If the player has not questioned others yet:

steps.player: Constantinius...

steps.speaker: Hutza
steps.text: Perhaps you should make sure you've questioned everyone before making an accusation, [player name].

steps.player: Hmm... Fair enough.

steps.text: If the player has questioned others:

steps.player: Constantinius! I believe you were responsible for the murder of Livius. He was getting too expensive to sponsor and you needed him gone!

steps.speaker: Constantinius
steps.text: I wasn't tied to him... If I'd wanted to stop sponsoring him, I'd have just done that. There would have been no need to kill him...

steps.player: Well, perhaps you felt a murder mystery would have helped make this party interesting and memorable.

steps.speaker: Constantinius
steps.text: I can't deny that it has very much enhanced the event, but do you think I'd have someone killed just for a social function?

steps.player: That's... a fair point, and indeed, why would you kill your lead actor right before the play?

steps.speaker: Constantinius
steps.text: You're the one accusing me, [player name]. You should know.

steps.player: Hmm... Very well.

the-accusation-talking-to-constantinius-.speaker: Constantinius
the-accusation-talking-to-constantinius-.text: Haven't you already tried to accuse me?

the-accusation-talking-to-constantinius-.player: Indeed I have. Just keeping you on your toes. As you were.

the-accusation-cozyac.player: Cozyac, did you not claim to have never interacted with Livius?

the-accusation-cozyac.speaker: Cozyac
the-accusation-cozyac.text: I did, and I shall stand by that claim! Why are you the one making these accusations anyway? You were the one down there with him! Besides, you're just a butler!

the-accusation-cozyac.player: A note written by yourself for Livius. Seems you weren't very happy with him...
So it seems you did know him. In fact, you had an issue with him, did you not?

the-accusation-cozyac.speaker: Cozyac
the-accusation-cozyac.text: Not one I would have killed him over! He owed me some money and wasn't paying up. I just needed to put some pressure on him.

the-accusation-cozyac.player: Hmm... An outstanding debt could be considered motive for murder...

steps.speaker: Hutza
steps.text: He makes a fair point, [player name].

steps.player: Hmm... Very well.

How heavily would you say you drank together?

the-accusation-pavo.speaker: Pavo
the-accusation-pavo.text: On occasion, a little too heavily.

the-accusation-pavo.speaker: Pavo
the-accusation-pavo.text: We'd tend to bring our own, although I did sometimes let him have a bit extra from my flask.

the-accusation-pavo.speaker: Pavo
the-accusation-pavo.text: Yes, that's the one! I must've misplaced it.

the-accusation-pavo.player: If you were letting Livius drink from your flask, it wouldn't have been hard for you to poison him, would it?

the-accusation-pavo.speaker: Pavo
the-accusation-pavo.text: But why would I poison a friend?

steps.text: If the player has not questioned others yet:

steps.player: Pavo...

steps.speaker: Hutza
steps.text: Perhaps you should make sure you've questioned everyone before making an accusation, [player name].

steps.player: Hmm... Fair enough.

steps.text: If the player has questioned others:

steps.player: Pavo! I believe you were responsible for the murder of Livius. You poisoned him when you let him drink from your flask!

steps.speaker: Pavo
steps.text: I would never do something like that! You have no proof!

steps.player: Well, the flask does still have some liquid left in it. Perhaps we should have it tested?

steps.speaker: Pavo
steps.text: Wait, there's still some left?
Pavo grabs the drinking flask from Stradius and quickly downs the rest of the contents.

steps.player: Oh... Well, I guess it's not poison then. Thanks for... helping to sort that one.

the-accusation-talking-to-pavo-afterward.speaker: Pavo
the-accusation-talking-to-pavo-afterward.text: Haven't you already tried to accuse me?

the-accusation-talking-to-pavo-afterward.player: Indeed I have. Just keeping you on your toes. As you were.

the-accusation-xocotla.player: Xocotla, you've never had any dealings with Livius, have you?
So he's never needed anything shipped by your company? Nothing he needed to move swiftly and discretely?

the-accusation-xocotla.speaker: Xocotla
the-accusation-xocotla.text: Why would he? I'm sure he's got more than enough solutions for moving his costumes around.

the-accusation-xocotla.speaker: Xocotla
the-accusation-xocotla.text: That looks like a contract between... myself and Livius.

the-accusation-xocotla.player: Good eye. Interesting how you yourself seemed to not be aware of it, especially given it was you who was carrying it.

the-accusation-xocotla.speaker: Xocotla
the-accusation-xocotla.text: Alright, fine. Livius had recently contracted us to help him move some of his belongings around. He's been doing well for himself and was moving into a larger property.

the-accusation-xocotla.speaker: Xocotla
the-accusation-xocotla.text: I needed him to sign off on a slight change in timelines, and given we were both here, I thought we may as well get it sorted.

steps.text: If the player has not questioned others yet:

steps.player: Xocotla...

steps.speaker: Hutza
steps.text: Perhaps you should make sure you've questioned everyone before making an accusation, [player name].

steps.player: Hmm... Fair enough.

steps.text: If the player has questioned others:

steps.player: Xocotla! I believe you were responsible for the murder of Livius. You pretended you didn't know him, but you lied!

steps.speaker: Xocotla
steps.text: Yes... It may surprise you to know that I didn't want to be associated with a murder victim whilst an investigation was ongoing!

steps.speaker: Hutza
steps.text: I suppose that is fair, [player name], and lying isn't a crime on its own.

steps.player: Hmm... Very well.

the-accusation-talking-to-xocotla-afterw.speaker: Xocotla
the-accusation-talking-to-xocotla-afterw.text: Haven't you already tried to accuse me?

the-accusation-talking-to-xocotla-afterw.player: Indeed I have. Just keeping you on your toes. As you were.

the-accusation-adala-and-patzi.player: Patzi, Adala. The two of you weren't even invited to this party...
But being here presented a huge opportunity for an up-and-coming actor like Patzi.
You already knew that Constantinius was thinking about sponsoring a new actor. Perhaps you decided to speed things along a bit by removing the competition.

the-accusation-adala-and-patzi.speaker: Patzi
the-accusation-adala-and-patzi.text: But why would I need to remove the competition if he was already open to sponsoring me anyway? That doesn't make sense...

the-accusation-adala-and-patzi.player: Perhaps, and indeed it is true that you couldn't have been present at the time of the murder. You never left the party. In fact you sent me down into the cellar for you, didn't you?

the-accusation-adala-and-patzi.speaker: Adala
the-accusation-adala-and-patzi.text: So you're saying that you're actually more likely to be guilty yourself?

the-accusation-adala-and-patzi.player: Sending me down there made me look guilty! A perfect way of drawing attention away from the true culprit.

the-accusation-adala-and-patzi.speaker: Adala
the-accusation-adala-and-patzi.text: But... that would be a terrible plan. You were here with us...

the-accusation-adala-and-patzi.player: Which leads me on to you, Adala. Patzi was accounted for when the murder took place, but you were not. Care to tell us what you were up to?

the-accusation-adala-and-patzi.speaker: Adala
the-accusation-adala-and-patzi.text: I took Patzi's bag to the backstage area, spent some time chatting to the actors, and then made my way to the party.

the-accusation-adala-and-patzi.player: So you never entered the wine cellar?
But you knew a lot about it, didn't you?

the-accusation-adala-and-patzi.speaker: Adala
the-accusation-adala-and-patzi.text: Where are you going with this?

the-accusation-adala-and-patzi.player: Wine labels from Constantinius' cellar, found on your person. Care to explain?

the-accusation-adala-and-patzi.speaker: Adala
the-accusation-adala-and-patzi.text: I just found them on the floor. It's bad manners not to pick up litter.

steps.text: If the player has not questioned others yet:

steps.player: Patzi...

steps.speaker: Hutza
steps.text: Perhaps you should make sure you've questioned everyone before making an accusation, [player name].

steps.player: Hmm... Fair enough.

steps.text: If the player has questioned others:

steps.player: Patzi! I believe you were responsible for the murder of Livius. You wanted him out of the way so you could take his place!

steps.speaker: Patzi
steps.text: But why? Constantinius was open to sponsoring me anyway. I didn't need to kill anyone...

steps.speaker: Hutza
steps.text: I think he's right, [player name]. There's no real motive here.

steps.player: Hmm... Very well.

steps.text: If the player has not questioned others yet:

steps.player: Adala...

steps.speaker: Hutza
steps.text: Perhaps you should make sure you've questioned everyone before making an accusation, [player name].

steps.player: Hmm... Fair enough.

steps.text: If the player has questioned others:

steps.player: Adala! I believe you were responsible for the murder of Livius. All the evidence is pointing at you!
You were the only person missing at the time of the murder, and despite your claims, we have clear evidence you were in that cellar!

steps.speaker: Adala
steps.text: Alright, fine. I admit I was in the cellar.

steps.speaker: Patzi
steps.text: Wait, what is this?

steps.speaker: Adala
steps.text: The Principum Red, you fool. I could retire on the value of that wine. All I had to do was get out of here with it.

steps.speaker: Constantinius
steps.text: My wine!

steps.speaker: Patzi
steps.text: You used me...

steps.speaker: Adala
steps.text: And I probably would've got away with it too, if it wasn't for this precocious butler turned investigator you hired!

steps.player: What happened Adala? Did Livius interrupt your plan? Did he need to be silenced?

steps.speaker: Adala
steps.text: Murder! What a ridiculous assertion! I may be a thief, but I'd never kill someone!
Adala starts attacking the player.

steps.player: Patzi...

steps.speaker: Patzi
steps.text: Haven't you already tried to accuse me?

steps.player: Indeed I have. Just keeping you on your toes. As you were.

the-accusation-fighting-adala.text: If the player loses the fight to Adala:

steps.player: Alright, I yield! You win!

steps.speaker: Adala
steps.text: I could've killed you, but I'm not that kind of person, just like how I didn't kill Livius.

the-accusation-fighting-adala.text: If the player wins the fight against Adala:

steps.speaker: Adala
steps.text: Stop! You're too good for me! You win!

steps.player: Are you ready to confess now?

steps.speaker: Adala
steps.text: I promise I didn't do it! I'm just a thief! I wasn't even strong enough to defeat you. How could I have killed Livius?

the-accusation-fighting-adala.speaker: Stradius
the-accusation-fighting-adala.text: She may be telling the truth, [player name], but either way, we know she's a criminal now.

the-accusation-fighting-adala.speaker: Hutza
the-accusation-fighting-adala.text: Come with us, Adala. You can have fun contemplating your crimes from your new cell...

the-accusation-fighting-adala.speaker: Constantinius
the-accusation-fighting-adala.text: Does this mean we can get on with tonight's play?

the-accusation-fighting-adala.player: You still want to go ahead with the play? You don't even have a lead actor anymore!

the-accusation-fighting-adala.speaker: Constantinius
the-accusation-fighting-adala.text: Yes, it is a bit of a last minute issue, but I have no doubt that Livius' understudy will be able to step up.

the-accusation-fighting-adala.player: But Adala might not have even been the killer!

the-accusation-fighting-adala.speaker: Constantinius
the-accusation-fighting-adala.text: Well, you've been doing a wonderful job so far, so I'm sure if the villain is still loose, you'll catch them.

the-accusation-fighting-adala.speaker: Hutza
the-accusation-fighting-adala.text: Constantinius, with respect, I'm not sure we can let everyone leave until we're sure we have this case solved.

the-accusation-fighting-adala.speaker: Constantinius
the-accusation-fighting-adala.text: That's not a problem. You can easily keep everyone in the theatre. The only place they'd be able to run to from there is straight off the cliff!

the-accusation-fighting-adala.speaker: Constantinius
the-accusation-fighting-adala.text: It's settled then! We will proceed with the play! While we do that, if the killer is still at large, the ever capable [player name] here will ensure they are dealt with!

the-accusation-fighting-adala.speaker: Constantinius
the-accusation-fighting-adala.text: Oh, no, you can't come with us. I don't want your investigation disrupting things. You'll need to stay out of sight. Why don't you take the back way?

the-accusation-fighting-adala.speaker: Constantinius
the-accusation-fighting-adala.text: Yes! It's not been used in a while, so it's a little bit precarious these days, but I'm sure you'll manage.

the-accusation-fighting-adala.player: Fine. Where do I find this back way?

the-accusation-fighting-adala.speaker: Hutza
the-accusation-fighting-adala.text: The pathway leads around the cliffs to the south. We'll see you at the theatre, [player name].
The others depart for the theatre.

the-backstage-attempting-to-climb-up-the.player: I don't think I should be going up there.

the-backstage-attempting-to-enter-throug.player: I have no reason to go down there right now.

the-backstage-talking-to-hutza-or-stradi.speaker: Stradius
the-backstage-talking-to-hutza-or-stradi.text: Well... we don't really have one, but the play is about to start and we still might have a killer on the loose.

the-backstage-talking-to-hutza-or-stradi.player: Perhaps there's some evidence we missed somewhere.

the-backstage-talking-to-hutza-or-stradi.speaker: Hutza
the-backstage-talking-to-hutza-or-stradi.text: It seemed like you'd been quite thorough. The only place you didn't check was here at the theatre.

the-backstage-talking-to-hutza-or-stradi.player: Well then I guess it's time to fix that.

the-backstage-talking-to-hutza-or-stradi.speaker: Stradius
the-backstage-talking-to-hutza-or-stradi.text: The stairs over there lead down to the backstage area. That's where the actors, including Livius, were getting ready for the play. That seems like the best place to check for any missing clues.

the-backstage-talking-to-hutza-or-stradi.speaker: Hutza
the-backstage-talking-to-hutza-or-stradi.text: Any luck down in the backstage area?

the-backstage-talking-to-hutza-or-stradi.speaker: Stradius
the-backstage-talking-to-hutza-or-stradi.text: Keep at it! I'm sure you can solve this one!

the-backstage-searching-the-crate-before.text: You search the crate, but don't find anything of interest.

the-backstage-talking-to-costumer.speaker: Costumer
the-backstage-talking-to-costumer.text: Nilsal. Are you the one who's trying to find Livius' killer?

the-backstage-talking-to-costumer.player: That's right. So I'm guessing down here is your domain?

the-backstage-talking-to-costumer.speaker: Costumer
the-backstage-talking-to-costumer.text: If you think I have any actual control in here, you'd be sorely mistaken. I don't think anyone could keep these actors in line. They're a... dramatic bunch.

the-backstage-talking-to-costumer.player: Speaking of which, where are they?

the-backstage-talking-to-costumer.speaker: Costumer
the-backstage-talking-to-costumer.text: The play will be starting as we speak. They'll all be up in the theatre.

the-backstage-talking-to-costumer.player: Right, well in that case, I'd better get to it. I'd like to have a look around down here. Hopefully I can find some sort of clue as to how Livius died.
I'd also like to ask you a few questions, if that's okay?

options.text: What can you tell me about the actors?

steps.player: What can you tell me about the actors?

steps.speaker: Costumer
steps.text: There's four of them in total... Well... was four I should say.

steps.speaker: Costumer
steps.text: There's Naiatli. She was Livius' understudy. After what happened, she's now taking the lead role tonight.

steps.speaker: Costumer
steps.text: Then you have Clodius. He's getting close to retirement now so prefers to take on small, but impactful roles.

steps.speaker: Costumer
steps.text: Finally there's Quintilia. She's quite new, so she mostly takes on the non-speaking parts.

steps.player: And all of them were in here earlier?

steps.speaker: Costumer
steps.text: That's right. Livius went out for his pre-performance drink, as he likes to do. The others all stayed here until after the murder happened.

steps.player: And you're sure none of them could have slipped out at any point?

steps.speaker: Costumer
steps.text: I don't think so. I suppose I do get quite engrossed in my work sometimes, so it's not impossible. But I'm sure I'd have spotted someone going up the stairs...

options.text: What's the crate of poison for?
options.condition: If the player has searched the crate of poison:

steps.player: What's the crate of poison for?

steps.speaker: Costumer
steps.text: Ah, that was a gift from Constantinius. We were having a bit of a rat problem, so he gave us the poison to deal with them.

options.text: It seems one of the costumes has a stain on it.
options.condition: If the player has searched the costume rack:

steps.player: It seems one of the costumes has a stain on it.

steps.speaker: Costumer
steps.text: A stain?

steps.player: Yes, a wine stain. Apparently the costume belongs to Naiatli. Is there any reason the costume would be stained?

steps.speaker: Costumer
steps.text: No, none of her characters have any interaction with wine...

steps.player: Do you have any wine backstage?

steps.speaker: Costumer
steps.text: Well, the actors do often like to have a drink after a play, but I always ask that they do that outside so as to not risk any damage to the costumes.

steps.player: Interesting...

options.text: Did you know there was a hidden passage in here?
options.condition: If the player has searched the bookshelf:

steps.player: Did you know there was a hidden passage in here?

steps.speaker: Costumer
steps.text: A passage? I had no idea, but I suppose it's not too suprising.

steps.player: How come?

steps.speaker: Costumer
steps.text: This is an old villa. Apparently it once played a role in some smuggling operations a long time ago. I could see them having a few secrets to help them with that.

options.text: I'm going to get looking around.

steps.player: I'm going to keep looking around.

options.text: What can you tell me about the actors?
What's the crate of poison for?
options.condition: If the player has searched the crate of poison:

options.text: It seems one of the costumes has a stain on it.
options.condition: If the player has searched the costume rack:

options.text: Did you know there was a hidden passage in here?
options.condition: If the player has searched the bookshelf:

options.text: I'm going to get looking around.

the-backstage-searching-the-costume-rack.text: You search the costume rack and find that one of the costumes has a wine stain on it. The label reads: 'Naiatli'.

the-backstage-searching-the-crate-after-.text: You search the crate and find it to be full of poison.

the-backstage-searching-the-bookshelf.text: The bookshelf hides a secret passage into the wine cellar.

the-backstage-talking-to-hutza-or-stradi.speaker: Hutza
the-backstage-talking-to-hutza-or-stradi.text: The play is well underway and for all we know there's still a killer out there. I hope you have something for us, [player name].

the-backstage-talking-to-hutza-or-stradi.player: I think I might. It turns out there's a secret passage from the backstage area into the wine cellar. Someone could have got in and out without anyone else knowing.
Not only that, but the backstage area has had a rat problem recently. They have plenty of poison for dealing with them. That same poison could easily have been used to kill Livius.

the-backstage-talking-to-hutza-or-stradi.speaker: Hutza
the-backstage-talking-to-hutza-or-stradi.text: But did you find anything that could tell us who did it?

the-backstage-talking-to-hutza-or-stradi.speaker: Stradius
the-backstage-talking-to-hutza-or-stradi.text: Yes, we need to confront the killer! Who was it, [player name]?

steps.player: Patzi.

steps.speaker: Stradius
steps.text: But how? We established that he couldn't have accessed the cellar.

steps.speaker: Hutza
steps.text: That's right. The secret passage doesn't change that either as he never left the villa.

steps.player: Okay, not him then.
Adala.

steps.speaker: Stradius
steps.text: So it was her? But why?

steps.speaker: Hutza
steps.text: Adala may be a criminal, but she had no reason to want Livius dead. I don't think it was her.

steps.player: Hmm... Good point.
Constantinius.

steps.speaker: Stradius
steps.text: How would he have gained from killing Livius?

steps.speaker: Hutza
steps.text: Exactly. If he's wanted to stop sponsoring him, he could have just done that. No killing needed.

steps.player: I guess you're right.
Cozyac.

steps.speaker: Hutza
steps.text: Because of the debt? That could be a motive, but he never had the means.

steps.player: Hmm... I suppose you're right.

steps.prompt: Who killed Livius?

steps.player: Xocotla.

steps.speaker: Hutza
steps.text: She did lie about knowing him, but we never determined any proper motive.

steps.speaker: Stradius
steps.text: I don't think she ever had the opportunity either.

steps.player: I think you're right actually. Ignore me.
Pavo.

steps.speaker: Stradius
steps.text: I thought we'd ruled them out?

steps.speaker: Hutza
steps.text: Do you have new information that changes that, [player name]?

steps.player: Er... No.

steps.speaker: Hutza
steps.text: Well then it's probably not them.

steps.player: Naiatli.

steps.speaker: Hutza
steps.text: The understudy that's on stage right now? Why?

steps.player: As a fellow actor, she had access to the secret passage into the wine cellar where Livius was having his pre- performance drink.

steps.speaker: Hutza
steps.text: But how did she kill him?

steps.player: The rat poison. Enough of that would easily kill a man. She poisoned his drink so that she could be back out of the cellar before he died.

steps.speaker: Stradius
steps.text: I suppose that makes sense, but she wasn't the only one who had access to that passage.

steps.player: But she was the only one who had wine on her clothes. Wine isn't allowed backstage, so it must have come from the cellar.

steps.speaker: Hutza
steps.text: Oh, very good! But what about motive?

steps.player: Constantinius mentioned earlier that she had been in Livius' shadow for some time. Killing him has finally allowed her to take on a leading role.

steps.speaker: Stradius
steps.text: I suppose this does all make sense, but are you certain?

steps.player: I'd say eighty, maybe ninety percent sure.

steps.speaker: Hutza
steps.text: Well I suppose that will have to be enough. You've not taken us down too many wrong paths today...

steps.speaker: Stradius
steps.text: Except for the whole fake butler act.

steps.speaker: Hutza
steps.text: True, but you were honest about that pretty quickly. We'll wait until the play is over and then we'll take her in.

steps.player: Wait? But should we not be acting now?

steps.speaker: Hutza
steps.text: Constantinius would kill us if we stopped the performance.

steps.speaker: Stradius
steps.text: And then we'd have another murder mystery on our hands...

steps.player: Well then we'll have to just speed things along a bit. I'm going out there!

steps.text: Player is transported to the stage.

steps.player: Clodius.

steps.speaker: Hutza
steps.text: The actor? But why would he do that?

steps.player: Well, he was one of the few who had access to the secret passage into the wine cellar. He also had access to the rat poison.

steps.speaker: Stradius
steps.text: But what was his motive?

steps.player: Er... I don't know.

steps.speaker: Hutza
steps.text: We're going to need more than that, [player name].

steps.prompt: Who killed Livius?

steps.player: Quintilia.

steps.speaker: Hutza
steps.text: The actress? But why?

steps.player: She had access to both the secret passage into the wine cellar and to the rat poison.

steps.speaker: Stradius
steps.text: But she doesn't have a motive... She also isn't the only one who had access to the passage and poison.

steps.player: Ah... Good point.
The Costumer.

steps.speaker: Stradius
steps.text: Really?

steps.player: Well, she had access to the secret passage. She claimed not to know about it, but she did know about the history of the villa. She also had access to the rat poison.

steps.speaker: Hutza
steps.text: But why would she kill him? What's the motive?

steps.player: I... don't know.

steps.speaker: Hutza
steps.text: Sounds like she might not be our killer then, [player name].

steps.player: Livius.

steps.speaker: Stradius
steps.text: You think Livius killed himself?

steps.player: Well it's the last thing anyone would expect.

steps.speaker: Hutza
steps.text: It's the last thing anyone would expect because it obviously didn't happen! Let's try considering some more plausible candidates.

steps.player: You two.

steps.speaker: Stradius
steps.text: Us? But surely we'd remember...

steps.speaker: Hutza
steps.text: Of course it wasn't us! Stop messing around, [player name]!

steps.prompt: Who killed Livius?

steps.player: Me.

steps.speaker: Stradius
steps.text: You?! Goodness, it's the crime of the century! Right, come with us!

steps.player: Wait! I was joking!

steps.speaker: Hutza
steps.text: Stop playing around, [player name]! We have a killer to deal with!

steps.player: The dog.

steps.speaker: Hutza
steps.text: The dog? But how would a dog do something like this?

steps.speaker: Stradius
steps.text: Never underestimate a dog, Hutza.

steps.speaker: Hutza
steps.text: Okay, but even if the dog did have the means, it didn't have the opportunity, not to mention motive...

steps.player: Okay, fine, not the dog.

options.text: I don't know yet. I need to review the evidence.

steps.player: I don't know yet. I need to review the evidence.

steps.speaker: Hutza
steps.text: Be quick, [player name].

the-backstage-talking-to-hutza-or-stradi.speaker: Stradius
the-backstage-talking-to-hutza-or-stradi.text: We need to confront the killer! Who was it, [player name]?

steps.player: Yes.

steps.text: Player is transported to the backstage.

steps.player: No.

the-stage-talking-to-hutza-or-stradius.text: Player is transported to the stage.

the-stage-subsequently-talking-to-hutza-.player: I need go back on stage.

the-stage-subsequently-talking-to-hutza-.text: Player is transported to the stage.

the-stage-talking-to-naiatli.speaker: Naiatli
the-stage-talking-to-naiatli.text: At last, the vile villain shows themselves!

the-stage-talking-to-naiatli.player: Villain? The only villain here is you, murderer!

the-stage-talking-to-naiatli.speaker: Naiatli
the-stage-talking-to-naiatli.text: I am no murderer! What vexatious allegations you come at me with!

the-stage-talking-to-naiatli.speaker: Cozyac
the-stage-talking-to-naiatli.text: I'm not sure about this new character. Are they even in costume?

the-stage-talking-to-naiatli.player: Do not pretend you don't know! Your lies are at an end!

the-stage-talking-to-naiatli.speaker: Constantinius
the-stage-talking-to-naiatli.text: I don't think this was in the original script...

the-stage-talking-to-naiatli.speaker: Naiatli
the-stage-talking-to-naiatli.text: I've overcome so much! I won't fall at this last hurdle!

the-stage-talking-to-naiatli.player: Lay down your arms! Your heroic deeds are fabrications!

the-stage-talking-to-naiatli.text: Player attacks Naiatli, resulting in her taking three damage.

the-stage-talking-to-naiatli.speaker: Naiatli
the-stage-talking-to-naiatli.text: Argh! You're stronger than I thought... I need to regroup!

the-stage-talking-to-naiatli-again.speaker: Naiatli
the-stage-talking-to-naiatli-again.text: Ha! You've stepped into my trap.

the-stage-talking-to-naiatli-again.speaker: Clodius
the-stage-talking-to-naiatli-again.text: Aha, villain! This is where you fall!

the-stage-attacking-clodius.text: Player attacks Clodius, resulting in him taking five damage.

the-stage-attacking-clodius.speaker: Clodius
the-stage-attacking-clodius.text: I'm sorry... You'll have to fight alone.

the-stage-attacking-naiatli.speaker: Naiatli
the-stage-attacking-naiatli.text: How could you be this powerful?

the-stage-attacking-naiatli.player: It's all part of my grand plan. I grow stronger with every passing moment!

the-stage-attacking-naiatli.text: Player attacks Naiatli, resulting in her taking eight damage.

the-stage-attacking-naiatli.speaker: Naiatli
the-stage-attacking-naiatli.text: I can't keep up with this!

the-stage-attacking-naiatli-again.speaker: Naiatli
the-stage-attacking-naiatli-again.text: I must make my last stand... Could you find it in your heart to stay your hand?

the-stage-attacking-naiatli-again.player: And let you live to foil my plans another day? I'm afraid that's not the game we play!

the-stage-attacking-naiatli-again.text: Player attacks Naiatli, resulting in her taking four damage. Naiatli falls on the stage.

the-stage-attacking-naiatli-again.speaker: Naiatli
the-stage-attacking-naiatli-again.text: And so I take my leave from this mortal coil!

the-stage-attacking-naiatli-again.speaker: Pavo
the-stage-attacking-naiatli-again.text: Well that was a twist, wasn't it?

the-stage-attacking-naiatli-again.player: Naiatli, I know you killed Livius. Why?

the-stage-attacking-naiatli-again.speaker: Naiatli
the-stage-attacking-naiatli-again.text: I've been stuck in the shadow of that man for too long. He wouldn't even let me fill another role...

the-stage-attacking-naiatli-again.player: Murder is a bit far though. Could you not have just... lightly poisoned him?

the-stage-attacking-naiatli-again.speaker: Naiatli
the-stage-attacking-naiatli-again.text: You don't understand... I never poisoned him... I just tripped him. All I wanted was to put him out of action. A small injury would've been enough for him to not perform this evening...

the-stage-attacking-naiatli-again.speaker: Naiatli
the-stage-attacking-naiatli-again.text: He'd had so much to drink. He fell harder than expected, and he wouldn't get up... I fled... I never wanted him to...

the-stage-attacking-naiatli-again.player: Oh, Naiatli... Come on, let's get you to the guards.

the-stage-attacking-naiatli-again.text: Player is transported inside the villa.

the-stage-attacking-naiatli-again.player: Stradius, Hutza, it's been a surprising pleasure working with you to solve this case.

the-stage-attacking-naiatli-again.speaker: Stradius
the-stage-attacking-naiatli-again.text: I can't believe it was all an accident...

the-stage-attacking-naiatli-again.speaker: Hutza
the-stage-attacking-naiatli-again.text: [player name], you've done well. I'd like to apologise for our hasty arrest earlier. Your commitment to helping us has been commendable.

the-stage-attacking-naiatli-again.speaker: Stradius
the-stage-attacking-naiatli-again.text: To be fair to us, you did seem like the perfect suspect.

the-stage-attacking-naiatli-again.player: I suppose I did, but no harm done. I'm just glad we got it all sorted out, though I don't think Patzi is going to be paying me any time soon...

the-stage-attacking-naiatli-again.speaker: Hutza
the-stage-attacking-naiatli-again.text: You win some and you lose some I guess. All the best, [player name]!

post-quest-dialogue-talking-to-hutza.speaker: Hutza
post-quest-dialogue-talking-to-hutza.text: You were quite impressive up on stage. Maybe you should take up a career in acting... or investigating crime.

post-quest-dialogue-talking-to-stradius.speaker: Stradius
post-quest-dialogue-talking-to-stradius.text: Thanks for your help again, [player name]. It's good to know people like you are around.

post-quest-dialogue-talking-to-patzi.speaker: Patzi
post-quest-dialogue-talking-to-patzi.text: No thanks to you! This was meant to be a big moment for me, and you totally upstaged me!

post-quest-dialogue-talking-to-patzi.player: Are you angry at me for getting involved in all of this? Did you forget that it was you that hired me?

post-quest-dialogue-talking-to-patzi.speaker: Patzi
post-quest-dialogue-talking-to-patzi.text: I hired you to make me look better!

post-quest-dialogue-talking-to-patzi.player: And I don't think I did too bad a job. You never got kicked out, even though you did bring a thief in with you.
So how about that payment you promised?

post-quest-dialogue-talking-to-constanti.speaker: Constantinius
post-quest-dialogue-talking-to-constanti.text: Well, I never imagined you'd be quite the actor!

post-quest-dialogue-talking-to-constanti.player: I have to admit, I rather surprised myself there.

post-quest-dialogue-talking-to-constanti.speaker: Constantinius
post-quest-dialogue-talking-to-constanti.text: I don't suppose you'd like to be acting here in the future? To be honest, I'd prefer you to that odd fellow that brought you to my door.

post-quest-dialogue-talking-to-constanti.player: It's a kind offer, but I'm afraid it was a one-time job.

post-quest-dialogue-talking-to-constanti.speaker: Constantinius
post-quest-dialogue-talking-to-constanti.text: Anyway, do feel free to wander around the villa whenever you fancy. I don't recommend drinking from the wine fountain though.

post-quest-dialogue-talking-to-the-costu.speaker: Costumer
post-quest-dialogue-talking-to-the-costu.text: You were very brave for going on stage to confront a killer. Looks like you did well to get her to surrender without damaging her costume.

post-quest-dialogue-talking-to-the-costu.player: It was very well made. Makes the job of not damaging it much easier!

post-quest-dialogue-talking-to-the-costu.speaker: Costumer
post-quest-dialogue-talking-to-the-costu.text: Why thank you! I credit my needles for the good work.

post-quest-dialogue-talking-to-the-costu.player: Would I be able to get one of them for my own purposes?

post-quest-dialogue-talking-to-the-costu.speaker: Costumer
post-quest-dialogue-talking-to-the-costu.text: I suppose I could part with one... If you're careful not to lose it.
The costumer gives you one of her special needles.

post-quest-dialogue-talking-to-the-head-.speaker: Head Butler
post-quest-dialogue-talking-to-the-head-.text: After all that, are you sure I can't convince you to join the union?

post-quest-dialogue-talking-to-the-head-.speaker: Head Butler
post-quest-dialogue-talking-to-the-head-.text: Kuani! I'll need to run and grab my forms, but if you wait there just a moment...

post-quest-dialogue-talking-to-the-head-.player: I was going to ask if you had any spare equipment...
I may have a need to mask my identity again in the future... or perhaps carry a tray around.

post-quest-dialogue-talking-to-the-head-.speaker: Head Butler
post-quest-dialogue-talking-to-the-head-.text: You're certain you don't want to join the union as well?

post-quest-dialogue-talking-to-the-head-.speaker: Head Butler
post-quest-dialogue-talking-to-the-head-.text: I see. In that case, which equipment would you like?

steps.player: The ram mask.

steps.text: The head butler hands you a ram mask.
