steps.speaker: Bartender
steps.text: There you go. Now get out, we don't like your sort around here.

steps.speaker: Bartender
steps.text: Get out of my bar then! We don't like your sort round here!

enchanting-the-mirrors-talking-to-the-ba.speaker: Bartender
enchanting-the-mirrors-talking-to-the-ba.text: You've had your drink, now get out of here. I have nothing to say to the-

enchanting-the-mirrors-talking-to-the-ba.player: No, Wait! Look, I'm here on an archaeological expedition for the Museum of Varrock.
I am only here looking for artefacts...

enchanting-the-mirrors-talking-to-the-ba.speaker: Bartender
enchanting-the-mirrors-talking-to-the-ba.text: Oh really? Our inheritance is only sand and death. What do you expect to find out here in this desert forsaken by the gods?

steps.player: I heard a rumour about four diamonds or crystals...

steps.speaker: Bartender
steps.text: The four diamonds of Azzanadra??? How came you to know of this?

steps.player: You've heard of them then?

steps.speaker: Bartender
steps.text: It's just a fairy tale for children. Maybe one of the village elders might know more, but it's not really something I care about.

steps.speaker: Bartender
steps.text: Now get out of here, your sort isn't welcome in my bar.

steps.player: Certain things have led me to believe there may be some kind of ruined fortress around here...

steps.speaker: Bartender
steps.text: Doubt it. What in the world would someone need to guard against in the middle of this desert?

steps.speaker: Bartender
steps.text: A bad attack of sand? I think you're on the wrong track here, stranger.

enchanting-the-mirrors-talking-to-the-ba.speaker: Bartender
enchanting-the-mirrors-talking-to-the-ba.text: You've had your drink, now get out of here. I have nothing to say to the-

enchanting-the-mirrors-talking-to-the-ba.player: No, Wait! Look, I'm here on an archaeological expedition for the Museum of Varrock.
I am only here looking for artefacts...

enchanting-the-mirrors-talking-to-the-ba.speaker: Bartender
enchanting-the-mirrors-talking-to-the-ba.text: Oh really? Our inheritance is only sand and death. What do you expect to find out here in this desert forsaken by the gods?

options.text: I heard of the Diamonds of Azzanadra.

steps.player: Tell me all you know about the Diamonds of Azzanadra.

steps.speaker: Bartender
steps.text: Not that I think it's any of your business, but when I was a child I remember hearing the legend.

steps.speaker: Bartender
steps.text: I don't recall it particularly well, other than they are said to contain an incredible power.

steps.speaker: Bartender
steps.text: If you really want to hear more about it you'd be best off finding someone who cares about the past, and the history of this area, and stop bothering me.

enchanting-the-mirrors-talking-to-the-ba.player: I'm here on an archaeological expedition for the Museum of Varrock.
I believe there may be some interesting artefacts in the area.

steps.speaker: Bandit
steps.text: I'm sure there are many secrets buried beneath the sands here. The thing about this being a desert, is that they're likely to stay that way.

steps.speaker: Bandit
steps.text: The gods forsake us, and drove us to this place. Anything of worth has been long gone.

steps.speaker: Bandit
steps.text: Do I look like I care who you are or where you came from?

steps.speaker: Bandit
steps.text: You're crazy. The only thing you will find out here in the desert is your death.
The bandits start attacking the player.

steps.speaker: Bandit
steps.text: I have no interest in the world that betrayed my people. Search where you will, you will find nothing.

enchanting-the-mirrors-talking-to-eblis-.player: Hello. I represent the Museum of Varrock, and I have reason to believe there may be some kinds of artefacts of historical significance in the nearby area...

enchanting-the-mirrors-talking-to-eblis-.speaker: Eblis
enchanting-the-mirrors-talking-to-eblis-.text: Ah yes. The only time people care about our existence is when they think they have something to gain from us.

enchanting-the-mirrors-talking-to-eblis-.speaker: Eblis
enchanting-the-mirrors-talking-to-eblis-.text: I have nothing to say to you. You and your kind are not welcome here.

enchanting-the-mirrors-talking-to-eblis-.player: Please, if I can just have a few minutes of your time to ask some questions...?

enchanting-the-mirrors-talking-to-eblis-.speaker: Eblis
enchanting-the-mirrors-talking-to-eblis-.text: (sigh) I suppose I can spare you that. What do you wish to know about?

options.text: Why is this village so hostile?
Do you know anything about treasure near here?
Do you know anything about a fortress near here?
Tell me of The four diamonds of Azzanadra

steps.player: So tell me... Did you ever hear of something called the Diamonds of Azzanadra?

steps.speaker: Eblis
steps.text: This is the treasure which you seek???

steps.speaker: Eblis
steps.text: Please accept my apologies! I thought you were but some opportunistic thief, looking to steal what heritage we have left! Now I see that you are in fact a brave adventurer,

steps.speaker: Eblis
steps.text: looking to restore our glories back upon us!

steps.player: Uh... yeah... So anyway, you have heard of them?

steps.speaker: Eblis
steps.text: Heard of them? Of course I have heard of them! They are the legacy of the great Mahjarrat hero, Azzanadra!

steps.player: So... do you have any idea where they might be? I have a feeling they will be very valuable.
Uh, valuable as historical artefacts I mean, obviously.

steps.speaker: Eblis
steps.text: They were stolen by warriors of the false god Zamorak generations ago. When you find the warriors, you will find the diamonds.

steps.speaker: Eblis
steps.text: I suspect they will not willingly part with such objects of power however.

steps.speaker: Eblis
steps.text: Beware too, for these warriors are very powerful; they have taken the powers of the diamonds into themselves!

steps.player: How do you mean?

steps.speaker: Eblis
steps.text: Each diamond has an elemental quality...

steps.speaker: Eblis
steps.text: There is the Diamond of Blood, the Diamond of Ice, the Diamond of Smoke and the Diamond of Shadow.

steps.speaker: Eblis
steps.text: You should expect the warriors to have taken some aspect of these diamonds as their own...

steps.player: Do you have any idea how I could track down these warriors somehow, then?

steps.speaker: Eblis
steps.text: There is an ancient spell I know of that may spy upon such power... But it will require a few ingredients for it to work.

steps.speaker: Eblis
steps.text: Should you be willing to get these ingredients for me, I will be able to locate the rough area where each of these warriors has taken refuge. The spell is imprecise, but it should help you get on the

steps.speaker: Eblis
steps.text: right track in your search.

steps.speaker: Eblis
steps.text: Is your desire for our freedom strong enough? Will you gather the ingredients for this spell for me?

steps.player: Sure, what do you need?

steps.speaker: Eblis
steps.text: For this spell, I will need to make some scrying glasses. I will need enough so that we can view the realm in its entirety.

steps.speaker: Eblis
steps.text: When enchanted, the scrying glass will be able to let us view any area that has been influenced by the presence of the Diamonds of Azzanadra.

steps.player: Okay, but what exactly do you need for this spell?

steps.speaker: Eblis
steps.text: Well, six scrying glasses should be sufficient. For each scrying glass, I will need two magic logs, a steel bar and some molten glass. This makes a total of 12 magic logs, 6 pieces of molten

steps.speaker: Eblis
steps.text: glass, and 6 steel bars.

steps.speaker: Eblis
steps.text: In addition, for the actual spell to enchant the glasses, I will require one set of normal bones, some ash, some charcoal and a single blood rune.

steps.speaker: Eblis
steps.text: Do you understand me, adventurer?

steps.player: Quick question; what kind of bones do you need?

steps.speaker: Eblis
steps.text: Standard bones. Other types of bones are of no use to me in this spell.

options.text: Yes, I will go get those for you.

steps.player: It's a slightly odd collection of ingredients, but I shouldn't have too much trouble getting those for you.

steps.text: Same as "Talking to Eblis after agreeing to get ingredients" below.

steps.player: Actually I don't feel like going on a shopping trip for you right now.

steps.speaker: Eblis
steps.text: As you wish. I should have known not to get my hopes up that our long cursed life may soon be at an end...

enchanting-the-mirrors-talking-to-eblis-.text: If the player has some ingredients

steps.player: I have some of the stuff you are looking for with me...

steps.speaker: Eblis
steps.text: Thank you, pass over the ingredients so that I may begin working on the spell.

enchanting-the-mirrors-talking-to-eblis-.speaker: Eblis
enchanting-the-mirrors-talking-to-eblis-.text: Before I can complete the spell I will still need the following items;

steps.speaker: Eblis
steps.text: [X] magic logs [X] steel bars [X] molten glass

steps.speaker: Eblis
steps.text: [X] bones, [X] ashes, [X] charcoal and [X] blood rune[s].

enchanting-the-mirrors-giving-eblis-ingr.text: You hand over a magic log.
You hand over a steel bar.
You hand over some molten glass.

enchanting-the-mirrors-giving-eblis-ingr.speaker: Eblis
enchanting-the-mirrors-giving-eblis-ingr.text: Thank you, that is enough ash for the spell.

enchanting-the-mirrors-giving-eblis-ingr.speaker: Eblis
enchanting-the-mirrors-giving-eblis-ingr.text: Thank you, those are enough bones for the spell.

enchanting-the-mirrors-giving-eblis-ingr.speaker: Eblis
enchanting-the-mirrors-giving-eblis-ingr.text: Thank you, that is enough charcoal for the spell.
You hand over a blood rune.

enchanting-the-mirrors-giving-eblis-ingr.speaker: Eblis
enchanting-the-mirrors-giving-eblis-ingr.text: Thank you, that blood rune should be sufficient for the spell.

enchanting-the-mirrors-talking-to-eblis-.speaker: Eblis
enchanting-the-mirrors-talking-to-eblis-.text: Excellent! Those are all the ingredients I need to create the scrying glasses.

enchanting-the-mirrors-talking-to-eblis-.speaker: Eblis
enchanting-the-mirrors-talking-to-eblis-.text: I will find a suitable spot in the desert to the East of here, and set them up. When you are ready to begin your search, please come and find me there, I will show you how to utilise the

enchanting-the-mirrors-talking-to-eblis-.speaker: Eblis
enchanting-the-mirrors-talking-to-eblis-.text: Meet me again in the desert East of here, I will use these ingredients to create a scrying glass for you.

enchanting-the-mirrors-talking-to-eblis-.player: So can you give me any help on where to find these warriors and their diamonds?

enchanting-the-mirrors-talking-to-eblis-.speaker: Eblis
enchanting-the-mirrors-talking-to-eblis-.text: No, the magic used in this spell is powerful, but inaccurate. The direction the scrying glass faces is roughly the direction you will find the warrior, but I'm afraid I

enchanting-the-mirrors-talking-to-eblis-.speaker: Eblis
enchanting-the-mirrors-talking-to-eblis-.text: can't be any more help than that.

enchanting-the-mirrors-talking-to-eblis-.player: I don't understand why there are six mirrors when there are only four diamonds...

enchanting-the-mirrors-talking-to-eblis-.speaker: Eblis
enchanting-the-mirrors-talking-to-eblis-.text: As I say, the enchantment is very inaccurate.

enchanting-the-mirrors-talking-to-eblis-.speaker: Eblis
enchanting-the-mirrors-talking-to-eblis-.text: I can only focus upon the aura the diamonds have left behind them, so any place where the Diamonds were present for a significant period of time will still be shown - such as the Bandit Camp where I make my home.

enchanting-the-mirrors-talking-to-eblis-.speaker: Eblis
enchanting-the-mirrors-talking-to-eblis-.text: My apologies, but magic is an inaccurate art in many respects.

enchanting-the-mirrors-talking-to-eblis-.speaker: Eblis
enchanting-the-mirrors-talking-to-eblis-.text: Don't forget to come back here when you have collected all four diamonds.

enchanting-the-mirrors-talking-to-asgarn.speaker: Asgarnia Smith
enchanting-the-mirrors-talking-to-asgarn.text: Hello again. You find any signs of that treasure yet?

enchanting-the-mirrors-talking-to-asgarn.player: Not as such... Although I think I'm onto something of a promising lead...
Did you ever hear of something called the Diamonds of Azzanadra?

enchanting-the-mirrors-talking-to-asgarn.speaker: Asgarnia Smith
enchanting-the-mirrors-talking-to-asgarn.text: Diamonds of Azzanadra? That sounds very promising indeed!

enchanting-the-mirrors-talking-to-asgarn.player: So you have heard of them?

enchanting-the-mirrors-talking-to-asgarn.speaker: Asgarnia Smith
enchanting-the-mirrors-talking-to-asgarn.text: Nope, never heard of them before, but you said diamonds! Diamonds are always promising!

smoke-diamond-climbing-down-the-smokey-w.player: I can see a lot of foul looking smoke at the bottom of this well.
I don't think breathing it in directly would be very good for my health.

smoke-diamond-lighting-a-standing-torch.text: If the last standing torch was lit:

steps.text: The path is lit, now claim the key...
There seems to be no way to open this chest. Engraved where the keyhole should be is a message; 'Light the path, and find the key...'
Without the warm key:
warm key
You open the chest and take a key.
With the warm key:
The chest is empty.
This gate is locked.
You unlock the gate and enter the room.
Fareed spawns and attacks the player.

steps.speaker: Fareed
steps.text: You dare trespass in my realm?

smoke-diamond-without-wearing-ice-gloves.text: The heat from the warrior causes you to drop your weapon.

smoke-diamond-upon-defeating-fareed.text: You take the Diamond of Smoke from the ashes of the warrior.

smoke-diamond-re-entering-the-room-witho.text: The Diamond of Smoke seems to have mystically found its way back here.

shadow-diamond-talking-to-hadley.prompt: What would you like to ask about?

steps.player: I don't suppose you know anything about some kind of diamond nearby here, do you?

steps.speaker: Hadley
steps.text: I am afraid not [Sir/Madam]. But isn't our waterfall very pretty?

steps.player: Um... yeah, I guess.

steps.speaker: Hadley
steps.text: There was a very scruffy looking merchant in here the other day, perhaps he might have the item you are looking for?

shadow-diamond-talking-to-rasolo.speaker: Rasolo
shadow-diamond-talking-to-rasolo.text: Greetings friend. I am Rasolo, the famous merchant. Would you care to see my wares?

options.text: Ask about the Diamonds of Azzanadra

steps.player: No, actually I was looking for something specific...

steps.speaker: Rasolo
steps.text: Hmmmm? And what would that be?

steps.player: I am looking for one of the Diamonds of Azzanadra. I have reason to believe it may be somewhere around here...

steps.speaker: Rasolo
steps.text: Ahhh...  The Shadow Diamond...

steps.speaker: Rasolo
steps.text: I know the object of which you speak. It is guarded by a fearsome warrior known as Damis, they say, who lives in the shadows, invisible to prying eyes...

steps.player: How can I find this 'Damis' then?

steps.speaker: Rasolo
steps.text: Well now... perhaps we can help each other out here.

steps.speaker: Rasolo
steps.text: I have in my possession a small trinket, a ring, that allows its wearer to see the unseen...

steps.player: How much do you want for it?

steps.speaker: Rasolo
steps.text: Ah, but it is not for sale...  As such...

steps.speaker: Rasolo
steps.text: I am offering to trade it for an item that was rightfully mine, but that was stolen by a bandit named Laheeb.

steps.speaker: Rasolo
steps.text: The item in question is a gilded cross, that has some sentimental value to myself. I wish for you to recover this item for me, and I will happily let you have my ring of visibility.

steps.player: Where can I find this Laheeb?

steps.speaker: Rasolo
steps.text: Well, as a travelling merchant I have roamed these lands for many years...

steps.speaker: Rasolo
steps.text: To the far east of here there is an area that is dry, and barren like the desert... it is called...

steps.player: Al Kharid?

steps.speaker: Rasolo
steps.text: ...Yes, Al Kharid. Now, to the south of Al Kharid there is a passageway, it is called the...

steps.player: Shantay Pass.

steps.speaker: Rasolo
steps.text: ...Yes. I didn't realise you had travelled there yourself.

steps.speaker: Rasolo
steps.text: Anyway, when you have gone through the Shantay Pass, you will find yourself in a hostile desert... You will need to bring water with you to keep your life. Now, to the south-west of this pass, you will find a small

steps.speaker: Rasolo
steps.text: village...

steps.player: The Bedabin camp.

steps.speaker: Rasolo
steps.text: If you know where Laheeb lives, why did you ask me?

steps.player: I don't. Sorry, please continue.

steps.speaker: Rasolo
steps.text: Well, okay then. Anyway, south of this encampment there is an area where few have ever been... It is a village of murderous bandits, and treacherous

steps.speaker: Rasolo
steps.text: thieves... This is where Laheeb makes his home.

steps.speaker: Rasolo
steps.text: He will have hidden his stolen treasure somewhere in that village, I am sure of it. When you find his loot, you will find my gilded cross. Return it to me, and I will reward you with my ring

steps.speaker: Rasolo
steps.text: of visibility, so that you may find Damis. Does this seem fair to you?

steps.player: Not a problem. I'll be back with your cross before you know it.
Sounds like too much effort to me. I'll find this Damis by myself.

steps.speaker: Rasolo
steps.text: As you wish.

shadow-diamond-talking-to-rasolo-after-d.player: Where can I find this Damis again?

shadow-diamond-talking-to-rasolo-after-d.speaker: Rasolo
shadow-diamond-talking-to-rasolo-after-d.text: I have already told you, he is of the shadows. You will see neither him nor his lair without the aid of magic.

shadow-diamond-talking-to-rasolo-after-d.speaker: Rasolo
shadow-diamond-talking-to-rasolo-after-d.text: Well now... perhaps we can help each other out here.

shadow-diamond-talking-to-rasolo-after-a.speaker: Rasolo
shadow-diamond-talking-to-rasolo-after-a.text: Have you retrieved my gilded cross for me yet?

shadow-diamond-talking-to-rasolo-after-a.speaker: Rasolo
shadow-diamond-talking-to-rasolo-after-a.text: Well what seems to be the problem?

steps.player: Where can I find this Laheeb?
