steps.text: Well, as a travelling merchant I have roamed these lands for many years...

steps.speaker: Rasolo
steps.text: To the far east of here there is an area that is dry, and barren like the desert... it is called...

steps.player: Al Kharid?

steps.speaker: Rasolo
steps.text: ...Yes, Al Kharid. Now, to the south of Al Kharid there is a passageway, it is called the...

steps.player: Shantay Pass.

steps.speaker: Rasolo
steps.text: ...Yes. I didn't realise you had travelled there yourself.

steps.speaker: Rasolo
steps.text: Anyway, when you have gone through the Shantay Pass, you will find yourself in a hostile desert... You will need to bring water with you to keep your life. Now, to the south-west of this pass, you will find a small

steps.speaker: Rasolo
steps.text: village...

steps.player: The Bedabin camp.

steps.speaker: Rasolo
steps.text: If you know where Laheeb lives, why did you ask me?

steps.player: I don't. Sorry, please continue.

steps.speaker: Rasolo
steps.text: Well, okay then. Anyway, south of this encampment there is an area where few have ever been... It is a village of murderous bandits, and treacherous

steps.speaker: Rasolo
steps.text: thieves... This is where Laheeb makes his home.

options.text: Can't I just buy your ring?

steps.player: Can't I just buy your ring?

steps.speaker: Rasolo
steps.text: No, it is not for sale. Some things are more important than money, and the return of my gilded cross is one of them.

steps.player: Is Damis near here, then?

steps.speaker: Rasolo
steps.text: You would be surprised to know just how close he is...

shadow-diamond-attempting-to-open-laheeb.text: Your skill as a thief allows you to see some kind of elaborate booby trapped locking mechanism on this chest.

steps.text: Without a lockpick:
You will need a lockpick for this lock.
With a lockpick:

shadow-diamond-picklocking-the-chest.text: You attempt to pick the first lock...

steps.text: ...You successfully picked the first lock!
You attempt to pick the second lock...
If successful:
...You successfully picked the second lock!
You attempt to pick the final lock...
If successful:
You manage to pick final lock.
gilded cross
Inside the chest, hidden under some rags, you find a Gilded Cross.
If unsuccessful:
If unsuccessful:
...and fail. The locking mechanism has reset itself.
Your lock pick snapped while attempting to pick the lock.

shadow-diamond-opening-the-chest-after-s.text: If the player lost the cross:

steps.text: Inside the chest, hidden under some rags, you find a Gilded Cross.

shadow-diamond-opening-the-chest-after-s.text: If the player still has the cross:

steps.text: You find nothing of interest inside the chest.

shadow-diamond-talking-to-hadley-after-l.prompt: What would you like to ask about?

steps.player: I don't suppose you've ever heard of someone named Damis, have you?

steps.speaker: Hadley
steps.text: I heard a rumour many years ago, that there was a warrior by that name who had a secret hideout somewhere in these parts, but I have never seen it myself.

steps.speaker: Hadley
steps.text: And why would you be looking for such a criminal element when you could be admiring the tranquil beauty of the waterfall, anyway?

shadow-diamond-returning-to-rasolo.speaker: Rasolo
shadow-diamond-returning-to-rasolo.text: Have you retrieved my gilded cross for me yet?

shadow-diamond-returning-to-rasolo.speaker: Rasolo
shadow-diamond-returning-to-rasolo.text: Excellent, excellent. Here, take this ring. While you wear it, you will be able to see the things that live in shadows...

shadow-diamond-returning-to-rasolo.speaker: Rasolo
shadow-diamond-returning-to-rasolo.text: And you will be able to find the entrance to Damis' lair.

shadow-diamond-talking-to-rasolo-again.speaker: Rasolo
shadow-diamond-talking-to-rasolo-again.text: So how goes your quest? Did you manage to find the Diamond you were looking for yet?
If the player lost the ring of visibility:

steps.player: I lost that ring you gave me...

steps.speaker: Rasolo
steps.text: Then by all means, take another. Only a foolish merchant would give away his only stock!

shadow-diamond-talking-to-rasolo-again.speaker: Rasolo
shadow-diamond-talking-to-rasolo-again.text: Well, his lair is very close to here. I suggest you look around for it.

shadow-diamond-approaching-damis.text: A voice seems to come from the walls around you;
'You... do not be... long in this... place...
Turn... back now, or... prepare... to meet your... doom...'
Damis spawns and attacks the player.

shadow-diamond-approaching-damis.speaker: Damis
shadow-diamond-approaching-damis.text: You should... have listened to me!

shadow-diamond-upon-defeating-his-first-.speaker: Damis
shadow-diamond-upon-defeating-his-first-.text: This armour... is for restraint, not... protection...

shadow-diamond-upon-defeating-his-first-.speaker: Damis
shadow-diamond-upon-defeating-his-first-.text: Now I show... you... my true... power!

steps.speaker: Damis
steps.text: I will crush you utterly!

steps.speaker: Damis
steps.text: You are no match for my power!

steps.speaker: Damis
steps.text: Taste my blade and feel my wrath!

steps.speaker: Damis
steps.text: I... am... invincible!

steps.speaker: Damis
steps.text: You will regret ever coming here!

steps.speaker: Damis
steps.text: Hah! I fear not your feeble power!

options.condition: If Protect from Melee is active:

steps.speaker: Damis
steps.text: Your pathetic skill won't help you now!

blood-diamond-entering-the-hair-of-the-d.speaker: Roavar
blood-diamond-entering-the-hair-of-the-d.text: M-my lord Malak, what brings you here?
If the player has not completed The Blood Moon Rises:

steps.speaker: Malak
steps.text: Hmm? You know very well that your tithe is due, Roavar. I am here to collect.

steps.speaker: Roavar
steps.text: Y-yes of course, sire, but surely your graciousness is too important to perform such menial duties? Is this not Gadderanks job, your most high beneficence?

steps.speaker: Malak
steps.text: Indeed it is Roavar, but I cannot find that incompetent fool. And assuming you are not the one who wishes to tell Lord Drakan that his tithe has not been collected, I saw fit to take on the duty myself this time.

steps.speaker: Roavar
steps.text: Of course, my lord, I meant no disrespect.

steps.speaker: Malak
steps.text: So you have the tithe ready for me?

steps.speaker: Roavar
steps.text: Of course, my lord. I trust you will find it all there and in good order.

steps.speaker: Malak
steps.text: Hmm... Well, for your sake, you had better hope that indeed it is. The mood I am in for having to come to this wolfen cesspit means any shortfall is coming from you directly.

blood-diamond-entering-the-hair-of-the-d.text: If the player has completed The Blood Moon Rises quest:

steps.speaker: Malak
steps.text: Hmm? You know very well that your tithe is due, Roavar. I am here to collect.

steps.speaker: Roavar
steps.text: B-but under Lord Sugadinti, the tithes are no longer-

steps.speaker: Malak
steps.text: Silence! Lord Drakan may be gone, but you owe a personal debt to me, Roavar, unless you have forgotten?

steps.speaker: Roavar
steps.text: Of course, my lord, I meant no disrespect.

steps.speaker: Malak
steps.text: So you have the tithe ready for me?

steps.speaker: Roavar
steps.text: Of course, my lord. I trust you will find it all there and in good order.

steps.speaker: Malak
steps.text: Hmmm... Well, for your sake, you had better hope that indeed it is. The mood I am in for having to come to this wolfen cesspit means any shortfall is coming from you directly.

blood-diamond-entering-the-hair-of-the-d.speaker: Malak
blood-diamond-entering-the-hair-of-the-d.text: Then again... perhaps this was not a total waste of my time after all.

blood-diamond-entering-the-hair-of-the-d.speaker: Malak
blood-diamond-entering-the-hair-of-the-d.text: Yes, you. Your bearing suggests you are not one of the usual peasants, and your stench suggests you are not one of these filthy wolfen folk.

blood-diamond-entering-the-hair-of-the-d.speaker: Malak
blood-diamond-entering-the-hair-of-the-d.text: Come here, I would like to know what you are doing here.

blood-diamond-talking-to-malak.text: If the player is wearing a Ring of Charos(a):

steps.speaker: Malak
steps.text: A human, eh? Don't think that silly little ring of yours will fool me. Give me one good reason why I should not just take you to Lord Drakan now.

blood-diamond-talking-to-malak.text: If the player is wearing a Ring of Charos(a) and has completed The Blood Moon Rises:

steps.speaker: Malak
steps.text: A human, eh? Don't think that silly little ring of yours will fool me. Give me one good reason why I should not just kill you right now.

blood-diamond-talking-to-malak.text: If the player is not wearing a Ring of Charos(a):

steps.speaker: Malak
steps.text: A human, eh? Give me one good reason why I should not just take you to Lord Drakan now.

blood-diamond-talking-to-malak.text: If the player is not wearing a Ring of Charos(a) and has completed the Blood Moon Rises:

steps.speaker: Malak
steps.text: A human, eh? Give me one good reason why I should not just kill you right now.

blood-diamond-talking-to-malak.speaker: Malak
blood-diamond-talking-to-malak.text: You had better make it a good one too, or you will not survive the night, I'll wager.

options.text: I am here to worship Zamorak

steps.player: I am here to worship the almighty Zamorak! Yay! Go Zamorak!

steps.speaker: Malak
steps.text: I see. You are a moron. You have probably settled right in with the rest of the idiots in this pathetic excuse for a village.

steps.speaker: Malak
steps.text: Unfortunately for you, that is not a good enough reason to explain your presence here.

steps.speaker: Malak
steps.text: Now tell me the reason for your coming here, or I will ensure you suffer a horrible fate indeed.

options.text: Well, I could tell Sugadinti about you collecting tithes...
options.condition: If the player has completed The Blood Moon Rises:

steps.player: Well, I could tell Sugadinti about you collecting tithes...

steps.speaker: Malak
steps.text: Hah! Most entertaining, human! Lord Sugadinti does not have time for a human like you. Besides, Roavar owes me a personal debt, and I do not intend any new laws to stop me from collecting it.

steps.speaker: Malak
steps.text: Now, tell me the reason you are here.

options.text: I am here to praise Lord Drakan

steps.player: I am here only to serve the mighty Drakan. Yup, Drakan, he's the man.

steps.text: If the player has completed Vampyre Slayer:

steps.speaker: Malak
steps.text: I see. I would perhaps be more inclined to believe you if I could not smell the death blood of his brother Draynor upon you.

steps.speaker: Malak
steps.text: What are you real intentions here?
If the player has not completed Vampyre Slayer:

steps.speaker: Malak
steps.text: Really? That is interesting, that you would want to give your life by tresspassing in this land for such an unbelievable reason.

steps.speaker: Malak
steps.text: Now speak, what is your purpose in coming here?

options.text: I am here to worship you, oh mighty Malak

steps.player: I came here looking for you, oh mighty Malak, so that I might serve your glory.

steps.speaker: Malak
steps.text: Please. Do not think that I am so vain and foolish as to allow you to avoid my question with such obvious sycophancy.

steps.speaker: Malak
steps.text: Now tell me the reason behind your being here, or I will ensure that you suffer.

options.text: I am here to kill Lord Drakan

steps.player: I am here to kill Lord Drakan, and every stinking one of his vampyre brood!

steps.speaker: Malak
steps.text: Hah! Most entertaining, human!

steps.speaker: Malak
steps.text: Now tell me the reason you are here, or we shall soon see who will be killing whom.

options.text: I am looking for a special Diamond...

steps.player: I am here looking for a special diamond... I have reason to believe it is somewhere in this vicinity, and it is probably in the possession of a warrior of Zamorak.
I'm fairly sure it will have some kind of magical aura or something too. I don't suppose you've seen it, or know where it might be?

steps.speaker: Malak
steps.text: Interesting... Well perhaps we can come to a little... arrangement, human.

steps.speaker: Malak
steps.text: I may have information that may assist you, but you in turn will have to do something for me. What do you say? Do you think we could come to some form of

steps.speaker: Malak
steps.text: agreement?

steps.player: Well, what kind of something? No offence, but you're not exactly the trustworthy type...

steps.speaker: Malak
steps.text: Ah, you have a healthy sense of paranoia, I see. It is not a particularly unfair request on my part...

steps.speaker: Malak
steps.text: All I ask is that you ensure that the current owner of the diamond is killed. For my part, I will let you know his whereabouts, and how exactly to kill him.

steps.speaker: Malak
steps.text: When he is dead, you may take the diamond from his corpse and do with it what you will. I have no interest in such baubles.

steps.speaker: Malak
steps.text: So what say you? A life for a diamond. As a mark of good faith, I will give you some information free:

steps.speaker: Malak
steps.text: The current owner of this diamond is named Dessous.

steps.prompt: Agree to this arrangement?

steps.player: Well... I can't see any drawback. Okay, I accept your offer. Now tell me what you know.

steps.speaker: Malak
steps.text: What I know? Hah! After you have been alive for as long as I, the things I know are enough to fill a library.

steps.speaker: Malak
steps.text: I'm afraid you will need to be a little more specific.

options.text: Why do you want Dessous dead?

steps.player: I don't see exactly how this bargain benefits you... Why exactly do you want Dessous killed anyway?

steps.speaker: Malak
steps.text: That is an impertinent question to demand from myself.

steps.speaker: Malak
steps.text: However, if it will help seal our deal, I will let you know some of the details.
If the player has not completed The Blood Moon Rises:

steps.speaker: Malak
steps.text: As you may or may not know, myself and my blood kin are the rulers of this land, all serving under Lord Drakan. However, we tend not to die of old age or similar

steps.speaker: Malak
steps.text: natural causes, which means that to gain another Lords tithe or land, there often need to be...
If the player has completed The Blood Moon Rises:

steps.speaker: Malak
steps.text: While there may have been some changes to things around here recently, myself and my blood kin are still the rulers of this land. However, we tend not to die of old age or similar

steps.speaker: Malak
steps.text: natural causes, which means that to gain another Lords title or land, there often need to be...

steps.speaker: Malak
steps.text: Unnatural causes of death involved. Let us just say, that Dessous is in control of some land that I myself would like some say in, and that it is not in my interest to be seen to be responsible for the

steps.speaker: Malak
steps.text: death of a fellow Lord.

steps.speaker: Malak
steps.text: It would however be extremely advantageous to myself should some random human adventurer take it upon themself to remove this rival for me... Do you understand?

steps.player: Yes... I think so...

steps.speaker: Malak
steps.text: Good, we understand each other then. We will both benefit from the death of Dessous.

steps.player: Where can I find this Dessous?

steps.speaker: Malak
steps.text: He currently resides in a graveyard to the South-East of here. You will not be able to move the gravestone which he lies beneath however, you will need to find some way to

steps.speaker: Malak
steps.text: lure him out from his tomb.

steps.player: And how exactly would I go about doing that?

steps.speaker: Malak
steps.text: Well, he is a vampyre, so fresh blood would almost certainly entice him out.

steps.speaker: Malak
steps.text: However, even though he is a frail and decrepit example of our species, he will be able to kill a weakling human such as yourself extremely easily. Having him in a bloodlust as he does so, will not make

steps.speaker: Malak
steps.text: your job any easier.

steps.player: So what advice can you give me on killing Dessous?

steps.speaker: Malak
steps.text: As ancient and weak as Dessous is, he is still more than a match for the likes of you.

steps.speaker: Malak
steps.text: That is, assuming you were to fight him fairly.

steps.speaker: Malak
steps.text: My proposal would be for you to even the odds up a little bit...

steps.player: How would I go about doing that?

steps.speaker: Malak
steps.text: Well, my plan would be as follows. First, take a silver bar to the man living in the sewers in Draynor. He was an assistant to Count Draynor in some of his...

steps.speaker: Malak
steps.text: more interesting experiments many years past. Tell him you need a sacrificial offering pot. He will know what you speak of, it is a unique type of container used in various ancient vampyric ceremonies.

steps.speaker: Malak
steps.text: Then take the pot to Entrana and get it blessed by the Head Monk. This will lend the pot some holy power.

steps.speaker: Malak
steps.text: If you then bring that silver pot back to me, I will provide you with some fresh blood, to put into it. To that pot of blood, you will add some crushed garlic, and some spice to disguise the smell.

steps.speaker: Malak
steps.text: Use that pot of blood upon Dessous' tomb, and he will be unable to resist rising and drinking from it.

steps.speaker: Malak
steps.text: The combination of garlic, silver, and blessings from Saradomin will act upon him as a poison, and allow you to kill him.

steps.speaker: Malak
steps.text: This is just my suggestion of course, you may ignore it if you wish, although I offer no guarantees of your ability to defeat him otherwise.

steps.speaker: Malak
steps.text: Was there anything else you wanted?

options.text: Actually, I don't need to know anything.

steps.player: Never mind, I will figure out all I need to know by myself.

steps.speaker: Malak
steps.text: As you wish. Come and see me when you have managed to kill Dessous.

steps.player: I don't trust you, or anything you say. I'm afraid I have to decline.

steps.speaker: Malak
steps.text: As you wish human. I doubt anybody near here knows of the diamond you seek, however.

steps.speaker: Malak
steps.text: If you wish to claim it as your own, you have little choice but to accept my bargain. I will wait here until such time as you change your mind.

blood-diamond-talking-to-malak-after-agr.speaker: Malak
blood-diamond-talking-to-malak-after-agr.text: Why are you still here? I notice Dessous still lives.

steps.player: Where can I find this Dessous?

steps.speaker: Malak
steps.text: He currently resides in a graveyard to the South-East of here. You will not be able to move the gravestone which he lies beneath however, you will need to find some way to

steps.speaker: Malak
steps.text: lure him out from his tomb.

steps.player: And how exactly would I go about doing that?

steps.speaker: Malak
steps.text: Come and see my when you have prepared a silver ritual pot in the manner I have told you.

steps.speaker: Malak
steps.text: I will ensure that you get some fresh blood that you may taint with garlic and spices, to lure our Dessous.

options.text: How do I kill Dessous again?

steps.player: How am I supposed to kill Dessous again?

steps.speaker: Malak
steps.text: Take a silver bar to the man in the Draynor sewers. He will fashion a ritualistic pot for you, which you should then take to Entrana and get blessed.

steps.speaker: Malak
steps.text: When you have done that, come back here and speak to me, I will provide you with some fresh blood which you will then crush some garlic into, and then add some spices to hide the garlic.

steps.speaker: Malak
steps.text: In this way, you will be able to lure him from his tomb and he should be sufficiently weakened to be vulnerable to your attacks.

options.text: Actually, I don't need to know anything.

blood-diamond-talking-to-ruantun.speaker: Ruantun
blood-diamond-talking-to-ruantun.text: You ssshould not be down here...

blood-diamond-talking-to-ruantun.player: Are you an assistant to Count Draynor?

blood-diamond-talking-to-ruantun.speaker: Ruantun
blood-diamond-talking-to-ruantun.text: I usssed to have that honour... Why do you ssseek me?
If the player has a silver bar.

steps.player: I have a silver bar with me, I was wondering if you could make it into a 'sacrificial offering pot' for me?

steps.speaker: Ruantun
steps.text: Yesss, of courssse... There you are, put it to good usssse...

blood-diamond-talking-to-ruantun.text: If the player doesn't have a silver bar.

steps.player: I understand that you can make me a 'sacrificial offering pot' if I bring you a bar of silver?

steps.speaker: Ruantun
steps.text: And where did you hear thisss?

steps.player: It was from Malak in Canifis.

steps.speaker: Ruantun
steps.text: Ah, I sssee... Yesss, I know how to make sssuch an item... It has been many yearsss sssince I have needed to however...

steps.speaker: Ruantun
steps.text: It is not my wisssh to quessstion your desssire for sssuch an item. I wasss merely sssurprisssed that one sssuch as you would make sssuch a requessst...

steps.speaker: Ruantun
steps.text: I will happily make you thisss pot, but you mussst bring me a bar of sssilver... Alasss, I can no longer collect my own ingredientsss, and mussst remain here...

blood-diamond-using-items-on-him.speaker: Ruantun
blood-diamond-using-items-on-him.text: I have no ussse for that...

blood-diamond-talking-to-the-high-priest.speaker: High Priest
blood-diamond-talking-to-the-high-priest.text: Many greetings. Welcome to our fair island.

blood-diamond-talking-to-the-high-priest.player: Hi, I was wondering, can you quickly bless this for me?

blood-diamond-talking-to-the-high-priest.speaker: High Priest
blood-diamond-talking-to-the-high-priest.text: A somewhat strange request, but I see no harm in it. There you go. May Saradomin walk with you.

blood-diamond-talking-to-the-high-priest.speaker: High Priest
blood-diamond-talking-to-the-high-priest.text: Many greetings. Welcome to our fair island.

blood-diamond-talking-to-the-high-priest.player: Hi, I was wondering, can you quickly bless this for me?

blood-diamond-talking-to-the-high-priest.speaker: High Priest
blood-diamond-talking-to-the-high-priest.text: A somewhat strange request, but I see no harm in... Wait a moment... is that BLOOD?

blood-diamond-talking-to-the-high-priest.speaker: High Priest
blood-diamond-talking-to-the-high-priest.text: Why do you want me to bless a pot full of someones blood???

blood-diamond-talking-to-the-high-priest.player: Oh, don't worry, it's not 'someones', it's my own!

blood-diamond-talking-to-the-high-priest.speaker: High Priest
blood-diamond-talking-to-the-high-priest.text: I... see... Well it is an unusual thing, but I see no harm in it. Take this, and walk in peace with Saradomin.

blood-diamond-talking-to-malak-with-the-.player: I found Ruantun in Draynors sewers. He made me this pot, now where can I get some fresh blood to fill it with?

blood-diamond-talking-to-malak-with-the-.text: Malak cuts you and pours some of your blood into the pot.

blood-diamond-talking-to-malak-with-the-.speaker: Malak
blood-diamond-talking-to-malak-with-the-.text: There you go. As fresh as it gets.

blood-diamond-talking-to-malak-with-the-.speaker: Malak
blood-diamond-talking-to-malak-with-the-.text: Come and speak to me again when you have managed to kill Dessous.

blood-diamond-adding-garlic-to-the-bless.text: You add some crushed garlic to the pot.

blood-diamond-adding-spices-to-the-bless.text: You add some spices to the pot.

blood-diamond-using-the-blessed-pot-on-d.text: You pour the blood from the pot onto the tomb.

blood-diamond-using-an-empty-blessed-pot.text: There is nothing in the pot to pour onto the grave.

blood-diamond-after-defeating-dessous.player: Well that's Dessous dead, but where is the Diamond he was supposed to have?
If Malak lied to me about it, he is going to pay!

blood-diamond-talking-to-malak-after-def.speaker: Malak
blood-diamond-talking-to-malak-after-def.text: Ah, the wandering hero returns! I take it you have dispatched poor old Dessous for me?

blood-diamond-talking-to-malak-after-def.player: Quit playing games with me, Malak. I want that diamond, and I want it now!

blood-diamond-talking-to-malak-after-def.speaker: Malak
blood-diamond-talking-to-malak-after-def.text: Do not take that tone of voice with me, meat. You should be thankful I have allowed you your life.

blood-diamond-talking-to-malak-after-def.speaker: Malak
blood-diamond-talking-to-malak-after-def.text: Here, take your precious little bauble.
If the player has not completed The Blood Moon Rises:

steps.speaker: Malak
steps.text: I will take that silver pot from you as well, humans are not meant to possess such artefacts. Now get out of my sight, our deal is complete, and if I see you here again I will not hesitate to take you to

steps.speaker: Malak
steps.text: Lord Drakan.

steps.speaker: Malak
steps.text: He will be extremely pleased to meet the murderer of poor Dessous, I suspect.

blood-diamond-talking-to-malak-after-def.text: If the player has completed The Blood Moon Rises:

steps.speaker: Malak
steps.text: I will take that silver pot from you as well, humans are not meant to possess such artefacts. Now get out of my sight, our deal is complete, and if I see you here again I will not hesitate to put an end to

steps.speaker: Malak
steps.text: you.

blood-diamond-talking-to-malak-after-obt.speaker: Malak
blood-diamond-talking-to-malak-after-obt.text: Be lucky I have let you live, meat. Our deal is done, I wish no further dealing with you.

blood-diamond-talking-to-malak-after-los.player: Where is the Diamond of Blood? I know you have it!

blood-diamond-talking-to-malak-after-los.speaker: Malak
blood-diamond-talking-to-malak-after-los.text: Do not take that tone of voice with me, meat. Here, take your bauble. I have no use for it.

ice-diamond-talking-to-the-troll-child.text: This troll seems very upset about something. Maybe some sweet food would take his mind off things?

ice-diamond-attempting-to-go-through-the.text: The bars are frozen tightly shut and a sturdy layer of ice prevents you from slipping through.

ice-diamond-giving-the-troll-child-an-it.text: It doesn't look like that will cheer him up at all...

ice-diamond-giving-the-troll-child-sweet.player: Hey there little troll... Take this and dry those tears...

ice-diamond-talking-to-the-troll-child-a.speaker: Troll child
ice-diamond-talking-to-the-troll-child-a.text: It was the bad man! He hurt my mommy and daddy! He made them all freezey!

ice-diamond-talking-to-the-troll-child-a.speaker: Troll child
ice-diamond-talking-to-the-troll-child-a.text: He said it was because they stole his diamond! But they never did! They found it, and didn't know who it belonged to!

ice-diamond-talking-to-the-troll-child-a.speaker: Troll child
ice-diamond-talking-to-the-troll-child-a.text: My mommy always told me stealing is wrong, they would never steal from someone!

ice-diamond-talking-to-the-troll-child-a.speaker: Troll child
ice-diamond-talking-to-the-troll-child-a.text: Then he did some wavey hand thing and my mommy and daddy got frozified!

ice-diamond-talking-to-the-troll-child-a.player: A diamond you say? Listen, I think I might be able to help your parents, but I need that Diamond in return.

ice-diamond-talking-to-the-troll-child-a.speaker: Troll child
ice-diamond-talking-to-the-troll-child-a.text: -sniff- I don't think they really wanted it anyway, they would have given it back to the bad man if he'd asked before freezifying them...

ice-diamond-talking-to-the-troll-child-a.speaker: Troll child
ice-diamond-talking-to-the-troll-child-a.text: I give you my promise, that if you unfreeze my mommy and daddy, you can have the stupid diamond.

steps.player: Absolutely. Don't worry kid, I'll get your parents back to you safe and sound.
Sorry, I can't make any promises about that, and I don't think I have the time to waste trying to defrost some stupid ice trolls.

steps.speaker: Troll child
steps.text: Waaaaaaa!

ice-diamond-talking-to-the-troll-child-a.speaker: Troll child
ice-diamond-talking-to-the-troll-child-a.text: You didn't free my mommy and daddy yet?

ice-diamond-talking-to-the-troll-child-a.speaker: Troll child
ice-diamond-talking-to-the-troll-child-a.text: Please try harder! I love my mommy and daddy!

ice-diamond-entering-the-ice-gate-for-th.speaker: Troll child
ice-diamond-entering-the-ice-gate-for-th.text: Oh, I'm sorry. My mommy says that we ice trolls are so cold we can freeze the air around us when we are upset or angry.

ice-diamond-entering-the-ice-gate-for-th.speaker: Troll child
ice-diamond-entering-the-ice-gate-for-th.text: I'm afraid I must have frozen those gates too much when I was crying, but since you told me you are going to help rescue my mommy and daddy you should be able to squeeze through the bars.

ice-diamond-entering-the-ice-gate-for-th.speaker: Troll child
ice-diamond-entering-the-ice-gate-for-th.text: You are much smaller than most trolls, it should be easy for you!

ice-diamond-entering-the-ice-gate.text: You squeeze through the large icy bars of the gate.

ice-diamond-talking-to-the-ice-troll-pas.speaker: Ice troll
ice-diamond-talking-to-the-ice-troll-pas.text: Hur hur hur! Well look here, a puny fleshy human!

ice-diamond-talking-to-the-ice-troll-pas.speaker: Ice troll
ice-diamond-talking-to-the-ice-troll-pas.text: You should beware of the icy wind that runs through this valley, it will bring a fleshy like you to a cold end indeed!

ice-diamond-trying-to-enter-the-cave.text: The entrance to the cave is covered in too much ice to get through.

ice-diamond-killing-an-ice-troll.text: A chunk of ice falls away from the cave entrance.

ice-diamond-after-defeating-kamil.player: Well, that must have been the 'bad man' that the troll kid was on about... His parents must be up ahead somewhere.

ice-diamond-trying-to-climb-the-ice-ledg.player: I don't think I'll make much headway along that icy slope without some spiked boots...

ice-diamond-passing-through-the-ice-gate.text: You Squeeze through the large icy bars of the gate.

ice-diamond-talking-to-a-frozen-troll.text: There is a thick layer of ice covering this troll. You will have to find some way of shattering it.

ice-diamond-talking-to-the-troll-father-.speaker: Troll father
ice-diamond-talking-to-the-troll-father-.text: Oh thank you! It was really cold in there! But please, you must free my wife as well! Our son is depending on us!

ice-diamond-talking-to-the-troll-mother-.speaker: Troll mother
ice-diamond-talking-to-the-troll-mother-.text: Wow, thanks for breaking me out of that ice! But please, my husband is still trapped in there!

ice-diamond-talking-to-the-troll-parents.speaker: Troll father
ice-diamond-talking-to-the-troll-parents.text: Phew! Am I glad to be out of that big ice cube! Are you okay too darling?

ice-diamond-talking-to-the-troll-parents.speaker: Troll mother
ice-diamond-talking-to-the-troll-parents.text: Yes, I thought we were done for! Why ever did that nasty Kamil freeze us up there anyway?

ice-diamond-talking-to-the-troll-parents.player: He must have been trying to protect his Diamond...

ice-diamond-talking-to-the-troll-parents.speaker: Troll father
ice-diamond-talking-to-the-troll-parents.text: You mean that diamond I found the other day belonged to him? But why didn't he just ask for it back? It's not like I really want it or anything!

ice-diamond-talking-to-the-troll-parents.speaker: Troll father
ice-diamond-talking-to-the-troll-parents.text: And how did you know we had that diamond anyway, fleshy?

ice-diamond-talking-to-the-troll-parents.player: Your son told me. That's why I rescued you, it is very important that I have that diamond...

ice-diamond-talking-to-the-troll-parents.speaker: Troll mother
ice-diamond-talking-to-the-troll-parents.text: Ooohhhhh, my poor baby! He must have been so worried about us...

ice-diamond-talking-to-the-troll-parents.speaker: Troll father
ice-diamond-talking-to-the-troll-parents.text: Yes, but he certainly inherited his Dad's smarts!

ice-diamond-talking-to-the-troll-parents.speaker: Troll father
ice-diamond-talking-to-the-troll-parents.text: If he'd told this fleshy that he had the Diamond and not us, we might never have been rescued!

ice-diamond-talking-to-the-troll-parents.player: Wait... what? That stupid little troll kid had the diamond all along?

ice-diamond-talking-to-the-troll-parents.speaker: Troll mother
ice-diamond-talking-to-the-troll-parents.text: Don't you talk about my baby like that!

ice-diamond-talking-to-the-troll-parents.speaker: Troll father
ice-diamond-talking-to-the-troll-parents.text: Now, now dear, all's well that ends well. We've been freed and this fleshy has certainly earned himself that diamond.

ice-diamond-talking-to-the-troll-parents.speaker: Troll father
ice-diamond-talking-to-the-troll-parents.text: Let's get out of this terrible place and see our son!

ice-diamond-talking-to-the-troll-parents.speaker: Troll father
ice-diamond-talking-to-the-troll-parents.text: That's right son, and it's all thanks to this brave adventurer here. Now, make sure you hand over that diamond he was looking for.

ice-diamond-talking-to-the-troll-parents.speaker: Troll father
ice-diamond-talking-to-the-troll-parents.text: It has been nothing but trouble for us, let's just get back to our cave and have dinner.

ice-diamond-talking-to-the-troll-parents.speaker: Troll mother
ice-diamond-talking-to-the-troll-parents.text: That's right son, it's your favorite tonight too! A big plate of raw mackerel!

ice-diamond-talking-to-the-troll-parents.speaker: Troll child
ice-diamond-talking-to-the-troll-parents.text: Here ya go! Thanks for getting my mom and dad away from the bad man!

ice-diamond-talking-to-the-troll-parents.player: Don't worry about it, just as long as I don't have to go back into that blizzard.

ice-diamond-talking-to-the-troll-father-.speaker: Troll father
ice-diamond-talking-to-the-troll-father-.text: Thanks again for freeing me from that ice block! I might be a troll, but it was real uncomfortable in there!

ice-diamond-talking-to-the-troll-mother-.speaker: Troll mother
ice-diamond-talking-to-the-troll-mother-.text: Thanks again for freeing me from that ice block! I don't know what my little snookums would have done without us!

ice-diamond-talking-to-the-troll-child-a.speaker: Troll child
ice-diamond-talking-to-the-troll-child-a.text: Thanks for all your help! I'm surprised you managed to survive the blizzard, being a thin skinned fleshy and all!

ice-diamond-talking-to-the-troll-child-a.player: What can I say? I'm a lot tougher than I look.
I lost that diamond of Ice you gave me...

ice-diamond-talking-to-the-troll-child-a.speaker: Troll child
ice-diamond-talking-to-the-troll-child-a.text: That's okay, it blew back on an icy wind... It's almost like it wants to stay here! Here, take it back, you've earned it.

the-ancient-pyramid-stranger-danger.speaker: Stranger
the-ancient-pyramid-stranger-danger.text: You are not worthy of holding that Diamond of [Blood/Shadow/Smoke/Ice]!

the-ancient-pyramid-upon-defeating-the-s.player: I wonder what that was all about?

the-ancient-pyramid-talking-to-eblis-wit.player: I have collected one Diamond so far!

the-ancient-pyramid-talking-to-eblis-wit.speaker: Eblis
the-ancient-pyramid-talking-to-eblis-wit.text: That is a good start... but Azzanadra is still imprisoned!

the-ancient-pyramid-talking-to-eblis-wit.player: So can you give me any help on where to find these warriors and their diamonds?
I have collected 2 Diamonds so far!

the-ancient-pyramid-talking-to-eblis-wit.speaker: Eblis
the-ancient-pyramid-talking-to-eblis-wit.text: That is a good start... but Azzanadra is still imprisoned!

the-ancient-pyramid-talking-to-eblis-wit.player: So can you give me any help on where to find these warriors and their diamonds?
I have collected 3 Diamonds so far!

the-ancient-pyramid-talking-to-eblis-wit.speaker: Eblis
the-ancient-pyramid-talking-to-eblis-wit.text: That is a good start... but Azzanadra is still imprisoned!

the-ancient-pyramid-talking-to-eblis-wit.player: So can you give me any help on where to find these warriors and their diamonds?
So I have all four of these Diamonds of Azzanadra, now what?

the-ancient-pyramid-talking-to-eblis-wit.speaker: Eblis
the-ancient-pyramid-talking-to-eblis-wit.text: Azzanadra was a Mahjarrat hero. He was unkillable, and the cowardly traitors who stole our lands did not know what to do with him, for his hatred for them was as strong as his magics.

the-ancient-pyramid-talking-to-eblis-wit.speaker: Eblis
the-ancient-pyramid-talking-to-eblis-wit.text: In the end, they cast a spell upon him, to trap him in the stone structure to the South of here.

the-ancient-pyramid-talking-to-eblis-wit.speaker: Eblis
the-ancient-pyramid-talking-to-eblis-wit.text: They stole his very life force, the essence of his power, and trapped it within four crystals - the very same Four Diamonds which you have now recovered from the brigands who stole from us.

the-ancient-pyramid-talking-to-eblis-wit.speaker: Eblis
the-ancient-pyramid-talking-to-eblis-wit.text: The four pillars surrounding the structure are keeping the containment spell intact. By placing a diamond into each, you will breach the magical defences and begin to restore Azzanadra's

the-ancient-pyramid-talking-to-eblis-wit.speaker: Eblis
the-ancient-pyramid-talking-to-eblis-wit.text: power, and be able to enter the structure.

the-ancient-pyramid-talking-to-eblis-wit.speaker: Eblis
the-ancient-pyramid-talking-to-eblis-wit.text: Go, place the diamonds, and free my lord Azzanadra!

the-ancient-pyramid-talking-to-eblis-wit.speaker: Eblis
the-ancient-pyramid-talking-to-eblis-wit.text: The path will be hard, for his prison is full of traps and danger to prevent his rescue, but he will reward you beyond your wildest dreams when freed!

the-ancient-pyramid-talking-to-eblis-wit.speaker: Eblis
the-ancient-pyramid-talking-to-eblis-wit.text: Quickly... After all these centuries, Lord Azzanadra is nearly free! You must spare no time, place the Diamonds upon the pillars and enter the pyramid so that you may free him!

the-ancient-pyramid-talking-to-asgarnia-.speaker: Asgarnia Smith
the-ancient-pyramid-talking-to-asgarnia-.text: Hello again. How's the treasure hunting going?

the-ancient-pyramid-talking-to-asgarnia-.speaker: Asgarnia Smith
the-ancient-pyramid-talking-to-asgarnia-.text: What? But you've been gone ages!

the-ancient-pyramid-talking-to-asgarnia-.speaker: Asgarnia Smith
the-ancient-pyramid-talking-to-asgarnia-.text: C'mon, you can be square with me, you must have found more treasure than just four measly diamonds by now!

the-ancient-pyramid-talking-to-asgarnia-.speaker: Asgarnia Smith
the-ancient-pyramid-talking-to-asgarnia-.text: Hmmm. Well, okay a deal is a deal. Hand two of them over.

the-ancient-pyramid-talking-to-asgarnia-.player: Actually, I think I'm going to need them to gain access to the real treasure...

the-ancient-pyramid-talking-to-asgarnia-.speaker: Asgarnia Smith
the-ancient-pyramid-talking-to-asgarnia-.text: Don't worry about two measly diamonds if you think they'll lead to something better!

the-ancient-pyramid-talking-to-asgarnia-.speaker: Asgarnia Smith
the-ancient-pyramid-talking-to-asgarnia-.text: I don't usually get out of bed for less than a hundred gold bars!

the-ancient-pyramid-attempting-to-replac.text: You are not a powerful enough mage to breach the protective aura.
You need a magic level of at least 50 to enter the Pyramid.

the-ancient-pyramid-replacing-the-diamon.text: The diamond is absorbed into the pillar...

steps.text: The force preventing access to the Pyramid has now vanished.

the-ancient-pyramid-trying-to-use-the-pa.text: This passage doesn't seem to lead anywhere...

the-ancient-pyramid-after-replacing-the-.player: I used the Four Diamonds on the pillars surrounding the pyramid...

the-ancient-pyramid-after-replacing-the-.speaker: Eblis
the-ancient-pyramid-after-replacing-the-.text: Ah, that was the power being re-absorbed back into them. That should have been sufficient to break the magic seal preventing anyone exiting or entering the structure.

the-ancient-pyramid-after-replacing-the-.speaker: Eblis
the-ancient-pyramid-after-replacing-the-.text: Quickly, you must let Lord Azzanadra know that he is free again after these many years!

the-ancient-pyramid-after-replacing-the-.speaker: Eblis
the-ancient-pyramid-after-replacing-the-.text: Please, when you have freed Azzanadra, let me know what words he has for his faithful followers...

the-ancient-pyramid-after-replacing-the-.speaker: Asgarnia Smith
the-ancient-pyramid-after-replacing-the-.text: Hello again, apprentice archaeologist. How's the treasure hunting going?

the-ancient-pyramid-after-replacing-the-.speaker: Asgarnia Smith
the-ancient-pyramid-after-replacing-the-.text: Great! Pass me my share, and it's a good job all around!

the-ancient-pyramid-after-replacing-the-.speaker: Asgarnia Smith
the-ancient-pyramid-after-replacing-the-.text: Huh? You're not trying to break a deal here are ya???

the-ancient-pyramid-after-replacing-the-.player: No, it's just... There were these weird pillars around this pyramid...
They kind of... ate the diamonds...

the-ancient-pyramid-after-replacing-the-.speaker: Asgarnia Smith
the-ancient-pyramid-after-replacing-the-.text: That's a crazy story kid. Why would you go putting diamonds into them in the first place anyway? Diamonds!

the-ancient-pyramid-after-replacing-the-.player: Well, I have this feeling there is some better treasure inside that pyramid, and I needed to put the diamonds in to gain entrance.

the-ancient-pyramid-after-replacing-the-.speaker: Asgarnia Smith
the-ancient-pyramid-after-replacing-the-.text: Well what are you wasting time talking to me for?

the-ancient-pyramid-after-replacing-the-.speaker: Asgarnia Smith
the-ancient-pyramid-after-replacing-the-.text: Go get me some treasure, pal!

the-ancient-pyramid-praying-at-the-altar.text: This altar seems to do nothing...

the-ancient-pyramid-talking-to-azzanadra.speaker: Azzanadra
the-ancient-pyramid-talking-to-azzanadra.text: I knew they could not trap me here for long! Well done, friend. Tell me, how goes the war?

the-ancient-pyramid-talking-to-azzanadra.speaker: Azzanadra
the-ancient-pyramid-talking-to-azzanadra.text: You do not know of the war for our survival? More time must have passed than I had thought...

the-ancient-pyramid-talking-to-azzanadra.speaker: Azzanadra
the-ancient-pyramid-talking-to-azzanadra.text: Tell me, what news of great Paddewwa? Do the shining spires of Lassar still stand? And what of glorious Annakarl? The fortress is still intact?

the-ancient-pyramid-talking-to-azzanadra.player: Er... sorry, I've never heard of them...

the-ancient-pyramid-talking-to-azzanadra.speaker: Azzanadra
the-ancient-pyramid-talking-to-azzanadra.text: No! My lord... what has become of you? I cannot hear your voice anymore!

the-ancient-pyramid-talking-to-azzanadra.speaker: Azzanadra
the-ancient-pyramid-talking-to-azzanadra.text: My thanks to you friend for your help in freeing me from this accursed place, but it seems I have much to do to make amends. If our empire no longer stands, it means that we must have failed my lord...

the-ancient-pyramid-talking-to-azzanadra.speaker: Azzanadra
the-ancient-pyramid-talking-to-azzanadra.text: How long have I been trapped here? Master... have you truly been dispatched from this world?

the-ancient-pyramid-talking-to-azzanadra.speaker: Azzanadra
the-ancient-pyramid-talking-to-azzanadra.text: My friend, for your efforts in freeing me, I offer you the gift of knowledge. We Mahjarrat were once granted powerful ancient magicks by our lord. I now bestow their power upon you.

the-ancient-pyramid-talking-to-azzanadra.speaker: Azzanadra
the-ancient-pyramid-talking-to-azzanadra.text: They will replace the knowledge you previously had, but you may switch between them by praying at the altar in this room at any time. May you use them well.

the-ancient-pyramid-talking-to-azzanadra.speaker: Azzanadra
the-ancient-pyramid-talking-to-azzanadra.text: I trust that we shall meet again, but now I must leave you. Feel free to use the portal I shall create to return here easily in the future!

the-ancient-pyramid-talking-to-azzanadra.player: I should go and let Eblis know what's happened here...

post-quest-eblis.speaker: Eblis
post-quest-eblis.text: So have you spoken to my Lord Azzanadra yet?

post-quest-eblis.speaker: Eblis
post-quest-eblis.text: And what words did he have for his followers?

post-quest-eblis.player: Er.... He didn't really mention you at all, but he did teach me some cool new magic spells.

post-quest-eblis.speaker: Eblis
post-quest-eblis.text: It is understandable perhaps... His poor mind must be addled after all of those years of confinement, he would not willingly ignore his followers...

post-quest-eblis.speaker: Eblis
post-quest-eblis.text: Anyway, if he has taught you our ancient magics, you may be interested in purchasing an ancient heirloom that was passed down to me. My ancestor fought in the ancient battles using the

post-quest-eblis.speaker: Eblis
post-quest-eblis.text: magic of our god. This heirloom will help you with the speed of your spell-casting.

post-quest-eblis.speaker: Eblis
post-quest-eblis.text: Normally I could not bear to part with such a priceless relic, but for your help in freeing my Lord Azzanadra, I will be prepared to sell it to you for a mere 80,000 gold.

steps.text: If the player has enough gold to purchase it:

steps.speaker: Eblis
steps.text: Take care of it, it is the only heirloom from those times I possess, although rumour has it many of our ancient warriors were buried with identical weapons so that they could continue to fight for my Lord in their deaths.
If the player doesn't have enough gold to purchase it:

steps.speaker: Eblis
steps.text: Stranger... Do not abuse my generosity... I cannot possibly sell it for less than 80,000 gold.

steps.speaker: Eblis
steps.text: Come back and see me when you have the necessary funds to buy.

steps.player: No thanks.

steps.speaker: Eblis
steps.text: As you wish. Bear my offer in mind should you ever change your decision, I will remain here.

options.text: Have you got any symbols of your god?

steps.player: I'll leave you to it.

options.text: Have you got any symbols of your god?

steps.player: Have you got any symbols of your god?

steps.text: Eblis gives you a little signet. Its shape matches the icon you saw on the altar in the pyramid.

post-quest-eblis-after-buying-his-staff.speaker: Eblis
post-quest-eblis-after-buying-his-staff.text: Greetings. I await the return of my Lord Azzanadra and of our god. I do not know why, but I feel this spot has some significance...

familiar-faces-inspecting-the-ancient-va.prompt: Start the Desert Treasure II - The Fallen Empire quest?

steps.text: (Continues with dialogue after starting the quest.)

options.quest: Desert Treasure II - The Fallen Empire

familiar-faces-inspecting-the-ancient-va.text: If the player is on the Ancient Magicks spellbook:

steps.text: You can feel the distinct energy of Ancient Magicks emanating from the door. You reach out and touch it. The symbol on the door starts to glow in response...
A cutscene begins. The player is inside the vault, and Asgarnia Smith appears, following the player inside.

steps.speaker: Asgarnia Smith
steps.text: I don't understand... How?
The cutscene ends.
(Continues with Asgarnia Smith dialogue.)

familiar-faces-inspecting-the-ancient-va.text: If the player is on another spellbook:

steps.text: You can feel the distinct energy of Ancient Magicks emanating from the door. You reach out and touch it, but nothing happens.

familiar-faces-talking-to-asgarnia-smith.player: Hey, I know you! You're that archaeologist! What was your name again...?

familiar-faces-talking-to-asgarnia-smith.speaker: Asgarnia Smith
familiar-faces-talking-to-asgarnia-smith.text: You don't remember my name?! You don't remember the world famous Asgarnia Smith, archaeologist extraordinaire?

familiar-faces-talking-to-asgarnia-smith.player: No... sorry. It's not a very memorable name.

familiar-faces-talking-to-asgarnia-smith.speaker: Asgarnia Smith
familiar-faces-talking-to-asgarnia-smith.text: All that work we did together, and you don't even remember my name.

familiar-faces-talking-to-asgarnia-smith.player: To be fair, we never really did that much work together. You sent me on a treasure hunt, but you never really contributed much yourself.

familiar-faces-talking-to-asgarnia-smith.speaker: Asgarnia Smith
familiar-faces-talking-to-asgarnia-smith.text: And a good job I didn't! I never saw a single ounce of gold from that partnership.

familiar-faces-talking-to-asgarnia-smith.player: Well if a partnership with me was so disappointing, how come you're here?

familiar-faces-talking-to-asgarnia-smith.speaker: Asgarnia Smith
familiar-faces-talking-to-asgarnia-smith.text: Bah, I'm not here for you, kid. I'm here for treasure!

familiar-faces-talking-to-asgarnia-smith.speaker: Asgarnia Smith
familiar-faces-talking-to-asgarnia-smith.text: After our last escapade turned out to be pointless, I set out in search of a new adventure! I started off on Karamja, but that didn't really go anywhere...

familiar-faces-talking-to-asgarnia-smith.speaker: Asgarnia Smith
familiar-faces-talking-to-asgarnia-smith.text: In the end, I came back to the desert and dug up this place! I've spent ages trying to work out how to get in, only for you to walk up and open the door right away!

familiar-faces-talking-to-asgarnia-smith.player: Yeah... funny that. They opened for me because of some magical abilities I gained on our last treasure hunt. You know, that one you were saying was pointless.

familiar-faces-talking-to-asgarnia-smith.speaker: Asgarnia Smith
familiar-faces-talking-to-asgarnia-smith.text: Huh... Well, who'd have thought...

familiar-faces-talking-to-asgarnia-smith.speaker: Asgarnia Smith
familiar-faces-talking-to-asgarnia-smith.text: Alright then, kid, I'll tell you what... You didn't find us any proper treasure last time around, so now's your chance to redeem yourself!

familiar-faces-talking-to-asgarnia-smith.speaker: Asgarnia Smith
familiar-faces-talking-to-asgarnia-smith.text: I'm sure this place is the key to finding riches beyond imagination, and I, Asgarnia Smith, am willing to enter into a partnership with you, er...

familiar-faces-talking-to-asgarnia-smith.player: You don't remember my name either, do you? It's [player name].

familiar-faces-talking-to-asgarnia-smith.speaker: Asgarnia Smith
familiar-faces-talking-to-asgarnia-smith.text: Yes, as I was saying, I, Asgarnia Smith, am willing to enter into a partnership with you, [player name], to uncover those riches!

familiar-faces-talking-to-asgarnia-smith.speaker: Asgarnia Smith
familiar-faces-talking-to-asgarnia-smith.text: Who knows, perhaps you'll even learn a thing or two from a master treasure hun- I mean, a master archaeologist like me.

familiar-faces-talking-to-asgarnia-smith.speaker: Asgarnia Smith
familiar-faces-talking-to-asgarnia-smith.text: And I am willing to offer you an exclusive rate of a forty percent split!

familiar-faces-talking-to-asgarnia-smith.player: Fifty percent.

familiar-faces-talking-to-asgarnia-smith.speaker: Asgarnia Smith
familiar-faces-talking-to-asgarnia-smith.text: Absolutely! A forty-five percent split! So, kid, what do you say?

familiar-faces-talking-to-asgarnia-smith.player: How about I look around while I think about it?

familiar-faces-talking-to-asgarnia-smith.speaker: Asgarnia Smith
familiar-faces-talking-to-asgarnia-smith.text: Of course!

familiar-faces-talking-to-asgarnia-smith.speaker: Asgarnia Smith
familiar-faces-talking-to-asgarnia-smith.text: Well, kid, any thoughts on my offer?

familiar-faces-talking-to-asgarnia-smith.player: I'm still looking around. I'll decide once I know a bit more about what this place is.

familiar-faces-talking-to-asgarnia-smith.speaker: Asgarnia Smith
familiar-faces-talking-to-asgarnia-smith.text: Of course! Take as much time as you need, as long as you don't take long.

familiar-faces-talking-to-asgarnia-smith.player: Right...

familiar-faces-talking-to-asgarnia-smith.speaker: Asgarnia Smith
familiar-faces-talking-to-asgarnia-smith.text: Well, kid, any thoughts on my offer?

familiar-faces-talking-to-asgarnia-smith.player: Do you not want to hear about what I've found first?

familiar-faces-talking-to-asgarnia-smith.speaker: Asgarnia Smith
familiar-faces-talking-to-asgarnia-smith.text: Oh, yes, go ahead!

familiar-faces-talking-to-asgarnia-smith.player: According to that plaque over there, this place is a vault that was built to protect the 'mighty treasures' of the 'Empty Lord' from 'the soulless betrayers'.

familiar-faces-talking-to-asgarnia-smith.speaker: Asgarnia Smith
familiar-faces-talking-to-asgarnia-smith.text: Mighty treasures, you say? Fantastic! Any idea how to access them?

familiar-faces-talking-to-asgarnia-smith.player: I'm guessing it has something to do with these statues. It looks like each of them is meant to be holding something.

familiar-faces-talking-to-asgarnia-smith.speaker: Asgarnia Smith
familiar-faces-talking-to-asgarnia-smith.text: Ah, so we need to find whatever it is they should be holding. Classic treasure vault puzzle! Where do you plan to start?

familiar-faces-talking-to-asgarnia-smith.player: Well hang on there. I haven't actually agreed to anything yet.

familiar-faces-talking-to-asgarnia-smith.speaker: Asgarnia Smith
familiar-faces-talking-to-asgarnia-smith.text: But surely you can't turn down an opportunity like this! You said it yourself: Mighty treasures!

familiar-faces-talking-to-asgarnia-smith.player: Mighty treasures that we can't access.

familiar-faces-talking-to-asgarnia-smith.speaker: Asgarnia Smith
familiar-faces-talking-to-asgarnia-smith.text: Now look here, kid. You won't get far in life with an attitude like that. Is there really nothing else we have to go on?

familiar-faces-talking-to-asgarnia-smith.player: We have four names: Vardorvis, Perseriya, Duke Sucellus and the Whisperer.

familiar-faces-talking-to-asgarnia-smith.speaker: Asgarnia Smith
familiar-faces-talking-to-asgarnia-smith.text: They sound like pretty solid leads to me. If we can find these four individuals, maybe we can also find whatever it is we need to get to the treasure.

familiar-faces-talking-to-asgarnia-smith.player: That's a big 'if' right there. This vault is clearly Zarosian, which means whoever these four are, they're from thousands of years ago. They're probably all long- dead now.

familiar-faces-talking-to-asgarnia-smith.speaker: Asgarnia Smith
familiar-faces-talking-to-asgarnia-smith.text: Zarosian? I'm sure I've heard that term before...

familiar-faces-talking-to-asgarnia-smith.speaker: Asgarnia Smith
familiar-faces-talking-to-asgarnia-smith.text: Ah yes! Those recent discoveries at the Digsite! I bet my good friend Terry Balando can help. Why don't you talk to him?

familiar-faces-talking-to-asgarnia-smith.player: Again, I've not actually agreed to help.

familiar-faces-talking-to-asgarnia-smith.speaker: Asgarnia Smith
familiar-faces-talking-to-asgarnia-smith.text: No, but you're going to. I can tell. The thrill of the adventure is too much to resist. Not to mention that thirty percent split!

familiar-faces-talking-to-asgarnia-smith.player: Fifty percent.

familiar-faces-talking-to-asgarnia-smith.speaker: Asgarnia Smith
familiar-faces-talking-to-asgarnia-smith.text: So we're agreed? Excellent! You'll find Terry at the Digsite Exam Centre. Good luck!

familiar-faces-talking-to-asgarnia-smith.player: sigh*

familiar-faces-talking-to-asgarnia-smith.speaker: Asgarnia Smith
familiar-faces-talking-to-asgarnia-smith.text: Good to see you, kid. Did you speak to Terry Balando?

familiar-faces-talking-to-asgarnia-smith.player: You know I still haven't agreed to help you, right?

familiar-faces-talking-to-asgarnia-smith.speaker: Asgarnia Smith
familiar-faces-talking-to-asgarnia-smith.text: You'll find Terry at the Digsite Exam Centre. You'd best get going. There's treasure to uncover!

familiar-faces-talking-to-asgarnia-smith.player: sigh*

familiar-faces-talking-to-terry-balando.speaker: Terry Balando
familiar-faces-talking-to-terry-balando.text: Hello again. How goes the archaeology?

familiar-faces-talking-to-terry-balando.player: Pretty good, thanks. In fact, I've come across something I was hoping you could help me with.
I came across something very interesting down in the desert: A Zarosian vault.

familiar-faces-talking-to-terry-balando.speaker: Terry Balando
familiar-faces-talking-to-terry-balando.text: Zarosian? Like that artefact you found for us?

familiar-faces-talking-to-terry-balando.player: Exactly! I'm hoping to learn about four names I discovered on statues within the vault.

familiar-faces-talking-to-terry-balando.speaker: Terry Balando
familiar-faces-talking-to-terry-balando.text: Sounds like an exciting discovery, but I'm afraid I can't help. This 'Zaros' is still mostly a mystery to me. In fact, I'd say you probably know more than I do!

familiar-faces-talking-to-terry-balando.speaker: Terry Balando
familiar-faces-talking-to-terry-balando.text: Well you may well be in luck. We had a new arrival at the Digsite recently who claims to be a Zarosian expert!

familiar-faces-talking-to-terry-balando.speaker: Terry Balando
familiar-faces-talking-to-terry-balando.text: Quite impressive for one of those to exist considering the greatest historians and archaeologists in the world has no knowledge on Zaros until very recently...

familiar-faces-talking-to-terry-balando.player: Interesting... Where can I find this expert?

familiar-faces-talking-to-terry-balando.speaker: Terry Balando
familiar-faces-talking-to-terry-balando.text: He's set up a new dig on the eastern edge of the Digsite. You're looking for... Ah, what was his name again...

familiar-faces-talking-to-terry-balando.speaker: Terry Balando
familiar-faces-talking-to-terry-balando.text: Banikan! You'll be wanting to speak to Dr Banikan!

familiar-faces-talking-to-terry-balando.player: Great! I'll head over there and see if I can find him.

familiar-faces-talking-to-terry-balando-.speaker: Terry Balando
familiar-faces-talking-to-terry-balando-.text: Hello again. Did you speak to Dr Banikan?

familiar-faces-talking-to-terry-balando-.speaker: Terry Balando
familiar-faces-talking-to-terry-balando-.text: He's set up a new dig on the eastern edge of the Digsite. You'll likely find him there.

familiar-faces-talking-to-terry-balando-.speaker: Terry Balando
familiar-faces-talking-to-terry-balando-.text: Hello again. How goes the archaeology?

familiar-faces-attempting-to-visit-the-n.text: You haven't been given permission to use that.

familiar-faces-talking-to-dr-banikan.speaker: Dr Banikan
familiar-faces-talking-to-dr-banikan.text: Oh... Good day, adventurer.

familiar-faces-talking-to-dr-banikan.speaker: Dr Banikan
familiar-faces-talking-to-dr-banikan.text: Banikan? Yes... I am Banikan.

familiar-faces-talking-to-dr-banikan.player: Are you sure? You don't seem very sure...

familiar-faces-talking-to-dr-banikan.speaker: Dr Banikan
familiar-faces-talking-to-dr-banikan.text: My apologies. I was not expecting company down here, so you caught me a bit off guard.

familiar-faces-talking-to-dr-banikan.player: Hmm... We haven't met before, have we? You seem familiar.

familiar-faces-talking-to-dr-banikan.speaker: Dr Banikan
familiar-faces-talking-to-dr-banikan.text: I don't believe so.

familiar-faces-talking-to-dr-banikan.speaker: Dr Banikan
familiar-faces-talking-to-dr-banikan.text: So tell me, adventurer, what brings you down here?

familiar-faces-talking-to-dr-banikan.player: I've been told you're a Zarosian expert. I was hoping you could help me with some names.

familiar-faces-talking-to-dr-banikan.speaker: Dr Banikan
familiar-faces-talking-to-dr-banikan.text: Names? What names?

familiar-faces-talking-to-dr-banikan.player: Vardorvis, Perseriya, Duke Sucellus and the Whisperer. I believe they were all Zarosians.

familiar-faces-talking-to-dr-banikan.speaker: Dr Banikan
familiar-faces-talking-to-dr-banikan.text: Where did you hear these names?

familiar-faces-talking-to-dr-banikan.player: I found a strange vault down in the desert, on the eastern coast. The names were on four statues inside.

familiar-faces-talking-to-dr-banikan.speaker: Dr Banikan
familiar-faces-talking-to-dr-banikan.text: A Zarosian vault? How curious...

familiar-faces-talking-to-dr-banikan.speaker: Dr Banikan
familiar-faces-talking-to-dr-banikan.text: I think so. I suspect the information you seek can be found in the very place I'm searching for.

familiar-faces-talking-to-dr-banikan.speaker: Dr Banikan
familiar-faces-talking-to-dr-banikan.text: You seem to be fairly knowledgeable when it comes to the Zarosian Empire, which is quite a rarity these days. How much do you know about its fall?

familiar-faces-talking-to-dr-banikan.player: I know that Zaros was overthrown by one of his most trusted generals, Zamorak, who became a god as a result.

familiar-faces-talking-to-dr-banikan.speaker: Dr Banikan
familiar-faces-talking-to-dr-banikan.text: Spot on! You could teach the so-called experts around here a thing or two. The betrayal of Zaros ultimately led to the God Wars, making it quite possibly the most pivotal moment in all of history.

familiar-faces-talking-to-dr-banikan.speaker: Dr Banikan
familiar-faces-talking-to-dr-banikan.text: However, even to those of us who do know our stuff, much of what happened to the empire following Zaros' defeat is still a mystery. That's why I'm here.

familiar-faces-talking-to-dr-banikan.speaker: Dr Banikan
familiar-faces-talking-to-dr-banikan.text: Senntisten, the Zarosian settlement once located here, was believed to be the capital of the empire.

familiar-faces-talking-to-dr-banikan.speaker: Dr Banikan
familiar-faces-talking-to-dr-banikan.text: If my research is right, and I have strong reason to believe it is, the remains of a key military installation are located right beneath us.

familiar-faces-talking-to-dr-banikan.speaker: Dr Banikan
familiar-faces-talking-to-dr-banikan.text: I can definitely think of worse places to discover details on the fall of the empire.

familiar-faces-talking-to-dr-banikan.player: And you think this military installation could have information on the four names I found?

familiar-faces-talking-to-dr-banikan.speaker: Dr Banikan
familiar-faces-talking-to-dr-banikan.text: Absolutely! Any respectable military outpost would have been filled to the brim with key strategic intelligence. I'd expect details on notable Zarosians to be included.

familiar-faces-talking-to-dr-banikan.speaker: Dr Banikan
familiar-faces-talking-to-dr-banikan.text: Of course, they wouldn't have wanted that information falling into the wrong hands, so recovering it may not be straightforward...

familiar-faces-talking-to-dr-banikan.player: Well I do love a good challenge.

familiar-faces-talking-to-dr-banikan.speaker: Dr Banikan
familiar-faces-talking-to-dr-banikan.text: Glad to hear it. Now, I have made good progress in excavating these ruins so far, but perhaps you can help me with the final step?

familiar-faces-talking-to-dr-banikan.player: Sounds like something I'd be good at! What do you need me to blow up?

familiar-faces-talking-to-dr-banikan.speaker: Dr Banikan
familiar-faces-talking-to-dr-banikan.text: Excuse me?

familiar-faces-talking-to-dr-banikan.player: Well, my first major discovery here involved me blowing a big hole in some rocks to access an ancient temple. Shouldn't be too hard to do that again.

familiar-faces-talking-to-dr-banikan.speaker: Dr Banikan
familiar-faces-talking-to-dr-banikan.text: I'm sorry, what?

familiar-faces-talking-to-dr-banikan.speaker: Dr Banikan
familiar-faces-talking-to-dr-banikan.text: You risked the structural integrity of an ancient temple by blowing it open with explosives?!

familiar-faces-talking-to-dr-banikan.player: Huh... I guess I never thought about it like that before. Yeah... now that you mention it, that was really quite a stupid idea.

familiar-faces-talking-to-dr-banikan.speaker: Dr Banikan
familiar-faces-talking-to-dr-banikan.text: How about we take just a touch more care with this one?

familiar-faces-talking-to-dr-banikan.player: Good idea. What do you need me to do?

familiar-faces-talking-to-dr-banikan.speaker: Dr Banikan
familiar-faces-talking-to-dr-banikan.text: Grab yourself a pickaxe and carefully clear away these rocks. There should be a pickaxe in the crate in the corner.

options.text: So how come you know so much about Zaros?

steps.player: So how come you know so much about Zaros?

steps.speaker: Dr Banikan
steps.text: Well... in my travels, I ended up spending a great deal of time in one of the few places Zarosian remnants can still be found. My time studying them filled me with fascination, and sadness.

steps.player: Sadness?

steps.speaker: Dr Banikan
steps.text: 'I walked across the sands and saw the ruins of time...'

steps.player: What?

steps.speaker: Dr Banikan
steps.text: It's an old poem about the rise, and inevitable fall, of kingdoms and empires. Once, Zaros' Empire stretched as far as the eye could see. Now, no one even remembers his name.

steps.speaker: Dr Banikan
steps.text: To think that something that was once so absolute may soon be lost forever... It falls to people like me, and perhaps you as well, to ensure that history isn't forgotten.

options.text: What is it you're searching for here?

steps.player: What is it you're searching for here?

steps.speaker: Dr Banikan
steps.text: As I said, I hope to find details about the fall of the Zarosian Empire.

steps.player: Anything in particular though?

steps.speaker: Dr Banikan
steps.text: I have a few leads. Details on individuals and artefacts that may have played a key role in the final days of the Empire.

steps.player: Do you think my four names could be connected?

steps.speaker: Dr Banikan
steps.text: I'd say it's definitely possible. I suppose there's only one way to find out.

steps.player: I'd best get to work.

familiar-faces-entering-the-military-ins.player: It was some sort of ancient golem. I'm guessing it was here to guard the place. Don't worry, I dealt with it.

familiar-faces-entering-the-military-ins.speaker: Dr Banikan

familiar-faces-entering-the-military-ins.player: It's kind of what I do.

familiar-faces-entering-the-military-ins.speaker: Dr Banikan

familiar-faces-entering-the-military-ins.speaker: Dr Banikan
familiar-faces-entering-the-military-ins.text: And on that note, we should take a look around.

familiar-faces-entering-the-military-ins.speaker: Dr Banikan

steps.speaker: Elissa
steps.text: That's right. Why do you ask?

steps.player: I'm trying to learn more about a vampyre called Vardorvis. Apparently he travelled to the west long ago in pursuit of someone called Yonrith Lovakengj.

steps.speaker: Elissa
steps.text: A vampyre? This must have been a very long time ago.

steps.player: Back when Senntisten still stood, it seems.

steps.speaker: Elissa
steps.text: Oh wow, that is a long time! You're talking about a time before Great Kourend even existed!

steps.player: Indeed. I was wondering if during your travels there, you came across any details about Vardorvis or Yonrith?

steps.speaker: Elissa
steps.text: Hmm... You say this vampyre was in pursuit of Yonrith?

steps.player: That's right.

steps.speaker: Elissa
steps.text: Well... it could be nothing, but there's this monument in Lovakengj called the Burning Man. Apparently, it represents the defeat of an ancient evil. Could be a good place to start?

steps.player: Definitely sounds worth a look.

steps.speaker: Elissa
steps.text: You'll find it in western Lovakengj. It's pretty hard to miss!

steps.player: Great! Thanks for the help.

options.text: I hear you visited Lovakengj recently.

steps.player: I hear you visited Lovakengj recently.

steps.speaker: Elissa
steps.text: We've had this conversation before, haven't we? If I were you, I'd check out the Burning Man monument in western Lovakengj. Apparently it represents the defeat of an ancient evil.

steps.player: Great! Thanks for the help.

carnifex-maximus-vardorvis-talking-to-ba.speaker: Barus
carnifex-maximus-vardorvis-talking-to-ba.text: Hello! Here to see the Burning Man?

carnifex-maximus-vardorvis-talking-to-ba.speaker: Barus
carnifex-maximus-vardorvis-talking-to-ba.text: Well you picked a great day for it! The name's Barus by the way. I work as a historian here. Those Arceuus lot may think they know it all, but I reckon I could tell you a thing or two that even they haven't realised!

carnifex-maximus-vardorvis-talking-to-ba.player: Well on that note, what can you tell me about the Burning Man?

carnifex-maximus-vardorvis-talking-to-ba.speaker: Barus
carnifex-maximus-vardorvis-talking-to-ba.text: The Burning Man is a monument to a great triumph in Lovakengj history. We're talking thousands of years ago, before Kourend was even a kingdom! Sadly, that does mean some details have been lost to time.

carnifex-maximus-vardorvis-talking-to-ba.speaker: Barus
carnifex-maximus-vardorvis-talking-to-ba.text: What we do know is that a great evil threatened the earliest dwarven settlers here. Had that evil prevailed, Lovakengj might never have existed!

carnifex-maximus-vardorvis-talking-to-ba.speaker: Barus
carnifex-maximus-vardorvis-talking-to-ba.text: Thankfully, with guidance from their brave leader, the settlers were able to overcome this evil! The Burning Man is a reminder of that.

carnifex-maximus-vardorvis-talking-to-ba.player: So I'm guessing the monument represents this evil?
But what was it, and where did it come from?

carnifex-maximus-vardorvis-talking-to-ba.speaker: Barus
carnifex-maximus-vardorvis-talking-to-ba.text: Ah, now that bit is less clear. Have you heard of the Stranglewood?

carnifex-maximus-vardorvis-talking-to-ba.speaker: Barus
carnifex-maximus-vardorvis-talking-to-ba.text: Not too surprising. It's not a place you'd want to visit. Anyway, that's supposedly where this evil emerged from.

carnifex-maximus-vardorvis-talking-to-ba.player: I see. What can you tell me about the Stranglewood?

carnifex-maximus-vardorvis-talking-to-ba.speaker: Barus
carnifex-maximus-vardorvis-talking-to-ba.text: You'll find it on the border between the Kebos Lowlands and the Kingdom of Varlamore. It's a cursed place. Few have ever entered, and of those that have, none have returned!

carnifex-maximus-vardorvis-talking-to-ba.speaker: Barus
carnifex-maximus-vardorvis-talking-to-ba.text: You know, I heard some chap from Hosidius went missing not too long ago. They reckon he went exploring the Stranglewood. Poor guy.

carnifex-maximus-vardorvis-talking-to-ba.speaker: Barus
carnifex-maximus-vardorvis-talking-to-ba.text: Some botanist I think. His name escapes me, but I think he lived just south of the Hosidius Estate Agent.

carnifex-maximus-vardorvis-talking-to-ba.player: Interesting... Thanks for all the information.
Hello! Where did you say that botanist lived?

carnifex-maximus-vardorvis-talking-to-ba.speaker: Barus
carnifex-maximus-vardorvis-talking-to-ba.text: If I remember right, he lived just south of the Hosidius Estate Agent.

carnifex-maximus-vardorvis-searching-the.text: You find a note and a potion in the desk.
If the player has both the note and the potion

steps.text: You search the desk, but find nothing of interest.

carnifex-maximus-vardorvis-searching-the.text: If the player has only the note but not the potion

steps.text: You find a potion in the desk.

carnifex-maximus-vardorvis-searching-the.text: If the player has only the potion but not the note

steps.text: You find a potion in the desk.

carnifex-maximus-vardorvis-attempting-to.player: I probably shouldn't just go drinking random potions without knowing what they are.

carnifex-maximus-vardorvis-boarding-the-.player: This Stranglewood place is supposed to be really dangerous. I should probably get myself some sort of protection before heading there.

carnifex-maximus-vardorvis-boarding-the-.text: You have no reason to use this boat.

carnifex-maximus-vardorvis-travelling-to.text: The screen fades to black and "THE STRANGLEWOOD" is displayed in white.

carnifex-maximus-vardorvis-entering-the-.text: A cutscene begins in which the player enters the ruins of the Stranglewood, and encounters a horde of strangled.

carnifex-maximus-vardorvis-entering-the-.player: I'm just going to quietly go over here now.

carnifex-maximus-vardorvis-entering-the-.text: The player walks towards the nearest building, stepping on a tendril which goes crunch* and climbing over a barricade.
A disheveled man named Kasonde will walk towards you.

carnifex-maximus-vardorvis-entering-the-.speaker: Kasonde
carnifex-maximus-vardorvis-entering-the-.text: And who on Gielinor are you?

carnifex-maximus-vardorvis-talking-to-ka.speaker: Kasonde
carnifex-maximus-vardorvis-talking-to-ka.text: Well? Who are you?

carnifex-maximus-vardorvis-talking-to-ka.speaker: Kasonde
carnifex-maximus-vardorvis-talking-to-ka.text: I think you already know the answer to that.

carnifex-maximus-vardorvis-talking-to-ka.speaker: Kasonde
carnifex-maximus-vardorvis-talking-to-ka.text: Shaw. Kasonde Shaw. Don't go acting like you haven't been following me for some time now.

carnifex-maximus-vardorvis-talking-to-ka.player: Ah, of course. Those old ruins.

carnifex-maximus-vardorvis-talking-to-ka.speaker: Kasonde
carnifex-maximus-vardorvis-talking-to-ka.text: Exactly. Perhaps you took me for a fool, but I was on to you from the start. Considering what we learnt, I knew it was only a matter of time before you showed up.

carnifex-maximus-vardorvis-talking-to-ka.player: You mean soul transference? Not actually something that interests me, to be honest.

carnifex-maximus-vardorvis-talking-to-ka.speaker: Kasonde
carnifex-maximus-vardorvis-talking-to-ka.text: Don't take me for a fool! If you had no interest in the Old Ones' secrets, why would you have followed me to those ruins? And why would you have come here?

carnifex-maximus-vardorvis-talking-to-ka.player: To be honest, I didn't even know what an Old One was. I still don't really. I was just exploring when I found your camp.
As for why I'm here, I'm looking for information about someone called Vardorvis.

carnifex-maximus-vardorvis-talking-to-ka.speaker: Kasonde
carnifex-maximus-vardorvis-talking-to-ka.text: Really? You want me to believe that all of this is a coincidence?

carnifex-maximus-vardorvis-talking-to-ka.speaker: Kasonde
carnifex-maximus-vardorvis-talking-to-ka.text: You're lying! You're lying and...

carnifex-maximus-vardorvis-talking-to-ka.speaker: Kasonde
carnifex-maximus-vardorvis-talking-to-ka.text: Hang on... do you hear that?

carnifex-maximus-vardorvis-talking-to-ka.speaker: Kasonde
carnifex-maximus-vardorvis-talking-to-ka.text: The Strangled! Did you disturb any tendrils on your way in here?

carnifex-maximus-vardorvis-talking-to-ka.speaker: Kasonde
carnifex-maximus-vardorvis-talking-to-ka.text: They'll be coming. We've got no chance up here. Head down below! Now!

carnifex-maximus-vardorvis-talking-to-ka.speaker: Kasonde
carnifex-maximus-vardorvis-talking-to-ka.text: What are you waiting for? They're coming! Quick, head down below!

carnifex-maximus-vardorvis-the-strangled.text: If strangled are coming from the north east
If strangled are coming from the north west
If strangled are coming from the south east
If strangled are coming from the south west

carnifex-maximus-vardorvis-the-strangled.speaker: Kasonde
carnifex-maximus-vardorvis-the-strangled.text: They seem to be running out of steam! Let's head back up.
The Strangled horde begins to retreat...
You failed to keep Kasonde alive

carnifex-maximus-vardorvis-talking-to-ka.speaker: Kasonde
carnifex-maximus-vardorvis-talking-to-ka.text: That's the lot of them. Let's head back up.

carnifex-maximus-vardorvis-talking-to-ka.speaker: Kasonde
carnifex-maximus-vardorvis-talking-to-ka.text: That was too close. You nearly got us both killed!

carnifex-maximus-vardorvis-talking-to-ka.player: I don't understand... What are those things? Are they zombies?

carnifex-maximus-vardorvis-talking-to-ka.speaker: Kasonde
carnifex-maximus-vardorvis-talking-to-ka.text: You really want me to believe that you don't know anything about this place?

carnifex-maximus-vardorvis-talking-to-ka.player: I already told you, I wasn't lying.

carnifex-maximus-vardorvis-talking-to-ka.speaker: Kasonde
carnifex-maximus-vardorvis-talking-to-ka.text: Well I don't have any reason to trust that.

carnifex-maximus-vardorvis-talking-to-ka.player: With how dangerous this place is, do you really have a choice?

carnifex-maximus-vardorvis-talking-to-ka.speaker: Kasonde
carnifex-maximus-vardorvis-talking-to-ka.text: Hmm...

carnifex-maximus-vardorvis-talking-to-ka.speaker: Kasonde
carnifex-maximus-vardorvis-talking-to-ka.text: Alright, fine. But I have no desire to see you get us killed, so you'd better wisen up fast.

carnifex-maximus-vardorvis-talking-to-ka.speaker: Kasonde
carnifex-maximus-vardorvis-talking-to-ka.text: It all starts with the Old Ones. They lived here long before humans came to these lands, and these ruins here were once their home.

carnifex-maximus-vardorvis-talking-to-ka.player: And these Old Ones discovered soul transference?

carnifex-maximus-vardorvis-talking-to-ka.speaker: Kasonde
carnifex-maximus-vardorvis-talking-to-ka.text: They did, and they did so long before House Arceuus even existed. It was their final attempt to overcome their extinction, but they failed.

carnifex-maximus-vardorvis-talking-to-ka.speaker: Kasonde
carnifex-maximus-vardorvis-talking-to-ka.text: What you see around you is the result of their failure. It's known as the Strangler.

carnifex-maximus-vardorvis-talking-to-ka.speaker: Kasonde
carnifex-maximus-vardorvis-talking-to-ka.text: It's some sort of parasite. It was presumably meant to play a role in their transference rituals, but instead it destroyed them. It has remained here ever since.

carnifex-maximus-vardorvis-talking-to-ka.speaker: Kasonde
carnifex-maximus-vardorvis-talking-to-ka.text: Exactly. Plenty of unwary fools have fallen victim to the Strangler. If you don't take care, you will share their fate.

carnifex-maximus-vardorvis-talking-to-ka.player: So how do we deal with them?

carnifex-maximus-vardorvis-talking-to-ka.speaker: Kasonde
carnifex-maximus-vardorvis-talking-to-ka.text: The trick is to maintain your distance. They're relatively passive unless you get too close, but if you disturb one, the rest will quickly come running.

carnifex-maximus-vardorvis-talking-to-ka.speaker: Kasonde
carnifex-maximus-vardorvis-talking-to-ka.text: If you need to fight one, try to do it away from the rest!

carnifex-maximus-vardorvis-talking-to-ka.speaker: Kasonde
carnifex-maximus-vardorvis-talking-to-ka.text: And stay off of the tendrils! You'll alert the lot of them to your location! It's like a network.

carnifex-maximus-vardorvis-talking-to-ka.player: Keep my distance and stay off the tendrils. I can do that. So what's our next move?

carnifex-maximus-vardorvis-talking-to-ka.speaker: Kasonde
carnifex-maximus-vardorvis-talking-to-ka.text: The fact that you're still alive tells me you broke into my home and stole some of the potion I made.
