joining-the-carnillean-side-talking-to-c.speaker: Ceril Carnillean
joining-the-carnillean-side-talking-to-c.text: SIR Ceril to you. But good work there! BLOOMING good work! Hand over the armour then.

joining-the-carnillean-side-talking-to-c.player: Uh... yeah... about that... I interrogated a cult member at the hideout's entrance, but he managed to escape into the sewer system.
Seems they have some sort of grievance against you and your family. Something about some guy called Hazeel?

joining-the-carnillean-side-talking-to-c.speaker: Ceril Carnillean
joining-the-carnillean-side-talking-to-c.text: Nope, they're obviously a bunch of blooming loonies! Go find them and bring me back my blooming armour! Nobody steals from Sir Ceril Carnillean!!!

joining-the-carnillean-side-talking-to-h.speaker: Henryeta Carnillean
joining-the-carnillean-side-talking-to-h.text: I hope you found those awful hooligan cultists! I simply cannot sleep at night knowing they're loose!

joining-the-carnillean-side-talking-to-h.player: I know, I know, I'm working on it ok?

joining-the-carnillean-side-talking-to-h.speaker: Henryeta Carnillean
joining-the-carnillean-side-talking-to-h.text: I don't know, honestly I don't. There are some very odd folk around these parts.

joining-the-carnillean-side-talking-to-a.speaker: Hazeel Cultist
joining-the-carnillean-side-talking-to-a.text: What? How did you get in here? Who are you and why do you come here? It doesn't matter, you will not live long enough to tell anyone of our hideout!
The Hazeel Cultist attacks the player.

joining-the-carnillean-side-talking-to-a.speaker: Alomone
joining-the-carnillean-side-talking-to-a.text: How did YOU get in here?

joining-the-carnillean-side-talking-to-a.player: I've come for the Carnillean family armour. Hand it over, or face the consequences.

joining-the-carnillean-side-talking-to-a.speaker: Alomone
joining-the-carnillean-side-talking-to-a.text: I thought I made it clear to the butler you could not be allowed to interfere with our mission. The incompetent fool must be going soft.

joining-the-carnillean-side-talking-to-a.player: So the butler's part of your sordid little cult huh? Why is it ALWAYS the butler? I should have known...

joining-the-carnillean-side-talking-to-a.speaker: Alomone
joining-the-carnillean-side-talking-to-a.text: Well you won't live long enough to tell anyone! DIE!!!

joining-the-carnillean-side-talking-to-a.speaker: Alomone
joining-the-carnillean-side-talking-to-a.text: Out of my way idiot! We are preparing matters your puny mind could not hope to understand!

joining-the-carnillean-side-talking-to-c.player: Uh... I didn't get it yet... I DID find the cult's hideout though!

joining-the-carnillean-side-talking-to-c.speaker: Ceril Carnillean
joining-the-carnillean-side-talking-to-c.text: Well what are you waiting for? I'm not paying you to blooming sight see you know!

joining-the-carnillean-side-talking-to-a.speaker: Hazeel Cultist
joining-the-carnillean-side-talking-to-a.text: What? An intruder? HERE? How did you get in here? You must leave! NOW!

joining-the-carnillean-side-talking-to-c.speaker: Clivet
joining-the-carnillean-side-talking-to-c.text: You again! You meddle in our affairs too much! When Lord Hazeel returns to this realm he will lay a mighty vengeance upon you!

joining-the-carnillean-side-talking-to-h.speaker: Henryeta Carnillean
joining-the-carnillean-side-talking-to-h.text: Oh, hello again adventurer. I trust you did not have too much trouble dealing with those hooligans?

joining-the-carnillean-side-talking-to-h.player: Nah, it was a piece of cake.

joining-the-carnillean-side-talking-to-b.speaker: Butler Jones
joining-the-carnillean-side-talking-to-b.text: Yes? You need some help with your quest?

joining-the-carnillean-side-talking-to-b.player: Drop the act Jones. I know you're in league with the cultists.

joining-the-carnillean-side-talking-to-b.speaker: Butler Jones
joining-the-carnillean-side-talking-to-b.text: W-what? N-no I'm not, don't be silly!

joining-the-carnillean-side-talking-to-b.player: Listen pal, I went to your hideout, I heard them talking about you. You're fooling nobody.

joining-the-carnillean-side-talking-to-b.speaker: Butler Jones
joining-the-carnillean-side-talking-to-b.text: You think you're so smart don't you? You might think you know what's going on but you have no idea.

joining-the-carnillean-side-talking-to-b.player: I know all I need to know and when I reveal the truth you're going directly to jail.

joining-the-carnillean-side-talking-to-b.speaker: Butler Jones
joining-the-carnillean-side-talking-to-b.text: Oh, you think so do you? You think that silly old fool Ceril will take YOUR word over MINE? He trusts me completely!

joining-the-carnillean-side-talking-to-b.speaker: Butler Jones
joining-the-carnillean-side-talking-to-b.text: This is your last warning adventurer: keep your nose out of our business.

joining-the-carnillean-side-returning-th.speaker: Ceril Carnillean
joining-the-carnillean-side-returning-th.text: Well done! I must say I am very impressed! Come on, hand it over.

joining-the-carnillean-side-returning-th.speaker: Ceril Carnillean
joining-the-carnillean-side-returning-th.text: Before we send you on your way with your payment, I'll just get Jones to whip you up a batch of his special broth.

joining-the-carnillean-side-returning-th.player: I'd rather not if it's all the same to you. I overheard the cultists talking, and apparently Jones is in league with them.

joining-the-carnillean-side-returning-th.text: If the player is on the {{FloorNumber|uk=0}}:

steps.speaker: Ceril Carnillean
steps.text: W-what? RIGHT! You! Come with me upstairs! We're going to blooming well sort this out right now once and for all!

joining-the-carnillean-side-returning-th.text: If the player is on the {{FloorNumber|uk=1}}:

steps.speaker: Ceril Carnillean
steps.text: W-what? RIGHT! You! We're going to blooming well sort this out right now once and for all!

joining-the-carnillean-side-returning-th.speaker: Ceril Carnillean
joining-the-carnillean-side-returning-th.text: Jones! This commoner says you had something to do with the theft of my armour. What do you have to say for yourself about that?

joining-the-carnillean-side-returning-th.speaker: Butler Jones
joining-the-carnillean-side-returning-th.text: It wasn't me m'lud. I am, as you know, a loyal servant.

joining-the-carnillean-side-returning-th.speaker: Ceril Carnillean
joining-the-carnillean-side-returning-th.text: Humph. Quite right too. I cannot fathom why this scoundrel would accuse you of such a crime without evidence to back up his accusations.

joining-the-carnillean-side-returning-th.speaker: Ceril Carnillean
joining-the-carnillean-side-returning-th.text: Right. I have decided. I have given my word as a nobleman to reward you for your efforts in retrieving my armour.

joining-the-carnillean-side-returning-th.speaker: Ceril Carnillean
joining-the-carnillean-side-returning-th.text: but I must also compensate Jones for this terrible slander you have made against him.
Sir Ceril gives you 5 gold. Sir Ceril gives Jones 1995 gold.

joining-the-carnillean-side-returning-th.speaker: Ceril Carnillean
joining-the-carnillean-side-returning-th.text: Now take it and leave you scoundrel! And don't darken my doorstep again!

joining-the-carnillean-side-returning-th.speaker: Butler Jones
joining-the-carnillean-side-returning-th.text: Don't worry m'lud, this fool won't be bothering us any more.
Jones smirks at you. You are going to need more than words to prove Jones' treachery.
Fake quest complete!

joining-the-carnillean-side-talking-to-t.speaker: Guard
joining-the-carnillean-side-talking-to-t.text: Hello again adventurer. Still hanging around here eh? I'll be honest, I'm glad someone of your ability is around to assist me in case of trouble.

joining-the-carnillean-side-talking-to-c.speaker: Ceril Carnillean
joining-the-carnillean-side-talking-to-c.text: I owe you nothing you scoundrel! Now get out or I'll have Jones throw you out!

joining-the-carnillean-side-talking-to-b.speaker: Butler Jones
joining-the-carnillean-side-talking-to-b.text: Cretin. Did you think you could 'save the day' just by accusing me? We've been planning this for YEARS. your meddling has been nothing more than a minor inconvenience.

joining-the-carnillean-side-talking-to-b.speaker: Butler Jones
joining-the-carnillean-side-talking-to-b.text: When Lord Hazeel returns, the likes of you and the arrogant Carnilleans will be first to suffer his vengeance.

joining-the-carnillean-side-talking-to-b.player: Not if I can help it!

joining-the-carnillean-side-talking-to-b.speaker: Butler Jones
joining-the-carnillean-side-talking-to-b.text: That's basically my point. You cannot help it. Now begone!

joining-the-carnillean-side-talking-to-h.speaker: Henryeta Carnillean
joining-the-carnillean-side-talking-to-h.text: You! Don't think you can go accusing our trusted staff and then waltz up to me as though nothing has happened!

joining-the-carnillean-side-talking-to-h.player: Everything I said was the truth.

joining-the-carnillean-side-talking-to-h.speaker: Henryeta Carnillean
joining-the-carnillean-side-talking-to-h.text: HA! Don't be so ridiculous! Next you'll be trying to tell me Jones murdered our old butler!

joining-the-carnillean-side-talking-to-a.speaker: Alomone
joining-the-carnillean-side-talking-to-a.text: I have no time to waste with the likes of you do-gooder.

joining-the-carnillean-side-talking-to-c.speaker: Clivet
joining-the-carnillean-side-talking-to-c.text: You again. Mark my words meddler; when Lord Hazeel returns you will be punished most severely for your interference in our schemes.

joining-the-carnillean-side-talking-to-t.speaker: Guard
joining-the-carnillean-side-talking-to-t.text: Hello adventurer. I hear you accused Jones the butler of being an accomplice of that loony cult. Is that true?

joining-the-carnillean-side-talking-to-t.player: That's true, but nobody believes me.

joining-the-carnillean-side-talking-to-t.speaker: Guard
joining-the-carnillean-side-talking-to-t.text: You have my utter faith adventurer. I can't openly defy my employer, Sir Ceril, but I'd like you to know that I think you're on the right track there.

joining-the-carnillean-side-talking-to-t.player: Hey, thanks! That actually does make me feel a bit better!

joining-the-carnillean-side-talking-to-t.speaker: Guard
joining-the-carnillean-side-talking-to-t.text: You've already proven to me that you're a law-abiding citizen. Besides, I always found it suspicious that Jones would just show up here on the doorstep the very day after the old butler died in such suspicious

joining-the-carnillean-side-talking-to-t.speaker: Guard
joining-the-carnillean-side-talking-to-t.text: circumstances. Good luck in clearing your name. You have my support.

joining-the-carnillean-side-searching-th.text: You search the cupbaord thoroughly. You find a bottle of poison and a mysterious amulet. You pass your discovery on to Ceril.

joining-the-carnillean-side-searching-th.speaker: Ceril Carnillean
joining-the-carnillean-side-searching-th.text: What do you want now you scoundrel?

joining-the-carnillean-side-searching-th.player: Look what I've found in the cupboard!

joining-the-carnillean-side-searching-th.text: You hand Ceril the bottle of poison.

joining-the-carnillean-side-searching-th.speaker: Ceril Carnillean
joining-the-carnillean-side-searching-th.text: I... I don't believe it! Poison! JONES!

joining-the-carnillean-side-searching-th.speaker: Butler Jones
joining-the-carnillean-side-searching-th.text: You called m'lud?

joining-the-carnillean-side-searching-th.speaker: Ceril Carnillean
joining-the-carnillean-side-searching-th.text: JONES! Just WHAT is this POISON doing here???

joining-the-carnillean-side-searching-th.speaker: Butler Jones
joining-the-carnillean-side-searching-th.text: P-p-poison??? yeah... uh... well, hmm... Oh, it's for Killing rats.

joining-the-carnillean-side-searching-th.speaker: Butler Jones
joining-the-carnillean-side-searching-th.text: Yes, that's right. Killing rats. I am but a loyal butler sir.

joining-the-carnillean-side-searching-th.speaker: Ceril Carnillean
joining-the-carnillean-side-searching-th.text: Rats eh? Yes, fair enough. Sorry to have doubted you old boy.
You show Ceril the amulet from the cupboard.

joining-the-carnillean-side-searching-th.speaker: Ceril Carnillean
joining-the-carnillean-side-searching-th.text: Wh-what??? I've seen this amulet before... The thieves that broke in... One of them was wearing an identical amulet! Jones! I don't believe it!

joining-the-carnillean-side-searching-th.speaker: Ceril Carnillean
joining-the-carnillean-side-searching-th.text: Jones! We trusted you! We took you into our home!

joining-the-carnillean-side-searching-th.speaker: Butler Jones
joining-the-carnillean-side-searching-th.text: You senile old fool... It was all too easy! I should have killed you and your pathetic family weeks ago!

joining-the-carnillean-side-searching-th.speaker: Ceril Carnillean
joining-the-carnillean-side-searching-th.text: To think we took you in and trusted you... and this is how you repay us...

joining-the-carnillean-side-searching-th.speaker: Ceril Carnillean
joining-the-carnillean-side-searching-th.text: GUARD!
A Guard rushes into the house.

joining-the-carnillean-side-searching-th.speaker: Ceril Carnillean
joining-the-carnillean-side-searching-th.text: Take him away. Attempted murder and burglary.

joining-the-carnillean-side-searching-th.speaker: Butler Jones
joining-the-carnillean-side-searching-th.text: Don't think this is the last you have heard of me Ceril. You and your family will pay dearly for this. GLORY TO HAZEEL! ALL PRAISE ZAMORAK!

joining-the-carnillean-side-searching-th.speaker: Guard
joining-the-carnillean-side-searching-th.text: Now now. Come along quietly. There'll be no revenge where YOU'RE going - Port Sarim Jail.

joining-the-carnillean-side-searching-th.speaker: Ceril Carnillean
joining-the-carnillean-side-searching-th.text: It looks like I am indebted to you sirrah!

joining-the-carnillean-side-searching-th.player: No problem. We all make mistakes.

joining-the-carnillean-side-searching-th.speaker: Ceril Carnillean
joining-the-carnillean-side-searching-th.text: But if it weren't for you... My whole family... we could have been... I apologise for my harshness before.

joining-the-carnillean-side-searching-th.speaker: Ceril Carnillean
joining-the-carnillean-side-searching-th.text: the very least I can do is to reward you for your noble efforts, and to offer my sincerest apologies as a Lord and gentleman.

joining-the-carnillean-side-searching-th.speaker: Ceril Carnillean
joining-the-carnillean-side-searching-th.text: No, no, thank YOU! Feel free to stop by anytime adventurer!
Quest complete!

joining-the-hazeel-side-talking-to-clive.speaker: Clivet
joining-the-hazeel-side-talking-to-clive.text: You have a mission for us adventurer. Go to the Carnilliean household and poison their meal to prove your loyalty.

joining-the-hazeel-side-losing-the-poiso.speaker: Clivet
joining-the-hazeel-side-losing-the-poiso.text: You have a mission for us adventurer. Go to the Carnilliean household and poison their meal to prove your loyalty.

joining-the-hazeel-side-losing-the-poiso.player: I lost the poison you gave me...

joining-the-hazeel-side-losing-the-poiso.speaker: Clivet
joining-the-hazeel-side-losing-the-poiso.text: Useless. Take this and don't mess up this time. Lord Hazeel is depending on you.

joining-the-hazeel-side-talking-to-a-haz.speaker: Hazeel Cultist
joining-the-hazeel-side-talking-to-a-haz.text: Leave me alone, can't you see I'm busy? We have a lot to do preparing for the imminent return of Lord Hazeel

joining-the-hazeel-side-talking-to-the-g.speaker: Guard
joining-the-hazeel-side-talking-to-the-g.text: Hello. I hear tell you're after that loony cult who broke in the other night. It always gladdens me when civilians assist the law like this.

joining-the-hazeel-side-talking-to-henry.speaker: Henryeta Carnillean
joining-the-hazeel-side-talking-to-henry.text: I hope you found those awful hooligan cultists! I simply cannot sleep at night knowing they're loose!

joining-the-hazeel-side-talking-to-henry.speaker: Henryeta Carnillean
joining-the-hazeel-side-talking-to-henry.text: Humph. You really are useless aren't you?

joining-the-hazeel-side-talking-to-phili.speaker: Philipe Carnillean
joining-the-hazeel-side-talking-to-phili.text: More toys! I want MORE TOYS!

joining-the-hazeel-side-talking-to-phili.player: Nope, sorry, I don't have sweets either.

joining-the-hazeel-side-talking-to-phili.speaker: Philipe Carnillean
joining-the-hazeel-side-talking-to-phili.text: I hate you! HATE YOU! Where's my mommy?

joining-the-hazeel-side-talking-to-claus.speaker: Claus the chef
joining-the-hazeel-side-talking-to-claus.text: You're that adventurer the family asked to help get those weird cultists who keep breaking in, right?

joining-the-hazeel-side-using-the-poison.text: You pour the poison into the hot pot. The poison dissolves into the soup.

joining-the-hazeel-side-talking-to-claus.speaker: Claus the chef
joining-the-hazeel-side-talking-to-claus.text: Hello there. Caught any of those weird thieves yet?

joining-the-hazeel-side-talking-to-henry.speaker: Henryeta Carnillean
joining-the-hazeel-side-talking-to-henry.text: No, no I am very far from OK. Those hooligans slaughtered my precious Scruffy! I shall never recover! I am emotionally scarred for life!

joining-the-hazeel-side-talking-to-henry.player: It WAS only a dog you know...

joining-the-hazeel-side-talking-to-butle.speaker: Butler Jones
joining-the-hazeel-side-talking-to-butle.text: Hello friend. I heard about your handiwork. Quite amusing really. I'm sure Hazeel will be pleased anyway; Keep up the good work!

joining-the-hazeel-side-talking-to-phili.speaker: Philipe Carnillean
joining-the-hazeel-side-talking-to-phili.text: Someone killed scruffy. I liked scruffy. He never told me off.

joining-the-hazeel-side-talking-to-ceril.speaker: Ceril Carnillean
joining-the-hazeel-side-talking-to-ceril.text: Oh.. the inhumanity... the cruelty.. the misery... the pain... my son is a good boy, really, but how could he give his dinner to Scruffy without having the servants test it for poison first? How? How could he be so

joining-the-hazeel-side-talking-to-ceril.speaker: Ceril Carnillean
joining-the-hazeel-side-talking-to-ceril.text: thoughtless and careless? He knows we are all under threat!

joining-the-hazeel-side-talking-to-ceril.speaker: Ceril Carnillean
joining-the-hazeel-side-talking-to-ceril.text: He's been with our family for twenty years... that's 140 in dog years! The poor dog... what did HE ever do to deserve such a fate???

joining-the-hazeel-side-talking-to-ceril.speaker: Ceril Carnillean
joining-the-hazeel-side-talking-to-ceril.text: I agree! I hope whichever evildoer is responsible gets the full weight of the law brought upon them!

joining-the-hazeel-side-talking-to-the-g.speaker: Guard
joining-the-hazeel-side-talking-to-the-g.text: Hello. The sarge is furious with me! Apparently those loony cultists have been back somehow without me noticing! I got a right roasting earlier...

joining-the-hazeel-side-talking-to-the-g.speaker: Guard
joining-the-hazeel-side-talking-to-the-g.text: I don't exactly know what they got up to in the house... but that's besides the point. Sir Ceril was extremely upset, and I don't blame him.

joining-the-hazeel-side-talking-to-a-haz.speaker: Hazeel Cultist
joining-the-hazeel-side-talking-to-a-haz.text: Well, it's always good to have a new recruit. Soon we shall retrive Hazeels' scroll and the ritual to revive him can begin!

the-scroll-talking-to-clivet.player: I poured the poison into the Carnillean's meal as requested. It didn't quite go to plan however.

the-scroll-talking-to-clivet.speaker: Clivet
the-scroll-talking-to-clivet.text: Yes, we heard all about it from one of our sources. Hazeel has eyes everywhere! You have now proved your loyalty and will be rewarded when Hazeel is revived!

the-scroll-talking-to-clivet.speaker: Clivet
the-scroll-talking-to-clivet.text: Here. Wear this amulet; it is called The Sign Of Hazeel. Not only will it identify you as one of our brotherhood to other followers but it is also key to finding our hideout.

steps.text: If the player already has Hazeel's mark:

steps.speaker: Clivet
steps.text: But of course, you already knew that, as you already have The Sign Of Hazeel.

the-scroll-talking-to-clivet.text: If the player does not have Hazeel's mark:

steps.player: How does this amulet help do that then?

steps.speaker: Clivet
steps.text: Hazeel in his wisdom when he built this lair did so by making it inaccessible unless the flow of the sewers is controlled exactly by the sewer valves above ground.

steps.speaker: Clivet
steps.text: Each sewer valve must be correctly set before the water level is such that you may enter. The secret of the correct settings is contained in these amulets which honour him.

steps.speaker: Clivet
steps.text: Starting from left to right, follow the design of the amulet to locate each sewer valve, and then turn each so as to follow the amulet design.

steps.speaker: Clivet
steps.text: When you solve the sequence you may enter our hideout where our leader, Alomone, awaits you.

the-scroll-talking-to-alomone.speaker: Alomone
the-scroll-talking-to-alomone.text: Well well well... So we have a new recruit. Clivet told me of your desire to join us in our glorious task to resurrect the mighty Hazeel from his slumber.

the-scroll-talking-to-alomone.speaker: Alomone
the-scroll-talking-to-alomone.text: To accomplish this, we require the ancient words of summoning which will restore his shattered body, so that he can bring vengeance upon his enemies.

the-scroll-talking-to-alomone.speaker: Alomone
the-scroll-talking-to-alomone.text: Hazeel in his mighty cunning anticipated that he might be defeated and secured within his home somewhere a powerful magical scroll that could restore him.

the-scroll-talking-to-alomone.speaker: Alomone
the-scroll-talking-to-alomone.text: The words to this powerful enchantment are hidden within the Carnillean mansion, right under the nose of his unsuspecting foes. We already have an agent in place there

the-scroll-talking-to-alomone.speaker: Alomone
the-scroll-talking-to-alomone.text: in their Butler Jones, a faithful follower to Hazeel. His loyalty to Hazeel is beyond questioning, yet he has been unsuccessful in locating the scroll containing the spell so far.

the-scroll-talking-to-alomone.speaker: Alomone
the-scroll-talking-to-alomone.text: Go back to the mansion, and assist us in finding this enchantment, so that together we can restore Hazeel to his true power and glory!

the-scroll-talking-to-clivet-again.speaker: Clivet
the-scroll-talking-to-clivet-again.text: Hello once more adventurer. All we need is Hazeels' magical scroll to bring him forth once more to this world.

the-scroll-talking-to-a-hazeel-cultist-a.speaker: Hazeel Cultist
the-scroll-talking-to-a-hazeel-cultist-a.text: Well hello! Until we have retrieved the scroll of Hazeel we cannot resurrect our master. You must find it and bring it to us.

the-scroll-talking-to-alomone-again.speaker: Alomone
the-scroll-talking-to-alomone-again.text: Hazeel has waited long enough to return! It is IMPERATIVE you find that spell!

the-scroll-talking-to-alomone-again.player: Yeah yeah yeah, I'm on it, I'm ON it.

the-scroll-talking-to-the-guard.speaker: Guard
the-scroll-talking-to-the-guard.text: Hello again adventurer. Still hanging around here eh? Let me know if you spot any of those loony cultists sniffing around.

the-scroll-talking-to-ceril.speaker: Ceril Carnillean
the-scroll-talking-to-ceril.text: Oh cruel world! Scruffy... I knew you well... I... just... don't think I can... go on without...
Sir Ceril breaks down into tears.

the-scroll-talking-to-ceril.player: Loosen up already. It was only a DOG.

the-scroll-talking-to-philipe-again.speaker: Philipe Carnillean
the-scroll-talking-to-philipe-again.text: Mommy said you're here to kill all the nasty men that keep breaking in.

the-scroll-talking-to-henryeta-again.speaker: Henryeta Carnillean
the-scroll-talking-to-henryeta-again.text: I'm sorry. I am far too depressed to talk to anybody right now. Oh... poor Scruffy...

the-scroll-talking-to-butler-jones.text: If the player has Hazeel's mark equipped:

steps.speaker: Butler Jones
steps.text: Hello again friend. I see you have the mark now; You should keep it covered up.

steps.player: That? Oh, it's nothing. Just an old amulet.

the-scroll-talking-to-butler-jones.text: If the player does not have Hazeel's mark equipped:

steps.speaker: Butler Jones
steps.text: Hello again friend. I see you decided to keep the mark of Hazeel discreetly about you.

steps.player: Mark of Hazeel? I'm sure I don't know what you mean.

the-scroll-talking-to-butler-jones.speaker: Butler Jones
the-scroll-talking-to-butler-jones.text: You don't have to pretend with me, friend! Our cause is one and the same; the sooner Lord Hazeel is avenged the better for this city... and for us!

the-scroll-talking-to-butler-jones.player: So do you have any idea where the scroll with the enchantment is?

the-scroll-talking-to-butler-jones.speaker: Butler Jones
the-scroll-talking-to-butler-jones.text: No idea I'm afraid. I KNOW it's somewhere in this house, but for the life of me I can't find it anywhere. I've searched high and low for it!

the-scroll-talking-to-butler-jones.player: And Sir Ceril doesn't suspect a thing?

the-scroll-talking-to-butler-jones.speaker: Butler Jones
the-scroll-talking-to-butler-jones.text: Ha! That silly old fool? He can't see the forest for the trees.

the-scroll-talking-to-claus.speaker: Claus the chef
the-scroll-talking-to-claus.text: I... just CAN'T understand it! How? HOW could someone poison my delicious food without me even noticing??? I... I just don't understand!

the-scroll-talking-to-claus.speaker: Claus the chef
the-scroll-talking-to-claus.text: Oh man... I hope I don't lose my job over this... but HOW? How did they do it? And why would the villain want to kill poor Scruffy anyway? He was such a good dog...

the-scroll-talking-to-claus.player: Yeah. It's a real mystery, huh?

the-scroll-searching-the-crate-in-the-ki.text: You search the crate. Under various food package you find an old rusty key.

the-scroll-chest.text: Inside the chest you find the Scroll of Hazeel.

the-scroll-talking-to-jones-after-obtain.text: If the player has the scroll in their inventory:

the-scroll-talking-to-jones-after-obtain.speaker: Butler Jones
the-scroll-talking-to-jones-after-obtain.text: Quick, get it back to our hideout! These are glorious times indeed adventurer, when the mighty Hazeel returns things are REALLY going to change around here!
If the player does not have the scroll in their inventory:

steps.player: Uh... yeah... about that.. I don't exactly have it right now...

steps.speaker: Butler Jones
steps.text: Incompetent fool! The future of our entire plans relies on that scroll! You MUST find it and take it back to our hideout as soon as possible!

the-scroll-talking-to-ceril-after-obtain.speaker: Ceril Carnillean
the-scroll-talking-to-ceril-after-obtain.text: SIR Ceril! SIR! And I'm not sure but I think the thieves have been back in my house.

the-scroll-talking-to-ceril-after-obtain.speaker: Ceril Carnillean
the-scroll-talking-to-ceril-after-obtain.text: Well, either I'm going crazy, or theres been an intruder in Jones' room upstairs!

the-scroll-talking-to-philipe-after-obta.speaker: Philipe Carnillean
the-scroll-talking-to-philipe-after-obta.text: Have you got me some toys?

the-scroll-talking-to-philipe-after-obta.player: Gee. I guess I'll just have to live with that then.

the-scroll-talking-to-claus-after-obtain.speaker: Claus the chef
the-scroll-talking-to-claus-after-obtain.text: Those animals... how could they do that to poor Scruffy? What kind of lowlife would do that???

the-scroll-talking-to-claus-after-obtain.player: Get over it, it was only a dog.

the-scroll-talking-to-the-guard-after-ob.speaker: Guard
the-scroll-talking-to-the-guard-after-ob.text: Hello adventurer. I hope you find the cult soon we have a horrible suspicion that there's been another burglary.

the-scroll-talking-to-the-guard-after-ob.speaker: Guard
the-scroll-talking-to-the-guard-after-ob.text: Yes, it is. What's worse is I have no idea how they keep doing it. It's like they do it under my very nose!

the-scroll-talking-to-clivet-after-obtai.speaker: Clivet
the-scroll-talking-to-clivet-after-obtai.text: Have you acquired the enchanted scroll required to resurrect Hazeel yet?
If the player has the scroll in their inventory:

steps.player: Yes, it was in the house all along. Jones can't have looked that hard for it.

steps.speaker: Clivet
steps.text: At last! The pieces are all in place for the glorious resurrection of Lord Hazeel! Now is the starting point for a new page in history, and our chance for vengeance!

steps.speaker: Clivet
steps.text: Quickly now! Take the scroll to Alomone so that we may begin the ritual... and when Lord Hazeel returns I promise you that you shall be well rewarded!

the-scroll-talking-to-clivet-after-obtai.text: If the player does not have the scroll in their inventory:

steps.player: Uh... yeah... about that... I seem to have, errm, misplayed it somewhere...

steps.speaker: Clivet
steps.text: Incompetent cretin! Return to the Carnillean household and do not return again without it!

the-scroll-talking-to-a-hazeel-cultist-a.speaker: Hazeel Cultist
the-scroll-talking-to-a-hazeel-cultist-a.text: Welcome back adventurer! Since you have brought us the scroll of Hazeel we can now perform the resurrection ceremony! Soon our master will return!

the-scroll-talking-to-alomone-after-obta.speaker: Alomone
the-scroll-talking-to-alomone-after-obta.text: Have you brought me the scroll of restoration to complete the ritual?
If the player has the scroll in their inventory:

steps.player: Yep. Got it right here.

steps.speaker: Alomone
steps.text: FINALLY! Quickly, give it to me and I will begin the ritual!
You hand Alomone the scroll of Hazeel.

steps.speaker: Alomone
steps.text: Yes... YES! With the words contained within this scroll our Lord shall return to this realm and bring destruction to our enemies!

steps.speaker: Alomone
steps.text: Watch adventurer, and witness the glorious rebirth of Hazeel!

steps.speaker: Alomone
steps.text: Lord Hazeel... Lord Zamorak... I call upon the powers of evil... The forces of chaos... The strength of hatred...

steps.speaker: Alomone
steps.text: Sentente sillaberi junque dithmento! Ia! Ia! dextrimon encanto! termando... imcando... solly enty rando... sentente! Ia! Ia! Indenti zaggarati g'thxa!
Alomone continues to recite the scroll. It is a language you have never heard and do not understand at all.

steps.speaker: Alomone
steps.text: Dintenta! Sententa! Retenta! Q'exjta! Ia! Sottottott! Ia! Dysmenta junque fammatio svelken! Sottey! Sentey! SOLOMENT!
As Alomone finishes reading from the scroll you hear a shrill scream emanate from Hazeel's coffin.

steps.speaker: Hazeel
steps.text: My loyal followers. I have pride in you all. Never did I expect to return to this land and I see I have much to attend to.

steps.speaker: Hazeel
steps.text: Soon this world will cower once more at the name Hazeel, and my fury will blaze across mine enemies just as my loyal followers gain their rewards.
Hazeel turns to look at your directly.

steps.speaker: Hazeel
steps.text: Adventurer. I know that thy efforts were principal in my return to this plane of existence. I offer you my thanks directly.

steps.speaker: Hazeel
steps.text: You may not be a follower of Zamorak directly but your cunning and treachery mark you as a friend to the Mahjarrat. Rest assured; I will call on your assistance again.

steps.speaker: Hazeel
steps.text: Weak as I am now, my strength shall return, and my followers will be greatly rewarded when my powers peak once more. Join me in my cause as my servant, and all

steps.speaker: Hazeel
steps.text: the riches of this plane shall be yours to share, in domination over all who oppose my kind. You would be wise to pledge yourself now while you still may.

steps.player: I serve nobody but myself.

steps.speaker: Hazeel
steps.text: Your insolence shall be overlooked this time for I am in truth in your debt. Come close: I shall reward you with wealth such as you deserve.

steps.speaker: Hazeel
steps.text: Although your true reward will be later, when Zamorak and I, together, lay waste to this miserable planet, and you are spared as an ally to us.
Hazeel gives you some coins. They seem to be extremely ancient.

steps.speaker: Hazeel
steps.text: And now I must leave you loyal subjects for time is short, and I have many pressing matters to address before I may make my return. I must leave now, and head Northwards

steps.speaker: Hazeel
steps.text: to join my fellow mahjarrat and regain my strength and powers. I shall return when I am ready to fight my enemies and much blood shall flow across these lands!
Quest complete

before-hazeel-cult.npc: Oh, hello. If you wish to look around the Carnillean family home, please refrain from touching anything with those grubby hands of yours.

after-hazeel-cult-sided-with-carnillean.npc: Hello again, adventurer. Since you dealt with those horrible cultists, things have vastly improved for us around here!

after-hazeel-cult-sided-with-hazeel.npc: Oh, it's you. I'm very disappointed that you never found those awful cultists. You're quite useless really, aren't you?

after-swan-song.npc: Ah, [player name]! How's the fishing going?

after-swan-song.player: Still working on it. How's the Colony?

after-swan-song.npc: Flourishing, now that the colonists are coming back! Soon all the finest restaurants will be serving monkfish!
It's a pity those skeletons you brought here haven't gone away again, though. They're in the dormitories, which is rather annoying! So please take a little time to kick 'em around a bit.
Oh, and please don't call me Hermie.

the-greatest-heroes-of-the-land-talking-.speaker: Achietties
the-greatest-heroes-of-the-land-talking-.text: Greetings. Welcome to the Heroes' Guild.

the-greatest-heroes-of-the-land-talking-.speaker: Achietties
the-greatest-heroes-of-the-land-talking-.text: Only the greatest heroes of this land may gain entrance to this guild.
If the player's skill levels are lower than the quest requirements.

steps.text: Before starting this quest, be aware that one or more of your skill levels are lower than what is required to fully complete it.

steps.player: I'm a hero. May I apply to join?

steps.text: If the player doesn't have the quest requirements to start the quest:

steps.speaker: Achietties
steps.text: You're a hero? I've never heard of you.
You do not meet all of the requirements to start the Heroes' Quest.

steps.speaker: Achietties
steps.text: Well, you seem to meet our initial requirements, so you may now begin the tasks to earn membership in the Heroes' Guild.

steps.speaker: Achietties
steps.text: The three items required for entrance are: An Entranan Firebird feather, a Master Thieves' armband, and a cooked Lava Eel.

options.text: Any hints on getting the armband?

steps.player: Any hints on getting the thieves armband?

steps.speaker: Achietties
steps.text: I'm sure you have the relevant contacts to find out about that.

options.text: Any hints on getting the feather?

steps.player: Any hints on getting the feather?

steps.speaker: Achietties
steps.text: Not really - other than Entranan firebirds tend to live on Entrana.

options.text: Any hints on getting the eel?

steps.player: Any hints on getting the eel?

steps.speaker: Achietties
steps.text: Maybe go and find someone who knows a lot about fishing?

options.text: I'll start looking for all those things then.

steps.player: I'll start looking for all those things then.

steps.speaker: Achietties
steps.text: Good luck with that.

steps.player: Good for the foremost heroes of the land.

steps.speaker: Achietties
steps.text: Yes. Yes it is.

the-greatest-heroes-of-the-land-talking-.speaker: Achietties

the-greatest-heroes-of-the-land-talking-.player: It's tough. I've not done it yet.

the-greatest-heroes-of-the-land-talking-.speaker: Achietties
the-greatest-heroes-of-the-land-talking-.text: Remember, the items you need to enter are:

the-greatest-heroes-of-the-land-talking-.speaker: Achietties

options.text: Any hints on getting the armband?
Any hints on getting the feather?
Any hints on getting the eel?
I'll start looking for all those things then.

master-thieves-armband-phoenix-gang-talk.player: How would I go about getting a Master Thief armband?

master-thieves-armband-phoenix-gang-talk.speaker: Straven
master-thieves-armband-phoenix-gang-talk.text: Ooh... tricky stuff. Took me YEARS to get that rank.

master-thieves-armband-phoenix-gang-talk.speaker: Straven
master-thieves-armband-phoenix-gang-talk.text: Well, what some of the more aspiring thieves in our gang are working on right now is to steal some very valuable candlesticks from Scarface Pete - the pirate leader on Karamja.

master-thieves-armband-phoenix-gang-talk.speaker: Straven
master-thieves-armband-phoenix-gang-talk.text: His security is excellent, and the target very valuable so that might be enough to get you the rank.

master-thieves-armband-phoenix-gang-talk.speaker: Straven
master-thieves-armband-phoenix-gang-talk.text: Go talk to our man Alfonse, the waiter in the Shrimp and Parrot.

master-thieves-armband-phoenix-gang-talk.speaker: Straven
master-thieves-armband-phoenix-gang-talk.text: Use the secret word 'gherkin' to show you're one of us.

master-thieves-armband-phoenix-gang-talk.player: What am I supposed to be doing again?

master-thieves-armband-phoenix-gang-talk.speaker: Straven
master-thieves-armband-phoenix-gang-talk.text: You told me you wanted to get a Master thief's armband! Now pay attention.

master-thieves-armband-phoenix-gang-talk.speaker: Straven
master-thieves-armband-phoenix-gang-talk.text: Some of the more aspiring thieves in our gang are working on right now is to steal some very valuable candlesticks from Scarface Pete - the pirate leader on Karamja.

master-thieves-armband-phoenix-gang-talk.speaker: Straven
master-thieves-armband-phoenix-gang-talk.text: His security is excellent, and the target very valuable so that might be enough to get you the rank.

master-thieves-armband-phoenix-gang-talk.speaker: Straven
master-thieves-armband-phoenix-gang-talk.text: Go talk to our man Alfonse, the waiter in the Shrimp and Parrot.

master-thieves-armband-phoenix-gang-talk.speaker: Straven
master-thieves-armband-phoenix-gang-talk.text: Use the secret word 'gherkin' to show you're one of us.

master-thieves-armband-phoenix-gang-tryi.speaker: Alfonse the waiter
master-thieves-armband-phoenix-gang-tryi.text: Hey! You can't go through there! That's private property!

master-thieves-armband-phoenix-gang-talk.speaker: Alfonse the waiter
master-thieves-armband-phoenix-gang-talk.text: Welcome to the Shrimp and Parrot. Would you like to order, sir?

steps.player: Do you sell Gherkins?

steps.speaker: Alfonse the waiter
steps.text: Hmmmm Gherkins eh? Ask Charlie the cook, round the back. He may have some 'gherkins' for you!
Alfonse winks at you.

options.text: Where do you get your Karambwan from?

master-thieves-armband-phoenix-gang-talk.speaker: Charlie the cook
master-thieves-armband-phoenix-gang-talk.text: Hey! What are you doing back here?

steps.player: I'm looking for a gherkin...

steps.speaker: Charlie the cook
steps.text: Aaaaaah... a fellow Phoenix! So, tell me compadre... what brings you to sunny Brimhaven?

options.text: Sun, sand and the fresh sea air!

steps.player: Sun, sand and the fresh sea air!

steps.speaker: Charlie the cook
steps.text: Well, can't say I blame you compadre. I used to be a city boy myself, but have to admit it's a lot nicer living here nowadays. Brimhaven's certainly good for it.

options.text: I want to steal Scarface Pete's candlesticks.

steps.player: I want to steal Scarface Pete's candlesticks.

steps.speaker: Charlie the cook
steps.text: Ah yes, of course. The candlesticks. Well, I have to be honest with you compadre, we haven't made much progress in that task ourselves so far. We can however offer

steps.speaker: Charlie the cook
steps.text: a little assistance. The setting up of this restaurant was the start of things; we have a secret door out the back of here that leads through the back of Mr Olbors' garden.

steps.speaker: Charlie the cook
steps.text: Now, at the other side of Mr Olbors' garden, is an old side entrance to Scarface Pete's mansion. It seems to have been blocked off from the rest of the mansion some years ago

steps.speaker: Charlie the cook
steps.text: and we can't seem to find a way through. We're positive this is the key to entering the house undetected however, and I promise to let you know if we find anything there.

steps.player: Mind if I check it out for myself?

steps.speaker: Charlie the cook
steps.text: Not at all! The more minds we have working on the problem, the quicker we get that loot!

options.text: I'm a fellow member of the Phoenix gang.

steps.player: I'm a fellow member of the Phoenix gang.

steps.speaker: Charlie the cook
steps.text: Aaaaaah... a fellow Phoenix! So, tell me compadre... what brings you to sunny Brimhaven?

options.text: Sun, sand and the fresh sea air!
I want to steal Scarface Pete's candlesticks.

steps.player: Just exploring...

steps.speaker: Charlie the cook
steps.text: Well get out! This kitchen isn't for exploring! It's a private establishment! It's out of bounds to customers!

master-thieves-armband-phoenix-gang-atte.speaker: Garv
master-thieves-armband-phoenix-gang-atte.text: Oi! Where do you think you're going pal?

steps.player: Can I go in there?

steps.speaker: Garv
steps.text: No. In there is private.

steps.player: I want for nothing!

steps.speaker: Garv
steps.text: You're one of a very lucky few then.

options.text: Would you like your hedges trimming?

steps.player: Would you like your hedges trimming?

steps.speaker: Grubor
steps.text: Eh? Don't be daft! We don't even HAVE any hedges!

steps.player: I want to come in.

steps.speaker: Grubor
steps.text: No, go away.

steps.player: Do you want to trade?

steps.speaker: Grubor
steps.text: No, I'm busy.

master-thieves-armband-phoenix-gang-atte.player: This room isn't a lot of use on its own... Maybe I can get extra help from the inside somehow... I wonder if any of the other players have found a way in.

master-thieves-armband-phoenix-gang-atte.speaker: Straven
master-thieves-armband-phoenix-gang-atte.text: Well, in all honesty, you didn't actually retrieve it yourself, did you? You don't qualify as a master thief unless you actually steal it yourself, you know...

master-thieves-armband-phoenix-gang-hand.speaker: Straven
master-thieves-armband-phoenix-gang-hand.text: Hmmm. Not bad, not bad. Let's see it, make sure it's genuine.

master-thieves-armband-phoenix-gang-hand.player: So is this enough to get me a Master Thief armband?

master-thieves-armband-phoenix-gang-hand.speaker: Straven
master-thieves-armband-phoenix-gang-hand.text: Aww, go on then. I suppose I'm in a generous mood today.
Straven hands you a Master Thief armband.

master-thieves-armband-phoenix-gang-talk.player: I'm afraid I've lost my Master Thief armband.

master-thieves-armband-phoenix-gang-talk.speaker: Straven
master-thieves-armband-phoenix-gang-talk.text: Lucky for you I have a spare. Don't lose it again!

master-thieves-armband-phoenix-gang-talk.player: I'm afraid I've lost my Master Thief armband.

master-thieves-armband-phoenix-gang-talk.speaker: Straven
master-thieves-armband-phoenix-gang-talk.text: We shouldn't speak about that now!

options.text: Who are all those people in there?
Is there any way I can get the rank of master thief?

steps.player: Is there any way I can get the rank of master thief?

steps.speaker: Katrine
steps.text: Master thief? Ain't we the ambitious one!

steps.speaker: Katrine
steps.text: Well, you're gonna have to do something pretty amazing.

steps.player: Anything you can suggest?

steps.speaker: Katrine
steps.text: Well, some of the MOST coveted prizes in thiefdom right now are in the pirate town of Brimhaven on Karamja.

steps.speaker: Katrine
steps.text: The pirate leader Scarface Pete has a pair of extremely valuable candlesticks.

steps.speaker: Katrine
steps.text: His security is VERY good.

steps.speaker: Katrine
steps.text: We, of course, have gang members in a town like Brimhaven who may be able to help you.

steps.speaker: Katrine
steps.text: Visit our hideout in the alleyway on Palm Street. To get in you will need to tell them the secret password 'four leafed clover'.

steps.speaker: Grubor
steps.text: Oh, you're one of the gang are you? Ok, hold up a second, I'll just let you in through here.
You hear the door being unbarred from inside.

master-thieves-armband-black-arm-gang-ta.speaker: Grubor
master-thieves-armband-black-arm-gang-ta.text: Hi. I'm a little busy right now.

master-thieves-armband-black-arm-gang-tr.speaker: Trobert
master-thieves-armband-black-arm-gang-tr.text: Hi. Welcome to our Brimhaven headquarters. I'm Trobert and I'm in charge here.

options.text: So can you help me get Scarface Pete's candlesticks?

steps.player: So can you help me get Scarface Pete's candlesticks?

steps.speaker: Trobert
steps.text: Well, we have made some progress there. We know that one of the only keys to Pete's treasure room is carried by Grip, the head guard, so we thought it might be good to get close to him somehow.

steps.speaker: Trobert
steps.text: Grip was taking on a new deputy called Hartigen, an Asgarnian Black Knight who was deserting the Black Knight Fortress and seeking new employment here on Brimhaven.

steps.speaker: Trobert
steps.text: We managed to waylay him on the journey here, and steal his I.D. papers. Now all we need is to find somebody willing to impersonate him and take the deputy role to get that key for us.

options.text: I volunteer to undertake that mission!

steps.player: I volunteer to undertake that mission!

steps.speaker: Trobert
steps.text: Good good. Here's the I.D. papers. Take them and introduce yourself to the guards at Scarface Pete's mansion. We'll have that treasure in no time.

steps.player: Well, good luck then.

steps.speaker: Trobert
steps.text: Someone will show up eventually.

steps.player: Pleased to meet you.

steps.speaker: Trobert
steps.text: Likewise.

master-thieves-armband-black-arm-gang-ta.text: If the player has the ID papers:

steps.speaker: Trobert
steps.text: How's it going?

steps.player: Fine, thanks.

master-thieves-armband-black-arm-gang-ta.text: If the player has lost the ID papers:

steps.player: I have lost Hartigen's ID paper...

steps.speaker: Trobert
steps.text: Well that was careless of you wasn't it? Fortunately for you, he had a spare. Take this one, but please try to be more careful with this one.

master-thieves-armband-black-arm-gang-ta.text: If the player has lost the ID papers and has a full inventory:

steps.player: I have lost Hartigen's ID papers...

steps.speaker: Trobert
steps.text: Well that was careless of you, wasn't it? Fortunately for you, he had a spare set. Take this one, but please try to be more careful with it.

master-thieves-armband-black-arm-gang-in.text: Trying to enter the mansion rather than talking to Garv

steps.speaker: Garv
steps.text: Oi! Where do you think you're going pal?

steps.speaker: Garv
steps.text: Hello. What do you want?

master-thieves-armband-black-arm-gang-in.player: Hi. I'm Hartigen. I've come to work here.

master-thieves-armband-black-arm-gang-in.text: If the player is not wearing black armour:

steps.speaker: Garv
steps.text: Hartigen the Black Knight? I don't think so. He doesn't dress like that.

master-thieves-armband-black-arm-gang-in.text: If the player is wearing black armour:

steps.speaker: Garv
steps.text: I assume you have your I.D. papers then?
If the player has the ID papers

steps.speaker: Garv
steps.text: You'd better come in then. Grip will want to talk to you.
If the player do not have the ID papers

steps.player: Uh... yeeeeaaaaah.... about that.... I must have left them in my other suit of armour....

master-thieves-armband-black-arm-gang-re.player: Hi there. I am Hartigen. reporting for duty as your new deputy sir!

master-thieves-armband-black-arm-gang-re.speaker: Grip
master-thieves-armband-black-arm-gang-re.text: Ah good, at last. You took your time getting here! Now let me see...

master-thieves-armband-black-arm-gang-re.speaker: Grip
master-thieves-armband-black-arm-gang-re.text: I'll get your hours and duty roster sorted out in a while. Oh, and do you have your I.D. papers with you? Internal security is almost as important as external security for a guard.
If the player has the ID papers

steps.player: Right here sir!

steps.text: You hand the ID papers over to Grip.

options.text: So can I guard the treasure room please?

steps.player: So can I guard the treasure room please?

steps.speaker: Grip
steps.text: Well, I might post you outside it sometimes. I prefer to be the only one allowed inside however.

steps.speaker: Grip
steps.text: There's some pretty valuable artefacts in there! Those keys stay ONLY with the head guard and Scarface Pete.

options.text: So what do my duties involve?

steps.speaker: Grip
steps.text: You'll have various guard related duties on various shifts. I'll assign specific duties as they are required as and when they become necessary. Just so you know, if anything happens to me

steps.speaker: Grip
steps.text: you'll need to take over as head guard here. You'll find important keys to the treasure room and Pete's quarters inside my jacket - although I doubt anything bad's going to happen to

steps.speaker: Grip
steps.text: me anytime soon!
Grip laughs to himself at the thought.

options.text: So can I guard the treasure room please?
Well, I'd better sort my new room out.

steps.player: Anything I can do now?

steps.text: If the player does not have a miscellaneous key yet:

steps.speaker: Grip
steps.text: Hmm. Well, you could find out what this key opens for me. Apparently it's for something in this building, but for the life of me I can't find what.
Grip hands you a key.
a miscellaneous key
If the player has a miscellaneous key already:

steps.speaker: Grip
steps.text: Can't think of anything right now.

options.text: Well, I'd better sort my new room out.

steps.player: Well, I'd better sort my new room out.

steps.speaker: Grip
steps.text: Yeah, I'll give you time to settle in. Better get a good nights sleep, I expect you to report for duty at oh five hundred hours tomorrow on the dot!

master-thieves-armband-black-arm-gang-re.text: If the player lost the ID papers

steps.player: Oh dear... I don't have that with me anymore..

steps.speaker: Grip
steps.text: Well that's no good! Go get them immediately, then report back for duty.

master-thieves-armband-black-arm-gang-wh.player: I can't attack the head guard here! There are too many witnesses around to see me do it! I'd have the whole of Brimhaven after me! Besides, if he dies I want the promotion!

master-thieves-armband-black-arm-gang-wh.text: Perhaps you need another player's help...?
If Grip is alive and any of the pirate guards are nearby

master-thieves-armband-black-arm-gang-wh.speaker: Pirate Guard
master-thieves-armband-black-arm-gang-wh.text: I don't think Mr Grip will like you opening that. That's his private drinks cabinet.

options.text: He won't notice me having a quick look.

steps.player: He won't notice me having a quick look.

steps.speaker: Grip
steps.text: Stay out of my drinks cabinet!

steps.player: Ok, I'll leave it.

master-thieves-armband-black-arm-gang-wh.text: If there's no one to stop you:

steps.text: You find a bottle of whiskey in the cupboard.
whisky

master-thieves-armband-black-arm-gang-se.text: You find two candlesticks in the chest. So that will be one for you, and one for the person who killed Grip for you.

master-thieves-armband-black-arm-gang-at.speaker: Katrine
master-thieves-armband-black-arm-gang-at.text: I'll be giving a master thieves armband to the one who retrieved that. I know it wasn't you.

master-thieves-armband-black-arm-gang-ha.speaker: Katrine
master-thieves-armband-black-arm-gang-ha.text: This really is a FINE bit of thievery.

master-thieves-armband-black-arm-gang-ha.speaker: Katrine
master-thieves-armband-black-arm-gang-ha.text: Us thieves have been trying to get hold of this one for a while!

master-thieves-armband-black-arm-gang-ha.speaker: Katrine
master-thieves-armband-black-arm-gang-ha.text: You wanted to be ranked as a master thief didn't you? Well, I guess this just about ranks as good enough!
Katrine gives you a master thief armband.

entrana-firebird-feather-talking-to-a-mo.player: Hello, I am in search of an Entranan Firebird. Can you help me?

entrana-firebird-feather-talking-to-a-mo.speaker: Monk
entrana-firebird-feather-talking-to-a-mo.text: Oh ho! Another one! I don't think they exist, but you'd probably ask the head monk about it. If anyone would know, he would!

entrana-firebird-feather-talking-to-a-mo.speaker: Monk
entrana-firebird-feather-talking-to-a-mo.text: Anything else you wanted to know?

options.text: Can you heal me? I'm injured.
Isn't this place built a bit out the way

entrana-firebird-feather-talking-to-the-.speaker: High Priest
entrana-firebird-feather-talking-to-the-.text: Many greetings. Welcome to our fair island.

entrana-firebird-feather-talking-to-the-.player: Hello, I am in search of an Entranan Firebird. Can you help me?

entrana-firebird-feather-talking-to-the-.speaker: High Priest
entrana-firebird-feather-talking-to-the-.text: Well adventurer, I have heard that they exist on this island, but have not ever seen one myself.

entrana-firebird-feather-talking-to-the-.speaker: High Priest
entrana-firebird-feather-talking-to-the-.text: According to legend however, they are so hot that their merest touch can burn flesh.

entrana-firebird-feather-talking-to-the-.speaker: High Priest
entrana-firebird-feather-talking-to-the-.text: Apparently long ago a great hero used a pair of magical gloves, stolen from the Queen of the Ice to cool the bird down enough to catch as a pet.

entrana-firebird-feather-talking-to-the-.player: So where would I find this 'Queen of the Ice' then?

entrana-firebird-feather-talking-to-the-.speaker: High Priest
entrana-firebird-feather-talking-to-the-.text: I know not adventurer, it was just a myth I was told as a young boy. Perhaps somewhere icy?

entrana-firebird-feather-investigating-t.text: These rocks contain nothing interesting. They are just in the way.

entrana-firebird-feather-attempting-to-p.text: It is too hot to take. You need something cold to pick it up with.

cooked-lava-eel-talking-to-gerrant.speaker: Gerrant
cooked-lava-eel-talking-to-gerrant.text: Welcome! You can buy fishing equipment at my store. We'll also buy anything you catch off you.

options.text: Let's see what you've got then.
I want to find out how to catch a lava eel.

steps.player: I want to find out how to catch a lava eel.

steps.speaker: Gerrant
steps.text: Lava eels eh? That's a tricky one that is, you'll need a lava-proof fishing line. The method for making this would be to take an ordinary fishing rod, and then cover it with the fire-proof Blamish Oil.

steps.speaker: Gerrant
steps.text: You know... thinking about it... I may have a jar of Blamish Slime around here somewhere... Now where did I put it?
Gerrant searches around a bit.
Blamish snail slime

steps.speaker: Gerrant
steps.text: Aha! Here it is! Take this slime, mix it with some Harralander and water and you'll have the Blamish Oil you need for treating your fishing rod.

cooked-lava-eel-talking-to-gerrant-again.speaker: Gerrant
cooked-lava-eel-talking-to-gerrant-again.text: Welcome! You can buy fishing equipment at my store. We'll also buy anything you catch off you.

options.text: Let's see what you've got then.
I want to find out how to catch a lava eel.

steps.player: I want to find out how to catch a lava eel.

steps.speaker: Gerrant
steps.text: You'll need a lava-proof fishing line. I'm sure I already gave you what you need for this - take an ordinary fishing rod, and then cover it with the fire-proof Blamish Oil.

cooked-lava-eel-making-an-oily-fishing-r.text: You mix the slime into your potion.

cooked-lava-eel-making-an-oily-fishing-r.player: You know... I'd really rather not.

cooked-lava-eel-making-an-oily-fishing-r.text: You rub the oil into the fishing rod.

handing-in-the-items-trying-to-hand-in-a.speaker: Achietties
handing-in-the-items-trying-to-hand-in-a.text: Greetings. Welcome to the Heroes' Guild.

handing-in-the-items-trying-to-hand-in-a.player: I have a raw Lava Eel!

handing-in-the-items-trying-to-hand-in-a.speaker: Achietties
handing-in-the-items-trying-to-hand-in-a.text: That's nice. I require it to be cooked however.

handing-in-the-items-speaking-to-achiett.speaker: Achietties
handing-in-the-items-speaking-to-achiett.text: Greetings. Welcome to the Heroes' Guild.

handing-in-the-items-speaking-to-achiett.player: I have all the required items.

handing-in-the-items-speaking-to-achiett.speaker: Achietties
handing-in-the-items-speaking-to-achiett.text: I see that you have. Well done; Now, to complete the quest, and gain entry to the Heroes' Guild in your final task all that you have to do is...

handing-in-the-items-speaking-to-achiett.player: W-what? What do you mean? There's MORE???

handing-in-the-items-speaking-to-achiett.speaker: Achietties
handing-in-the-items-speaking-to-achiett.text: I'm sorry, I was just having a little fun with you. Just a little Heroes' Guild humour there. What I really meant was

handing-in-the-items-speaking-to-achiett.speaker: Achietties
handing-in-the-items-speaking-to-achiett.text: Congratulations! You have completed the Heroes' Guild entry requirements! You will find the door now open for you! Enter, Hero! And take this reward!

6FQuQb.speaker: Grubor
6FQuQb.text: Eh? What are you on about? Go away!

steps.player: Do you wish to trade?

steps.npc: Why yes, this a jewel shop after all.

options.text: Sorry I don't want to talk to you actually.

steps.player: Sorry I don't want to talk to you actually.

steps.npc: Huh! Charming!

treasure-trails-easy.text: If the reward is another clue scroll:

standard-dialogue-after-finishing-contac.npc: Hello again. How can I help you?
Things are slowly coming back to life in our city of the dead. The bank under the Temple of the Lesser Gods has been restored, and a number of our merchants have reopened their stalls.
We're making progress on them. With our citizens back, we had enough people to finally deal with the frogs and locusts that were filling the town up.
We worried they'd just come back, but perhaps we have managed to appease whichever god sent them.
The infected cows have been handled as well. The only plague left now is this infuriating pox. Still, at least it isn't contagious.

standard-dialogue-after-finishing-contac.player: Any sign of Menaphos opening up again?

standard-dialogue-after-finishing-contac.npc: They are adamant that their city must remain closed until all the plagues have gone. Until we can get rid of the pox, I can't see their gates opening to us, or to anyone else.

standard-dialogue-after-finishing-contac.player: Well at least things are moving in the right direction.

standard-dialogue-after-finishing-contac.npc: Indeed. Now, is there anything else I can do for you?

steps.player: Well I'm happy to have helped. Any news from Menaphos?

steps.npc: They are continuing their preparations. It will take some time, but the city will soon be open once more.

steps.player: Great!

standard-dialogue.npc: You offered yourself to Zulrah as a sacrifice, yet here you stand before me. Did Zulrah reject you?

steps.npc: Very funny, human, but I find that hard to believe. Go and offer yourself as a sacrifice again, before the mighty Zulrah grows impatient.

options.text: Have you any advice for surviving against Zulrah?

steps.player: Have you any advice for surviving against Zulrah?

steps.npc: I think you have misunderstood the nature of the sacrifice, human. Never mind, the mighty Zulrah will make the matter clear to you.

steps.player: Tell me about Zulrah.

steps.npc: Zulrah is the all-powerful snake god of the southern wastes. He rises from the swamp to show his divine majesty and to accept our homage.
Long ago, our forebears came to this place, not realising that they were trespassing in Zulrah's domain. He arose from the swamp in wrath, and many were slain.
But Zulrah, in his mercy, allowed some of those transgressors to live, sparing them the punishment they deserved, and allowing them the chance to repent.
Then my mother, oldest and wisest of the tribe, dared to intercede with the mighty Zulrah on behalf of her people, and thus a sacred contract was declared.
Zulrah granted us the right to dwell in his lands, and to eat of their bounty. None shall ever drive us out, for Zulrah protects us.
All he asks in return is a periodic sacrifice at his sacred shrine. As long as the sacrifices continue, Zulrah will let us live peacefully in his lands.
Willing volunteers are never hard to find, for their sacrifice buys peace for the tribe, and I grant their families extra rations of food.

options.text: Have you any advice for surviving against Zulrah?

steps.player: Who are you all?

steps.npc: The southern wastes are a perilous place where travellers often become lost. Elves from the woodland villages, gnomes from the eastern caves, and many others.
Some find their way here, like my forebears did. They eat of the sacred swamp eels that Zulrah sends, and become one with the tribe.
Their original families and tribes shun them as unclean creatures once they have tasted of the sacred swamp eels, so they remain here to worship Zulrah.

options.text: Have you any advice for surviving against Zulrah?

standard-dialogue.npc: Hello there!
Aha, interested in my crossbows are you?

They're dwarven engineering at its best. If you've got enough skill in crafting, smithing and fletching, you can even make them yourself. You can buy some of the parts here and make the rest yourself.

options.text: How do I make one for myself?

steps.player: How do I make one for myself?

steps.npc: Well, firstly you'll need to chop yourself some wood, then use a knife on the wood to whittle out a nice crossbow stock like these here.

steps.player: Wood fletched into stock... check.

steps.npc: Then get yourself some metal and a hammer and smith yourself some limbs for the bow, mind that you use the right metals and woods though as some wood is too light to use with some metal and vice versa.

steps.player: Which goes with which?

steps.npc: Wood and Bronze as they're basic materials, Oak and Blurite, Willow and Iron, Steel and Teak, Mithril and Maple, Adamantite and Mahogany and finally Runite and Yew.

steps.player: Ok, so I have my stock and a pair of limbs... what now?

steps.npc: Simply take a hammer and smack the limbs firmly onto the stock. You'll then need a string, only they're not the same as normal bows. You'll need to dry some large animal's meat to get sinew, then spin that on a spinning
wheel, it's the only thing we've found to be strong enough for a crossbow.

steps.player: What about magic logs?

steps.npc: Well.. I don't rightly know... us dwarves don't work with magic, we prefer gold and rock. Much more stable. I guess you could ask the humans at the rangers guild to see if they can do something but I don't want
anything to do with it!

steps.player: Thanks for telling me. Bye!

steps.npc: Take care, straight shooting.

steps.player: What about ammo?

steps.npc: You can smith yourself lots of different bolts, don't forget to flight them with feathers like you do arrows though. You can poison any untipped bolt but there's also the option of tipping them with gems then

steps.player: What's through those broken bars?

steps.npc: Well, my intrepid friend, through those broken bars lies a most remarkable discovery! I named it Scurrius, The Rat King!
This is no ordinary rat. It is a magnificent creature of evolution, forged by the unwitting contributions of adventurers who entered its cave.
It absorbed their combat abilities, transforming itself into an obscene monster. Nature's response to intrusion, you might say! How utterly fascinating!
Ahem, anyway you'll be absolutely fine, of course! Your victory awaits, I'm sure. I shall observe your progress with interest... for science, you know.
Oh, and if you happen to come across Scurrius' spine, please bring it to me.

before-completion-of-tale-of-the-righteo.player: Hello. What are you doing here?

before-completion-of-tale-of-the-righteo.npc: Duffy's the name. I'm a natural historian from Varrock Museum. My team and I are here to explore this mountain.

before-completion-of-tale-of-the-righteo.player: It's just an old mountain isn't it? What natural history are you hoping to find here?

before-completion-of-tale-of-the-righteo.npc: Bahaha, you adventurers are all the same, never seeing past the fights and treasure...
This Mountain is steeped in natural history, but our main focus is to study the lizard creatures that surround this area.
Indeed, they're a fascinating species! We're hoping to learn about their origins and how they've evolved.
However, we're not very familiar with this region so we've enlisted the help of the Kourend Grand Library to aid us in our research.

before-completion-of-tale-of-the-righteo.player: What have you learned so far?

before-completion-of-tale-of-the-righteo.npc: Well, we have a theory that lizard creatures aren't natural at all, but were created by dark magical experiments.
Right now we're looking for evidence to prove this theory, but's it's proving somewhat difficult.
No thanks adventurer, natural history studies are delicate and precise... but if we ever need something haphazardly destroyed we'll let you know.

before-completion-of-tale-of-the-righteo.player: Not all adventurers only care about fighting, you know... I was only offering to help.

before-completion-of-tale-of-the-righteo.npc: We don't need your help. Run along now, go and play in the dungeons with the other adventurers. I hear they're full of monsters to fight!
Try not to get yourself killed, it would be such a tragedy!

after-completion-of-tale-of-the-righteou.npc: Good thanks. Now that we've found this cave, we're learning more about the lizardmen than ever before.

as Aristarchus in Pollnivneach, Varmen and, of course, Anna Jones. Anyway, we think we have discovered an island that has massive archaeological significance. We can't say much beyond that at this point, as we haven't
researched it. If you have the qualifications and help us out around the museum, I'm sure we could offer you a place on the dig when we're ready to go.
