steps.speaker: Morris
steps.text: Move on through. Talk to Bonzo to enter the competition.

keys-to-the-crypt-opening-the-gate-next-.text: If the player does not have a Fishing pass:

options.text: I don't have one of them.
What do I need that for?
I need to catch a Hemenster Whitefish.

steps.player: I need to catch a Hemenster Whitefish.

steps.speaker: Morris
steps.text: Whitefish, eh? Okay, since you've won the competition before, I'll let you in.

keys-to-the-crypt-talking-to-aggie-while.speaker: Aggie
keys-to-the-crypt-talking-to-aggie-while.text: What can I help you with?

options.text: What could you make for me?
Cool, do you turn people into frogs?
You mad old witch, you can't help me.
Can you make dyes for me please?

steps.player: Can you make dyes for me please?

steps.speaker: Aggie
steps.text: What sort of dye would you like? Red, yellow or blue?

options.text: What do you need to make red dye?
What do you need to make yellow dye?
What do you need to make blue dye?
Could you remove the dye from this goblin mail?

steps.player: Could you remove the dye from this goblin mail?

keys-to-the-crypt-using-goblin-mail-on-a.player: Could you remove the dye from this goblin mail?

keys-to-the-crypt-using-goblin-mail-on-a.text: If the player has enough coins:

steps.text: You hand the goblin mail, whitefish, and payment to Aggie. She uses the whitefish to remove the dye from the goblin mail and then hands it back to you.

keys-to-the-crypt-using-goblin-mail-on-a.text: If the player does not have enough coins:

steps.player: I don't have that much money on me.

keys-to-the-crypt-using-goblin-mail-on-a.player: Could you remove the dye from this goblin mail?

keys-to-the-crypt-using-goblin-mail-on-a.speaker: Aggie
keys-to-the-crypt-using-goblin-mail-on-a.text: You'll need to go and get a Hemenster Whitefish first.

keys-to-the-crypt-using-goblin-mail-on-a.player: Yeah, I was just about to do that.

keys-to-the-crypt-using-whitefish-on-agg.player: Could you remove the dye from this goblin mail?
Oh, right. I'll go and get some.

keys-to-the-crypt-using-white-goblin-mai.player: Could you remove the dye from this goblin mail?

keys-to-the-crypt-using-white-goblin-mai.speaker: Aggie
keys-to-the-crypt-using-white-goblin-mai.text: That goblin mail is already white.

keys-to-the-crypt-talking-to-the-tribe-p.speaker: Priest
keys-to-the-crypt-talking-to-the-tribe-p.text: Listen! Whoever does not worship Big High War God, whether great or small, goblin or other, must die!

keys-to-the-crypt-talking-to-the-tribe-p.speaker: Priest
keys-to-the-crypt-talking-to-the-tribe-p.text: If another goblin tell you to worship different gods, you not listen to them! You kill them! All tribe kill them!

keys-to-the-crypt-talking-to-the-tribe-p.speaker: Priest
keys-to-the-crypt-talking-to-the-tribe-p.text: Kill peoples who worship different gods! Smite them! Destroy them! Do not show mercy!

keys-to-the-crypt-talking-to-the-tribe-p.speaker: Priest
keys-to-the-crypt-talking-to-the-tribe-p.text: Enemies must die! Doubters must die! These words of Big High War God!

keys-to-the-crypt-talking-to-the-tribe-p.speaker: Priest
keys-to-the-crypt-talking-to-the-tribe-p.text: Remember, we holy people of Big High War God! He chose us to be special people, better than all people in world!

keys-to-the-crypt-talking-to-the-tribe-p.speaker: Priest
keys-to-the-crypt-talking-to-the-tribe-p.text: Big High War God not choose us because we many, or because we strong. We nothing before he choose us! But he take us from Yu'biusk with mighty hand, and make us strong!

keys-to-the-crypt-talking-to-the-tribe-p.speaker: Priest
keys-to-the-crypt-talking-to-the-tribe-p.text: Soon Big High War God send Chosen Commander!

keys-to-the-crypt-talking-to-the-tribe-p.speaker: Priest
keys-to-the-crypt-talking-to-the-tribe-p.text: I tell you truth! There some goblins here who not die before they see Chosen Commander coming with glory of Big High War God!

keys-to-the-crypt-talking-to-the-tribe-p.speaker: Priest
keys-to-the-crypt-talking-to-the-tribe-p.text: Then Chosen Commander lead goblins into war as one army, and we kill every other race and all followers of other gods!

keys-to-the-crypt-talking-to-the-tribe-p.speaker: Priest
keys-to-the-crypt-talking-to-the-tribe-p.text: Then Big High War God himself return and sit on throne of bronze and rull over all!

keys-to-the-crypt-talking-to-the-tribe-p.speaker: Priest
keys-to-the-crypt-talking-to-the-tribe-p.text: Let me tell you story about Hopespear! He prophet of Big High War God! He very holy goblin!

keys-to-the-crypt-talking-to-the-tribe-p.speaker: Priest
keys-to-the-crypt-talking-to-the-tribe-p.text: When Hopespear old, he walking near Goblin Village, and little goblin children came out of village and make fun of him.

keys-to-the-crypt-talking-to-the-tribe-p.speaker: Priest
keys-to-the-crypt-talking-to-the-tribe-p.text: The he look at them, and curse them in name of Big High War God. Then monsters come and tear children to pieces!

keys-to-the-crypt-talking-to-the-tribe-p.speaker: Priest
keys-to-the-crypt-talking-to-the-tribe-p.text: May Big High War God give you faith!

keys-to-the-crypt-talking-to-the-tribe-p.speaker: Priest
keys-to-the-crypt-talking-to-the-tribe-p.text: Before you enter battle, clear mind of thought. Do not think about what you will do or what may happen.

keys-to-the-crypt-talking-to-the-tribe-p.speaker: Priest
keys-to-the-crypt-talking-to-the-tribe-p.text: When battle start, Big High War God guide your arm and fill your heart with courage.

keys-to-the-crypt-talking-to-the-tribe-p.speaker: Priest
keys-to-the-crypt-talking-to-the-tribe-p.text: Have faith in Big High War God. He rule all war, so whatever happen in war, it his will.

keys-to-the-crypt-talking-to-the-tribe-p.speaker: Priest
keys-to-the-crypt-talking-to-the-tribe-p.text: Goblins great nation in time of great war!

keys-to-the-crypt-talking-to-the-tribe-p.speaker: Priest
keys-to-the-crypt-talking-to-the-tribe-p.text: Big High War God himself lead us into battle! Then we crush enemies, we burn cities to ground, we kill every man, woman and child! Even animals!

keys-to-the-crypt-talking-to-the-tribe-p.speaker: Priest
keys-to-the-crypt-talking-to-the-tribe-p.text: Some enemies, we kill them so bad, now there no trace and no one ever remember them! That what happen to enemies of Big High War God!

high-priests-of-ages-past-snothead.speaker: Snothead
high-priests-of-ages-past-snothead.text: You beat me. What you want?

steps.player: Where is Yu'biusk?

steps.speaker: Snothead
steps.text: It long way away. Me not know where. High priest who come before me, he say that when goblins die we go to Yu'biusk. Perhaps he know where it is.

steps.player: What was your predecessor's name?

steps.speaker: Snothead
steps.text: Snailfeet. That his name.

steps.player: Why did you attack me?

steps.speaker: Snothead
steps.text: You not goblin. Not high priest. So me attack.

steps.player: What's it like being dead?

steps.speaker: Snothead
steps.text: It dark. Very dark. And cold.

steps.player: Goodbye.

high-priests-of-ages-past-snailfeet.speaker: Snailfeet
high-priests-of-ages-past-snailfeet.text: You beaten me. Ask your questions.

steps.player: Where is Yu'biusk?

steps.speaker: Snailfeet
steps.text: Far, far away. Me not know where. But high priest who come before me, he say that when goblins die in battle, our souls travel to Yu'biusk.

steps.player: What was your predecessor's name?

steps.speaker: Snailfeet
steps.text: Mosschin.

steps.player: Why did you attack me?

steps.speaker: Snailfeet
steps.text: You not goblin high priest! Me only answer questions for goblin high priest!

steps.player: What's it like being dead?

steps.speaker: Snailfeet
steps.text: Why me here? Me die in battle, fighting humans! Why me not in Yu'biusk?

steps.player: Goodbye.

high-priests-of-ages-past-mosschin.speaker: Mosschin
high-priests-of-ages-past-mosschin.text: You have defeated me, human. Ask your questions.

steps.player: Where is Yu'biusk?

steps.speaker: Mosschin
steps.text: Far beyond this world. Long ago, the Big High War God brought goblins from Yu'biusk.

steps.speaker: Mosschin
steps.text: The high priest who came before me said that whenever goblins die in battle and their blood spills onto the ground, Yu'biusk is close and their souls can travel there.

steps.player: What was your predecessor's name?

steps.speaker: Mosschin
steps.text: Redeyes.

steps.player: Why did you attack me?

steps.speaker: Mosschin
steps.text: I only answer questions for those who are worthy! I had to test you!

steps.player: What's it like being dead?

steps.speaker: Mosschin
steps.text: All alone. I thought my soul would travel to Yu'biusk. But perhaps I was not worthy.

steps.player: Goodbye.

steps.speaker: Mosschin
steps.text: Goodbye, human.

high-priests-of-ages-past-redeyes.speaker: Redeyes
high-priests-of-ages-past-redeyes.text: You have defeated me, human. Ask your questions.

steps.player: Where is Yu'biusk?

steps.speaker: Redeyes
steps.text: Yu'biusk is far away. Beyond the icelands to the north, beyond the mountains to the west, beyond the oceans to the south and the deserts to the east.

steps.speaker: Redeyes
steps.text: But it is also close. Wherever goblins fight in the name of the Big High War God and their blood spills on the ground, Yu'biusk is close.

steps.speaker: Redeyes
steps.text: My predecessor told me that no living goblin has ever gone to Yu'biusk. If no living goblin can go there, then perhaps the dead can.

steps.player: What was your predecessor's name?

steps.speaker: Redeyes
steps.text: Strongbones. He was a mighty high priest and warrior of the Big High War God. It was he who learned the magic that allows us to be called up to speak with the living.

steps.player: Why did you attack me?

steps.speaker: Redeyes
steps.text: You are not a goblin high priest, so I had to see if you were worthy.

steps.player: What's it like being dead?

steps.speaker: Redeyes
steps.text: I had thought perhaps I would go to Yu'biusk, to fight in endless battles for the Big High War God. Instead, there is only endless sleep.

steps.player: Goodbye.

steps.speaker: Redeyes
steps.text: Good luck in your quest, human.

high-priests-of-ages-past-strongbones.speaker: Strongbones
high-priests-of-ages-past-strongbones.text: You have proved yourself the stronger, human. Ask your questions.

steps.player: Where is Yu'biusk?

steps.speaker: Strongbones
steps.text: Yu'biusk is another plane of existence. No goblin alive today has ever been there.

steps.speaker: Strongbones
steps.text: It is many millennia since the Big High War God brought our ancestors from Yu'biusk, but the call to that plane is still strong in us.

steps.speaker: Strongbones
steps.text: If the barriers between the planes were ever to be broken, goblin blood would call out and open a portal to Yu'biusk.

steps.player: What was your predecessor's name?

steps.speaker: Strongbones
steps.text: His name is not important. He is not buried here. Before my time, priests were cremated, and their ashes scattered to the winds. You cannot talk to him.

steps.player: Why did you attack me?

steps.speaker: Strongbones
steps.text: You are a human, not one of the children of the Big High War God. For this reason, you had to prove yourself in combat before I could speak with you.

steps.player: What's it like being dead?

steps.speaker: Strongbones
steps.text: I cannot tell you. I no longer remember what it is like to be alive.

steps.player: Goodbye.

steps.speaker: Strongbones
steps.text: Goodbye, human. I am sure that the Chosen Commander will find what she is looking for when you bring her to Yu'biusk.

steps.player: Wait... What?

path-to-yu-biusk-returning-to-dorgesh-ka.speaker: Zanik
path-to-yu-biusk-returning-to-dorgesh-ka.text: You're back! Any luck at the temple? Have you found out where Yu'biusk is?

path-to-yu-biusk-returning-to-dorgesh-ka.player: Sort of. I've discovered that Yu'biusk is another plane of existence. Apparently if the barriers between the planes are breached, goblin blood will call out to Yu'biusk and create a portal leading there.

path-to-yu-biusk-returning-to-dorgesh-ka.speaker: Oldak
path-to-yu-biusk-returning-to-dorgesh-ka.text: Another plane? You mean goblins aren't native to Gielinor? That's remarkable. Think of the historical implications...

path-to-yu-biusk-returning-to-dorgesh-ka.player: But how could we breach the barriers between the planes?

path-to-yu-biusk-returning-to-dorgesh-ka.speaker: Zanik
path-to-yu-biusk-returning-to-dorgesh-ka.text: I know! The fungus ring in the southern caves! Didn't you say that had magical properties, Oldak?

path-to-yu-biusk-returning-to-dorgesh-ka.speaker: Oldak
path-to-yu-biusk-returning-to-dorgesh-ka.text: Yes... that sample you showed me had very similar properties to Law runes. I believe that the fungus ring could create an effect similar to my moving-over-distance spheres.

path-to-yu-biusk-returning-to-dorgesh-ka.player: Fungus ring? That sounds like a fairy ring. They're part of a big teleportation network.

path-to-yu-biusk-returning-to-dorgesh-ka.speaker: Zanik
path-to-yu-biusk-returning-to-dorgesh-ka.text: Well that confirms it then. This fungus ring might be just what we need!

path-to-yu-biusk-returning-to-dorgesh-ka.speaker: Oldak
path-to-yu-biusk-returning-to-dorgesh-ka.text: If the ring can create a moving-over-distance effect... then with enough power, we should be able to use it to break the planar barriers.

path-to-yu-biusk-returning-to-dorgesh-ka.speaker: Oldak
path-to-yu-biusk-returning-to-dorgesh-ka.text: Then we just need goblin blood to call out to Yu'biusk!

path-to-yu-biusk-returning-to-dorgesh-ka.speaker: Zanik
path-to-yu-biusk-returning-to-dorgesh-ka.text: Well I reckon we've got plenty of that.

path-to-yu-biusk-returning-to-dorgesh-ka.speaker: Zanik
path-to-yu-biusk-returning-to-dorgesh-ka.text: I can't believe this! The goblin homeland! This could be somewhere safe for goblins like Grubfoot. A new home, free of war!

path-to-yu-biusk-returning-to-dorgesh-ka.speaker: Zanik
path-to-yu-biusk-returning-to-dorgesh-ka.text: Could this be it, [player name]? Could this be my destiny? Could this be why I was marked by the Tears of Guthix?

path-to-yu-biusk-returning-to-dorgesh-ka.speaker: Oldak
path-to-yu-biusk-returning-to-dorgesh-ka.text: We should see if this works before we tell anyone else. Now, I think I can create some apparatus to provide power to the fungus ring.

path-to-yu-biusk-returning-to-dorgesh-ka.speaker: Oldak
path-to-yu-biusk-returning-to-dorgesh-ka.text: Come on, Zanik. [player name], will you meet us by the fungus ring to the south of the city?

path-to-yu-biusk-talking-to-zanik.speaker: Zanik
path-to-yu-biusk-talking-to-zanik.text: Hey, [player name]. This is incredible! I can't believe we're really going to go to Yu'biusk, the Land of the Goblins!

path-to-yu-biusk-talking-to-zanik.player: What do you think we'll find there?

path-to-yu-biusk-talking-to-zanik.speaker: Zanik
path-to-yu-biusk-talking-to-zanik.text: I don't know. All we have to go on is Grubfoot's dream, which isn't much. Still, not long now until we find out!

path-to-yu-biusk-talking-to-zanik.speaker: Zanik
path-to-yu-biusk-talking-to-zanik.text: Anyway, you should help Oldak out with the machine. He wants me to stand here so that when the portal opens, it'll have a goblin right next to it.

path-to-yu-biusk-talking-to-oldak.speaker: Oldak
path-to-yu-biusk-talking-to-oldak.text: Ah, [player name]. The machine is nearly ready. When I activate it, it will bombard the fungus ring with magical energy.

path-to-yu-biusk-talking-to-oldak.speaker: Oldak
path-to-yu-biusk-talking-to-oldak.text: For this to work, we'll need to make sure the power is distributed correctly between the three circles of fungi. I need to handle the activation. [player name], could you please handle the power distribution?

path-to-yu-biusk-talking-to-oldak.speaker: Oldak
path-to-yu-biusk-talking-to-oldak.text: The inner circle has a radius of one zurg, the middle circle has a radius of two zurgs, and the outer circle has a radius of three zurgs. You will need to distribute the power in proportion to the area of each circle.

through-the-fungus-ring-activating-the-m.text: The screen fades to black. The player, Zanik, and Oldak arrive at a barren wasteland.

through-the-fungus-ring-activating-the-m.speaker: Oldak
through-the-fungus-ring-activating-the-m.text: Something must have gone wrong. This isn't what Grubfoot described.

through-the-fungus-ring-activating-the-m.speaker: Oldak
through-the-fungus-ring-activating-the-m.text: I don't understand. What happened here?

through-the-fungus-ring-activating-the-m.speaker: Zanik
through-the-fungus-ring-activating-the-m.text: We must be missing something. This can't be it...

through-the-fungus-ring-activating-the-m.speaker: Oldak
through-the-fungus-ring-activating-the-m.text: I'll stay here and keep an eye on the portal.

through-the-fungus-ring-talking-to-oldak.speaker: Oldak
through-the-fungus-ring-talking-to-oldak.text: You should have a look around and see if you can find out anything about this place. I'll stay here and keep an eye on the portal.

through-the-fungus-ring-talking-to-oldak.speaker: Oldak
through-the-fungus-ring-talking-to-oldak.text: [player name]. We should head back through the portal. Zanik is waiting on the other side.

through-the-fungus-ring-talking-to-oldak.speaker: Oldak
through-the-fungus-ring-talking-to-oldak.text: Don't go too far! I don't know how stable this portal is!

through-the-fungus-ring-talking-to-zanik.speaker: Zanik
through-the-fungus-ring-talking-to-zanik.text: There must be something around here. It can't all be dead... can it?

through-the-fungus-ring-talking-to-grubf.speaker: Grubfoot
through-the-fungus-ring-talking-to-grubf.text: Did you go to Land of Goblins?

through-the-fungus-ring-talking-to-grubf.player: Yes, but we haven't properly explored it yet.

steps.speaker: General Bentnoze
steps.text: Shut up Grubfoot!

steps.speaker: General Wartface
steps.text: Shut up Grubfoot!

through-the-fungus-ring-a-strange-box.speaker: Zanik
through-the-fungus-ring-a-strange-box.text: This is really it, isn't it? Grubfoot's dream was just that, a dream. All Yu'biusk is now is an empty wasteland.

through-the-fungus-ring-a-strange-box.player: I don't understand... What happened here?

through-the-fungus-ring-a-strange-box.speaker: Zanik
through-the-fungus-ring-a-strange-box.text: The Big High War God happened.

through-the-fungus-ring-a-strange-box.speaker: Zanik
through-the-fungus-ring-a-strange-box.text: I thought this might be it, [player name]. I really did. I thought this place might finally give me some answers, but it's just another dead end.

through-the-fungus-ring-a-strange-box.speaker: Zanik
through-the-fungus-ring-a-strange-box.text: Let's have a look at what this box is, then let's go home. There's nothing here for anyone any more.
The player and Zanik push off the cover of the strange box. Suddenly, Zanik is surrounded by energy emanating from the box.
Zanik is sucked into the strange box.

through-the-fungus-ring-a-strange-box.speaker: Oldak
through-the-fungus-ring-a-strange-box.text: The portal is closing! You've got to get back now!
The player quickly returns to Oldak.

through-the-fungus-ring-a-strange-box.speaker: Oldak
through-the-fungus-ring-a-strange-box.text: [player name]? What's going on? Where's Zanik?

through-the-fungus-ring-a-strange-box.player: I don't know... She just disappeared...

through-the-fungus-ring-a-strange-box.speaker: Oldak
through-the-fungus-ring-a-strange-box.text: The portal... We have to go.
The player enters the portal, arriving back at Oldak's lab.

options.text: What are we going to do about Zanik?
options.condition: If the player has not yet traveled to Yu'biusk via fairy ring:

steps.player: What are we going to do about Zanik?

steps.speaker: Oldak
steps.text: We can only assume she's still in Yu'biusk somewhere. Problem is, I haven't been able to get the fungus ring machine working again.

steps.player: So there's no way back?

steps.speaker: Oldak
steps.text: Perhaps not. Still, now that we've broken the planar barriers between Gielinor and Yu'biusk, maybe we've enabled some alternate methods of transport there.

steps.speaker: Oldak
steps.text: Those fungus rings would be a good starting point. Maybe you could use one of them to find another way to Yu'biusk. In the meantime, I'll keep trying to get the machine working again.

options.text: I managed to get back to Yu'biusk.
options.condition: If the player has traveled to Yu'biusk via fairy ring:

steps.player: I managed to get back to Yu'biusk.

steps.speaker: Oldak
steps.text: You did? Did you find anything there? Was there any trace of Zanik?

steps.player: No, there was nothing.

steps.speaker: Oldak
steps.text: Then it's just as I feared. It seems that whatever's happened to Zanik, wherever she is... she's on her own.

steps.player: I will find her, Oldak.

steps.speaker: Oldak
steps.text: I know you will, [player name].

options.text: Can I buy a teleport sphere please?

post-quest-dialogue-grubfoot.speaker: Grubfoot
post-quest-dialogue-grubfoot.text: Did you go to Land of Goblins?

post-quest-dialogue-grubfoot.player: Yes, but it wasn't how you'd dreamed. It was a devastated wasteland.

post-quest-dialogue-grubfoot.speaker: Grubfoot
post-quest-dialogue-grubfoot.text: Yu'biusk... Land of Goblins... All gone?

post-quest-dialogue-grubfoot.player: I'm afraid so. And that's not all. Zanik vanished there.
Yes. A bright white light picked her up and then she was gone.

post-quest-dialogue-grubfoot.speaker: Grubfoot
post-quest-dialogue-grubfoot.text: She not gone. I sure of it. Someday she return.

steps.speaker: General Bentnoze
steps.text: Shut up Grubfoot!

steps.speaker: General Wartface
steps.text: Shut up Grubfoot!

standard-dialogue.npc: Good day, how may I help you?

steps.player: What is this place?

steps.npc: This is the great Castle Wars arena! Here you can fight for the glory of Saradomin or Zamorak.

options.text: Really, how do I do that?

steps.player: Really, how do I do that?

steps.npc: Easy, you just step through one of the three portals. To join Zamorak, pass through the red portal. To join Saradomin, pass through the blue portal. If you don't mind then pass through the green portal.

steps.player: Are there any rules?

steps.npc: Of course, there are always rules. Firstly you can't wear a cape as you enter the portal, you'll be given your team colours to wear while in the arena. You're also prohibited from taking non-combat related items in with you. So you should only have equipment, potions, and runes on you. Secondly, attacking your own team or your team's defences isn't allowed. You don't want to be angering your patron god, do you? Other than that, just have fun and enjoy it!

steps.player: Great! Oh, how do I win the game?

steps.npc: The aim is to get into your opponents' castle and take their team standard. Then bring that back and capture it on your team's standard.

steps.player: What can I win?

steps.npc: Players on the winning team will receive 2 Castle Wars Tickets which you can trade back to me for other items. In the event of a draw every player will get 1 ticket.

options.text: Take a look at this dead chicken I've got.
options.condition: If the player has any of Ava's devices in their inventory

steps.player: Take a look at this dead chicken I've got.

steps.text: If the player has not shown the Ava's device to Lanthus before:

steps.npc: ... I'm looking at the dead chicken. Why am I looking at the dead chicken?

steps.player: It's a special device, invented by a friend of mine. If I'm wearing it while ranging, it uses magnets to retrieve some of my ammunition.

steps.npc: Oh. Gosh. That's clever. So are you wanting to take it into Castle Wars? The gods expect people to fight in the team capes.

steps.player: Can they be a bit more flexible, please?

steps.npc: I'll ask. Hold on a minute...
... (Lanthus communes with the gods.)

options.text: Who are you and why are you here?

steps.player: Who are you and why are you here?

steps.npc: Once I was a merchant. I worked hard and became wealthy, very wealthy. I was brave too, storing my possessions in two great chests here, where few would dare to interfere with them.
But I was not strong enough. One day a witch allied with the pirates of the north; between their strength and her magic, they killed me. The pirates carried one of my chests away to their ship.
I keep vigil here now, as it interests me to watch adventurers come to raid this little chest, whenever they can find one of my keys.
My bigger chest was taken north to the pirates' ship - a brave adventurer may like to raid that one instead, if they can handle the perils of the north. I kept more wealth in that one.

options.condition: If the player has a Larran's key in their inventory:

steps.player: I've got your key.

steps.npc: Well done, adventurer. I have two chests, containing my wealth from the days when I was alive. The smaller one is here, and the bigger one was taken far to the north, to the pirates' ship.
You can use the key to open either of them. The bigger one, in the pirates' ship, contains more wealth than this small one.

steps.player: Can you give me anything?

steps.npc: If you want my worldly goods, open my chests with my keys. Adventurers occasionally find my keys while slaying monsters in the Wilderness, on assignment from the witch Krystilia.
I do not know why Krystilia sends adventurers to find my keys instead of looting the chest herself. Perhaps it amuses her to send people into this land to risk their lives.

steps.player: I'll leave you to it.

steps.npc: I will be here if you return.

before-horror-from-the-deep.npc: Oh, thank Armadyl! I am in such a worry... please help me!

steps.player: With what?

steps.npc: Oh... it is terrible... horrible... My boyfriend lives here in this lighthouse, but I haven't seen him the last few days! I think something terrible has happened!
Look, you can see for yourself that the light has gone out, and the front door is locked up tight! He would NEVER do that!
With the light off this coastline is terribly dangerous to ships! And to lock the front door so that nobody can turn the light back on?

steps.player: Maybe he just went on holiday or something? Must be pretty boring living in a lighthouse.

steps.npc: That is terribly irresponsible! He is far too thoughtful for that! He would never leave it unattended! He would also never leave without telling me!
Please, I know something terrible has happened to him... I can sense it! Please... please help me adventurer!

steps.player: But how can I help?

steps.npc: Well, we have to do something to get the lighthouse working again! Also, as you may have noticed, the storm that knocked the bridge out
has trapped me on this causeway! You seem to have got here okay somehow, so if you could go and visit my cousin and get the spare key I left him,
as well as fix the bridge enough so that I can go and speak to my family in Rellekka and tell them whats happened, I will be eternally grateful!

steps.prompt: Start the Horror from the Deep quest?

steps.npc: OH! THANK YOU SO MUCH! I know my darling would never have left with the lighthouse lights off and without even telling me where he's gone!

steps.player: Where is your cousin?

I don't exactly know where he has gone, but I am sure he went somewhere to practise his agility. If you see him, his name is Gunnjorn. Mention my name, he will recognise it.

steps.npc: Well, I am not just some helpless girl! I have pretty good agility, so you will only need to use two planks to make a ledge that I can balance along.

options.text: I heard about your ship, can you tell me what happened?

steps.player: I heard about your ship. Can you tell me what happened?

steps.npc: Aye, I can tell ye what happened.
We be out on our fortnightly fishin' trip, I was doin' me normal work. Setting up the nets, swabbing the deck and the like.
'Twas a good hawl t' start, plenty of manta ray and snappers. But we would be movin' on the next day to our deep sea fishin' spot.
'Twas nothin' but smooth sailin' to our deep sea spot near Karamja, but on the way I noticed more debris in the water than usual.

steps.player: What kind of debris? Was it ship debris?

steps.npc: Aye, 'twas. Most of the time, it be nets or items people throw off ships that they don't need. This had me worried a bit.
There was a lack of fish in the water, 'twas kind of... eerie.
The next day, Koanee changed the ship's course, but that be because of a storm on the horizon.
But the storm seemed t' be... following us. As if it had a mind of its own.
The wind started a blowin' and the fog started a showin', huge waves crashing against the boat.
The ship started fallin' apart. I rushed to the cook's quarters and found 'im layin' on the floor with a plank over 'im.
I brought 'im up to the top deck and tied 'im to a piece of loose wood. I did the same t' the Skipper and Navigator.

steps.player: Oh my, that's awful! You're very lucky you didn't get hit.

steps.npc: Aye, it be lucky indeed. But that not be the end of it. As the ship finished sinking, I balanced out the wood so we did not slip.
In the distance I saw glowing eyes and a large monster sorta thing in the fog movin' t'wards us.
But all of a sudden, it vanished. I then had to keep us afloat 'till we made it t' shore by Al Kharid.
Pudi gathered us up and we went t' the Chancellor as soon as we could stand.
These ruins turned out t' be a great base to research the beast from undisturbed! Bit close to Menaphos though, aye?
That be the end of me story. Can I help ye with anything else?

options.text: A pirate doing paperwork, that's new.

steps.npc: Let me guess, ye thought we be doin' nothing but pluderin' and pillagin'?

steps.npc: Hello there. Do you have any questions about Leagues?

steps.player: What's a League?

steps.npc: Leagues are time-limited challenges that provide a unique twist on the world you know and love.
With each League, you start afresh, with a limited amount of time to progress through the League.

steps.player: A fresh start? Why would I want that?

steps.npc: Glory, rewards, and the chance to do things in a different way!
First up, the glory. Within a League, you can earn League Points by completing various tasks.
The more points you have, the better League Rank you will be given.
Each League Rank will unlock a trophy for you. These trophies can be used to show off your accomplishments.
If that doesn't interest you, perhaps another reward might be more appealing? League Points can be used to buy things from the Leagues Reward Shop.
You can keep these purchases for yourself or sell them on to others!

steps.player: And if glory and rewards don't interest me?

steps.npc: Every League has unique rules and features. It's a very different world from the one you're used to.
For one thing, within the Leagues, you can unlock powerful artefacts known as Relics which completely change the way you progress.
So even if glory and rewards aren't your thing, you'll still find Leagues to be a whole lot of fun!

steps.player: I see, thanks for the information.

steps.npc: My pleasure!

options.text: Is there currently a League running?

steps.player: Is there currently a League running?

steps.npc: Yes! The current League is Leagues IV: Trailblazer Reloaded.
Within this League you are restricted to certain regions around Gielinor - although you'll get to choose which ones.
You can also collect powerful artefacts known as Relics. Each one provides a different buff to your League experience.
I heard there's one that lets you note items wherever you want, and one that makes shops free!
One other thing. You must participate as an Iron Man. This means you stand alone and cannot trade with other participants.

steps.player: Interesting. Maybe I should take part!

steps.npc: I'd highly recommend it!

steps.text: To take part in a League, you must be on a Leagues World. The world switcher in the logout menu can be used to switch worlds.

options.text: Can I purchase some League rewards?

steps.player: Can I purchase some League rewards?

steps.player: How do League Trophies work?

steps.npc: League Trophies are a representation of how well you did in a specific League. Performance is judged on the number of League Points you earned.
There are seven tiers of League Trophy: Bronze, Iron, Steel, Mithril, Adamant, Rune and Dragon.

The Mithril Trophy cut-off is 1,770 points. The Adamant Trophy cut-off is 5,270 points. The Rune Trophy cut-off is 10,820 points.
Finally, the Dragon Trophy cut-off is 20,830 points.

steps.player: What's a League?

steps.npc: Leagues are time-limited challenges that provide a unique twist on the world you know and love.
With each League, you start afresh, with a limited amount of time to progress through the League.

steps.player: A fresh start? Why would I want that?

steps.npc: Glory, rewards, and the chance to do things in a different way!
First up, the glory. Within a League, you can earn League Points by completing various tasks.
The more points you have, the better League Rank you will be given.

steps.player: And if glory and rewards don't interest me?

steps.player: I see, thanks for the information.

steps.player: Is there currently a League running?

steps.npc: Yes! The current League is Leagues V: Raging Echoes.
This League features powerful boss variants in each region, and Combat Masteries to enhance your chosen combat style's strengths.
As usual, you are restricted to certain regions around Gielinor - although you'll get to choose which ones.
You can also collect powerful artifacts known as Relics. Each one provides a different buff to your League experience.
There's one that lets you keep a kingdom in your pocket, and one that lets you become a Slayer Master!
One other thing. You must participate as an Ironman. This means you stand alone and cannot trade with other participants.

steps.player: Interesting. Maybe I should take part!

steps.npc: I'd highly recommend it!

steps.text: To take part in a League, you must be on a Leagues World. The world switcher in the logout menu can be used to switch worlds.

standard-dialogue-leagues-worlds.npc: Hello mortal. What do you seek?

options.text: What changes have been made for this League?

steps.player: What changes have been made for this League?

steps.npc: The great and terrible demon Yama has bound this League to his will.
Once again, regions contain monstrous Echo Bosses that can be defeated to earn unique and powerful rewards.
Yama, in his wisdom, has granted you the ability to augment your powers through Demonic Pacts. You may earn Demonic Pact points by completing Demonic Pact tasks.
Unlike before, you'll initially be restricted to the single Region of Varlamore. However, as you progress, you'll be able to unlock new areas of your choosing.
Be warned though - you won't be able to unlock every area, so choose wisely.
Additionally, Misthalin will not be available at all this League, and once you reach the first task threshold Karamja will be unlocked for free.
You must participate as an Ironman. This means you stand alone and cannot trade with other participants.
And that's not all. Training skills during the League will grant you substantially more experience than you'd normally expect.
These experience increases are known as passive effects, which get more generous the higher your Relic tier.
Finally, some quests have been completed for you automatically. Further quests and more will be completed as you unlock the relevant areas.
I think that covers the basics. Would you like to know more, [player name]?

steps.text: Opens Leagues Info panel

steps.player: Not right now.

steps.npc: Is there anything else you need from me?

options.text: Can you tell me about Demonic Pacts?

steps.player: Can you tell me about Demonic Pacts?

steps.npc: Demonic Pacts are new powers granted by Yama that modify and improve your combat abilities for the entire League.

steps.player: Why would Yama want to give me more power?

steps.npc: It wouldn't be very entertaining to see you go up against Echo Bosses with your mortal prowess now would it?
At least, not for very long. Death comes easily to your kind.

steps.player: I see.

steps.npc: You can earn Demonic Pact points by completing specific combat tasks.
These points can be spent to unlock abilities and progress through the pacts in a manner that suits your preference for combat.
There are many choices available, but you will not be able to select them all. Plan ahead and choose wisely.
Now, would you like to take a look at the Demonic Pacts available to you?

steps.text: Opens Leagues Demonic Pacts panel

steps.player: Not right now.

steps.npc: Very well. Is there anything else you need from me?

steps.player: How do tasks work?

steps.npc: In every League, there are a number of tasks for you to complete. Each task has a level of difficulty: Easy, Medium, Hard, Elite and Master.
Completing tasks allows you to access new areas. The more tasks you complete, the more areas become available to unlock.
Not only that, completing tasks also earns you League Points. The number of points earned is dependent on the difficulty of the task.

steps.player: What do these points do?

steps.npc: Once you have achieved a certain amount of League Points you can unlock a new Relic. These artefacts have been reshaped by Yama and his cohort to grant new powers.
League Points can also be used to buy rewards from the Leagues Reward Shop.

steps.text: As we speak, you are playing on your Leagues profile. The Leagues Reward Shop can only be opened on your main profile.
You can access your main profile by switching to any normal Old School RuneScape world. The world switcher in the logout menu can be used to switch worlds.

steps.player: So how many tasks are there?

steps.npc: More than you'll ever be able to complete, most likely. It's up to you which ones you attempt.

steps.player: Thanks!

steps.npc: Now, would you like to take a look at the tasks for this League?

steps.text: Opens Leagues Tasks panel

steps.player: Not right now.

steps.npc: Is there anything else you need from me?

options.text: How does the area system work?

steps.player: How does the area system work?

steps.npc: Currently, you are restricted to the Kingdom of Varlamore. However, as you progress, you can unlock more areas.
Once you have proven yourself dedicated to the League, Yama will also grant you free access to Karamja.
There are eleven different areas in total. However, you can only unlock a maximum of five, including the two you are gifted. Choose wisely.
The first two area unlocks are given to everyone. You can unlock the other three by completing the tasks you have been set.
The more tasks you complete, the more areas you can unlock.

steps.player: I see. Thanks!

steps.npc: Would you like to take a look at the available areas now?

steps.text: Opens Leagues Areas panel

steps.player: Not right now.

steps.npc: Fair enough. Is there anything else you need from me?

steps.player: What are Relics?

steps.npc: Relics are powerful artefacts made by me that grant unique abilities for the entire League.
You may even recognise a few from Leagues past.
There are 23 separate Relics, split across 8 different tiers. You can only have one Relic from each tier, however.
The first Relic tier is available to everyone. The others must be unlocked with League Points.
League Points are earned by completing tasks.
Once you have selected a Relic, your choice can't be changed for the rest of the League. Make your choices carefully.
Would you like to take a look at the Relics for this League?

steps.player: Yes, please.

steps.text: Opens Leagues Relics panel

steps.player: Not right now.

steps.text: Has unclaimed rewards:

steps.player: Tell me about League rewards.

steps.npc: As well as letting you unlock new areas, completing tasks in the League will earn you League Points. The more League Points you have, the more Relic tiers you have available.
However, alongside allowing you to unlock Relics, League Points can also be used to buy rewards from the Leagues Reward Shop.

steps.player: What rewards can I buy?

steps.npc: Oh, all sorts of things. New cosmetic kits, an alternative Home Teleport animation, some rather stylish outfits... and much more.
Many of these rewards can be traded with your fellow mortals, so if you wish, you can earn some money by selling them on. Of course, you might prefer to keep them for yourself instead.

steps.player: I see. That all sounds good to me.

steps.text: Currently, you are playing on your Leagues profile. The Leagues Reward Shop can only be used to buy items on your main profile, although you can still browse the shop within the League.

steps.npc: Would you like to look at the rewards shop?

steps.prompt: Open rewards shop?

steps.text: Opens Rewards shop
You can access your main profile by switching to any normal Old School RuneScape world. The world switcher in the logout menu can be used to switch worlds.

steps.npc: You can use this shop to buy previous League rewards, too.
Alongside the rewards in the Leagues Reward Shop, there's also League Ranks.

steps.player: League Ranks? How do they work?

steps.npc: During the League as you gain more points you will gain a League Rank. This rank can be seen in the Ranks interface.
You currently have the rank: Unranked.
As you get ranks you will gain access to trophies.

steps.player: Trophies?

steps.npc: That's right. Trophies are items that are awarded to you for competing in the League. You can use them to show off your League Rank.
Connected to League Ranks are the League to League rewards. These are unlocked in the next League based upon the League Rank you earn in this one.
League Starter Outfits and League Icons are some of things you can unlock for the next League. In addition, any pets you earn in this League will transfer over to the next one.
Finally, on top of the tasks for this League, there are some other activities for which I will recognise the first person who completes them.
You can view the entire list of activities, as well as whether or not someone has completed them, by reading the board beside me.

steps.player: Thanks!

steps.npc: My pleasure. Now, is there anything else you need from me?

steps.player: Let's talk about pets.
Can you tell me how pets work in Leagues?

steps.npc: But of course. If you're lucky enough to obtain a pet during a League, it will automatically be insured for you.
This means that if you lose it somehow you can talk to me and I'll give it back to you. Insurance and reclaiming is all free of charge.
Additionally, each pet you obtain will be transferred to the next League. I'll take good care of it until you're ready to reclaim it.

steps.player: Okay! Thank you.

steps.npc: Come back to me once you have some pets and you can view your collection. Now, is there anything else you need from me?

steps.player: Is there currently a League running?

steps.npc: Yes! The current League is Leagues V: Raging Echoes.
This League features powerful boss variants in each region, and Combat Masteries to enhance your chosen combat style's strengths.
As usual, you are restricted to certain regions around Gielinor - although you'll get to choose which ones.
You can also collect powerful artifacts known as Relics. Each one provides a different buff to your League experience.
There's one that lets you keep a kingdom in your pocket, and one that lets you become a Slayer Master!
One other thing. You must participate as an Ironman. This means you stand alone and cannot trade with other participants.

steps.player: Interesting. Maybe I should take part!

steps.npc: I'd highly recommend it!

during-in-a-league-world.npc: Hello! Do you have any questions for me?

options.text: What changes have been made for this League?

steps.player: What changes have been made for this League?

steps.npc: All sorts of things! I can't recount all of the information for you, but I can give you the basics though.
During this League, you are initially restricted to the Kingdom of Misthalin. However, as you progress, you'll be able to unlock new areas of your choosing.
Be warned though - you won't be able to unlock every area, so choose wisely.
Now, for the entire League, you must participate as an Iron Man. This means you stand alone and cannot trade with other participants.
And that's not all. Training skills during the League will grant you substantially more experience than you'd normally expect!
Finally, some quests have been completed for you automatically. Further quests will be completed as you unlock the relevant areas.
I think that covers the basics. Would you like to see some more in-depth information?

steps.player: Yes, please.

steps.text: Trailblazer Info interface opens.

steps.player: Not right now.

steps.npc: Fair enough. Is there anything else I can help you with?

steps.player: How do tasks work?

steps.npc: In every League, there are a number of tasks for you to complete. Each task has a level of difficulty: Easy, Medium, Hard, Elite and Master.
Completing tasks allows you to access new areas. The more tasks completed, the more areas available to unlock.
Not only that, completing tasks also earns you League Points. The number of points earned is dependent on the difficulty of the task.

steps.player: What do these points do?

steps.npc: Once you have achieved a certain amount of League Points you can unlock a new Relic! These are powerful artefacts to help you in the League.
League Points can also be used to buy rewards from the Leagues Reward Shop.

steps.text: Right now, you are playing on your Leagues profile. The Leagues Reward Shop can only be opened on your main profile.
You can access your main profile by switching to any normal Old School RuneScape world. The world switcher in the logout menu can be used to switch worlds.

steps.player: So how many tasks are there?

steps.npc: More than you'll ever be able to complete, most likely. With so many to choose from, it's up to you which ones you go for.

steps.player: Thanks!

steps.npc: Not a problem. Now, would you like to take a look at the tasks for this League?

steps.player: Yes, please.

steps.text: Trailblazer Task interface opens.

options.text: How does the area system work?

steps.player: How does the area system work?

steps.npc: In this League, you are initially locked to the Kingdom of Misthalin and the island of Karamja. However, as you progress, you can unlock more areas.
There are nine different areas in total. However, you can only unlock a maximum of five, including Misthalin and Karamja, so choose wisely.
The first two area unlocks are given to everyone. However, the other three unlocks are unavailable to begin with.
You can access these additional area unlocks by completing tasks. The more tasks you've completed, the more areas you can unlock.

steps.player: I see. Thanks!

steps.npc: Would you like to take a look at the available areas now?

steps.player: Yes, please.

steps.text: Trailblazer Task interface opens.

steps.player: How does the area system work?

steps.npc: Relics, or Trailblazer Relics to give them their full name, are powerful artefacts that grant unique abilities for the entire League!
There are eighteen separate Relics, split across six different tiers. You can only have one Relic from each tier though.
The first Relic tier is available to everyone. However, the higher tiers are locked to begin with.
You can unlock these higher tiers by earning League Points. League Points are earned by completing tasks.
Be warned, you'll need to choose carefully when picking a Relic. Once you have selected a Relic, your choice can't be changed for the rest of the League.
Anyway, it looks like you have a Relic available for selection right now! Would you like to take a look?

steps.player: Yes, please.

steps.text: Trailblazer Relic interface opens.

steps.player: Tell me about League rewards.

steps.npc: As well as letting you unlock new areas, completing tasks in the League will earn you League Points. The more League Points you have, the more Trailblazer Relic tiers you have available.
However, alongside allowing you to unlock Trailblazer Relics, League Points can also be used to buy rewards from the Leagues Reward Shop.

steps.player: What rewards can I buy?

steps.npc: All sorts of things! There's some new furniture for your house, an alternate animation for your Home Teleport spell and some new stylish outfits, just to name a few.
Most of the rewards can be traded with others, so if you want, you can earn some money by selling them on. Of course, you might prefer to keep them for yourself instead.

steps.player: I see. That all sounds good to me.

steps.text: Right now, you are playing on your Leagues profile. The Leagues Reward Shop can only be opened on your main profile.
You can access your main profile by switching to any normal Old School RuneScape world. The world switcher in the logout menu can be used to switch worlds.

steps.npc: One thing to be aware of is that the Trailblazer rewards won't be available until the League has ended. You can still buy rewards from previous Leagues though.
Now, alongside the rewards in the Leagues Reward Shop, there's also League Ranks.

steps.player: League Ranks? How do they work?

steps.npc: At the end of the League, you will be given a League Rank. This is based upon the number of League Points you have earned compared to the other participants.
Anyone who earns at least 100 League Points will be eligible for the Bronze rank. The top 80% of participants get the Iron rank. The top 60% get Steel.
The top 40% get Mithril. The top 20% get Adamant. The top 5% get Rune. The best participants, those who make it to the top 1%, get the Dragon rank!
When the League ends, your rank will determine what trophy you get. These trophies symbolise your performance in the League.

steps.player: Trophies?

steps.npc: That's right. Trophies are items that are given to you after the League. You can use them to show off your League Rank!
Connected to League Ranks are the League to League rewards. These are unlocked in the next League based upon the League Rank you earn in this one!
League Starter Outfits and League Icons are some of things you can unlock for the next League. Also, any pets you earn in this League will transfer over to the next one.
Finally, on top of the tasks for this League, there are some other activities for which I will recognise the first person who completes them.
You can view the entire list of activities, as well as whether or not someone has completed them, by reading the board beside me.

steps.player: Thanks!

steps.npc: Not a problem. Now, is there anything else I can help you with?

steps.player: Let's talk about pets.
Can you tell me how pets work in Leagues?

steps.npc: Of course! If you're lucky enough to obtain a pet during a League, it will automatically be insured for you.
This means that if you were to ever lose it, you can talk to me and I'll give it back to you. Insurance and reclaiming is all free!
Additionally, each pet you obtain will be transferred to the next League. It'll be waiting with me for you to reclaim it!

steps.player: Okay! Thank you.

steps.npc: No worries. Come back to me once you have some pets and you can view your collection! Now, is there anything else I can help you with?

steps.npc: Bronze trophy: 10 points, Iron trophy: 80 points, Steel trophy: 510 points, Mithril trophy: 1770 points.
Adamant trophy: 5270 points, Rune trophy: 10820 points and the Dragon Trophy: 20830 points.

steps.text: If the player has not earned any points during the Twisted League:

steps.npc: You earned 0 League points which does not qualify you for any trophy.

steps.text: If the player has earned more than 10 points during the Twisted League:

steps.npc: You earned [number] League points which qualifies you for the all of the Twisted League trophies up to and including the Twisted [type] trophy!

options.text: I'd like to claim my League trophies.
I'd like to claim my League trophies.
Can I purchase my League rewards?

steps.player: Can I purchase my League rewards?

steps.npc: Certainly, I have a number of unique rewards which you can purchase using points earned competing in a League. Here is what is available.

steps.text: Leagues Reward Shop interface opens.

options.text: I'd like to claim my League trophies.

steps.player: I'd like to claim my League trophies.

steps.text: If the player has not earned any points during the Twisted League:

steps.npc: You have not earned any League trophies. If you want a League trophy you should participate next time a League comes around!

steps.text: If the player has earned points during the Twisted League:

steps.npc: Of course, here are the trophies you have earned.

steps.text: If the player does not have enough inventory space:

steps.npc: You do not have enough space for all the League trophies you can claim. Come back to me when you have more space.

steps.text: If the player has claimed all eligible trophies:

steps.npc: You have already claimed all of the League trophies which you have earned.

steps.player: Goodbye.

steps.npc: All the best.

customization.text: Setting your appearanceBefore you get started, you'll need to set the appearance of your character. Please use the open interface to set your appearance.
Past ExperienceBefore you get started, please use the open interface to select your experience with Old School RuneScape.

options.text: I'm brand new! This is my first time here.
I've played in the past, but not recently.

customization.text: Getting startedWhen you're ready to get started, click on the Gielinor Guide. He is indicated by a flashing yellow arrow.

gielinor-guide.speaker: Gielinor Guide
gielinor-guide.text: Greetings! I see you are a new arrival to the world of Gielinor. My job is to welcome all new visitors. So welcome!

gielinor-guide.speaker: Gielinor Guide
gielinor-guide.text: You have already learned the first thing needed to succeed in this world: talking to other people!

gielinor-guide.speaker: Gielinor Guide
gielinor-guide.text: You will find many inhabitants of this world have useful things to say to you. By [clicking/tapping] on them you can talk to them.

gielinor-guide.speaker: Gielinor Guide
gielinor-guide.text: Now then, let's start by looking at your settings menu.
Settings menuPlease [click/tap] on the flashing spanner icon found on the bottom right of your screen. This will display your settings menu.

gielinor-guide-attempting-to-leave-the-b.text: You need to talk to the Gielinor Guide before you are allowed to proceed through this door.

gielinor-guide-after-opening-settings-me.text: Settings menuOn the side panel, you can now see a variety of game settings. You can also [click/tap] the all settings button to see all available settings. Talk to the Gielinor Guide to continue.

gielinor-guide-after-opening-settings-me.speaker: Gielinor Guide
gielinor-guide-after-opening-settings-me.text: Looks like you're making good progress! The menu you've just opened is one of many. You'll learn about the rest as you progress through the tutorial.

gielinor-guide-after-opening-settings-me.speaker: Gielinor Guide
gielinor-guide-after-opening-settings-me.text: Anyway, I'd say it's time for you to go and meet your first instructor!

Moving onIt's time to meet your first instructor. To continue, all you need to do is [click/tap] on the door. It's indicated by a flashing yellow arrow. Remember, you can [swipe across the screen/use your arrow keys] to rotate the camera.

gielinor-guide-talking-to-the-gielinor-g.speaker: Gielinor Guide
gielinor-guide-talking-to-the-gielinor-g.text: Welcome back. You have already learnt the first thing needed to succeed in this world: talking to other people!

gielinor-guide-talking-to-the-gielinor-g.speaker: Gielinor Guide
gielinor-guide-talking-to-the-gielinor-g.text: You will find many inhabitants of this world have useful things to say to you. By [clicking/tapping] on them, you can talk to them.

gielinor-guide-talking-to-the-gielinor-g.speaker: Gielinor Guide
gielinor-guide-talking-to-the-gielinor-g.text: To continue the tutorial go through that door over there and speak to your first instructor!

Moving onIt's time to meet your first instructor. To continue, all you need to do is [click/tap] on the door. It's indicated by a flashing yellow arrow. Remember, you can [swipe across the screen/use your arrow keys] to rotate the camera.

survival-expert-attempting-to-chop-down-.text: You cannot cut down this tree yet. You must progress further in the tutorial.

survival-expert-attempting-to-fish-for-s.text: You cannot fish here yet. You must progress further in the tutorial.

survival-expert-talking-to-the-survival-.speaker: Survival Expert
survival-expert-talking-to-the-survival-.text: Hello there, newcomer. My name is Brynna. My job is to teach you about the skills you can use to survive in this world.

survival-expert-talking-to-the-survival-.speaker: Survival Expert
survival-expert-talking-to-the-survival-.text: The first skill we're going to look at is Fishing. There's some shrimp in this pond here. Let's try and catch some.
The survival expert gives you a small fishing net.
You've been given an itemTo view the item you've been given, you'll need to open your inventory. To do so, [click/tap] on the flashing backpack icon to the right hand side of your screen.

survival-expert-attempting-to-leave-thro.text: You need to talk to the Survival Guide and complete her tasks before you are allowed to proceed through this gate.

survival-expert-after-opening-inventory.text: InventoryThis is your inventory. You can view all of your items here, including the net you've just been given. Let's use it to catch some shrimp.

survival-expert-before-fishing.speaker: Survival Expert
survival-expert-before-fishing.text: Hello again. First up, we're going to do some fishing. There's some shrimp in this pond here. Let's try and catch some.

survival-expert-after-clicking-on-a-fish.text: Please waitYour character is now attempting to catch some shrimp. Sit back for a moment while [he does/she does/they do] all the hard work.
You manage to catch some shrimp.
You've gained some experience[Click/Tap] on the flashing bar graph icon near the inventory button to see your skills menu.

survival-expert-before-opening-skills-me.speaker: Survival Expert
survival-expert-before-opening-skills-me.text: Hello again. You should take a look at that menu before we continue.

survival-expert-after-fishing.player: I've managed to catch some shrimp.

survival-expert-after-fishing.speaker: Survival Expert
survival-expert-after-fishing.text: Excellent work. Next you'll want to cook those shrimp. To do that, you'll need a fire. This brings us on to the Woodcutting and Firemaking skills.
The survival expert gives you a bronze axe and a tinderbox.

WoodcuttingIt's time to cook your shrimp. However, you require a fire to do that which means you need some logs. You can cut down trees using your Woodcutting skill, all you need is an axe. Give it a go by clicking on one of the trees in the area.

survival-expert-before-cutting-a-tree.speaker: Survival Expert
survival-expert-before-cutting-a-tree.text: Next up you need to make a fire. First, you'll need to cut down a tree to get some logs.

survival-expert-attempting-to-equip-an-i.text: You'll be told how to equip items later.

survival-expert-after-clicking-on-a-tree.text: Please waitYour character is now attempting to cut down the tree. Sit back for a moment while [he/she] does all the hard work.
You manage to cut some logs.

FiremakingNow that you have some logs, it's time to light a fire. First, [click/tap] on the tinderbox in your inventory. Then, with the tinderbox highlighted, [click/tap] on the logs to use the tinderbox on them.

survival-expert-before-lighting-a-fire.speaker: Survival Expert
survival-expert-before-lighting-a-fire.text: Now that you have some shrimp, you're going to want to cook them. To do that, you'll need a fire.

survival-expert-after-using-tinderbox-on.text: Please waitYour character is now attempting to light a fire. This should only take a few seconds.

steps.text: CookingNow it's time to get cooking. To do so, [click/tap] on the shrimp in your inventory. Then, with the shrimp highlighted, [click/tap] on a fire to cook them. If you look at the top left of the screen, you'll see the instructions that you're giving to your character.
CookingNow it's time to get cooking. To do so, [click/tap] on the shrimp in your inventory. Then, with the shrimp highlighted, [click/tap] on a fire to cook them.

survival-expert-before-cooking-the-shrim.speaker: Survival Expert
survival-expert-before-cooking-the-shrim.text: Now that you have some shrimp, you're going to want to cook them. All you need to do is use them on a fire.

survival-expert-after-using-shrimp-on-fi.text: Please waitYour character is now attempting to cook some shrimp. This will only take a few seconds.

steps.text: You manage to cook some shrimp.

Moving onWell done, you've just cooked your first meal! Speak to the survival expert if you want a recap, otherwise you can move on. [Click/Tap] on the gate shown and follow the path. Remember, you can [swipe across the screen/use your arrow keys] to rotate the camera.
You accidently burn the shrimp.

Moving onOh no, you've just burnt your meal! Speak to the survival expert if you want a recap, otherwise you can move on. [Click/Tap] on the gate shown and follow the path. Remember, you can [swipe across the screen/use your arrow keys] to rotate the camera.

survival-expert-cooking-more-shrimp.text: Please waitYour character is now attempting to cook some shrimp. This will only take a few seconds.
If the player successfully cooks the shrimp:

steps.text: You manage to cook some shrimp.

Moving onWell done, you've just cooked another meal! Speak to the survival expert if you want a recap, otherwise you can move on. [Click/Tap] on the gate shown and follow the path. Remember, you can [swipe across the screen]/[use your arrow keys] to rotate the camera.

survival-expert-speaking-to-the-survival.speaker: Survival Expert
survival-expert-speaking-to-the-survival.text: Hello again. Is there something you'd like to hear more about?

options.text: Tell me about my skills again.

steps.player: Tell me about my skills again.

steps.speaker: Survival Expert
steps.text: Every skill is listed in the skills menu. Here you can see what your current levels are and how much experience you have.

steps.speaker: Survival Expert
steps.text: As you move your mouse over the various skills the small tooltip will show you the exact amount of experience you have and how much is needed to get to the next level.

steps.speaker: Survival Expert
steps.text: You can also [click/tap] on a skill to open up the relevant skillguide. In the skillguide, you can see all of the unlocks available in that skill.

steps.speaker: Survival Expert
steps.text: Is there anything else you'd like to hear more about?

steps.player: Tell me about Woodcutting again.

steps.speaker: Survival Expert
steps.text: Woodcutting, eh? Don't worry, newcomer, it's really very easy. Simply equip your axe and [click/tap] on a nearby tree to chop away.

steps.speaker: Survival Expert
steps.text: As you explore the mainland you will discover many different kinds of trees that will require different Woodcutting levels to chop down.

steps.speaker: Survival Expert
steps.text: Logs are not only useful for making fires. Many archers use the skill known as Fletching to craft their own bows and arrows from trees.

steps.speaker: Survival Expert
steps.text: Is there anything else you'd like to hear more about?

steps.player: Tell me about Firemaking again.

steps.speaker: Survival Expert
steps.text: Certainly, newcomer. When you have logs simply use your tinderbox on them. If successful, you will start a fire.

steps.speaker: Survival Expert
steps.text: You can also set fire to logs you find lying on the floor already, and some other things can also be set alight...

steps.speaker: Survival Expert
steps.text: A tinderbox is always a useful item to keep around!

steps.speaker: Survival Expert
steps.text: Is there anything else you'd like to hear more about?

steps.player: Tell me about Fishing again.

steps.speaker: Survival Expert
steps.text: Ah, yes. Fishing! Fishing is undoubtedly one of the more popular hobbies here in Gielinor!

steps.speaker: Survival Expert
steps.text: Whenever you see sparkling waters, you can be sure there's probably some good fishing to be had there!

steps.speaker: Survival Expert
steps.text: Not only are fish absolutely delicious when cooked, they will also heal lost health.

steps.speaker: Survival Expert
steps.text: I would recommend everybody has a go at Fishing at least once in their lives!

steps.speaker: Survival Expert
steps.text: Is there anything else you'd like to hear more about?

steps.player: Tell me about Cooking again.

steps.speaker: Survival Expert
steps.text: Yes, the most basic of survival techniques. Most simple foods can be used on a fire to cook them. If you're feeling a bit fancier, you can also use a range to cook the food instead.

steps.speaker: Survival Expert
steps.text: Eating cooked food will restore lost health. The harder something is to cook, the more it will heal you.

steps.speaker: Survival Expert
steps.text: Is there anything else you'd like to hear more about?

steps.player: Nothing thanks.

survival-expert-after-opening-the-gate.text: Moving onFollow the path to find until you get to the door with the yellow arrow above it. [Click/Tap] on the door to open it. Remember that you can also move around by [clicking]/[tapping] on the minimap in the top right.

steps.text: Perhaps you've done enough woodcutting now.

You won't be able to chop oak trees until you have a Woodcutting level of 15. You'll advance to higher Woodcutting levels by chopping down normal trees. At higher Woodcutting levels you will find even more trees you can cut.
You don't have enough inventory space to hold that item.
