chapter-2-talking-to-zooknock.text: It has been tried in the past, but the results were far from ... satisfactory. Although we, like you, are related to the monkeys, the link is too weak for a successful transformation. That is why we need you.

chapter-2-talking-to-zooknock.player: Right. What do I have to do?

chapter-2-talking-to-zooknock.speaker: Zooknock
chapter-2-talking-to-zooknock.text: There will be two aspects to your transformation. We must first arrange it so that you are able to understand and communicate with the monkeys.

chapter-2-talking-to-zooknock.speaker: Zooknock
chapter-2-talking-to-zooknock.text: We must also transform your body so that you may pass amongst them unnoticed.

chapter-2-talking-to-zooknock.speaker: Zooknock
chapter-2-talking-to-zooknock.text: So that the effects of my spells are not permanent, I will invest their power into magical items which you must find. You can then use them at your will.

chapter-2-talking-to-zooknock.player: What kind of items?

chapter-2-talking-to-zooknock.speaker: Zooknock
chapter-2-talking-to-zooknock.text: For the spells to take full effect, they will have to be in some way related to the monkeys.

chapter-2-talking-to-zooknock.speaker: Zooknock
chapter-2-talking-to-zooknock.text: I suggest that I invest the ability to communicate with the monkeys in an authentic monkey amulet.

chapter-2-talking-to-zooknock.speaker: Zooknock
chapter-2-talking-to-zooknock.text: Similarly, the transformation spell should be stored in a monkey talisman of some kind.

options.text: What do we need for the monkey amulet?

steps.player: What do we need for the monkey amulet?

steps.speaker: Zooknock
steps.text: We need a gold bar, a monkey amulet mould and something to do monkey speech.

options.text: Where do I find a gold bar?

steps.player: Where do I find a gold bar?

steps.speaker: Zooknock
steps.text: I am not sure. You look wealthy enough to know the answer to that question anyway.

options.text: Where do I find a monkey amulet mould?

steps.player: Where do I find a monkey amulet mould?

steps.speaker: Zooknock
steps.text: They ought to be for sale in the village, but be careful: you probably will not be able to walk straight in and buy one.

options.text: Where do I find something to do with monkey speech?

steps.player: Where do I find something to do with monkey speech?

steps.speaker: Zooknock
steps.text: I don't know. I'm sure you'll think of something.

steps.player: I'll be back later.

options.text: What do we need for the monkey talisman?

steps.player: What do we need for the monkey talisman?

steps.speaker: Zooknock
steps.text: We need some kind of monkey remains as well as an authentic magical monkey talisman.

options.text: Where do I find monkey remains?

steps.player: Where do I find monkey remains?

steps.speaker: Zooknock
steps.text: I'll leave that to your better judgement... However, bear in mind the type of remain might affect the type of monkey you become...

steps.player: What if I need to be another type of monkey?

steps.speaker: Zooknock
steps.text: Then bring me different monkey remains and another talisman.

options.text: Where do I find a magical monkey talisman?

steps.player: Where do I find a magical monkey talisman?

steps.speaker: Zooknock
steps.text: There ought to be something in the village. I cannot be sure, as I have not spent much time there.

steps.player: I'll be back later.

chapter-2-talking-to-zooknock-talking-to.speaker: Zooknock
chapter-2-talking-to-zooknock-talking-to.text: Slow, as ever. Can't you tell?

chapter-2-talking-to-zooknock-talking-to.player: I have been sent by your Sergeant. He believes that the best way to rescue the rest of your squad with the minimum of casualties is to have an insider - a monkey working for us.

chapter-2-talking-to-zooknock-talking-to.speaker: Zooknock
chapter-2-talking-to-zooknock-talking-to.text: Finally. He wants me to turn you into a monkey.

chapter-2-talking-to-zooknock-talking-to.player: Actually, it was more along the lines of a disguise...

chapter-2-monkey-amulet-searching-the-cr.text: You find a hole in the floor under the crate! All you can see is the faint glimmer of light from extremely far below.

chapter-2-monkey-amulet-searching-the-cr.prompt: Would you like to go down?

steps.text: You begin to lower yourself into the hole...
... and using your catlike agility land on all fours at the bottom of a large cavern!
You push the crate over the hole again.

chapter-2-monkey-amulet-searching-the-mo.text: This crate is full of ...  monkey amulet moulds!

chapter-2-monkey-amulet-searching-the-mo.prompt: Do you wish to take one?

steps.text: M'amulet mould

chapter-2-monkey-amulet-using-the-monkey.text: You hand Zooknock the monkey amulet mould.

chapter-2-monkey-amulet-using-the-monkey.speaker: Zooknock
chapter-2-monkey-amulet-using-the-monkey.text: We still need the gold bar and something to do with monkey speech.

chapter-2-monkey-amulet-searching-the-de.text: This crate is full of ...  magical monkey talking dentures!

chapter-2-monkey-amulet-searching-the-de.prompt: Do you wish to take one?

steps.text: Monkey dentures

chapter-2-monkey-amulet-using-the-monkey.text: You hand Zooknock the magical monkey dentures.

chapter-2-monkey-amulet-using-the-monkey.speaker: Zooknock
chapter-2-monkey-amulet-using-the-monkey.text: We still need the gold bar.

chapter-2-monkey-amulet-using-the-gold-b.text: You hand Zooknock the gold bar.
If all items required for the monkeyspeak amulet have been given to Zooknock:

steps.speaker: Zooknock
steps.text: Now listen closely, human. I will cast a spell to enchant this gold bar with the power contained in these monkey dentures.

steps.speaker: Zooknock
steps.text: You must then smith the gold using the monkey amulet mould. However, unless you do this in a place of religious significance to the monkeys, the spirits contained within will likely depart.

steps.player: Where do I find a place of religious significance to monkeys?

steps.speaker: Zooknock
steps.text: Somewhere in the village. It ought to be obvious. Now give me a moment.
Zooknock hands you back the gold bar and the monkey amulet mould.

chapter-2-monkey-amulet-stringing-the-mo.text: You put some string on your amulet. It makes a slight 'Ook' sound.

chapter-2-monkey-talisman-talking-to-the.speaker: Monkey Child
chapter-2-monkey-talisman-talking-to-the.text: Ook. Ook. Ook Ah Uh! Ook Ah Uh!
You cannot understand what he is saying.

chapter-2-monkey-talisman-talking-to-the.speaker: Monkey Child
chapter-2-monkey-talisman-talking-to-the.text: Hello big-big. Aunty told me not to talk to strangers.

chapter-2-monkey-talisman-talking-to-the.speaker: Monkey Child
chapter-2-monkey-talisman-talking-to-the.text: You look strange to me!

chapter-2-monkey-talisman-talking-to-the.speaker: Monkey Child
chapter-2-monkey-talisman-talking-to-the.text: You're strange! Go away!

chapter-2-monkey-talisman-talking-to-the.speaker: Monkey Child
chapter-2-monkey-talisman-talking-to-the.text: Then what are you?

steps.player: I'm a monkey's brother!

steps.speaker: Monkey Child
steps.text: Ook! But I don't have any brothers!

steps.player: I knew your sister's mother!

steps.speaker: Monkey Child
steps.text: But I don't have any sisters! Ook Ook!

steps.player: I'm just a monkey lover!

steps.speaker: Monkey Child
steps.text: Aunty told me not to talk to monkey lovers! Ook!

options.text: Well I'll be a monkey's uncle!

steps.player: Well I'll be a monkey's uncle!

steps.speaker: Monkey Child
steps.text: Uh ah! You do look like my uncle!
The player performs the laugh emote.

chapter-2-monkey-talisman-talking-to-the.speaker: Monkey Child
chapter-2-monkey-talisman-talking-to-the.text: You never said what you were!

options.text: Well I'll be a monkey's uncle!

chapter-2-monkey-talisman-talking-to-the.speaker: Monkey Child
chapter-2-monkey-talisman-talking-to-the.text: You look a lot bigger than last time, Uncle!

chapter-2-monkey-talisman-talking-to-the.player: I've been ... eating more bananas... just like you should be!

chapter-2-monkey-talisman-talking-to-the.speaker: Monkey Child
chapter-2-monkey-talisman-talking-to-the.text: I'm bored.

chapter-2-monkey-talisman-talking-to-the.speaker: Monkey Child
chapter-2-monkey-talisman-talking-to-the.text: Aunty told me to pick loads of bananas. She said if, I got bananas, she'd give me a new toy!

options.text: What kind of toy did Aunty say she'd give you?

steps.player: What kind of toy did Aunty say she'd give you?

steps.speaker: Monkey Child
steps.text: She said it would be something from the magic shop!

options.text: How many bananas did Aunty want?

steps.player: How many bananas did Aunty want?

steps.speaker: Monkey Child
steps.text: Twenty! But I can't count! It's very mean of her, isn't it Uncle?

steps.player: Yes, very mean ... do you want me to get the bananas for you?

steps.speaker: Monkey Child
steps.text: Ok! Ook Ook!

steps.player: But only if you promise to let me borrow your toy...

steps.speaker: Monkey Child
steps.text: Ok Uncle!

chapter-2-monkey-talisman-getting-caught.speaker: The Monkey's Aunt
chapter-2-monkey-talisman-getting-caught.text: How dare you come near my farmhouse! Guards! Guards! Remove this human!
You are knocked unconscious by a blow to the head!

chapter-2-monkey-talisman-using-an-item-.speaker: Monkey Child
chapter-2-monkey-talisman-using-an-item-.text: I have no use for that.

chapter-2-monkey-talisman-talking-to-the.speaker: Monkey Child
chapter-2-monkey-talisman-talking-to-the.text: Did you get any bananas, Uncle?

chapter-2-monkey-talisman-talking-to-the.player: No, not yet. I'm still trying to get them.

chapter-2-monkey-talisman-talking-to-the.speaker: Monkey Child
chapter-2-monkey-talisman-talking-to-the.text: Did you get any bananas, Uncle?

chapter-2-monkey-talisman-talking-to-the.speaker: Monkey Child
chapter-2-monkey-talisman-talking-to-the.text: That doesn't look like 20 bananas Uncle! Aunty will be so angry with me!

chapter-2-monkey-talisman-talking-to-the.player: Don't worry, I'll get some more.

chapter-2-monkey-talisman-talking-to-the.speaker: Monkey Child
chapter-2-monkey-talisman-talking-to-the.text: Did you get any bananas, Uncle?

chapter-2-monkey-talisman-talking-to-the.speaker: Monkey Child
chapter-2-monkey-talisman-talking-to-the.text: Wow that's a lot of bananas! Are there twenty?
You give the monkey child your bananas.

chapter-2-monkey-talisman-talking-to-the.speaker: Monkey Child
chapter-2-monkey-talisman-talking-to-the.text: Aunty will be so happy!

chapter-2-monkey-talisman-talking-to-the.player: Has Aunty given you the toy yet?

chapter-2-monkey-talisman-talking-to-the.speaker: Monkey Child
chapter-2-monkey-talisman-talking-to-the.text: No, not yet... she said she's too busy dealing with something called humans.

chapter-2-monkey-talisman-talking-to-the.player: Has Aunty given you the toy yet?

chapter-2-monkey-talisman-talking-to-the.speaker: Monkey Child
chapter-2-monkey-talisman-talking-to-the.text: Yeah - it's really neat!

chapter-2-monkey-talisman-talking-to-the.player: Can I borrow it now then?

chapter-2-monkey-talisman-talking-to-the.speaker: Monkey Child
chapter-2-monkey-talisman-talking-to-the.text: But I only just got it!

chapter-2-monkey-talisman-talking-to-the.speaker: Monkey Child
chapter-2-monkey-talisman-talking-to-the.text: Ok then...
The monkey child gives you some kind of talisman.

steps.player: How are you today?

steps.speaker: Monkey Child
steps.text: I'm good, uncle! I'd quite like my toy back now...

options.text: I've lost that toy you gave me...

steps.player: I've lost that toy you gave me...

steps.speaker: Monkey Child
steps.text: You lost it!? What am I going to play with now?
The monkey child begins to cry...

chapter-2-monkey-talisman-trying-to-talk.text: The monkey child is too busy crying...

chapter-2-monkey-talisman-if-enough-time.speaker: Monkey Child
chapter-2-monkey-talisman-if-enough-time.text: I'm feeling a bit better now...

chapter-2-monkey-talisman-if-enough-time.player: It's good to see you've cheered up then.

chapter-2-monkey-talisman-if-enough-time.speaker: Monkey Child
chapter-2-monkey-talisman-if-enough-time.text: Yes - Aunty gave me a new toy!

steps.player: That's really sweet of her!
Wow - can I borrow it?

steps.speaker: Monkey Child
steps.text: Only if you promise to give it back...

steps.player: Ok, I promise!

steps.text: a monkey talisman
The monkey child gives you some kind of talisman.

options.text: Actually, I don't really need it.

steps.player: Actually, I don't really need it.

chapter-2-monkey-talisman-using-the-toy-.speaker: Monkey Child
chapter-2-monkey-talisman-using-the-toy-.text: Thank you uncle - I love you!
The monkey child gives you a hug!

chapter-2-creating-the-monkey-gree-gree-.text: You hand Zooknock the monkey talisman.

chapter-2-creating-the-monkey-gree-gree-.speaker: Zooknock
chapter-2-creating-the-monkey-gree-gree-.text: Excellent.

chapter-2-creating-the-monkey-gree-gree-.speaker: Zooknock
chapter-2-creating-the-monkey-gree-gree-.text: We still need some kind of monkey remains.
You hand Zooknock the monkey remains.

chapter-2-creating-the-monkey-gree-gree-.speaker: Zooknock
chapter-2-creating-the-monkey-gree-gree-.text: Excellent.

chapter-2-creating-the-monkey-gree-gree-.speaker: Zooknock
chapter-2-creating-the-monkey-gree-gree-.text: We still need an authentic magical monkey talisman.

chapter-2-creating-the-monkey-gree-gree-.speaker: Zooknock
chapter-2-creating-the-monkey-gree-gree-.text: Well done, human.

chapter-2-creating-the-monkey-gree-gree-.speaker: Zooknock
chapter-2-creating-the-monkey-gree-gree-.text: Bear with me human: I must now cast an extremely powerful spell. It is not often we are successful in investing shapeshifting powers within objects.
Zooknock hands you back the talisman. It seems to glow slightly.

chapter-2-creating-the-monkey-gree-gree-.speaker: Zooknock
chapter-2-creating-the-monkey-gree-gree-.text: I am afraid I have not been able to fully invest my powers in that talisman. You may use it, but it will continue to draw its energy directly from me.

chapter-2-creating-the-monkey-gree-gree-.speaker: Zooknock
chapter-2-creating-the-monkey-gree-gree-.text: The range at which I will be able to sustain it is limited. I cannot ensure it will be effective off the atoll.

chapter-2-creating-the-monkey-gree-gree-.speaker: Zooknock
chapter-2-creating-the-monkey-gree-gree-.text: Furthermore, you will not be able to attack whilst using this, so be careful. Perhaps when I refine my spells I could look into making this possible.
Meanwhile, somewhere far below the Ape Atoll...

chapter-2-creating-the-monkey-gree-gree-.speaker: G.L.O. Caranock
chapter-2-creating-the-monkey-gree-gree-.text: It is good of you to meet me, Waydar.

chapter-2-creating-the-monkey-gree-gree-.speaker: Waydar
chapter-2-creating-the-monkey-gree-gree-.text: It is good to see you again, Caranock. It is a strange island these monkeys inhabit.

chapter-2-creating-the-monkey-gree-gree-.speaker: G.L.O. Caranock
chapter-2-creating-the-monkey-gree-gree-.text: Well observed. How have you been keeping yourself occupied?

chapter-2-creating-the-monkey-gree-gree-.speaker: Waydar
chapter-2-creating-the-monkey-gree-gree-.text: I am now a Flight Commander. My duties include testing Glough's prototype military glider.

chapter-2-creating-the-monkey-gree-gree-.speaker: G.L.O. Caranock
chapter-2-creating-the-monkey-gree-gree-.text: My my. How things have changed somewhat since Glough's time... Now, what of the human?

chapter-2-creating-the-monkey-gree-gree-.speaker: Waydar
chapter-2-creating-the-monkey-gree-gree-.text: The human? Just somebody Narnode appears to have taken a fancy to. It is hard to tell why. I suspect the human was involved with Glough's fall from grace.

chapter-2-creating-the-monkey-gree-gree-.speaker: G.L.O. Caranock
chapter-2-creating-the-monkey-gree-gree-.text: You may be right. Never mind - there are greater matters afoot. With Glough gone, it falls to us to continue with his plans.

chapter-2-creating-the-monkey-gree-gree-.speaker: G.L.O. Caranock
chapter-2-creating-the-monkey-gree-gree-.text: Also, the shipyard workers are becoming restless.

chapter-2-creating-the-monkey-gree-gree-.speaker: Waydar
chapter-2-creating-the-monkey-gree-gree-.text: I see. What do you have in mind?

chapter-2-creating-the-monkey-gree-gree-.speaker: G.L.O. Caranock
chapter-2-creating-the-monkey-gree-gree-.text: Money for me, Waydar, and promotion for you. As you know, the 10th squad of the Royal Guard are slightly worse for wear on this island.

chapter-2-creating-the-monkey-gree-gree-.speaker: Waydar
chapter-2-creating-the-monkey-gree-gree-.text: This I know. But I don't see how it leads to money or promotion.

chapter-2-creating-the-monkey-gree-gree-.speaker: G.L.O. Caranock
chapter-2-creating-the-monkey-gree-gree-.text: What if they were to die? An entire squad of the Royal Guard goes missing in the jungle of Karamja ... We could blame it on the humans.

chapter-2-creating-the-monkey-gree-gree-.speaker: Waydar
chapter-2-creating-the-monkey-gree-gree-.text: Narnode would be furious!

chapter-2-creating-the-monkey-gree-gree-.speaker: G.L.O. Caranock
chapter-2-creating-the-monkey-gree-gree-.text: Precisely. He might even order an invasion. At the very least he'll step up the defence. More orders for me, promotion for you.

chapter-2-creating-the-monkey-gree-gree-.speaker: Waydar
chapter-2-creating-the-monkey-gree-gree-.text: Very clever. It might also serve us well to remind Narnode of Bolren's situation.

chapter-2-creating-the-monkey-gree-gree-.speaker: G.L.O. Caranock
chapter-2-creating-the-monkey-gree-gree-.text: Ah yes - all that trouble with the Khazard. Last I heard, Bolren had retrieved the orbs of protection. Apparently some human lent their assistance.

chapter-2-creating-the-monkey-gree-gree-.speaker: Waydar
chapter-2-creating-the-monkey-gree-gree-.text: Really? Typical meddling human behaviour. Nevertheless, it will stoke fires of worry. After all, the battle still continues.

chapter-2-creating-the-monkey-gree-gree-.speaker: G.L.O. Caranock
chapter-2-creating-the-monkey-gree-gree-.text: I agree. Anyhow, we don't want your human wondering as to your whereabouts. When the time is right, don't hesitate to ... dispose of it.

chapter-2-creating-the-monkey-gree-gree-.speaker: Waydar
chapter-2-creating-the-monkey-gree-gree-.text: Understood. Military gliders are after all an untested form of transport...
Monkey Madness: Chapter 3 In which our hero finds themselves contending with life as a monkey.

steps.player: I've lost the monkey amulet...

steps.speaker: Zooknock
steps.text: Are you sure?

steps.player: Yes.

steps.speaker: Zooknock
steps.text: Careless human. No matter - bring me the same materials again and I will prepare for you another one.

options.text: Can you make another monkey talisman?

steps.player: Can you make another monkey talisman?

steps.speaker: Zooknock
steps.text: Are you sure?

steps.player: Yes.

steps.speaker: Zooknock
steps.text: Very well. Bring me the required materials again and I will prepare for you another one.

steps.player: Actually, I'm not that sure.

chapter-3-talking-to-an-elder-guard-earl.player: Oh nothing ... I'm just passing by.

chapter-3-talking-to-garkor-while-not-di.speaker: Garkor
chapter-3-talking-to-garkor-while-not-di.text: Have you spoken to Zooknock about the monkey disguise yet?

chapter-3-talking-to-garkor-while-not-di.player: Yes - I've now made an amulet of monkey speak and a monkey greegree.

chapter-3-talking-to-garkor-while-not-di.speaker: Garkor
chapter-3-talking-to-garkor-while-not-di.text: Very good. In a moment, speak to me through your monkey disguise so that I may judge how good it is.

chapter-3-talking-to-garkor-while-disgui.speaker: Garkor
chapter-3-talking-to-garkor-while-disgui.text: My my, Zooknock has outdone himself this time. You do look very much like a monkey you know.
If the player is not transformed into a Karamjan monkey:

steps.speaker: Garkor
steps.text: However, you look like the wrong sort of monkey. My plan requires that you look like one of the monkeys of mainland Karamja.

steps.player: What exactly is your plan?

steps.speaker: Garkor
steps.text: When the time comes, you are to pretend you are an envoy from the monkeys of Karamja and that you are seeking an alliance.

steps.player: How do you know this will work?

steps.speaker: Garkor
steps.text: As I said, I've been listening to Awowogei for some time now. Come back when you look like one of the Karamjan monkeys.

chapter-3-talking-to-garkor-while-disgui.text: If the player is transformed into a Karamjan monkey:

steps.speaker: Garkor
steps.text: And by happy coincidence you appear to be just the right sort of monkey.

steps.speaker: Garkor
steps.text: I need you now to seek audience with Awowogei. Claim you are an envoy from the monkeys of Karamja and are seeking an alliance.

steps.speaker: Garkor
steps.text: You must win his trust if we are to succeed.

chapter-3-talking-to-garkor-again-after-.speaker: Garkor
chapter-3-talking-to-garkor-again-after-.text: I need you now to seek audience with Awowogei. Claim you are an envoy from the monkeys of Karamja and are seeking an alliance.

chapter-3-talking-to-garkor-again-after-.speaker: Garkor
chapter-3-talking-to-garkor-again-after-.text: You must win his trust if we are to succeed.

chapter-3-talking-to-kruk-early.speaker: Kruk
chapter-3-talking-to-kruk-early.text: What brings you up here, monkey?

chapter-3-talking-to-kruk-early.speaker: Kruk
chapter-3-talking-to-kruk-early.text: You would do better to explore elsewhere - we are extremely busy at the moment.

chapter-3-talking-to-an-elder-guard.player: I'd like to speak with Awowogei, please.

chapter-3-talking-to-an-elder-guard.speaker: Elder Guard
chapter-3-talking-to-an-elder-guard.text: Only the Captain of the Monkey Guard or those he authorises may enter this building. You will need his permission to enter.

chapter-3-talking-to-an-elder-guard.player: Who is the Captain of the Monkey Guard?

chapter-3-talking-to-an-elder-guard.speaker: Elder Guard
chapter-3-talking-to-an-elder-guard.text: He goes by the name of Kruk.

chapter-3-talking-to-kruk.speaker: Kruk
chapter-3-talking-to-kruk.text: What brings you up here, monkey?

chapter-3-talking-to-kruk.player: I have come to seek audience with Awowogei. I am told I need your permission to do so.

chapter-3-talking-to-kruk.speaker: Kruk
chapter-3-talking-to-kruk.text: That's right - you do. What business have you on our island?

chapter-3-talking-to-kruk.player: I am envoy from the monkeys of Karamja. I have come to propose an alliance.

chapter-3-talking-to-kruk.text: If the player is transformed into the wrong monkey:

steps.speaker: Kruk
steps.text: I don't believe you. You don't look much like any Karamja monkey I've seen.

steps.speaker: Kruk
steps.text: Stop wasting my time.

chapter-3-talking-to-kruk.text: If the player is transformed into a Karamjan monkey:

steps.speaker: Kruk
steps.text: I see. Very well, you look genuine enough. Follow me.
Screen fades in and out. The player is now in Awowogei's throne room.

chapter-3-talking-to-uwogo.speaker: Uwogo
chapter-3-talking-to-uwogo.text: Get away from me, you foul commoner!

chapter-3-talking-to-kruk-2.speaker: Kruk
chapter-3-talking-to-kruk-2.text: Sorry, I am far too busy dealing with the invaders right now.

chapter-3-talking-to-awowogei.speaker: Awowogei
chapter-3-talking-to-awowogei.text: Greetings, visitor. What brings you to my island?

chapter-3-talking-to-awowogei.player: I am an envoy from the monkeys of Karamja. We wish to propose an alliance.

chapter-3-talking-to-awowogei.speaker: Awowogei
chapter-3-talking-to-awowogei.text: I see. Ours is a strong and mighty lineage of monkey, visitor. We clearly do not need your offer of an alliance.

chapter-3-talking-to-awowogei.player: Awowogei, please consider my offer carefully.
We offer strength in numbers and our island would serve as a northern platform for defence. All that we ask for in return is peace.

chapter-3-talking-to-awowogei.speaker: Uwogo
chapter-3-talking-to-awowogei.text: I don't believe him, Awowogei. Never trust a northern monkey.

chapter-3-talking-to-awowogei.speaker: Muruwoi
chapter-3-talking-to-awowogei.text: I think he seems trustworthy, sir.

chapter-3-talking-to-awowogei.speaker: Awowogei
chapter-3-talking-to-awowogei.text: I must admit, I have always regarded your kind as our inferior cousins, visitor.

chapter-3-talking-to-awowogei.speaker: Awowogei
chapter-3-talking-to-awowogei.text: However, I am well aware that you may have a few things to offer.

chapter-3-talking-to-awowogei.speaker: Awowogei
chapter-3-talking-to-awowogei.text: I have heard your kind are exceptionally resourceful. I wish to put this reputation to the test.

chapter-3-talking-to-awowogei.speaker: Awowogei
chapter-3-talking-to-awowogei.text: You must be well aware your kind are hunted and trapped almost everywhere.

chapter-3-talking-to-awowogei.speaker: Awowogei
chapter-3-talking-to-awowogei.text: In particular you may have heard of such activities in a city known to the humans as Ardougne.

chapter-3-talking-to-awowogei.speaker: Awowogei
chapter-3-talking-to-awowogei.text: There are several of your kind kept captive there. I challenge you to free one and return it to me.

chapter-3-talking-to-awowogei.player: How am I meant to free one of them?

chapter-3-talking-to-awowogei.speaker: Awowogei
chapter-3-talking-to-awowogei.text: This is for you to decide, visitor.

chapter-3-talking-to-awowogei.player: Very well. I will be back later, with one of the captives.

chapter-3-talking-to-awowogei-again-befo.speaker: Awowogei
chapter-3-talking-to-awowogei-again-befo.text: Have you brought with you a captive?

chapter-3-talking-to-awowogei-again-befo.speaker: Awowogei
chapter-3-talking-to-awowogei-again-befo.text: Then hurry, visitor. I am beginning to lose my faith in you.

chapter-3-getting-captured-by-the-monkey.speaker: Monkey minder
chapter-3-getting-captured-by-the-monkey.text: Why do you monkeys keep trying to escape? Good thing I've caught you before you got away, you little scoundrel.

chapter-3-getting-captured-by-the-monkey.speaker: Monkey minder
chapter-3-getting-captured-by-the-monkey.text: Let's put you back in your cage where you belong...

chapter-3-getting-captured-by-the-monkey.speaker: Monkey minder
chapter-3-getting-captured-by-the-monkey.text: I must be imagining things ... monkeys can't talk.

chapter-3-talking-to-a-monkey-in-the-cag.player: How would you like to get out of here?

chapter-3-talking-to-a-monkey-in-the-cag.speaker: Monkey
chapter-3-talking-to-a-monkey-in-the-cag.text: Escape!? It's all I ever think about!

chapter-3-talking-to-a-monkey-in-the-cag.player: That's convenient. When would you like to leave?

chapter-3-talking-to-a-monkey-in-the-cag.speaker: Monkey
chapter-3-talking-to-a-monkey-in-the-cag.text: Where will you be taking me?

chapter-3-talking-to-a-monkey-in-the-cag.player: Erm ... to the happy, sunny jungle of Karamja...

chapter-3-talking-to-a-monkey-in-the-cag.speaker: Monkey
chapter-3-talking-to-a-monkey-in-the-cag.text: Wowee! I was born there you know!

chapter-3-talking-to-a-monkey-in-the-cag.player: That's nice. Are you ready to go?

chapter-3-talking-to-a-monkey-in-the-cag.speaker: Monkey
chapter-3-talking-to-a-monkey-in-the-cag.text: Yes. Actually, can I bring some of my friends?

chapter-3-talking-to-a-monkey-in-the-cag.player: No, I only have space for one.

chapter-3-talking-to-a-monkey-in-the-cag.speaker: Monkey
chapter-3-talking-to-a-monkey-in-the-cag.text: Pretty please with a banana on top?

chapter-3-talking-to-a-monkey-in-the-cag.player: Look, I already said no. If you want to come then jump into my backpack.

chapter-3-escaping-the-cage.speaker: Monkey minder
chapter-3-escaping-the-cage.text: My word - what are you doing in there?

chapter-3-escaping-the-cage.player: I ... er ... I don't know! One minute I was asleep, and the next minute I was here surrounded by monkeys!

chapter-3-escaping-the-cage.speaker: Monkey minder
chapter-3-escaping-the-cage.text: Well, don't worry. We'll have you out of there shortly.

chapter-3-bringing-awowogei-a-monkey.speaker: Awowogei
chapter-3-bringing-awowogei-a-monkey.text: Have you brought with you a captive?

chapter-3-bringing-awowogei-a-monkey.speaker: Awowogei
chapter-3-bringing-awowogei-a-monkey.text: You have shown yourself to be very resourceful. You have managed to complete an extremely long journey remarkably quickly.

chapter-3-bringing-awowogei-a-monkey.speaker: Awowogei
chapter-3-bringing-awowogei-a-monkey.text: You are clearly well acquainted with the ways of this world. We will talk more on this later.

chapter-3-bringing-awowogei-a-monkey.speaker: Awowogei
chapter-3-bringing-awowogei-a-monkey.text: In the meantime, feel free to remain as long as you like on my island.

chapter-3-bringing-awowogei-a-monkey.player: What about the proposed alliance, Awowogei?

chapter-3-bringing-awowogei-a-monkey.speaker: Awowogei
chapter-3-bringing-awowogei-a-monkey.text: I must think upon it some more and discuss the matter with my advisers. We will contact you when we are ready.

steps.speaker: King Awowogei
steps.text: We are still pondering your proposition...We will let you know when we have an answer...

chapter-3-talking-to-muruwoi-after-bring.speaker: Muruwoi
chapter-3-talking-to-muruwoi-after-bring.text: Well done on retrieving the captive, visitor. Awowogei was impressed.

chapter-3-returning-to-garkor.speaker: Garkor
chapter-3-returning-to-garkor.text: Well done on winning Awowogei's trust. I overheard everything from here.

chapter-3-returning-to-garkor.speaker: Garkor
chapter-3-returning-to-garkor.text: However, your efforts may be in vain...

chapter-3-returning-to-garkor.speaker: Garkor
chapter-3-returning-to-garkor.text: Progress in the caves has been slow. Whilst you were in Ardougne, Bunkwicket and Waymottin overheard a slightly disturbing conversation.

chapter-3-returning-to-garkor.player: Who was speaking? What was said?

chapter-3-returning-to-garkor.speaker: Garkor
chapter-3-returning-to-garkor.text: Listen closely whilst I narrate the details...
Somewhere far below the Ape Atoll...

chapter-3-returning-to-garkor.speaker: G.L.O. Caranock
chapter-3-returning-to-garkor.text: Good evening, Awowogei.

chapter-3-returning-to-garkor.speaker: Awowogei
chapter-3-returning-to-garkor.text: It is always dark here, Gnome. Why have you asked to see me in private?

chapter-3-returning-to-garkor.speaker: Waydar
chapter-3-returning-to-garkor.text: Caranock and I have a suggestion to make.

chapter-3-returning-to-garkor.speaker: Awowogei
chapter-3-returning-to-garkor.text: Then be quick about it.

chapter-3-returning-to-garkor.speaker: Waydar
chapter-3-returning-to-garkor.text: The foot soldiers of the Royal Guard in your jail...

chapter-3-returning-to-garkor.speaker: G.L.O. Caranock
chapter-3-returning-to-garkor.text: Would it not be easier if they were somehow just to ... die?

chapter-3-returning-to-garkor.speaker: Awowogei
chapter-3-returning-to-garkor.text: Why would I want to do that? Your king would declare war on my island.

chapter-3-returning-to-garkor.speaker: G.L.O. Caranock
chapter-3-returning-to-garkor.text: I can assure you he will not. We will lay the blame at the humans' feet.

chapter-3-returning-to-garkor.speaker: G.L.O. Caranock
chapter-3-returning-to-garkor.text: Narnode will indeed declare war: not against you, but against humankind.

chapter-3-returning-to-garkor.speaker: Waydar
chapter-3-returning-to-garkor.text: You are of course welcome to your share of the profits.

chapter-3-returning-to-garkor.speaker: Awowogei
chapter-3-returning-to-garkor.text: Intriguing. I have recently secured an alliance with the northern monkeys, which may prove useful.

chapter-3-returning-to-garkor.speaker: Awowogei
chapter-3-returning-to-garkor.text: What would you have me do?

chapter-3-returning-to-garkor.speaker: G.L.O. Caranock
chapter-3-returning-to-garkor.text: Kill the foot soldiers and the rest of the 10th squad. My superior has sent you a few tricks which may prove useful.

chapter-3-returning-to-garkor.speaker: Awowogei
chapter-3-returning-to-garkor.text: Such as?

chapter-3-returning-to-garkor.speaker: G.L.O. Caranock
chapter-3-returning-to-garkor.text: High magic: the ability to summon the entire 10th squad to a single location. And -

chapter-3-returning-to-garkor.speaker: Awowogei
chapter-3-returning-to-garkor.text: Even those who escaped?

chapter-3-returning-to-garkor.speaker: G.L.O. Caranock
chapter-3-returning-to-garkor.text: Yes. And of course, you will also receive access to one of his 'pets'.

chapter-3-returning-to-garkor.speaker: G.L.O. Caranock
chapter-3-returning-to-garkor.text: You must be careful with these, as you have only one use of each. Ensure you set your trap well - none must survive lest they spread the truth.

chapter-3-returning-to-garkor.speaker: Waydar
chapter-3-returning-to-garkor.text: What of my human?

chapter-3-returning-to-garkor.speaker: Awowogei
chapter-3-returning-to-garkor.text: What human??

chapter-3-returning-to-garkor.speaker: G.L.O. Caranock
chapter-3-returning-to-garkor.text: Ignore [him/her/them]. My colleague's official mission was to look after a human in the area, but don't worry: it is probably dead already.

chapter-3-returning-to-garkor.speaker: Awowogei
chapter-3-returning-to-garkor.text: I should hope so, for both of your sakes.

chapter-3-returning-to-garkor.speaker: Awowogei
chapter-3-returning-to-garkor.text: Very well. I shall let you know when I have dealt with the Royal Guard.

chapter-3-returning-to-garkor.speaker: G.L.O. Caranock
chapter-3-returning-to-garkor.text: Good luck, Awowogei.

chapter-3-returning-to-garkor.speaker: Awowogei
chapter-3-returning-to-garkor.text: With access to one of Glough's 'pets', I don't think I'll need it...
Monkey Madness: Chapter 4 The Final Battle

chapter-4.speaker: Garkor
chapter-4.text: Zooknock and I have come up with a plan.

chapter-4.speaker: Garkor
chapter-4.text: I hope you were listening closely. The teleportation spell that was provided will teleport ALL of the 10th squad, no matter where we may be.

chapter-4.speaker: Garkor
chapter-4.text: In effect, the spell will break Lumo, Bunkdo and Carado out of the jail for us.

chapter-4.player: But you will be teleported straight into whatever trap they have prepared!

chapter-4.speaker: Garkor
chapter-4.text: Indeed. This is where you come in. Do not forget that we are the 10th squad of the Royal Guard, and that we are more than capable of holding our own.

chapter-4.speaker: Garkor
chapter-4.text: With your assistance, we should be able to defeat whatever is thrown at us.

chapter-4.player: But how will I join you?

chapter-4.speaker: Garkor
chapter-4.text: Simple. We fool the teleportation spell that you are in fact a member of our squad.

chapter-4.speaker: Garkor
chapter-4.text: Zooknock knows Glough's grasp of magic well. He believes the spell is linked to the sigils that all of our squad carry.

chapter-4.speaker: Garkor
chapter-4.text: It is these sigils that identify us as a member of the squad.
Garkor hands you some kind of medallion.

chapter-4.speaker: Garkor
chapter-4.text: It is a replica Waymottin has made of our squad sigils. If you wear that when the spell is cast, you will be summoned along with the rest of us.

chapter-4.speaker: Garkor
chapter-4.text: You should prepare. Collect your thoughts and belongings and then wear the sigil. Hurry, human, we do not wish to enter this fight without you.

chapter-4.player: All I have to do is wear this sigil?

chapter-4.speaker: Garkor
chapter-4.text: Yes - but do not do so until you are ready.

steps.player: What should I do now?

steps.speaker: Garkor
steps.text: Collect your thoughts and belongings and then wear our squad sigil. Hurry, human, we do not wish to enter this fight without you.

options.text: What kind of enemy do we face?

steps.player: What kind of enemy do we face?

steps.speaker: Garkor
steps.text: I don't know. I truly don't know.

options.condition: If the player lost the 10th squad sigil:

steps.player: I've lost the sigil...

steps.speaker: Garkor
steps.text: For all your power, your kind are exceptionally foolish. You must seek out Waymottin and ask him to make a replica. I have no spares.

steps.speaker: Waymottin
steps.text: Can't you see I'm busy?

steps.speaker: Waymottin
steps.text: Can't talk now.

steps.speaker: Waymottin
steps.text: I'm too busy to talk, sorry.

chapter-4-talking-to-waymottin-without-a.player: Sergeant Garkor has sent me. You are asked to create another replica of the 10th squad sigil so that I may join you for the final battle.

chapter-4-talking-to-waymottin-without-a.speaker: Waymottin
chapter-4-talking-to-waymottin-without-a.text: Already made one. Figured it would come in handy.

chapter-4-talking-to-waymottin-without-a.speaker: Bunkwicket
chapter-4-talking-to-waymottin-without-a.text: He's cleverer than he looks, is that Waymottin.
Waymottin hands you a replica of the squad sigil.

chapter-4-equipping-the-sigil.prompt: Let the sigil teleport you when worn?

steps.text: The 10th squad sigil begins to shake violently!
A cutscene begins as the screen starts to shake. The camera slowly zooms out from the giant monkey statue in the underground banana plantation.
First time:

steps.speaker: Garkor
steps.text: Ready yourself, human: the final battle begins!
Subsequent times:

steps.speaker: Garkor
steps.text: Ready yourself, human: the final battle begins... again!

chapter-4-talking-to-garkor-after-killin.speaker: Garkor
chapter-4-talking-to-garkor-after-killin.text: Well done, human! For a second there, I thought we would fail.

chapter-4-talking-to-garkor-after-killin.speaker: Garkor
chapter-4-talking-to-garkor-after-killin.text: Indeed we did - and with no casualties either.

chapter-4-talking-to-garkor-after-killin.speaker: Garkor
chapter-4-talking-to-garkor-after-killin.text: You should report to King Narnode immediately. Tell him that the 10th squad still survives and has suffered no casualties.

chapter-4-talking-to-garkor-after-killin.player: Rest assured, I will do so. How do I leave this place?

chapter-4-talking-to-garkor-after-killin.speaker: Garkor
chapter-4-talking-to-garkor-after-killin.text: Speak to Zooknock. He will arrange for you to leave.

chapter-4-talking-to-bonzara.speaker: Bonzara
chapter-4-talking-to-bonzara.text: It looks like you're trying to escape. Would you like some help?

steps.player: I ... uh ... yes.

steps.speaker: Bonzara
steps.text: Right you are.
The player gets teleported to the surface of Ape Atoll.

steps.player: No thank you. Who are you by the way?

steps.speaker: Bonzara
steps.text: Never mind that child. You should worry more about who you are and the nature of the forces that have driven you here.

steps.player: I'll ... keep that in mind, thanks.

steps.speaker: Bonzara
steps.text: We WILL meet again, [player name].

steps.player: Ok...

chapter-4-talking-to-zooknock.speaker: Zooknock
chapter-4-talking-to-zooknock.text: Well done, human. Bear with me now.
The player is teleported out of the banana plantation

chapter-4-returning-to-king-narnode.speaker: King Narnode Shareen
chapter-4-returning-to-king-narnode.text: Yes? How is the mission going ... it has been quite some time since I sent you on your way.

chapter-4-returning-to-king-narnode.speaker: King Narnode Shareen
chapter-4-returning-to-king-narnode.text: Yes, alright. Report on what happened.

chapter-4-returning-to-king-narnode.player: With all due respect sir, if I told you, you would not believe me. I expect Sergeant Garkor will be sending you a full report soon enough.
They all live - we suffered no casualties.
I, uh, I'm part of the 10th squad now. I even have the sigil.

chapter-4-returning-to-king-narnode.text: You show King Narnode your sigil.

chapter-4-returning-to-king-narnode.speaker: King Narnode Shareen
chapter-4-returning-to-king-narnode.text: Well, now. It appears I cannot argue with that. Garkor obviously thinks highly of you, as do I.

chapter-4-returning-to-king-narnode.speaker: King Narnode Shareen
chapter-4-returning-to-king-narnode.text: No service such as what you have done for me goes unrewarded in my kingdom. I personally made a visit to the Royal Treasury to withdraw your reward.
King Narnode hands you a huge stack of gold coins and several diamonds!

chapter-4-returning-to-king-narnode.speaker: King Narnode Shareen
chapter-4-returning-to-king-narnode.text: So you're officially a member of the 10th squad then?

chapter-4-returning-to-king-narnode.speaker: King Narnode Shareen
chapter-4-returning-to-king-narnode.text: Well then you had better sign up for training.

chapter-4-returning-to-king-narnode.speaker: King Narnode Shareen
chapter-4-returning-to-king-narnode.text: Yes. All members of the Royal Guard must complete a mandatory training programme.

chapter-4-returning-to-king-narnode.player: Where do I sign up for this?

chapter-4-returning-to-king-narnode.speaker: King Narnode Shareen
chapter-4-returning-to-king-narnode.text: The High Tree Guardian Daero is in charge of the training programme. You should know where to find him by now.

post-quest-king-narnode.speaker: King Narnode Shareen
post-quest-king-narnode.text: Good of you to stop by, human.

post-quest-king-narnode.speaker: King Narnode Shareen
post-quest-king-narnode.text: Everything seems fine, as far as I can tell... I will let you know if there is any trouble.
You do not meet all of the requirements to start the Monkey Madness II quest.

options.text: I want to sign up for the training programme.

steps.player: Good day, High Tree Guardian.

steps.speaker: Daero
steps.text: Hello there. I hear your mission is complete.

steps.player: News travels quickly on this tree. I expect you also know that I am to be enrolled in the Royal Guard training programme.

steps.speaker: Daero
steps.text: Indeed I do.

steps.player: How long does it take?

steps.speaker: Daero
steps.text: For you, it should hardly take any time at all.

steps.player: Then let us begin.

steps.speaker: Daero
steps.text: Enthusiasm. I like that. We will first begin with a series of exercises designed to increase your strength and stamina.

steps.speaker: Daero
steps.text: We then will follow these up by improving your attack and defence techniques.

steps.speaker: Daero
steps.text: You will improve your strength, stamina, attack and defence, but you may choose what you want to focus on.

options.text: Focus on increasing strength and stamina...

steps.text: Several hours later...

options.text: Focus on improving attack and defence techniques...

steps.text: Several hours later...

options.text: I need to return to Crash Island.

steps.player: I need to return to Crash Island.

steps.speaker: Daero
steps.text: You know the routine...
You wear the blindfold Daero hands you.
The screen fades to black and the player is taken to the secret hangar.

post-quest-glough.speaker: Glough
post-quest-glough.text: This isn't the last you'll see of me, human. Mark my words - the monkeys are listening.

post-quest-lumo.player: How did you get back in there?

post-quest-lumo.speaker: Lumo
post-quest-lumo.text: Yes. We are working undercover here. Isn't that right, guys?

post-quest-carado.speaker: Carado
post-quest-carado.text: Well I'm not complaining - this jail cell is larger than my room in the Grand Tree! It is a little sparse however...

post-quest-carado.player: We'll get you out of there soon enough.

post-quest-carado.speaker: Carado
post-quest-carado.text: I'm meant to be here now. We're working undercover.

post-quest-garkor.speaker: Garkor
post-quest-garkor.text: My squad and I are to remain on this island as undercover operatives. I am collecting information on Awowogei and his policies.

post-quest-karam.speaker: Karam
post-quest-karam.text: My squad and I are to remain on this island in secret. The monkeys think we are trying to break our friends out of the jail, but we are just biding our time.

steps.speaker: Waymottin
steps.text: Can't you see I'm busy?

steps.speaker: Waymottin
steps.text: Can't talk now.

steps.speaker: Waymottin
steps.text: I'm too busy to talk, sorry.

post-quest-waymottin.speaker: Waymottin
post-quest-waymottin.text: But if you ever lose your sigil, let me know.

chapter-i-talking-to-king-narnode.speaker: King Narnode Shareen
chapter-i-talking-to-king-narnode.text: Good of you to stop by, human.
If the player does not have the requirements to start the quest:

steps.speaker: King Narnode Shareen
steps.text: Everything seems fine, as far as I can tell... I will let you know if there is any trouble.

chapter-i-talking-to-king-narnode.text: If the player has the requirements to start the quest:

steps.speaker: King Narnode Shareen
steps.text: All is not well, [player name]. Despite having had Glough under close surveillance since the events on Ape Atoll, he has managed to escape the Stronghold.

steps.speaker: King Narnode Shareen
steps.text: I know you have already done so much for our kingdom, but could you look into Glough's disappearance?

options.text: I'll help you look for Glough.

steps.player: I'll help you look for Glough.
Any idea on where to start?

steps.speaker: King Narnode Shareen
steps.text: You should look anywhere Glough may have left behind clues of his whereabouts. I've already had my men search his home, but perhaps you can find something they missed.

steps.player: I'll get right to it.
I'm busy at the moment.

steps.speaker: King Narnode Shareen
steps.text: Perhaps some other time, then.

chapter-i-talking-to-king-narnode-talkin.speaker: King Narnode Shareen
chapter-i-talking-to-king-narnode-talkin.text: How are you getting on, [player name]?

chapter-i-talking-to-king-narnode-talkin.player: What should I be looking for again?

chapter-i-talking-to-king-narnode-talkin.speaker: King Narnode Shareen
chapter-i-talking-to-king-narnode-talkin.text: You should look anywhere Glough may have left behind clues of his whereabouts. I've already had my men search his home, but perhaps you can find something they missed.

chapter-i-investigating-the-tree-in-glou.player: I wonder who could have left this in Glough's home? The initials A.A. are embroidered into it.

chapter-i-talking-to-anita.speaker: Anita
chapter-i-talking-to-anita.text: Why, yes, it is. I must have left it behind somewhere...
You return Anita's handkerchief - she looks as if she could use it.

steps.speaker: Anita
steps.text: sob* It's Glough... I fear for the worst!

steps.player: What do you mean?

steps.speaker: Anita
steps.text: I think he might be seeing someone else! *sob* I hadn't heard from him in a while, and so decided to give him a visit.

steps.speaker: Anita
steps.text: At first, I thought there was nobody home... *sob* But then I heard... *sob*

steps.player: Heard what?

steps.speaker: Anita
steps.text: I've already said too much. *sob* The last time I helped you, Glough lost his job!

options.text: What do you care? He's seeing someone else!

steps.player: What do you care? He's seeing someone else!

options.text: He might be in trouble, I could help.

steps.player: He might be in trouble, I could help.

steps.speaker: Anita
steps.text: I heard whispering coming from higher up in his tree! I managed to climb the first branch... *sob* But I'm not agile enough to get up to the highest level...

steps.speaker: Anita
steps.text: Do you really think he might have gotten into trouble? *sob*

steps.player: There's another level to his home?

steps.speaker: Anita
steps.text: sob* There's nowhere else the voices could have been coming from... *sob* Please, climb up there and let me know what you find!

steps.player: Any idea where Glough is?

steps.speaker: Anita
steps.text: The last time I helped you... *sob* Glough lost his job!

steps.player: Nothing, goodbye.

chapter-i-searching-fire-remains.text: The fire has been recently extinguished, you find a half burned note in the ashes.

chapter-i-reading-the-mysterious-note.player: The note is blank... I'm not sure what I'm meant to be reading right now.

chapter-i-reading-the-scrawled-note.text: The rest of the note has been destroyed by the fire.

chapter-i-reading-the-scrawled-note.player: I need to translate this before it's going to be of any use... Maybe the King can help.

chapter-i-reading-the-scrawled-note-read.player: What could the note mean? I should show it to the King, he might be able to make some sense of it.

chapter-i-talking-to-king-narnode-2.speaker: King Narnode Shareen
chapter-i-talking-to-king-narnode-2.text: How are you getting on, [player name]?

chapter-i-talking-to-king-narnode-2.player: I found a note in Glough's home which might be of use.

chapter-i-talking-to-king-narnode-2.speaker: King Narnode Shareen
chapter-i-talking-to-king-narnode-2.text: Excellent, do you have it with you?
You show the note to King Narnode.

chapter-i-talking-to-king-narnode-2.speaker: King Narnode Shareen
chapter-i-talking-to-king-narnode-2.text: Ah, I see that it is written in the ancient gnome language... Perhaps you could translate it with that translation book you've used before?
If the player doesn't have a translation book:

steps.player: I don't have a copy of the translation book any more.

steps.speaker: King Narnode Shareen
steps.text: Here's a spare copy.
King Narnode hands you a replacement copy of the translation book.

steps.player: I'll give it a go.

chapter-i-talking-to-king-narnode-2.text: If the player has a translation book:

steps.player: I'll give it a go.

chapter-i-translating-the-note.text: Some of the ancient Gnome phrases found on the note are missing from the translation book. I should tell the King.

chapter-i-talking-to-king-narnode-3.speaker: King Narnode Shareen
chapter-i-talking-to-king-narnode-3.text: How are you getting on, [player name]?

chapter-i-talking-to-king-narnode-3.player: There's too much missing from this translation book to make much sense of the note.

chapter-i-talking-to-king-narnode-3.speaker: King Narnode Shareen
chapter-i-talking-to-king-narnode-3.text: It is true that the translation guide is incomplete... Perhaps it would be of more use to go to the author directly?

chapter-i-talking-to-king-narnode-3.player: I'll see if the author can help translate the note for me, then.

steps.player: Could you translate these notes? I found them in Glough's home, half of it is missing.

steps.text: You show Anita the notes you found.

steps.speaker: Anita
steps.text: Hmm... This certainly isn't Glough's handwriting...
Anita takes a moment to translate the notes.
Anita hands you a translation of the notes.

steps.speaker: Anita
steps.text: Here you go, hopefully it helps you find Glough.

chapter-i-reading-the-translated-note.text: The rest of the note has been destroyed by the fire.

chapter-i-reading-the-translated-note.player: What could the note mean? I should show it to the King, he might be able to make some sense of it.

chapter-i-talking-to-king-narnode-4.player: King Narnode! With Anita's help I was able to translate the note... It appears Glough had help leaving the stronghold!

chapter-i-talking-to-king-narnode-4.speaker: King Narnode Shareen
chapter-i-talking-to-king-narnode-4.text: What!? Who could have committed such a crime? Show me the note.
King Narnode reads the translated note.

chapter-i-talking-to-king-narnode-4.speaker: King Narnode Shareen
chapter-i-talking-to-king-narnode-4.text: The note refers to a replacement pilot, we've only had one pilot reassigned recently and that's Lori taking over Le Smith's post as a balloon pilot.

chapter-i-talking-to-king-narnode-4.speaker: King Narnode Shareen
chapter-i-talking-to-king-narnode-4.text: [player name], you must find out where Glough might have travelled to. Assistant Lori may be able to help.

chapter-i-talking-to-king-narnode-talkin.speaker: King Narnode Shareen
chapter-i-talking-to-king-narnode-talkin.text: Have you been able to find out where Glough has gone, [player name]

chapter-i-talking-to-king-narnode-talkin.speaker: King Narnode Shareen
chapter-i-talking-to-king-narnode-talkin.text: Please hurry, [player name]. Glough is very dangerous and must be stopped!

chapter-i-talking-to-assistant-lori.speaker: Assistant Lori
chapter-i-talking-to-assistant-lori.text: Do you want to use the balloon? Just so you know, some locations require special logs and high Firemaking skills.

steps.player: Who are you?

steps.speaker: Assistant Lori
steps.text: I am Assistant Lori. I've been assigned to the stronghold by Auguste.

steps.player: What happened to Assistant Le Smith?

steps.speaker: Assistant Lori
steps.text: I'm not sure, you would have to speak to Auguste about that.

steps.speaker: Assistant Lori
steps.text: Do you want to use the balloon?

chapter-i-talking-to-auguste.speaker: Auguste
chapter-i-talking-to-auguste.text: Hello, [player name]. It is good to see you again. My enterprise has grown since we last met. I've expanded all over Gielinor!

chapter-i-talking-to-auguste.speaker: Auguste
chapter-i-talking-to-auguste.text: If you'd like to go to a new location, you will have to help fly the balloon again. Some of the routes are very dangerous!

chapter-i-talking-to-auguste.speaker: Auguste
chapter-i-talking-to-auguste.text: But each route you complete will earn you Firemaking experience.

chapter-i-talking-to-auguste.speaker: Auguste
chapter-i-talking-to-auguste.text: Once you've opened a route, it only costs 1 log of the corresponding type to travel there again, from any location you've already opened!

chapter-i-talking-to-auguste.speaker: Auguste
chapter-i-talking-to-auguste.text: I have also hired assistants to watch over the balloons at each new location we go to. They will help you get where you want to go.

chapter-i-talking-to-auguste.speaker: Auguste
chapter-i-talking-to-auguste.text: Do you want to use the balloon? Just so you know, some locations require special logs and high Firemaking skills.

steps.player: I'd like to talk about Assistant Le Smith.

steps.speaker: Auguste
steps.text: What a coincidence, he just so happened to visit recently. What's this about?

steps.player: I need to know about the route you taught him.

steps.speaker: Auguste
steps.text: Ah... I insisted it was far too dangerous, nobody has attempted to make that journey before!

steps.player: Where?

steps.speaker: Auguste
steps.text: Ape Atoll...

steps.player: Thanks for the information.

options.text: Can you teach me the route?

steps.player: Can you teach me the route?

steps.speaker: Auguste
steps.text: Most certainly not! For all I know, I've already sent one of my finest pilots to his peril!

chapter-i-talking-to-king-narnode-5.speaker: King Narnode Shareen
chapter-i-talking-to-king-narnode-5.text: How are you getting on, [player name]?

chapter-i-talking-to-king-narnode-5.player: I've found evidence that Glough may have headed to Ape Atoll.
Assistant Le Smith is involved, it appears he has flown them there.

chapter-i-talking-to-king-narnode-5.speaker: King Narnode Shareen
chapter-i-talking-to-king-narnode-5.text: Agh! We were foolish to allow him to stay here after dismissing him from the glider regiment.

chapter-i-talking-to-king-narnode-5.player: So, what should we do now?

chapter-i-talking-to-king-narnode-5.speaker: King Narnode Shareen
chapter-i-talking-to-king-narnode-5.text: Glough must be working with the monkeys once again. Fortunately, the rest of the 10th squad remained on Ape Atoll after your previous mission, they have been keeping a close eye on Awowogei.

chapter-i-talking-to-king-narnode-5.speaker: King Narnode Shareen
chapter-i-talking-to-king-narnode-5.text: Perhaps they will have spotted something out of the ordinary that could help indicate what Glough is doing.

chapter-i-talking-to-king-narnode-5.speaker: King Narnode Shareen
chapter-i-talking-to-king-narnode-5.text: Glough is a threat to us all... I must hereby re-assign you to Ape Atoll, [player name]. Report to Sergeant Garkor on Ape Atoll for further orders.

chapter-i-talking-to-king-narnode-talkin.speaker: King Narnode Shareen
chapter-i-talking-to-king-narnode-talkin.text: I have given you orders, [player name]. Report to Sergeant Garkor on Ape Atoll for further instruction.

steps.player: King Narnode has sent me. I'm investigating the disappearance of Glough.

steps.speaker: Garkor
steps.text: Glough... really? We've not had any indication that he has returned to Ape Atoll.

steps.speaker: Garkor
steps.text: But we have been seeing a lot of activity from Awowogei and his commanders - I assumed the king would send someone soon enough.

steps.player: Any idea what they're up to?

steps.speaker: Garkor
steps.text: We're not entirely sure, he has been keeping a tight lid on his plans. I guess it could be tied to Glough's disappearance? Perhaps you could get more information from Awowogei directly...

steps.speaker: Garkor
steps.text: He may be willing to share his plans with you, assuming you are disguised with a greegree, that is.

steps.player: That sounds far too dangerous.

steps.speaker: Garkor
steps.text: A member of the 10th squad should never back down in the face of adversity, come back when you're feeling up to the task.

steps.player: It's worth a shot.

steps.speaker: Garkor
steps.text: Good luck, [player name].

options.text: What are you still doing here?

steps.player: What are you still doing here?

steps.speaker: Garkor
steps.text: My squad and I are still carrying out reconnaissance. Awowogei has been very occupied as of lately, could this have something to do with why you're here?

steps.player: I'm only passing through.
I'm only passing through.

chapter-ii-talking-to-garkor-talking-to-.speaker: Garkor
chapter-ii-talking-to-garkor-talking-to-.text: Have you learned anything from Awowogei yet?

chapter-ii-talking-to-garkor-talking-to-.speaker: Garkor
chapter-ii-talking-to-garkor-talking-to-.text: We can't give up, [player name], come back when you've got more information.

chapter-ii-talking-to-garkor-talking-to-.player: I'll get to it right away.

chapter-ii-talking-to-awowogei.speaker: Awowogei
chapter-ii-talking-to-awowogei.text: What do you want? I'm very busy right now.

steps.player: How are things going, Awowogei?

steps.speaker: Awowogei
steps.text: I don't have time for idle chat! What do you want?

options.text: I'm here to discuss military strategies.

steps.player: I'm here to discuss military strategies.

steps.speaker: Awowogei
steps.text: I only discuss such matters with my highest ranking military officials. In fact, I am supposed to be in a meeting with my commander right now. Kruk has been consistently late to our meetings recently.

steps.speaker: Awowogei
steps.text: Uwogo, have a messenger fetch him from his post.

steps.speaker: Uwogo
steps.text: I'm afraid all of our messengers are busy.

steps.speaker: Awowogei
steps.text: Hmmm, perhaps you could make yourself useful after all, visitor. Why don't you run along to the gate and remind Kruk of our meeting.

steps.player: Of course, my king.
Garkor isn't going to be happy when I tell him about this...

steps.speaker: Awowogei
steps.text: What was that? Is there a problem?

steps.player: None at all.

steps.speaker: Awowogei
steps.text: Excellent. I must prepare for my meeting, Uwogo.

steps.speaker: Uwogo
steps.text: I'm afraid your time with the king is up, you should fetch Kruk from his post on the gate.

options.text: I don't take orders from you!

steps.player: I don't take orders from you!

options.text: Any idea where I can find Glough?

steps.player: Any idea where I can find Glough?

steps.speaker: Awowogei
steps.text: I don't know what you're talking about. We haven't been involved with Glough since he failed us.

chapter-ii-talking-to-garkor-2.speaker: Garkor
chapter-ii-talking-to-garkor-2.text: Have you learned anything from Awowogei yet?

chapter-ii-talking-to-garkor-2.player: He won't discuss his plans with anyone but his military commanders.

chapter-ii-talking-to-garkor-2.speaker: Garkor
chapter-ii-talking-to-garkor-2.text: Ah, the monkey has more sense than we give him credit for... Perhaps you could go back in there as one of his commanders?

chapter-ii-talking-to-garkor-2.speaker: Garkor
chapter-ii-talking-to-garkor-2.text: Zooknock could get you disguised as one of Awowogei's commanders if you retrieved the necessary items for him to make a greegree. We just need to choose which commander to go after...

chapter-ii-talking-to-garkor-2.player: Well Awowogei mentioned something about a meeting with Kruk. He wanted me to go to find him.

chapter-ii-talking-to-garkor-2.speaker: Garkor
chapter-ii-talking-to-garkor-2.text: Kruk eh... Captain of the monkey guard would certainly be a useful disguise to have at our disposal. Hopefully you can find him somewhere isolated from the rest of the guards... Once you have defeated him, take his

chapter-ii-talking-to-garkor-2.speaker: Garkor
chapter-ii-talking-to-garkor-2.text: corpse to Zooknock along with an uncharged monkey talisman, well, you know the routine.

chapter-ii-talking-to-garkor-2.player: I'll get to it right away.

chapter-ii-talking-to-garkor-talking-to-.speaker: Garkor
chapter-ii-talking-to-garkor-talking-to-.text: Have you learned anything from Awowogei yet?

chapter-ii-talking-to-garkor-talking-to-.player: I'm still working on getting that greegree.

chapter-ii-talking-to-garkor-talking-to-.speaker: Garkor
chapter-ii-talking-to-garkor-talking-to-.text: Please hurry [player name], we need this information from Awowogei before it's too late.

chapter-ii-talking-to-garkor-talking-to-.player: I'll get to it right away.

chapter-ii-talking-to-the-monkey-archer.player: The king has sent me with a message for Kruk, any idea where I can find him?

chapter-ii-talking-to-the-monkey-archer.speaker: Monkey Archer
chapter-ii-talking-to-the-monkey-archer.text: Your guess is as good as mine, you didn't hear it from me, but he's been disappearing from his post a lot lately...

chapter-ii-talking-to-the-monkey-archer.speaker: Monkey Archer
chapter-ii-talking-to-the-monkey-archer.text: You might be able to track him down if you've got what it takes, although I wouldn't want to be the one caught sneaking up on Kruk!

chapter-ii-talking-to-the-monkey-archer.player: Any idea where to start looking?

chapter-ii-talking-to-the-monkey-archer.speaker: Monkey Archer
chapter-ii-talking-to-the-monkey-archer.text: There's only one way off the wall, and that's down the Western ramp to the shore. I know that's where I'd start looking.

chapter-ii-talking-to-the-monkey-archer-.speaker: Monkey Archer
chapter-ii-talking-to-the-monkey-archer-.text: You'd best not keep the king waiting, try tracking down Kruk's movements.

chapter-ii-talking-to-the-monkey-archer-.speaker: Monkey Archer
chapter-ii-talking-to-the-monkey-archer-.text: There's only one way off the wall, and that's down the Western ramp to the shore. I know that's where I'd start looking.

chapter-ii-confronting-kruk.speaker: Kruk
chapter-ii-confronting-kruk.text: I'm impressed you made it so far, human.

chapter-ii-confronting-kruk.speaker: Kruk
chapter-ii-confronting-kruk.text: However, I'm afraid that this is the end of the line for you.

chapter-ii-talking-to-awowogei-as-kruk.speaker: Awowogei
chapter-ii-talking-to-awowogei-as-kruk.text: Ah finally, Kruk! I was beginning to think you had run into trouble...

chapter-ii-talking-to-awowogei-as-kruk.speaker: Awowogei
chapter-ii-talking-to-awowogei-as-kruk.text: Excellent. Have you had any further considerations for our plans?

chapter-ii-talking-to-awowogei-as-kruk.player: And which plans would we be talking about here?

chapter-ii-talking-to-awowogei-as-kruk.speaker: Awowogei
chapter-ii-talking-to-awowogei-as-kruk.text: Are you sure everything is okay Kruk? You seem very distracted lately.

chapter-ii-talking-to-awowogei-as-kruk.player: I'm fine, just been very busy thinking over those plans. Could you remind me where we left off last time?

chapter-ii-talking-to-awowogei-as-kruk.speaker: Awowogei
chapter-ii-talking-to-awowogei-as-kruk.text: We decided to move forward with our three-way assault.

chapter-ii-talking-to-awowogei-as-kruk.speaker: Awowogei
chapter-ii-talking-to-awowogei-as-kruk.text: You were negotiating an alliance with the ogres and trolls, working on a new fleet of battleships and then developing that secret weapon of yours.

chapter-ii-talking-to-awowogei-as-kruk.speaker: Awowogei
chapter-ii-talking-to-awowogei-as-kruk.text: So, how is progress of our plans coming along?

chapter-ii-talking-to-awowogei-as-kruk.speaker: Awowogei
chapter-ii-talking-to-awowogei-as-kruk.text: Don't let me down Kruk, we all know what is at stake here.

chapter-ii-talking-to-garkor-3.speaker: Garkor
chapter-ii-talking-to-garkor-3.text: Have you learned anything from Awowogei yet?

chapter-ii-talking-to-garkor-3.player: The monkeys are planning another attack!

chapter-ii-talking-to-garkor-3.speaker: Garkor
chapter-ii-talking-to-garkor-3.text: Ah, this comes as little surprise. Did you uncover any details of the plans?

chapter-ii-talking-to-garkor-3.player: The assault is coming in three stages...
First, the monkeys wish to join into an alliance with the trolls and ogres...

chapter-ii-talking-to-garkor-3.speaker: Garkor
chapter-ii-talking-to-garkor-3.text: That makes sense, it's no secret that those races are no fans of humans, other than perhaps as ingredients in a soup... What else did you learn?

chapter-ii-talking-to-garkor-3.player: The monkeys have been building a fleet of battleships.

chapter-ii-talking-to-garkor-3.speaker: Garkor
chapter-ii-talking-to-garkor-3.text: That is odd, we have spies posted at the shipyard who haven't reported any news of this to us. I'll get a few scouts to look into it further. What's the final element to this attack?

chapter-ii-talking-to-garkor-3.player: Apparently Kruk has been working on a secret weapon, I've got no idea what it is.

chapter-ii-talking-to-garkor-3.speaker: Garkor
chapter-ii-talking-to-garkor-3.text: Well then, that sounds ominous. I'll have some men look into it. For now, let's deal with the problems we can solve.

chapter-ii-talking-to-garkor-3.speaker: Garkor
chapter-ii-talking-to-garkor-3.text: You must convince the trolls and ogres not to ally with the monkeys.

chapter-ii-talking-to-garkor-3.speaker: Garkor
chapter-ii-talking-to-garkor-3.text: You should pay a visit to the military officials of each race. I believe a troll general by the name of Kob is still filling that role in the Troll Stronghold. As for the ogres, I would recommend finding the head of the city

chapter-ii-talking-to-garkor-talking-to-.speaker: Garkor
chapter-ii-talking-to-garkor-talking-to-.text: You must convince the trolls and ogres not to ally with the monkeys.

chapter-ii-talking-to-garkor-talking-to-.speaker: Garkor
chapter-ii-talking-to-garkor-talking-to-.text: You should pay a visit to the military officials of each race. I believe a troll general by the name of Kob is still filling that role in the Troll Stronghold. As for the ogres, I would recommend finding the head of the city

options.text: I know about your deal with the monkeys.

steps.player: I know about your deal with the monkeys. I'm here to persuade you not to join their alliance.

steps.speaker: Kob
steps.text: Alliance? We plan to crush the hairy little men as soon as the humans are gone!

options.text: You won't be around to crush anyone when I'm done with you.

steps.player: You won't be around to crush anyone when I'm done with you.

steps.speaker: Kob
steps.text: Ah, this food thinks it's a brave one, this will be fun!

steps.speaker: Kob
steps.text: Here's the game, I kill you, we help little hairy men kill all the humans. You kill me, we call off the attack.

steps.player: I accept your challenge.
Not right now.

steps.speaker: Kob
steps.text: Maybe human not as brave as Kob thinks!

options.text: What would it take to persuade you not to attack the humans?

steps.player: What would it take to persuade you not to attack the humans?

steps.speaker: Kob
steps.text: Humans are all so weak! There is nothing you can offer us to stop the attack!

options.text: I'll just be on my way.

steps.player: Who are you?

steps.speaker: Kob
steps.text: I am Kob, mightiest of the troll generals!

options.text: I'll just be on my way.

steps.player: I'll just be on my way.

steps.speaker: Kob
steps.text: Hurry before I get hungry!

chapter-iii-defeating-kob.speaker: Kob
chapter-iii-defeating-kob.text: Wait! Maybe battle to death is too much...

chapter-iii-defeating-kob.speaker: Kob
chapter-iii-defeating-kob.text: You win, I will call off the attack.

chapter-iii-talking-to-keef.player: I'm looking for the head of the city guard...

chapter-iii-talking-to-keef.speaker: Keef
chapter-iii-talking-to-keef.text: You found him! What do you want, little human?

options.text: I know about your deal with the monkeys.

steps.player: I know about your deal with the monkeys. I'm here to persuade you not to join their alliance.

steps.speaker: Keef
steps.text: Hahaha! Monkeys offer us treasure, land and all the humans we can eat! What do you offer us?

options.text: Perhaps I could offer you more?

steps.player: Perhaps I could offer you more?

steps.speaker: Keef
steps.text: I don't think human can offer me cities like the monkey king can!

steps.player: Um... that's not going to work.

options.text: I offer to spare your life.

steps.player: I offer to spare your life.

steps.speaker: Keef
steps.text: Little human is brave! I think I can offer you a deal...

steps.speaker: Keef
steps.text: If you can defeat me in battle, I will tell my men not to help the monkeys.

steps.player: I accept your challenge.
Not right now.
I'm looking for a fight!

steps.speaker: Keef
steps.text: Hahaha, human is funny! You will barely fill my stomach, stop wasting my time!

steps.player: Nevermind.

chapter-iii-defeating-keef.speaker: Keef
chapter-iii-defeating-keef.text: Stop! Stop! You prove you are very strong, little human!

chapter-iii-defeating-keef.speaker: Keef
chapter-iii-defeating-keef.text: A deal is a deal. We will not be allies with the monkeys.

chapter-iii-talking-to-garkor.player: I have convinced the ogres and trolls not to form an alliance with the monkeys.

chapter-iii-talking-to-garkor.speaker: Garkor
chapter-iii-talking-to-garkor.text: I have had my men look into this supposed fleet of battleships. The shipyard has turned up nothing, although, someone did say they saw a familiar face sneaking around town.

chapter-iii-talking-to-garkor.speaker: Garkor
chapter-iii-talking-to-garkor.text: An old pilot from the stronghold, he went by the name of Le Smith. I hadn't heard of him since he was dismissed from the glider regiment.

chapter-iii-talking-to-garkor.player: Right. He's the one who flew Glough here...

chapter-iii-talking-to-garkor.speaker: Garkor
chapter-iii-talking-to-garkor.text: If that's the case then he's likely to have information we could use. You should track him down and see what you can learn.

chapter-iii-talking-to-garkor.player: Any idea where I should start looking?

chapter-iii-talking-to-garkor.speaker: Garkor
chapter-iii-talking-to-garkor.text: Your guess is as good as mine - he must be somewhere on Ape Atoll.

chapter-iii-talking-to-assistant-le-smit.speaker: Assistant Le Smith
chapter-iii-talking-to-assistant-le-smit.text: Sorry, I don't have an amulet of monkey speak.

chapter-iii-talking-to-assistant-le-smit.player: That's okay, I am wearing my... uh... amulet of human speak.

chapter-iii-talking-to-assistant-le-smit.speaker: Assistant Le Smith
chapter-iii-talking-to-assistant-le-smit.text: Oh, right... What are you doing here?

options.text: I was going to ask you the same question.

steps.player: I was going to ask you the same question.

steps.speaker: Assistant Le Smith
steps.text: Glough told me not to talk to anyone while I'm here.

steps.player: So you're here with Glough?

steps.speaker: Assistant Le Smith
steps.text: I've already said too much. Please, leave me be.

steps.player: Why is that?

steps.speaker: Assistant Le Smith
steps.text: The fleet must be kept top secret... Agh! Forget I said anything.

options.text: Awowogei has already informed me about the battleships.

steps.player: Awowogei has already informed me about the battleships. In fact, he sent me here to check up on your progress.

steps.speaker: Assistant Le Smith
steps.text: So what is it you want to know?

steps.player: Where is the fleet? The shipyard still seems pretty bare.

steps.speaker: Assistant Le Smith
steps.text: Aha! The shipyard? Of course you aren't going to find anything there!

steps.player: Aha... right... Of course?

steps.speaker: Assistant Le Smith
steps.text: The airships are being built just off the coast of Ape Atoll.

steps.player: Airships!? I mean... Right.

steps.speaker: Assistant Le Smith
steps.text: Anyway, I have to get back to work. Let Awowogei know everything is on schedule.

steps.player: Actually, I know enough already.

options.text: What fleet are you talking about?

steps.player: What fleet are you talking about?

steps.text: I've already said too much. Please, leave me be.

options.text: King Awowogei has sent me to find Glough.

steps.player: King Awowogei has sent me to find Glough.

steps.speaker: Assistant Le Smith
steps.text: Well you're not going to find him up here. I'm afraid I'm too busy to chat right now.

options.text: I was just admiring the view.

steps.player: I was just admiring the view.

steps.speaker: Assistant Le Smith
steps.text: Me too, it's perfect conditions for my test flight.

options.text: Good for you, I'll just be on my way.

steps.player: Good for you, I'll just be on my way.
Test flight?

steps.speaker: Assistant Le Smith
steps.text: Oh sorry, ignore that. I just meant it's a lovely day.

steps.player: I was just leaving.

steps.speaker: Assistant Le Smith
steps.text: Odd, I didn't think Awowogei was the type to work with humans...

steps.player: Um.. I am a prisoner of war here, Awowogei gets me to run errands.
