earning-their-trust-speaking-to-elena.speaker: Elena
earning-their-trust-speaking-to-elena.text: Not bad, did you speak to the king?

earning-their-trust-speaking-to-elena.player: I did, he admitted the plague is a hoax.
He did. Turns out he was lying to me though.
About his loyalty. It seems the plague is part of some evil plan of his. I still don't know what that is though.

earning-their-trust-speaking-to-elena.speaker: Elena
earning-their-trust-speaking-to-elena.text: This doesn't sound good at all. Should we tell someone?

earning-their-trust-speaking-to-elena.player: Not yet. I still need to work out exactly what's going on. I have some new allies who might help me with that though.

earning-their-trust-speaking-to-elena.speaker: Elena
earning-their-trust-speaking-to-elena.text: Well let me know as soon as you have something. And look after yourself out there, I worry about what you've got yourself involved in.

earning-their-trust-speaking-to-elena.player: I'll be careful Elena. I promise.

earning-their-trust-speaking-to-elena-sp.speaker: Elena
earning-their-trust-speaking-to-elena-sp.text: How dare you enter my house, Mourner! Get out!

earning-their-trust-speaking-to-elena-sp.speaker: Elena
earning-their-trust-speaking-to-elena-sp.text: [player name]? I didn't recogonise you in all that Mourner gear!

earning-their-trust-speaking-to-elena-sp.player: Sorry, didn't mean to scare you.

earning-their-trust-speaking-to-elena-sp.speaker: Elena
earning-their-trust-speaking-to-elena-sp.text: I worry about what you've got yourself involved in. You be careful out there.

earning-their-trust-speaking-to-elena-sp.player: I'll look after myself Elena. I promise.

earning-their-trust-speaking-to-elena-sp.speaker: Elena
earning-their-trust-speaking-to-elena-sp.text: You'd better. Let me know as soon as you work out what's going on.

earning-their-trust-for-the-greater-good.speaker: Essyllt
earning-their-trust-for-the-greater-good.text: Have you finished with those sheep yet?

earning-their-trust-for-the-greater-good.player: Yes, it is done. What next?

earning-their-trust-for-the-greater-good.speaker: Essyllt
earning-their-trust-for-the-greater-good.text: It is good to see your enthusiasm. I was going to get one of the others to do this job, but as you are here...

earning-their-trust-for-the-greater-good.speaker: Essyllt
earning-their-trust-for-the-greater-good.text: It has been quite some time since anyone got ill from the plague, so I would like you to see to it that people do!

earning-their-trust-for-the-greater-good.player: Err... But the plague doesn't exist, how am I meant to do that?

earning-their-trust-for-the-greater-good.speaker: Essyllt
earning-their-trust-for-the-greater-good.text: We have never tried this before, but some joker put something in our food not too long ago that gave us all symptoms akin to those of the plague.

earning-their-trust-for-the-greater-good.speaker: Essyllt
earning-their-trust-for-the-greater-good.text: If you can find out what it was that we were poisoned with, you could reproduce the effects. If done right the poison should not be fatal and could help restock our dwindling supply of cheap labour.

earning-their-trust-for-the-greater-good.speaker: Essyllt
earning-their-trust-for-the-greater-good.text: We can have our men remove the 'infected' citizens and sent into the mines.

earning-their-trust-for-the-greater-good.speaker: Essyllt
earning-their-trust-for-the-greater-good.text: Distribution should be easy enough. Because of the city walls no one can grow their own food. Instead, all the food here comes from one of three supply points.

earning-their-trust-for-the-greater-good.player: Let me get this clear, you want me to find out who poisoned you, find out what they poisoned you with, find out how to make the poison and produce enough poison to affect a lot of people?

earning-their-trust-for-the-greater-good.speaker: Essyllt
earning-their-trust-for-the-greater-good.text: Don't forget the part where you use the poison to contaminate the food supply. Two of the three supply points should be enough.

earning-their-trust-for-the-greater-good.player: How am I meant to do all of that?

earning-their-trust-for-the-greater-good.speaker: Essyllt
earning-their-trust-for-the-greater-good.text: You seem resourceful so I'm sure you will come up with something. I would help you but I am not a biologist.

earning-their-trust-for-the-greater-good.player: Luckily for me I know a biologist nearby.

earning-their-trust-for-the-greater-good.speaker: Essyllt
earning-their-trust-for-the-greater-good.text: Someone trustworthy I hope?

earning-their-trust-for-the-greater-good.player: Oh yes, definitely.

earning-their-trust-for-the-greater-good.speaker: Essyllt
earning-their-trust-for-the-greater-good.text: Very well. Perform this task and then return to me.

earning-their-trust-for-the-greater-good.speaker: Essyllt
earning-their-trust-for-the-greater-good.text: You're back already? How is the epidemic going?

earning-their-trust-for-the-greater-good.player: The epidemic? Oh, you mean the poisoning?

earning-their-trust-for-the-greater-good.speaker: Essyllt
earning-their-trust-for-the-greater-good.text: Subtle as a brick... Yes that, how is it going?

earning-their-trust-for-the-greater-good.player: Can you explain to me again what it is I have to do?

earning-their-trust-for-the-greater-good.speaker: Essyllt
earning-their-trust-for-the-greater-good.text: We need you to make it seem like people are ill with the plague. It will help keep the lie alive and also give us an excuse to abduct some more slaves for the mines.

earning-their-trust-for-the-greater-good.player: How am I meant to do that?
Hello again Elena.

earning-their-trust-for-the-greater-good.text: If the player is wearing full mourner gear:

steps.speaker: Elena
steps.text: How dare you enter my house, Mourner! Get out!

steps.player: Elena, it's me... [player name].

steps.speaker: Elena
steps.text: [player name]? I didn't recognise you in all that Mourner gear!

steps.player: It's a long story.

steps.speaker: Elena
steps.text: Well I'm not going anywhere. What's going on?

earning-their-trust-for-the-greater-good.text: If the player is not wearing full mourner gear:

steps.speaker: Elena
steps.text: [player name]! How's it going? Have you found out any more about the plague?

steps.player: As it goes, yes I have. It's a long story.

steps.speaker: Elena
steps.text: Well I'm not going anywhere.

steps.player: It turns out the king was lying to me.

steps.speaker: Elena
steps.text: Lying? About what?

steps.player: About his loyalty.

steps.speaker: Elena
steps.text: His loyalty? What's going on?

earning-their-trust-for-the-greater-good.player: Well I'll start from when we found out that the plague was a hoax. When I confronted the king, he told me that he faked the plague to keep people safe from his brother, King Tyras.
He said that Tyras was taken by the Dark Lord while exploring the lands to the west. He claimed that the Dark Lord corrupted him by forcing him to drink from the Chalice of Eternity.

earning-their-trust-for-the-greater-good.speaker: Elena
earning-their-trust-for-the-greater-good.text: But that was a lie?

earning-their-trust-for-the-greater-good.player: Indeed, but I didn't find out until much later. On the kings orders, I travelled through the Underground Pass and into the western lands of Tirannwn.
Once there, I met up with Lord Iorwerth, the leader of some elves that had allied with the king. He helped me kill King Tyras.
That was when I discovered the truth. While returning to King Lathas, I was confronted by another elf named Arianwyn, the leader of a group of rebel elves opposing Lord Iorwerth.
At the time, I was carrying a letter from Lord Iorwerth to King Lathas. Arianwyn magically broke the seal on the letter so I could read it.

earning-their-trust-for-the-greater-good.speaker: Elena
earning-their-trust-for-the-greater-good.text: What did it say?

earning-their-trust-for-the-greater-good.player: It revealed that it's actually King Lathas and Lord Iorwerth who serve the Dark Lord. According to the letter, King Lathas wants to reclaim Camelot from King Arthur and believes the Dark Lord can help him.

earning-their-trust-for-the-greater-good.speaker: Elena
earning-their-trust-for-the-greater-good.text: And Lord Iorwerth?

earning-their-trust-for-the-greater-good.player: I'm not exactly sure yet. West Ardougne seems to be key to his plans though. I met with Arianwyn who revealed to me that the mourners are actually elves in service to Lord Iorwerth.
I've infiltrated the mourners and I'm trying to work out what they are doing. From what I've learnt so far, there's something important to them in the caves below West Ardougne.
I'm currently working with them to earn their trust. Hopefully they'll reveal their plans to me soon.

earning-their-trust-for-the-greater-good.speaker: Elena
earning-their-trust-for-the-greater-good.text: I see, that's quite the reveal. If you need anything from me just ask.

earning-their-trust-for-the-greater-good.player: Well, I was hoping you could help me with something.

earning-their-trust-for-the-greater-good.speaker: Elena
earning-their-trust-for-the-greater-good.text: What's the problem?

earning-their-trust-for-the-greater-good.player: I've been asked to produce a poison based on rotten apples.

earning-their-trust-for-the-greater-good.speaker: Elena
earning-their-trust-for-the-greater-good.text: I doubt any poison based solely on apples, rotten or not, would be very effective.

earning-their-trust-for-the-greater-good.player: Well I put a rotten apple in the mourners' stew, I'm told that the effect was much like the symptoms of the plague.

earning-their-trust-for-the-greater-good.speaker: Elena
earning-their-trust-for-the-greater-good.text: Hmm... That sounds like they were ill from some sort of toxin, I should think it was a mould of some sort that had the effect, not the rotten apple itself. What do you need it for?

earning-their-trust-for-the-greater-good.player: I need to poison a large food supply in order to get the mourners' trust.

earning-their-trust-for-the-greater-good.speaker: Elena
earning-their-trust-for-the-greater-good.text: That's awful, I can't help you with that.

earning-their-trust-for-the-greater-good.player: If I don't gain the trust of the mourners, then the people of West Ardougne will have a much worse time than the effects of that toxin. Elena trust me.

earning-their-trust-for-the-greater-good.speaker: Elena
earning-their-trust-for-the-greater-good.text: You'd better be right about this, and I'd better make sure you get this toxin right so no one dies!

earning-their-trust-for-the-greater-good.speaker: Elena
earning-their-trust-for-the-greater-good.text: Bring me a sample of rotten apple to examine. I'll also see if I can make a counteractant for the toxin.
Without a rotten apple in the inventory:

steps.player: Alright I'll be back shortly with a rotten apple for you.

earning-their-trust-for-the-greater-good.text: With a rotten apple in the inventory:

steps.player: I have one right here.

steps.text: You hand Elena the rotten apple.

earning-their-trust-for-the-greater-good.player: I'm back.

earning-their-trust-for-the-greater-good.speaker: Elena
earning-their-trust-for-the-greater-good.text: You have a sample of rotten apple for me?

earning-their-trust-for-the-greater-good.player: No, I forgot to get one.

earning-their-trust-for-the-greater-good.speaker: Elena
earning-their-trust-for-the-greater-good.text: Well if you bring me one we can get started on this toxin.

earning-their-trust-for-the-greater-good.speaker: Elena
earning-their-trust-for-the-greater-good.text: Is that you [player name]?

earning-their-trust-for-the-greater-good.player: Yes it's me.

earning-their-trust-for-the-greater-good.speaker: Elena
earning-their-trust-for-the-greater-good.text: You have a sample of rotten apple for me?

earning-their-trust-for-the-greater-good.player: Yes I have it right here.

earning-their-trust-for-the-greater-good.text: You hand Elena the rotten apple.

earning-their-trust-for-the-greater-good.speaker: Elena
earning-their-trust-for-the-greater-good.text: Ick... Alright then let's get started.
Elena starts some tests on the apple.

earning-their-trust-for-the-greater-good.speaker: Elena
earning-their-trust-for-the-greater-good.text: Right.. lets see...

earning-their-trust-for-the-greater-good.speaker: Elena
earning-their-trust-for-the-greater-good.text: Okay, I've managed to isolate a small sample of the toxin. It's a byproduct of the mould that grows on these apples, it's not fatal so a counteractant shouldn't be necessary.

earning-their-trust-for-the-greater-good.speaker: Elena
earning-their-trust-for-the-greater-good.text: How big is the store that you're going to affect?

earning-their-trust-for-the-greater-good.player: Well I was instructed to contaminate two of the three supply points in West Ardougne.

earning-their-trust-for-the-greater-good.speaker: Elena
earning-their-trust-for-the-greater-good.text: That's over half of the food in the city! You're going to need a huge amount of the toxin to do that. You're also going to need to refine it too, or people will notice rotten apples in amongst the food.

earning-their-trust-for-the-greater-good.player: This is starting to sound a little tricky, can't you make it for me?

earning-their-trust-for-the-greater-good.speaker: Elena
earning-their-trust-for-the-greater-good.text: I would, but I don't have the right equipment here to do anything in bulk.

earning-their-trust-for-the-greater-good.player: Alright then, tell me the process and I'll get started.

earning-their-trust-for-the-greater-good.speaker: Elena
earning-their-trust-for-the-greater-good.text: Right then, the first thing to do is mash up a lot of rotten apples, then you will need to dissolve the toxin into a liquid that has a very low evaporation point, some form of solvent.

earning-their-trust-for-the-greater-good.speaker: Elena
earning-their-trust-for-the-greater-good.text: I don't know as much about those kinds of chemicals but I believe naphtha will be perfect for this.

earning-their-trust-for-the-greater-good.player: Ah yes, I've worked with naphtha before. The chemist in Rimmington helped me make it from coal tar.

earning-their-trust-for-the-greater-good.speaker: Elena
earning-their-trust-for-the-greater-good.text: Perfect. Well get yourself some naphtha and some mashed rotten apples and mix them together. Once you've done that, strain out any solids.

earning-their-trust-for-the-greater-good.speaker: Elena
earning-their-trust-for-the-greater-good.text: Finally, heat the mixture to evaporate off the solvent. Be careful of naked flames as the solvent will be highly flammable.

earning-their-trust-for-the-greater-good.player: And that's all is it? Why isn't anything ever easy?

earning-their-trust-for-the-greater-good.speaker: Elena
earning-their-trust-for-the-greater-good.text: Sorry, I never said it would be simple. Here, you'll need this to strain out the solids.
Elena hands you a large sieve.

earning-their-trust-for-the-greater-good.speaker: Elena
earning-their-trust-for-the-greater-good.text: You may want to check out the orchard just north of the city. I hear no one has tended it since the blight infected the trees there. I imagine it will have plenty of rotten apples.

earning-their-trust-for-the-greater-good.player: It will take forever to fill like this. I need something that can transport lots of rotten apples in it.

earning-their-trust-for-the-greater-good.text: You scoop up a barrel full of the rotten apples.
You use the apple press to crush your rotten apples.
You get a barrel full of crushed rotten apples.
You mix the naphtha with the apple mush.

earning-their-trust-for-the-greater-good.player: Hey Elena.

earning-their-trust-for-the-greater-good.text: With full mourner's gear equipped:

steps.speaker: Elena
steps.text: Huh? Oh hello. I just can't get used to a friend being dressed as mourner.

earning-their-trust-for-the-greater-good.speaker: Elena
earning-their-trust-for-the-greater-good.text: So how's the poisoning going?

earning-their-trust-for-the-greater-good.player: Not too well, can you remind me how I should make it again?

earning-their-trust-for-the-greater-good.speaker: Elena
earning-their-trust-for-the-greater-good.text: Right, the first thing to do is mash up a lot of rotten apples. You'll probably be able to do that at the orchard just north of the city. I hear no one has tended it since the blight infected the trees there.

earning-their-trust-for-the-greater-good.speaker: Elena
earning-their-trust-for-the-greater-good.text: Next, you'll want to get yourself some naphtha and mix it with the rotten apples. You mentioned the chemist in Rimmingon helped you with naphtha before. You might want to speak to him again.

earning-their-trust-for-the-greater-good.speaker: Elena
earning-their-trust-for-the-greater-good.text: Once that's done, use the sieve I gave you to strain out any solids. Finally, heat the mixture to evaporate off the solvent. Be careful of naked flames as the solvent will be highly flammable.

earning-their-trust-for-the-greater-good.player: Okay, thanks Elena.

earning-their-trust-for-the-greater-good.speaker: Elena
earning-their-trust-for-the-greater-good.text: No problem.

earning-their-trust-contaminating-the-st.text: You sieve the solids out of the mixture.
You evaporate the naphtha and you're left with a powdery residue on the insides of the barrel.

steps.speaker: Elena
steps.text: Huh? Oh hello. I just can't get used to a friend being dressed as a mourner.

earning-their-trust-contaminating-the-st.player: It's going okay, I made a batch of the toxin but have yet to use it.

earning-their-trust-contaminating-the-st.speaker: Elena
earning-their-trust-contaminating-the-st.text: Well be careful, that toxin is nasty stuff!
You add the toxin to the grain, after a few seconds of mixing you can't tell the difference.

earning-their-trust-contaminating-the-st.speaker: Elena
earning-their-trust-contaminating-the-st.text: So have you found out what those mourner are up to yet?

earning-their-trust-contaminating-the-st.player: I was just on my way back there.

earning-their-trust-contaminating-the-st.speaker: Elena
earning-their-trust-contaminating-the-st.text: Well let me know when you find out.

earning-their-trust-contaminating-the-st.player: Nothing I'm just talking to people randomly in case it helps.

earning-their-trust-contaminating-the-st.speaker: Gnome
earning-their-trust-contaminating-the-st.text: Maybe you should give me more toad crunchies. Ask any gnome, 'toad should be in everything' they'll tell you, mark my words.

earning-their-trust-contaminating-the-st.speaker: Gnome
earning-their-trust-contaminating-the-st.text: Thanks... Toads always hit the spot!

earning-their-trust-contaminating-the-st.speaker: Gnome
earning-their-trust-contaminating-the-st.text: I got no need for that, keep it.

the-mourners-plan.speaker: Essyllt
the-mourners-plan.text: You are back already? How is the epidemic going?

the-mourners-plan.player: The epidemic? Oh, you mean the poisoning?

the-mourners-plan.speaker: Essyllt
the-mourners-plan.text: Subtle as a brick... Yes that, how is it going?

the-mourners-plan.speaker: Essyllt
the-mourners-plan.text: This is good news, give it a few days and the slave pens will be full again.

the-mourners-plan.player: So have I proved my commitment now?

the-mourners-plan.speaker: Essyllt
the-mourners-plan.text: Yes I think you have. I guess you want to know what we're doing in the mines?

the-mourners-plan.speaker: Essyllt
the-mourners-plan.text: A long time ago, Seren herself ordered the construction of a great temple deep beneath the earth. This temple guards a great power, one that is key to our plans.

the-mourners-plan.speaker: Essyllt
the-mourners-plan.text: We believe the temple lies beneath this city. That is why we are here.

the-mourners-plan.speaker: Essyllt
the-mourners-plan.text: Unfortunately, progress has been slower than we'd have liked. The slaves accidentally mined into some old caverns infested with beasts. They have caused us significant issues.

the-mourners-plan.player: I see. But how close are we to finding it?

the-mourners-plan.speaker: Essyllt
the-mourners-plan.text: It shouldn't be long now. We have started to see signs that we are near.

the-mourners-plan.speaker: Essyllt
the-mourners-plan.text: Anyway, now that you know about the temple, I have a new task for you to perform, deep within the mines.

the-mourners-plan.speaker: Essyllt
the-mourners-plan.text: Alas, one of the guards has taken the key to the mines to be copied. Report in regularly and I will see that you get a copy as soon as he gets back.

the-mourners-plan.speaker: Essyllt
the-mourners-plan.text: Now be on your way, I have other things to attend to.

the-mourners-plan.player: I should probably report this to Arianwyn.

the-mourners-plan-talking-to-essyllt-aga.player: Do you have the key to the mines yet?

the-mourners-plan-talking-to-essyllt-aga.speaker: Essyllt
the-mourners-plan-talking-to-essyllt-aga.text: No, the guard is being a bit slow, but we should have it soon.

the-mourners-plan-talking-to-essyllt-aga.player: Alright, I'll report in again later.

the-mourners-plan-talking-to-elena-again.speaker: Elena
the-mourners-plan-talking-to-elena-again.text: Hello [player name]. Have you found out what those mourners are up to yet?

the-mourners-plan-talking-to-elena-again.player: Apparently they are trying to find an old temple deep under the city. That's what their mining operation is for.
The temple seems to be the key to their plans. It apparently holds a great power. I still have no idea what that is yet though.

the-mourners-plan-talking-to-elena-again.speaker: Elena
the-mourners-plan-talking-to-elena-again.text: Well let me know when you find out.

the-mourners-plan-reporting-back-to-aria.player: I think I have the information you're after. It seems Iorwerth elves are searching for an ancient temple of some sort deep beneath West Ardougne.

the-mourners-plan-reporting-back-to-aria.speaker: Arianwyn
the-mourners-plan-reporting-back-to-aria.text: Temple? That must be the Temple of Light!

the-mourners-plan-reporting-back-to-aria.player: Temple of Light? What's the Temple of Light?

the-mourners-plan-reporting-back-to-aria.speaker: Arianwyn
the-mourners-plan-reporting-back-to-aria.text: It was built by Seren herself to guard a dark and ancient power. This is not good friend, I fear Lord Iorwerth intends to use that power to summon the Dark Lord!

the-mourners-plan-reporting-back-to-aria.player: I don't think they've found this temple yet, but they know it's down there.

the-mourners-plan-reporting-back-to-aria.speaker: Arianwyn
the-mourners-plan-reporting-back-to-aria.text: Well then we still have time. Thank you for your help so far, we would never have discovered this without you. Now we must prepare for what comes next.

the-mourners-plan-reporting-back-to-aria.player: So what are we going to do about the Temple of Light?

the-mourners-plan-reporting-back-to-aria.speaker: Arianwyn
the-mourners-plan-reporting-back-to-aria.text: First of all, we need to know how close the Iorwerth elves are to finding it. Do you think you are ready for this?

the-mourners-plan-reporting-back-to-aria.prompt: Start the Mourning's End Part II quest?

steps.player: I'll head over there right away.

steps.speaker: Arianwyn
steps.text: Thank you friend. Don't forget your disguise.

yvBLv1.player: Alright, I've managed to infiltrate the mourners. I just have to find out what they are up to now.

yvBLv1.speaker: Arianwyn
yvBLv1.text: Great work! Stick with it [player name].

starting-the-quest.player: Hello Arianwyn. What are we going to do about the Temple of Light?

starting-the-quest.speaker: Arianwyn
starting-the-quest.text: First of all, we need to know how close the Iorwerth elves are to finding it. Return to the Mourner Headquarters and gain access to their mine. Once there, see what you can discover about the temple.

starting-the-quest.prompt: Start the Mourning's End Part II quest?

steps.player: I'll head over there right away.

steps.speaker: Arianwyn
steps.text: Thank you friend. Don't forget your disguise.

steps.player: I don't have time to do that right now.

steps.speaker: Arianwyn
steps.text: Well don't take too long. Every second we waste is a big risk.

starting-the-quest-talking-to-arianwyn-a.player: What do I need to do again?

starting-the-quest-talking-to-arianwyn-a.speaker: Arianwyn
starting-the-quest-talking-to-arianwyn-a.text: Return to the Mourner Headquarters and gain access to their mine. Once there, see what you can discover about the Temple of Light.

starting-the-quest-talking-to-arianwyn-a.speaker: Arianwyn
starting-the-quest-talking-to-arianwyn-a.text: Thank you friend. Don't forget your disguise.

talking-to-essylt.player: Do you have the key to the excavation site yet?

talking-to-essylt.text: If the player's inventory is full:

steps.speaker: Essylt
steps.text: Try freeing up some space in your inventory, then we can talk about keys.

talking-to-essylt.speaker: Essylt
talking-to-essylt.text: The guard has finally returned. Seems it took him so long because he had ten times more cut than we needed.

talking-to-essylt.player: That's useful. I'm always losing keys.
So... You mentioned a task you had for me, something to do with the mines?

talking-to-essylt.speaker: Essylt
talking-to-essylt.text: That's right. One of our dig teams has gone missing while searching for the temple. I need you to find out what happened to them.

talking-to-essylt.speaker: Essylt
talking-to-essylt.text: You say that now but the beasts in the mines are deadly, you'll have to be very careful in there.
Essylt hands you a newly cut key.

talking-to-essylt-talking-to-essylt-agai.speaker: Essylt
talking-to-essylt-talking-to-essylt-agai.text: Any news yet on our missing dig team?
If the player lost the mine key:

steps.player: I've lost the key to the mine.

steps.text: If the player's inventory is full:

steps.speaker: Essylt
steps.text: Free up some inventory space and get another one from my desk.

steps.speaker: Essylt
steps.text: Have a new one then, if you lose it help yourself to one from my desk.
Essylt hands you a newly cut key.

reaching-the-temple.text: Player approaches the temple entrance and sees the lifeless bodies of the dig team

reaching-the-temple.player: Well this looks like the dig team, and it seems they managed to find the temple. I'd better let Arianwyn know before the Mourners find out.

steps.text: You find a colour wheel and some notes but you don't have enough room to take them.
You find a colour wheel and some notes.

reaching-the-temple-talking-to-essylt-af.speaker: Essylt
reaching-the-temple-talking-to-essylt-af.text: Any news yet on our missing dig team?

reaching-the-temple-talking-to-essylt-af.player: No, I have looked everywhere but I can't see any sign of them.

reaching-the-temple-talking-to-essylt-af.speaker: Essylt
reaching-the-temple-talking-to-essylt-af.text: This is not good news. Did you find anything else down there?

reaching-the-temple-talking-to-essylt-af.player: Nothing other than the beasts you spoke of.

reaching-the-temple-talking-to-essylt-af.speaker: Essylt
reaching-the-temple-talking-to-essylt-af.text: I must ask you to return to the search. Do let me know if you see anything elven-made down there as well. Any clues to the location of the temple will be very helpful.

reaching-the-temple-talking-to-essylt-af.player: I'll let you know as soon as I find something.

reaching-the-temple-talking-to-essylt-af.text: If the player lost the mine key:

steps.player: I've lost the key to the mine.

returning-to-arianwyn-after-being-given-.player: Good, I have been given access to the mine beneath West Ardougne. I can now begin searching it.

returning-to-arianwyn-after-being-given-.speaker: Arianwyn
returning-to-arianwyn-after-being-given-.text: Very good, let me know when you discover something.

returning-to-arianwyn-after-finding-the-.speaker: Arianwyn
returning-to-arianwyn-after-finding-the-.text: [player name], what is the latest news?

returning-to-arianwyn-after-finding-the-.player: I think I have found the entrance to the temple. It looks like one of the dig crews discovered it. They were killed by some strange shadows though, so the other mourners don't know about it yet.

returning-to-arianwyn-after-finding-the-.speaker: Arianwyn
returning-to-arianwyn-after-finding-the-.text: This isn't good, it will only be a matter of time before they discover the temple.

returning-to-arianwyn-after-finding-the-.speaker: Arianwyn
returning-to-arianwyn-after-finding-the-.text: I did some research while you were gone. Apparently, the temple was built with safeguards to prevent all but Seren's chosen from entering.

returning-to-arianwyn-after-finding-the-.speaker: Arianwyn
returning-to-arianwyn-after-finding-the-.text: If there are shadows roaming outside the temple, it means those safeguards have long since decayed. I believe we can still restore them though.

returning-to-arianwyn-after-finding-the-.speaker: Arianwyn
returning-to-arianwyn-after-finding-the-.text: The temple guards an ancient altar, one with powers over life and death. I suspect this altar is why Lord Iorwerth is so keen to access the temple.

returning-to-arianwyn-after-finding-the-.player: You think he means to use it to summon the Dark Lord?

returning-to-arianwyn-after-finding-the-.speaker: Arianwyn
returning-to-arianwyn-after-finding-the-.text: Indeed. Now, the altar is also key to the safeguards on the temple. We will need to use it to restore them.

returning-to-arianwyn-after-finding-the-.speaker: Arianwyn
returning-to-arianwyn-after-finding-the-.text: First, I need you to return to the temple and find the crystal that is powering the safeguards. As they are no long working, I expect the crystal will be black in colour.

returning-to-arianwyn-after-finding-the-.speaker: Arianwyn
returning-to-arianwyn-after-finding-the-.text: Bring me a sample of this crystal. We will then determine our next steps.
If the player doesn't have the black crystal:

steps.player: So go to the temple, find a black crystal and bring you a sample of it. Got it. I'll be back soon.

returning-to-arianwyn-after-finding-the-.text: You show the blackened crystal to Arianwyn.

returning-to-arianwyn-after-finding-the-.speaker: Arianwyn
returning-to-arianwyn-after-finding-the-.text: Yes! Good work.

returning-to-arianwyn-after-finding-the-.player: Thanks, I found it on the top floor of the temple.

returning-to-arianwyn-after-finding-the-.speaker: Arianwyn
returning-to-arianwyn-after-finding-the-.text: Well done, with this sample, a good crystal chanter should be able to make a replacement. Just a second, I will summon Eluned.
Eluned appears next to Arianwyn

returning-to-arianwyn-after-finding-the-.speaker: Arianwyn
returning-to-arianwyn-after-finding-the-.text: Thank you for responding to my summons Eluned.

returning-to-arianwyn-after-finding-the-.speaker: Eluned
returning-to-arianwyn-after-finding-the-.text: Any time Arianwyn, how can I help?

returning-to-arianwyn-after-finding-the-.speaker: Arianwyn
returning-to-arianwyn-after-finding-the-.text: [player name] here has an old crystal sample, we need you to make a replacement for it.

returning-to-arianwyn-after-finding-the-.speaker: Eluned
returning-to-arianwyn-after-finding-the-.text: Alright, hand it here and I shall take a look.
You hand Eluned the blackened crystal.

returning-to-arianwyn-after-finding-the-.speaker: Eluned
returning-to-arianwyn-after-finding-the-.text: Now, let me see... Hmm... Ah, there we go.
Eluned gives you a newly formed crystal.

returning-to-arianwyn-after-finding-the-.speaker: Eluned
returning-to-arianwyn-after-finding-the-.text: No problem, Arianwyn will tell you what you should do with it. Now I had better get going, see you round.

returning-to-arianwyn-after-finding-the-.player: I have the new crystal, now what am I meant to do with it?

returning-to-arianwyn-after-finding-the-.speaker: Arianwyn
returning-to-arianwyn-after-finding-the-.text: You will need to first take the newly formed crystal to the end of the temple and place it on the altar there. This will imbue the crystal with the power it needs to safeguard the temple.

returning-to-arianwyn-after-finding-the-.player: This is starting to sound hard.

returning-to-arianwyn-after-finding-the-.speaker: Arianwyn
returning-to-arianwyn-after-finding-the-.text: It should be quite simple. Once you have powered up the newly formed crystal, you will need to return to the blackened crystal and place the new shard with others. This should restore the safeguards.

returning-to-arianwyn-after-finding-the-.speaker: Arianwyn
returning-to-arianwyn-after-finding-the-.text: Yes, that is all.

returning-to-arianwyn-after-finding-the-.player: Right then, I'll get to it.

returning-to-arianwyn-talking-to-arianwy.speaker: Arianwyn
returning-to-arianwyn-talking-to-arianwy.text: [player name], do you have that sample yet?
If the player has the black crystal:

steps.player: Is this it?

returning-to-arianwyn-talking-to-arianwy.speaker: Arianwyn
returning-to-arianwyn-talking-to-arianwy.text: Don't take too long. Remember, you need to search the temple for a blackened crystal. Once you find it, bring a sample of it back here.

the-temple-of-light-searching-the-pillar.text: There is a green crystal fused into the pillar.

the-temple-of-light-fractured-crystal-pl.text: The crystal only fits the pillar with the clear side facing north.
The crystal only fits the pillar with the clear side facing east.

the-temple-of-light-fractured-crystal-ta.text: You take the fractured crystal from the pillar.

the-temple-of-light-fractured-crystal-in.text: This fractured crystal doesn't seem to fit right in this pillar.

the-temple-of-light-meeting-thorgel.text: Player steps through the light barrier after solving the puzzle and is met with a dwarf standing next to the Death Altar

the-temple-of-light-meeting-thorgel.player: Funny, I was just going to ask you the same thing.
Well I battled my way through hordes of shadows, whilst trying to solve a huge maze that I had to bounce a light beam around. Now your turn.

the-temple-of-light-meeting-thorgel.speaker: Thorgel
the-temple-of-light-meeting-thorgel.text: I came in through this hole in the back.

the-temple-of-light-meeting-thorgel.player: You mean there's an easy way?

the-temple-of-light-meeting-thorgel.speaker: Thorgel
the-temple-of-light-meeting-thorgel.text: Not easy as such. A few of the boys and me set up an outpost at the other end of the tunnel, at the bottom of a huge cavern. The only way to get there is through caves riddled with traps.

the-temple-of-light-meeting-thorgel.player: Hang on, this sounds familiar. Is the name of one of your companions Klank?

the-temple-of-light-meeting-thorgel.speaker: Thorgel
the-temple-of-light-meeting-thorgel.text: Yes, how did you know that?

the-temple-of-light-meeting-thorgel.player: He's a friend of mine, he made me a great pair of gauntlets.
That's right. How did you know that?

the-temple-of-light-meeting-thorgel.speaker: Thorgel
the-temple-of-light-meeting-thorgel.text: Klank told me about you, told me how you got rid of that Iban fellow. As it's you, I'll make you an offer, I'll trade you a Death Talisman. You'll need it if you want to access this altar.
If the player has a death talisman in their inventory:

steps.player: Thanks, but I have one.

steps.speaker: Thorgel
steps.text: Well if you wanna ‘nother, just come back and I'll tell you what I need.

the-temple-of-light-meeting-thorgel.text: If the player does not have a death talisman:

steps.player: Great... Wait, what for?

steps.speaker: Thorgel
steps.text: I just need a few things, here I'll make you a list.
The Dwarf writes on a scrap of paper and hands it to you.

steps.player: Right I'd better get started, see you soon.

the-temple-of-light-retrieving-items-for.speaker: Thorgel
the-temple-of-light-retrieving-items-for.text: Hi again, how're you doing with those items we need?

options.text: I've got some of them with me.

steps.player: I've got some of them with me.

steps.speaker: Thorgel
steps.text: Great, can I take everything I need?
If the player still has items to turn in:

steps.player: Yeah sure.

steps.speaker: Thorgel
steps.text: Thanks, I've updated your list for you.
After the player has turned in all the items:

steps.speaker: Thorgel
steps.text: Great, thank you so much for getting all that for us! Here take this Death Talisman as a reward. Anytime you want another one of those Talismans come see me and I'll sort you out with another list.

steps.player: I'd rather you didn't.

options.text: Do you have another copy of the list?

steps.player: Do you have another copy of the list?

steps.text: If the player already has the list:

steps.speaker: Thorgel
steps.text: You already have the list! Just bring them to me and I'll take them off your hands.
If the player doesn't have the list:

steps.speaker: Thorgel
steps.text: Try not to lose it this time, we need everything on it! Just bring them to me and I'll take them off your hands.
If the player doesn't have the list and their inventory is full:

steps.speaker: Thorgel
steps.text: Looks like you're carrying enough stuff at the moment.

options.text: What do you need all this stuff for?

steps.player: What do you need all this stuff for?

steps.speaker: Thorgel
steps.text: Oh well, we don't get many deliveries down here, so it's supplies mostly...

options.text: What about the Agility arena ticket?
options.condition: If the item is on the list:

steps.player: What about the Agility arena ticket?

steps.speaker: Thorgel
steps.text: Well you see.. Umm... We don't really get much chance to.. Er.. Go out or anything... And we'd like some of the prizes some day...

steps.player: So why didn't you ask for the prizes then?

steps.speaker: Thorgel
steps.text: Oh no, that'd just be sad.

options.condition: If the item is on the list:

steps.player: What about the Archery ticket?

options.text: So why do you want the Crumbling tome?
options.condition: If the item is on the list:

steps.player: So why do you want the Crumbling tome?

steps.speaker: Thorgel
steps.text: Oh just some light reading, it's nice to catch up on current events occasionally.

steps.player: Current events? But it's... Oh never mind.

options.text: So why do you want the Battered book?
options.condition: If the item is on the list:

steps.player: So why do you want the Battered book?

options.text: So why do you want Prifddinas' history?
options.condition: If the item is on the list:

steps.player: So why do you want Prifddinas' history?

options.text: How do you explain the Dusty key?
options.condition: If the item is on the list:

steps.player: How do you explain the Dusty key?

steps.speaker: Thorgel
steps.text: Ah... Um... I'm not sure how that got on the list... Can we have it anyway?

steps.player: Right, why do I get the feeling I shouldn't?

steps.speaker: Thorgel
steps.text: Pretty please with a Blood Talisman on top?!

steps.player: A Blood Talisman?!

steps.speaker: Thorgel
steps.text: Oops! I meant 'Death Talisman'!

options.text: How do you explain the Jail key?
options.condition: If the item is on the list:

steps.player: How do you explain the Jail key?

options.text: How do you explain the Door key?
options.condition: If the item is on the list:

steps.player: How do you explain the Door key?

options.text: Yeah right, all of those are just 'supplies'.

steps.player: Yeah right, all of those are just 'supplies'.

options.text: No, I'd better get looking for them.

steps.player: No, I'd better get looking for them.

the-temple-of-light-charging-the-newly-m.text: You place the crystal on the altar. It starts to glow with a strange light.

the-temple-of-light-resealing-the-temple.text: You place the powered crystal amongst the other shards.

informing-arianwyn.player: Good news Arianwyn, I've repaired the safeguards on the Temple of Light.

informing-arianwyn.speaker: Arianwyn
informing-arianwyn.text: This is good news indeed, [player name]. That should stop anyone from entering for another thousand years.

informing-arianwyn.player: Erm... not quite. It seems some dwarves have managed to tunnel through to the back of the temple.
Yes. They've set up an outpost in the Underground Pass.

informing-arianwyn.speaker: Arianwyn
informing-arianwyn.text: This is interesting news. I will send an envoy down to speak with them. We must ensure all access into the temple is secure.

informing-arianwyn.speaker: Arianwyn
informing-arianwyn.text: Even still, I can't see Lord Iorwerth discovering this tunnel any time soon. For now, he should have no way to summon the Dark Lord.

informing-arianwyn.speaker: Arianwyn
informing-arianwyn.text: This isn't the end by any means. The Iorwerth forces are still at large and we are not strong enough to stop them. However, with the temple secure, the main threat has been dealt with.

informing-arianwyn.speaker: Arianwyn
informing-arianwyn.text: I will let you know if there are any further developments. For now though, your work is done.

informing-arianwyn.speaker: Arianwyn
informing-arianwyn.text: I can't offer much of a reward I'm afraid. However, I did have Eluned make this for you. It should allow you to bypass the defences on the temple.

standard-dialogue-talking-to-movario-or-.npc: I don't know. It's giving strange readings...
I'm not even sure it's working any more.

standard-dialogue-talking-to-movario-or-.speaker: Darve
standard-dialogue-talking-to-movario-or-.text: This is a wild goose chase! We trek halfway across the world and there's nothing down here but this bunch of useless goblins!

standard-dialogue-talking-to-movario-or-.npc: I am sure my triangulation calculations indicated that the source of power was in this rough area...
I find it encouraging that it's pointed to somewhere where there actually are caves.

standard-dialogue-talking-to-movario-or-.speaker: Darve
standard-dialogue-talking-to-movario-or-.text: This part of the world is riddled with caves! It's hard not to hit a cave around here! Are you sure you're not just picking up these goblin lanterns or something stupid?

standard-dialogue-talking-to-movario-or-.npc: You should have more faith in my skills as a mage! I've been working on this for years-

standard-dialogue-talking-to-movario-or-.speaker: Darve
standard-dialogue-talking-to-movario-or-.text: Gah! We have an eavesdropper! Buzz off, adventurer - go talk to the goblins or something.

steps.player: Okay, I won't bother you.

steps.npc: That's what I like to see: a polite adventurer! Now, where was I...

steps.player: What are you looking for?

steps.speaker: Darve
steps.text: None of your business!

options.text: Hey, I'm one of you guys! See this pendant?
options.condition: If the player is wearing the pendant of Lucien:

steps.player: Hey, I'm one of you guys! See this pendant?

steps.speaker: Darve
steps.text: Where did you come from? Who sent you? I'll have you know I'm the mage's bodyguard for this job. We don't need anyone else!

options.text: No one sent me, I'm just nosy.

steps.player: No one sent me, I'm just nosy.

steps.speaker: Darve
steps.text: Well stick your nose somewhere else!

steps.npc: I'm sorry, but pendant or no pendant, this is a secret. I'm sure you understand.

steps.player: Lucien sent me.

steps.npc: He did not! If he had, I would be aware of it!

steps.speaker: Darve
steps.text: Don't try to lie to us! Now go away!

options.text: (Charm) I'm sure you're a much better bodyguard than me...
options.condition: If the player is wearing the Ring of Charos(a):

steps.player: I'm sure you're a much better bodyguard than me, but perhaps I can help in some non-bodyguarding way?

steps.npc: Well, we don't know how big this thing is. If we find it, I suppose we might need someone else to help us carry it.

steps.player: So, what are we looking for?

steps.npc: You're not very well briefed, are you?

steps.speaker: Darve
steps.text: To be honest I'm still a bit hazy on that point too.

steps.npc: sigh*
Lucien has asked us to search for artefacts that give off a very specific type of energy. After many years of research, I think I'm finally drawing near.

steps.speaker: Darve
steps.text: You don't sound very sure.

steps.npc: Bah! My detection device is totally shot. I don't understand it.
I wouldn't hang around for now, adventurer. It could be a long while before I can get a clear reading.

steps.player: Okay, I'll be on my way.

steps.npc: Can I help you, outsider?

steps.player: What are you selling?
Tell me about this shop.

steps.npc: This is the headquarters of Supplies's Supplies, a global chain of world class equipment providing outposts that effectively synergise with local corporate needs.

steps.player: I'm sorry?

steps.npc: Excuse me, I wasn't done.

steps.player: My apologies, please continue.

steps.npc: This business has been stimulating local economies for over one generation, and represents a core pillar of every community in which it operates.
We have locations at every major settlement on Wyrmscraig and a diverse portfolio of other business interests in the area.

steps.player: Other business interests?

steps.npc: Supplies's Supplies has recently opened its own production facility for high tensile strength fastening cords.
I bought a yak and I'm using its hair to weave rope.

steps.player: What are you selling?
I'd best be off.
No thanks.

standard-dialogue.text: If the player accepts the event from the Dunce:

steps.npc: Ah, it's you [player name]. You've been slacking in your studies, so it's time for an exam.
There are two types of question. One type requires you to find the next object in a pattern.
In the second type I will present you with fifteen cards and a hint. Discover three cards related to the hint, select them and confirm.

standard-dialogue.text: If the player logs out or hops worlds after starting the event:

steps.npc: Welcome to the Emir's Arena! What can I do for you?

steps.player: What is this place?

steps.npc: This is the Emir's Arena, recently renovated with his coin. Here, you can fight for glory and prestige in individual duels and tournaments.

options.text: Where did this Arena come from?

steps.player: Where did this Arena come from?

steps.npc: The original building was excavated by the Varrock Museum a while ago. It dated back to the Second Age!

When the archaeologists moved out, a group of warriors, headed by myself, bought the land and converted it to a set of arenas for duels. The best fighters from around the world would come here to fight!
More recently, the Emir of Al Kharid acquired the Arena and had it renovated to the state it's in now. He's kept me on to handle day-to-day running, though.

steps.player: What would the Emir want to do with a bunch of fight pits?

steps.npc: Something about a rowdy group of match-fixers, so I heard. I think the guards would know more about it than I would.

options.text: How do I get a fight?
What kind of fights are happening today?
How do I get a fight?

steps.player: How do I get a fight?

steps.npc: You can participate in Duels and Tournaments. These may be ranked, if you want rewards and prestige, or unranked if you're just fighting your friends for fun.

steps.text: This is the icon for the Grouping tab. Within it you'll find the PvP Arena options.
There, you can click Find to seek the official group for ranked Duels or Tournaments.
Once you've found it, click Sign up to sign up to one, and you'll be considered for an invitation to a Duel or Tournament, whenever one begins.
Ranked Duels and Tournaments take place on designated worlds, with stats and items provided to you on those worlds.

steps.npc: Win or lose, you'll earn Reward Points for taking part in ranked Duels and Tournaments. You can trade your points here for supplies that might help in the Wilderness, or such places.
Now, if you want to choose your opponents, you can have an unranked Duel or Tournament instead, just for the fun of beating them.
Use the recruitment boards outside the hospital to set up your own unranked tournament, or to apply to an existing one.
For an unranked Duel, look around the Arena for someone you wish to fight, and challenge them...

steps.text: You'll see a 'Challenge' option when you right-click other people around the Arena. Use that to set up an unranked Duel.
On PvP Arena worlds the Arena will supply stats and items for your fight. You'll get to choose your load-out from a menu.
On other worlds, like this one, you must bring your own items, and fight with your own stats.

steps.player: I challenge you!

steps.npc: Ho! Ho! Ho!

options.text: What kind of fights are happening today?
What kind of fights are happening today?

steps.player: What kind of fights are happening today?

steps.npc: Every week, we'll rotate the active build, meaning you'll have access to a different set of stats and items. This week, the active build is [Zerker/1 Def Pure/Max/Med].

I'll be off.

steps.player: Who are you?

steps.npc: Why, it's my little shop. I supply all kinds of items that the Lovakengj workers need. Though if you need pickaxes, you should visit Toothy in the sulphur mine.
Now, can I help you today?

steps.player: Let's trade.
No, I'm fine.

steps.npc: Hello there...thanks for helping out Trufitus commune with the gods Bwana. We've been able to return to the village thanks to your help.

standard-dialogue.text: First time after hacking away at jungle if the fence hasn't been repaired yet:

steps.npc: I see that you've been hacking away at the jungle...good, now if you have some thatching spars you can go and fix the fence. It's just to the south near the jungle, again, you'll need a machete for this.

standard-dialogue.text: First time after repairing the fence:

steps.npc: Great, I saw you were fixing the fence earlier, it looks like you've got the hang of this now! Let me give you something for your effort!

steps.text: You get [amount] trading sticks. You are left with [percentage] favour.

steps.player: What do you do here?

steps.npc: Well, I tend the hardwood grove nearby, you can enter if you like and harvest some of the very fine hardwood that grows within.
Apart from that I'm a simple Tai Bwo Wannai villager...I like to try and find out what's going on in the mainland and the rest of the known world.

options.text: Is there anything interesting to do here?

steps.text: If the player hasn't hacked away at jungle:

steps.npc: Well Bwana, if you're stuck for something to do, you could always do a bit of handymanship about the village and cut away the jungle that lies here about.
If you's is good with da machete Bwana, you's can get's some thatching spars and put them to use repairing the run-down village fence.

steps.text: (Show options below.)
If the player has hacked away at jungle:

steps.npc: Apart from cutting back the jungle and repairing the fence, I think we've got most things covered now Bwana.

options.text: Ask about cutting back the jungle.

steps.text: (Show options below.)

steps.player: Ok, thanks.

options.text: Do I get anything for doing this?

steps.player: Do I get anything for doing this?

steps.npc: Yes Bwana, you gain experience in woodcutting. In addition many members of the community will reward you with trading sticks, our local currency, for your efforts.

steps.player: Trading sticks?

steps.npc: Correct Bwana, trading sticks! It's our form of local currency! Everything you do to help out in the village will give you some favour, but there's a maximum limit!
When you've reached one hundred percent, you cannot gain any more favour, you need to cash in your favour for trading sticks before you can increase your favour again.

options.text: Who do I get trading sticks from?

steps.player: Who do I get trading sticks from?

steps.npc: Well Bwana, there's a good ten villagers I know of who would show their appreciation for your effort. Who do you want to ask about?
Sharimika is married to Mamma Bufetta, Bwana. They live in the houses just in front of the tribal statue.
Mamma Bufetta lives with her family in the building that faces the stone statue, she lives there with her husband Sharimika and her daughter Layleen.
Layleen is a young girl, the daughter of Mamma Bufetta and Sharimika, she lives with her parents.

Karaday is a young man and his chosen profession is fishing, he follows after his father Safta Doc in that respect. You can find him usually around the center of the village, that is when he's not off fishing.

Safta Doc used to be a fisherman, but he's just about retired now. He has an interesting profession which you might like to talk to him about. You'll find him usually near the building with the anvil in it.
It's just slightly north of the village statue.
Gabooty is a bit of a mystery, no one's sure where he came from! He's quite helpful though, you can find him in the middle of the village enclosure, to the south of Sharimika's house.
Fanellaman was a fisherman, he's retired now, but he'll try and regale you with tales of his salty sea dog days. He's often walking up and down the western beach.
Jagbakoba is a wild hunter. He can be a bit aggressive but he'll reward anyone who helps to keep the village in good order. You'll find him to the south of the enclosure, near the fires.
Ah Rionasta! He's an enterprising man! Had a very good idea and is now much in demand, you'll find him between the blacksmith's and Timfraku's hut.

Murcaily! That's me! Well, what do you want to know?! I look after the teak and mahogany trees and make sure that we get payment of anyone who uses the facility. And I'm usually standing just about here!

steps.text: If he doesn't want to give you trading sticks:
If he wants to give you trading sticks:

steps.npc: Hey, I've seen you working around the village. You've been doing a lot of good work around here for us. Let me give you something for your trouble.

steps.text: You get [amount] trading sticks. You are left with [percentage] favour.

options.text: Where can I get a machete from?

steps.player: Where can I get a machete from?

steps.npc: You can purchase a standard machete from Jiminua's store. Gabooty has a selection of local items which you may like to purchase, including better machetes. Also, you may like to chat to Safta Doc, he may have a deal you'll find interesting.

steps.player: Where is this jungle?

steps.npc: You'll find much of it to the southern end of Tai Bwo Wannai, outside of the village. Some is tougher than others so you may have difficulties cutting it back.
Beware though Bwana, those bushes can conceal a great many dangers or trophies, it could be the death... or the making of you!

steps.player: What do you mean by that?

steps.npc: It means that you may find something you wish you hadn't but then discover something you never thought you could! If you find me too vague, go and have a chat with Sharimika about it!

options.text: Where is the fence that needs to be repaired?

steps.npc: This is to the South Bwana, you should see that there are sections which are rotten, but some other passers-by sometimes help out repairing it.
You'll need some thatching spars and a machete in order to repair the fence though Bwana.

steps.text: Well, it's all very mysterious. Mary, the maid, found the body in the study next to his bedroom on the east wing of the ground floor.

steps.speaker: Guard
steps.text: The door was found locked from the inside, and he seemed to have been stabbed, but there was an odd smell in the room. Frankly, I'm stumped.

steps.text: It's odd that apparently nothing was stolen though... Find out something has been stolen,

steps.speaker: Guard
steps.text: and the case is closed, but the murdered man was a friend of the King, and it's more than my job's worth not to investigate fully.

steps.text: Old Lord Sinclair was a great man with a lot of respect in these parts. More than his worthless children have anyway.

steps.speaker: Gossip

steps.text: Well, they used to live in the big castle, but old Lord Sinclair gave it up so that those strange knights could live there instead. So the king built him a new house to the North.

steps.speaker: Gossip

options.text: What can you tell me about his sons?

steps.player: Tell me about Bob.

steps.speaker: Gossip
steps.text: Bob is an odd character indeed... I'm not one to gossip, but I heard Bob is addicted to Tea. He can't make

steps.speaker: Gossip
steps.text: it through the day without having at least 20 cups!

steps.speaker: Gossip
steps.text: You might not think that's such a big thing, but he has spent thousands of gold to feed his habit!

steps.speaker: Gossip
steps.text: At one point he stole a lot of silverware from the kitchen and pawned it just so he could afford to buy his daily tea allowance.

steps.speaker: Gossip
steps.text: If his father ever found out, he would be in so much trouble... he might even get disowned!

steps.player: Tell me about David.

steps.speaker: Gossip
steps.text: David... oh David... not many people know this, but David really has an anger problem. He's always screaming and shouting

steps.speaker: Gossip
steps.text: at the household servants when he's angry, and they live in a state of fear, always walking on eggshells around him, but none of them have the courage

steps.speaker: Gossip
steps.text: to talk to his father about his behaviour. If they did, Lord Sinclair would almost certainly

steps.speaker: Gossip
steps.text: kick him out of the house, as some of the servants have been there longer than he has, and he definitely has no right to treat them like he does... but I'm not one to gossip about people.

steps.player: Tell me about Frank.

steps.speaker: Gossip
steps.text: I'm not one to talk ill of people behind their back, but Frank is a real piece of work. He is an absolutely terrible gambler... he can't pass 2 dogs in the street without putting a bet on which one will bark first!

steps.speaker: Gossip
steps.text: He has already squandered all of his allowance, and I heard he had stolen a number of paintings of his fathers to sell to try and cover his debts, but he still owes a lot of

steps.speaker: Gossip
steps.text: people a lot of money. If his father ever found out, he would stop his income, and then he would be in serious trouble!

options.text: What can you tell me about his daughters?

steps.player: What can you tell me about his daughters?

steps.speaker: Gossip
steps.text: His daughters eh? They're all nasty pieces of work. which of them specifically did you want to know about?

steps.player: Tell me about Anna.

steps.text: Anna... ah yes... Anna has 2 great loves:

steps.speaker: Gossip
steps.text: Sewing and gardening. But one thing she has kept secret is that she once had an affair with Stanford the gardener, and tried to get him fired when they broke up,

steps.speaker: Gossip
steps.text: by killing all of the flowers in the garden. If her father ever found out she had done that he would be so furious he would probably disown her.

steps.player: Tell me about Carol.

steps.speaker: Gossip
steps.text: Oh Carol... she is such a fool. You didn't hear this from me, but I heard a while ago she was conned out of a lot of money by a travelling salesman who sold her a box full

steps.speaker: Gossip
steps.text: of beans by telling her they were magic. But they weren't. She sold some rare books from the library to cover her debts, but

steps.speaker: Gossip
steps.text: her father would be incredibly annoyed if he ever found out - he might even throw her out of the house!

steps.player: Tell me about Elizabeth.

steps.speaker: Gossip
steps.text: Elizabeth? Elizabeth has a strange problem... She cannot help herself, but is always stealing small objects - it's pretty sad that she is rich enough to afford to buy things, but would rather steal them instead.

steps.speaker: Gossip
steps.text: Now, I don't want to spread stories, but I heard she even stole a silver needle from her father that had great sentimental value for him.

steps.speaker: Gossip
steps.text: He was devastated when it was lost, and cried for a week thinking he had lost it!

steps.speaker: Gossip
steps.text: If he ever found out that it was her who had stolen it he would go absolutely mental, maybe even disowning her!
