steps.player: Oh, so you want a favour doing as well?

steps.speaker: Brian
steps.text: Well, yes, if you wouldn't mind? Aggie the witch is a family friend and she's a pillar of the local community.

steps.speaker: Brian
steps.text: I know you wouldn't think it would you! Could you ask her if she'll act as a character witness for my friend?

steps.player: What?

steps.speaker: Brian
steps.text: Oh, please. It would mean such a lot to me! Just ask Aggie if she'll be a character witness for my friend. She only lives in Draynor Village. It'll only take you a few minutes!

options.text: Look, can you sharpen this cursed axe or what?
Is there anyone else who can sharpen this axe?
Ok, ok, I'll do it! I'll go and see Aggie.

steps.player: Ok, ok, I'll do it! I'll go and see Aggie.

steps.text: (Blunt axe is removed from the player's inventory.)

steps.speaker: Brian
steps.text: Oh, great, that would be really helpful! Here, give me the axe for safe keeping and I'll get it sharpened as soon as she agrees to help.

options.text: Is there anyone else who can sharpen this axe?

steps.player: Is there anyone else who can sharpen this axe?

steps.speaker: Brian
steps.text: Hmm, well you could try your luck in Lumbridge at Bob's Axes, though I've no clue if he offers this kind of service.

steps.speaker: Brian
steps.text: He always seemed very focused on selling axes to blood-hungry killers keen to explore the wilderness.

steps.player: Okay, thanks.

the-various-favours-are-asked-asking-bri.speaker: Bob
the-various-favours-are-asked-asking-bri.text: Hmmm, yes, that looks pretty badly damaged. Unfortunately, I don't have the tools to fix it, but Brian over in Port Sarim might be able to.

options.text: What did you want me to do again?

steps.player: What did you want me to do again?

steps.speaker: Brian
steps.text: Go talk to Aggie and ask her if she'll be a character witness for my friend before he finds himself in jail with less than savoury people...or worse, he runs off to the wilderness!

steps.player: Oh, right, yes, sorry, I forgot..

steps.speaker: Brian
steps.text: So it seems!

the-various-favours-are-asked-asking-agg.speaker: Aggie
the-various-favours-are-asked-asking-agg.text: What can I help you with?

options.text: Hey you're a witch aren't you?

steps.player: Hey you're a witch aren't you?

steps.speaker: Aggie
steps.text: My, you're observant!
Continues with regular options

options.text: Could I ask you about being a character witness?

steps.player: Could I ask you about being a character witness?

steps.speaker: Aggie
steps.text: Not at the minute I'm afraid...I'm really worried! My new apprentice 'Jimmy the Chisel' has gone missing!

options.text: 'Jimmy the Chisel' - what kind of name is that?

steps.player: 'Jimmy the Chisel' - what kind of name is that?

steps.speaker: Aggie
steps.text: It's sort of like a 'street name'...it's a new fad [player name]...perhaps you've seen it around? Anyway, it's not his name I'm concerned with, it's his whereabouts that worries me!

steps.player: What do you mean missing?

steps.speaker: Aggie
steps.text: Well, I sent him to Lumbridge to get some supplies and he hasn't come back! He left about two days ago and I've seen neither hide nor hair of him all that time.

steps.player: Do you have any idea where he might be?

steps.speaker: Aggie
steps.text: Not really, I mean, not for definite. But I did hear old Ned talking about some strange activity in that ruined building infested with goblins and spiders in between here and Lumbridge.

steps.speaker: Aggie
steps.text: It's probably nothing...but it would aid my mind a lot to know he was safe. I can't leave here until he returns. What if he's had an accident and needs some emergency magical attention?

options.text: Let me guess, you're going to ask me to do you a favour?

steps.player: Let me guess, you're going to ask me to do you a favour?

steps.speaker: Aggie
steps.text: Would you my dear, it would only be a small favour...one small favour, that's all I ask.

steps.player: Hmm, I seem to have heard that one before. Go on then, what do you want me to do?

steps.speaker: Aggie
steps.text: Could you go on and check out that abandoned building and see if there's anything odd going on. Just check to see if there's any sign of young Jimmy.

options.text: No way...I've had enough of doing favours for people.

steps.player: No way...I've had enough of doing favours for people.

steps.speaker: Aggie
steps.text: Why you big meanie! He could be dead for all you know!

options.text: Oh, Ok, I'll see if I can find Jimmy.

steps.player: Oh, Ok, I'll see if I can find Jimmy.

steps.speaker: Aggie
steps.text: Oh, thanks ever so much...I do appreciate it! Good Luck!

steps.player: Okay, thanks.

the-various-favours-are-asked-asking-agg.speaker: Aggie
the-various-favours-are-asked-asking-agg.text: What can I help you with?

options.text: Hey you're a witch aren't you?
What am I supposed to be doing?

steps.player: What am I supposed to be doing?

steps.speaker: Aggie
steps.text: Well, I had hoped that you would go and look for 'Jimmy the Chisel'...but it looks like you've had other 'more important' things to do!

options.text: What am I supposed to be doing?
Where am I supposed to look?

steps.player: Where am I supposed to look?

steps.speaker: Aggie
steps.text: I don't know where he is! But I suggest that you check out that ruined building to the east, you know, the one with all the spiders in it! Doesn't look like anyone's been living in there for years!

options.text: What am I doing this for?

steps.player: What am I doing this for?

steps.speaker: Aggie
steps.text: Oh, I don't know, you mumbled something about 'witnesses', I just can't think straight worrying so much about that poor little Jimmy.

steps.speaker: Aggie
steps.text: He could be lying somewhere in a pool of his blood, crying out for help...oooh, it's too much for me to bear.

steps.player: Okay, thanks.

the-various-favours-are-asked-asking-joh.speaker: Johanhus Ulsbrecht
the-various-favours-are-asked-asking-joh.text: Welcome [Brother/Sister]...to our organisation...ours is a fight for humanity in all its shapes and forms...and to rid mankind of the monsters that exist in our world. We have no quarrel with a fellow [brother/sister].

options.text: What kind of organisation is this?
Who are you and what do you do here?
I'm looking for Jimmy the Chisel.

steps.player: I'm looking for Jimmy the Chisel.

steps.speaker: Johanhus Ulsbrecht
steps.text: Ah yes, he'll be joining our ranks very soon, I feel. He's still quite young and strong, but he will see the error of his ways before too long.

steps.player: Huh, it sounds like you're forcing him to join you

steps.speaker: Johanhus Ulsbrecht
steps.text: Not at all...he just needs some time to think about things...we've given him all the time he needs in the cage back there.

steps.player: Well, I have to return him to his employer, she's very worried about him, so if you could just hand him over...I'll be getting out of your way.

steps.speaker: Johanhus Ulsbrecht
steps.text: I'm afraid I can't do that...he has value to us...he's related to a farmer named Fred who lives near here. We need to arrange some things with this 'Brother Fred' so that my people down here can eat.

options.text: What kind of organisation is this?
Who are you and what do you do here?
And I suppose you need me to do you a favour?

steps.player: And I suppose you need me to do you a favour?

steps.speaker: Johanhus Ulsbrecht
steps.text: Well, actually, now that you mention it...it would be a real help to us if you could organise some chickens in exchange for young Jimmy's release.

steps.player: Ok, just exactly what is it that you want me to do?

steps.speaker: Johanhus Ulsbrecht
steps.text: Go to Brother Fred the farmer and tell him that we have young Brother Jimmy. Tell him that we're not going to let him free until he agrees to send us a month's supply of chickens.

options.text: No way...go do your own dirty work!

steps.player: No way...go do your own dirty work!

steps.speaker: Johanhus Ulsbrecht
steps.text: Now, now [player name], I'm a little disappointed in you! Can't you see that this is merely a business transaction?

steps.speaker: Johanhus Ulsbrecht
steps.text: Come back and see me when you change your mind!

options.text: Ok, Jimmy has to be worth more than a few scrawny chickens!

steps.player: Ok, Jimmy has to be worth more than a few scrawny chickens!

steps.speaker: Johanhus Ulsbrecht
steps.text: That's exactly right! Do this for us and we'll let Brother Jimmy go!

the-various-favours-are-asked-asking-joh.speaker: Johanhus Ulsbrecht
the-various-favours-are-asked-asking-joh.text: Welcome [Brother/Sister]...to our organisation...ours is a fight for humanity in all its shapes and forms...and to rid mankind of the monsters that exist in our world. We have no quarrel with a fellow [brother/sister].

options.text: What kind of organisation is this?
Who are you and what do you do here?

steps.player: I'm back.

steps.speaker: Johanhus Ulsbrecht
steps.text: Welcome back [Brother/Sister] [player name], how are your negotiations going with Brother Fred?

options.text: What did you want me to do again?

steps.player: What did you want me to do again?

steps.speaker: Johanhus Ulsbrecht
steps.text: Oh for the love of Saradomin...it's not too difficult! Go to Brother Fred and ask him to supply a month's worth of chickens in return for Brother Jimmy's freedom!

options.text: Can't you just release Jimmy the Chisel?

steps.player: Can't you just release Jimmy the Chisel?

steps.speaker: Johanhus Ulsbrecht
steps.text: Yes, of course....why didn't you ask earlier? Is that all you wanted? Huh!

steps.speaker: Johanhus Ulsbrecht
steps.text: Of course, you do have the chickens don't you?

steps.player: Er...not exactly!

steps.speaker: Johanhus Ulsbrecht
steps.text: Go get them then!

options.text: I don't think I can do this.

steps.player: I don't think I can do this.

steps.speaker: Johanhus Ulsbrecht
steps.text: That's a shame, because Brother Jimmy is getting older every day! His employer isn't going to be too pleased if you don't do something soon.

steps.player: Okay, thanks.

the-various-favours-are-asked-asking-fre.speaker: Fred the Farmer
the-various-favours-are-asked-asking-fre.text: What are you doing on my land?

options.text: I need to talk to you about Jimmy.

steps.player: I need to talk to you about Jimmy.

steps.speaker: Fred the Farmer
steps.text: What's the problem with Jimmy?

steps.player: He's being kept prisoner by a bunch of fanatics and I need to organise a delivery of a month's supply of chickens to secure his release.

steps.speaker: Fred the Farmer
steps.text: Oh dear, oh dear, this is terrible. Terrible!

steps.player: Yes, it's pretty bad...but keep calm, I'm going to help.

steps.speaker: Fred the Farmer
steps.text: I've no idea what to do!

steps.player: None at all?

steps.speaker: Fred the Farmer
steps.text: Well, no actually. I'm just a farmer. I've no idea how to deal with fanatics!

steps.player: Well, can't you just give me some chickens?

steps.speaker: Fred the Farmer
steps.text: Normally I'd say yes, but I just don't have enough for a month's supply.

steps.player: Well, do you know someone who does have a month's supply?

steps.speaker: Fred the Farmer
steps.text: Seth does, Seth Groats. He's another farmer over yonder at the other farm. Over the river and on the way to Varrock, he has loads of chickens.

the-various-favours-are-asked-asking-fre.speaker: Fred the Farmer
the-various-favours-are-asked-asking-fre.text: What are you doing on my land?

options.text: What did you suggest I do again?

steps.player: What did you suggest I do again?

steps.speaker: Fred the Farmer
steps.text: Have you been to Seth Groats yet? He's over at the other farm on the way to Varrock!

steps.player: Ok, I'll go and see him then.

the-various-favours-are-asked-asking-set.speaker: Seth Groats
the-various-favours-are-asked-asking-set.text: Hello there stranger, what's the meaning of this intrusion? A farmer's hovel is his castle!

the-various-favours-are-asked-asking-set.player: Sorry for the intrusion, but this is quite urgent. Jimmy the Chisel is being held by fanatics. They won't release him until they get a month's supply of chickens.
I've already talked to Fred but he says he doesn't have a month's supply of chickens. Is there any way that you could help?

the-various-favours-are-asked-asking-set.speaker: Seth Groats
the-various-favours-are-asked-asking-set.text: A month's supply eh! Well, I was going to take them to market and just concentrate on the cows, but I reckon that little Jimmy's neck is worth a few scrawny chickens, don't you?

the-various-favours-are-asked-asking-set.speaker: Seth Groats
the-various-favours-are-asked-asking-set.text: Well, Ok then. We need to get this organised. First off, we need to get some proper cages to get them chickens transported. I've never normally transported chickens in such large quantities before.

the-various-favours-are-asked-asking-set.speaker: Seth Groats
the-various-favours-are-asked-asking-set.text: We'll need to get some proper cages, but I have nothing like that here. You'll have to go and see my friend Horvik in Varrock. He's a pretty well known metal-smith and he's done me a few favours in the past.

the-various-favours-are-asked-asking-set.speaker: Seth Groats
the-various-favours-are-asked-asking-set.text: I'm afraid that I'll have to ask a small favour of you as well, my friend.

the-various-favours-are-asked-asking-set.player: I had a feeling you might!

the-various-favours-are-asked-asking-set.speaker: Seth Groats
the-various-favours-are-asked-asking-set.text: Could you get three bars of steel and take them to Horvik, that's what I owe him for a previous job that he did for me.

options.text: No way, I'm fed up with this wild goose chase!

steps.player: No way, I'm fed up with this wild goose chase!

steps.speaker: Seth Groats
steps.text: I understand...

steps.speaker: Seth Groats
steps.text: Poor old Jimmy, locked in that cage...

steps.speaker: Seth Groats
steps.text: Forever!

options.text: Oh, ok! I guess it's not that much further to Varrock!

steps.player: Oh, ok! I guess it's not that much further to Varrock!

steps.speaker: Seth Groats
steps.text: Many thanks! Remember, you need to take him three steel bars.

the-various-favours-are-asked-asking-set.player: What am I meant to be doing again?

the-various-favours-are-asked-asking-set.speaker: Seth Groats
the-various-favours-are-asked-asking-set.text: You need to get three bars of steel and take them to Horvik in Varrock, ask him if he can make some chicken cages so that we can transport these chickens to those fanatics and release poor Jimmy.

the-various-favours-are-asked-asking-set.speaker: Seth Groats
the-various-favours-are-asked-asking-set.text: How are those chicken cages coming along?

the-various-favours-are-asked-asking-set.player: Sorry, but I don't have any yet.

the-various-favours-are-asked-asking-hor.speaker: Horvik
the-various-favours-are-asked-asking-hor.text: Hello, do you need any help?

options.text: Hi, I need to talk to you about chicken cages!

steps.player: Hi, I need to talk to you about chicken cages! Seth Groats has asked me to come and see you!

steps.speaker: Horvik
steps.text: Hmm, Seth eh! He's a good friend, but he still owes me three steel bars for a plough I fixed. I'm sorry but I need to have that paid off first before I can do any more work for him.
If player does not have enough steel bars:

steps.player: But I don't have three steel bars at the moment!

steps.speaker: Horvik
steps.text: I'm sorry to be so harsh, but I have to ensure the debt is paid before I do any more work for Seth.
With at least 3 steel bars in inventory:

steps.player: Ok, well I have three steel bars here, you can have these.

steps.speaker: Horvik
steps.text: Ok then! Great...tell me a little more about these chicken cages... Cough Cough Cough!

steps.player: Oh dear, you don't sound too well?

steps.speaker: Horvik
steps.text: No, I'm not actually, I'm quite ill!

steps.player: Well that's a shame because I really need your help to make some chicken cages!

steps.speaker: Horvik
steps.text: I'm sorry, but the most I can manage today is simple trading...however, if I was to get some medicine say, I could be persuaded to do you a small favour!

steps.player: Oh I see, you need me to do you a favour?

steps.speaker: Horvik
steps.text: Well, just one small favour...and then I'll do you a small favour.

options.text: Oh, no not another favour...I just can't do another one!

steps.player: Oh, no not another favour...I just can't do another one!

steps.speaker: Horvik
steps.text: Well, I'm sorry about that...but I just can't work when I'm feeling so ill.

options.text: Ok, I guess one good turn deserves another.

steps.text: Horvik takes the steel bars.

steps.player: Ok, I guess one good turn deserves another.

steps.speaker: Horvik
steps.text: Well that's jolly decent of you my friend. I need some medicine, could you get me some herbal tincture and breathing salts, that should solve my ailments!

steps.player: Well, hopefully, I'll be right back, but you never know, it might take longer!

steps.speaker: Horvik
steps.text: That's great! However, I must warn you, it'll be a lot easier for me to simply adjust some existing pigeon cages. If you could get me five or so of those, that would help a lot.

steps.speaker: Horvik
steps.text: But first things first, bring me the medicine!

the-various-favours-are-asked-asking-hor.speaker: Horvik
the-various-favours-are-asked-asking-hor.text: Hello, do you need any help?

options.text: What was I supposed to be doing?

steps.player: What was I supposed to be doing?

steps.speaker: Horvik
steps.text: Please can you get me some medicine? I need herbal tincture and a pot of breathing salts. Also, get me five or so of those pigeon cages that they have over in Ardougne so that I can convert them into chicken

steps.speaker: Horvik
steps.text: cages.

steps.player: Horvik is ill, I need breathing salts and herbal tincture.

steps.speaker: Apothecary
steps.text: No problem!
The Apothecary shows you the herbal tincture.

steps.speaker: Apothecary
steps.text: There you do! There's your herbal tincture!

steps.player: Wow, that was surprisingly easy! Fantastic, thanks very much.

steps.speaker: Apothecary
steps.text: No problem, pleased to help.

steps.player: Oh...but...what about the breathing salts...

steps.speaker: Apothecary
steps.text: Oh, yes, breathing salts...erm, just let me look around. I'm sure I have some around here somewhere.

steps.player: Ok...

steps.speaker: Apothecary
steps.text: Yep, here they are....
The Apothecary gets out a jar of breathing salts.

steps.speaker: Apothecary
steps.text: Oh blimey...I've dropped the pot and smashed it!

steps.player: That's ok, just hand over the breathing salts.

steps.speaker: Apothecary
steps.text: Oh no, you don't understand. They're ruined. They're supposed to be kept in an airtight container and this was my last one.

steps.speaker: Apothecary
steps.text: I can't order any more in until I have a new airtight container. And they were a top selling item as well.

steps.player: I just knew this wasn't going to be easy! So you can't get any more breathing salts?

steps.speaker: Apothecary
steps.text: No, I can..I can order plenty, but they'll lose their effectiveness. I need an airtight pot to keep them in.

steps.player: Where would you get one of those from?

steps.speaker: Apothecary
steps.text: I've no idea really, this pot was a family heirloom. I guess you'd have to get a new one made?

steps.player: Where could I do that?

steps.speaker: Apothecary
steps.text: You could try Tassie Slipcast over at the Barbarian Village. She's a potter there and may be able to make one. But mind, it has to be air tight.

options.text: Oh, no way am I going to the Barbarian Village.

steps.player: Oh, no way am I going to the Barbarian Village.

steps.speaker: Apothecary
steps.text: I understand...they're all barbarians over there.

options.text: I guess I can go to the Barbarian Village.

steps.player: I guess I can go to the Barbarian Village.

steps.speaker: Apothecary
steps.text: Wonderful, I'd really appreciate it!

steps.player: What about the breathing salts?

steps.speaker: Apothecary
steps.text: I smashed the pot which held them, remember?

steps.player: Oh yes...where am I going to get a new pot?

steps.text: If the player has lost the herbal tincture:

steps.player: I've lost that herbal tincture you gave me!

steps.speaker: Apothecary
steps.text: No problem, I'll just rustle up another one for you.

steps.player: What was I supposed to be doing again?

steps.speaker: Apothecary
steps.text: Go and see Tassie in the Barbarian Village about making an airtight pot for me to store my breathing salts in, then you can take some for Horvik.

steps.player: Oh, yes right!

the-various-favours-are-asked-tassie-s-r.player: Hey there...I need an airtight pot just as soon as you can make one!
It's a matter of some urgency that I have an airtight container as soon as possible!

the-various-favours-are-asked-tassie-s-r.speaker: Tassie Slipcast
the-various-favours-are-asked-tassie-s-r.text: Who on earth do you think you are coming in here demanding an airtight pot...Can't you see that I have my own worries to think about?

the-various-favours-are-asked-tassie-s-r.player: Oh, sorry, I didn't think...what's the problem?

the-various-favours-are-asked-tassie-s-r.speaker: Tassie Slipcast
the-various-favours-are-asked-tassie-s-r.text: Well, if you must know, I'm working all the hours that Saradomin sends, I have to in order to make enough money to pay that loan shark Hammerspike!

the-various-favours-are-asked-tassie-s-r.player: Loan shark? Hammerspike? What are you talking about?

the-various-favours-are-asked-tassie-s-r.speaker: Tassie Slipcast
the-various-favours-are-asked-tassie-s-r.text: I took over this abandoned pottery place with a loan from Hammerspike. He's demanding payment and I can barely just make the interest payments.

the-various-favours-are-asked-tassie-s-r.speaker: Tassie Slipcast
the-various-favours-are-asked-tassie-s-r.text: I'm working as hard as I can but I'll never pay the loan off at this rate!

the-various-favours-are-asked-tassie-s-r.player: But I need an airtight pot...to store breathing salts in.

the-various-favours-are-asked-tassie-s-r.speaker: Tassie Slipcast
the-various-favours-are-asked-tassie-s-r.text: Well, that may be, but I have a rush order for a top paying customer that's going to keep Hammerspike off my back for a bit.

the-various-favours-are-asked-tassie-s-r.speaker: Tassie Slipcast
the-various-favours-are-asked-tassie-s-r.text: If you really want that pot, you're going to have to deal with Hammerspike in the dwarven mines!

steps.player: Ok, I'll deal with Hammerspike!

steps.speaker: Tassie Slipcast
steps.text: Really, you will?

steps.player: Yes, I'll go and have a chat with him, perhaps we can sort something out.

steps.speaker: Tassie Slipcast
steps.text: Well, that would be really great...I just hope he doesn't grind you into flour to make his bread, he's one of the most ruthless gangsters in the area.

steps.speaker: Tassie Slipcast
steps.text: Beware, his guards are incredibly loyal, they'll slit their own throats to protect him!

steps.player: That's not a pretty picture you're painting, but don't worry, I'll be careful. Now, where do I find this Hammerspike?

steps.speaker: Tassie Slipcast
steps.text: He's in the dwarven mines somewhere, not sure exactly where though.

options.text: No, sorry, no more blooming favours for anyone!

steps.player: No, sorry, no more blooming favours for anyone!

steps.speaker: Tassie Slipcast
steps.text: Oh, well that's a real shame, I was hoping you could have sorted out that Hammerspike for me once and for all!

the-various-favours-are-asked-tassie-s-r.speaker: Tassie Slipcast
the-various-favours-are-asked-tassie-s-r.text: So I see. What's the problem? Did you sort out Hammerspike?

the-various-favours-are-asked-tassie-s-r.player: Not exactly, can you tell me what I'm supposed to do again?

the-various-favours-are-asked-tassie-s-r.speaker: Tassie Slipcast
the-various-favours-are-asked-tassie-s-r.text: Go talk to Hammerspike in the Dwarven mines and see if you can get him to leave me alone...I won't be able to make you the airtight pot else.

steps.player: I'm looking for Hammerspike.

steps.speaker: Dwarf gang member
steps.text: Well, he's around here somewhere, just use your eyes, I'm sure you'll get there one day.

the-various-favours-are-asked-dealing-wi.speaker: Hammerspike Stoutbeard
the-various-favours-are-asked-dealing-wi.text: And who da heck are you?

the-various-favours-are-asked-dealing-wi.player: I'm [player name] and I want to talk to you about a friend of mine, Tassie Slipcast. She says you're putting the screws on her for some loan she had from you. Is this true?

the-various-favours-are-asked-dealing-wi.speaker: Hammerspike Stoutbeard
the-various-favours-are-asked-dealing-wi.text: And what if it is? Tassie got into an arrangement that is mutually beneficial, as far as I understood it, she was happy with the deal.

options.text: Well, I've come to change the deal!

steps.player: Well, I've come to change the deal!

steps.speaker: Hammerspike Stoutbeard
steps.text: Oh, so you wanna give me something for leaving Tassie alone?

steps.player: Er...er...not exactly...why can't you just leave her alone? I mean, make a nice gesture, I'm asking out as a favour...please?

options.text: Can't you just leave Tassie alone?

steps.player: Can't you just leave Tassie alone?

steps.speaker: Hammerspike Stoutbeard
steps.text: Where would I be if I just left all of my 'customers' alone? Some people just need an extra 'encouragement' to make the best out of life...I'm just helping them along.

options.text: Oh, come on...do something nice for Tassie.

steps.player: Oh, come on...do something nice for a Tassie. Think about how hard she's working!

steps.speaker: Hammerspike Stoutbeard
steps.text: Well...now that you come to mention it, I guess I have been a little hard on the girl.

steps.player: Yeah, come on give her a break.

steps.speaker: Hammerspike Stoutbeard
steps.text: And I guess I am quite stressed about things, what with so much to think about recently.

steps.player: I can understand that...you have a lot on your mind. Go on, make a change...it'll do you good! There must be something else that you wanted to do at least once in your life.

steps.speaker: Hammerspike Stoutbeard
steps.text: Hmm, yes, yes you're right...I did want to do something, something I noticed recently, but you'll laugh if I tell you...nah, it's silly.

options.text: Have you always been a gangster?

steps.player: Have you always been a gangster? Wasn't there anything else that you wanted to do instead? Come on, tell me what you want to do...I'm listening.

steps.speaker: Hammerspike Stoutbeard
steps.text: Well, I was just thinking the other day that I'm feeling sort of unfulfilled in my life.

steps.speaker: Hammerspike Stoutbeard
steps.text: I'd like to get rid of all this anger and frustration that my current lifestyle brings and do something relaxing...like those druids, I mean, all day sitting around, looking at herbs and wearing robes and stuff.

steps.player: Ok, that sounds good.

steps.speaker: Hammerspike Stoutbeard
steps.text: Yeah, yeah, I really want to be a druid...so...go and see the druid leader, I think Sanfew is his name, and persuade him to take me as an initiate. Do me this one small favour and I'll leave Tassie alone.

options.text: I don't think they take dwarven gangsters as initiates.

steps.player: I don't think they take dwarven gangsters as initiates.

steps.speaker: Hammerspike Stoutbeard
steps.text: Whatever...I guess Tassie's gonna be working hard for a bit longer yet then!

options.text: Ok, another favour...I think I can manage that.

steps.player: Ok, another favour...I think I can manage that.

steps.speaker: Hammerspike Stoutbeard
steps.text: Good...I mean great! Come back when Sanfew has agreed to take me as an initiate!

steps.speaker: Dwarf gang member
steps.text: Ha ha ha ha! Good one boss, I can't believe [he/she/they] fell for that, boss!

steps.player: Okay, thanks.

the-various-favours-are-asked-dealing-wi.player: What was it that I was supposed to do for you?

the-various-favours-are-asked-dealing-wi.speaker: Hammerspike Stoutbeard
the-various-favours-are-asked-dealing-wi.text: Go and talk to Sanfew and get him to accept me as a druid initiate!

options.text: Are you taking any new initiates?

steps.player: Are you taking any new initates?

steps.speaker: Sanfew
steps.text: Hmmm, are you considering yourself?

options.text: How does someone become an initate?

steps.player: How does someone become an initate?

steps.speaker: Sanfew
steps.text: Hmm, it's quite a straight-forward process. A person, perhaps like yourself, comes along to me and asks.

steps.speaker: Sanfew
steps.text: We test your knowledge of Herblore and see if you can fit in with the rest of us. If you pass, then we let you become an initiate.

steps.player: Seems pretty straight forward!
Do you accept dwarves?

steps.speaker: Sanfew
steps.text: Dwarves? Well now, that's a mighty interesting question... Just because we haven't before, doesn't mean to say that we shouldn't.

options.text: A dwarf I know wants to become an initiate.

steps.player: A dwarf I know wants to become an initiate.

steps.speaker: Sanfew
steps.text: Oh yes? Well, that's interesting. Let me think for a moment. Hmmm... yes, actually, I don't mind taking him on, so long as you can do me just one small favour. Well, two actually.

steps.player: Not you as well?

steps.speaker: Sanfew
steps.text: Stop interrupting me. I haven't told you about these favours!

steps.speaker: Sanfew
steps.text: There's a poor little gnome up on White Wolf mountain. I wondered if you could take him a warming herbal brew. I have the recipe here!

steps.player: Well, that seems simple enough.

steps.speaker: Sanfew
steps.text: In addition...

steps.speaker: Sanfew
steps.text: I've long wished to take a trip down to see those ogres to the south of Yanille, and bring the word of Guthix to them. I was hoping you might organise this trip with the gnome pilot up there on White Wolf mountain.

steps.player: Are you mad?

steps.speaker: Sanfew
steps.text: Well, perhaps a bit... but it's never stopped you doing things for me before.

steps.player: I've been asked to do a lot of favours recently.

steps.speaker: Sanfew
steps.text: Well, that's the life of an adventurer. Is it a deal, or not?

steps.player: Yep, it's a deal. Tell me the recipe for this herbal tea.

steps.speaker: Sanfew
steps.text: Ok, you need to heat some water up in a bowl, then pour it into an empty teacup. Add 1 harralander, 2 guam and 1 marrentill...it'll warm that poor fellow up a treat!

steps.player: Mmm, sounds delicious! What's it called?

steps.speaker: Sanfew
steps.text: We call it 'Guthix's rest'.

steps.player: Can I drink it?

steps.speaker: Sanfew
steps.text: If you want!

steps.player: Great! And thanks.

steps.speaker: Sanfew
steps.text: But you'll have to make another one for the gnome.

steps.player: But I can drink it though.

steps.speaker: Sanfew
steps.text: Yes, but you'll have to make another one for the gnome.

steps.player: Ok, I think I understand.
Nope, it's not a deal!

steps.speaker: Sanfew
steps.text: Well, that's a shame. I was looking forward to visiting the ogres... Perhaps someday I will.

steps.player: Okay, thanks.

options.text: What did you need me to do again?

steps.player: What did you need me to do again?

steps.speaker: Sanfew
steps.text: Make a herbal tea for the gnome and persuade him to take me to the ogre area, down to the south!

steps.player: Oh yes, right, thanks!

options.text: How do I make the tea again?

steps.player: How do I make the tea again?

steps.speaker: Sanfew
steps.text: Ok, you need to heat some water up in a bowl, then pour it into an empty teacup. Add 1 harralander, 2 guam and 1 marrentill...it'll warm that poor fellow up a treat!

steps.player: Oh yes, right, thanks!
Okay, thanks.

options.text: Sanfew asked me to come and talk to you.

the-various-favours-are-asked-talking-to.player: Sanfew asked me to come and talk to you.

the-various-favours-are-asked-talking-to.speaker: Captain Bleemadge
the-various-favours-are-asked-talking-to.text: Brrr, blimey it's cold up here! Wish I had something nice to drink to chase away these chills!

options.text: I have a special tea here for you from Sanfew!

steps.player: I have a special tea here for you from Sanfew!

steps.speaker: Captain Bleemadge
steps.text: Ohhh! Many thanks! Brrr, blimey it's cold up here!
(Guthix rest tea is removed from the inventory.)

steps.speaker: Captain Bleemadge
steps.text: Blimey, it was certainly jolly decent of that old stick Sanfew to get you to make me a cup of herbal tea. Wow! It really does chase away the chills!

steps.player: Yes, he's quite considerate that way...you know, thinking of people. In fact, he was thinking that you may be able to help him with another little 'helping' situation that involves ogres.

steps.speaker: Captain Bleemadge
steps.text: Ogres!

steps.speaker: Captain Bleemadge
steps.text: Hmmm, well I guess they're just like overgrown gnomes when you think about it!

steps.player: More like 'super-over-grown-gnomes' if you ask me! Or 'overgrown humans'!

steps.speaker: Captain Bleemadge
steps.text: Quite! Anyway, go on! What was Sanfew after?

steps.player: Sanfew wants to bring the word of Guthix to those ogres, though I've no idea if ogres have the mental ability to grasp druidic concepts.

steps.speaker: Captain Bleemadge
steps.text: Yes, quite, but who amongst us does? I know I'm often confused by that beardy bunch of yakking druids.

steps.player: Well, he wants to know if he can organise a glider ride down there.

steps.speaker: Captain Bleemadge
steps.text: Hmm, interesting! I know that the elders want to extend the network of glider routes, and I did hear that the Feldip Hills were being considered. I don't know why it hasn't opened up yet though.

steps.speaker: Captain Bleemadge
steps.text: If I'm going to transport that yakking druid down to the ogres I'll want to make it in record time so I'll need some lighter kit.

steps.player: Ok, good luck with that.

steps.speaker: Captain Bleemadge
steps.text: There's a chap called Arhein in Catherby and I've heard that his special interest in ships has helped him to produce lightweight but strengthened ropes. I'm in need of some T.R.A.S.H.! And I need you to get it for me.

steps.player: TRASH? What the demonikin are you talking about? Why do I have to get it?

steps.speaker: Captain Bleemadge
steps.text: I'm talking about the next generation of lightweight ropes. Triple Redundant Aero Super Hawser...T.R.A.S.H.! I'll transport your yakking druid if you can get me some T.R.A.S.H!

steps.speaker: Captain Bleemadge
steps.text: And you have to get it because I have to stay here with this glider. Is it a deal?

options.text: What do you want me to do?

steps.player: What do you want me to do?

steps.speaker: Captain Bleemadge
steps.text: Go to Arhein and ask him for some T.R.A.S.H....

steps.player: What is T.R.A.S.H?

steps.speaker: Captain Bleemadge
steps.text: T.R.A.S.H. is a short way of saying, 'Triple Redundant Aero Super Hawser', it's a technical term that we gnomes like to use when specifying lightweight rope.

options.text: Where can I get this from?

steps.player: Where can I get this from?

steps.speaker: Captain Bleemadge
steps.text: Go and talk to a chap called Arhein in Catherby, he's developed it so he'll know exactly what you're talking about.

steps.player: Great! So I get to talk T.R.A.S.H with shopkeepers!

options.text: Ok, I'll go and get you some T.R.A.S.H.

steps.player: Ok, I'll go and get you some T.R.A.S.H.

steps.speaker: Captain Bleemadge
steps.text: Wonderful my friend, wonderful!

options.text: No, sorry, I can't do it right now.

steps.player: No, sorry, I can't do it right now.

steps.speaker: Captain Bleemadge
steps.text: Well, that's a bit of a shame...I was looking forward to upgrading my glider!

steps.player: How was that tea?

steps.speaker: Captain Bleemadge
steps.text: It was delicious thanks!

options.text: What am I supposed to be doing again?

steps.player: What am I supposed to be doing again?

steps.speaker: Captain Bleemadge
steps.text: Go to Arhein in Catherby and get some T.R.A.S.H! That's a short name for Triple Redundant Aero Super Hawser and then bring it back to me! I mean, it's not difficult is it?

the-various-favours-are-asked-talking-t-.speaker: Arhein
the-various-favours-are-asked-talking-t-.text: Hello! Would you like to trade?

options.text: I need to talk T.R.A.S.H. to you.

steps.player: I need to talk T.R.A.S.H. to you.

steps.speaker: Arhein
steps.text: Oh yes, well it won't be the first time...but just so I'm sure can you explain what you mean?

steps.player: Yes, of course. There's a Gnome on White Wolf mountain who needs some T.R.A.S.H...for his glider...do you have some?

steps.speaker: Arhein
steps.text: Well, I've done a lot of research into Triple Redundant Aero Super Hawsers and it seems to have paid off, but answer me this one question. Why are you asking me this rather than the Gnome?

steps.player: Well, I'm sort of doing him a favour.

steps.speaker: Arhein
steps.text: Hmm, really, is that so? Well, I do have some Triple Redundant Aero Super Hawser and I'll let you have some if you do me just one small favour.

steps.player: How totally unpredictable!

steps.speaker: Arhein
steps.text: No, this is a really quick thing and shouldn't take you longer than a few minutes.

steps.player: Yeah, I've heard that before! Go on...tell me anyway.

steps.speaker: Arhein
steps.text: I'm funding a rather expensive trade run to Brimhaven soon and I want to be sure that the weather isn't going to change and cause my ships any trouble.

steps.speaker: Arhein
steps.text: The last thing I need is a load of goods going straight to the bottom of the ocean.

steps.player: Well, I can understand that.

steps.speaker: Arhein
steps.text: I just need you to pop along to Seers Village and ask those philosophers of foresight for a weather report. I believe a new seer there called Phantuwti can help you.

options.text: No way...I've had enough of this wild goose chase.

steps.player: No way...I've had enough of this wild goose chase.
Yes, Ok, I'll do it!

steps.speaker: Arhein
steps.text: That's great, many thanks.

options.text: Hi, can you give me a weather forecast?

steps.player: Hi, can you give me a weather forecast?

steps.speaker: Phantuwti Fanstuwi Farsight
steps.text: Hmm, somehow I knew you were going to ask me that...strange...life is so predictable when you have the power of foresight.

steps.player: Great! So I can assume you've been really pro-active and compiled an up-to-date one for me?

steps.speaker: Phantuwti Fanstuwi Farsight
steps.text: Alas my presumptuous friend, the power of foresight and the impulse to act is quite similar to the interplay between intelligence and wisdom.

steps.speaker: Phantuwti Fanstuwi Farsight
steps.text: One might have intelligence enough to realise that cakes are bad for us, but we may not have the wisdom to stop cramming that delicious-looking fatty cream cake into our salivating mouth.

steps.player: So, in your case, you have the power of foresight, but you're too lazy to act on it?

steps.speaker: Phantuwti Fanstuwi Farsight
steps.text: Not exactly lazy...but unable. My abilities and concern have been focused on the fate of a local girl whose association with a certain wizard has landed her between a rock and hard place.

options.text: Who is this girl that you're concerned about?

steps.player: Who is this girl that you're concerned about?

steps.speaker: Phantuwti Fanstuwi Farsight
steps.text: The girl's name is Petra, she's a very ...energetic youngster, always wanted to travel and have adventures. When she turned seventeen she set off to earn herself fame and fortune.

steps.speaker: Phantuwti Fanstuwi Farsight
steps.text: It looks like she's ended up in a bit of a dead end position...

steps.player: Where is this girl?

steps.speaker: Phantuwti Fanstuwi Farsight
steps.text: It's quite difficult to pinpoint exactly where she is, but apparently she's in some sort of cavern structure.

steps.speaker: Phantuwti Fanstuwi Farsight
steps.text: We sense that there are other beings around her, smelly creatures, and some sort of presence is watching over her.

steps.player: Do you have any ideas where that might be? I mean, it's pretty vague isn't it?

steps.speaker: Phantuwti Fanstuwi Farsight
steps.text: Well, we believe it may be some sort of nearby cave, it can't be very far away as the impressions we get are quite strong. We believe the cave is a home for some sort of creature or creatures.

options.text: What do you think needs to be done?

steps.player: What do you think needs to be done?

steps.speaker: Phantuwti Fanstuwi Farsight
steps.text: Well, it would be nice to locate her...if possible. Then we may be able to work out what to do when we can see what sort of state she's in.

options.text: I'm sorry but I can't help.

steps.player: I'm sorry but I can't help.

steps.speaker: Phantuwti Fanstuwi Farsight
steps.text: Well, that's a bit of a shame, I have to say...we all miss our Petra!

options.text: What can I do to help?

steps.player: What can I do to help?

steps.speaker: Phantuwti Fanstuwi Farsight
steps.text: Do you think you could do me a small favour? Check around the vicinity. The impressions are coming from a south westerly direction.

steps.speaker: Phantuwti Fanstuwi Farsight
steps.text: Don't go further east than you are already, no further south than Ardougne and no further west than the combat training camp.

steps.player: So, let me get this right. You want me to start poking my nose into a lot of caves where some creatures might be?
Risking my neck for some tomboy who thinks she's got what it takes to be a real adventurer?

steps.speaker: Phantuwti Fanstuwi Farsight
steps.text: Well, I wouldn't have put it quite that way...

steps.player: Yes, Ok, I'll do it.

steps.speaker: Phantuwti Fanstuwi Farsight
steps.text: Great! I just knew you'd agree to help!

options.text: No, sorry, I can't do it right now. Or maybe ever!

steps.player: No, sorry, I can't do it right now. Or maybe ever!

steps.speaker: Phantuwti Fanstuwi Farsight
steps.text: I knew you wouldn't help...oh well, perhaps someday you'll surprise me.

options.text: What did you need me to do again?

steps.player: What did you need me to do again?

steps.speaker: Phantuwti Fanstuwi Farsight
steps.text: I need you to start checking nearby caves looking for our missing Petra. The caves are probably home to some creature or creatures. Check around the vicincity.

steps.speaker: Phantuwti Fanstuwi Farsight
steps.text: The impressions are coming from a south westerly direction. Don't go further east than you are already, no further south than Ardougne and no further west than the combat training camp.

the-various-favours-are-asked-searching-.text: A short cutscene highlighting Petra as a sculpture plays.
It looks like a very well carved statue of a young girl.
You search the life-like sculpture and see what looks like a message sticking out of the girl's belt. It reads,'...problems report to Wizard Cromp.....rently in residence in East Ardoug...

the-various-favours-are-asked-asking-wiz.speaker: Wizard Cromperty
the-various-favours-are-asked-asking-wiz.text: Hello there. My name is Cromperty. I am a wizard, and an inventor.

the-various-favours-are-asked-asking-wiz.speaker: Wizard Cromperty
the-various-favours-are-asked-asking-wiz.text: You must be [player name]. My good friend Sedridor has told me about you. As both wizard and inventor, he has aided me in my great invention!

options.text: Two jobs? That's got to be tough.
Can you teleport me to the Rune Essence Mine?
I need to talk to you about a girl stuck in some rock!

steps.player: I need to talk to you about a girl stuck in some rock!

steps.speaker: Wizard Cromperty
steps.text: Eh!

steps.speaker: Wizard Cromperty
steps.text: What? I have no clue what you're talking about! Now, please excuse me! I need to get back to my experiments!

steps.player: Hey! Not so fast! I've seen a young girl encased in rock, a note in her belt led me to you.

steps.speaker: Wizard Cromperty
steps.text: Oh dear, it's such a bother getting them back out of the rock walls and I do loathe the trip to Port Khazard for the components.

steps.player: What the demonikin are you talking about?

steps.speaker: Wizard Cromperty
steps.text: Well, it's not the first time someone's been teleported into a rock face, just the slightest miscalculation and bang...they're in the wall!

steps.speaker: Wizard Cromperty
steps.text: It's fairly straightforward to cast a spell and fish them out again - but it requires a spell component from a chap in Port Khazard.

steps.speaker: Wizard Cromperty
steps.text: I don't suppose you could do me a small favour could you?

steps.speaker: Wizard Cromperty
steps.text: Just one small favour? Pop along to Port Khazard and get some iron oxide, it's a component of the spell.

options.text: No way am I going to Port Khazard for you!

steps.player: No way am I going to Port Khazard for you!

steps.speaker: Wizard Cromperty
steps.text: Oh dear, what a shame...I just don't have time to deal with this now...she's safe where she is for now, and I'm sure I'll get to it sooner or later.

options.text: Oh! Ok, one more 'small favour' isn't going to kill me...I hope!

steps.player: Oh! Ok, one more 'small favour' isn't going to kill me...I hope!

steps.speaker: Wizard Cromperty
steps.text: Waaahaaay! Great! I'd never suspect you'd be so helpful!

steps.speaker: Wizard Cromperty
steps.text: You need to talk to a chap called Tindel Marchant in Port Khazard, he's sort of like an antiques dealer.

steps.speaker: Wizard Cromperty
steps.text: Well, off you go then! A journey of a thousand miles starts with the first step and all that!

steps.player: What? Are you saying I have to travel a thousand miles?

steps.speaker: Wizard Cromperty
steps.text: Of course not...you silly...just...you know...the sooner you start the sooner you can get back...that's all I was saying.

the-various-favours-are-asked-asking-wiz.speaker: Wizard Cromperty
the-various-favours-are-asked-asking-wiz.text: Hello there. My name is Cromperty. I am a wizard, and an inventor.

the-various-favours-are-asked-asking-wiz.speaker: Wizard Cromperty
the-various-favours-are-asked-asking-wiz.text: You must be [player name]. My good friend Sedridor has told me about you. As both wizard and inventor, he has aided me in my great invention!

options.text: Two jobs? That's got to be tough.
Can you teleport me to the Rune Essence Mine?
What did you want me to do again?

steps.player: What did you want me to do again?

steps.speaker: Wizard Cromperty
steps.text: Go to Port Khazard and get me some iron oxide from Tindel Marchant.

the-various-favours-are-asked-asking-tin.speaker: Tindel Marchant
the-various-favours-are-asked-asking-tin.text: Hello there! Welcome to my special antiques boutique.

options.text: Wizard Cromperty sent me to get some iron oxide.

steps.player: Wizard Cromperty sent me to get some iron oxide. Do you have some?

steps.speaker: Tindel Marchant
steps.text: As a matter of fact, I do! However, it's the last in stock and I'm not likely to get more for a while so it's highly prized amongst the wizards at the moment.

steps.speaker: Tindel Marchant
steps.text: It's not easy to get so much rust together, even if I do come across it more often than most people with cleaning these rusty swords up!

steps.player: Rust? What do you mean? How much does it cost?

steps.speaker: Tindel Marchant
steps.text: Yes, iron oxide is more commonly referred to as rust. As for a price, hmmm...well...let me think now...I could give it to you for the price of...

steps.speaker: Tindel Marchant
steps.text: One small favour!

steps.player: Groan!!!

steps.speaker: Tindel Marchant
steps.text: I need a nice mattress to sleep on! I haven't had a decent night's sleep in an ice-age...could you take this stodgy mattress down to Rantz in the ogre area and ask him to fill it with prime chompy bird feathers please?

steps.player: So, let me get this straight.
You want me to traipse ALL the way down past the ogre city with some flea infested mattress, to some hermit ogre, who can't shoot a chompy bird to save his life, so that you'll give me a pot of rust?

steps.speaker: Tindel Marchant
steps.text: Well, er, I wouldn't have said it quite that way...

steps.player: Okay, I'll do it!

steps.speaker: Tindel Marchant
steps.text: Great, many thanks indeed! Here's the mattress!
Tindel gives you a worn out, very poor-looking mattress.

options.text: Sorry, I just don't want to do it.

steps.player: Sorry, I just don't want to do it.

steps.speaker: Tindel Marchant
steps.text: Well, that's a shame, but come back and see me if you change your mind.

the-various-favours-are-asked-asking-tin.speaker: Tindel Marchant
the-various-favours-are-asked-asking-tin.text: Hello there! Welcome to my special antiques boutique.

options.text: What did you want me to do again?

steps.player: What did you want me to do again?

steps.speaker: Tindel Marchant
steps.text: You need to take that stodgy mattress I gave you to Rantz and ask him to fill it with feathers! Then, bring it back to me and I'll give you some iron oxide.

steps.player: Oh, okay then!

the-various-favours-are-asked-asking-tin.speaker: Tindel Marchant
the-various-favours-are-asked-asking-tin.text: Hello there! Welcome to my special antiques boutique.

steps.player: Erm, I've lost the mattress... do you have another one I can get refilled?

steps.speaker: Tindel Marchant
steps.text: Yes, but I had to pay for this myself so you'd better pay me for losing my last one...it cost 100 gold!

options.text: Okay, here's 100 coins for another mattress...

steps.player: Okay, here's 100 coins for another mattress...

steps.speaker: Tindel Marchant
steps.text: Okay, thanks a lot, here's the mattress!
Tindel gives you a new, old mattress!

options.text: I'm not paying you 100 coins for that stinky mattress.

steps.player: I'm not paying you 100 coins for that stinky mattress.

steps.speaker: Tindel Marchant
steps.text: Well, don't expect your iron oxide any time soon then!

steps.player: Okay, then I won't.

steps.speaker: Tindel Marchant
steps.text: Good!

steps.player: Great!

steps.speaker: Tindel Marchant
steps.text: Get out!

steps.player: GLADLY!

steps.speaker: Tindel Marchant
steps.text: Grrrr!

options.text: I need to talk to you about a mattress.

steps.player: I need to talk to you about a mattress!

steps.speaker: Rantz
steps.text: You's creature shuvs flapper sack in rantz face, making rantz very upset

options.text: Can you fill this mattress with feathers?

steps.player: Can you fill this mattress with feathers?

steps.speaker: Rantz
steps.text: Der's no flappers to get cos da little guy scares dem away wiv his banging. He's making da man flapper 'come-down-place' and it's takin' ages and ages.

steps.speaker: Rantz
steps.text: Da chompies don't come no more since he's banging all da time.

steps.player: What's going on around here?

steps.speaker: Rantz
steps.text: Da little guy, he's making da man flapper 'come-down-place'...so deyz more of yous creatures coming to see Rantz...but he's takin ages to do it.

options.text: What can I do about that?

steps.player: What can I do about that?

steps.speaker: Rantz
steps.text: You's can help da little guy, he's over der near da ogre city...he's stuck wiv sumfing, making da man flapper 'come-down-place'. Me's not doin' no chompy hunting wiv dat noise going on.

options.text: Ok, I'll see what I can do.

steps.player: Ok, I'll see what I can do.

steps.speaker: Rantz
steps.text: Dat would be da good find...den me's help wiv da flufsies sack.

steps.player: Okay, thanks.

options.text: What did you want me to do again?

steps.player: What did you want me to do again?

steps.speaker: Rantz
steps.text: Yous creature, go see little guy and help wiv da man flapper 'come-down-place'...den Rantz helps yous creature wiv da fluffsies sack.

the-various-favours-are-asked-helping-gn.speaker: Gnormadium Avlafrim
the-various-favours-are-asked-helping-gn.text: Hello! Don't get in the way around here, we've got a lot of work to do!

options.text: Hello there, what are you working on?

steps.player: Hello there, what are you working on?

steps.speaker: Gnormadium Avlafrim
steps.text: Well, it's quite exciting... we're extending the glider network to include the Feldip Hills so that people can come and look at these curious ogres.

steps.speaker: Gnormadium Avlafrim
steps.text: They are impressive creatures aren't they - quite mystified they are by the technology we gnomes have invented.

steps.player: What are you working on?

steps.speaker: Gnormadium Avlafrim
steps.text: Well, people will be able to visit this area, once construction has finished, by using the most advanced network of glider routes in the whole of Gielinor... in fact, the only network of glider routes!

options.text: Is there anything that I can do?

steps.player: Is there anything that I can do?

steps.speaker: Gnormadium Avlafrim
steps.text: Not really, I'm afraid, it's probably all far too technical for someone like you.

options.text: Rantz said I should help you finish this project.

steps.player: Rantz said I should help you finish this project.

steps.speaker: Gnormadium Avlafrim
steps.text: Rantz? *gulp* Well, that would be nice actually! We are having some problems with getting the landing lights to work... do you think you could take a look at them?

steps.speaker: Gnormadium Avlafrim
steps.text: I expect that it's far too complex for you, but hey, you may be able to do something!

options.text: Yes, I'll take a look at them.

steps.player: Yes, I'll take a look at them.

steps.speaker: Gnormadium Avlafrim
steps.text: Ok then, just pop over and let me know if you're not sure what you're doing... I'm sure I'll just have to fix it myself anyway. If you need any materials, just pop over.

steps.player: We'll see!

options.text: Sorry, but I've got other things to attend to.

steps.player: Sorry, but I've got other things to attend to.

steps.speaker: Gnormadium Avlafrim
steps.text: Yes, I expected it might be a bit too complex for you. We Gnomes lead the way with technical things like this - world leaders, you might say.

steps.player: Okay, thanks.

options.text: What was it you wanted me to do again?

steps.player: What was it you wanted me to do again?

steps.speaker: Gnormadium Avlafrim
steps.text: Go and take a look at those landing lights and see if you can get them to work, would you? They've been as dull as an ogre conversation since we started working here.

steps.speaker: Gnormadium Avlafrim
steps.text: Come back and tell me if you actually manage to get them fixed.

the-various-favours-are-asked-helping-gn.text: Depending on which Gnome landing light is searched:

steps.text: You find an uncut sapphire in the landing light.
You find an uncut opal in the landing light.
You find an uncut red topaz in the landing light.
You find an uncut jade in the landing light.

the-various-favours-are-asked-helping-gn.speaker: Gnormadium Avlafrim
the-various-favours-are-asked-helping-gn.text: Hello! Don't get in the way around here, we've got a lot of work to do!

options.text: Hello there, what are you working on?
Is there anything I can do?
I need a chisel to fix these crystals.

steps.player: I need a chisel to fix these crystals.

steps.speaker: Gnormadium Avlafrim
steps.text: Okay, I can sell you one for 10 coins.
Without the right amount of coins in inventory:

steps.player: But I don't have 10 coins.

steps.speaker: Gnormadium Avlafrim
steps.text: So I can't sell you one then!
With at least 10 coins in inventory:

options.text: Okay, I'll buy a chisel for 10 coins.

steps.player: Okay, I'll buy a chisel for 10 coins.

steps.text: You pay ten coins for the chisel.

steps.speaker: Gnormadium Avlafrim
steps.text: Okay, many thanks for your custom.

options.text: No, I won't buy the chisel.

steps.player: No, I won't buy the chisel.

steps.speaker: Gnormadium Avlafrim
steps.text: Fair enough, come back if you change your mind.

options.text: Hello there, what are you working on?
Is there anything I can do?
I need a new [opal/jade/red topaz] to fix the lights.

steps.player: I need a new [opal/jade/red topaz] to fix the lights.

steps.speaker: Gnormadium Avlafrim
steps.text: Broken something, have you? I'll want 500 coins for a new one. Be careful - my supplies are limited, and if I run out, you'll have to find your own materials elsewhere.
Without the right amount of coins in inventory:

steps.player: But I don't have 500 coins!

steps.speaker: Gnormadium Avlafrim
steps.text: I can't give you one then.
With at least 500 coins in inventory:

options.text: Okay, here's 500 coins, I'll buy one.

steps.player: Okay, here's 500 coins, I'll buy one.

options.text: No way am I paying that much.

steps.player: No way am I paying that much.

the-various-favours-are-asked-helping-gn.text: Depending on which Gnome landing light is searched:

steps.text: You place the sapphire in the landing light. It seems to look right.
You place the opal in the landing light. It seems to look right.
You place the red topaz in the landing light. It seems to look right.
You place the jade in the landing light. It seems to look right.

the-various-favours-are-asked-helping-gn.text: Depending on how many lights have been fixed:

steps.text: You've fixed one landing light so far...
You've fixed 2 landing lights so far...
You've fixed 3 landing lights so far...
You've fixed 4 landing lights so far...
You've fixed 5 landing lights so far...
You've fixed 6 landing lights so far...
You've fixed 7 landing lights so far...
You've fixed all the landing lights!

options.text: Hello there, what are you working on?
Is there anything I can do?

steps.player: I've fixed all the lights!

steps.speaker: Gnormadium Avlafrim
steps.text: Hmm. That seems a tad unlikely to me, but let's flick the switch here and see, shall we?!
Cutscene plays of the lights being turned on.

steps.speaker: Gnormadium Avlafrim
steps.text: I don't believe it - you fixed it! Well done, well done... We can pack up now and leave these ogres in peace.

steps.player: I know one ogre who'll be very pleased about that!

the-various-favours-are-asked-helping-gn.speaker: Gnormadium Avlafrim
the-various-favours-are-asked-helping-gn.text: Hello! Don't get in the way around here, we've got a lot of work to do!

options.text: Hello there, what are you working on?
Is there anything I can do?

steps.player: Is there anything I can do?

steps.speaker: Gnormadium Avlafrim
steps.text: No thanks, you've helped enough by fixing those lights!

options.text: Do you need any more help from me?

steps.player: Do you need any more help from me?

steps.speaker: Gnormadium Avlafrim
steps.text: No, it's all great now that you've fixed the landing lights... I must admit, I was surprised you managed to pull that off.

steps.speaker: Gnormadium Avlafrim
steps.text: Are you sure you don't have any gnomish ancestors? Your insight into technical things is quite amazing for a human!

steps.player: Okay, thanks.

options.text: Ok, I've helped that Gnome, he shouldn't bother you anymore.

steps.player: Ok, I've helped that Gnome, he shouldn't bother you anymore.

steps.speaker: Rantz
steps.text: Yous creature dun a gud fing...Rantz give yous creature da fluffsies sack now...
If the player doesn't have the Stodgy mattress:

steps.player: But I don't have the stodgy mattress anymore...I'll have to get another one.

steps.text: If the player has the Stodgy mattress:
Rantz gives you a filled comfy mattress.

steps.speaker: Rantz
steps.text: De're yous goes creature...da fluffsies sack is full now.

steps.player: Great, I think Tindel will get a good night's rest on this.

options.text: Hello again, what should I do now?

steps.player: Hello again, what should I do now?

steps.speaker: Rantz
steps.text: Yous do somefing wiv da fluffsies sack...Rantz not care...!

options.text: I've lost that filled mattress you gave me!

steps.player: I've lost that filled mattress you gave me!

steps.text: If the player doesn't have a stodgy mattress:

steps.speaker: Rantz
steps.text: Yous creature needs to bring me da saggy fluffsies sack to full wiv da chompy flufsies!
If the player has a stodgy mattress:

steps.speaker: Rantz
steps.text: It cost you dis many bright pretties to do dis again, yous den be more careful wiv my work next time round.
Rantz flashes his fingers at you many times, you think he wants about 200 gold. ~
If the player doesn't have enough coins:

steps.player: But I don't have that many bright pretties!

steps.speaker: Rantz
steps.text: Den yous no get da fluffsies sack...
If the player has at least 200 coins:

options.text: Ok, I'll give you 200 bright pretties.

steps.player: Ok, I'll give you 200 bright pretties.

steps.text: Rantz gives you a new comfy mattress.

steps.speaker: Rantz
steps.text: De're yous goes creatures...dere's yous comfy fluffsies sack.

options.text: No way am I giving you 200 bright pretties.

steps.player: No way am I giving you 200 bright pretties.

steps.speaker: Rantz
steps.text: Den yous no get da fluffsies sack...

heading-back-to-complete-the-favours-tin.speaker: Tindel Marchant
heading-back-to-complete-the-favours-tin.text: Hello there! Welcome to my special antiques boutique.

steps.player: I have the mattress!

steps.speaker: Tindel Marchant
steps.text: Great! Let's have a look then.
You hand Tindel the comfy mattress. Tindel gives you the iron oxide.

steps.speaker: Tindel Marchant
steps.text: Great! Here's the iron oxide I promised you!

heading-back-to-complete-the-favours-tin.speaker: Tindel Marchant
heading-back-to-complete-the-favours-tin.text: Hello there! Welcome to my special antiques boutique.

steps.player: What should I do now?

steps.speaker: Tindel Marchant
steps.text: Didn't you need to take that bottle of rust to someone?

heading-back-to-complete-the-favours-tin.speaker: Tindel Marchant
heading-back-to-complete-the-favours-tin.text: Hello there! Welcome to my special antiques boutique.

options.text: I've lost the iron oxide, can I have some more?

steps.player: I've lost the iron oxide, can I have some more?

steps.speaker: Tindel Marchant
steps.text: Okay, but I'm going to have to charge you I'm afraid. 200 coins.
If the player doesnt' have enough coins:

steps.player: But I haven't got 200 coins!

steps.speaker: Tindel Marchant
steps.text: Sorry, but I have to make a living.
If the player has at least 200 coins:

steps.player: Okay, I'll buy it.

steps.text: You pay 200 coins for another bottle of rust.

options.text: No way am I paying 200 coins for a bottle of rust!

steps.player: No way am I paying 200 coins for a bottle of rust!

steps.speaker: Tindel Marchant
steps.text: Suit yourself... I have plenty of other customers.

heading-back-to-complete-the-favours-wiz.speaker: Wizard Cromperty
heading-back-to-complete-the-favours-wiz.text: Hello there. My name is Cromperty. I am a wizard, and an inventor.

options.condition: If the medium Ardougne Diary is completed:

steps.speaker: Wizard Cromperty
steps.text: You must be [player name]. My good friend Sedridor has told me about you. As both wizard and inventor, he has aided me in my great invention!

options.text: Two jobs? That's got to be tough.
Can you teleport me to the Rune Essence Mine?
I have that iron oxide you asked for!

steps.player: I have that iron oxide you asked for!

steps.speaker: Wizard Cromperty
steps.text: Great! Just what I needed! Now I need to give you a spell scroll to help bring Petra back again.
Cromperty takes the iron oxide and starts preparing a spell.
After some time, he comes back and gives you an animate rock spell.

steps.speaker: Wizard Cromperty
steps.text: Just cast this in the room, it should have her out of that rock in a jiffy! Good luck with your exploits...now, where was I with that wranklin severance device...

heading-back-to-complete-the-favours-wiz.speaker: Wizard Cromperty
heading-back-to-complete-the-favours-wiz.text: Hello there. My name is Cromperty. I am a wizard, and an inventor.

options.condition: If the medium Ardougne Diary is completed:

steps.speaker: Wizard Cromperty
steps.text: You must be [player name]. My good friend Sedridor has told me about you. As both wizard and inventor, he has aided me in my great invention!

options.text: Two jobs? That's got to be tough.
Can you teleport me to the Rune Essence Mine?

steps.player: What should I do now?

steps.speaker: Wizard Cromperty
steps.text: Well, I thought you were going to use that spell I gave you to free Petra from the rock face?

heading-back-to-complete-the-favours-wiz.speaker: Wizard Cromperty
heading-back-to-complete-the-favours-wiz.text: Hello there. My name is Cromperty. I am a wizard, and an inventor.

options.condition: If the medium Ardougne Diary is completed:

steps.speaker: Wizard Cromperty
steps.text: You must be [player name]. My good friend Sedridor has told me about you. As both wizard and inventor, he has aided me in my great invention!

options.text: Two jobs? That's got to be tough.
Can you teleport me to the Rune Essence Mine?
I need another animate rock spell.

steps.player: I need another animate rock spell.

steps.speaker: Wizard Cromperty
steps.text: I suspected that you might...you can have one, but it will cost you 100 gold pieces.
If the player doesn't have enough coins:

steps.player: But I don't have 100 coins!

steps.speaker: Wizard Cromperty
steps.text: So you can't have the spell then can you!
If the player has at least 100 coins:

options.text: No way...I'm cleaning up your mess, you should be grateful!

steps.player: No way...I'm cleaning up your mess, you should be grateful!

steps.speaker: Wizard Cromperty
steps.text: Well, I did give you the last one for free...you're not getting another one for free, even if it is my mess that you're trying to clear up! You shouldn't be so careless to leave things lying around!

steps.player: Ok, here you go!

steps.speaker: Wizard Cromperty
steps.text: Thanks...try not to lose it this time.

steps.player: Grrrrr!

heading-back-to-complete-the-favours-pet.text: The spell doesn't seem to be working here.

heading-back-to-complete-the-favours-pet.player: Whoooah! That was a bit of a misfire.

heading-back-to-complete-the-favours-pet.speaker: Petra Fiyed
heading-back-to-complete-the-favours-pet.text: Oh thank goodness you released me...how long have I been stuck in that gloomy wall?

heading-back-to-complete-the-favours-pet.player: Oh, not so long...I don't think...
I mean...that is... I'm not so sure...at all...in fact.

heading-back-to-complete-the-favours-pet.speaker: Petra Fiyed
heading-back-to-complete-the-favours-pet.text: Well, at least I'm ok...thanks to you! Last time I get involved with that Cromperty lunatic...in fact I have some words to say to that man!

heading-back-to-complete-the-favours-pet.player: Well actually, I think that some of the people at the Seers Village are worried about you. That's how I came to find you here, Phantuwti sent me.

heading-back-to-complete-the-favours-pet.speaker: Petra Fiyed
heading-back-to-complete-the-favours-pet.text: Oh, right, yes, well I guess I'd better go back there and let them all know that I'm safe then..Ok, thanks...I'll be off now and once again thanks for your help.

heading-back-to-complete-the-favours-pet.player: No problem...I'll probably see you back at the Seers Village.

options.text: I've released Petra, she should have returned.

steps.player: I've released Petra, she should have returned.

steps.speaker: Phantuwti Fanstuwi Farsight
steps.text: Hi there, yes she has actually! Well done, you're a true hero!

steps.player: So, can I have the weather report now please?

steps.speaker: Phantuwti Fanstuwi Farsight
steps.text: I wish I could but it's just been so difficult to get a clear image of the future at the moment. You know...we're all so relieved that Petra has returned and all that.

options.text: Listen you...just give me the blooming weather report!

steps.player: Listen you...just give me the blooming weather report!

steps.speaker: Phantuwti Fanstuwi Farsight
steps.text: Er...no. I can't, I told you, I can't get a clear picture. Nope, sorry, the conditions are just not quite right.

options.text: Why can't you get a clear picture?

steps.player: Why can't you get a clear picture?

steps.speaker: Phantuwti Fanstuwi Farsight
steps.text: Well, it's just like that Ok, I just can't get a clear picture...and that's it.

options.text: I've done my part of the deal, now hand over that weather report.

steps.player: I've done my part of the deal, now hand over that weather report.

steps.speaker: Phantuwti Fanstuwi Farsight
steps.text: I would really like to, please believe me, I would, but I just can't.

options.text: I'll run you through if you don't give me that weather report.

steps.player: I'll run you through if you don't give me that weather report.

steps.speaker: Phantuwti Fanstuwi Farsight
steps.text: Well, that's not very nice...I mean, I'm a nice guy and I thought you were nice too! Why would you want to run me through? I mean, it's only a weather report.

steps.speaker: Phantuwti Fanstuwi Farsight
steps.text: It doesn't make sense to get angry about something so trivial.

options.text: You're making me angry! I did you a favour, now pay up!

steps.player: You're making me angry! I did you a favour, now pay up!

steps.speaker: Phantuwti Fanstuwi Farsight
steps.text: I'm not making you angry, you're doing all that on your own! I just don't have a weather report to give you!

steps.speaker: Phantuwti Fanstuwi Farsight
steps.text: I can't help that, you should be more understanding and less forceful, then I might be persuaded to give you the weather report.

options.text: Why can't you get a clear picture?

steps.speaker: Phantuwti Fanstuwi Farsight
steps.text: Well, it's complicated, the special Seers tools that help us predict the weather are not aligned properly...

options.text: You're making me angry! I did you a favour, now pay up!
Which special Seers tools do you mean?

steps.player: Which special Seers tools do you mean?

steps.speaker: Phantuwti Fanstuwi Farsight
steps.text: Well, we use a special combination of items which are used to gauge current weather movements and we're able to predict future weather patterns from these. Of course, it's strongly linked to the Seers' foresight ability.

options.text: What do you mean, 'special combination of items'?

steps.player: What do you mean, 'special combination of items'?

steps.speaker: Phantuwti Fanstuwi Farsight
steps.text: Well, let me think now...There's a copper eye, a rotating thing, and some pointy direction thingies. It's all highly scientific - and of course mystical - in a very magical 'foresight' sort of way.

steps.player: You're talking about a weather vane aren't you?

steps.speaker: Phantuwti Fanstuwi Farsight
steps.text: Er...maybe...I may be talking about that...

steps.player: You can't predict the weather because your weather vane is broken...that's it isn't it? Holy Saradomin breath....you can't even predict the weather, you need a weather vane!

steps.speaker: Phantuwti Fanstuwi Farsight
steps.text: Erm, well....err....

steps.player: Ok, show me where this weather vane is...I want to look at it.

steps.speaker: Phantuwti Fanstuwi Farsight
steps.text: What for?

steps.player: I may be able to fix it and then you can give me a weather report...come on, let's go!

steps.speaker: Phantuwti Fanstuwi Farsight
steps.text: Oh, very well..but you'll need to be a specialist to fix this weather vane, it was made by some of the most experienced....

steps.player: Just show me it!

steps.speaker: Phantuwti Fanstuwi Farsight
steps.text: Ok, ok, it's up on the roof...

options.text: You're talking in riddles, just give me a straight answer!

steps.player: You're talking in riddles, just give me a straight answer!

steps.speaker: Phantuwti Fanstuwi Farsight
steps.text: Since when has any Seer ever given you a straight answer...the power of knowing the future and the visions we see have to be wrapped in allegory so that the truth can slowly be accepted by the listener.

steps.player: This isn't allegory though, you're just avoiding my questions!

steps.speaker: Phantuwti Fanstuwi Farsight
steps.text: How can you be sure? Are you so sure of what you just asked me? And am I really avoiding your questions by asking you lots of other questions? Answer me that huh!

steps.speaker: Phantuwti Fanstuwi Farsight
steps.text: Anyway, we need a special combination of items before we can truly have foreknowledge of the weather.

options.text: How hard can it be to predict the weather?

steps.player: How hard can it be to predict the weather?

steps.speaker: Phantuwti Fanstuwi Farsight
steps.text: Quite hard actually. I mean, you're still waiting for me to do it aren't you and I've told you time and again that I can't...right now...but that normally it's actually quite an easy thing for me to do.

options.text: Ok, what's it going to take to get a weather report?

steps.player: Ok, what's it going to take to get a weather report?

steps.speaker: Phantuwti Fanstuwi Farsight
steps.text: Hmm, well, you can come back in several months and see if we can do one for you....does that help?

steps.player: No, sorry, it doesn't help at all, I need a weather report and I need it now...so hand it over!

options.text: You're just a fake...you can't predict the weather!
What's it going to take for you to give me that weather report?
You're just a fake...you can't predict the weather!

steps.player: You're just a fake...you can't predict the weather!

steps.speaker: Phantuwti Fanstuwi Farsight
steps.text: Why...how dare you...I've never been so insulted in my life.

steps.player: You should get out more!

options.text: What's it going to take for you to give me that weather report?

steps.player: What's it going to take for you to give me that weather report.

steps.speaker: Phantuwti Fanstuwi Farsight
steps.text: Well, nothing in fact, as I can't give you a weather report. I'm sorry, but that's just the way it is.

options.text: Ok, show me where this weather vane is...I want to look at it.

heading-back-to-complete-the-favours-far.player: Ok, show me where this weather vane is...I want to look at it.

heading-back-to-complete-the-favours-far.text: It looks pretty broken!

You search the weather vane... you find that the ornament is broken, as are the directionals and the rotating bar. You think you may be able to repair them if you can get them off. They look pretty rusted on, it might take quite a powerful force to loosen them.
You give the structure a good solid whack...
At least three inventory spaces free:
You find a broken ornament...
broken directionals...
and a broken rotating pillar.
Fewer than three inventory spaces free:
You see that there are three parts which you could replace, but you don't have enough inventory space to store them all.
You can find nothing interesting here, all the parts seem to be missing.

steps.player: Hey, I'm fixing the weather vane!

steps.speaker: Phantuwti Fanstuwi Farsight
steps.text: Fantastic, come and let me know when you've finished.

heading-back-to-complete-the-favours-far.text: Using the broken ornament on an anvil:
You fix the ornament.
Using the broken directionals on an anvil:
You fix the directionals.
Using the broken weathervane pillar on an anvil:
You fix the Weathervane Pillar.
Using the ornament on the weather vane:
You fix the ornament into the weather vane.
Using the directionals on the weather vane:
You fix the directionals into the weather vane.
Using the weathervane pillar on the weather vane:
You fix the Weathervane Pillar into the weather vane.
After using all parts:
You fix the last part of the weather vane into place.
The weather vane seems to be totally repaired.

steps.player: I've fixed the weather vane!

steps.speaker: Phantuwti Fanstuwi Farsight
steps.text: Oh, thanks so much...you can't believe how helpful it is to get accurate predictions on the weather...we Seers are almost blind without it.
Phantuwti starts compiling a weather report for you.

steps.speaker: Phantuwti Fanstuwi Farsight
steps.text: There you go...a weather report as asked for...I hope it helps you!

options.text: Hi again, what should I do now?

steps.player: Hi again, what should I do now?

steps.speaker: Phantuwti Fanstuwi Farsight
steps.text: I've no clue my friend, you mentioned something about Arhein, but your plans might have changed in the meantime.

steps.player: I've lost the weather report.

steps.speaker: Phantuwti Fanstuwi Farsight
steps.text: Well, I knew you were going to say that! Here you go...have another one!

steps.player: Thanks!

options.text: What do you have for sale?
I have the weather report for you.

steps.player: I have the weather report for you.

steps.speaker: Arhein
steps.text: Fantastic...let's see it!
You show the weather report to Arhein.

steps.speaker: Arhein
steps.text: Wonderful...well the weather report is slightly unspecific, but I feel much better anyway for getting it. Hopefully now the Seers will take some responsibility if my ships go down to the bottom of the ocean.

steps.speaker: Arhein
steps.text: I'll get one of my associates to take some T.R.A.S.H to your Gnome Glider Pilot friend on White Wolf mountain. Once again, many thanks for your help.

steps.player: Thanks!

options.text: I think I might have misplaced that duck.
options.condition: After obtaining the current duck:

options.text: What do you have for sale?
What did you want me to do again?

steps.player: Is that T.R.A.S.H. all sorted?

steps.speaker: Arhein
steps.text: Indeed it is. One of my associates has taken some to your Gnome Glider Pilot friend on White Wolf mountain. Once again, many thanks for your help.

steps.player: Thanks!

options.text: I think I might have misplaced that duck.
options.condition: After obtaining the current duck:

options.text: Hey there, did you get your T.R.A.S.H?

steps.player: Hey there, did you get your T.R.A.S.H? Arhein said that he'd send one of this associates up with it.

steps.speaker: Captain Bleemadge
steps.text: Oh, yes, thanks...I've already installed it. I should go like the wind now! Tell Sanfew, that yakking old druid, I'll be happy to take him to the ogre area now...and yourself of course if you should like to go.

steps.player: Ok then...thanks I will!

heading-back-to-complete-the-favours-san.speaker: Sanfew
heading-back-to-complete-the-favours-san.text: What can I do for you young 'un?

options.condition: If Eadgar's Ruse has been completed:

steps.npc: Okay, first you need dynamite. That's got three ingredients...

steps.text: Firstly, you need volcanic sulphur. It comes from Toothy's mine, west of here.
Secondly, you need juniper charcoal. Smoggy's got some charcoal furnaces on the beach in the Hosidius area, near the juniper woods.

standard-dialogue-initial-dialogue.npc: Hello.

standard-dialogue-initial-dialogue.player: Hey, I saw that!
