talking-to-king-after-gathering-all-her-.speaker: King
talking-to-king-after-gathering-all-her-.text: Welcome back, iknami. What can I get you?

steps.player: I've gathered your men.

steps.speaker: King
steps.text: Then I've done all I can. The rest is now in their hands, and yours. Good luck, iknami.

talking-to-king-after-gathering-all-her-.speaker: Nezketi
talking-to-king-after-gathering-all-her-.text: This isn't good, iknami. We don't think there's any way we can put this egg back together again.

talking-to-king-after-gathering-all-her-.player: What are we going to do?

talking-to-king-after-gathering-all-her-.speaker: Acatzin
talking-to-king-after-gathering-all-her-.text: The way I see it, we only have one option. We need to replace the egg.

talking-to-king-after-gathering-all-her-.speaker: Kauayotl
talking-to-king-after-gathering-all-her-.text: It's more than madness. There isn't even a word to properly describe what it is. However, I fear it is the only path available to us.

talking-to-king-after-gathering-all-her-.player: But where would we even get a replacement egg?

talking-to-king-after-gathering-all-her-.speaker: Acatzin
talking-to-king-after-gathering-all-her-.text: We're going to need to obtain a chicken egg.

talking-to-king-after-gathering-all-her-.speaker: Nezketi
talking-to-king-after-gathering-all-her-.text: Tetamo! That's preposterous! A chicken egg is far too small.

talking-to-king-after-gathering-all-her-.speaker: Acatzin
talking-to-king-after-gathering-all-her-.text: Not if it's from a rather large chicken.

talking-to-king-after-gathering-all-her-.speaker: Kauayotl
talking-to-king-after-gathering-all-her-.text: A dragon egg is what we need. They are the perfect size.

talking-to-king-after-gathering-all-her-.speaker: Nezketi
talking-to-king-after-gathering-all-her-.text: A dragon egg would be suicide. No dragon would willingly give up its egg. What we need is a jaguar egg.

talking-to-king-after-gathering-all-her-.speaker: Kauayotl
talking-to-king-after-gathering-all-her-.text: But jaguars don't lay eggs...

talking-to-king-after-gathering-all-her-.player: How about we gather a few potential eggs and pick the best one?

talking-to-king-after-gathering-all-her-.speaker: Acatzin
talking-to-king-after-gathering-all-her-.text: Kuani! What a brilliant idea.

talking-to-king-after-gathering-all-her-.player: Okay, I just need to know where I can find these eggs.

talking-to-king-after-gathering-all-her-.speaker: Kauayotl
talking-to-king-after-gathering-all-her-.text: There are some dragons in a cave just south east of here, across the river from Tal Teklan. One of them should have an egg.

talking-to-king-after-gathering-all-her-.speaker: Acatzin
talking-to-king-after-gathering-all-her-.text: There's a chicken farm on the outskirts of Tal Teklan. I reckon you'll be able to find a large chicken egg there.

talking-to-king-after-gathering-all-her-.speaker: Nezketi
talking-to-king-after-gathering-all-her-.text: And I've heard talk of some eggs in an old camp site by the mine east of Tal Teklan. Apparently the camp site is a hot spot for jaguars! They must be jaguar eggs!

talking-to-king-after-gathering-all-her-.player: Right then. I'll be back once I have some eggs.
Remind me, where can I find a dragon egg?

talking-to-king-after-gathering-all-her-.speaker: Kauayotl
talking-to-king-after-gathering-all-her-.text: There are some dragons in a cave just south east of here, across the river from Tal Teklan. One of them should have a suitable egg.

talking-to-king-after-gathering-all-her-.player: I'll head over there and try to find one.
Remind me, where can I find a large chicken egg?

talking-to-king-after-gathering-all-her-.speaker: Acatzin
talking-to-king-after-gathering-all-her-.text: There's a farm on the outskirts of Tal Teklan. I reckon you'll be able to find one there.

talking-to-king-after-gathering-all-her-.player: Remind me, where can I find a jaguar egg?

talking-to-king-after-gathering-all-her-.speaker: Nezketi
talking-to-king-after-gathering-all-her-.text: I've heard talk of some in an old camp site by the mine east of Tal Teklan.

talking-to-king-after-gathering-all-her-.player: I'll have a look and see if I can find them.

talking-to-king-after-gathering-all-her-.text: If the player attempts to take a large egg from the egg pile:

steps.text: A nearby chicken doesn't take kindly to you trying to take one of its eggs.

talking-to-king-after-gathering-all-her-.text: If the player takes an egg after defeating the large chicken:

steps.text: You find a nice large egg. You take it.

talking-to-king-after-gathering-all-her-.text: If the player takes an egg after defeating the large chicken without enough inventory space:

steps.text: You find a nice large egg, but you don't have enough room to take it.

talking-to-king-after-gathering-all-her-.text: If the player attempts to take a jaguar egg from the egg pile:

steps.text: A nearby jaguar doesn't take kindly to you trying to take one of its eggs.

talking-to-king-after-gathering-all-her-.text: If the player takes an egg after defeating the black jaguar:

steps.text: You find an egg. You're not convinced a jaguar laid it, but you take it anyway.

talking-to-king-after-gathering-all-her-.text: If the player takes an egg after defeating the black jaguar without enough inventory space:

steps.text: You find an egg, but you don't have enough room to take it.

talking-to-king-after-gathering-all-her-.text: If the player attempts to take a dragon egg from the egg pile:

steps.text: A nearby dragon doesn't take kindly to you trying to take one of its eggs.

talking-to-king-after-gathering-all-her-.text: If the player takes an egg after defeating the Red dragon:

steps.text: You find a dragon egg. You take it.

talking-to-king-after-gathering-all-her-.text: If the player takes an egg after defeating the Red dragon without enough inventory space:

steps.text: You find a dragon egg, but you don't have enough room to take it.

after-collecting-the-three-eggs-talking-.player: I managed to find a large chicken egg!

after-collecting-the-three-eggs-talking-.speaker: Acatzin
after-collecting-the-three-eggs-talking-.text: Good work! I'll get it set up so its ready to be judged.
Acatzin sets up the chicken egg.

after-collecting-the-three-eggs-talking-.speaker: Acatzin
after-collecting-the-three-eggs-talking-.text: The chicken egg is ready to be judged. You should get the other eggs gathered.

after-collecting-the-three-eggs-kauayotl.player: I managed to find a dragon egg!

after-collecting-the-three-eggs-kauayotl.speaker: Kauayotl
after-collecting-the-three-eggs-kauayotl.text: Kuani! Excellent work! I'll get it ready to go.
Kauayotl sets up the dragon egg.

after-collecting-the-three-eggs-kauayotl.speaker: Kauayotl
after-collecting-the-three-eggs-kauayotl.text: The dragon egg is ready to be judged. You should get the other eggs gathered.

after-collecting-the-three-eggs-nezketi.speaker: Nezketi
after-collecting-the-three-eggs-nezketi.text: Kuani! I'll get it set up and ready to be judged.
Nezketi sets up the jaguar egg.

after-collecting-the-three-eggs-nezketi-.speaker: Nezketi
after-collecting-the-three-eggs-nezketi-.text: The jaguar egg is all set up and ready to be judged. You should work on gathering the other eggs.

after-collecting-the-three-eggs-after-pl.speaker: Kauayotl
after-collecting-the-three-eggs-after-pl.text: That's the last one. Let's get these eggs judged.

judging-the-eggs.speaker: Nezketi
judging-the-eggs.text: We've prettied them up as best we can. Hopefully one of them looks like Scrumpty Lumpy.

judging-the-eggs.player: Hmm... It's not bad, but I think it's just a little bit too small to be Humpty Fumty.

judging-the-eggs.speaker: Kauayotl
judging-the-eggs.text: Well, what about the dragon egg?

judging-the-eggs.player: It's a good size, but the face... it seems to be melting off. I think the egg is too warm.

judging-the-eggs.speaker: Nezketi
judging-the-eggs.text: The jaguar egg then? It's a perfect size and it's the right temperature.

judging-the-eggs.speaker: Kauayotl
judging-the-eggs.text: I still don't think it's actually a jaguar egg...

judging-the-eggs.player: Well, regardless of what it is, I do think it might be the one.

judging-the-eggs.speaker: Nezketi
judging-the-eggs.text: Kuani! Good work everyone. I think we've done it!
All three eggs fall to the ground.
If the player has the profanity filter enabled:
If the player has the profanity filter disabled:

steps.speaker: King's men and the Player
steps.text: Bollocks.

judging-the-eggs.player: What are we going to do now?

judging-the-eggs.speaker: Kauayotl
judging-the-eggs.text: We gave it our best, but I fear we have failed.

judging-the-eggs.speaker: Acatzin
judging-the-eggs.text: There's only one thing for it. We're going to have to put Pumpty Lumpty back together again.

judging-the-eggs.speaker: Kauayotl
judging-the-eggs.text: But how? He was broken beyond repair!

judging-the-eggs.speaker: Nezketi
judging-the-eggs.text: We don't have any other options. We have to try.

judging-the-eggs-talking-to-any-of-king-.text: The player attempts to put the eggs together in one piece.

judging-the-eggs-talking-to-any-of-king-.speaker: Kauayotl
judging-the-eggs-talking-to-any-of-king-.text: Indeed it is. I think this means our work here is done.

judging-the-eggs-talking-to-any-of-king-.player: Thank you. I don't think I could have done it without you three.

judging-the-eggs-talking-to-any-of-king-.speaker: Acatzin
judging-the-eggs-talking-to-any-of-king-.text: Don't mention it. We're happy to have helped. Now, we should leave you to it.

judging-the-eggs-talking-to-any-of-king-.speaker: Alan
judging-the-eggs-talking-to-any-of-king-.text: I'm back! How was Plumper? He didn't cause you any problems, did he?

judging-the-eggs-talking-to-any-of-king-.player: Er... No. No problems at all.

judging-the-eggs-talking-to-any-of-king-.speaker: Alan
judging-the-eggs-talking-to-any-of-king-.text: Wonderful! I'm so glad to hear it. Now, I've got quite the meal lined up for us. Would you mind giving me a hand bringing everything inside?

judging-the-eggs-talking-to-any-of-king-.speaker: Alan
judging-the-eggs-talking-to-any-of-king-.text: You know, friend, it wasn't until now that I came to realise that I'd actually been lost for a long time. I had a job back home... I had a family... and yet, something was missing.

judging-the-eggs-talking-to-any-of-king-.speaker: Alan
judging-the-eggs-talking-to-any-of-king-.text: But now... now I think I've finally found myself. For the first time in my life, I know who I am... who I'm meant to be. I think this can be a proper home. A home for me, and for Rumpy as well. A forever home.
Alan falls to the ground, dying at the bottom of the stairs.
If the player has the profanity filter enabled:
If the player has the profanity filter disabled:

steps.player: Bollocks.

post-quest-dialogue-nezketi.player: Hello there. Thanks again for helping with Mumpty Rumpty.

post-quest-dialogue-nezketi.speaker: Nezketi
post-quest-dialogue-nezketi.text: Don't mention it, iknami. Always happy to be of service.

post-quest-dialogue-acatzin.player: Hello there. Thanks again for helping with Rumpty Bumpty.

post-quest-dialogue-king.speaker: King
post-quest-dialogue-king.text: Welcome back, iknami. I hear you managed to solve your egg problem.

post-quest-dialogue-king.player: I did. Your men were a big help.

post-quest-dialogue-king.speaker: King
post-quest-dialogue-king.text: Glad to hear it. Now, what can I get you?

post-quest-dialogue-kauayotl.player: Hello there. Thanks again for helping with Mumpty Rumpty.

post-quest-dialogue-kauayotl.speaker: Kauayotl
post-quest-dialogue-kauayotl.text: It was my pleasure, iknami. We of course wouldn't have been able to do it without you either.

steps.player: Scrubfoot, are you okay?

steps.npc: Ugh... no. Scrubfoot can't move.

steps.player: I'm sorry. Sledding is dangerous business.

steps.npc: That it is. It also dangerous business going back to generals without glowy flying things.

options.text: How do I get out of here?

steps.player: How do I get out of here?

steps.npc: Over by water there is crack in the wall.

steps.player: Thanks. Will you make it out by yourself?

steps.npc: Scrubfoot needs a minute before moving.

steps.player: Good luck with that.
What were you doing here?

steps.npc: General Wartface send Scrubfoot to get green glowy flying things.

steps.player: I guess you won't be able to get the green ones now.

steps.npc: It not matter. If Scrubfoot get green fireflies, General Bentnoze kick Scrubfoot. If not get green fireflies, General Wartface kick Scrubfoot.

steps.player: Seems like you can't win with those generals. What if you got them both green and red?

steps.npc: Scrubfoot never tried that.

2020-christmas-event-dialogue-goblin-vil.npc: Scrubfoot busy. Must scrub generals' feet.

starting-off.speaker: Caroline
starting-off.text: Is there any chance you could help me?

starting-off.speaker: Caroline
starting-off.text: It's my husband, he works on a fishing platform. Once a month he takes our son, Kennith, out with him.

starting-off.speaker: Caroline
starting-off.text: They usually write to me regularly, but I've heard nothing all week. It's very strange.

starting-off.speaker: Caroline
starting-off.text: Maybe, but no-one's heard from the other fishermen on the platform. Their families are becoming quite concerned.

starting-off.speaker: Caroline
starting-off.text: Is there any chance you could visit the platform and find out what's going on?
If the player's Firemaking level is less than 30:

steps.text: Before starting this quest, be aware that one or more of your skill levels are lower than what is required to fully complete it.

starting-off.text: If the player's Firemaking level is 30 or above:

steps.prompt: Start the Sea Slug quest?

steps.player: I suppose so, how do I get there?

steps.speaker: Caroline
steps.text: That's very good of you [player name]. My friend Holgart will take you there.

steps.player: Ok, I'll go and see if they're ok.

steps.speaker: Caroline
steps.text: I'll reward you for your time. It'll give me peace of mind to know Kennith and my husband, Kent, are safe.

steps.player: I'm sorry, I'm too busy.

steps.speaker: Caroline
steps.text: That's a shame.

steps.player: Bye.

steps.speaker: Caroline
steps.text: Bye.

starting-off-talking-to-caroline-again.speaker: Caroline
starting-off-talking-to-caroline-again.text: Brave [player name], have you any news about my son and his father?

starting-off-talking-to-caroline-again.player: I'm working on it now Caroline.

starting-off-talking-to-caroline-again.speaker: Caroline
starting-off-talking-to-caroline-again.text: Please bring them back safe and sound.

talking-to-holgart.player: I would like a ride on your boat to the fishing platform.

talking-to-holgart.speaker: Holgart
talking-to-holgart.text: I'm afraid it isn't sea worthy, it's full of holes. To fill the holes I'll need some swamp paste.

talking-to-holgart.speaker: Holgart
talking-to-holgart.text: Yes, swamp tar mixed with flour and heated over a fire.
If the player already has one swamp paste in their inventory:

steps.speaker: Holgart
steps.text: In fact, unless me nose be mistaken, you've got some in yer pack.

steps.player: Oh yes, I forgot about that stuff. Can you use it?

steps.speaker: Holgart
steps.text: Aye, that be perfect.
You give Holgart the swamp paste.
Cutscene starts, focusing on Holgart fixing the boat.

steps.speaker: Holgart
steps.text: Right me hearty. Let's get this boat fixed.

steps.speaker: Holgart
steps.text: Huzzah! We've fixed the leaky old tub.

talking-to-holgart.text: If the player does not have swamp tar:

steps.player: Where can I find swamp tar?

steps.speaker: Holgart
steps.text: Unfortunately the only supply of swamp tar is in the swamps below Lumbridge. It's too far for an old man like me to travel.

steps.speaker: Holgart
steps.text: If you make me some swamp paste I'll give you a ride in my boat.

steps.player: I'll see what I can do.

talking-to-holgart-talking-to-holgart-ag.speaker: Holgart
talking-to-holgart-talking-to-holgart-ag.text: Hello m'hearty. Did you manage to make some swamp paste?
If the player does not have swamp tar:

steps.player: I'm afraid not.

steps.speaker: Holgart
steps.text: It's simply swamp tar mixed with flour heated over a fire. Unfortunately the only supply of swamp tar is in the swamps below Lumbridge.

steps.speaker: Holgart
steps.text: I can't fix my row boat without it.

steps.player: Ok, I'll try to find some.

talking-to-holgart-talking-to-holgart-ag.text: If the player has swamp tar:

steps.player: Yes, I have some here.

steps.text: Cutscene starts, focusing on Holgart fixing the boat.

steps.speaker: Holgart
steps.text: Right me hearty. Let's get this boat fixed.

steps.speaker: Holgart
steps.text: Huzzah! We've fixed the leaky old tub.

talking-to-holgart-talking-to-holgart-af.speaker: Holgart
talking-to-holgart-talking-to-holgart-af.text: Hello again land lover. There's some strange goings on, on that platform, I tell you.

steps.player: Will you take me there?

steps.speaker: Holgart
steps.text: Of course m'hearty. If that's what you want.
You arrive at the fishing platform.

steps.player: I'm keeping away from there.

steps.speaker: Holgart
steps.text: Fair enough m'hearty.

at-the-fishing-platform-talking-to-holga.speaker: Holgart
at-the-fishing-platform-talking-to-holga.text: Have you had enough of this place yet? It's really starting to scare me.

options.text: No, I'm going to stay a while.

steps.player: No, I'm going to stay a while.

steps.speaker: Holgart
steps.text: Okay... you're the boss.

steps.player: Okay, let's go back.

steps.speaker: Holgart
steps.text: Okay m'hearty, jump on.
Holgart takes the player back to Witchaven.

at-the-fishing-platform-taking-a-sea-slu.text: You pick up the sea slug.
It sinks its teeth deep into your hand.

at-the-fishing-platform-talking-to-baile.speaker: Bailey
at-the-fishing-platform-talking-to-baile.text: What? Who are you? Come inside quickly!

at-the-fishing-platform-talking-to-baile.player: I'm trying to find out what happened to a boy named Kennith.

at-the-fishing-platform-talking-to-baile.speaker: Bailey
at-the-fishing-platform-talking-to-baile.text: Oh you mean Kent's son. He's around somewhere, probably hiding if he knows what's good for him.

at-the-fishing-platform-talking-to-baile.player: Hiding from what? What's got you so frightened?

at-the-fishing-platform-talking-to-baile.speaker: Bailey
at-the-fishing-platform-talking-to-baile.text: Haven't you seen all those things out there?

at-the-fishing-platform-talking-to-baile.speaker: Bailey
at-the-fishing-platform-talking-to-baile.text: It all began about a week ago. We pulled up a haul of deep sea flatfish. Mixed in with them we found those slug things, but thought nothing of it.

at-the-fishing-platform-talking-to-baile.speaker: Bailey
at-the-fishing-platform-talking-to-baile.text: Not long after that my friends began to change, now they spend all day pulling in hauls of fish, only to throw back the fish and keep those nasty sea slugs.

at-the-fishing-platform-talking-to-baile.speaker: Bailey
at-the-fishing-platform-talking-to-baile.text: What am I supposed to do with those? I haven't figured out how to kill one yet, if I put them near the stove they squirm and jump away.

at-the-fishing-platform-talking-to-baile.player: I doubt they would taste too good.

at-the-fishing-platform-talking-to-baile.speaker: Bailey
at-the-fishing-platform-talking-to-baile.text: This is no time for humour.

at-the-fishing-platform-talking-to-baile.player: I'm sorry, I didn't mean to upset you.

at-the-fishing-platform-talking-to-baile.speaker: Bailey
at-the-fishing-platform-talking-to-baile.text: That's okay. I just can't shake the feeling that this is the start of something... Terrible.

at-the-fishing-platform-talking-to-kenni.speaker: Kennith
at-the-fishing-platform-talking-to-kenni.text: He went to get help days ago.

at-the-fishing-platform-talking-to-kenni.speaker: Kennith
at-the-fishing-platform-talking-to-kenni.text: The nasty fishermen tried to throw me and daddy into the sea. So he told me to hide here.

at-the-fishing-platform-talking-to-kenni.player: That's good advice, you stay here and I'll go try and find your father.

at-the-fishing-platform-subsequent-dialo.text: If the player kicks the loose panel near Kennith:

steps.text: You kick the loose panel.
But nothing interesting happens.

talking-to-holgart-after-talking-to-kenn.player: Holgart, something strange is going on here.

talking-to-holgart-after-talking-to-kenn.speaker: Holgart
talking-to-holgart-after-talking-to-kenn.text: You're telling me, none of the sailors seem to remember who I am.

talking-to-holgart-after-talking-to-kenn.player: Apparently Kennith's father left for help a couple of days ago.

talking-to-holgart-after-talking-to-kenn.speaker: Holgart
talking-to-holgart-after-talking-to-kenn.text: That's a worry, no-one's heard from him on shore. Come on, we'd better go look for him.
You arrive on a small island.

at-the-shipwreck-island-talking-to-holga.speaker: Holgart
at-the-shipwreck-island-talking-to-holga.text: Someway off mainland still. You'd better see if me old matey's okay.

at-the-shipwreck-island-talking-to-kent.speaker: Kent
at-the-shipwreck-island-talking-to-kent.text: Oh thank Saradomin! I thought I'd be left out here forever.

at-the-shipwreck-island-talking-to-kent.player: Your wife sent me out to find you and your boy. Kennith's fine by the way, he's on the platform.

at-the-shipwreck-island-talking-to-kent.speaker: Kent
at-the-shipwreck-island-talking-to-kent.text: I knew the row boat wasn't sea worthy. I couldn't risk bringing him along but you must get him off that platform.

at-the-shipwreck-island-talking-to-kent.speaker: Kent
at-the-shipwreck-island-talking-to-kent.text: Five days ago we pulled in a huge catch. As well as fish we caught small slug like creatures, hundreds of them.

at-the-shipwreck-island-talking-to-kent.speaker: Kent
at-the-shipwreck-island-talking-to-kent.text: That's when the fishermen began to act strange.

at-the-shipwreck-island-talking-to-kent.speaker: Kent
at-the-shipwreck-island-talking-to-kent.text: It was the sea slugs, they attach themselves to your body and somehow take over the mind of the carrier.

at-the-shipwreck-island-talking-to-kent.speaker: Kent
at-the-shipwreck-island-talking-to-kent.text: I told Kennith to hide until I returned but I was washed up here.

at-the-shipwreck-island-talking-to-kent.speaker: Kent
at-the-shipwreck-island-talking-to-kent.text: Please go back and get my boy, you can send help for me later.
Kent notices a sea slug in your torso.
He pulls a sea slug from under your top.

at-the-shipwreck-island-talking-to-kent.speaker: Kent
at-the-shipwreck-island-talking-to-kent.text: A few more minutes and that thing would have full control of your body.

at-the-shipwreck-island-subsequent-dialo.speaker: Kent
at-the-shipwreck-island-subsequent-dialo.text: Oh my, I must get back to shore.

at-the-shipwreck-island-talking-to-holga.player: We'd better get back to the platform so we can see what's going on.

at-the-shipwreck-island-talking-to-holga.speaker: Holgart
at-the-shipwreck-island-talking-to-holga.text: You're right. It all sounds pretty creepy.
You arrive at the fishing platform.

rescuing-kennith-talking-to-bailey.speaker: Bailey
rescuing-kennith-talking-to-bailey.text: Oh, thank the gods it's you. They've all gone mad I tell you, one of the fishermen tried to throw me into the sea!

rescuing-kennith-talking-to-bailey.player: They're all being controlled by the sea slugs.
I need to get Kennith off this platform, but I can't get past the fishermen.

rescuing-kennith-talking-to-bailey.speaker: Bailey
rescuing-kennith-talking-to-bailey.text: The sea slugs are scared of heat, I figured that out when I tried to cook them.
If the player has no space in their inventory:

steps.text: Bailey gives you a torch.
The unlit torch is dropped to the ground.

rescuing-kennith-talking-to-bailey.text: If the player has one free space in their in their inventory:

steps.text: an unlit torch

steps.speaker: Bailey
steps.text: I doubt the fishermen will come near you if you can get this torch lit.

steps.speaker: Bailey
steps.text: The only problem is all the wood and flint are damp... I can't light a thing!

rescuing-kennith-talking-to-bailey.text: If the player loses their unlit torch:

steps.player: I've managed to lose my torch.

steps.speaker: Bailey
steps.text: That was silly, fortunately I have another. Here, take it.
an unlit torch

rescuing-kennith-talking-to-bailey-again.player: I'd better find a way to light this torch, and soon.

rescuing-kennith-interacting-with-the-it.text: If the player attempts to use the tinderbox on damp sticks:

steps.text: Nothing interesting happens.

rescuing-kennith-interacting-with-the-it.text: If the player attempts to use the tinderbox on an unlit torch:

steps.text: Your tinderbox is damp from the sea crossing. It won't light here.

rescuing-kennith-interacting-with-the-it.text: If the player lights a fire upstairs and uses damp sticks on the fire:

steps.text: You can't cook that.

rescuing-kennith-interacting-with-the-it.text: If the player rotates the crane upstairs:

steps.text: You rotate the crane around.

rescuing-kennith-making-a-fire.text: If the player uses the broken glass on the damp sticks:

steps.text: The player uses the broken glass to heat up the damp sticks.
a pair of dry sticks

rescuing-kennith-making-a-fire.text: If the player attempts to rub the dry sticks without level 30 Firemaking:

steps.text: You rub together the dry sticks but nothing happens.
You need a Firemaking level of 30 or above.

rescuing-kennith-making-a-fire.text: If the player attempts to rub the dry sticks with at least level 30 Firemaking:

steps.text: If the player gets the sticks but does not get a fire:
You rub together the dry sticks and the sticks smoke momentarily then die out.
If the player gets the sticks to start a fire:
If the player does not have an unlit torch (or has an unlit candle or lantern instead) in their inventory:
You rub together the dry sticks and the sticks catch alight.
The sticks smoke momentarily then die out.
If the player has an unlit torch in their inventory:
You rub together the dry sticks and the sticks catch alight.
You place the smoulding twigs to your torch.
Your torch lights.

rescuing-kennith-talking-to-bailey-with-.player: I've managed to light the torch.

rescuing-kennith-talking-to-bailey-with-.speaker: Bailey
rescuing-kennith-talking-to-bailey-with-.text: Well done traveller, you'd better get Kennith out of here soon.

rescuing-kennith-talking-to-bailey-with-.speaker: Bailey
rescuing-kennith-talking-to-bailey-with-.text: The fishermen are becoming stranger by the minute, and they keep pulling up those blasted sea slugs.

rescuing-kennith-talking-to-bailey-with-.player: Don't worry I'm working on it.

rescuing-kennith-talking-to-bailey-with-.speaker: Bailey
rescuing-kennith-talking-to-bailey-with-.text: Just be sure to watch your back. The fishermen seem to have taken notice of you.

rescuing-kennith-attempting-to-go-upstai.text: You attempt to climb up the ladder.
and smack you on the head with a fishing rod!

rescuing-kennith-talking-to-kennith.player: You'll be able to see him soon. First we need to get you back to land, come with me to the boat.

rescuing-kennith-talking-to-kennith.speaker: Kennith
rescuing-kennith-talking-to-kennith.text: I'm scared of those nasty sea slugs. I won't go near them.

rescuing-kennith-talking-to-kennith.player: Okay, you wait here and I'll go figure another way to get you out.

rescuing-kennith-using-the-lit-torch.text: If the player uses the lit torch on any sea slug:

steps.text: The sea slug curls up into its shell.

rescuing-kennith-using-the-lit-torch.text: If the player uses the lit torch on a possessed fisherman:

steps.text: The fisherman covers his face.
He seems afraid of your torch.

rescuing-kennith-using-the-lit-torch.text: If the player uses the lit torch on the ice cube:

steps.text: Nothing interesting happens.

freeing-kennith.text: If the player kicks the loose panel near Kennith after talking to Bailey:

steps.text: You kick the loose panel.
The wood is rotten and crumbles away...
leaving an opening big enough for Kennith to climb through.

freeing-kennith-talking-to-kennith-after.text: If there are sea slugs or fishermen nearby:

steps.text: He doesn't seem interested in talking.

freeing-kennith-talking-to-kennith-after.text: If there are no sea slugs or fishermen nearby:

steps.player: Kennith, I've made an opening in the wall. You can come out through there.

steps.speaker: Kennith
steps.text: Are there any sea slugs on the other side?

steps.player: Not one.
Kennith, I've made an opening in the wall. You can come out through there.

steps.speaker: Kennith
steps.text: Are there any sea slugs on the other side?

steps.player: Not one.

steps.speaker: Kennith
steps.text: How will I get downstairs?

steps.player: I'll figure that out in a moment.

steps.speaker: Kennith
steps.text: Ok, when you have I'll come out.

freeing-kennith-subsequent-dialogue-with.text: He doesn't seem interested in talking.

freeing-kennith-using-the-crane.text: If the player is too far away from the crane:

steps.text: I need to get closer to that.

freeing-kennith-using-the-crane.text: If the player is one tile from the crane:

steps.text: Kennith scrambles through the broken wall...
Down below, you see Holgart collect the boy from the crane and lead him away to safety.

freeing-kennith-talking-to-bailey-after-.speaker: Bailey
freeing-kennith-talking-to-bailey-after-.text: Hello again. I saw you managed to get Kennith off the platform. Well done. He wasn't safe around those slugs.

freeing-kennith-talking-to-bailey-after-.player: Are you going to come back with us?

freeing-kennith-talking-to-bailey-after-.speaker: Bailey
freeing-kennith-talking-to-bailey-after-.text: No, these fishermen are my friends, I'm sure they can be saved. I'm going to stay and try to get rid of all these slugs.

freeing-kennith-talking-to-bailey-after-.player: Do you have a way of removing the slugs once they've attached themselves to someone?

freeing-kennith-talking-to-bailey-after-.speaker: Bailey
freeing-kennith-talking-to-bailey-after-.text: Not yet but I'll keep working on it.

freeing-kennith-talking-to-bailey-after-.player: I only hope they stay confined to the fishing platform.

freeing-kennith-talking-to-bailey-after-.speaker: Bailey
freeing-kennith-talking-to-bailey-after-.text: Yes, I dread to think what would happen if they got to Witchaven nearby.

freeing-kennith-talking-to-bailey-after-.speaker: Bailey
freeing-kennith-talking-to-bailey-after-.text: I guess I'll just have to keep an eye on things here until a way of removing the slugs can be found.

freeing-kennith-talking-to-bailey-after-.player: You're braver than most. Take care of yourself Bailey.

freeing-kennith-talking-to-holgart.player: Did you get the kid back to shore?

freeing-kennith-talking-to-holgart.speaker: Holgart
freeing-kennith-talking-to-holgart.text: Yes, he's safe and sound with his parents. Your turn to return to land now adventurer.

freeing-kennith-talking-to-caroline.speaker: Caroline
freeing-kennith-talking-to-caroline.text: Kennith told me about the strange goings-on at the platform. I had no idea it was so serious.

freeing-kennith-talking-to-caroline.speaker: Caroline
freeing-kennith-talking-to-caroline.text: I could have lost my son and my husband if it wasn't for you.

freeing-kennith-talking-to-caroline.player: We found Kent stranded on an island.

freeing-kennith-talking-to-caroline.speaker: Caroline
freeing-kennith-talking-to-caroline.text: Yes, Holgart told me and sent a rescue party out. Kent's back home now, resting with Kennith. I don't think he'll be doing any fishing for a while.

freeing-kennith-talking-to-caroline.speaker: Caroline
freeing-kennith-talking-to-caroline.text: Here, take these Oyster pearls as a reward. They're worth quite a bit and can be used to make lethal crossbow bolts.

freeing-kennith-talking-to-caroline.speaker: Caroline
freeing-kennith-talking-to-caroline.text: Thank you. Take care of yourself [player name].

historical-dialogue.player: Hello there.

historical-dialogue.npc: Good day to you.

options.text: Do you know where the ship to Kourend is?

steps.player: Do you know where the ship to Kourend is?

steps.npc: Veos' ship? I think it's on the northern dock.

steps.player: See you later.

steps.npc: Welcome, adventurer. Are you looking for a sublime staff? I'm afraid a little issue with some ents means I don't have any battlestaffs for sale, but other than that, I'm sure I'll have what you need.

steps.player: I'll have a look.

steps.npc: Unfortunately, we had someone new handling the delivery and they accidently left the cart in the way of the ents. I think the ents must have then considered both the cart and its contents to be a gift for them.

steps.player: They stole them?

steps.npc: I wouldn't say stole. I just think they misunderstood why the cart had been left there.

steps.player: Could you not ask for them back?

steps.npc: I'm sure the courier tried, but I suspect the ents didn't really understand him.
Anyway, would you like to buy a staff?

steps.player: I'll have a look.
No thanks.

steps.npc: Tetamo, iknami! I hope you change your mind soon!

steps.player: No thanks.

steps.npc: Tetamo, iknami! I hope you change your mind soon!

pre-quest-attempting-to-climb-up-the-sta.speaker: Guard
pre-quest-attempting-to-climb-up-the-sta.text: Hey! Come out here. We need to talk!

pre-quest-talking-to-henryeta-carnillean.speaker: Henryeta Carnillean
pre-quest-talking-to-henryeta-carnillean.text: How could this happen? How? Will our pain never end?

pre-quest-talking-to-henryeta-carnillean.speaker: Henryeta Carnillean
pre-quest-talking-to-henryeta-carnillean.text: Leave me at once! I don't want to talk right now.

pre-quest-talking-to-philipe-carnillean.speaker: Philipe Carnillean
pre-quest-talking-to-philipe-carnillean.text: It's not fair! All the bad things keep happening to us! Why don't they happen to anyone else?

pre-quest-talking-to-philipe-carnillean.speaker: Philipe Carnillean
pre-quest-talking-to-philipe-carnillean.text: I shouldn't talk to you. You might be one of the bad people.

pre-quest-talking-to-claus-the-chef.speaker: Claus the Chef
pre-quest-talking-to-claus-the-chef.text: This poor family. I don't know how much more they can take.

pre-quest-talking-to-claus-the-chef.speaker: Claus the Chef
pre-quest-talking-to-claus-the-chef.text: Sorry, I shouldn't be talking to you about it.

a-death-in-the-family-talking-to-the-car.speaker: Guard
a-death-in-the-family-talking-to-the-car.text: Hey! I need to talk to you!

a-death-in-the-family-talking-to-the-car.prompt: Start the Secrets of the North quest?

steps.player: Me?

steps.speaker: Guard
steps.text: Yes, you. I have some questions.

steps.player: Okay...

steps.speaker: Guard
steps.text: You were recently hired by Sir Ceril Carnillean, correct?

steps.player: That's right... he wanted me to find some cultists that stole his armour.

steps.speaker: Guard
steps.text: And were you successful?
If the player opposed the cult during the quest Hazeel Cult:

steps.player: Of course.

steps.speaker: Guard
steps.text: And have you had any contact with the Carnilleans since your success?
If the player helped the cult during the quest Hazeel Cult:

steps.player: No.

steps.speaker: Guard
steps.text: And have you had any contact with the Carnilleans since your failure?

steps.player: Not really...
Sorry, I'm very confused. What's all this about?

steps.speaker: Guard
steps.text: An unthinkable crime has taken place, and as someone who has recently had contact with the Carnilleans, you are one of our suspects.

steps.player: A crime? What's happened?

steps.speaker: Guard
steps.text: Until I am satisfied that you were not involved, I can't say.

steps.player: Well then what do I need to do to convince you I wasn't?

steps.text: The guard leans in closer and whispers to you.

steps.speaker: Guard
steps.text: Sorry about all this. I'm pretty confident you had nothing to do with any of it, but I need to put on a good show for Lady Carnillean.

steps.player: Right...

steps.speaker: Guard
steps.text: Well I must say adventurer, that is quite the alibi. You clearly had no involvement in this horrific crime.

steps.player: Well I'm glad we could...

steps.speaker: Guard
steps.text: And what's that? You want to help us find the culprit? How generous of you!

steps.player: But I never said...

steps.text: The guard gives you a pleading look.

steps.player: sigh*
Of course! I would never sit by while criminals are on the loose! You will have all the help you need!

steps.speaker: Guard
steps.text: Excellent! Please join me upstairs when you're ready to begin.
The guard heads upstairs.

steps.player: What on Gielinor have I just agreed to?
Sorry, I need to get going.

steps.speaker: Guard
steps.text: But...

a-death-in-the-family-inspecting-sir-cer.speaker: Guard
a-death-in-the-family-inspecting-sir-cer.text: Let me run you through what happened before you start inspecting things.

a-death-in-the-family-talking-to-the-car.speaker: Guard
a-death-in-the-family-talking-to-the-car.text: I was hoping you could help work that out.

a-death-in-the-family-talking-to-the-car.player: Well I guess we should get started right away. What do we know so far?

a-death-in-the-family-talking-to-the-car.text: If the player opposed the cult:

steps.speaker: Guard
steps.text: It happened in the early hours of the morning. According to Lady Carnillean, Sir Ceril heard a noise coming from Butler Jones' old room. He got up to investigate.

steps.speaker: Guard
steps.text: After a few moments, she heard Sir Ceril shout something, followed by a scream. She went to see what was happening, and this is what she found.

steps.player: So no one else was in the room?

steps.speaker: Guard
steps.text: Not that she saw.

steps.player: Where was everyone else at this point?

steps.speaker: Guard
steps.text: I was the guard on duty last night. I was stationed out front as usual. Claus, the family chef, was down in the kitchen preparing an early breakfast for Sir Ceril.

steps.speaker: Guard
steps.text: Young Philipe was in bed. He slept through the entire thing.

steps.player: Do we have any obvious suspects?

steps.speaker: Guard
steps.text: Jones is behind bars, but many of his fellow cultists are still at large. Perhaps this was an act of revenge on their part.

a-death-in-the-family-talking-to-the-car.text: If the player helped the cult:

steps.speaker: Guard
steps.text: It happened in the early hours of the morning. According to Lady Carnillean, Sir Ceril heard a noise coming from Butler Jones' room. He got up to investigate.

steps.speaker: Guard
steps.text: After a few moments, she heard Sir Ceril shout something, followed by a scream. She went to see what was happening, and this is what she found.

steps.player: So no one else was in the room?

steps.speaker: Guard
steps.text: Not that she saw.

steps.player: Where was everyone else at this point?

steps.speaker: Guard
steps.text: I was the guard on duty last night. I was stationed out front as usual. Claus, the family chef, was down in the kitchen preparing an early breakfast for Sir Ceril.

steps.speaker: Guard
steps.text: Young Philipe was in bed. He slept through the entire thing. Jones himself was downstairs at the time, but he vanished before we could question him.

steps.player: Jones vanished?

steps.speaker: Guard
steps.text: Indeed. That, along with the murder occurring in his room, makes him a prime suspect.

steps.player: I see...
Apart from Jones, do we have any other suspects?

steps.speaker: Guard
steps.text: We also have those cultists that broke in a while back. Following his disappearance, we can't help but wonder if Jones might have been in league with them...

a-death-in-the-family-talking-to-the-car.speaker: Guard
a-death-in-the-family-talking-to-the-car.text: There's a few other things to note, but it's probably best if you have a look around the crime scene before we go any further.

a-death-in-the-family-talking-to-the-car.player: Good idea. I'll begin at once.

a-death-in-the-family-talking-to-the-car.speaker: Guard
a-death-in-the-family-talking-to-the-car.text: Are you done looking around the crime scene?

a-death-in-the-family-talking-to-the-car.speaker: Guard
a-death-in-the-family-talking-to-the-car.text: Not to worry. Take all the time you need.

a-death-in-the-family-talking-to-henryet.speaker: Henryeta Carnillean
a-death-in-the-family-talking-to-henryet.text: My dear husband... how could this happen? Will our pain never end?

a-death-in-the-family-talking-to-henryet.speaker: Henryeta Carnillean
a-death-in-the-family-talking-to-henryet.text: Please, leave me. I would mourn alone.

a-death-in-the-family-talking-to-philipe.speaker: Philipe Carnillean
a-death-in-the-family-talking-to-philipe.text: It's not fair! All the bad things keep happening to us! Why don't they happen to anyone else?

a-death-in-the-family-talking-to-philipe.speaker: Philipe Carnillean
a-death-in-the-family-talking-to-philipe.text: Then you're useless! Leave me alone!

a-death-in-the-family-talking-to-claus-t.speaker: Claus the Chef
a-death-in-the-family-talking-to-claus-t.text: I still don't believe it. This poor family. I don't know how much more they can take.

a-death-in-the-family-inspecting-sir-cer.text: The body is that of Sir Ceril Carnillean. He's lying face down on the floor, with the cause of death seemingly a single stab wound to the back. The wound looks to have been caused by an unusually thin blade.
If this is the third piece of evidence observed:

a-death-in-the-family-inspecting-the-bro.text: The window has been broken. The glass on the floor suggests it was broken from the outside.
If this is the third piece of evidence observed:

a-death-in-the-family-knocking-at-the-fa.text: If the player opposed the cult:

steps.text: The wall looks to have been slightly damaged. You knock on it. It sounds like there's a hollow space on the other side.

a-death-in-the-family-knocking-at-the-fa.text: If the player helped the cult:

steps.text: The false wall looks to have been slightly damaged.

a-death-in-the-family-inspecting-the-che.text: If the player opposed the cult:

steps.text: Someone has forced the chest open, breaking it in the process. If anything was in the chest, it's now gone.

a-death-in-the-family-inspecting-the-che.text: If the player helped the cult:

steps.text: Someone has forced the chest open, breaking it in the process.

steps.player: Hmm... was someone after Hazeel's restoration scroll?

a-death-in-the-family-inspecting-the-che.text: If this is the third piece of evidence observed:

a-death-in-the-family-talking-to-the-car.speaker: Guard
a-death-in-the-family-talking-to-the-car.text: Are you done looking around the crime scene?

options.condition: If the player has gone through the three options:

steps.player: I think that's everything.

steps.speaker: Guard
steps.text: So someone broke in from the outside, something may have been stolen from a hidden room upstairs, and Sir Ceril was stabbed in the back. All useful information, but none of it gives us anything definitive.

steps.speaker: Guard
steps.text: Thankfully, we do have one more lead that might hold some promise. Take a look at this.
The guard shows you an amulet with a skull on it.

steps.speaker: Guard
steps.text: I found this by the window. That skull on it is the symbol of the Khazard Army. There's also a name engraved into the back: 'Evelot'.

steps.player: Sounds like we need to find this Evelot and see what they know.

steps.speaker: Guard
steps.text: While I agree, my superiors won't be happy if I open an investigation into a member of the Khazard Army. I think you'll need to handle this bit yourself. Besides, I need to take care of matters here.

steps.player: Right...

steps.speaker: Guard
steps.text: If you want a place to start, I'd suggest the bar at the Fight Arena. Places like that are always good for gathering information.

steps.player: Good idea.

options.text: Should we not look into the Hazeel Cult as well?

steps.player: Should we not look into the Hazeel Cult as well?

steps.speaker: Guard
steps.text: They're definitely top suspects, but we don't have any actual evidence linking them to the crime. Until we do, this Evelot lead seems like a safer bet.

steps.player: I see. Fair enough.

options.text: Why can't you investigate the Khazard Army yourself?

steps.player: Why can't you investigate the Khazard Army yourself?

steps.speaker: Guard
steps.text: The matter is... complicated. On paper, General Khazard is an upstanding citizen, and his private army operates with approval from the crown. King Lathas even hired them for some peacekeeping once.

steps.player: But?

steps.speaker: Guard
steps.text: It's fair to say that Khazard is a bit... controversial. His war with the gnomes is creating more than a few problems for Kandarin, not to mention the rumours about the people fighting in his arena...
If Song of the Elves has not been completed:

steps.speaker: Guard
steps.text: For now though, King Lathas considers him a valuable ally. As such, it is preferred we maintain a good relationship with him and his army.
If Song of the Elves has been completed:

steps.speaker: Guard
steps.text: Unlike his predecessor, King Thoros is keen to slowly distance himself from Khazard. However, in the meantime, we have to maintain a good relationship with him and his army.

steps.player: And that's where I come in. I understand.

options.text: Don't you think I should try and find Jones?
options.condition: If the player helped the cult:

steps.speaker: Guard
steps.text: No need to worry. Some of our best are already out searching for him. I'm sure he won't get far.

steps.player: Maybe I could help them?

steps.speaker: Guard
steps.text: Your concern is appreciated, but they'll be fine. You're better off focusing on Evelot.

steps.player: If you're sure.
I'd better get going.

options.text: The window was broken from the outside.
The window was broken from the outside.

steps.player: The window was broken from the outside.

steps.speaker: Guard
steps.text: I didn't see anyone leave or enter from the front of the building last night, so that makes sense. The window must have been their way in and out.

steps.player: So it was likely someone who didn't have any other way to access the mansion. We can probably rule out staff and family members.

steps.speaker: Guard
steps.text: Agreed. Did you find anything else?

steps.player: Ceril was stabbed from behind.

steps.speaker: Guard
steps.text: So he wasn't facing his killer. But if that were the case, why did Lady Carnillean say she heard him shouting? Surely he'd have been facing whoever he was shouting at.

steps.player: That could mean there were two people in the room with him.

steps.speaker: Guard
steps.text: Let's hope not. One killer on the loose is bad enough.

steps.player: There's something else as well. It looks like the blade used to kill him was unusually thin.

steps.speaker: Guard
steps.text: Really? How odd. I'll make a note to look into that once we're done here.

steps.speaker: Guard
steps.text: Anyway, did you find anything else?

options.text: A hidden room above us was broken into.

steps.player: A hidden room above us was broken into.

steps.speaker: Guard
steps.text: A hidden room? What hidden room?

steps.player: It looks like it can only be accessed from in here. It doesn't seem like anyone has been in there for some time.

steps.speaker: Guard
steps.text: What's in this room?

steps.player: There's a chest up there that's been broken into.

steps.speaker: Guard
steps.text: Do you think they took anything from it?
If the player opposed the cult:

steps.player: I'm not sure.

steps.text: If the player helped the cult:

steps.player: I don't know. I don't think so.

steps.speaker: Guard
steps.text: This raises more questions than answers. Was this actually a murder, or just a robbery gone wrong? And how was there a hidden room that we knew nothing about?

steps.speaker: Guard
steps.text: Did you find anything else?

steps.player: I have to go.

steps.speaker: Guard
steps.text: Oh. Well don't be gone too long. We have work to do here.

a-death-in-the-family-talking-to-the-car.speaker: Guard
a-death-in-the-family-talking-to-the-car.text: So did you find anything of note in your investigation?

options.text: I think I've gone over everything.

steps.player: I think I've gone over everything.

steps.speaker: Guard
steps.text: So someone broke in from the outside, something may have been stolen from a hidden room upstairs, and Sir Ceril was stabbed in the back. All useful information, but none of it gives us anything definitive.

options.text: The window was broken from the outside.
A hidden room above us was broken into.

a-death-in-the-family-talking-to-the-car.speaker: Guard
a-death-in-the-family-talking-to-the-car.text: So someone broke in from the outside, something may have been stolen from a hidden room upstairs, and Sir Ceril was stabbed in the back. All useful information, but none of it gives us anything definitive.

a-death-in-the-family-talking-to-the-car.speaker: Guard
a-death-in-the-family-talking-to-the-car.text: Hello there. You should head over to the bar at the Fight Arena and see what you can learn about this Evelot.

options.text: Should we not look into the Hazeel Cult as well?
Why can't you investigate the Khazard Army yourself?
Don't you think I should try and find Jones?

on-the-trail-talking-to-the-khazard-barm.speaker: Khazard Barman
on-the-trail-talking-to-the-khazard-barm.text: Hi, what can I get you? We have a range of quality brews.

options.text: I'd like a Khali Brew please.
Do you know anyone called Evelot?

steps.player: Do you know anyone called Evelot?

steps.speaker: Khazard Barman
steps.text: Why do you ask?

steps.player: I'm looking for them.

steps.speaker: Khazard Barman
steps.text: It's not my place to go giving out information to people I don't know.

steps.player: Are you sure? I could make it worth your while.

steps.speaker: Khazard Barman
steps.text: Are you suggesting that I'm the kind of person that would besmirch my honour for a measly bribe?

steps.player: Er...

steps.speaker: Khazard Barman
steps.text: Because you'd be absolutely right! 100 coins will pay for the information you desire.
If the player has 100 coins:

steps.player: Alright, here's the money.

steps.speaker: Khazard Barman
steps.text: Thank you very much.

steps.player: So what can you tell me about Evelot?

steps.speaker: Khazard Barman
steps.text: So oddly enough, she was in here not that long ago, but just before you arrived, one of the lads came in and spoke to her.

steps.player: To say what?

steps.speaker: Khazard Barman
steps.text: No idea, but she left in quite the hurry afterwards. Perhaps you'll be able to pick up her trail if you look around outside.

steps.player: I might just do that. Thanks for the information.

steps.speaker: Khazard Barman
steps.text: Fancy a drink before you go?
If the player does not have 100 coins:

steps.player: Alright, I'll come back when I have the money.

steps.speaker: Khazard Barman
steps.text: Fancy a drink before you go?

on-the-trail-talking-to-the-khazard-barm.speaker: Khazard Barman
on-the-trail-talking-to-the-khazard-barm.text: Hi, what can I get you? We have a range of quality brews.

options.text: I'd like a Khali Brew please.
Do you know anyone called Evelot?

steps.player: Do you know anyone called Evelot?

steps.text: If the player does not have 100 coins:

steps.speaker: Khazard Barman
steps.text: Like I said, 100 coins will pay for the information you desire.

steps.player: Alright, I'll come back when I have the money.

steps.speaker: Khazard Barman
steps.text: Fancy a drink before you go?
If the player has 100 coins:

steps.player: Alright, here's the money.

options.text: I'd like a Khali Brew please.
Do you know anyone called Evelot?

steps.player: Do you know anyone called Evelot?

steps.player: To say what?

steps.speaker: Khazard Barman
steps.text: No idea, but she left in quite the hurry afterwards. Perhaps you'll be able to pick up her trail if you look around outside.

steps.player: I might just do that. Thanks for the information.

steps.text: Fancy a drink before you go?

options.text: I'd like a Khali Brew please.
Do you know anyone called Evelot?

steps.player: Do you know anyone called Evelot?

steps.speaker: Khazard Barman
steps.text: Like I told you, she left earlier in quite a hurry. Perhaps you'll be able to pick up her trail if you look around outside.

steps.player: Ah yes, thanks again for the information.

steps.speaker: Khazard Barman
