steps.speaker: King Roald
steps.text: I'm afraid that's only half the reward certificate. You'll have to get the other half and join them together if you want to claim the reward.

finishing-up-talking-to-king-roald-with-.speaker: King Roald
finishing-up-talking-to-king-roald-with-.text: Yes, citizen. Do you need something?

options.text: I'm here about the Shield of Arrav.

steps.player: I'm here about the Shield of Arrav.

steps.text: You show the certificate to the king.

steps.speaker: King Roald
steps.text: My goodness! This is for the reward offered by my father many years ago! I never thought I would live to see the day when someone came forward to claim it!

steps.player: It was quite the undertaking. I wouldn't have been able to do it without help from a fellow adventurer.

steps.speaker: King Roald
steps.text: Well, in that case, it's only right that you both be rewarded. I will grant half of the reward to you and half to your companion. That means 600 coins for you. Enjoy it! You've very much earned it!
Congratulations! Quest complete!

options.text: I've heard you've got some cool treasures in this place.

post-quest-talking-to-straven-as-a-membe.player: I've heard you've got some cool treasures in this place.

post-quest-talking-to-straven-as-a-membe.speaker: Straven
post-quest-talking-to-straven-as-a-membe.text: Oh yeah, we've all stolen some stuff in our time. Our candlesticks down here, for example, were quite a challenge to get out of the palace.

post-quest-talking-to-straven-as-a-membe.speaker: Straven
post-quest-talking-to-straven-as-a-membe.text: Once one of our most prized possessions.

post-quest-talking-to-straven-as-a-membe.speaker: Straven

post-quest-talking-to-straven-as-a-membe.player: Oh no! I'll be sure to keep an eye out for any of their members sneaking around.

options.text: Any suggestions for where I can go thieving?

steps.player: So I'm part of the gang now?

steps.speaker: Katrine
steps.text: You are, but don't make me regret it. In case you didn't hear, someone recently stole something very important from us. We need to be more careful about who we let in.

options.text: Who are all those people in there?
Teach me to be a top class criminal!
I'm in search of a quest.

steps.text: Let me think actually...

options.text: Do you have anything to trade?

shared-starting-finding-the-shield-of-ar.player: Aha! 'The Shield of Arrav'! Exactly what I was looking for.

shared-starting-finding-the-shield-of-ar.text: You take the book from the bookcase.

shared-starting-talking-to-reldo-after-r.player: Ok. I've read the book. Do you know where I can find the Phoenix Gang?

shared-starting-talking-to-reldo-after-r.speaker: Reldo
shared-starting-talking-to-reldo-after-r.text: No, I don't. I think I know someone who might, however.

shared-starting-talking-to-reldo-after-r.speaker: Reldo
shared-starting-talking-to-reldo-after-r.text: If I were you I would talk to Baraek, the fur trader in the market place. I've heard he has connections with the Phoenix Gang.

options.text: Is there anything down this alleyway?

steps.player: Is there anything down this alleyway?

steps.speaker: Charlie the Tramp
steps.text: Funny you should mention that...there is actually.

steps.speaker: Charlie the Tramp
steps.text: The ruthless and notorious criminal gang known as the Black Arm Gang have their headquarters down there.
If the player's combat level is less than 10.
Before starting this quest, be aware that you combat level is lower than the recommended level of 10.

steps.prompt: Start the Shield of Arrav quest?

steps.player: Do you think they would let me join?

steps.speaker: Charlie the Tramp
steps.text: You never know. You'll find a lady down there called Katrine. Speak to her.

steps.speaker: Charlie the Tramp
steps.text: But don't upset her, she's pretty dangerous.

steps.player: Thanks for the warning!

steps.speaker: Charlie the Tramp
steps.text: Don't worry about it.

black-arm-gang-talking-to-katrine.speaker: Katrine
black-arm-gang-talking-to-katrine.text: It's a private business. Can I help you at all?

options.text: I've heard you're the Black Arm Gang

steps.player: I've heard you're the Black Arm Gang.

steps.speaker: Katrine
steps.text: Who told you that?

options.text: I'd rather not reveal my sources.

steps.player: I'd rather not reveal my sources.

steps.speaker: Katrine
steps.text: Yes, I can understand that. So what do you want with us?

options.text: I want to become a member of your gang.

steps.player: I want to become a member of your gang.

steps.speaker: Katrine
steps.text: How unusual.

steps.speaker: Katrine
steps.text: Normally we recruit for our gang by watching local thugs and thieves in action. People don't normally waltz in here saying 'hello, can I play'.

steps.speaker: Katrine
steps.text: How can I be sure you can be trusted?

options.text: Well, you can give me a try can't you?

steps.player: Well, you can give me a try can't you?

steps.speaker: Katrine
steps.text: I'm not so sure.

steps.speaker: Katrine
steps.text: Thinking about it... I may have a solution actually.

steps.speaker: Katrine
steps.text: Our rival gang - the Phoenix Gang - has a weapons stash a little east of here.

steps.speaker: Katrine
steps.text: We're fresh out of crossbows, so if you could steal a couple of crossbows for us it would be very much appreciated.

steps.speaker: Katrine
steps.text: Then I'll be happy to call you a Black Arm.

steps.player: Sounds simple enough. Any particular reason you need two of them?

steps.speaker: Katrine
steps.text: I have an idea for framing a local merchant who is refusing to pay our, very reasonable, 'keep-your-life-pleasant' insurance rates. I need two phoenix crossbows; one to kill somebody important with and the other to

steps.speaker: Katrine
steps.text: hide in the merchant's house where the local law can find it! When they find it, they'll suspect him of murdering the target for the Phoenix Gang and, hopefully, arrest the whole gang! Leaving us as the only

steps.speaker: Katrine
steps.text: thieves gang in Varrock! Brilliant, eh?

steps.player: Yeah, brilliant. So who are you planning to murder?

steps.speaker: Katrine
steps.text: I haven't decided yet, but it'll need to be somebody important. Say, why are you being so nosey? You aren't with the law are you?

steps.player: No, no! Just curious.

steps.speaker: Katrine
steps.text: You'd better just keep your mouth shut about this plan, or I'll make sure it stays shut for you. Now, are you going to go get those crossbows or not?

steps.player: Ok, no problem.

steps.speaker: Katrine
steps.text: Great! You'll find the Phoenix gang's weapon stash just next to a temple, due east of here.

options.text: Sounds a little tricky. Got anything easier?

steps.player: Sounds a little tricky...
Got anything easier?

steps.speaker: Katrine
steps.text: If you're not up to a little bit of danger I don't think you've got anything to offer our gang.

options.text: Well, people tell me I have an honest face.

steps.player: Well, people tell me I have an honest face!

steps.speaker: Katrine
steps.text: ... How unusual. Someone honest wanting to join a gang of thieves. Excuse me if I remain unconvinced.
Continues from "Thinking about it... I may have a solution actually."

options.text: I want some hints for becoming a thief.

steps.player: I want some hints for becoming a thief.

steps.speaker: Katrine
steps.text: Well, I'm sorry luv, I'm not giving away any of my secrets.

steps.speaker: Katrine
steps.text: Not to people who ain't Black Arm members anyway.

options.text: I'm looking for the door out of here.

steps.player: I'm looking for the door out of here.

steps.text: Katrine groans.

steps.speaker: Katrine
steps.text: Try...the one you just came in?

options.text: It was Charlie, the tramp outside.

steps.player: It was Charlie, the tramp outside.

steps.speaker: Katrine
steps.text: Is that guy still out there? He's getting to be a nuisance. Remind me to send someone to kill him.

steps.speaker: Katrine
steps.text: So now you've found us, what do you want?
Continues after "Yes, I can understand that. So what do you want with us?"

options.text: Everyone knows - it's no great secret.

steps.player: Everyone knows. It's no great secret.

steps.speaker: Katrine
steps.text: I thought we were safe back here!

steps.player: Oh no, not at all... It's so obvious! Even the town guard have caught on...

steps.speaker: Katrine
steps.text: Wow! We MUST be obvious! I guess they'll be expecting bribes again soon in that case.

steps.speaker: Katrine
steps.text: Thanks for the information.

steps.speaker: Katrine
steps.text: Is there anything else you want to tell me?
Continues after "Yes, I can understand that. So what do you want with us?"

steps.player: What sort of business?

steps.speaker: Katrine
steps.text: A small, family business. We give financial advice to other companies.

options.text: I'm looking for fame and riches.

steps.player: I'm looking for fame and riches.

steps.speaker: Katrine
steps.text: And you expect to find it up the back streets of Varrock?

black-arm-gang-attempting-to-enter-the-b.text: This door seems to be locked from the inside.

options.text: Any idea where the Phoenix gang hideout is?

steps.player: Any idea where the Phoenix gang hideout is?

steps.speaker: Charlie the Tramp
steps.text: Sure. I know everything there is to know about this city. I'd be happy to tell you for 10 gold.

steps.player: Ok, that sounds fair.

steps.text: If the player doesn't have 10 gold.
If the player has 10 gold.
10 gold

steps.speaker: Charlie the Tramp
steps.text: Great, thanks.

steps.player: So where is the hideout then?

steps.speaker: Charlie the Tramp
steps.text: Now listen closely; to get to the Phoenix hideout, walk south from here and take the first road to the east. It's the one with the Blue moon pub on the corner. Take the first alley leading south off of that road and you'll

steps.speaker: Charlie the Tramp
steps.text: find the hideout at the end of that alley. It's called the VTAM corporation.

steps.player: VTAM, got it.

options.text: Don't worry, I'll find it myself.

steps.player: Don't worry, I'll find it myself.

steps.speaker: Charlie the Tramp
steps.text: Well you know where to find me if you get lost!

options.text: 10 gold? That's too much, I'll give you 5.

steps.player: 10 gold? That's too much, I'll give you 5.

steps.speaker: Charlie the Tramp
steps.text: I guess that'll have to do then.
If the player doesn't have 5 gold.
If the player has 5 gold.
5 gold

steps.speaker: Charlie the Tramp
steps.text: Great, thanks.

steps.player: So where is the hideout then?

steps.speaker: Charlie the Tramp
steps.text: If you pay me the other 5 gold, I'll tell you.

options.text: You theiving gutter-scum! You'd better watch your back!

steps.player: You theiving gutter-scum! You'd better watch your back!

steps.speaker: Charlie the Tramp
steps.text: Yeah, sure, whatever. You don't frighten me, pal.

options.text: That's not fair, but I guess I don't have a choice.

steps.player: That's not fair, but I guess I don't have a choice.

steps.text: If the player doesn't have 5 gold.
If the player has 5 gold.
5 gold

steps.speaker: Charlie the Tramp
steps.text: Great, thanks.

steps.player: So where is the hideout then?

steps.text: Continues above from "Now listen closely"

options.text: I think I know where the hideout is, but I can't get inside.

steps.player: I think I know where the hideout is, but I can't get inside. Any ideas?

steps.speaker: Charlie the Tramp
steps.text: Hmmm. I dunno.

steps.speaker: Charlie the Tramp
steps.text: Your best bet would probably be to find someone else... Someone who ISN'T a member of the Black Arm Gang, and get them to infiltrate the ranks of the Phoenix Gang for you.

steps.player: Ok. Good plan!

steps.speaker: Charlie the Tramp
steps.text: I'm not just a pretty face!

steps.player: Like who?

steps.speaker: Charlie the Tramp
steps.text: There's plenty of other adventurers about besides yourself. I'm sure if you asked one of them nicely they would help you.

steps.player: No, I haven't yet found them.

steps.speaker: Katrine
steps.text: I need two crossbows stolen from the Phoenix Gang weapons stash, which if you head east for a bit, is a building on the south side of the road.

steps.speaker: Katrine
steps.text: Come back when you got 'em.

two Phoenix crossbows

options.text: Who are all those people in there?

steps.player: Who are all those people in there?

steps.speaker: Katrine
steps.text: They're just various rogues and thieves.

steps.player: They don't say a lot...

steps.speaker: Katrine
steps.text: Nope.

options.text: Teach me to be a top class criminal!

steps.player: Teach me to be a top class criminal.

steps.speaker: Katrine
steps.text: Teach yourself.

options.text: Can you tell me where I can find the Phoenix Gang?

steps.player: Can you tell me where I can find the Phoenix Gang?

steps.speaker: Baraek
steps.text: Sh sh sh, not so loud! You don't want to get me in trouble!

steps.player: So DO you know where they are?

steps.speaker: Baraek
steps.text: I may do.

steps.speaker: Baraek
steps.text: But I don't want to get into trouble for revealing their hideout.

steps.speaker: Baraek
steps.text: Of course, if I was, say 20 gold coins richer I may happen to be more inclined to take that sort of risk...

steps.player: Okay. Have 20 gold coins.

steps.text: If the player has 20 coins.
20 coins

steps.speaker: Baraek
steps.text: Ok, to get to the gang hideout, enter Varrock through the south gate. Then, if you take the first turning east, somewhere along there is an alleyway to the south. The door at the end of there is the entrance to the Phoenix

steps.speaker: Baraek
steps.text: Gang. They're operating there under the name of the VTAM Corporation. Be careful. The Phoenixes ain't the types to be messed about.

steps.player: Thanks!

steps.text: If the player doesn't have 20 coins.

steps.player: Uh....oops. My mistake. I don't have 20 coins. Silly me.

options.text: No, I don't like things like bribery.

steps.speaker: Baraek
steps.text: Heh. If you wanna deal with the Phoenix Gang they're involved in much worse than a bit of bribery.

options.text: Yes. I'd like to be 20 gold coins richer too.

steps.player: Yes. I'd like to be 20 gold coins richer.

options.text: Can you sell me some furs?

phoenix-gang-talking-to-straven.speaker: Straven
phoenix-gang-talking-to-straven.text: Hey! You can't go in there. Only authorised personnel of the VTAM Corporation are allowed beyond this point.

steps.player: I know who you are!

steps.speaker: Straven
steps.text: Really.

steps.speaker: Straven
steps.text: Well?

steps.speaker: Straven
steps.text: Who are we then?

steps.player: This is the headquarters of the Phoenix Gang, the most powerful crime syndicate this city has ever seen!

steps.speaker: Straven
steps.text: No, this is a legitimate business run by legitimate businessmen.

steps.speaker: Straven
steps.text: Supposing we were this crime gang however, what would you want with us?

options.text: I'd like to offer you my services.

steps.player: I'd like to offer you my services.

steps.speaker: Straven
steps.text: You mean you'd like to join the Phoenix Gang?

steps.speaker: Straven
steps.text: Well, obviously I can't speak for them, but the Phoenix Gang doesn't let people join just like that.

steps.speaker: Straven
steps.text: You can't be too careful, you understand.

steps.speaker: Straven
steps.text: Generally someone has to prove their loyalty before they can join.

steps.player: How would I go about doing that?

steps.speaker: Straven
steps.text: Obviously, I would have no idea about that.

steps.speaker: Straven
steps.text: Although having said that, a rival gang of ours, er, theirs, called the Black Arm Gang is supposedly meeting a contact from Port Sarim today in the Blue Moon Inn.

steps.speaker: Straven
steps.text: The Blue Moon Inn is just by the south entrance to this city, and supposedly the name of the contact is Jonny the Beard.

steps.speaker: Straven
steps.text: OBVIOUSLY I know NOTHING about the dealings of the Phoenix Gang, but I bet if SOMEBODY were to kill him and bring back his intelligence report, they would be considered loyal enough to join.

steps.player: Ok, I'll get right on it.

options.text: I want nothing. I was just making sure you were them.

steps.player: I want nothing. I was just making sure you were them.

steps.speaker: Straven
steps.text: Well, then get lost and stop wasting my time.

steps.speaker: Straven
steps.text: ...if you know what's good for you.

options.text: How do I get a job with the VTAM corporation?

steps.player: How do I get a job with the VTAM corporation?

steps.speaker: Straven
steps.text: Get a copy of the Varrock Herald. If we have any positions right now, they'll be advertised in there.

steps.player: Why not?

steps.speaker: Straven
steps.text: Sorry. That's classified information.

phoenix-gang-attempting-to-enter-the-pho.text: Continues above from "Hey! You can't go in there."

phoenix-gang-talking-to-straven-after-ac.text: If the player doesn't have the intel report.

steps.player: I haven't managed to find the report yet...

steps.speaker: Straven
steps.text: You need to kill Jonny the Beard, who should be in the Blue Moon Inn.

steps.speaker: Straven
steps.text: ...I would guess. Not being a member of the Phoenix Gang and all.

phoenix-gang-talking-to-straven-after-ac.text: If the player has the intel report.

steps.player: I have the intelligence report!

steps.speaker: Straven
steps.text: Let's see it then.

steps.player: Let me go get it.

steps.speaker: Straven
steps.text: I'll wait here.

steps.speaker: Straven
steps.text: Yes. Yes, this is very good. Very well, then! You can join the Phoenix Gang! I am Straven, one of the gang leaders.

steps.player: Nice to meet you.

steps.text: intel report

steps.speaker: Straven
steps.text: You now have access to the inner sanctum of our subterranean hideout, and our weapons supply depot round the front of this building.

options.text: I've heard you've got some cool treasures in this place.

steps.player: I've heard you've got some cool treasures in this place...

steps.speaker: Straven
steps.text: Oh yeah, we've all stolen some stuff in our time. Those candlesticks down here, for example, were quite a challenge to get out of the palace.

steps.player: And the shield of Arrav? I heard you got that!

steps.speaker: Straven
steps.text: Woah... that's a blast from the past! We stole that years and years ago! We don't even have all the shield anymore.

steps.speaker: Straven
steps.text: About five years ago we had a massive fight in our gang and the shield got broken in half during that fight.

steps.speaker: Straven
steps.text: Shortly after that fight some gang members decided they didn't want to be part of our gang anymore. So they split off to form their own gang.

steps.speaker: Straven
steps.text: The Black Arm Gang.

steps.speaker: Straven
steps.text: On their way out they looted what treasures they could from us - which included one of the halves of the shield. We've been rivals with the Black Arms ever since.

options.text: Any suggestions for where I can go thieving?

steps.player: Any suggestions for where I can go thieving?

steps.speaker: Straven
steps.text: You can always try the marketplace in Ardougne. LOTS of opportunity there!

options.text: Where's the Black Arm Gang hideout?

steps.player: Where's the Black Arm Gang hideout? I wanna go sabotage 'em!

steps.speaker: Straven
steps.text: That would be a little tricky; their security is pretty good.

steps.speaker: Straven
steps.text: Not as good as ours, obviously.

steps.speaker: Straven
steps.text: But still good.

steps.speaker: Straven
steps.text: If you really want to go there, it's in the alleyway to the west as you come in the south gate.

steps.speaker: Straven
steps.text: One of our operatives is often near the alley - a red haired tramp, goes by the name of Charlie. He may be able to give you some ideas.

steps.player: Thanks for the help!

phoenix-gang-talking-to-straven-after-lo.player: I'm afraid I've lost the key you gave me.

phoenix-gang-talking-to-straven-after-lo.speaker: Straven
phoenix-gang-talking-to-straven-after-lo.text: You really need to be more careful. We don't want that key falling into the wrong hands. Ah well... Have this spare. Don't lose THIS one.

phoenix-gang-talking-to-katrine-after-jo.text: You've got some guts coming here, Phoenix guy!

finishing-up-talking-to-curator-haig-hal.speaker: Curator Haig Halen
finishing-up-talking-to-curator-haig-hal.text: Welcome to the museum of Varrock.

finishing-up-talking-to-curator-haig-hal.player: I have half the shield of Arrav here. Can I get a reward?

finishing-up-talking-to-curator-haig-hal.speaker: Curator Haig Halen
finishing-up-talking-to-curator-haig-hal.text: The Shield of Arrav! Goodness, the Museum has been searching for that for years! The late King Roald II offered a reward for it years ago!

finishing-up-talking-to-curator-haig-hal.player: Well, I'm here to claim it.

finishing-up-talking-to-curator-haig-hal.speaker: Curator Haig Halen
finishing-up-talking-to-curator-haig-hal.text: Let me have a look at it first.

steps.text: The curator peers at the shield.

finishing-up-talking-to-curator-haig-hal.speaker: Curator Haig Halen
finishing-up-talking-to-curator-haig-hal.text: That shield has been missing for over twenty-five years!

finishing-up-talking-to-curator-haig-hal.speaker: Curator Haig Halen
finishing-up-talking-to-curator-haig-hal.text: Leave the shield here with me and I'll write you out a certificate saying that you have returned the shield, so that you can claim your reward from the King.

finishing-up-talking-to-curator-haig-hal.player: Can I have two certificates please?

finishing-up-talking-to-curator-haig-hal.speaker: Curator Haig Halen
finishing-up-talking-to-curator-haig-hal.text: Yes, certainly. Please hand over the shield.

steps.text: You hand over the shield half.

steps.text: Well Bwana, if you have Rashiliyia's remains, you need to find a way to put her spirit to rest. Perhaps there was a clue with one of the artefacts that you have?

options.text: No, I'll keep hold of the remains.

visiting-the-tomb-of-rashiliyia-using-ra.text: You have my gratitude for releasing my spirit. I have suffered a vengeful and evil existence. I was tricked by Zamorak. He returned my son to me as an undead creature.

visiting-the-tomb-of-rashiliyia-using-ra.speaker: Rashiliyia
visiting-the-tomb-of-rashiliyia-using-ra.text: My hatred and bitterness corrupted me. I tried to destroy all life... now I am released. And am grateful to contemplate eternal rest...

Why howdy there, sailor! Welcome to this here fine shipyard. Anything I can help ya with?

options.text: Can you tell me more about this place?

steps.player: Can you tell me more about this place?

steps.npc: Why, this is the shipyard, of course! I'd say it's the finest one in all of Gielinor!

steps.player: How many others even are there in Gielinor?

steps.npc: Ha! You're a funny one, sailor! Anyhoo, this here is the place where ya can modify your boat to your heart's content! Ya can do that in two ways.
Once you're on board, you'll find that you've got different spots on your boat for different facilities! If ya can't find what you're looking for, be sure to check the other spots as well!

steps.player: But what if I don't have the right skillsets?

steps.npc: Well now, I reckon we might be able to help ya out there... for a price of course!
Now, the other way ya can modify your boat is by upgrading the core components of it. If ya fancy doing that, you'll wanna use this here schematics board!
Much like with building facilities, ya can use the board to pick the part of your boat ya wanna upgrade!

Now, it's important ya keep in mind that these upgrades are the big ones! They're too much to handle solo, so we'll wrangle up some of the workers to lend ya a hand. They'll also supply the tools for ya!

steps.player: That's very kind of them. What's the catch?

steps.npc: Well, while they're happy to give ya a helping hand, they are going to expect ya to take the lead.

steps.player: And if I'm not skilled enough to take the lead?

steps.npc: Well, we might be able to help ya out there... for a price of course!

steps.player: Of course.

steps.npc: Anyhoo, I think that just about covers the shipyard. Anything else I can do for ya?

options.text: What do you have for sale?

steps.player: What do you have for sale?

steps.npc: I've got a few basic shipbuilding supplies that ya might find handy. Take a look, sailor!

options.text: Could you help me repair my boat?

steps.text: If the boat is not damaged:

steps.npc: Looks like ya boat's already all fine and dandy, sailor.

steps.player: Could you help me repair my boat?

steps.npc: Sure thing, sailor. That'll cost ya [..] coins.

steps.prompt: Have your boat repaired for [..] coins?

steps.player: Sounds good to me.

steps.npc: Alrighty! Let's call some of the workers over...

steps.text: Some workers make repairs to your boat.

steps.npc: That's all done for ya, sailor.

steps.player: Sounds good to me.

steps.npc: Alrighty! Let's call some of the workers over...

steps.text: Some workers make repairs to your boat.

steps.npc: That's all done for ya, sailor.

steps.player: Actually, I'd rather not.

steps.npc: Fair enough, sailor.

options.text: Where can I get materials for my boat?

steps.player: Where can I get materials for my boat?

steps.npc: Well, ain't that the question on everyone's mind, sailor? But to answer, it depends on what materials you'll be wanting.
Ya look like a smart enough sailor to know where to find logs and bars. Nails, ya make from taking a metal bar to an anvil.
For planks, you'll need to take matching logs to a sawmill. I know there's a few around, but I like to get mine from the one north east of Varrock.
If ya need standard hull parts, you'll wanna take five planks to a workbench. We've got one right here, but any good shipwright's gonna have one.
If it's standard keel parts ya need, you'll wanna take five metal bars to any old anvil.
For the larger hull parts or keel parts, don't overthink it. Just grab five of the standard parts and put them together in the same way!
Obviously, some raw materials are rarer than others, and some of them ya might need to go sail that great blue marble to get.
Finally, if it helps ya at all, I've got some basic supplies for sale.

options.text: I might need help building things on my boat.

steps.player: I might need help building things on my boat.

steps.npc: Well, ya wouldn't be the first, sailor! I reckon ya probably won't be the the last either. Don't worry though, we can help ya out... for a price of course!

steps.player: And what sort of price should I expect?

steps.npc: Well, that there depends on how hard the job is. The more skills needed, the more money you're gonna need to part with.

steps.player: So you're telling me you won't be able to spare your best shipwrights?

steps.npc: Yeah I'd say that's a good way of putting it. In general, we'll only be able to help ya with things that use less fancy materials. Mithril and mahogany are gonna be the limit.
We're also only gonna be able to help ya with the more standard parts and facilities, so hulls, sails, helms, keels, cannons, salvaging hooks and cargo holds.

steps.player: I see. So once things start to get complicated, I'm going to have to do it myself?

steps.npc: Afraid so, sailor. Oh, and don't forget that even when we're helping ya out, we're still gonna need ya to supply the materials.

steps.player: Goodbye.

steps.npc: See ya later, sailor.

standard-dialogue.npc: Human.

steps.player: Tell me about the Nightmare.

steps.npc: From the moment I was born, all I ever knew was the Nightmare. Every night she would feast upon us, filling our minds with horrors beyond comprehension.
By day, our warriors would enter her lair in the caves beneath the island. We could not hope to defeat her, we knew that, but our survival was dependent on ensuring she didn't grow too strong.
Here's the thing though. Even now, we know little about her. Before she claimed them, my parents would sometimes tell me a story of her origin.
They told me of a group of shamans who performed an unknown ritual in the hope of gaining great power. The ritual went wrong, though, and instead, they unleashed the Nightmare on this world.

steps.player: Do you believe the story?

steps.npc: I'm not sure to be honest. I suppose it doesn't matter though. We'll likely never know her true origin. But as long as we can defeat her, we don't need to.

steps.player: Defeat her? Using the totems?

steps.npc: Exactly. Thanks to the Nightmare, the caves beneath our home are mostly unexplored. There's all sorts of things down there, provided you're brave enough to enter.
I found the totems deep within the caves. Someone far smarter than you or I had worked out how to make them. But they perished before they could use them against her.
I managed to recover them, and with them, we finally drove her off the island.

steps.player: But she came here.

steps.npc: Yes. And thanks to the Sleeper Plague, she's far stronger than ever before.

steps.player: Do you know where the Sleeper Plague came from?

steps.npc: No. It was here long before the Nightmare apparently. It resurfaced shortly before she arrived. Probably the work of the vampyres.
Is there anything else you need?

steps.player: Tell me about yourself.

steps.npc: The name's Shura. I come from an island called Ashihama, in the Pincers.

steps.player: The Pincers?

steps.npc: It's a group of islands within the Wushanko Isles, a large archipelago to the far east. Over here I think the area is more commonly known as the Eastern Lands.

steps.player: And you're a siren, right?

steps.npc: That's right. We rarely come this far to the west, the climate is too cold for our tastes. Although while the Nightmare lives, the climate is the least of my worries.
Back home on the other hand, our numbers equal the humans. Sirens live on pretty much every island in the archipelago.

steps.player: So why were you the only one to come here?

steps.npc: We took up arms against the Nightmare because we had to, not because we wanted to. We are a peaceful race, and most were all too eager to lay down their weapons once the Nightmare was gone.

steps.player: So why didn't you?

steps.npc: My kind believe in something called Mo Kal. It means that anything bad that could happen, will happen. The others may have forgotten this, but I have not.
The Nightmare may have left my home, but I won't rest until I know for sure that she can never return.
Is there anything else you need?

steps.player: I'd better get going.

steps.npc: Good luck.

standard-dialogue-when-trying-to-interac.npc: Hey! Don't just go poking her without knowing what you're up against. Come talk to me first.

standard-dialogue-first-time-talking-to-.player: What's going on here?

standard-dialogue-first-time-talking-to-.npc: Nothing good. This dungeon is tainted and has become the new home of the Nightmare.

standard-dialogue-first-time-talking-to-.player: The Nightmare?

standard-dialogue-first-time-talking-to-.npc: A being of pure darkness. No living creature is safe from her hunger. She feasts upon her victims while they sleep, draining their energy without even needing to touch them.
Those that she feeds upon experience horrifying nightmares, unlike anything you could possibly imagine. Eventually, they become too weak to even wake. Death claims them soon after.

standard-dialogue-first-time-talking-to-.player: Nightmares? Hence the name?

standard-dialogue-first-time-talking-to-.npc: Indeed. Our kind are not always the most creative.

standard-dialogue-first-time-talking-to-.player: So how did she end up here?

standard-dialogue-first-time-talking-to-.npc: For generations, she terrorised the island of Ashihama, my home. I lost a lot of good friends to her. Sometimes, I even thought I would lose myself. For some, the nightmares become too much to bear.
Some of us refused to give in though. Everything has a weakness, including the Nightmare, and eventually we found it. We drove her off the island, but she managed to endure.

The people here are ill, suffering from a deep sleep from which few wake. They call it the Sleeper Plague. The illness made these people easy prey for the Nightmare, so she made this place her new home.

standard-dialogue-first-time-talking-to-.player: And you followed her here?

standard-dialogue-first-time-talking-to-.npc: While she still exists, my home will never be truly safe. Thanks to the Sleeper Plague, her power has grown faster than it ever did on Ashihama. If she is allowed to grow too strong, there won't be any way to stop her.
I've managed to contain her within this section of the dungeon. She has no desire to leave for the moment. She has no need to, after all.
But make no mistake, I won't be able to stop her if she decides to move on.

standard-dialogue-first-time-talking-to-.player: She doesn't look too dangerous at the moment.

standard-dialogue-first-time-talking-to-.npc: Looks can be deceiving. The battle with the Nightmare is a mental one, not a physical one. If you try to take her on, she will pull you into her dream - one where she makes the rules.

standard-dialogue-first-time-talking-to-.player: But if it's a dream, how can it be dangerous?

standard-dialogue-first-time-talking-to-.npc: It's her dream, not yours. Dying in her dream will destroy your mind, killing you in this world as well.

standard-dialogue-first-time-talking-to-.player: Sounds lovely. So how can we stop her?

standard-dialogue-first-time-talking-to-.npc: If you're willing to help, enter her dream and fight to keep her at bay. Our only hope is to prevent her from growing too strong.
You can go in alone, but I wouldn't recommend it. The more support you have, the better your chances.

standard-dialogue-first-time-talking-to-.player: How do I keep her at bay?

standard-dialogue-first-time-talking-to-.npc: There are four totems in the area that can be used to harm her. First, you'll need to take down her shield for the totems to have an effect. Once her shield is down, use your energy to charge up the totems.
She won't sit about while you do this though, so you'll need to take care if you want to survive.

standard-dialogue-first-time-talking-to-.player: And what's in it for me if I do survive?

standard-dialogue-first-time-talking-to-.npc: You mean apart from saving the world? She's claimed many victims over the years. I'm sure she's claimed many items as well. Maybe some of them will be of value to you.

standard-dialogue-first-time-talking-to-.player: Works for me. I'd better get started then.

standard-dialogue-first-time-talking-to-.npc: Good luck. Return to me if you need more information.

to clean them on. If you find anything interesting, let us know and we'll see if it's good enough to go on display.

steps.npc: What have we here?

Oh! This is very interesting...and confusing at the same time. This coin means that the city that we're excavating on the Digsite - Saranthium - was actually inhabited much, much earlier by followers of Zamorak,
at which time, the city was known as Senntisten.

This is a most remarkable discovery, as we have other evidence indicating that Zarosian followers were resident before the Saradominists took over, but it also seems that Zamorakian forces used it during a battle of some
sort. Still, it allows us to roughly date when the city changed from following Zaros and Zamorak to following Saradomin. Put it in display case 44.

slepe-s-sleeper-plague-talking-to-veliaf.player: Veliaf? What are you doing here?

slepe-s-sleeper-plague-talking-to-veliaf.speaker: Veliaf Hurtz
slepe-s-sleeper-plague-talking-to-veliaf.text: Well met friend. I'm here on an investigation. There's something strange going on in this town, and I suspect the vampyres are involved.
If the player does not have the requirements to start the quest:

steps.speaker: Veliaf Hurtz
steps.text: Not at the moment. Keep checking in though, I may have need of you soon.

slepe-s-sleeper-plague-talking-to-veliaf.text: If the player has the requirements to start the quest:

steps.speaker: Veliaf Hurtz
steps.text: Well an extra pair of hands is always beneficial. If you have the time of course?
If the player has a lower combat level than recommended:
Before starting this quest, be aware that your combat level is lower than the recommended level of 95.

steps.prompt: Start the Sins of the Father quest?

steps.player: Of course. What do you need?

steps.speaker: Veliaf Hurtz
steps.text: This town has recently become home to an illness known as the Sleeper Plague. It's a nasty affliction. Those infected fall into a deep sleep, never to wake.

steps.speaker: Veliaf Hurtz
steps.text: Now, Morytania is no stranger to odd afflictions. However, I've been doing some digging. Apparently, this isn't the first time this illness has beset Slepe. In fact, they say it's how the town was named.

steps.player: And now the illness is back. You said you suspect the vampyres are involved?

steps.speaker: Veliaf Hurtz
steps.text: I do. The first victim of the new Sleeper Plague was none other than Lady Crombwick. She rules over this town from Crombwick Manor, along with her husband.

steps.speaker: Veliaf Hurtz
steps.text: He's not been seen since she fell ill, and their manor has been locked down.

steps.speaker: Veliaf Hurtz
steps.text: Here's the interesting part though. Vampyres have been seen around the manor. Apparently they showed up around the time when the Sleeper Plague returned.

steps.player: I see where this is going. You think the vampyres are the reason the plague is back.

steps.speaker: Veliaf Hurtz
steps.text: I do. The question is, why?

steps.player: I guess that's for us to work out. Where do we start?

steps.speaker: Veliaf Hurtz
steps.text: We'll split up. I'm going to try and learn more about these vampyres at the manor. While I do that, I want you to try and find the source of the illness.

steps.speaker: Veliaf Hurtz
steps.text: They're looking after the victims in this church here. I'd recommend you make that your starting point.

steps.player: Sounds like a plan. Good luck.

steps.speaker: Veliaf Hurtz
steps.text: And to you. Myreque prevail.

options.text: How have things been for you recently?

steps.player: How have things been for you recently?

steps.speaker: Veliaf Hurtz
steps.text: We haven't been doing too bad. Even out in Mort Myre, the impact of Ranis' death can be seen.

steps.speaker: Veliaf Hurtz
steps.text: People have a little bit more hope now, and it has become easier for us to gather support.

steps.player: That's good to know.

steps.speaker: Veliaf Hurtz
steps.text: Of course, there are downsides. The vampyres are hunting us with ever greater determination. But this is the life we chose.

options.text: What do you know about this place?

steps.player: What do you know about this place?

steps.speaker: Veliaf Hurtz
steps.text: Slepe? It's wretched. The people of this town follow the teachings of Zamorak. Some are no better than the vampyres themselves.

steps.player: Do they get on with the vampyres?

steps.speaker: Veliaf Hurtz
steps.text: As well as any humans can. All settlements in Morytania must pay the vampyres in blood tithes, but the people of Slepe do so willingly.

steps.speaker: Veliaf Hurtz
steps.text: They see the vampyres as fellow servants of Zamorak. Of course, the vampyres only really serve themselves.

steps.player: So why do these people follow Zamorak?

steps.speaker: Veliaf Hurtz
steps.text: Apparently this place was founded by a group called the Sisterhood, former healers of Saradomin that turned to Zamorak.

steps.speaker: Veliaf Hurtz
steps.text: Their order still exists to this day. You'll probably see a few of them around the town.

options.text: Can you tell me any more about the Sleeper Plague?

steps.player: Can you tell me any more about the Sleeper Plague?

steps.speaker: Veliaf Hurtz
steps.text: What I told you is pretty much what I know. The illness causes people to fall to sleep, never to wake again.

steps.speaker: Veliaf Hurtz
steps.text: There's a rumour that the infected are also granted immortality, though I don't know if there's any truth in this.

steps.player: To be honest, immortality doesn't seem very useful if you're unable to wake up.

steps.speaker: Veliaf Hurtz
steps.text: Indeed. If history is to be believed, this is the second time the Sleeper Plague has hit Slepe. The first occurrence was many years ago and is supposedly what gave the town its name.

steps.speaker: Veliaf Hurtz
steps.text: That's all I know. That said, I suspect you might be able to learn more if you do some digging around town.

steps.player: I'd better get going.
Actually, I'm a bit busy right now. Maybe later.

steps.speaker: Veliaf Hurtz
steps.text: Very well friend. Myreque prevail.

slepe-s-sleeper-plague-talking-to-veliaf.player: What am I meant to be doing?

slepe-s-sleeper-plague-talking-to-veliaf.speaker: Veliaf Hurtz
slepe-s-sleeper-plague-talking-to-veliaf.text: You need to try and find the source of the Sleeper Plague. I'd start in the church. That's where they're looking after the victims.

options.text: How have things been for you recently?
What do you know about this place?
Can you tell me any more about the Sleeper Plague?

slepe-s-sleeper-plague-talking-to-hameln.speaker: Hameln the Jester
slepe-s-sleeper-plague-talking-to-hameln.text: You're not wrong about that. It's my travelling companion, Hanchen. They say he's the latest victim of the Sleeper Plague.

options.text: Do you know how he fell ill?

steps.player: Do you know how he fell ill?

steps.speaker: Hameln the Jester
steps.text: I've no idea. We'd just been to the pub for a quick drink. On our way back, he started to act all odd, then he just collapsed.

steps.player: Pub?

steps.speaker: Hameln the Jester
steps.text: Yes. The Rat & Bat just south east of here. I'm not a drinker myself but Hanchen's always loved a good tipple.

steps.player: Wait... you mean to say you weren't drinking?

steps.speaker: Hameln the Jester
steps.text: No, I never drink. Hanchen on the other hand was loving those Bloody Bracers.

steps.player: I see. Thanks for the information.

slepe-s-sleeper-plague-talking-to-hameln.speaker: Hameln the Jester
slepe-s-sleeper-plague-talking-to-hameln.text: You're not wrong about that. It's my travelling companion, Hanchen. They say he's the latest victim of the Sleeper Plague.

options.text: Do you know how he fell ill?

steps.player: Do you know how he fell ill?

steps.speaker: Hameln the Jester
steps.text: Like I said, I've no idea. We'd just been to the pub when it happened. Hanchen's always loved a good drink.

steps.player: I see. Thanks for the information.

slepe-s-sleeper-plague-talking-to-hameln.speaker: Veliaf Hurtz
slepe-s-sleeper-plague-talking-to-hameln.text: Well met friend. How goes the investigation?

slepe-s-sleeper-plague-talking-to-hameln.player: Apparently the latest victim of the Sleeper Plague was at the pub shortly before falling ill.

slepe-s-sleeper-plague-talking-to-hameln.speaker: Veliaf Hurtz
slepe-s-sleeper-plague-talking-to-hameln.text: Interesting. Might be worth a look.

slepe-s-sleeper-plague-talking-to-hameln.player: Agreed. I'll see if I can discover anything.

options.text: How have things been for you recently?
What do you know about this place?
Can you tell me any more about the Sleeper Plague?

plague-s-end-talking-to-carl.speaker: Carl
plague-s-end-talking-to-carl.text: We serve Crombwick's finest Bloody Bracer, that is all.

options.text: Alright, one Bloody Bracer, if that's all you have.
Where do you get your Bloody Bracers from?

steps.player: Where do you get your Bloody Bracers from?

steps.speaker: Carl
steps.text: It's an old recipe of the Crombwick family.

steps.player: Okay. But the actual Bloody Bracers you sell, where do they come from?

steps.speaker: Carl
steps.text: Who's asking?

steps.player: Well... me of course.

steps.speaker: Carl
steps.text: Yes, but what I mean is, why do you want to know?

steps.player: Does it matter?

steps.speaker: Carl
steps.text: My supplier is a private individual. He doesn't like others meddling in his affairs. So yes, it does matter.

steps.player: I represent... health?

steps.speaker: Carl
steps.text: Health? What are you on about?

steps.player: Err... Health and safety of course, here on a routine inspection.
Part of my work requires me to inspect the source of your Bloody Bracers. I was hoping you'd put me in touch with your supplier.

steps.speaker: Carl
steps.text: I don't know what you're on about. There're no routine inspections here. Now clear off, I have customers to serve!

steps.player: Well I might just have a look around anyway.

options.text: What can you tell me about this town?

plague-s-end-talking-to-carl-talking-to-.speaker: Carl
plague-s-end-talking-to-carl-talking-to-.text: We serve Crombwick's finest Bloody Bracer, that is all.

options.text: Alright, one Bloody Bracer, if that's all you have.
Where do you get your Bloody Bracers from?

steps.player: Where do you get your Bloody Bracers from?

steps.speaker: Carl
steps.text: You don't give up do you. I'm not telling you anything so clear off.

steps.player: Well I might just have a look around anyway.

options.text: What can you tell me about this town?

plague-s-end-barrel-investigation.text: The barrel is almost empty. It has the words 'Bloody Bracer' written on the side.

plague-s-end-barrel-investigation.player: Hmmm. Looks like Carl is pretty much out of Bloody Bracer. He'll need to collect more from his supplier soon.

plague-s-end-barrel-investigation.text: Carl exits the Rat & Bat and checks the barrel.

plague-s-end-barrel-investigation.speaker: Carl
plague-s-end-barrel-investigation.text: Huh. Looks like we're all out of Bloody Bracer again.

plague-s-end-barrel-investigation.player: Alright then Carl. Let's see what you're hiding...

plague-s-end-if-caught-by-carl.text: You failed to stay hidden from Carl.

plague-s-end-if-the-player-falls-too-far.text: You failed to stay close enough to Carl.

plague-s-end-eavesdropping-on-carl.text: Carl heads into the Sisterhood Sanctuary.

plague-s-end-eavesdropping-on-carl.player: The dungeon Carl? What are you hiding down there?

plague-s-end-eavesdropping-on-carl.text: Carl enters Kroy's lab.

plague-s-end-eavesdropping-on-carl.speaker: Kroy
plague-s-end-eavesdropping-on-carl.text: Carl? What do you want?

plague-s-end-eavesdropping-on-carl.speaker: Carl
plague-s-end-eavesdropping-on-carl.text: Kroy. We've run out of Bloody Bracer again.

plague-s-end-eavesdropping-on-carl.speaker: Kroy
plague-s-end-eavesdropping-on-carl.text: Did you really need to come here to tell me that?

plague-s-end-eavesdropping-on-carl.speaker: Carl
plague-s-end-eavesdropping-on-carl.text: There's something else as well. Someone's been poking around, asking about Bloody Bracer.

plague-s-end-eavesdropping-on-carl.speaker: Kroy
plague-s-end-eavesdropping-on-carl.text: Who?

plague-s-end-eavesdropping-on-carl.speaker: Carl
plague-s-end-eavesdropping-on-carl.text: I don't know. They don't look to be from around here.

plague-s-end-eavesdropping-on-carl.speaker: Kroy
plague-s-end-eavesdropping-on-carl.text: So someone's been snooping around asking questions, and you decided to come here? What if they followed you?

plague-s-end-eavesdropping-on-carl.speaker: Carl
plague-s-end-eavesdropping-on-carl.text: I... I thought you'd want to know.

plague-s-end-eavesdropping-on-carl.speaker: Kroy
plague-s-end-eavesdropping-on-carl.text: You're a fool Carl. If you're not careful, you'll jeopardise everything.

plague-s-end-eavesdropping-on-carl.speaker: Carl
plague-s-end-eavesdropping-on-carl.text: Hey! I don't need to help you!

plague-s-end-eavesdropping-on-carl.speaker: Kroy
plague-s-end-eavesdropping-on-carl.text: No, you don't. Your predecessor didn't want to help us. Perhaps you remember what came of him?

plague-s-end-eavesdropping-on-carl.speaker: Kroy
plague-s-end-eavesdropping-on-carl.text: Go back to your pub Carl. I'll have more Bloody Bracer sent over soon. In the meantime, try to be a bit smarter.

plague-s-end-eavesdropping-on-carl.speaker: Carl
plague-s-end-eavesdropping-on-carl.text: Fine.
Carl leaves the lab, failing to notice the player eavesdropping. Afterwards, Damien Leucurte enters the lab, followed by Vanstrom Klause.

plague-s-end-eavesdropping-on-carl.speaker: Vanstrom Klause
plague-s-end-eavesdropping-on-carl.text: Alright then, Damien. What is it that you're so keen to show me?

plague-s-end-eavesdropping-on-carl.speaker: Damien Leucurte
plague-s-end-eavesdropping-on-carl.text: Vanstrom, I'd like you to meet Kroy.

plague-s-end-eavesdropping-on-carl.speaker: Kroy
plague-s-end-eavesdropping-on-carl.text: Greetings, my lord.

plague-s-end-eavesdropping-on-carl.speaker: Vanstrom Klause
plague-s-end-eavesdropping-on-carl.text: Don't tell me you had me come all the way down here for this? Look at the wretched thing, Damien. It's barely even a proper juvenile.

plague-s-end-eavesdropping-on-carl.speaker: Damien Leucurte
plague-s-end-eavesdropping-on-carl.text: Well just hang on there, Vanstrom. Kroy may not look like much, but I've never met a vampyre with a better knowledge of herblore.

plague-s-end-eavesdropping-on-carl.speaker: Damien Leucurte
plague-s-end-eavesdropping-on-carl.text: Kroy, tell him what you found.

plague-s-end-eavesdropping-on-carl.speaker: Kroy
plague-s-end-eavesdropping-on-carl.text: Of course, my lord.

plague-s-end-eavesdropping-on-carl.speaker: Kroy
plague-s-end-eavesdropping-on-carl.text: It was hidden deep within the sanctuary here. A recipe, for an elixir.

plague-s-end-eavesdropping-on-carl.speaker: Vanstrom Klause
plague-s-end-eavesdropping-on-carl.text: An elixir?

plague-s-end-eavesdropping-on-carl.speaker: Kroy
plague-s-end-eavesdropping-on-carl.text: Yes! The ones that built the place, the Sisterhood, they called it the Elixir of Everlasting.

plague-s-end-eavesdropping-on-carl.speaker: Vanstrom Klause
plague-s-end-eavesdropping-on-carl.text: And just what is this Elixir of Everlasting?

plague-s-end-eavesdropping-on-carl.speaker: Damien Leucurte
plague-s-end-eavesdropping-on-carl.text: Those who drink it find their lives heavily extended, but at a cost. They are put into a deep sleep, never to wake.

plague-s-end-eavesdropping-on-carl.speaker: Vanstrom Klause
plague-s-end-eavesdropping-on-carl.text: So the Sleeper Plague? That was your doing?

plague-s-end-eavesdropping-on-carl.speaker: Damien Leucurte
plague-s-end-eavesdropping-on-carl.text: Indeed. Using the recipe, Kroy was easily able to recreate the elixir. After a quick test on Lady Crombwick, we started giving it to the citizens.

plague-s-end-eavesdropping-on-carl.speaker: Kroy
plague-s-end-eavesdropping-on-carl.text: We hide it in their beer, Bloody Bracer. They've no idea what it's really doing to them!

plague-s-end-eavesdropping-on-carl.speaker: Damien Leucurte
plague-s-end-eavesdropping-on-carl.text: And while they sleep, we tithe them. The sleepers only need a fraction of the blood a normal human needs, so we can take more than ever before!

plague-s-end-eavesdropping-on-carl.speaker: Vanstrom Klause
plague-s-end-eavesdropping-on-carl.text: And tell me, Damien, who gave you permission to do this?

plague-s-end-eavesdropping-on-carl.speaker: Damien Leucurte
plague-s-end-eavesdropping-on-carl.text: The nobles of Darkmeyer make their demands Vanstrom. Someone has to meet them.

plague-s-end-eavesdropping-on-carl.speaker: Vanstrom Klause
plague-s-end-eavesdropping-on-carl.text: That someone is not you. I am in charge of blood tithing. I alone decide how it is to be carried out.

plague-s-end-eavesdropping-on-carl.speaker: Damien Leucurte
plague-s-end-eavesdropping-on-carl.text: The nobles are restless. They are tired of inaction. I saw an opportunity and I took it. Lord Drakan should thank me.

plague-s-end-eavesdropping-on-carl.speaker: Vanstrom Klause
plague-s-end-eavesdropping-on-carl.text: I don't doubt the ingenuity of your plan. This elixir could have great potential. The thing I doubt is your recklessness. This Sleeper Plague has attracted attention. The wrong kind of attention.

plague-s-end-eavesdropping-on-carl.speaker: Damien Leucurte
plague-s-end-eavesdropping-on-carl.text: The Myreque? Don't tell me you're scared of that lot, Vanstrom? I thought you were made of stronger stuff.

plague-s-end-eavesdropping-on-carl.speaker: Vanstrom Klause
plague-s-end-eavesdropping-on-carl.text: I do not fear the Myreque. I have no need to. They have no way of touching me.

plague-s-end-eavesdropping-on-carl.speaker: Vanstrom Klause
plague-s-end-eavesdropping-on-carl.text: But you on the other hand, you should be very afraid. Out here alone, without the support of the Drakan household. You're a prime target. And if what I hear is true, they're right on your doorstep.

plague-s-end-eavesdropping-on-carl.speaker: Damien Leucurte
plague-s-end-eavesdropping-on-carl.text: What's that supposed to mean?

plague-s-end-eavesdropping-on-carl.speaker: Vanstrom Klause
plague-s-end-eavesdropping-on-carl.text: The Myreque are already here in Slepe, Damien. The one that killed Ranis Drakan is among them. Your overconfidence has begun your downfall.

plague-s-end-eavesdropping-on-carl.speaker: Damien Leucurte
plague-s-end-eavesdropping-on-carl.text: Well you'll have to do something. You'll need to send us some support.

plague-s-end-eavesdropping-on-carl.speaker: Vanstrom Klause
plague-s-end-eavesdropping-on-carl.text: I will do no such thing. You defied Lord Drakan when you came out here. The consequences of your actions are your own to deal with.

plague-s-end-eavesdropping-on-carl.speaker: Vanstrom Klause
plague-s-end-eavesdropping-on-carl.text: Now, if you'll excuse me, I will be on my way. There are things in Darkmeyer that require my attention.
Vanstrom leaves via the ladder, followed by Damien. The player enters Kroy's lab immediately after.

plague-s-end-eavesdropping-on-carl.speaker: Kroy
plague-s-end-eavesdropping-on-carl.text: How much did you hear, human?

plague-s-end-eavesdropping-on-carl.speaker: Kroy
plague-s-end-eavesdropping-on-carl.text: I see. Then you know that I can't let you leave this place alive.

plague-s-end-eavesdropping-on-carl.player: Tempting offer. Death isn't on my to-do list today though, so I'll have to decline.

plague-s-end-eavesdropping-on-carl.speaker: Kroy
plague-s-end-eavesdropping-on-carl.text: A joker? Your arrogance will be your end, human.

plague-s-end-eavesdropping-on-carl.speaker: Kroy
plague-s-end-eavesdropping-on-carl.text: Yes... We shall...
Kroy attacks the player.

plague-s-end-after-killing-kroy.player: Well that's him dealt with. I should destroy his lab as well. Don't want anyone else continuing his work.

plague-s-end-after-destroying-the-lab-ta.player: There. That should stop anyone from continuing Kroy's work. I should inform Veliaf.

an-unwelcome-surprise-reporting-back-to-.speaker: Veliaf Hurtz
an-unwelcome-surprise-reporting-back-to-.text: Well met friend. Anything to report?

an-unwelcome-surprise-reporting-back-to-.player: You were right about the vampyres. I did some digging and discovered that they are indeed the cause of the Sleeper Plague.
A vampyre in the dungeon called Kroy was making infected Bloody Bracers. The local barkeep was then selling them to the townspeople.
I put a stop to that though. I killed Kroy and destroyed his lab. The barkeep has no supply now.

an-unwelcome-surprise-reporting-back-to-.speaker: Veliaf Hurtz
an-unwelcome-surprise-reporting-back-to-.text: Excellent work friend. This should stop any new cases of the illness.

an-unwelcome-surprise-reporting-back-to-.player: There's something else, too. While I was spying on Kroy, I saw Vanstrom Klause with another vampyre called Damien. It sounded like Damien was Kroy's boss.

an-unwelcome-surprise-reporting-back-to-.speaker: Veliaf Hurtz
an-unwelcome-surprise-reporting-back-to-.text: The vampyre you speak of is a noble called Damien Leucurte. He's a known quantity to us. My investigations at the manor also involved the two of them, but let's hear the rest of your findings first.

an-unwelcome-surprise-reporting-back-to-.player: Well, in their conversations, it was revealed why they caused the new Sleeper Plague. Apparently, they did it to make it easier to take blood tithes.
But here's the interesting thing. Vanstrom didn't seem very happy with this. It sounded like Damien was doing it without his permission.

an-unwelcome-surprise-reporting-back-to-.speaker: Veliaf Hurtz
an-unwelcome-surprise-reporting-back-to-.text: This is all very interesting. The citizens of this town are Zamorakians and willingly give their blood to the vampyres. Why would Damien need the Sleeper Plague?

an-unwelcome-surprise-reporting-back-to-.player: He talked about increased demand from the nobles of Darkmeyer. Perhaps they have need for more blood than normal?

an-unwelcome-surprise-reporting-back-to-.speaker: Veliaf Hurtz
an-unwelcome-surprise-reporting-back-to-.text: That would make sense. I've heard rumours that the vampyre population has grown such that demand for blood now exceeds supply. Damien may be looking for ways to satisfy this demand.

an-unwelcome-surprise-reporting-back-to-.speaker: Veliaf Hurtz
an-unwelcome-surprise-reporting-back-to-.text: Even so, this seems extreme. And to go behind Vanstrom's back as well? Maybe their overcrowding issues are bigger than we first realised.

an-unwelcome-surprise-reporting-back-to-.player: Maybe. So, what's our next move?

an-unwelcome-surprise-reporting-back-to-.speaker: Veliaf Hurtz
an-unwelcome-surprise-reporting-back-to-.text: I have an idea about that, although my information is not quite as exciting as yours I'm afraid.

an-unwelcome-surprise-reporting-back-to-.speaker: Veliaf Hurtz
an-unwelcome-surprise-reporting-back-to-.text: While I was investigating the manor, I discovered that it has indeed been taken over by vampyres. Our friend Damien seems to be the leader of this group.

an-unwelcome-surprise-reporting-back-to-.speaker: Veliaf Hurtz
an-unwelcome-surprise-reporting-back-to-.text: During my time there, I also managed to spy on Vanstrom and Damien. I only heard a small part of their conversation, but Vanstrom didn't seem very happy, which matches up with what you heard.

an-unwelcome-surprise-reporting-back-to-.speaker: Veliaf Hurtz
an-unwelcome-surprise-reporting-back-to-.text: At one point, Vanstrom insulted Damien for his recklessness and accused him of demanding too much from the werewolves. Sounds like they've also been gathering extra blood without permission.

an-unwelcome-surprise-reporting-back-to-.player: That sounds familiar. I suspect it was werewolves who attacked me that time at Paterdomus.

an-unwelcome-surprise-reporting-back-to-.speaker: Veliaf Hurtz
an-unwelcome-surprise-reporting-back-to-.text: Yes, that encounter also sprung into my mind. It sounds like things are even worse now.

an-unwelcome-surprise-reporting-back-to-.player: So you want to investigate the werewolves?

an-unwelcome-surprise-reporting-back-to-.speaker: Veliaf Hurtz
an-unwelcome-surprise-reporting-back-to-.text: I do indeed. Something is going on in Darkmeyer that's causing this increased demand. If there's unrest in the city, we might be able to use it to our advantage.

an-unwelcome-surprise-reporting-back-to-.player: What about Slepe? Should we not deal with Damien as well?

an-unwelcome-surprise-reporting-back-to-.speaker: Veliaf Hurtz
an-unwelcome-surprise-reporting-back-to-.text: Not yet. Your actions will have drawn attention to us. We cannot stay here. It sounds like Damien can do little without Kroy, so I doubt he'll be much trouble anyway.

an-unwelcome-surprise-reporting-back-to-.speaker: Veliaf Hurtz
an-unwelcome-surprise-reporting-back-to-.text: Besides, we've already done too much for these Zamorakians. There are others more deserving of our time.

options.text: But aren't we meant to help people?

steps.player: But aren't we meant to help people?

steps.speaker: Veliaf Hurtz
steps.text: That's a complicated question friend. But yes, of course we are meant to help people.

steps.player: Then why are we letting Damien get away with this? Carl as well?

steps.speaker: Veliaf Hurtz
steps.text: Damien and Carl are small fish in a very big pond. Dealing with them might help the people here, but it will mean nothing to the rest of Morytania.

steps.speaker: Veliaf Hurtz
steps.text: If we want to help as many people as possible, we need to think bigger than that. The Drakan family, they are the real targets.

steps.player: I suppose. It just seems harsh to leave these people in the hands of a vampyre like Damien.

steps.speaker: Veliaf Hurtz
steps.text: We've already done a lot to help here. Besides, Damien will get what's coming to him in the end, I'm sure of that.

steps.player: You're sure this isn't just because they're Zamorakian?

steps.speaker: Veliaf Hurtz
steps.text: Zamorakians are evil my friend, it does not shame me to say it. But no, if this were a Saradominist town, my actions would be the same.

steps.player: Okay, fair enough.

steps.speaker: Veliaf Hurtz
steps.text: You have a good heart my friend. I have a lot of respect for that. I assure you that if we keep on our current path, we will bring freedom to all of Morytania.

steps.player: Thank you, Veliaf. So, what's our next move?

steps.speaker: Veliaf Hurtz
steps.text: Meet me at Paterdomus friend. We will check in with Drezel and Ivan, before continuing our investigation.

steps.player: Okay, I'll meet you there.

steps.speaker: Veliaf Hurtz
steps.text: Be careful out there. Myreque prevail.

options.text: How have things been for you recently?
What do you know about this place?
Can you tell me any more about the Sleeper Plague?

steps.player: Fair enough, so what now?

steps.speaker: Veliaf Hurtz
steps.text: Meet me at Paterdomus friend. We will check in with Drezel and Ivan, before continuing our investigation.

steps.player: Okay, I'll meet you there.

steps.speaker: Veliaf Hurtz
steps.text: Be careful out there. Myreque prevail.

options.text: How have things been for you recently?
What do you know about this place?
Can you tell me any more about the Sleeper Plague?

an-unwelcome-surprise-checking-in-at-pat.speaker: Veliaf Hurtz
an-unwelcome-surprise-checking-in-at-pat.text: Well met friend. Good to see you made it in one piece.

an-unwelcome-surprise-checking-in-at-pat.speaker: Drezel
an-unwelcome-surprise-checking-in-at-pat.text: Indeed, I hear Morytania becomes more dangerous by the day.

an-unwelcome-surprise-checking-in-at-pat.player: You can say that again. Good to see you Drezel. Has Veliaf already filled you in?

an-unwelcome-surprise-checking-in-at-pat.speaker: Veliaf Hurtz
an-unwelcome-surprise-checking-in-at-pat.text: Not yet, I thought it best to wait for you.

an-unwelcome-surprise-checking-in-at-pat.speaker: Drezel
an-unwelcome-surprise-checking-in-at-pat.text: But you're here now, so let's get started.

an-unwelcome-surprise-checking-in-at-pat.speaker: Veliaf Hurtz
an-unwelcome-surprise-checking-in-at-pat.text: Well Drezel, the reason we are here is due to an investigation we've been conducting in Slepe.

an-unwelcome-surprise-checking-in-at-pat.speaker: Drezel
an-unwelcome-surprise-checking-in-at-pat.text: Ah. I hear it's a nasty place, full of Zamorakian filth. Suffering from some sort of outbreak as well, I've been told.

an-unwelcome-surprise-checking-in-at-pat.player: Yes, the Sleeper Plague. It turns out, however, that the vampyres are responsible.

an-unwelcome-surprise-checking-in-at-pat.speaker: Veliaf Hurtz
an-unwelcome-surprise-checking-in-at-pat.text: Seems that one of their nobles, Damien Leucurte, has been looking for ways to increase blood output. Interestingly, he's been doing it without consent from the Drakan family.

an-unwelcome-surprise-checking-in-at-pat.player: That's right. Vanstrom doesn't seem to be very happy about it.

an-unwelcome-surprise-checking-in-at-pat.speaker: Drezel
an-unwelcome-surprise-checking-in-at-pat.text: Interesting. It's odd you should come to report this, because we've also experienced some strange happenings around here.

an-unwelcome-surprise-checking-in-at-pat.player: Hmm. Do these strange happenings have anything to do with werewolves, by any chance?

an-unwelcome-surprise-checking-in-at-pat.speaker: Drezel
an-unwelcome-surprise-checking-in-at-pat.text: They do.

an-unwelcome-surprise-checking-in-at-pat.speaker: Veliaf Hurtz
an-unwelcome-surprise-checking-in-at-pat.text: I knew it. What's been going on?

an-unwelcome-surprise-checking-in-at-pat.speaker: Drezel
an-unwelcome-surprise-checking-in-at-pat.text: Well, after [player name] here was ambushed outside the temple a while back, Ivan and I decided to keep a closer eye on things.

an-unwelcome-surprise-checking-in-at-pat.speaker: Drezel
an-unwelcome-surprise-checking-in-at-pat.text: For a time, nothing unusual happened. The reports of trouble in the area died down, and everything seemed normal.

an-unwelcome-surprise-checking-in-at-pat.speaker: Veliaf Hurtz
an-unwelcome-surprise-checking-in-at-pat.text: Perhaps their encounter with you scared them off, [player name].

an-unwelcome-surprise-checking-in-at-pat.speaker: Drezel
an-unwelcome-surprise-checking-in-at-pat.text: Maybe. But if so, it was only for a time. A few weeks ago, the reports of people going missing in the area started again. And they're much worse this time.

an-unwelcome-surprise-checking-in-at-pat.speaker: Drezel
an-unwelcome-surprise-checking-in-at-pat.text: Entire groups have been going missing. Not just miners and travellers either. Even some of the king's mercenaries have vanished.

an-unwelcome-surprise-checking-in-at-pat.speaker: Veliaf Hurtz
an-unwelcome-surprise-checking-in-at-pat.text: Did you send word to the king?

an-unwelcome-surprise-checking-in-at-pat.speaker: Drezel
an-unwelcome-surprise-checking-in-at-pat.text: We did. His adviser though, Aeonisig, encouraged him to refrain from military action.

an-unwelcome-surprise-checking-in-at-pat.speaker: Veliaf Hurtz
an-unwelcome-surprise-checking-in-at-pat.text: Typical. This is why I hate politics.

an-unwelcome-surprise-checking-in-at-pat.player: Has anyone seen who's been doing this? Is it definitely werewolves?

an-unwelcome-surprise-checking-in-at-pat.speaker: Drezel
an-unwelcome-surprise-checking-in-at-pat.text: We believe so. Ivan has been keeping a close watch. The disappearances have mostly taken place further up the pass, however, so it's taken a while for him to find any leads.

an-unwelcome-surprise-checking-in-at-pat.speaker: Veliaf Hurtz
an-unwelcome-surprise-checking-in-at-pat.text: But he has found one?

an-unwelcome-surprise-checking-in-at-pat.speaker: Drezel
an-unwelcome-surprise-checking-in-at-pat.text: Yes, last night. He overheard a hooded figure mention a meeting in the Haunted Woods, directly south of Fenkenstrain's Castle, that is apparently set for today.

an-unwelcome-surprise-checking-in-at-pat.player: Perfect. Sounds like that's where we should head next then.

an-unwelcome-surprise-checking-in-at-pat.speaker: Veliaf Hurtz
an-unwelcome-surprise-checking-in-at-pat.text: On the topic of Ivan, where is he Drezel?

an-unwelcome-surprise-checking-in-at-pat.speaker: Drezel
an-unwelcome-surprise-checking-in-at-pat.text: Ah... Well that's just the thing. He went to spy on the meeting.

an-unwelcome-surprise-checking-in-at-pat.speaker: Veliaf Hurtz
an-unwelcome-surprise-checking-in-at-pat.text: What? You just let him go? He's just a boy!

an-unwelcome-surprise-checking-in-at-pat.speaker: Drezel
an-unwelcome-surprise-checking-in-at-pat.text: He's a grown man, Veliaf! One far smarter than either you or I. If he wants to do something, he will do it. I can't stop him!

an-unwelcome-surprise-checking-in-at-pat.speaker: Veliaf Hurtz
an-unwelcome-surprise-checking-in-at-pat.text: You should have sent word to us! This is for us to deal with, not him!

an-unwelcome-surprise-checking-in-at-pat.speaker: Drezel
an-unwelcome-surprise-checking-in-at-pat.text: There wasn't time. He only found out about the meeting last night!

an-unwelcome-surprise-checking-in-at-pat.player: Ivan is still a member of the Myreque, isn't he? Surely he can look after himself.

an-unwelcome-surprise-checking-in-at-pat.speaker: Veliaf Hurtz
an-unwelcome-surprise-checking-in-at-pat.text: That's not the point! He needs to be kept safe!

an-unwelcome-surprise-checking-in-at-pat.player: I don't understand. Why is Ivan so important?

an-unwelcome-surprise-checking-in-at-pat.speaker: Drezel
an-unwelcome-surprise-checking-in-at-pat.text: Ivan... Well, Ivan is special. He is the last in his bloodline.

an-unwelcome-surprise-checking-in-at-pat.speaker: Drezel
an-unwelcome-surprise-checking-in-at-pat.text: Ivan is the last living descendant of Ivandis Seergaze himself. Once I am gone, he will be the only remaining descendant of the Seven Priestly Warriors.

steps.speaker: Drezel
steps.text: Are you becoming forgetful, [player name]? The Seven Priestly Warriors were the ones who originally blessed the River Salve.

steps.speaker: Drezel
steps.text: Without their sacrifice, Drakan and his kin would have long since taken over Misthalin.

steps.player: Ah yes, I remember. So, this is why you want to keep Ivan safe, Veliaf?

options.text: I see. So that's why you want to keep him safe, Veliaf?

steps.player: I see. So that's why you want to keep him safe, Veliaf?

an-unwelcome-surprise-checking-in-at-pat.speaker: Veliaf Hurtz
an-unwelcome-surprise-checking-in-at-pat.text: It's not just about that. There's also the promise I made. Before his mother died, I swore to her on my life that I would shield Ivan from any harm.

an-unwelcome-surprise-checking-in-at-pat.speaker: Veliaf Hurtz
an-unwelcome-surprise-checking-in-at-pat.text: Though I nearly failed her when Vanstrom killed Sani and Harold.

an-unwelcome-surprise-checking-in-at-pat.speaker: Drezel
an-unwelcome-surprise-checking-in-at-pat.text: Veliaf, my friend, you and I will not be around to protect Ivan forever. We have guided him to this point, but maybe it's time for him to start looking after himself.

an-unwelcome-surprise-checking-in-at-pat.speaker: Veliaf Hurtz
an-unwelcome-surprise-checking-in-at-pat.text: And what of his learnings here? You would have him abandon them?

an-unwelcome-surprise-checking-in-at-pat.speaker: Drezel
an-unwelcome-surprise-checking-in-at-pat.text: I have taught Ivan everything I know. There is nothing more he can gain from me.

an-unwelcome-surprise-checking-in-at-pat.player: Forgive me, but this can be resolved later. For now, we need to find Ivan and see what this meeting is about.

an-unwelcome-surprise-checking-in-at-pat.speaker: Veliaf Hurtz
an-unwelcome-surprise-checking-in-at-pat.text: Yes, you're absolutely right, friend. Forgive us. Directly south of Fenkenstrain's Castle. Is that right Drezel?

an-unwelcome-surprise-checking-in-at-pat.speaker: Drezel
an-unwelcome-surprise-checking-in-at-pat.text: That's right. In the Haunted Woods.

an-unwelcome-surprise-checking-in-at-pat.speaker: Veliaf Hurtz
an-unwelcome-surprise-checking-in-at-pat.text: Very well. Meet me there, [player name]. Let's see if we can find out what's going on.

an-unwelcome-surprise-checking-in-at-pat.speaker: Veliaf Hurtz
an-unwelcome-surprise-checking-in-at-pat.text: Oh, and [player name], I would appreciate it if you could avoid mentioning the stuff about Ivandis Seergaze to Ivan. One day he will have to bear that burden. But for now, he has enough weight on his shoulders.

an-unwelcome-surprise-checking-in-at-pat.speaker: Drezel
an-unwelcome-surprise-checking-in-at-pat.text: Good luck to you both. Saradomin be with you.

an-unwelcome-surprise-checking-in-at-pat.speaker: Veliaf Hurtz
an-unwelcome-surprise-checking-in-at-pat.text: Meet me in the Haunted Woods, just south of Fenkenstrain's Castle. We will hopefully find Ivan there.

an-unwelcome-surprise-checking-in-at-pat.speaker: Drezel
an-unwelcome-surprise-checking-in-at-pat.text: You should head for the Haunted Woods, friend. With luck, you'll find Ivan just south of Fenkenstrain's Castle.

options.text: Could you tell me more about the Seven Priestly Warriors?

steps.player: Could you tell me more about the Seven Priestly Warriors?

steps.speaker: Drezel
steps.text: Well at this point you should be no stranger to their tale, though I understand the desire for a recap.

steps.speaker: Drezel
steps.text: During the Fourth Age, the vampyre forces of Lowerniel Drakan attempted to invade Misthalin. They would have succeeded, were it not for the Seven Priestly Warriors.

steps.speaker: Drezel
steps.text: The warriors were the ones to bless the River Salve and build this temple, ensuring that Misthalin would be forever safe from the evils of Morytania.

steps.speaker: Drezel
steps.text: Sadly, all seven of them fell in the final battle against Drakan. They are now buried here, in this very mausoleum.

steps.player: I don't know if that's completely true.

steps.speaker: Drezel
steps.text: You talk of the suggestion that Ivandis Seergaze isn't actually buried with the others, don't you? That isn't a conversation I wish to have.

steps.player: Fair enough. Anything else you can tell me about the Warriors?

steps.speaker: Drezel
steps.text: Not really. You might learn more in the library below, but I'd be cautious of believing every word in those books.

steps.player: Okay. Thanks Drezel.
I'm on it.

an-unwelcome-surprise-meeting-at-the-hau.speaker: Ivan Strom
an-unwelcome-surprise-meeting-at-the-hau.text: [player name]! So good to see you. What brings you out here?

an-unwelcome-surprise-meeting-at-the-hau.player: Hello there, Ivan. Believe it or not, I'm actually here for you.

an-unwelcome-surprise-meeting-at-the-hau.speaker: Ivan Strom
an-unwelcome-surprise-meeting-at-the-hau.text: For me? I'm guessing Drezel sent you?

an-unwelcome-surprise-meeting-at-the-hau.player: That's right. He told us of your discovery about the werewolves. We came to lend a hand.

an-unwelcome-surprise-meeting-at-the-hau.speaker: Ivan Strom
an-unwelcome-surprise-meeting-at-the-hau.text: We? Is Veliaf with you?

an-unwelcome-surprise-meeting-at-the-hau.player: Yes. We've been investigating something together. We suspect it may be connected to this situation with the werewolves. I imagine he'll be here shortly.

an-unwelcome-surprise-meeting-at-the-hau.text: Veliaf arrives at the meeting spot.

an-unwelcome-surprise-meeting-at-the-hau.speaker: Ivan Strom
an-unwelcome-surprise-meeting-at-the-hau.text: Veliaf!

an-unwelcome-surprise-meeting-at-the-hau.speaker: Veliaf Hurtz
an-unwelcome-surprise-meeting-at-the-hau.text: Ivan. It's good to see you safe.

an-unwelcome-surprise-meeting-at-the-hau.speaker: Ivan Strom
an-unwelcome-surprise-meeting-at-the-hau.text: And you. [player name] says you're here about the werewolves.

an-unwelcome-surprise-meeting-at-the-hau.speaker: Veliaf Hurtz
an-unwelcome-surprise-meeting-at-the-hau.text: Indeed. But Ivan, you shouldn't be out here. It's not safe for you. Head back to the temple, let [player name] and I take it from here.

an-unwelcome-surprise-meeting-at-the-hau.speaker: Ivan Strom
an-unwelcome-surprise-meeting-at-the-hau.text: Don't worry, Veliaf. I can look after myself.

an-unwelcome-surprise-meeting-at-the-hau.speaker: Veliaf Hurtz
an-unwelcome-surprise-meeting-at-the-hau.text: Ivan...
Three werewolves arrive at the meeting spot with a family of prisoners, and greet Damien and two vampyre juvinates.

an-unwelcome-surprise-meeting-at-the-hau.speaker: Damien Leucurte
an-unwelcome-surprise-meeting-at-the-hau.text: You're late.

an-unwelcome-surprise-meeting-at-the-hau.speaker: Werewolf
an-unwelcome-surprise-meeting-at-the-hau.text: Well look who it is. Damien Leucurte! I thought you didn't like to associate with our lot.

an-unwelcome-surprise-meeting-at-the-hau.speaker: Werewolf
an-unwelcome-surprise-meeting-at-the-hau.text: Scared of getting mud on his pretty clothes, I bet.

an-unwelcome-surprise-meeting-at-the-hau.speaker: Damien Leucurte
an-unwelcome-surprise-meeting-at-the-hau.text: Mind your tongue, dog, or I'll have you put in a collar.

an-unwelcome-surprise-meeting-at-the-hau.speaker: Werewolf
an-unwelcome-surprise-meeting-at-the-hau.text: Your threats mean nothing out here Damien. There're no Drakans around to protect you.

an-unwelcome-surprise-meeting-at-the-hau.speaker: Werewolf
an-unwelcome-surprise-meeting-at-the-hau.text: Not that Drakan protection means much these days anyway. His own brother killed by a human. How does he respond? He stays hiding in his fancy castle.

an-unwelcome-surprise-meeting-at-the-hau.speaker: Werewolf
an-unwelcome-surprise-meeting-at-the-hau.text: Ha! You think this one would get Drakan protection even if he were about? I hear Vanstrom has found out about this little side venture. Little Damien has been a very naughty boy.

an-unwelcome-surprise-meeting-at-the-hau.speaker: Damien Leucurte
an-unwelcome-surprise-meeting-at-the-hau.text: Enough of this! What do you have for me?

an-unwelcome-surprise-meeting-at-the-hau.speaker: Werewolf
an-unwelcome-surprise-meeting-at-the-hau.text: A nice family of three, out for a little picnic a bit too close to the Salve.

an-unwelcome-surprise-meeting-at-the-hau.speaker: Prisoner
an-unwelcome-surprise-meeting-at-the-hau.text: Please... don't hurt us. We'll do anything!

an-unwelcome-surprise-meeting-at-the-hau.speaker: Werewolf
an-unwelcome-surprise-meeting-at-the-hau.text: Shut up!

an-unwelcome-surprise-meeting-at-the-hau.speaker: Damien Leucurte
an-unwelcome-surprise-meeting-at-the-hau.text: Three? Is that all?

an-unwelcome-surprise-meeting-at-the-hau.speaker: Werewolf
an-unwelcome-surprise-meeting-at-the-hau.text: Well if you want more, you're welcome to cross the Salve yourself and get them.

an-unwelcome-surprise-meeting-at-the-hau.speaker: Damien Leucurte
an-unwelcome-surprise-meeting-at-the-hau.text: There's been a setback with our operations in Slepe. We need you to make up the shortfall. Next time, bring more.

an-unwelcome-surprise-meeting-at-the-hau.speaker: Werewolf
an-unwelcome-surprise-meeting-at-the-hau.text: You assume there's going to be a next time. I bet you don't last another week now that the Myreque are running around with vampyre-killing weapons.

an-unwelcome-surprise-meeting-at-the-hau.speaker: Werewolf
an-unwelcome-surprise-meeting-at-the-hau.text: A week? He won't even last another day at the rate he's going!

an-unwelcome-surprise-meeting-at-the-hau.speaker: Damien Leucurte
an-unwelcome-surprise-meeting-at-the-hau.text: I tire of your arrogance. We're done here.

an-unwelcome-surprise-meeting-at-the-hau.speaker: Werewolf
an-unwelcome-surprise-meeting-at-the-hau.text: Yes, we are. See you around Damien.

an-unwelcome-surprise-meeting-at-the-hau.speaker: Werewolf
an-unwelcome-surprise-meeting-at-the-hau.text: Or not.
The werewolves leave the meeting.

an-unwelcome-surprise-meeting-at-the-hau.speaker: Veliaf Hurtz
an-unwelcome-surprise-meeting-at-the-hau.text: So it's as we suspected. The werewolves have been taking people from across the Salve.

an-unwelcome-surprise-meeting-at-the-hau.player: But they've been doing so without permission, just like in Slepe.

an-unwelcome-surprise-meeting-at-the-hau.speaker: Veliaf Hurtz
