preparing-to-enter-prifddinas-talking-to.text: While the Iorwerth clan may hold some magical knowledge... they are not mystics. I have no doubt that their work was crude at best, work that a true master of the magical arts could overcome.

preparing-to-enter-prifddinas-talking-to.player: I see. And where do we find a true master of the magical arts?

preparing-to-enter-prifddinas-talking-to.speaker: Arianwyn
preparing-to-enter-prifddinas-talking-to.text: There were eight separate elven clans that journeyed with Seren to this world. Those eight clans still exist today, with each elf born into one of them.

preparing-to-enter-prifddinas-talking-to.speaker: Arianwyn
preparing-to-enter-prifddinas-talking-to.text: You'll have already heard of some of the clans. The Iorwerth clan is known to you, the traitorous clan of assassins and slayers.

preparing-to-enter-prifddinas-talking-to.speaker: Baxtorian
preparing-to-enter-prifddinas-talking-to.text: And the Cadarn clan of course, the warrior clan of which myself and Arianwyn are part of.

preparing-to-enter-prifddinas-talking-to.speaker: Arianwyn
preparing-to-enter-prifddinas-talking-to.text: The other clans you might be less familiar with. However, one of those clans is key here, the Amlodd clan, the clan of mystics.

preparing-to-enter-prifddinas-talking-to.speaker: Baxtorian
preparing-to-enter-prifddinas-talking-to.text: It was the Amlodd clan who created the Prifddinas defences. Their clan should have the knowledge needed to overcome them. And of all the Amlodd clan, none know more than Lord Ieuan Amlodd himself.

preparing-to-enter-prifddinas-talking-to.player: And where do we find him?

preparing-to-enter-prifddinas-talking-to.speaker: Baxtorian
preparing-to-enter-prifddinas-talking-to.text: After Prifddinas was reverted to seed, the clan elders went into hiding. Before we parted ways, the others did leave me with some clues on how to find them.

preparing-to-enter-prifddinas-talking-to.speaker: Arianwyn
preparing-to-enter-prifddinas-talking-to.text: Lord Amlodd may be our priority, but the other elders could be of great help in our fight against Lord Iorwerth. We should try and find them all.

preparing-to-enter-prifddinas-talking-to.speaker: Baxtorian
preparing-to-enter-prifddinas-talking-to.text: I've managed to decipher the clue left behind by Lord Amlodd. We should be able to use it to find him. I've also started work on the other clues.

preparing-to-enter-prifddinas-talking-to.speaker: Baxtorian
preparing-to-enter-prifddinas-talking-to.text: Apart from Lord Amlodd, I've only been able to decipher Lady Trahaearn's clue so far. I'll keep working on the others though.

preparing-to-enter-prifddinas-talking-to.speaker: Arianwyn
preparing-to-enter-prifddinas-talking-to.text: [player name], myself and Baxtorian will continue to work on deciphering these clues. While we do, it would be of great help if you could find Lord Amlodd and Lady Trahaearn for us.

options.text: How do I find Lord Amlodd?

steps.player: How do I find Lord Amlodd?

steps.speaker: Baxtorian
steps.text: Here is the clue he left behind: 'The elven crystal will lead you to me.'

steps.player: I see, anything else I should know?

steps.speaker: Baxtorian
steps.text: The Amlodd clan is a clan of mystics. Some sort of magic may be key to finding Lord Amlodd. You might also find this of use, Lord Amlodd gave it to me before we went our seperate ways.
If the player has no inventory space:
Baxtorian tries to give you a crystal seed but you don't have enough room to take it.
If the player has inventory space:
Baxtorian gives you a crystal seed.

options.text: How do I find Lady Trahaearn?

steps.player: How do I find Lady Trahaearn?

steps.speaker: Baxtorian
steps.text: Here is the clue she left behind: 'I will journey south from the well.'

steps.player: I see, anything else I should know?

steps.speaker: Baxtorian
steps.text: The Trahaearn clan is a clan of smiths and miners. It's possible that you'll need to use your smithing and mining skills to find Lady Trahaearn.

steps.player: Okay, I'll get started.

preparing-to-enter-prifddinas-talking-to.player: What do I need to do now?

preparing-to-enter-prifddinas-talking-to.speaker: Arianwyn
preparing-to-enter-prifddinas-talking-to.text: We need you to find Lord Amlodd and Lady Trahaearn for us. Speak to Baxtorian, he can tell you about the clues they left behind.

preparing-to-enter-prifddinas-talking-to.speaker: Baxtorian
preparing-to-enter-prifddinas-talking-to.text: Oh... Hello there.

options.text: How do I find Lord Amlodd?
How do I find Lady Trahaearn?
I'd like to ask you something about yourself.

preparing-to-enter-prifddinas-finding-lo.text: It's a small crystal seed. It looks to be inactive. It will need enchanting before it can do anything.

preparing-to-enter-prifddinas-finding-lo.speaker: Eluned
preparing-to-enter-prifddinas-finding-lo.text: Hello again, how is it going?

preparing-to-enter-prifddinas-finding-lo.speaker: Eluned
preparing-to-enter-prifddinas-finding-lo.text: It's good to have you helping us. We're all very grateful.

options.text: I have a seed from Baxtorian that I think needs enchanting.

steps.player: I have a seed from Baxtorian that I think needs enchanting.

steps.speaker: Eluned
steps.text: Okay, let me see what I can do with it.
Eluned hands you an enchanted crystal seed.

steps.speaker: Eluned
steps.text: There you go. Be careful with it, I'm not sure what it will do when used.

steps.player: Thanks for the warning, see you later.

options.text: It's the least I can do. I'll see you later.

steps.player: It's the least I can do. I'll see you later.

preparing-to-enter-prifddinas-a-mysterio.text: The player rubs the seed, arriving at the Enchanted Valley next to a Mysterious Figure.

preparing-to-enter-prifddinas-a-mysterio.speaker: Mysterious Figure
preparing-to-enter-prifddinas-a-mysterio.text: Look at this place... It's beautiful, is it not?

preparing-to-enter-prifddinas-a-mysterio.speaker: Mysterious Figure
preparing-to-enter-prifddinas-a-mysterio.text: Amlodd? A curious name... Why do you ask?

preparing-to-enter-prifddinas-a-mysterio.player: Baxtorian sent me. He gave me a crystal that belonged to Lord Amlodd. It brought me here, to you.

preparing-to-enter-prifddinas-a-mysterio.speaker: Mysterious Figure
preparing-to-enter-prifddinas-a-mysterio.text: I have a question for you. This valley before us, how would you describe it?

steps.player: Beautiful.

steps.speaker: Mysterious Figure
steps.text: Yes... It's nice to look upon such beauty, it reminds me of my home. The crystal spires of Prifddinas.

steps.player: Dangerous.

steps.speaker: Mysterious Figure
steps.text: Yes... This world... it's so peaceful, so beautiful. But there is still danger here. It takes me back to the forests near my home, before Lord Iorwerth brought a different danger upon us.

steps.player: Peaceful.

steps.speaker: Mysterious Figure
steps.text: Yes... It is a welcome break from the wars of my home, the wars of Lord Iorwerth.

steps.player: Boring.

steps.speaker: Mysterious Figure
steps.text: I suppose it can seem that way. Little to see and little to do. But there is beauty in that simplicity, much like the forest of Isafdar.

steps.player: I don't know.

steps.speaker: Mysterious Figure
steps.text: The answers are not always easy to find. I have had time to reflect here, to consider this world. Maybe you need more time to find your own answer. Alas, it is time we do not have, for Lord Iorwerth awaits.

preparing-to-enter-prifddinas-a-mysterio.speaker: Lord Ieuan Amlodd
preparing-to-enter-prifddinas-a-mysterio.text: Indeed, and if Baxtorian sent you, then it is time for me to leave this place. Tell me human, where must I travel to?

preparing-to-enter-prifddinas-a-mysterio.player: The village of Lletya, in the forest of Isafdar.

preparing-to-enter-prifddinas-a-mysterio.speaker: Lord Ieuan Amlodd
preparing-to-enter-prifddinas-a-mysterio.text: Then we shall leave at once. Allow me to teleport you back with me.
Lord Amlodd teleports you both back to Lletya.

preparing-to-enter-prifddinas-a-mysterio.speaker: Lord Ieuan Amlodd
preparing-to-enter-prifddinas-a-mysterio.text: The rebels have created a wonderful village here. A safe refuge from the tyranny of Lord Iorwerth. Curious how something so beautiful could be born of something so terrible.

preparing-to-enter-prifddinas-a-mysterio.player: They've done well to keep up the fight for this long.

preparing-to-enter-prifddinas-a-mysterio.speaker: Lord Ieuan Amlodd
preparing-to-enter-prifddinas-a-mysterio.text: They have, but I'd expect no less of them. The song of the elves has been sung for thousands of years, it will continue for thousands more.

preparing-to-enter-prifddinas-a-mysterio.speaker: Lord Ieuan Amlodd
preparing-to-enter-prifddinas-a-mysterio.text: However, I fear that this verse is the darkest yet.

preparing-to-enter-prifddinas-finding-la.text: She seems to be in a deep sleep. She's wearing a strange exoskeleton made from runite. The exoskeleton is damaged and needs repairing.

preparing-to-enter-prifddinas-finding-la.speaker: Lady Tangwen Trahaearn
preparing-to-enter-prifddinas-finding-la.text: Who has awoken me? A human? You are not who I expected.

preparing-to-enter-prifddinas-finding-la.player: Baxtorian sent me. We need your help in the fight against Lord Iorwerth.

preparing-to-enter-prifddinas-finding-la.speaker: Lady Tangwen Trahaearn
preparing-to-enter-prifddinas-finding-la.text: Baxtorian lives? And he is working with a human? This is most irregular. I see you repaired my exoskeleton as well. Impressive work for a human, but again, most irregular.

preparing-to-enter-prifddinas-finding-la.speaker: Lady Tangwen Trahaearn
preparing-to-enter-prifddinas-finding-la.text: Tell me human, where is Baxtorian?

preparing-to-enter-prifddinas-finding-la.player: He's in the elven village of Lletya, south of here.

preparing-to-enter-prifddinas-finding-la.speaker: Lady Tangwen Trahaearn
preparing-to-enter-prifddinas-finding-la.text: Then I will journey there at once. There is clearly a lot I need to catch up on.

preparing-to-enter-prifddinas-finding-la.speaker: Lady Tangwen Trahaearn
preparing-to-enter-prifddinas-finding-la.text: These rebels had better get a move on and defeat Lord Iorwerth. Old ladies like me have a tendency to drop dead, and I'll be very annoyed if that happens before I see Prifddinas again.

preparing-to-enter-prifddinas-finding-la.player: How can you be annoyed if you're dead?

preparing-to-enter-prifddinas-finding-la.speaker: Lady Tangwen Trahaearn
preparing-to-enter-prifddinas-finding-la.text: Oh I'll cook up quite the storm in the afterlife, believe me.

preparing-to-enter-prifddinas-finding-la.speaker: Arianwyn
preparing-to-enter-prifddinas-finding-la.text: Good job finding Lord Amlodd and Lady Trahaearn. Now, you should probably go see how that seed you planted is doing.

preparing-to-enter-prifddinas-finding-la.player: Good idea, I'll go see Elena.

preparing-to-enter-prifddinas-finding-la.speaker: Baxtorian
preparing-to-enter-prifddinas-finding-la.text: Oh... Hello there. Thank you for finding Lord Amlodd and Lady Trahaearn.

preparing-to-enter-prifddinas-finding-la.speaker: Baxtorian
preparing-to-enter-prifddinas-finding-la.text: Have you checked in with Elena recently? That seed has probably grown by now.

options.text: I'd like to ask you something about yourself.

steps.player: I'll go talk to her.

preparing-to-enter-prifddinas-making-the.speaker: Elena
preparing-to-enter-prifddinas-making-the.text: Hey [player name]. The elder cadantine herb grew perfectly. Let's get it harvested.
Elena harvests the elder cadantine.

preparing-to-enter-prifddinas-making-the.player: So what else do we need for the potion?

preparing-to-enter-prifddinas-making-the.speaker: Elena
preparing-to-enter-prifddinas-making-the.text: The other ingredient is crystal dust. Hopefully you can get some from Arianwyn or Baxtorian. Once you've got some dust, just add it to a vial of water along with the herb.

preparing-to-enter-prifddinas-making-the.player: Right, I'll go see if I can get some crystal dust.

preparing-to-enter-prifddinas-making-the.speaker: Elena
preparing-to-enter-prifddinas-making-the.text: Don't forget this.
If the player has no inventory space:

steps.text: Elena tries to give you some elder cadantine but you don't have enough room for it.

preparing-to-enter-prifddinas-making-the.text: If the player has inventory space:

steps.text: Elena gives you some elder cadantine.

preparing-to-enter-prifddinas-making-the.player: Hey Elena, what do I need to do again?

preparing-to-enter-prifddinas-making-the.speaker: Elena
preparing-to-enter-prifddinas-making-the.text: Add the elder cadantine to a vial of water and then add some crystal dust. Hopefully either Arianwyn or Baxtorian can give you some crystal dust.

preparing-to-enter-prifddinas-making-the.speaker: Baxtorian
preparing-to-enter-prifddinas-making-the.text: Oh... Hello. Do you need something?

preparing-to-enter-prifddinas-making-the.player: I need some crystal dust for this potion I'm making.

preparing-to-enter-prifddinas-making-the.speaker: Baxtorian
preparing-to-enter-prifddinas-making-the.text: Ah yes... I don't have anything you can use I'm afraid. Maybe Arianwyn can help you.

preparing-to-enter-prifddinas-making-the.speaker: Arianwyn
preparing-to-enter-prifddinas-making-the.text: Hello [player name]. How's it going?

preparing-to-enter-prifddinas-making-the.player: I'm working on getting that potion made. I need some crystal dust for it though.

preparing-to-enter-prifddinas-making-the.speaker: Arianwyn
preparing-to-enter-prifddinas-making-the.text: Crystal dust? Interesting. Well I have an old crystal here that you can use. It will need grinding up though.
If the player has no inventory space:

steps.text: Arianwyn tries to give you an old crystal but you don't have enough room to take it.

preparing-to-enter-prifddinas-making-the.text: If the player has inventory space:

steps.text: Arianwyn gives you an old crystal.

preparing-to-enter-prifddinas-making-the.speaker: Arianwyn
preparing-to-enter-prifddinas-making-the.text: Hello [player name]. How's it going?

preparing-to-enter-prifddinas-making-the.player: I'm working on getting that potion made. I need some crystal dust for it though.

preparing-to-enter-prifddinas-making-the.speaker: Arianwyn
preparing-to-enter-prifddinas-making-the.text: Why don't you try using that crystal I gave you?

preparing-to-enter-prifddinas-making-the.speaker: Elena
preparing-to-enter-prifddinas-making-the.text: Hey [player name].

preparing-to-enter-prifddinas-making-the.player: Hey Elena, I've finished the potion.

preparing-to-enter-prifddinas-making-the.speaker: Elena
preparing-to-enter-prifddinas-making-the.text: Great, you should take it to Arianwyn and Baxtorian.

preparing-to-enter-prifddinas-making-the.speaker: Baxtorian
preparing-to-enter-prifddinas-making-the.text: Oh... Hello. Do you need something?

preparing-to-enter-prifddinas-making-the.speaker: Baxtorian
preparing-to-enter-prifddinas-making-the.text: Oh... You should give it to Arianwyn then.

preparing-to-enter-prifddinas-making-the.player: I should probably take this to Arianwyn and Baxtorian rather than drinking it.

preparing-to-enter-prifddinas-making-the.speaker: Arianwyn
preparing-to-enter-prifddinas-making-the.text: Hello [player name]. How's it going?

preparing-to-enter-prifddinas-making-the.speaker: Arianwyn
preparing-to-enter-prifddinas-making-the.text: Great, I'll look after it for you. Now, let's call the others and discuss our plan for the Grand Library.
Arianwyn calls the others to the meeting.

preparing-to-enter-prifddinas-making-the.speaker: Arianwyn
preparing-to-enter-prifddinas-making-the.text: Right, thanks to [player name], we should now have everything we need to enter the crystal seed containing Prifddinas.

preparing-to-enter-prifddinas-making-the.speaker: Eluned
preparing-to-enter-prifddinas-making-the.text: So we have a way to bypass the defences?

preparing-to-enter-prifddinas-making-the.speaker: Arianwyn
preparing-to-enter-prifddinas-making-the.text: Indeed we do. Baxtorian's knowledge allowed [player name] to reunite us with Lord Amlodd and Lady Trahaearn. It was the Amlodd clan that created those defences, Lord Amlodd can overcome them for us.

preparing-to-enter-prifddinas-making-the.speaker: Lord Ieuan Amlodd
preparing-to-enter-prifddinas-making-the.text: My magic can be used to teleport someone through the defences and into the crystal. It will require great focus though, I will only be able to send one of you in.

preparing-to-enter-prifddinas-making-the.speaker: Baxtorian
preparing-to-enter-prifddinas-making-the.text: The inversion potion will ensure that whoever is sent survives the journey, now we just need to decide who that is.

preparing-to-enter-prifddinas-making-the.speaker: Islwyn
preparing-to-enter-prifddinas-making-the.text: I propose we send [player name] in. They have proven to us time and time again that they have the skill needed for a challenge like this.

preparing-to-enter-prifddinas-making-the.speaker: Ysgawyn
preparing-to-enter-prifddinas-making-the.text: You cannot be serious? Even if [player name] has proven their worth as you claim, which I have my doubts about, they'll never be deemed worthy enough to unlock Seren's hidden knowledge.

preparing-to-enter-prifddinas-making-the.speaker: Ilfeen
preparing-to-enter-prifddinas-making-the.text: Why? Because they're not an elf?

preparing-to-enter-prifddinas-making-the.speaker: Ysgawyn
preparing-to-enter-prifddinas-making-the.text: Exactly! If Seren created a way for the seals to be destroyed, she would have made it so that only an elf could break them.

preparing-to-enter-prifddinas-making-the.speaker: Lady Tangwen Trahaearn
preparing-to-enter-prifddinas-making-the.text: Were you there when Seren made those seals, boy?

preparing-to-enter-prifddinas-making-the.speaker: Ysgawyn
preparing-to-enter-prifddinas-making-the.text: I... Well of course not.

preparing-to-enter-prifddinas-making-the.speaker: Lady Tangwen Trahaearn
preparing-to-enter-prifddinas-making-the.text: Then how do you know what our goddess intended?

preparing-to-enter-prifddinas-making-the.speaker: Ysgawyn
preparing-to-enter-prifddinas-making-the.text: I just think...

preparing-to-enter-prifddinas-making-the.speaker: Lady Tangwen Trahaearn
preparing-to-enter-prifddinas-making-the.text: I don't know this human here, but I damn well don't know you either. The human was capable enough to find me and fix my exoskeleton. Maybe they are capable of this as well.

preparing-to-enter-prifddinas-making-the.speaker: Arianwyn
preparing-to-enter-prifddinas-making-the.text: Then I propose that [player name] be the one sent into the crystal. Anyone disagree?

preparing-to-enter-prifddinas-making-the.speaker: Arianwyn
preparing-to-enter-prifddinas-making-the.text: Yes we already know you do Ysgawyn. Anyone else?

preparing-to-enter-prifddinas-making-the.speaker: Arianwyn
preparing-to-enter-prifddinas-making-the.text: Right, [player name], talk to Lord Amlodd when you are ready. Good luck.
The others leave the meeting.

preparing-to-enter-prifddinas-making-the.speaker: Baxtorian
preparing-to-enter-prifddinas-making-the.text: I... Hello. You should probably talk to Lord Amlodd.

options.text: I'd like to ask you something about yourself.

steps.player: Okay, will do.

preparing-to-enter-prifddinas-making-the.speaker: Arianwyn
preparing-to-enter-prifddinas-making-the.text: Good luck in the library, [player name]. We're all counting on you. Speak to Lord Amlodd when you're ready.

preparing-to-enter-prifddinas-making-the.speaker: Elena
preparing-to-enter-prifddinas-making-the.text: Hey [player name] Good luck in the library. We'll talk more when you get back.

the-grand-library-of-prifddinas-entering.speaker: Lord Ieuan Amlodd
the-grand-library-of-prifddinas-entering.text: The Grand Library of Prifddinas, such a beautiful place. You will be the first to step foot there for hundreds of years.

the-grand-library-of-prifddinas-entering.player: What do I need to do once I arrive?

the-grand-library-of-prifddinas-entering.speaker: Lord Ieuan Amlodd
the-grand-library-of-prifddinas-entering.text: They say Lord Iorwerth broke one of the nine seals of Seren within the library. Find this seal, and see what knowledge he uncovered.

the-grand-library-of-prifddinas-entering.speaker: Lord Ieuan Amlodd
the-grand-library-of-prifddinas-entering.text: Once that is done, seek out the other eight seals, see if you can break them as well. Their knowledge may be key to our fight against the darkness.

the-grand-library-of-prifddinas-entering.player: Do you have any idea how to break the seals?

the-grand-library-of-prifddinas-entering.speaker: Lord Ieuan Amlodd
the-grand-library-of-prifddinas-entering.text: According to Baxtorian, Seren herself said that those who follow the light will be able to access her knowledge.

the-grand-library-of-prifddinas-entering.player: That doesn't give me a lot to go on.

the-grand-library-of-prifddinas-entering.speaker: Lord Ieuan Amlodd
the-grand-library-of-prifddinas-entering.text: No, but it is all you have. Now, when you are ready, I can teleport you into the crystal seed. I have the potion that you made earlier, it will ensure you survive the journey.

the-grand-library-of-prifddinas-entering.speaker: Lord Ieuan Amlodd
the-grand-library-of-prifddinas-entering.text: One last thing, the laws that this land abide by, they may not apply in the library.

the-grand-library-of-prifddinas-entering.speaker: Lord Ieuan Amlodd
the-grand-library-of-prifddinas-entering.text: The library has been reverted to crystal. That which is impossible out here, may well be normal in an environment like that. You should be cautious.
You are about to enter the Grand Library of Prifddinas. Any items left in the library, including upon death, will be lost.

steps.player: Let me go and prepare first.

steps.speaker: Lord Ieuan Amlodd
steps.text: As you wish.

the-grand-library-of-prifddinas-entering.speaker: Lord Ieuan Amlodd
the-grand-library-of-prifddinas-entering.text: Do you wish to return to the Grand Library?

steps.player: Not right now.

steps.speaker: Lord Ieuan Amlodd
steps.text: As you wish.

the-grand-library-of-prifddinas-the-seal.speaker: Seren
the-grand-library-of-prifddinas-the-seal.text: And so comes another, to seek the knowledge of Seren. Greetings mortal.

the-grand-library-of-prifddinas-the-seal.speaker: Memory of Seren
the-grand-library-of-prifddinas-the-seal.text: No... I'm just a memory. A mere fragment of something far greater. A guardian of the knowledge that she left behind.

the-grand-library-of-prifddinas-the-seal.player: I seek that knowledge, to help in the fight against Lord Iorwerth.

the-grand-library-of-prifddinas-the-seal.speaker: Memory of Seren
the-grand-library-of-prifddinas-the-seal.text: It is not my place to question why. I only exist to pass on that which she sealed away.

the-grand-library-of-prifddinas-the-seal.player: So you'll give me the knowledge?

the-grand-library-of-prifddinas-the-seal.speaker: Memory of Seren
the-grand-library-of-prifddinas-the-seal.text: The seals guard the truth. This seal has been broken, its knowledge is now open to all. Here is what you seek:

the-grand-library-of-prifddinas-the-seal.speaker: Memory of Seren
the-grand-library-of-prifddinas-the-seal.text: '...Therein lies my guilt. A part of me, trapped and alone. Dark, yes, but still a part of my being, sealed away in the Temple of Light.'

the-grand-library-of-prifddinas-the-seal.speaker: Memory of Seren
the-grand-library-of-prifddinas-the-seal.text: 'The protections on the temple, they should keep her contained. But in case they don't, I created one last safeguard, a prison within a prison. With it I made a key, an orb of light, to unlock the darkness.'

the-grand-library-of-prifddinas-the-seal.speaker: Memory of Seren
the-grand-library-of-prifddinas-the-seal.text: 'I could have destroyed it, sealed her away forever. But I still question my decision, and so I hid the orb away, while I think upon my choices.'

the-grand-library-of-prifddinas-the-seal.speaker: Memory of Seren
the-grand-library-of-prifddinas-the-seal.text: 'The shrine at Gorlah, that is where it lies. With it, she can be freed... or destroyed...'

the-grand-library-of-prifddinas-the-seal.speaker: Memory of Seren
the-grand-library-of-prifddinas-the-seal.text: And so ends the knowledge of this seal.

the-grand-library-of-prifddinas-the-seal.player: So Lord Iorwerth spoke the truth. A part of Seren lives within the Temple of Light. But why?

the-grand-library-of-prifddinas-the-seal.speaker: Memory of Seren
the-grand-library-of-prifddinas-the-seal.text: I have imparted the knowledge of this seal. There is nothing more here to give. If you seek the rest, then the other seals must be broken.

the-grand-library-of-prifddinas-the-seal.speaker: Memory of Seren
the-grand-library-of-prifddinas-the-seal.text: Start with the Seal of Ithell, to the south east. The light will guide the way...

the-grand-library-of-prifddinas-the-seal.speaker: Memory of Seren
the-grand-library-of-prifddinas-the-seal.text: The seeker of knowledge returns. Do you wish to hear the knowledge again?

steps.player: Yes please.

steps.speaker: Memory of Seren
steps.text: Here is what you seek:

steps.speaker: Memory of Seren
steps.text: And so ends the knowledge of this seal.

steps.speaker: Memory of Seren
steps.text: If you seek more of the knowledge, look to the Seal of Ithell. You'll find it on the middle level, to the south east. The light will guide the way...

steps.player: No thanks.

steps.speaker: Memory of Seren
steps.text: Then I have nothing more to give. If you seek more of the knowledge, look to the Seal of Ithell. You'll find it on the middle level, to the south east. The light will guide the way...

the-grand-library-of-prifddinas-the-seal.speaker: Memory of Seren
the-grand-library-of-prifddinas-the-seal.text: 'When I first encountered the elves on their homeworld of Tarddiad, it was like I had finally found my purpose. I quickly fell in love with them, and they with me.'

the-grand-library-of-prifddinas-the-seal.speaker: Memory of Seren
the-grand-library-of-prifddinas-the-seal.text: 'I set out to help them, to guide them. They immediately embraced this, and one of their mystics, Ceidwad, documented my teachings in a great book called the Cerddi.'

the-grand-library-of-prifddinas-the-seal.speaker: Memory of Seren
the-grand-library-of-prifddinas-the-seal.text: 'It was the start of something beautiful, but there is pain in beauty, as I soon came to realise...'

the-grand-library-of-prifddinas-the-seal.speaker: Memory of Seren
the-grand-library-of-prifddinas-the-seal.text: And so ends the knowledge of this seal.

the-grand-library-of-prifddinas-the-seal.speaker: Memory of Seren
the-grand-library-of-prifddinas-the-seal.text: If you seek more of the knowledge, look to the Seal of Cadarn. You'll find it on the bottom level, to the south. The light will guide the way...
You hear a strange sound coming from the central chamber.

the-grand-library-of-prifddinas-the-seal.speaker: Memory of Seren
the-grand-library-of-prifddinas-the-seal.text: '...Compared to many of the mortal races I had encountered, the elves had reasonable lifespans. And yet, it wasn't long enough.'

the-grand-library-of-prifddinas-the-seal.speaker: Memory of Seren
the-grand-library-of-prifddinas-the-seal.text: 'As I spent time with the elves, I watched as they withered and died. Each death was a blade through my heart, but none more so than Ceidwad, my closest companion.'

the-grand-library-of-prifddinas-the-seal.speaker: Memory of Seren
the-grand-library-of-prifddinas-the-seal.text: 'It didn't seem fair, didn't seem right. They deserved more. I knew I had to give it to them...'

the-grand-library-of-prifddinas-the-seal.speaker: Memory of Seren
the-grand-library-of-prifddinas-the-seal.text: And so ends the knowledge of this seal.

the-grand-library-of-prifddinas-the-seal.text: '...I found a way to share my essence with the elves, a piece of my being for each one of them.'

the-grand-library-of-prifddinas-the-seal.speaker: Memory of Seren
the-grand-library-of-prifddinas-the-seal.text: 'With this gift, their years would number in the thousands, time enough to live the lives they deserved.'

the-grand-library-of-prifddinas-the-seal.speaker: Memory of Seren
the-grand-library-of-prifddinas-the-seal.text: 'In keeping with elven tradition, the gift was given through a song. They called it the song of creation, for it was the creation of a new life for them. At least, so we thought...'

the-grand-library-of-prifddinas-the-seal.text: '...With all my knowledge, I should have known not to meddle. That which I intended as a gift, soon turned out to be their curse.'

the-grand-library-of-prifddinas-the-seal.speaker: Memory of Seren
the-grand-library-of-prifddinas-the-seal.text: 'The song of creation increased their lifespans, but at a terrible price. It bound them to me. To stray too far from their sides, caused pain, and even death.'

the-grand-library-of-prifddinas-the-seal.speaker: Memory of Seren
the-grand-library-of-prifddinas-the-seal.text: 'I knew I had to help them, to fix my mistakes. I should have known that I'd only make it worse...'

the-grand-library-of-prifddinas-the-seal.speaker: Memory of Seren
the-grand-library-of-prifddinas-the-seal.text: 'I was sure I could use this power to save them. My essence is of life, of light. This darkness would be the perfect counter, a way to nullify the curse.'

the-grand-library-of-prifddinas-the-seal.speaker: Memory of Seren

the-grand-library-of-prifddinas-the-seal.speaker: Memory of Seren
the-grand-library-of-prifddinas-the-seal.text: 'When I was done, I looked upon my creation. A fragment of myself, but one of darkness, rather than light. I thought her essence would counter my own, ending the curse with her mere existence.'

the-grand-library-of-prifddinas-the-seal.speaker: Memory of Seren
the-grand-library-of-prifddinas-the-seal.text: 'It was not to be though. The curse was tied to me, not to her. I had failed, and she knew it. She turned on me, tried to destroy me. I had to stop her, so I sealed her away, in the very place I had created her...'

the-grand-library-of-prifddinas-the-seal.speaker: Memory of Seren

reporting-back-after-the-revelations-dia.speaker: Lord Ieuan Amlodd
reporting-back-after-the-revelations-dia.text: Your work in the library, is it done?

reporting-back-after-the-revelations-dia.speaker: Lord Ieuan Amlodd
reporting-back-after-the-revelations-dia.text: Then you should speak with Arianwyn at once.

reporting-back-after-the-revelations-dia.speaker: Baxtorian
reporting-back-after-the-revelations-dia.text: I see... You should tell Arianwyn.

reporting-back-after-the-revelations-dia.speaker: Elena
reporting-back-after-the-revelations-dia.text: Hey [player name]. You'd better speak with Arianwyn if you're done in the library.

reporting-back-after-the-revelations-the.speaker: Arianwyn
reporting-back-after-the-revelations-the.text: [player name], you have returned. Did you discover anything in the Grand Library?

reporting-back-after-the-revelations-the.player: I did. I think we should call the others.

reporting-back-after-the-revelations-the.speaker: Arianwyn
reporting-back-after-the-revelations-the.text: I see. I will summon them at once.
Arianwyn calls the others to the meeting.

reporting-back-after-the-revelations-the.speaker: Arianwyn
reporting-back-after-the-revelations-the.text: Okay, thank you all for joining us. In case you weren't aware, [player name] here has returned from the Grand Library with some news for us.

reporting-back-after-the-revelations-the.speaker: Ilfeen
reporting-back-after-the-revelations-the.text: So what happened?

reporting-back-after-the-revelations-the.player: I entered the library and found the seal broken by Lord Iorwerth.

reporting-back-after-the-revelations-the.speaker: Islwyn
reporting-back-after-the-revelations-the.text: So he did break one of the seals. Did it hide anything notable?

reporting-back-after-the-revelations-the.player: Yes, it contained a memory, left behind by Seren herself.

reporting-back-after-the-revelations-the.speaker: Eluned
reporting-back-after-the-revelations-the.text: A memory of Seren? Amazing!

reporting-back-after-the-revelations-the.player: It was only part of something larger though. I had to break the other eight seals to uncover the rest of it.

reporting-back-after-the-revelations-the.speaker: Arianwyn
reporting-back-after-the-revelations-the.text: So you managed to break all of Seren's seals? Very impressive [player name]. Now tell us, this memory, what was it?

reporting-back-after-the-revelations-the.player: That's where it gets interesting... The memory spoke of a curse on the elves, a curse that Seren was desperately trying to break.

reporting-back-after-the-revelations-the.speaker: Islwyn
reporting-back-after-the-revelations-the.text: A curse? What curse?

reporting-back-after-the-revelations-the.player: A curse binding the elves to Seren. As long as she remained close, it was unnoticeable, but if she went too far... pain, and death.

reporting-back-after-the-revelations-the.speaker: Ysgawyn
reporting-back-after-the-revelations-the.text: But who was responsible? Who cursed our people?

reporting-back-after-the-revelations-the.player: That's the thing... It was Seren herself.

reporting-back-after-the-revelations-the.speaker: Arianwyn
reporting-back-after-the-revelations-the.text: What?

reporting-back-after-the-revelations-the.speaker: Ysgawyn
reporting-back-after-the-revelations-the.text: Seren was our goddess, she would never curse us. How dare you suggest otherwise!

reporting-back-after-the-revelations-the.speaker: Ysgawyn
reporting-back-after-the-revelations-the.text: Truth? You don't know the meaning of the word!

reporting-back-after-the-revelations-the.speaker: Arianwyn
reporting-back-after-the-revelations-the.text: Let them finish Ysgawyn!

reporting-back-after-the-revelations-the.player: She didn't mean to do it, she was trying to help. She was using her own essence to try and extend your lifespans, it just went wrong...

reporting-back-after-the-revelations-the.speaker: Islwyn
reporting-back-after-the-revelations-the.text: I... I don't believe it. She cursed us? Our goddess cursed us?

reporting-back-after-the-revelations-the.speaker: Arianwyn
reporting-back-after-the-revelations-the.text: If... If what you say is true, how does it relate to Lord Iorwerth's claims?

reporting-back-after-the-revelations-the.player: Seren went to great lengths to undo the curse. She believed that she could nullify it by creating a being of darkness, one to counter her light essence.

reporting-back-after-the-revelations-the.speaker: Eluned
reporting-back-after-the-revelations-the.text: You don't mean...

reporting-back-after-the-revelations-the.player: Lord Iorwerth spoke the truth. She created a fragment of herself, filled with darkness, hoping to use it to break the curse. It didn't work though, so she sealed it in the Temple of Light.

reporting-back-after-the-revelations-the.speaker: Ilfeen
reporting-back-after-the-revelations-the.text: I... I don't...

reporting-back-after-the-revelations-the.speaker: Islwyn
reporting-back-after-the-revelations-the.text: This can't be real... This is a dream... Tell me this isn't real!

reporting-back-after-the-revelations-the.speaker: Ysgawyn
reporting-back-after-the-revelations-the.text: This is a lie! It has to be! The human is showing their true colours once again!

reporting-back-after-the-revelations-the.speaker: Lady Tangwen Trahaearn
reporting-back-after-the-revelations-the.text: Boy, what did I tell you about insulting the human!

reporting-back-after-the-revelations-the.speaker: Eluned
reporting-back-after-the-revelations-the.text: Arianwyn? What do we do?

reporting-back-after-the-revelations-the.speaker: Eluned
reporting-back-after-the-revelations-the.text: Arianwyn?

reporting-back-after-the-revelations-the.speaker: Ysgawyn
reporting-back-after-the-revelations-the.text: Why are we still stood here? This human needs putting in chains!

reporting-back-after-the-revelations-the.speaker: Eluned
reporting-back-after-the-revelations-the.text: Arianwyn? Do something!

reporting-back-after-the-revelations-the.speaker: Arianwyn
reporting-back-after-the-revelations-the.text: I... I don't...

reporting-back-after-the-revelations-the.speaker: Eluned
reporting-back-after-the-revelations-the.text: Arianwyn!

reporting-back-after-the-revelations-the.speaker: Arianwyn
reporting-back-after-the-revelations-the.text: I don't know what to do!

reporting-back-after-the-revelations-the.speaker: Arianwyn
reporting-back-after-the-revelations-the.text: I don't know what to do...

reporting-back-after-the-revelations-the.speaker: Arianwyn
reporting-back-after-the-revelations-the.text: You think I know something you all don't? You think I have some trick hidden up my sleeve? I have nothing!

reporting-back-after-the-revelations-the.speaker: Ysgawyn
reporting-back-after-the-revelations-the.text: You're our leader! Lead!

reporting-back-after-the-revelations-the.speaker: Arianwyn
reporting-back-after-the-revelations-the.text: And how would you have me do that, Ysgawyn? How am I meant to respond to this?

reporting-back-after-the-revelations-the.speaker: Ysgawyn
reporting-back-after-the-revelations-the.text: You can start by locking this human up. They are a traitor! The curse is clearly a lie!

reporting-back-after-the-revelations-the.speaker: Ysgawyn
reporting-back-after-the-revelations-the.text: If we were truly tied to Seren, we'd have all dropped dead when she was shattered! The curse clearly doesn't exist!

reporting-back-after-the-revelations-the.speaker: Baxtorian
reporting-back-after-the-revelations-the.text: Well... Don't be so sure of that.

reporting-back-after-the-revelations-the.speaker: Ysgawyn
reporting-back-after-the-revelations-the.text: Nice of you to suddenly speak up! I'd have thought a king would command a bit of authority rather than crying in the corner!

reporting-back-after-the-revelations-the.speaker: Baxtorian
reporting-back-after-the-revelations-the.text: I'm not a king any more...

reporting-back-after-the-revelations-the.speaker: Ysgawyn
reporting-back-after-the-revelations-the.text: Well thank Seren for that! You only managed to lose the entire kingdom to Lord Iorwerth!

reporting-back-after-the-revelations-the.speaker: Islwyn
reporting-back-after-the-revelations-the.text: You should learn some respect!

reporting-back-after-the-revelations-the.speaker: Ysgawyn
reporting-back-after-the-revelations-the.text: I have respect! I respect the heroes who died in this war, not the coward that ran away from it!

reporting-back-after-the-revelations-the.speaker: Baxtorian
reporting-back-after-the-revelations-the.text: You... You're right. I failed you, I failed you all. I wish I could go back and change that, but I can't. All I can do now, is try and make things right.

reporting-back-after-the-revelations-the.speaker: Baxtorian
reporting-back-after-the-revelations-the.text: While horrifying, I believe [player name] speaks the truth. They have no reason to lie to us, and what they say does make sense.

reporting-back-after-the-revelations-the.speaker: Islwyn
reporting-back-after-the-revelations-the.text: How?

reporting-back-after-the-revelations-the.speaker: Baxtorian
reporting-back-after-the-revelations-the.text: Most of you never met Seren. You only know her through the stories passed down to you. But I did know her, and I know she was filled with pain.

reporting-back-after-the-revelations-the.speaker: Ilfeen
reporting-back-after-the-revelations-the.text: You... You think this is the reason?

reporting-back-after-the-revelations-the.speaker: Baxtorian
reporting-back-after-the-revelations-the.text: I think it could be. As for why we don't feel the effects of the curse now, that is because Seren is still with us, every one of us.

reporting-back-after-the-revelations-the.speaker: Eluned
reporting-back-after-the-revelations-the.text: Of course, the crystal seeds. All of us carry them in some form or other, and all of them came from Seren when she shattered herself.

reporting-back-after-the-revelations-the.speaker: Baxtorian
reporting-back-after-the-revelations-the.text: Her last attempt to break the curse, after everything else failed...

reporting-back-after-the-revelations-the.speaker: Ilfeen
reporting-back-after-the-revelations-the.text: So what do we do?

reporting-back-after-the-revelations-the.player: There's one other thing. Seren built a second set of defences within the Temple of Light, this fragment of her is sealed within them. There's an orb that can bypass these defences.

reporting-back-after-the-revelations-the.speaker: Islwyn
reporting-back-after-the-revelations-the.text: An orb?

reporting-back-after-the-revelations-the.player: Yes, apparently she hid it somewhere called Gorlah.

reporting-back-after-the-revelations-the.speaker: Baxtorian
reporting-back-after-the-revelations-the.text: I know of Gorlah. It's an old shrine north of Prifddinas, a place for quiet worship away from the city.

reporting-back-after-the-revelations-the.speaker: Ilfeen
reporting-back-after-the-revelations-the.text: Does Lord Iorwerth know about the orb?

reporting-back-after-the-revelations-the.speaker: Eluned
reporting-back-after-the-revelations-the.text: Then he might already have claimed it. We should send someone to check.

reporting-back-after-the-revelations-the.speaker: Ysgawyn
reporting-back-after-the-revelations-the.text: I will go. I wish to see some actual proof of what this human claims.

reporting-back-after-the-revelations-the.speaker: Islwyn
reporting-back-after-the-revelations-the.text: That's not your call. Arianwyn is in charge here.

reporting-back-after-the-revelations-the.speaker: Arianwyn
reporting-back-after-the-revelations-the.text: Am I? My whole life, I've been fighting Lord Iorwerth. My whole life, I've believed him to be a servant of Zamorak. Now I learn that everything I fought for was a lie.

reporting-back-after-the-revelations-the.speaker: Arianwyn
reporting-back-after-the-revelations-the.text: I don't even know what I'm leading any more...

reporting-back-after-the-revelations-the.speaker: Ilfeen
reporting-back-after-the-revelations-the.text: Maybe Lord Iorwerth fights for a different cause to what we thought, but that doesn't change who he is, that doesn't change what he's done.

reporting-back-after-the-revelations-the.speaker: Arianwyn
reporting-back-after-the-revelations-the.text: I need time alone... Time to think... Baxtorian, I would appreciate it if you could take charge for a while.

reporting-back-after-the-revelations-the.speaker: Baxtorian
reporting-back-after-the-revelations-the.text: Oh... I... I'll do my best.

reporting-back-after-the-revelations-the.speaker: Arianwyn
reporting-back-after-the-revelations-the.text: That's all I ask. Now, I would like to be alone.

reporting-back-after-the-revelations-the.speaker: Eluned
reporting-back-after-the-revelations-the.text: You're not the only one. I think we all need time to process this.

reporting-back-after-the-revelations-the.speaker: Baxtorian
reporting-back-after-the-revelations-the.text: Then let us close this meeting. We will reconvene later.
The others leave the meeting.

reporting-back-after-the-revelations-tal.player: So what do we do now?

reporting-back-after-the-revelations-tal.speaker: Baxtorian
reporting-back-after-the-revelations-tal.text: There's a lot to think about, for all of us. There's also a lot we still don't know.

reporting-back-after-the-revelations-tal.player: Do you think Arianwyn will be okay?

reporting-back-after-the-revelations-tal.speaker: Baxtorian
reporting-back-after-the-revelations-tal.text: I hope so... I know the pain he feels, it can tear you apart if you're not careful.

reporting-back-after-the-revelations-tal.player: You seem to be dealing with it okay.

reporting-back-after-the-revelations-tal.speaker: Baxtorian
reporting-back-after-the-revelations-tal.text: I'm glad it seems that way, that's not how it feels though. I knew of Seren's troubles, but to know the cause... it's heart-breaking.

reporting-back-after-the-revelations-tal.speaker: Baxtorian
reporting-back-after-the-revelations-tal.text: Now I find myself leading once more, something I swore I would never do again.

reporting-back-after-the-revelations-tal.player: Arianwyn seems to think you're capable.

reporting-back-after-the-revelations-tal.speaker: Baxtorian
reporting-back-after-the-revelations-tal.text: Yes... But Arianwyn doesn't know me, not really.

reporting-back-after-the-revelations-tal.speaker: Baxtorian
reporting-back-after-the-revelations-tal.text: Anyway, I suppose my job now is to make sure we don't lose sight of our goal.

reporting-back-after-the-revelations-tal.player: Do we know what that is anymore?

reporting-back-after-the-revelations-tal.speaker: Baxtorian
reporting-back-after-the-revelations-tal.text: To stop Lord Iorwerth. Even if we now know his true intentions, even if some think those intentions may be good, we can't ignore his actions.

reporting-back-after-the-revelations-tal.speaker: Baxtorian
reporting-back-after-the-revelations-tal.text: He'd see us all dead just to free this fragment of Seren. He has to be stopped.

reporting-back-after-the-revelations-tal.player: What do you need me to do?

reporting-back-after-the-revelations-tal.speaker: Baxtorian
reporting-back-after-the-revelations-tal.text: Ysgawyn has gone to see if he can find the orb you spoke of. No one actually gave him permission, but he seems to care little for orders at the moment.

reporting-back-after-the-revelations-tal.speaker: Baxtorian
reporting-back-after-the-revelations-tal.text: Once he gets back we'll know more about what to do next. In the meantime, I've managed to decipher the clues left behind by Lord Crwys and Lady Hefin, two more of the clan elders. We should try to find them.

options.text: How do I find Lord Crwys?

steps.player: How do I find Lord Crwys?

steps.speaker: Baxtorian
steps.text: Here is the clue he left behind: 'The trees of my home will call to me.'

steps.player: I see, anything else I should know?

steps.speaker: Baxtorian
steps.text: The Crwys clan is a clan of woodcutters and farmers. The entire clan is close to nature, but none more than Lord Crwys.

options.text: How do I find Lady Hefin?

steps.player: How do I find Lady Hefin?

steps.speaker: Baxtorian
steps.text: Here is the clue she left behind: 'I will walk across the water to the south.'

steps.player: I see, anything else I should know?

steps.speaker: Baxtorian
steps.text: The Hefin clan are our religious leaders. They teach us to better ourselves, not just in mind, but in body as well. Lady Hefin used to lead some of the more vigorous training exercises of the Hefin clan.

options.text: I'd like to ask you something about yourself.

reporting-back-after-the-revelations-tal.player: What do I need to do again?

reporting-back-after-the-revelations-tal.speaker: Baxtorian
reporting-back-after-the-revelations-tal.text: You should try and find Lord Crwys and Lady Hefin. They could be of big help to us in the fight against Lord Iorwerth.

options.text: How do I find Lord Crwys?
How do I find Lady Hefin?
I'd like to ask you something about yourself.

reporting-back-after-the-revelations-fin.speaker: Lord Piquan Crwys
reporting-back-after-the-revelations-fin.text: A tree? No of course not! I am an elf, but through deep magic, I took on the form of a tree. It allowed me to hide, to stay safe.

reporting-back-after-the-revelations-fin.player: Yes. You must be Lord Crwys, Baxtorian sent me to find you. We need your help.
The village of Lletya. It's east of here.

reporting-back-after-the-revelations-fin.speaker: Lord Piquan Crwys
reporting-back-after-the-revelations-fin.text: Then it is time for me to uproot. I will head there at once.

reporting-back-after-the-revelations-fin.speaker: Lord Piquan Crwys
reporting-back-after-the-revelations-fin.text: It's strange to be an elf again. I spent so long living as a tree I almost forgot what my true form felt like.

reporting-back-after-the-revelations-fin.player: Maybe the tree was your true form and this is just your disguise.

reporting-back-after-the-revelations-fin.speaker: Lord Piquan Crwys
reporting-back-after-the-revelations-fin.text: Hmmm. Now there's an interesting thought...

reporting-back-after-the-revelations-fin.speaker: Elf Hermit
reporting-back-after-the-revelations-fin.text: A traveller? It's been a long time since I've had any company on this little island of mine.

reporting-back-after-the-revelations-fin.speaker: Elf Hermit
reporting-back-after-the-revelations-fin.text: I fear you are at a dead end though, there's nothing of interest for you here.

reporting-back-after-the-revelations-fin.player: Don't be so sure. I got here by following a clue, a clue left behind by Lady Hefin. I seek her on behalf of Baxtorian himself.

reporting-back-after-the-revelations-fin.speaker: Lady Carys Hefin
reporting-back-after-the-revelations-fin.text: Baxtorian? I see. Then I have good news for you human, you have found the one you seek.

reporting-back-after-the-revelations-fin.speaker: Lady Carys Hefin
reporting-back-after-the-revelations-fin.text: I am. I have lived here in solitude for a long time, but now that solitude must end. Where am I needed?

reporting-back-after-the-revelations-fin.player: The village of Lletya, north of here.

reporting-back-after-the-revelations-fin.speaker: Lady Carys Hefin
reporting-back-after-the-revelations-fin.text: Then it is time to resume my role among the elves. I will go at once.

reporting-back-after-the-revelations-fin.speaker: Lady Carys Hefin
reporting-back-after-the-revelations-fin.text: The road to enlightenment is a perilous one. The latest peril is the largest I've ever seen though.

reporting-back-after-the-revelations-fin.player: Do you think we can overcome it.

reporting-back-after-the-revelations-fin.speaker: Lady Carys Hefin
reporting-back-after-the-revelations-fin.text: That is not for me to say. All I can do is see where this path takes me. And if this is the final step of my journey, then I go to my end willingly.

recovering-the-orb-ysgawyn-returns.speaker: Baxtorian
recovering-the-orb-ysgawyn-returns.text: Oh... Hello. Good work finding Lord Crwys and Lady Hefin. I never thought I'd see the other elders again, maybe we'll have a chance with them alongside us.

recovering-the-orb-ysgawyn-returns.player: No problem. Any news from Ysgawyn?

recovering-the-orb-ysgawyn-returns.speaker: Baxtorian
recovering-the-orb-ysgawyn-returns.text: He has just returned. Let us gather the others and hear what he has to say.
Baxtorian calls the others to the meeting.

recovering-the-orb-ysgawyn-returns.speaker: Baxtorian
recovering-the-orb-ysgawyn-returns.text: Now that Ysgawyn has returned, I thought we should gather to hear what he has discovered.

recovering-the-orb-ysgawyn-returns.speaker: Eluned
recovering-the-orb-ysgawyn-returns.text: Where is Arianwyn?

recovering-the-orb-ysgawyn-returns.speaker: Elena
recovering-the-orb-ysgawyn-returns.text: I saw him heading out into the forest earlier. He must have wanted some time alone.

recovering-the-orb-ysgawyn-returns.speaker: Eluned
recovering-the-orb-ysgawyn-returns.text: I hope he's okay.

recovering-the-orb-ysgawyn-returns.speaker: Baxtorian
recovering-the-orb-ysgawyn-returns.text: He'll be alright, just give him time. While he is gone, we need to keep making progress.

recovering-the-orb-ysgawyn-returns.speaker: Baxtorian
recovering-the-orb-ysgawyn-returns.text: On that note, what news do you have, Ysgawyn?

recovering-the-orb-ysgawyn-returns.speaker: Ysgawyn
recovering-the-orb-ysgawyn-returns.text: The shrine at Gorlah was empty. The orb was removed quite a while ago by the looks of things.

recovering-the-orb-ysgawyn-returns.player: So do you believe me now?

recovering-the-orb-ysgawyn-returns.speaker: Ysgawyn
recovering-the-orb-ysgawyn-returns.text: If it helps with your overinflated ego, then yes, I now believe you.

recovering-the-orb-ysgawyn-returns.speaker: Islwyn
recovering-the-orb-ysgawyn-returns.text: If the orb isn't at Gorlah, Lord Iorwerth must have claimed it. It could be anywhere now.

recovering-the-orb-ysgawyn-returns.speaker: Ysgawyn
recovering-the-orb-ysgawyn-returns.text: Well luckily for us, I know exactly where it is. There's a cave just north of the Iorwerth Camp that is used to store supplies. Lord Iorwerth has it under close guard there.

recovering-the-orb-ysgawyn-returns.speaker: Ilfeen
recovering-the-orb-ysgawyn-returns.text: How do you know this?

recovering-the-orb-ysgawyn-returns.speaker: Ysgawyn
recovering-the-orb-ysgawyn-returns.text: Because I went scouting.

recovering-the-orb-ysgawyn-returns.speaker: Baxtorian
recovering-the-orb-ysgawyn-returns.text: Scouting? At the Iorwerth Camp? Who gave you permission?

recovering-the-orb-ysgawyn-returns.speaker: Ysgawyn
recovering-the-orb-ysgawyn-returns.text: I gave myself permission. I do not serve you, Baxtorian, or anyone else here.

recovering-the-orb-ysgawyn-returns.speaker: Islwyn
recovering-the-orb-ysgawyn-returns.text: No, you just serve yourself, don't you Ysgawyn?

recovering-the-orb-ysgawyn-returns.speaker: Ysgawyn
recovering-the-orb-ysgawyn-returns.text: My actions benefit us all! Now that we know where the orb is, we can move to claim it.

recovering-the-orb-ysgawyn-returns.speaker: Eluned
recovering-the-orb-ysgawyn-returns.text: But why would Lord Iorwerth keep the orb at the camp? Surely it would be more secure behind the Prifddinas walls.

recovering-the-orb-ysgawyn-returns.speaker: Ysgawyn
recovering-the-orb-ysgawyn-returns.text: That's the other thing I found out. Lord Iorwerth knows we managed to enter the library. He fears the orb would not be safe behind the walls.

recovering-the-orb-ysgawyn-returns.speaker: Baxtorian
recovering-the-orb-ysgawyn-returns.text: How did you discover this?

recovering-the-orb-ysgawyn-returns.speaker: Ysgawyn
recovering-the-orb-ysgawyn-returns.text: I have my methods...

recovering-the-orb-ysgawyn-returns.speaker: Baxtorian
recovering-the-orb-ysgawyn-returns.text: It worries me that you are unwilling to share them.

recovering-the-orb-ysgawyn-returns.speaker: Ysgawyn
recovering-the-orb-ysgawyn-returns.text: Save your suspicions for someone who cares.

recovering-the-orb-ysgawyn-returns.speaker: Ilfeen
recovering-the-orb-ysgawyn-returns.text: So we know where the orb is. What do we do now?

recovering-the-orb-ysgawyn-returns.speaker: Baxtorian
recovering-the-orb-ysgawyn-returns.text: Lord Iorwerth intends to use the orb to free the dark fragment of Seren. We need to stop him.

recovering-the-orb-ysgawyn-returns.speaker: Eluned
recovering-the-orb-ysgawyn-returns.text: But this fragment of Seren, it's still part of her. Lord Iorwerth has done some unspeakable things, but he doesn't serve Zamorak like we thought, maybe we can reason with him.

recovering-the-orb-ysgawyn-returns.speaker: Baxtorian
recovering-the-orb-ysgawyn-returns.text: I tried to reason with Lord Iorwerth a long time ago... It won't work, as much as I wish it would.

recovering-the-orb-ysgawyn-returns.speaker: Ysgawyn
recovering-the-orb-ysgawyn-returns.text: Regardless of his intentions, Lord Iorwerth is our enemy. You should want to kill him, not reason with him.

recovering-the-orb-ysgawyn-returns.speaker: Baxtorian
recovering-the-orb-ysgawyn-returns.text: I would never wish for the death of a fellow elf, no matter what they've done.

recovering-the-orb-ysgawyn-returns.speaker: Ysgawyn
recovering-the-orb-ysgawyn-returns.text: Well look at you with your moral high ground.

recovering-the-orb-ysgawyn-returns.speaker: Baxtorian
recovering-the-orb-ysgawyn-returns.text: Now is not the time for arguing. At some point, we will need to decide what to do about the fragment of Seren. For now though, we need to focus on getting that orb and stopping Lord Iorwerth.

recovering-the-orb-ysgawyn-returns.speaker: Islwyn
recovering-the-orb-ysgawyn-returns.text: The orb isn't enough for him to win though, he'll also need to break through the defences on the Temple of Light. He'll struggle to do that now he's lost Ardougne.

recovering-the-orb-ysgawyn-returns.player: There is another way into the temple though, a tunnel from the Underground Pass, built by the dwarves there.

recovering-the-orb-ysgawyn-returns.speaker: Ysgawyn
recovering-the-orb-ysgawyn-returns.text: Great... Dwarves... I hate dwarves.

recovering-the-orb-ysgawyn-returns.speaker: Islwyn
recovering-the-orb-ysgawyn-returns.text: You hate everything Ysgawyn.

recovering-the-orb-ysgawyn-returns.speaker: Baxtorian
recovering-the-orb-ysgawyn-returns.text: Lord Iorwerth will stop at nothing to enter the temple. We have to assume that sooner or later, he will find that tunnel.

recovering-the-orb-ysgawyn-returns.speaker: Lady Carys Hefin
recovering-the-orb-ysgawyn-returns.text: Then we should make sure the tunnel is secure. Baxtorian, allow myself and the other elders to go meet with these dwarves.

recovering-the-orb-ysgawyn-returns.speaker: Baxtorian
recovering-the-orb-ysgawyn-returns.text: Very well, head to the Underground Pass and see what you can do. In the meantime, we should secure that orb. Even if he does get into the temple, Lord Iorwerth can do nothing without it.

recovering-the-orb-ysgawyn-returns.speaker: Ysgawyn
recovering-the-orb-ysgawyn-returns.text: Let me guess, you're going to send your favourite human.

recovering-the-orb-ysgawyn-returns.speaker: Islwyn
recovering-the-orb-ysgawyn-returns.text: Jealous, Ysgawyn?

recovering-the-orb-ysgawyn-returns.speaker: Ysgawyn
recovering-the-orb-ysgawyn-returns.text: No. I have other things to do anyway.

recovering-the-orb-ysgawyn-returns.speaker: Baxtorian
recovering-the-orb-ysgawyn-returns.text: [player name], head to the cave at the Iorwerth Camp and recover the Orb of Light. Be careful though, it's likely to be well guarded.

recovering-the-orb-ysgawyn-returns.speaker: Islwyn
recovering-the-orb-ysgawyn-returns.text: Sounds like we're done here. Let's get moving.
The others leave the meeting.

recovering-the-orb-ysgawyn-returns-talki.player: What do I need to do now?

recovering-the-orb-ysgawyn-returns-talki.speaker: Baxtorian
recovering-the-orb-ysgawyn-returns-talki.text: Head to the cave at the Iorwerth Camp and recover the Orb of Light. Be careful though, it's likely to be well guarded.

options.text: I'd like to ask you something about yourself.

steps.player: Okay, I'll be back soon.

recovering-the-orb-entering-the-iorwerth.prompt: Are you sure you want to enter the cave? Any items left inside, including upon death, will be lost.

steps.speaker: Iorwerth Warrior
steps.text: Who are you?

steps.player: [Tim/Sue/Sam]?

steps.speaker: Iorwerth Archer
steps.text: Well prepare to die [Tim/Sue/Sam]!

steps.player: Uh oh...

recovering-the-orb-entering-the-iorwerth.text: You search the chest and find an orb.

recovering-the-orb-talking-to-baxtorian-.player: I've managed to recover the orb.

recovering-the-orb-talking-to-baxtorian-.speaker: Baxtorian
recovering-the-orb-talking-to-baxtorian-.text: Thank you friend. Without this, Lord Iorwerth has no hope of freeing that fragment of Seren. I will look after it until we decide what to do with it.

recovering-the-orb-talking-to-baxtorian-.speaker: Baxtorian
recovering-the-orb-talking-to-baxtorian-.text: We have the orb, and the elders are securing the Temple of Light as we speak. That fragment of Seren should no longer be a concern.

recovering-the-orb-talking-to-baxtorian-.speaker: Baxtorian
recovering-the-orb-talking-to-baxtorian-.text: Lord Iorwerth is still out there and thanks to his larger army, we have no way of easily dealing with him.

recovering-the-orb-talking-to-baxtorian-.player: There must be something we can do.

recovering-the-orb-talking-to-baxtorian-.speaker: Baxtorian
recovering-the-orb-talking-to-baxtorian-.text: I'm sure there is, but I don't know what.

recovering-the-orb-talking-to-baxtorian-.player: Perhaps we should call the others then.

recovering-the-orb-talking-to-baxtorian-.speaker: Baxtorian
recovering-the-orb-talking-to-baxtorian-.text: I was thinking the same. However, I have a favour to ask first. Something I'd rather keep quiet.

recovering-the-orb-talking-to-baxtorian-.speaker: Baxtorian
recovering-the-orb-talking-to-baxtorian-.text: Our group is fractured. The revelation about Seren has hit everyone hard, and opinions clearly differ on how we should be responding to it. I fear some intend to take matters into their own hands.

recovering-the-orb-talking-to-baxtorian-.speaker: Baxtorian
recovering-the-orb-talking-to-baxtorian-.text: Ysgawyn in particular has been very distant. I have concerns about his loyalties.

recovering-the-orb-talking-to-baxtorian-.player: You don't think he'd join with Lord Iorwerth do you?

recovering-the-orb-talking-to-baxtorian-.speaker: Baxtorian
recovering-the-orb-talking-to-baxtorian-.text: I don't know. He claims to hate the Iorwerth clan, and he has more reason to feel that way than most. That said... something isn't right.

recovering-the-orb-talking-to-baxtorian-.player: And you want me to investigate?

recovering-the-orb-talking-to-baxtorian-.speaker: Baxtorian
recovering-the-orb-talking-to-baxtorian-.text: I do. Ysgawyn left the village after the meeting earlier. See if you can track him down and find out what he's up to.

recovering-the-orb-talking-to-baxtorian-.player: Any idea where he might have gone?

recovering-the-orb-talking-to-baxtorian-.speaker: Baxtorian
recovering-the-orb-talking-to-baxtorian-.text: I'm afraid not. Elena said she saw him leaving though, maybe she can help.

options.text: I'd like to ask you something about yourself.

steps.player: I'll go talk to her.

recovering-the-orb-talking-to-baxtorian-.player: What do I need to do again?

recovering-the-orb-talking-to-baxtorian-.speaker: Baxtorian
recovering-the-orb-talking-to-baxtorian-.text: Ysgawyn has been acting suspiciously. See if you can find him and work out what he's up to. Elena said she saw him leaving the village. She might know where he went.

options.text: I'd like to ask you something about yourself.

steps.player: I'll go talk to her.

recovering-the-orb-talking-to-elena.text: If you chose "Go ahead." and picked the full options when she wanted to ask you something before the first meeting:

steps.speaker: Elena
steps.text: Hey [player name]. Good to see you.

steps.player: Hey Elena, how's it going?

recovering-the-orb-talking-to-elena.text: If you chose "Maybe later." when she wanted to ask you something before the first meeting:

steps.speaker: Elena
steps.text: Hey [player name].

steps.player: Hey Elena, how's it going?

recovering-the-orb-talking-to-elena.speaker: Elena
recovering-the-orb-talking-to-elena.text: Not too bad. I've been given a lot to think about though. Everything I've learnt about Seren, about the elves... it's crazy how big it all is. Our little fight in Ardougne seems so small now.

recovering-the-orb-talking-to-elena.player: I'm surprised it hasn't made you run for the hills.

recovering-the-orb-talking-to-elena.speaker: Elena
recovering-the-orb-talking-to-elena.text: Now you know me better than that, I'm too stubborn to leave now.

options.text: Why are you still here though?

steps.player: Why are you still here though?

steps.speaker: Elena
steps.text: It's about closure I guess. So many people were hurt by Lord Iorwerth's actions in West Ardougne. I need to know that he'll never hurt them again.

steps.player: He seems to think his actions are necessary.

steps.speaker: Elena
steps.text: Maybe his cause is just, but that doesn't give him the right to ruin lives in the way he has.

steps.player: What do you think should happen to him if we win?

steps.speaker: Elena
steps.text: You mean do I think he should die?

steps.speaker: Elena
steps.text: I've tried to dedicate my life to helping people, healing them. I think all lives are valuable, even the lives of people like Lord Iorwerth.

steps.speaker: Elena
steps.text: I think Lord Iorwerth should face justice for what he has done. I don't think killing him is justice though. Maybe that makes me weak, but that's how I feel.

options.text: I don't think it makes you weak, it makes you strong.

steps.player: I don't think it makes you weak, it makes you strong.

steps.speaker: Elena
steps.text: You do? Thank you, that means a lot, especially from you.

steps.speaker: Elena
steps.text: I realise I must come across as so self-righteous with all of this. I'm sorry about that.

steps.speaker: Elena
steps.text: As much as I hate it, I know that sometimes death is the only option. I like to think we can consider alternatives though. It's what sets us apart from the enemy.

options.text: He needs to pay for what he's done though.

steps.player: He needs to pay for what he's done though.

steps.speaker: Elena
steps.text: He does, but does it need to be with his life? Killing is a solution, but maybe it's not the only one.

steps.speaker: Elena
steps.text: I'm sorry. I realise I must come across as so self- righteous talking like this. I'm not trying to act better than anyone, I just want to make sure we've considered every option.

options.text: Sometimes people have to die for things to change.

steps.player: Sometimes people have to die for things to change.

steps.speaker: Elena
steps.text: I suppose... I just can't help but wonder if there might be another way.

steps.speaker: Elena
steps.text: I'm sorry. I realise I must come across as so self- righteous talking like this. I'm not trying to act better than anyone, I just want to make sure we've considered every option.

steps.speaker: Elena
steps.text: Anyway, did you want something?

steps.player: Yes. I wanted to ask you about Ysgawyn.

options.text: That's fair. Anyway, I wanted to ask you about Ysgawyn.

steps.player: That's fair. Anyway, I wanted to ask you about Ysgawyn.

options.text: Very true. Anyway, I'll see you later.

steps.player: Very true. Anyway, I'll see you later.

recovering-the-orb-talking-to-elena.player: Yes. I'm trying to find him. Baxtorian said you saw him leaving the village earlier.

recovering-the-orb-talking-to-elena.speaker: Elena
recovering-the-orb-talking-to-elena.text: I did. I don't know where he went though.

recovering-the-orb-talking-to-elena.speaker: Elena
recovering-the-orb-talking-to-elena.text: He only left recently, maybe you can pick up his trail. Have a look around the hidden entrance to the village, by the wolves, and see if you can find anything out of place.

recovering-the-orb-talking-to-elena-talk.text: If you chose "Go ahead." and picked the full options when she wanted to ask you something before the first meeting:

steps.speaker: Elena
steps.text: Hey [player name]. Thanks for the talk earlier, it meant a lot. I won't keep you, I'm sure you've got things to do. See you later
(End of dialogue)

recovering-the-orb-talking-to-elena-talk.text: If you chose "Maybe later." when she wanted to ask you something before the first meeting:

steps.speaker: Elena
steps.text: Hi there. I'm sure you've got things to do. You should probably go do them.

recovering-the-orb-confronting-ysgawyn.player: Well well! Meeting with the Iorwerth clan, Ysgawyn? This doesn't look good for you!

recovering-the-orb-confronting-ysgawyn.speaker: Ysgawyn
recovering-the-orb-confronting-ysgawyn.text: You! What are you doing here?

recovering-the-orb-confronting-ysgawyn.player: Keeping an eye on you, you traitor!

recovering-the-orb-confronting-ysgawyn.speaker: Ysgawyn
recovering-the-orb-confronting-ysgawyn.text: Traitor? You dare call me a traitor? Your loyalties change more than the wind and you have the nerve to say I'm the traitor?

recovering-the-orb-confronting-ysgawyn.speaker: Ysgawyn
recovering-the-orb-confronting-ysgawyn.text: Lord Iorwerth took everything from me! My whole life was destroyed by him and that dog, Essyllt! Do you really think I'd join up with them?

recovering-the-orb-confronting-ysgawyn.player: Well that's what it looks like!

recovering-the-orb-confronting-ysgawyn.speaker: Ysgawyn
recovering-the-orb-confronting-ysgawyn.text: You fool of a human! I may not agree much with the other rebels but everything I've done has been to stop Lord Iorwerth!

recovering-the-orb-confronting-ysgawyn.speaker: Ysgawyn
recovering-the-orb-confronting-ysgawyn.text: Well now that you've ruined everything as usual, I suppose I'd better tell you.

recovering-the-orb-confronting-ysgawyn.speaker: Ysgawyn
recovering-the-orb-confronting-ysgawyn.text: This is Iestin Edern, head of research for Lord Iorwerth, and my informant within the Iorwerth clan.

recovering-the-orb-confronting-ysgawyn.speaker: Ysgawyn
recovering-the-orb-confronting-ysgawyn.text: That's right you idiot! Iestin here has been providing me with information on the Iorwerth clan. Not only that, he is the reason why you were able to claim that Orb of Light.

recovering-the-orb-confronting-ysgawyn.player: But... I don't understand. If you've always been loyal, why all the secrecy?

recovering-the-orb-confronting-ysgawyn.speaker: Iestin
recovering-the-orb-confronting-ysgawyn.text: That was my request. I feared that the other rebels may not be trusting of me. They could have imprisoned me or even killed me. It seemed safer to keep things secret.

recovering-the-orb-confronting-ysgawyn.speaker: Ysgawyn
recovering-the-orb-confronting-ysgawyn.text: Not to mention the fact that it kept Iestin safe from any informants that Lord Iorwerth might have among the rebels.

recovering-the-orb-confronting-ysgawyn.player: I... I see... I guess that all makes sense.

steps.player: I'm sorry Ysgawyn.

steps.speaker: Ysgawyn
steps.text: I don't want an apology! I don't care how you feel about me. All I care about is stopping Lord Iorwerth for good. I lost all that I had, all that I cared about! I will make him pay!

steps.player: Arianwyn told me what they did. I...

steps.speaker: Ysgawyn
steps.text: No! You don't get to talk about that! You have no right!

steps.player: I'm sorry...

steps.speaker: Iestin
steps.text: Sorry to interrupt, but I think you need to hear this.

steps.speaker: Ysgawyn
steps.text: Yes. What news do you bring Iestin?

options.text: So what have you been discussing?

steps.player: So what have you been discussing?

steps.speaker: Ysgawyn
steps.text: Before you interrupted, Iestin was about to give me some news. Go ahead Iestin.

recovering-the-orb-confronting-ysgawyn.speaker: Iestin
recovering-the-orb-confronting-ysgawyn.text: It's not good I'm afraid. The human here was not wrong to suspect a betrayal. Lord Iorwerth, he knows about Lletya.

recovering-the-orb-confronting-ysgawyn.speaker: Iestin
recovering-the-orb-confronting-ysgawyn.text: There is a traitor amongst your people. I know not who they are, but it wasn't this human as you feared. They told Lord Iorwerth how to find the village.

recovering-the-orb-confronting-ysgawyn.speaker: Iestin
recovering-the-orb-confronting-ysgawyn.text: Earlier today. Essyllt is preparing their forces as we speak.

recovering-the-orb-confronting-ysgawyn.player: Hang on... If the traitor was one of the rebels, they'll also have told Lord Iorwerth about the tunnel into the Temple of Light!

recovering-the-orb-confronting-ysgawyn.speaker: Ysgawyn
recovering-the-orb-confronting-ysgawyn.text: He'll know how to get in... He just needs to reclaim the orb! We need to get to Lletya now!

recovering-the-orb-confronting-ysgawyn.speaker: Ysgawyn
recovering-the-orb-confronting-ysgawyn.text: Your days as an informant are done. You're coming with us. Now we need to move!

attack-on-lletya-a-village-on-fire.speaker: Elena
attack-on-lletya-a-village-on-fire.text: I'm fine. We need to get the citizens to safety!

attack-on-lletya-a-village-on-fire.speaker: Ysgawyn
attack-on-lletya-a-village-on-fire.text: Dammit! Right, you two go with Elena and help the citizens. I'll find Baxtorian.

attack-on-lletya-a-village-on-fire.speaker: Mawrth
attack-on-lletya-a-village-on-fire.text: My children! Someone help me find my children!

attack-on-lletya-a-village-on-fire.speaker: Elena
attack-on-lletya-a-village-on-fire.text: [player name], you go help Mawrth. We'll get the other citizens to safety.

attack-on-lletya-a-village-on-fire.speaker: Mawrth
attack-on-lletya-a-village-on-fire.text: My children are hiding in there! Please find them! Please save them!

attack-on-lletya-a-village-on-fire-findi.player: You have to be brave. Your mother is outside waiting for you.
She's outside, can you get to her?
Don't worry, you can do this!

attack-on-lletya-lord-iorwerth-arrives.speaker: Elena
attack-on-lletya-lord-iorwerth-arrives.text: Go! I'll get Mawrth and the other citizens to safety!

attack-on-lletya-lord-iorwerth-arrives.speaker: Lord Iorwerth
attack-on-lletya-lord-iorwerth-arrives.text: Well well, the great King Baxtorian. I wasn't sure I believed it when I heard you were still alive, but here you are.

attack-on-lletya-lord-iorwerth-arrives.speaker: Baxtorian
attack-on-lletya-lord-iorwerth-arrives.text: I'm sorry to disappoint you.

attack-on-lletya-lord-iorwerth-arrives.speaker: Lord Iorwerth
attack-on-lletya-lord-iorwerth-arrives.text: Well your ability to disappoint is one of your few talents, so I'll let it slide. However, I must insist that you give me the orb.

attack-on-lletya-lord-iorwerth-arrives.speaker: Ysgawyn
attack-on-lletya-lord-iorwerth-arrives.text: Crawl back into the hole you came from Lord Iorwerth, you won't leave here with that orb!

attack-on-lletya-lord-iorwerth-arrives.speaker: Lord Iorwerth
attack-on-lletya-lord-iorwerth-arrives.text: Oh I will, one way or another. But in case it wasn't clear, let me explain the situation.

attack-on-lletya-lord-iorwerth-arrives.speaker: Lord Iorwerth
attack-on-lletya-lord-iorwerth-arrives.text: As we speak, my forces are dealing with the last of your rebels and rounding up your citizens. You have no way to fight, and nowhere to run.

attack-on-lletya-lord-iorwerth-arrives.speaker: Lord Iorwerth
attack-on-lletya-lord-iorwerth-arrives.text: Of course, I could just have you all killed right now. After the trouble you've all caused me, it wouldn't be an unreasonable act. However, I am not without mercy, and I will not draw blood unless I have to.

attack-on-lletya-lord-iorwerth-arrives.speaker: Lord Iorwerth
attack-on-lletya-lord-iorwerth-arrives.text: Instead, I give you a choice. Give me the orb, and I will withdraw my forces, leaving you in peace. Refuse, and the blood of those citizens will be on your hands.

attack-on-lletya-lord-iorwerth-arrives.speaker: Islwyn
attack-on-lletya-lord-iorwerth-arrives.text: We do not barter with your kind!

attack-on-lletya-lord-iorwerth-arrives.speaker: Lord Iorwerth
attack-on-lletya-lord-iorwerth-arrives.text: I feared as much. That said, I do have someone here who might change your mind.

attack-on-lletya-lord-iorwerth-arrives.speaker: Islwyn
attack-on-lletya-lord-iorwerth-arrives.text: Arianwyn!

attack-on-lletya-lord-iorwerth-arrives.speaker: Ysgawyn
attack-on-lletya-lord-iorwerth-arrives.text: What is this? What have you done?

attack-on-lletya-lord-iorwerth-arrives.speaker: Lord Iorwerth
attack-on-lletya-lord-iorwerth-arrives.text: What have I done? Well I told him the truth. It was about time that someone did.

attack-on-lletya-lord-iorwerth-arrives.speaker: Islwyn
attack-on-lletya-lord-iorwerth-arrives.text: What truth?

attack-on-lletya-lord-iorwerth-arrives.speaker: Arianwyn
attack-on-lletya-lord-iorwerth-arrives.text: They're not the enemy. I thought they were, for so long, but they're not.

attack-on-lletya-lord-iorwerth-arrives.speaker: Lord Iorwerth
attack-on-lletya-lord-iorwerth-arrives.text: Everything we have done, every sacrifice we have made, all of it has been to free our goddess.

attack-on-lletya-lord-iorwerth-arrives.speaker: Baxtorian
attack-on-lletya-lord-iorwerth-arrives.text: You've never sacrificed, you've never lost anything. You only sacrifice those around you...

attack-on-lletya-lord-iorwerth-arrives.speaker: Lord Iorwerth
attack-on-lletya-lord-iorwerth-arrives.text: You have some nerve to lecture me. Remind me, how many of your people died under your watch? How many fell, trying to free your wife?

attack-on-lletya-lord-iorwerth-arrives.speaker: Lord Iorwerth
attack-on-lletya-lord-iorwerth-arrives.text: These new followers of yours, do they know? Do they know what you did? Do they know about the monster you truly are?

attack-on-lletya-lord-iorwerth-arrives.speaker: Baxtorian
attack-on-lletya-lord-iorwerth-arrives.text: I never...

attack-on-lletya-lord-iorwerth-arrives.speaker: Lord Iorwerth
attack-on-lletya-lord-iorwerth-arrives.text: No... of course they don't. You're a liar and a coward, that's all you've ever been.

attack-on-lletya-lord-iorwerth-arrives.speaker: Lord Iorwerth
attack-on-lletya-lord-iorwerth-arrives.text: As for me, I'm many things, and I admit, a lot of them aren't good. But I would never throw lives away like you did.

attack-on-lletya-lord-iorwerth-arrives.speaker: Islwyn
attack-on-lletya-lord-iorwerth-arrives.text: What's he on about?

attack-on-lletya-lord-iorwerth-arrives.speaker: Baxtorian
attack-on-lletya-lord-iorwerth-arrives.text: Nothing... He's lying. He's just trying to justify his mistakes.

attack-on-lletya-lord-iorwerth-arrives.speaker: Lord Iorwerth
attack-on-lletya-lord-iorwerth-arrives.text: I've done many terrible things, but none of them were a mistake. Every sacrifice I've made has been for her, for Seren.

attack-on-lletya-lord-iorwerth-arrives.speaker: Ysgawyn
attack-on-lletya-lord-iorwerth-arrives.text: And what are these apparent sacrifices you've made? Nothing compared to the suffering you've caused me, I'm sure!

attack-on-lletya-lord-iorwerth-arrives.speaker: Lord Iorwerth
attack-on-lletya-lord-iorwerth-arrives.text: When I first discovered the truth, our clan was still ruled by my mother. I went to her, told her what I'd found, told her what we needed to do.

attack-on-lletya-lord-iorwerth-arrives.speaker: Lord Iorwerth
attack-on-lletya-lord-iorwerth-arrives.text: I loved my mother, but she was blindly loyal to this fool here, she wouldn't have any of it. I couldn't just abandon my goddess though, she needed us. So I did what had to be done.

attack-on-lletya-lord-iorwerth-arrives.speaker: Baxtorian
attack-on-lletya-lord-iorwerth-arrives.text: You killed her?

attack-on-lletya-lord-iorwerth-arrives.speaker: Lord Iorwerth
attack-on-lletya-lord-iorwerth-arrives.text: And I would do it again without hesitation. For Seren, there is no price too great.

attack-on-lletya-lord-iorwerth-arrives.speaker: Islwyn
attack-on-lletya-lord-iorwerth-arrives.text: You're a monster! Surely you don't mean to side with this barbarian, Arianwyn.

attack-on-lletya-lord-iorwerth-arrives.speaker: Arianwyn
attack-on-lletya-lord-iorwerth-arrives.text: I don't condone what he did, what any of them have done. But they want what we want, we have to try working together.

attack-on-lletya-lord-iorwerth-arrives.speaker: Ysgawyn
attack-on-lletya-lord-iorwerth-arrives.text: I'll die before working with them.

attack-on-lletya-lord-iorwerth-arrives.speaker: Lord Iorwerth
attack-on-lletya-lord-iorwerth-arrives.text: No one else needs to die here. Please, just give me the orb. Do that, and I swear we will do you no further harm.

attack-on-lletya-lord-iorwerth-arrives.speaker: Baxtorian
