help-from-some-wizards-after-solving-the.text: Traiborn says I'm allowed to help you now. Let's find this teleportation matrix! I think you need to speak to Sedridor in the basement first though.

enter-the-gate-talking-to-sedridor-or-pe.speaker: Wizard Persten
enter-the-gate-talking-to-sedridor-or-pe.text: Hello again! Ready to uncover a magical secret that could change the world forever?

enter-the-gate-talking-to-sedridor-or-pe.speaker: Archmage Sedridor
enter-the-gate-talking-to-sedridor-or-pe.text: Slow down, Persten! I am still inspecting this amulet of yours.

enter-the-gate-talking-to-sedridor-or-pe.player: You're inspecting the amulet now? Does that mean the incantation is safe?

enter-the-gate-talking-to-sedridor-or-pe.speaker: Wizard Persten
enter-the-gate-talking-to-sedridor-or-pe.text: That's right! The amulet is as well, of course, but Sedridor here likes to be careful.

enter-the-gate-talking-to-sedridor-or-pe.speaker: Archmage Sedridor
enter-the-gate-talking-to-sedridor-or-pe.text: Not all of us are so carefree when it comes to the rules of our order, Persten. I mean really, Zamorakian incantations! Be glad I've even let you back in the tower!

enter-the-gate-talking-to-sedridor-or-pe.speaker: Wizard Persten
enter-the-gate-talking-to-sedridor-or-pe.text: The unfortunate price of progress, Sedridor.

enter-the-gate-talking-to-sedridor-or-pe.speaker: Archmage Sedridor
enter-the-gate-talking-to-sedridor-or-pe.text: I can think of a few other unfortunate things...

enter-the-gate-talking-to-sedridor-or-pe.speaker: Archmage Sedridor
enter-the-gate-talking-to-sedridor-or-pe.text: Anyway, the amulet seems to be safe, and as much as I hate to admit it, your assessment seems to be correct.

enter-the-gate-talking-to-sedridor-or-pe.speaker: Archmage Sedridor
enter-the-gate-talking-to-sedridor-or-pe.text: Yes. I'm still not happy about this, but we can't throw away this chance. I assume Traiborn's apprentices are ready?

enter-the-gate-talking-to-sedridor-or-pe.speaker: Wizard Persten
enter-the-gate-talking-to-sedridor-or-pe.text: Well then what are we waiting for? Let's do this!

steps.player: Let's do it.

steps.text: Incantation cutscene begins below.

enter-the-gate-after-declining-to-start-.speaker: Archmage Sedridor
enter-the-gate-after-declining-to-start-.text: Hello again, [player name]. What can I do for you?

options.text: Can you teleport me to the Rune Essence Mine?
So we're ready to perform the incantation?

steps.player: So we're ready to perform the incantation?

steps.speaker: Archmage Sedridor
steps.text: It seems so, assuming you are ready yourself?

steps.player: Let's do it.

steps.text: Incantation cutscene begins below.

steps.player: Not yet.

steps.speaker: Archmage Sedridor
steps.text: We will be here once you are.

options.text: Who else knows the teleport to the Rune Essence Mine?
Could you tell me about the old Wizards' Tower?
Nothing thanks, I'm just looking around.

steps.player: Let's do it.

steps.text: Incantation cutscene begins below.

enter-the-gate-incantation-cutscene.text: A cutscene plays. The three apprentices and Traiborn appear.

enter-the-gate-incantation-cutscene.speaker: Wizard Persten
enter-the-gate-incantation-cutscene.text: Everyone ready?

enter-the-gate-incantation-cutscene.speaker: Apprentice Felix
enter-the-gate-incantation-cutscene.text: We won't let you down, Persten.

enter-the-gate-incantation-cutscene.speaker: Wizard Persten
enter-the-gate-incantation-cutscene.text: Alright, with me!

enter-the-gate-incantation-cutscene.speaker: Persten and co.
enter-the-gate-incantation-cutscene.text: Saris! Val! Curak! Belito!
A blue portal opens.

enter-the-gate-incantation-cutscene.speaker: Apprentice Tamara
enter-the-gate-incantation-cutscene.text: It worked!

enter-the-gate-incantation-cutscene.speaker: Apprentice Cordelia
enter-the-gate-incantation-cutscene.text: Well what are we waiting for? Let's go in!

enter-the-gate-incantation-cutscene.speaker: Archmage Sedridor
enter-the-gate-incantation-cutscene.text: Go in? You three aren't going through that portal. We have no idea what's on the other side!

enter-the-gate-incantation-cutscene.speaker: Archmage Sedridor
enter-the-gate-incantation-cutscene.text: I have given Persten and [player name] permission to go through. Until we know it's safe, no one else may enter.

enter-the-gate-incantation-cutscene.speaker: Apprentice Cordelia
enter-the-gate-incantation-cutscene.text: You can't be serious!

enter-the-gate-incantation-cutscene.speaker: Apprentice Tamara
enter-the-gate-incantation-cutscene.text: Please let us help! We've all worked so hard for an opportunity like this!

enter-the-gate-incantation-cutscene.speaker: Apprentice Felix
enter-the-gate-incantation-cutscene.text: And we have Persten to look after us!

enter-the-gate-incantation-cutscene.speaker: Archmage Sedridor
enter-the-gate-incantation-cutscene.text: No. You are only apprentices. You were here to help with the incantation, and you've done that now. You should go back to your studies.

enter-the-gate-incantation-cutscene.speaker: Wizard Traiborn
enter-the-gate-incantation-cutscene.text: Come now, Sedridor. The young thingummywuts have proven themselves to be more than capable. Let them have their party!

enter-the-gate-incantation-cutscene.speaker: Wizard Persten
enter-the-gate-incantation-cutscene.text: It's going to be quite something! You really should let them help!

enter-the-gate-incantation-cutscene.speaker: Archmage Sedridor
enter-the-gate-incantation-cutscene.text: Quiet, Persten!

enter-the-gate-incantation-cutscene.speaker: Archmage Sedridor
enter-the-gate-incantation-cutscene.text: Let it be known that I consider this a bad idea. That said, they are your apprentices, Traiborn. If they have your permission, I won't stop them.

enter-the-gate-incantation-cutscene.speaker: Wizard Persten
enter-the-gate-incantation-cutscene.text: Alright! Ready to make history?

enter-the-gate-incantation-cutscene.speaker: Apprentice Tamara
enter-the-gate-incantation-cutscene.text: Let's go!
The five of you enter the portal.
Temple of the Eye cutscene continues below.

enter-the-gate-talking-to-archmage-sedri.speaker: Archmage Sedridor
enter-the-gate-talking-to-archmage-sedri.text: Hello again, [player name]. What can I do for you?

options.text: Can you teleport me to the Rune Essence Mine?
Are the others through the portal?

steps.player: Are the others through the portal?

steps.speaker: Archmage Sedridor
steps.text: I assume so. You should probably go through and join them.

options.text: Who else knows the teleport to the Rune Essence Mine?
Could you tell me about the old Wizards' Tower?
Nothing thanks, I'm just looking around.

enter-the-gate-entering-the-portal-befor.text: Temple of the Eye cutscene continues below.

enter-the-gate-temple-of-the-eye-cutscen.text: The five of you exit the portal at a strange, watery place.
The camera pans towards the Temple, and pans back to the group.

enter-the-gate-temple-of-the-eye-cutscen.speaker: Apprentice Tamara
enter-the-gate-temple-of-the-eye-cutscen.text: Let me cast a locator spell!

enter-the-gate-temple-of-the-eye-cutscen.speaker: Apprentice Tamara
enter-the-gate-temple-of-the-eye-cutscen.text: It seems we're deep below the sea, just south of Morytania!

enter-the-gate-talking-to-persten-upon-a.speaker: Wizard Persten
enter-the-gate-talking-to-persten-upon-a.text: This place is brilliant! The apprentices are looking around to see what they can discover. You should join them!

enter-the-gate-talking-to-apprentice-cor.speaker: Apprentice Cordelia
enter-the-gate-talking-to-apprentice-cor.text: There's something strange about this big hole here. It's giving out the tiniest amount of magical energy. I can't work out what it is though.

enter-the-gate-talking-to-apprentice-cor.player: You know, those plants look similar to stuff I've seen in the...

enter-the-gate-talking-to-apprentice-cor.speaker: Apprentice Cordelia
enter-the-gate-talking-to-apprentice-cor.text: Quiet! I'm more than capable of working this out. Maybe you should go help the others instead.

enter-the-gate-talking-to-apprentice-cor.speaker: Apprentice Cordelia
enter-the-gate-talking-to-apprentice-cor.text: Don't disturb me! I'll need absolute silence if I'm to work out what this mysterious energy is.

enter-the-gate-talking-to-apprentice-fel.speaker: Apprentice Felix
enter-the-gate-talking-to-apprentice-fel.text: See the plaque on it? It reads: 'Aliya, Justiciar of the Lion and guardian of the Temple of the Eye.'

enter-the-gate-talking-to-apprentice-fel.speaker: Apprentice Felix
enter-the-gate-talking-to-apprentice-fel.text: That must be where we are right now! I've read about the justiciars before, in a book back at the Wizards' Tower.

enter-the-gate-talking-to-apprentice-fel.speaker: Apprentice Felix
enter-the-gate-talking-to-apprentice-fel.text: They were powerful warriors in service to Saradomin himself, back when the gods still walked among us! This temple must be ancient. Imagine if Saradomin himself once stood here!

enter-the-gate-talking-to-apprentice-fel.speaker: Apprentice Felix
enter-the-gate-talking-to-apprentice-fel.text: Isn't it brilliant? A statue of a justiciar! I wish I could have met her!

enter-the-gate-talking-to-apprentice-tam.speaker: Apprentice Tamara
enter-the-gate-talking-to-apprentice-tam.text: Look! Rune guardians, like the ones at the Mage Training Arena! If this place was once a teleportation matrix, these rune guardians might have helped the wizards that used it.

enter-the-gate-talking-to-apprentice-tam.speaker: Apprentice Tamara
enter-the-gate-talking-to-apprentice-tam.text: Well, despite their age, they're actually of a remarkably similar design to the ones used by modern wizards. Isn't that amazing?

enter-the-gate-talking-to-apprentice-tam.player: Discovered anything more about these rune guardians?

enter-the-gate-talking-to-apprentice-tam.speaker: Apprentice Tamara
enter-the-gate-talking-to-apprentice-tam.text: Not yet, but their mere presence here is an amazing discovery!

enter-the-gate-talking-to-wizard-persten.speaker: Wizard Persten
enter-the-gate-talking-to-wizard-persten.text: Oh, sorry, I didn't see you there. I was lost in thought!

enter-the-gate-talking-to-wizard-persten.speaker: Wizard Persten
enter-the-gate-talking-to-wizard-persten.text: Hmm? Oh, I was looking at these markings here. They're very interesting! They seem to be radiating a magical energy I've never encountered before!

enter-the-gate-talking-to-wizard-persten.speaker: Wizard Persten
enter-the-gate-talking-to-wizard-persten.text: Take a closer look! Maybe you'll feel the energy as well!
You look at the markings...
You begin to experience a vision, and walk towards a Mysterious Stone.

enter-the-gate-talking-to-wizard-persten.speaker: First Mysterious Voice
enter-the-gate-talking-to-wizard-persten.text: Saradomin be with you.

enter-the-gate-talking-to-wizard-persten.speaker: Second Mysterious Voice
enter-the-gate-talking-to-wizard-persten.text: And with you, Zachariah. So, it's really true?

enter-the-gate-talking-to-wizard-persten.speaker: Zachariah
enter-the-gate-talking-to-wizard-persten.text: Indeed it is, Aliya, and he has given us the task of protecting it.

enter-the-gate-talking-to-wizard-persten.speaker: Aliya
enter-the-gate-talking-to-wizard-persten.text: What would he have me do?

enter-the-gate-talking-to-wizard-persten.speaker: Zachariah
enter-the-gate-talking-to-wizard-persten.text: You must build a sanctuary for the Eye. The forces of chaos already seek to reobtain it, as do countless others.

enter-the-gate-talking-to-wizard-persten.speaker: Aliya
enter-the-gate-talking-to-wizard-persten.text: I will keep it safe, no matter the cost. And you?

enter-the-gate-talking-to-wizard-persten.speaker: Zachariah
enter-the-gate-talking-to-wizard-persten.text: Zamorak has tasked his collector with finding the Eye. I will hunt him down before he does, along with any others who would try to claim it.

enter-the-gate-talking-to-wizard-persten.speaker: Aliya
enter-the-gate-talking-to-wizard-persten.text: Then I wish you luck, brother.

enter-the-gate-talking-to-wizard-persten.speaker: Zachariah
enter-the-gate-talking-to-wizard-persten.text: There is one last thing, Aliya. You must keep the Eye secret from all others, even our own. The fewer people that know the truth, the better.

enter-the-gate-talking-to-wizard-persten.speaker: Aliya
enter-the-gate-talking-to-wizard-persten.text: On my honour as a justiciar, it will be done.

enter-the-gate-talking-to-wizard-persten.speaker: Zachariah
enter-the-gate-talking-to-wizard-persten.text: Good. Saradomin be with you, sister.

enter-the-gate-talking-to-wizard-persten.speaker: Wizard Persten
enter-the-gate-talking-to-wizard-persten.text: [player name]?

enter-the-gate-talking-to-wizard-persten.speaker: Wizard Persten
enter-the-gate-talking-to-wizard-persten.text: What did you say?

enter-the-gate-talking-to-wizard-persten.speaker: Wizard Persten
enter-the-gate-talking-to-wizard-persten.text: Did you just say... 'Jas'?

enter-the-gate-talking-to-wizard-persten.player: I can't remember. When I looked at the marks on the floor I had this... vision, but it's all unclear.

enter-the-gate-talking-to-wizard-persten.speaker: Wizard Persten
enter-the-gate-talking-to-wizard-persten.text: Curious...

enter-the-gate-talking-to-wizard-persten.speaker: Wizard Persten
enter-the-gate-talking-to-wizard-persten.text: Well, time to see what the others have found!
The group gathers by the centre of the temple.
Abyssal rift cutscene continues below.

enter-the-gate-talking-to-wizard-persten.speaker: Wizard Persten
enter-the-gate-talking-to-wizard-persten.text: Hey! Let's see what the others have found!
Abyssal rift cutscene continues below.

enter-the-gate-abyssal-rift-cutscene.speaker: Wizard Persten
enter-the-gate-abyssal-rift-cutscene.text: Right, what have we discovered?

enter-the-gate-abyssal-rift-cutscene.speaker: Apprentice Cordelia
enter-the-gate-abyssal-rift-cutscene.text: That large hole behind you is radiating a strange energy. I'm still trying to work out what it is.

enter-the-gate-abyssal-rift-cutscene.speaker: Wizard Persten
enter-the-gate-abyssal-rift-cutscene.text: Need a hand with that?

enter-the-gate-abyssal-rift-cutscene.speaker: Apprentice Cordelia
enter-the-gate-abyssal-rift-cutscene.text: No, I can work it out.

enter-the-gate-abyssal-rift-cutscene.speaker: Wizard Persten
enter-the-gate-abyssal-rift-cutscene.text: You sure can! What else do we have?

enter-the-gate-abyssal-rift-cutscene.speaker: Apprentice Tamara
enter-the-gate-abyssal-rift-cutscene.text: There's some old rune guardians here with eye symbols on them.

enter-the-gate-abyssal-rift-cutscene.speaker: Wizard Persten
enter-the-gate-abyssal-rift-cutscene.text: So this place was definitely used by wizards at one point. Amazing!

enter-the-gate-abyssal-rift-cutscene.speaker: Apprentice Felix
enter-the-gate-abyssal-rift-cutscene.text: Not just any wizards, Saradominist wizards! There's some statues of an old Saradominist Justiciar called Aliya!

enter-the-gate-abyssal-rift-cutscene.speaker: Wizard Persten
enter-the-gate-abyssal-rift-cutscene.text: Remarkable! The justiciars haven't been around for thousands of years. That confirms my suspicions about the age of this place.

enter-the-gate-abyssal-rift-cutscene.speaker: Apprentice Felix
enter-the-gate-abyssal-rift-cutscene.text: That's not all I found. Apparently, this place was once called the Temple of the Eye!

enter-the-gate-abyssal-rift-cutscene.speaker: Apprentice Cordelia
enter-the-gate-abyssal-rift-cutscene.text: The Eye? What's the Eye?

enter-the-gate-abyssal-rift-cutscene.speaker: Apprentice Tamara
enter-the-gate-abyssal-rift-cutscene.text: I remember reading about something called the Eye back at the Wizards' Tower! I only came across mention of it once, but apparently it was a powerful artefact made by Saradomin himself!

enter-the-gate-abyssal-rift-cutscene.speaker: Wizard Persten
enter-the-gate-abyssal-rift-cutscene.text: Sorry... made by Saradomin, you say?

enter-the-gate-abyssal-rift-cutscene.speaker: Apprentice Tamara
enter-the-gate-abyssal-rift-cutscene.text: That's what the book said. Why?

enter-the-gate-abyssal-rift-cutscene.speaker: Wizard Persten
enter-the-gate-abyssal-rift-cutscene.text: Oh, just checking! I get all caught up in the moment and mishear things sometimes.

enter-the-gate-abyssal-rift-cutscene.player: This 'Eye'... did the book say what it looked like?

enter-the-gate-abyssal-rift-cutscene.speaker: Apprentice Tamara
enter-the-gate-abyssal-rift-cutscene.text: It didn't. It didn't actually have any other information on it. I tried to learn more from other books, but found nothing.

enter-the-gate-abyssal-rift-cutscene.speaker: Apprentice Felix
enter-the-gate-abyssal-rift-cutscene.text: Anything else was probably lost when the first Wizards' Tower burnt down.

enter-the-gate-abyssal-rift-cutscene.speaker: Apprentice Cordelia
enter-the-gate-abyssal-rift-cutscene.text: Of course! I've worked out what the energy from that hole is. It's abyssal energy!

enter-the-gate-abyssal-rift-cutscene.speaker: Wizard Persten
enter-the-gate-abyssal-rift-cutscene.text: Hmm... Yes... Brilliant!

enter-the-gate-abyssal-rift-cutscene.speaker: Wizard Persten
enter-the-gate-abyssal-rift-cutscene.text: Ah, sorry! Lost in thought again! It was for a good reason though. I think I've just about worked it all out!

enter-the-gate-abyssal-rift-cutscene.speaker: Apprentice Felix
enter-the-gate-abyssal-rift-cutscene.text: Amazing as always, Persten! We're so lucky to be able to work with you.

enter-the-gate-abyssal-rift-cutscene.speaker: Wizard Persten
enter-the-gate-abyssal-rift-cutscene.text: Thank you! So, I reckon my theory that this is an old teleportation matrix was spot on! The wizards here must have used power from the Abyss to create portals to the runic altars.

enter-the-gate-abyssal-rift-cutscene.speaker: Wizard Persten
enter-the-gate-abyssal-rift-cutscene.text: Then, with the power from this 'Eye' and support from their rune guardians, they'd have been able to create runes at lightning speed!

enter-the-gate-abyssal-rift-cutscene.speaker: Wizard Persten
enter-the-gate-abyssal-rift-cutscene.text: The Eye must have had a huge impact on their work. They named the temple after it and fashioned a symbol based on it.

enter-the-gate-abyssal-rift-cutscene.speaker: Apprentice Tamara
enter-the-gate-abyssal-rift-cutscene.text: And we're still using that symbol today! We just never knew why until now!

enter-the-gate-abyssal-rift-cutscene.speaker: Apprentice Felix
enter-the-gate-abyssal-rift-cutscene.text: Should we report back to Sedridor?

enter-the-gate-abyssal-rift-cutscene.speaker: Wizard Persten
enter-the-gate-abyssal-rift-cutscene.text: In a moment. I'm just going to cast a simple revealing spell first, just in case there's anything else hidden here.
Persten casts a revealing spell, but the Temple begins to rumble.

enter-the-gate-abyssal-rift-cutscene.speaker: Apprentice Tamara
enter-the-gate-abyssal-rift-cutscene.text: What's happening?

enter-the-gate-abyssal-rift-cutscene.speaker: Wizard Persten
enter-the-gate-abyssal-rift-cutscene.text: Don't worry! I'm sure everything is fine. Let me handle this.
An abyssal rift opens.

enter-the-gate-abyssal-rift-cutscene.speaker: Wizard Persten
enter-the-gate-abyssal-rift-cutscene.text: Huh... now that is a problem.
Persten is dragged into the rift.

enter-the-gate-abyssal-rift-cutscene.speaker: Apprentice Felix
enter-the-gate-abyssal-rift-cutscene.text: Persten!
Abyssal creatures begin coming out of the rift.

enter-the-gate-abyssal-rift-cutscene.speaker: Apprentice Cordelia
enter-the-gate-abyssal-rift-cutscene.text: You don't belong in this temple, accursed filth!
Cordelia casts a powerful spell that instantly kills all the invading creatures. Suddenly, the Great Guardian appears from the centre of the Temple.

enter-the-gate-abyssal-rift-cutscene.speaker: The Great Guardian
enter-the-gate-abyssal-rift-cutscene.text: And so the rift to the Scar is open once more. Humans, fight with us. Let us hold back the Abyss!
Great Guardian cutscene continues below.

enter-the-gate-talking-to-sedridor-after.speaker: Archmage Sedridor
enter-the-gate-talking-to-sedridor-after.text: Hello again, [player name]. What can I do for you?

options.text: Can you teleport me to the Rune Essence Mine?

steps.player: Sedridor! Something's gone wrong!

steps.speaker: Archmage Sedridor
steps.text: What do you mean?

steps.player: Through the portal! We've opened some sort of rift to the Abyss!

steps.speaker: Archmage Sedridor
steps.text: Well you'd better get back there and fix it!

options.text: Who else knows the teleport to the Rune Essence Mine?
Could you tell me about the old Wizards' Tower?
Nothing thanks, I'm just looking around.

enter-the-gate-talking-to-apprentice-fel.speaker: Apprentice Felix
enter-the-gate-talking-to-apprentice-fel.text: I... I think so. Sorry... I need a moment to collect myself.

enter-the-gate-talking-to-apprentice-fel.player: I'll go and check on Tamara and Cordelia. I'll be back soon

enter-the-gate-great-guardian-cutscene.speaker: Apprentice Tamara
enter-the-gate-great-guardian-cutscene.text: What do we do now? What if more of those creatures come through that rift?

enter-the-gate-great-guardian-cutscene.speaker: Apprentice Cordelia
enter-the-gate-great-guardian-cutscene.text: Well don't think I'll be stopping them all again! I may be powerful, but that spell still took a lot out of me.

enter-the-gate-great-guardian-cutscene.speaker: The Great Guardian
enter-the-gate-great-guardian-cutscene.text: Humans, use the cells. Protect me while I close the rift.

enter-the-gate-great-guardian-cutscene.speaker: Apprentice Felix
enter-the-gate-great-guardian-cutscene.text: Tamara! [player name]! I think I've found something over here!

enter-the-gate-talking-to-apprentice-cor.speaker: Apprentice Cordelia
enter-the-gate-talking-to-apprentice-cor.text: If you're hoping I can help in some way, you're out of luck. I may be powerful, but that spell still took a lot out of me. You'll have to hope the others can do something.

enter-the-gate-talking-to-apprentice-tam.player: I'll go and see what Felix has found.

guardians-of-the-rift-talking-to-felix.speaker: Apprentice Felix
guardians-of-the-rift-talking-to-felix.text: Well... I can't say for sure, but I think the containers on this table contain small amounts of runic energy.

guardians-of-the-rift-talking-to-felix.player: Right, I'll take one to Tamara.

guardians-of-the-rift-talking-to-felix.speaker: Apprentice Felix
guardians-of-the-rift-talking-to-felix.text: Just make sure you don't take more than one! I tried to do that already and the energy within them exploded!

guardians-of-the-rift-talking-to-felix-t.speaker: Apprentice Felix
guardians-of-the-rift-talking-to-felix-t.text: You should take one of these containers to Tamara. Just don't take more than one or they'll explode!

guardians-of-the-rift-talking-to-tamara.text: You show the cell to Tamara.

guardians-of-the-rift-talking-to-tamara.speaker: Apprentice Tamara
guardians-of-the-rift-talking-to-tamara.text: That must be one of the cells we need! Try placing it in the tile next to me.

guardians-of-the-rift-talking-to-tamara-.speaker: Apprentice Tamara
guardians-of-the-rift-talking-to-tamara-.text: Try placing that cell in the tile next to me.

guardians-of-the-rift-after-placing-the-.speaker: Apprentice Tamara
guardians-of-the-rift-after-placing-the-.text: It worked! This barrier should protect us against those creatures!

guardians-of-the-rift-after-placing-the-.speaker: Apprentice Tamara
guardians-of-the-rift-after-placing-the-.text: And just in time too. Here come more of them!

guardians-of-the-rift-after-placing-the-.speaker: Apprentice Tamara
guardians-of-the-rift-after-placing-the-.text: I'm not sure. The barrier won't hold out for long!

guardians-of-the-rift-after-placing-the-.speaker: Great Guardian
guardians-of-the-rift-after-placing-the-.text: Humans, we need more support. Restore my brethren! Place cells within imbued rocks and they will do the rest.

guardians-of-the-rift-after-placing-the-.speaker: Apprentice Tamara
guardians-of-the-rift-after-placing-the-.text: Imbued rocks? What does that mean?

guardians-of-the-rift-after-placing-the-.player: I'll see if Felix can help.
I'll see if Felix can help work out what to do next.

guardians-of-the-rift-talking-to-felix-a.player: Felix, we need to place cells in some imbued rocks. Any idea what that means?

guardians-of-the-rift-talking-to-felix-a.speaker: Apprentice Felix
guardians-of-the-rift-talking-to-felix-a.text: I think the essence piles here are actually remains of old guardians. They seem to contain elemental and catalytic energies. Perhaps you could try infusing each one with a cell.

guardians-of-the-rift-talking-to-felix-a.speaker: Apprentice Felix
guardians-of-the-rift-talking-to-felix-a.text: You'll probably need a chisel to shape the essence first. Looks like there's one on the floor there.

guardians-of-the-rift-talking-to-felix-a.speaker: Apprentice Felix
guardians-of-the-rift-talking-to-felix-a.text: Try infusing each of the essence piles here with a cell. You'll probably need a chisel to shape the essence first. Looks like there's one on the floor there.

guardians-of-the-rift-after-assembling-t.speaker: Apprentice Felix
guardians-of-the-rift-after-assembling-t.text: It worked! Looks like it's following the elemental symbols on the ground.

guardians-of-the-rift-after-assembling-t.speaker: Apprentice Felix
guardians-of-the-rift-after-assembling-t.text: Try creating another one using the other essence pile.

guardians-of-the-rift-after-assembling-t.speaker: Apprentice Felix
guardians-of-the-rift-after-assembling-t.text: Try infusing the other essence pile with a cell like you did with the first one.

guardians-of-the-rift-after-assembling-t.speaker: Apprentice Felix
guardians-of-the-rift-after-assembling-t.text: Amazing! Looks like this one's following the catalytic symbols.

guardians-of-the-rift-after-assembling-t.speaker: Apprentice Felix
guardians-of-the-rift-after-assembling-t.text: These guardians should be strong enough to fend off those creatures. Head back to Tamara and see what we should do next.

guardians-of-the-rift-after-assembling-t.speaker: Apprentice Felix
guardians-of-the-rift-after-assembling-t.text: The guardians should be strong enough to fend off those creatures. Maybe Tamara will know what to do next.

guardians-of-the-rift-talking-to-tamara-.speaker: Apprentice Tamara
guardians-of-the-rift-talking-to-tamara-.text: You made some rune guardians!

guardians-of-the-rift-talking-to-tamara-.player: And they seem to be holding back those creatures.

guardians-of-the-rift-talking-to-tamara-.speaker: The Great Guardian
guardians-of-the-rift-talking-to-tamara-.text: Humans, I lack the power needed to close the rift! I require runic energy!

guardians-of-the-rift-talking-to-tamara-.player: Runic energy? Do we need more cells?

guardians-of-the-rift-talking-to-tamara-.speaker: Apprentice Tamara
guardians-of-the-rift-talking-to-tamara-.text: Hmm... I don't think they'll work for this. We'll need something else...

guardians-of-the-rift-talking-to-tamara-.speaker: Apprentice Tamara
guardians-of-the-rift-talking-to-tamara-.text: Of course! We can use the rune guardians! See all the fallen guardians around here? They'd have once been powered using runic energy!

guardians-of-the-rift-talking-to-tamara-.speaker: Apprentice Tamara
guardians-of-the-rift-talking-to-tamara-.text: If you were to obtain some fragments from them, you might be able to make something to capture the runic energy needed.

guardians-of-the-rift-talking-to-tamara-.speaker: Apprentice Tamara
guardians-of-the-rift-talking-to-tamara-.text: Exactly! Hopefully you can find a pickaxe somewhere. Once you have a few fragments, go and speak to Felix. I'm sure he'll be able to help you use them.

guardians-of-the-rift-talking-to-tamara-.speaker: Apprentice Tamara
guardians-of-the-rift-talking-to-tamara-.text: Do you have anything to capture some runic energy with?

guardians-of-the-rift-talking-to-tamara-.speaker: Apprentice Tamara
guardians-of-the-rift-talking-to-tamara-.text: Try mining some fragments from the fallen guardians. Once you have a few, go and speak to Felix. I'm sure he'll be able to help you use them.

guardians-of-the-rift-after-mining-5-fra.player: I think I have enough fragments. I should speak to Felix about what to do with them.

guardians-of-the-rift-talking-to-felix-a.player: We need to power up this big guardian somehow, but I need a way to capture runic energy. Tamara said you might be able to help.

guardians-of-the-rift-talking-to-felix-a.speaker: Apprentice Felix
guardians-of-the-rift-talking-to-felix-a.text: Hmm... I reckon this old workbench here might have been used for just that. There's still plenty of pure essence on it for you to use, but that might not be enough...

steps.player: I have some fragments from the fallen guardians. What if I combined the pure essence with them?

guardians-of-the-rift-talking-to-felix-a.text: If the player has no fragments:

steps.player: What if I combined the pure essence with fragments from the fallen guardians?

guardians-of-the-rift-talking-to-tamara-.speaker: Apprentice Tamara
guardians-of-the-rift-talking-to-tamara-.text: Do you have anything to capture some runic energy with?

guardians-of-the-rift-talking-to-tamara-.player: I have some fragments from the fallen guardians.

guardians-of-the-rift-talking-to-tamara-.speaker: Apprentice Tamara
guardians-of-the-rift-talking-to-tamara-.text: Take them to Felix. He'll hopefully know what to do with them.

guardians-of-the-rift-talking-to-felix-a.player: I used the old workbench to make some essence!

guardians-of-the-rift-talking-to-felix-a.speaker: Apprentice Felix
guardians-of-the-rift-talking-to-felix-a.text: If you think you have enough, you should take it to Tamara.

guardians-of-the-rift-talking-to-tamara-.text: You show the guardian essence to Tamara.

guardians-of-the-rift-talking-to-tamara-.player: Do you think this will work?

guardians-of-the-rift-talking-to-tamara-.speaker: Apprentice Tamara
guardians-of-the-rift-talking-to-tamara-.text: Perfect! Now we just need to capture some runic energy with it.

guardians-of-the-rift-talking-to-tamara-.speaker: The Great Guardian
guardians-of-the-rift-talking-to-tamara-.text: I shall now use power from the Abyss to open a portal to the Runic Altar of Mind.

guardians-of-the-rift-talking-to-tamara-.speaker: Apprentice Tamara
guardians-of-the-rift-talking-to-tamara-.text: Well... I guess that's your answer. Head to the Mind Altar and craft some runes. That essence you have should capture some of the runic energy released. Take an uncharged cell with you as well.

guardians-of-the-rift-talking-to-tamara-.speaker: Apprentice Tamara
guardians-of-the-rift-talking-to-tamara-.text: I have a theory to test.

guardians-of-the-rift-talking-to-tamara-.player: Fair enough. I'll be back soon.

guardians-of-the-rift-talking-to-tamara-.speaker: Apprentice Tamara
guardians-of-the-rift-talking-to-tamara-.text: Head to the Mind Altar and craft some runes. That essence you made should capture some of the runic energy released. Take an uncharged cell with you as well.

guardians-of-the-rift-talking-to-tamara-.speaker: Apprentice Tamara
guardians-of-the-rift-talking-to-tamara-.text: I have a theory to test.

guardians-of-the-rift-talking-to-tamara-.player: Fair enough. I'll be back soon.

guardians-of-the-rift-talking-to-felix-a.speaker: Apprentice Felix
guardians-of-the-rift-talking-to-felix-a.text: I'm not sure. Maybe Tamara will know what to do.

guardians-of-the-rift-talking-to-tamara-.text: You show the guardian stones to Tamara.

guardians-of-the-rift-talking-to-tamara-.player: Look! This is what happened when I took that essence to the Mind Altar.

guardians-of-the-rift-talking-to-tamara-.speaker: Apprentice Tamara
guardians-of-the-rift-talking-to-tamara-.text: Great! That's exactly what I was hoping for. What about the cell?
You show the cell to Tamara.

guardians-of-the-rift-talking-to-tamara-.player: It seemed to capture energy from the altar as well.

guardians-of-the-rift-talking-to-tamara-.speaker: Apprentice Tamara
guardians-of-the-rift-talking-to-tamara-.text: I had a feeling it would! It's all coming together!

guardians-of-the-rift-talking-to-tamara-.speaker: Apprentice Tamara
guardians-of-the-rift-talking-to-tamara-.text: First, you should use that new cell to replace the one powering the barrier here. I don't think the current one will last much longer.

guardians-of-the-rift-talking-to-tamara-.speaker: Apprentice Tamara
guardians-of-the-rift-talking-to-tamara-.text: Then just use those stones to power up this big guardian.

guardians-of-the-rift-talking-to-tamara-.speaker: Apprentice Tamara
guardians-of-the-rift-talking-to-tamara-.text: First, you should use that new cell to replace the one powering the barrier here. I don't think the current one will last much longer.

guardians-of-the-rift-talking-to-tamara-.speaker: Apprentice Tamara
guardians-of-the-rift-talking-to-tamara-.text: Then just use those stones to power up this big guardian.

guardians-of-the-rift-talking-to-tamara-.speaker: Apprentice Tamara
guardians-of-the-rift-talking-to-tamara-.text: Just use those stones to power up this big guardian.

guardians-of-the-rift-powering-up-the-gr.speaker: The Great Guardian
guardians-of-the-rift-powering-up-the-gr.text: Human, the stones have fueled me, but more are needed.

guardians-of-the-rift-powering-up-the-gr.player: The guardian still needs more energy!

guardians-of-the-rift-powering-up-the-gr.speaker: Apprentice Tamara
guardians-of-the-rift-powering-up-the-gr.text: I guess we need to repeat the process again.

guardians-of-the-rift-powering-up-the-gr.speaker: The Great Guardian
guardians-of-the-rift-powering-up-the-gr.text: I shall now use power from the Abyss to open a portal to the Runic Altar of Water.

guardians-of-the-rift-powering-up-the-gr.speaker: Apprentice Tamara
guardians-of-the-rift-powering-up-the-gr.text: Looks like the portal to the Mind Altar has closed. I guess the guardian only keeps them open for so long. You'll need to use the new portal instead. Make sure you take another uncharged cell with you.

guardians-of-the-rift-powering-up-the-gr.speaker: Apprentice Tamara
guardians-of-the-rift-powering-up-the-gr.text: Create some more of that essence and use it to capture energy from the Water Altar. You should then be able to use it to power up the guardian again. Make sure you take another uncharged cell with you.

guardians-of-the-rift-talking-to-felix-b.player: What should I do to power up the big guardian?

guardians-of-the-rift-talking-to-felix-b.speaker: Apprentice Felix
guardians-of-the-rift-talking-to-felix-b.text: You could use the workbench here to combine pure essence with fragments from the nearby fallen guardians. The essence would then be perfect for capturing runic energy.

guardians-of-the-rift-talking-to-tamara-.speaker: Apprentice Tamara
guardians-of-the-rift-talking-to-tamara-.text: Use some more of that essence to capture energy from the Water Altar. You should then be able to use it to power up the guardian again. Make sure you take another uncharged cell with you.

guardians-of-the-rift-talking-to-felix-a.player: I have some stones I can use to power the big guardian.

guardians-of-the-rift-talking-to-felix-a.speaker: Apprentice Felix
guardians-of-the-rift-talking-to-felix-a.text: Great! You should go do that now.

guardians-of-the-rift-talking-to-tamara-.speaker: Apprentice Tamara
guardians-of-the-rift-talking-to-tamara-.text: Just use those stones to power up the guardian again.

guardians-of-the-rift-talking-to-tamara-.player: Alright, I'll get right on it.

guardians-of-the-rift-powering-the-guard.speaker: The Great Guardian
guardians-of-the-rift-powering-the-guard.text: Human, the stones have fueled me, but more are needed.

guardians-of-the-rift-talking-to-tamara-.text: You show the cell and the talisman to Tamara.

guardians-of-the-rift-talking-to-tamara-.player: Something odd happened at the Water Altar. The energy in this cell seems different to before. The essence also formed this strange talisman.

guardians-of-the-rift-talking-to-tamara-.speaker: Apprentice Tamara
guardians-of-the-rift-talking-to-tamara-.text: Oh, fascinating! I guess it makes sense that the stronger the runic energy, the more powerful the cell will be. After all, water is more powerful than air or mind.

guardians-of-the-rift-talking-to-tamara-.speaker: Apprentice Tamara
guardians-of-the-rift-talking-to-tamara-.text: Try making another rune guardian using that cell. In the meantime, I'll see if I can work out what this talisman does.

guardians-of-the-rift-talking-to-tamara-.speaker: Apprentice Tamara
guardians-of-the-rift-talking-to-tamara-.text: Try making another rune guardian using that new cell. In the meantime, I'll see if I can work out what this talisman does.

guardians-of-the-rift-talking-to-felix-b.player: I need to make another rune guardian.

guardians-of-the-rift-talking-to-felix-b.speaker: Apprentice Felix
guardians-of-the-rift-talking-to-felix-b.text: Go right ahead. Just use a chisel to shape one of these essence piles and then infuse the result with a cell.

guardians-of-the-rift-constructing-the-m.speaker: Apprentice Felix
guardians-of-the-rift-constructing-the-m.text: Look at that! I don't know what you did, but that guardian is much stronger than the ones you made before.

guardians-of-the-rift-talking-to-tamara-.player: That cell made a more powerful rune guardian!

guardians-of-the-rift-talking-to-tamara-.speaker: Apprentice Tamara
guardians-of-the-rift-talking-to-tamara-.text: Great! We're almost there! I think we just need to power up this guardian one more time for it to be able to close that rift.

guardians-of-the-rift-talking-to-tamara-.speaker: The Great Guardian
guardians-of-the-rift-talking-to-tamara-.text: I must conserve my power. The portal to the Runic Altar of Water has closed.

guardians-of-the-rift-talking-to-tamara-.speaker: Apprentice Tamara
guardians-of-the-rift-talking-to-tamara-.text: Don't worry, I think there's another way. I reckon that talisman you gave me can be used to return to the Water Altar without the portal being open.
Tamara hands you the talisman.

guardians-of-the-rift-talking-to-tamara-.speaker: Apprentice Tamara
guardians-of-the-rift-talking-to-tamara-.text: Just present that talisman to the statue where the portal to the Water Altar was. Make sure you take more essence and another cell with you.

guardians-of-the-rift-talking-to-tamara-.speaker: Apprentice Tamara
guardians-of-the-rift-talking-to-tamara-.text: Just present that talisman to the statue where the portal to the Water Altar was. Make sure you take more essence and another cell with you.

guardians-of-the-rift-talking-to-tamara-.player: I have another cell. Do you want me to power up the barrier again?

guardians-of-the-rift-talking-to-tamara-.speaker: Apprentice Tamara
guardians-of-the-rift-talking-to-tamara-.text: That's right! If my theory is correct, it should produce an even stronger barrier!

guardians-of-the-rift-placing-the-medium.speaker: Apprentice Tamara
guardians-of-the-rift-placing-the-medium.text: Just as I thought! We can create better barriers by using stronger cells!

guardians-of-the-rift-placing-the-medium.speaker: Apprentice Tamara
guardians-of-the-rift-placing-the-medium.text: Now, let's charge the guardian with those stones you created and close this rift!

guardians-of-the-rift-placing-the-medium.speaker: Apprentice Tamara
guardians-of-the-rift-placing-the-medium.text: Let's charge the guardian with those stones you created and close this rift!

guardians-of-the-rift-closing-the-rift.text: A cutscene plays. The Great Guardian prepares to close the rift.

guardians-of-the-rift-closing-the-rift.speaker: The Great Guardian
guardians-of-the-rift-closing-the-rift.text: Humans, I now have the power to close the rift. Brace yourselves!
The Great Guardian shoots a beam towards the rift, and it fades away.

guardians-of-the-rift-closing-the-rift.speaker: The Great Guardian
guardians-of-the-rift-closing-the-rift.text: We are safe, for now.

guardians-of-the-rift-closing-the-rift.speaker: Apprentice Tamara
guardians-of-the-rift-closing-the-rift.text: What was all that? What happened?

guardians-of-the-rift-closing-the-rift.speaker: The Great Guardian
guardians-of-the-rift-closing-the-rift.text: That was a rift into an area of the Abyss known as the Scar.

guardians-of-the-rift-closing-the-rift.speaker: Apprentice Cordelia
guardians-of-the-rift-closing-the-rift.text: The Scar? But I thought this was meant to be a teleportation matrix.

guardians-of-the-rift-closing-the-rift.speaker: The Great Guardian
guardians-of-the-rift-closing-the-rift.text: You are mistaken. While it is true that teleportation magic is strong here, that is only a side effect of this temple's history.

guardians-of-the-rift-closing-the-rift.speaker: Apprentice Felix
guardians-of-the-rift-closing-the-rift.text: What history?

guardians-of-the-rift-closing-the-rift.speaker: The Great Guardian
guardians-of-the-rift-closing-the-rift.text: This temple was built to house a powerful artefact. Many sought to claim this artefact for themselves, including servants of the Fallen Empire.

guardians-of-the-rift-closing-the-rift.speaker: The Great Guardian
guardians-of-the-rift-closing-the-rift.text: In their attempt to claim the artefact, they used magic they did not understand. The rift to the Scar was created as a result.

guardians-of-the-rift-closing-the-rift.player: This artefact... you mean the Eye?

guardians-of-the-rift-closing-the-rift.speaker: The Great Guardian
guardians-of-the-rift-closing-the-rift.text: You are correct. The Eye was removed after the battle, but not before the Justiciar of the Lion used it to seal the rift once more.

guardians-of-the-rift-closing-the-rift.speaker: The Great Guardian
guardians-of-the-rift-closing-the-rift.text: She then created us, the Guardians of the Rift, to protect this place in the event the rift was ever reopened.

guardians-of-the-rift-closing-the-rift.speaker: Apprentice Felix
guardians-of-the-rift-closing-the-rift.text: And we reopened it.

guardians-of-the-rift-closing-the-rift.speaker: Apprentice Cordelia
guardians-of-the-rift-closing-the-rift.text: But it's been sealed again now! The danger is gone.

guardians-of-the-rift-closing-the-rift.speaker: The Great Guardian
guardians-of-the-rift-closing-the-rift.text: Incorrect. Without the power of the Eye, we have no way to seal the rift permanently. It will soon reopen once more. You should leave before that happens.

guardians-of-the-rift-closing-the-rift.speaker: Apprentice Tamara
guardians-of-the-rift-closing-the-rift.text: No. This was our mistake. I'm staying to help fix it.

guardians-of-the-rift-closing-the-rift.speaker: Apprentice Felix
guardians-of-the-rift-closing-the-rift.text: Me too!

guardians-of-the-rift-closing-the-rift.speaker: Apprentice Cordelia
guardians-of-the-rift-closing-the-rift.text: Well if you two are staying, I guess I will as well.

guardians-of-the-rift-closing-the-rift.speaker: The Great Guardian
guardians-of-the-rift-closing-the-rift.text: Your support will be invaluable.

guardians-of-the-rift-closing-the-rift.speaker: Apprentice Tamara
guardians-of-the-rift-closing-the-rift.text: [player name], could you go back to the Wizards' Tower and let Sedridor know what happened here?

guardians-of-the-rift-closing-the-rift.player: Alright, if you're absolutely sure about this.

guardians-of-the-rift-closing-the-rift.speaker: Apprentice Felix
guardians-of-the-rift-closing-the-rift.text: What about Persten? We have to help her.

guardians-of-the-rift-closing-the-rift.speaker: The Great Guardian
guardians-of-the-rift-closing-the-rift.text: No part of the Abyss is more dangerous than the Scar. Your friend will have already been consumed.

guardians-of-the-rift-closing-the-rift.speaker: The Great Guardian
guardians-of-the-rift-closing-the-rift.text: Now, the power of the Abyss grows. The rift will soon reopen once more. Those of you staying should prepare yourselves.

guardians-of-the-rift-closing-the-rift.player: Then I guess I'd better go and see Sedridor. Good luck.

guardians-of-the-rift-closing-the-rift.text: The player returns to the Wizards' Tower.
Sedridor cutscene continues below.

guardians-of-the-rift-sedridor-cutscene.speaker: Archmage Sedridor
guardians-of-the-rift-sedridor-cutscene.text: What do you mean? Was there no teleportation matrix?

guardians-of-the-rift-sedridor-cutscene.player: Kind of, but not really. The portal took us to the Temple of the Eye, an ancient Saradominist temple built to house a powerful artefact.
Long ago, a rift to the Abyss was created in the temple, but it was sealed. At least it was, until Persten accidently opened it again...
She was sucked into the Abyss, and all these abyssal creatures came out!

guardians-of-the-rift-sedridor-cutscene.speaker: Archmage Sedridor
guardians-of-the-rift-sedridor-cutscene.text: Abyssal creatures? We have to get in there and stop this!

guardians-of-the-rift-sedridor-cutscene.player: It's okay again, for now. Some rune guardians called the Guardians of the Rift were built to protect the temple from the Abyss. They helped us close the rift again, but they say it will soon reopen.

guardians-of-the-rift-sedridor-cutscene.speaker: Archmage Sedridor
guardians-of-the-rift-sedridor-cutscene.text: This is a disaster! I knew that teleportation matrix was too good to be true. I should have stopped this, but I was blinded by my own desires for that matrix!

guardians-of-the-rift-sedridor-cutscene.player: They're safe. They chose to stay and help the Guardians of the Rift keep the rift closed.

guardians-of-the-rift-sedridor-cutscene.speaker: Archmage Sedridor
guardians-of-the-rift-sedridor-cutscene.text: Then I will ensure they have all the help they need. I will also begin researching this rift at once. Maybe we can still find a way to close it permanently.

guardians-of-the-rift-sedridor-cutscene.speaker: Archmage Sedridor
guardians-of-the-rift-sedridor-cutscene.text: In the meantime, I suggest you do what you can to help them as well. After all, this is partially your doing.

guardians-of-the-rift-sedridor-cutscene.player: I know. I'll help wherever I'm needed.

guardians-of-the-rift-sedridor-cutscene.speaker: Archmage Sedridor
guardians-of-the-rift-sedridor-cutscene.text: Thank you, [player name]. I appreciate that you did not mean for things to go this way. You should have this. It belonged to Persten. I don't want to think about where she got it.

guardians-of-the-rift-sedridor-cutscene.player: Do you think she's still alive?

guardians-of-the-rift-sedridor-cutscene.speaker: Archmage Sedridor
guardians-of-the-rift-sedridor-cutscene.text: Sadly, that seems unlikely. Still, if anyone can survive the Abyss, it's her.

guardians-of-the-rift-sedridor-cutscene.speaker: Archmage Sedridor
guardians-of-the-rift-sedridor-cutscene.text: Now, we'd better get to work.

post-quest-dialogue-archmage-sedridor.speaker: Archmage Sedridor
post-quest-dialogue-archmage-sedridor.text: Hello again, [player name]. What can I do for you?

options.text: Can you teleport me to the Rune Essence Mine?
How are things at the Temple of the Eye?

steps.player: How are things at the Temple of the Eye?

steps.speaker: Archmage Sedridor
steps.text: Between the Guardians of the Rift and ourselves, we are managing to keep the Abyss at bay.

steps.speaker: Archmage Sedridor
steps.text: However, despite all our research, we are no closer to working out how to close the rift permanently.

steps.speaker: Archmage Sedridor
steps.text: Gaining a better understanding of the artefact that was once there is key, but we have found little mention of this 'Eye'.

steps.speaker: Archmage Sedridor
steps.text: I'm sure the wizards of the first tower had plenty of research on it. After all, they knew enough about it to use its symbol as the symbol for our order.

steps.speaker: Archmage Sedridor
steps.text: All that knowledge lost because of those accursed Zamorakians!

steps.speaker: Archmage Sedridor
steps.text: Anyway, if you wish to help defend the temple, just head through the portal.

options.text: Who else knows the teleport to the Rune Essence Mine?
Could you tell me about the old Wizards' Tower?

steps.player: Could you tell me about the old Wizards' Tower?

steps.speaker: Archmage Sedridor
steps.text: Of course. The first Wizards' Tower was built at the same time the Order of Wizards was founded. It was at the dawn of the Fifth Age, when the secrets of runecrafting were rediscovered.

steps.speaker: Archmage Sedridor
steps.text: For years, the tower was a hub of magical research. Wizards of all races and religions were welcomed into our order.

steps.speaker: Archmage Sedridor
steps.text: Alas, that openness is what ultimately led to disaster. The wizards who served Zamorak, the evil god of chaos, tried to claim our magical discoveries in his name.

steps.speaker: Archmage Sedridor
steps.text: They failed, but in retaliation, they burnt the entire tower to the ground. Years of work was destroyed.

steps.speaker: Archmage Sedridor
steps.text: The tower was soon rebuilt of course, but even now we are still trying to regain knowledge that was lost.

steps.speaker: Archmage Sedridor
steps.text: That's why I spend my time down here, in fact. This basement is all that is left of the old tower, and I believe there are still some secrets to discover here.

steps.speaker: Archmage Sedridor
steps.text: Of course, one secret I am no longer looking for is the teleportation incantation to the Rune Essence Mine. We have you to thank for that.
If the player did not speak to the Mage of Zamorak about the abyssal incantation post-quest:
If the player spoke to the Mage of Zamorak about the abyssal incantation post-quest:

steps.player: I've heard a different take on how the tower burnt down. Something about a ritual gone wrong?

steps.speaker: Archmage Sedridor
steps.text: Nothing more than Zamorakian hearsay! They burnt the tower down and are now too cowardly to even admit it!

steps.player: Fair enough.

options.text: Nothing thanks, I'm just looking around.

post-quest-dialogue-mage-of-zamorak.speaker: Mage of Zamorak
post-quest-dialogue-mage-of-zamorak.text: Ah, you again. What do you want?

options.text: About that incantation your initiate gave me...

steps.player: About that incantation your initiate gave me...

steps.speaker: Mage of Zamorak
steps.text: Ah yes, the one to trace that amulet. Don't think I didn't notice that you modified the transmission spell I put on it. Next time you need help, we might not be so willing.

steps.player: Well maybe you should have asked first! Besides, you wouldn't have got anything useful out of it. In tracing that amulet, we accidently managed to open an uncontrollable rift to the Abyss.

steps.speaker: Mage of Zamorak
steps.text: And does this 'we' include the Order of Wizards?

steps.player: Maybe...

steps.speaker: Mage of Zamorak
steps.text: I knew it! It's just like them to play with magic they don't understand. First they burnt down the Wizards' Tower, now they're opening uncontrollable abyssal rifts!

steps.speaker: Mage of Zamorak
steps.text: Perhaps the fools should leave the dangerous magic to us next time!

steps.player: Oh, that reminds me. That incantation didn't appear to be written on parchment. What was it?

steps.speaker: Mage of Zamorak
steps.text: Hmm... probably the flesh of an abyssal creature. Why do you ask?

steps.player: Oh, I just thought it might be human flesh. I'm relieved it wasn't!

steps.speaker: Mage of Zamorak
steps.text: You've been spending too much time with your friends in the Order of Wizards! I know that we Zamorakians have a bad reputation, but do you really think we'd be so barbaric?

options.text: Can you tell me more about the Abyss?
Can you tell me more about your group?

0qD8qA.speaker: Wizard Persten
0qD8qA.text: That's a shame. Well, you just let me know if you reconsider.

0_QOga.player: I should probably get the amulet first.

AUUVFM.speaker: Mage of Zamorak
AUUVFM.text: Well then return to me when you are, but try not to waste too much of my time.

options.text: Why did you join the Emissaries?

steps.player: Why did you join the Emissaries?

steps.text: If Tenoch is not the traitor:

steps.npc: To do my duty, of course. Ralos and Ranul wish us to bring about the end of this world. Only then will we see the birth of a new one.

steps.text: If Tenoch is the traitor:

steps.npc: To do my duty, of course. Ralos and Ranul wish us to bring about the end of this world. Only then will we will all unite in Mictl.

steps.player: Who do you worship?

steps.npc: I worship both Ralos and Ranul equally, for in reality they are one. They have been separated for now, but soon they will rejoin once more.

options.text: Tell me about the Final Dawn.

steps.player: Tell me about the Final Dawn.

steps.text: If Tenoch is not the traitor:

steps.npc: The Final Dawn is our destiny. Ralos and Ranul will unite us all and end this world, but in doing so, we will all play a part in forming a new one.

steps.text: If Tenoch is the traitor:

steps.npc: The Final Dawn is our destiny. Ralos and Ranul will unite us all and end this world, but in doing so, they will grant us eternal life in Mictl.

options.text: Can I buy some Climbing boots?

steps.player: Can I buy some Climbing boots?

steps.npc: Sure, I'll sell you some in your size for 12 gold.

steps.player: OK, sounds good.

steps.text: If the player does not have enough coins in their inventory:

steps.player: I don't have the money on me.

steps.npc: Was there anything else?

steps.text: If the player has enough coins in their inventory:
Tenzing has given you some Climbing boots.

steps.npc: Was there anything else?

steps.player: No, thanks.

steps.npc: Was there anything else?

steps.player: What does a Sherpa do?

steps.npc: We are expert guides that take adventurers, such as yourself, on mountaineering expeditions.
Was there anything else?

options.text: How did you find out about the secret way?

steps.player: How did you find out about the secret way?

steps.npc: I used to take adventurers up Death Plateau and further north before the trolls came. I know these mountains well.
Was there anything else?

steps.player: Nice place you have here.

steps.npc: Thanks, I built it myself! I'm usually self sufficient but I can't earn any money with the trolls camped on Death Plateau.

steps.player: Now that the Imperial Guard know about the secret way they will be able to destroy the trolls!

steps.npc: Let us hope so traveller!
Was there anything else?

steps.player: Nothing, thanks!

standard-dialogue.npc: Hey it's the Hero! Wow! You're amazing, how on earth did you manage to tackle those two juvinates and Gadderanks? And the town is lovely, you've done a great job!

steps.player: What do you do here?

steps.npc: I'm Teodor, I be a farmer, oh arrr....and what can I do for you?

options.text: How do you like your town?

steps.player: How do you like your town?

steps.npc: It's just perfect, thanks so much for your efforts.

steps.player: What's happening around here?

steps.npc: Oh, not much really, we're all still hiding from the vampyres and eking out a living from this terrible place, hopefully soon we'll be strong enough to make the journey to the temple on the Salve.

options.text: Is there anything I can do to help out?

steps.player: Is there anything I can do to help out?

steps.npc: Not as far as I know, we have some basic amenities now which is so very useful, we're all incredibly grateful to you. I've never really seen or known a hero before, so I have nothing to compare one to, but I suspect in
most people's judgement, you would be one! I for one am very pleased to have met you.

steps.player: Ok, thanks.

after-the-blood-moon-rises.npc: Hey, it's the hero! Thank you so much for everything you've done, not just for us, but for all of Morytania!

steps.player: What do you do here?

steps.npc: I'm Teodor. I'm a farmer. Not that there's much to grow here.

steps.player: How are thing's here?

steps.npc: Well, I'd be lying if I said life was suddenly perfect, but it's nice to no longer live in constant fear of the vampyres.

steps.player: What will you do now that you don't have to worry about them?

steps.npc: Well, quite a few of us are working on making the town a bit nicer. Not that there's anything wrong with the work you did of course.
Some of the others don't want to stick around. They reckon it might be safe enough to make the journey up to Paterdomus now. I think they want to start a new life across the Salve.

steps.player: Is there anything I can do to help out?

steps.npc: With the town? No, I don't think so. You've done enough to help us anyway.
I suppose if you did want to help in some way though, you could maybe assist those who want to get to Paterdomus. The swamps can still be pretty dangerous.

steps.player: I'll keep that in mind.
I'd best be off.

standard-dialogue-before-the-dig-site.npc: Good day to you. My name is Terry Balando; I am an expert on digsite finds.
I am employed by the museum in Varrock to oversee all finds at this digsite. Anything you find must be reported to me.

standard-dialogue-before-the-dig-site.player: Oh, ok. If I find anything of interest I will bring it here.

standard-dialogue-before-the-dig-site.npc: Can I help you at all?

options.text: I have something I need checking out.

steps.player: I have something I need checking out.

steps.npc: Okay, give it to me and I'll have a look for you.

steps.player: No thanks.

steps.npc: Good, let me know if you find anything unusual.

options.text: Can you tell me anything about the digsite?

steps.player: Can you tell me anything about the digsite?

steps.npc: Yes, indeed; I am studying the lives of the settlers. During the end of the third age there used to be a great city at the site.
Its inhabitants were humans, supporters of the god Saradomin. It's not recorded what happened to the community here.
I suspect nobody has lived here for over a millennium!

options.text: Can you tell me more about the tools an archaeologist uses?

steps.player: Thank you!

options.text: Can you tell me more about the tools an archaeologist uses?

steps.player: Can you tell me more about the tools an archaeologist uses?

steps.npc: Of course! Let's see now... Rock picks are for splitting rocks or scraping away soil; you can get one from a cupboard in the Education Centre.

steps.player: What about sample jars?

steps.npc: I think you'll find them scattered about pretty much everywhere, but I know you can get one from a cupboard somewhere in the Education Centre, just like the rock pick!

steps.player: Okay, what about a specimen brush?

steps.npc: We have a bit of a shortage of those at the moment. You could try borrowing one from a workman on the site... but I don't think they'd give it willingly.

steps.player: Sounds like I'll need to be sneaky to get one of those, then... Okay - trowel?

steps.npc: Ahh... that you must earn by passing your exams! The examiner holds those.

steps.player: Ahh, ok thanks.

options.text: Ask about the Desert Treasure I quest.
options.condition: If Desert Treasure I has been completed:

steps.npc: Hello again. Was that translation any use to Asgarnia?

steps.player: I think it was, thanks!

steps.npc: Hello again. I am now studying this mysterious altar and its inhabitants. The markings are strange...
It refers to a god I have never heard of before, named Zaros. It must be some pagan superstition.
That was a great find; who knows what other secrets lie buried beneath the surface of our land...

talking-to-him-while-the-player-is-wield.npc: That staff is incredible! It's the same symbol that was on that talisman you found here. Does this mean you've found out more about Zaros?

talking-to-him-while-the-player-is-wield.player: I found out that he was banished, and that the people's hero was trapped in a pyramid and...

talking-to-him-while-the-player-is-wield.npc: So you're the one who found out about that. I've heard the story from my friends in the museum. Well done on being able to wield such an impressive symbol.

talking-to-him-while-the-player-is-wield.text: The dialogue continues to ask about the Digsite quest.

using-items-using-an-ancient-staff-on-hi.player: What do you think of this?

using-items-using-unidentified-liquid-on.text: All unidentified liquids in inventory are replaced with nitroglycerin.

using-items-using-unidentified-liquid-on.player: Do you know what this is?
From one of the barrels at the digsite.

using-items-using-unidentified-liquid-on.npc: This is a VERY dangerous liquid called nitroglycerin. Be careful how you handle it. Don't drop it or it will explode!

using-items-using-nitroglycerin-on-him.player: Can you tell me any more about this?

using-items-using-nitroglycerin-on-him.npc: Nitroglycerin! This is a dangerous substance. This is normally mixed with other chemicals to produce a potent compound.
Be sure not to drop it! That stuff is highly volatile...

using-items-using-ammonium-nitrate-on-hi.npc: Really, you do find the most unusual items. I know what this is - it's a strong chemical called ammonium nitrate. Why you want this I'll never know...

using-items-using-mixed-chemicals-on-him.npc: Hmm, that looks dangerous. Handle it carefully and don't drop it!

using-items-using-mixed-chemicals-with-c.player: See what I have done with the compound now.

using-items-using-mixed-chemicals-with-c.npc: Seriously, I think you have a death wish! What on earth are you going to do with that stuff?

using-items-using-mixed-chemicals-with-c.player: I'll find a use for it!

using-items-using-the-chemical-compound-.player: What do you think about this?

using-items-using-the-chemical-compound-.npc: What have you concocted now? Just be careful when playing with chemicals!

using-items-using-nuggets-on-him.text: If the player has less than 3 nuggets:

steps.npc: I can't do much with these nuggets yet. Come back when you have 3 and I will exchange them for you.

using-items-using-nuggets-on-him.text: If the player has at least 3 nuggets:

steps.text: Player gives 3 nuggets.

steps.npc: Good – that's three; I can exchange them for normal gold now. You can get this refined and make a profit!

steps.player: Excellent!

using-items-using-a-needle-on-him.npc: Hmm, yes; I wondered why this race were so well dressed! It looks like they had mastery of needlework.

using-items-using-a-rotten-apple-on-him.npc: Ew! Throw them away this instant!

using-items-using-broken-glass-on-him.player: Have a look at this glass.

using-items-using-broken-glass-on-him.npc: Hey you should be careful of that. It might cut your fingers, throw it away!

using-items-using-a-broken-arrow-on-him.player: Have a look at this arrow.

using-items-using-a-broken-arrow-on-him.npc: No doubt this arrow was shot by a strong warrior – it's split in half! It is not a valuable object though.

using-items-using-a-panning-tray-on-him.text: If the panning tray is empty:

steps.npc: I have no need for panning trays!

using-items-using-a-panning-tray-on-him.text: If the panning tray has something in it:

steps.npc: Have you searched this tray yet?

steps.player: Not that I remember...

steps.npc: It may contain something; I don't want to get my hands dirty.

steps.text: The expert hands the tray back to you.

using-items-using-bones-on-him.player: Have a look at these bones.

using-items-using-bones-on-him.npc: Ah, yes – a fine bone example... no noticeable fractures... and in good condition. These are common cow bones, however; they have no archaeological value.

using-items-using-buttons-on-him.npc: Let's have a look. Ah, I think these are from the nobility, perhaps a royal servant?

using-items-using-a-cracked-sample-on-hi.npc: What a shame it's cracked; this looks like it would have been a good sample.

using-items-using-an-old-tooth-on-him.npc: Oh, an old tooth. It looks like it has come from a mighty being. Pity there are no tooth fairies around here!

using-items-using-a-rusty-sword-on-him.npc: Oh, it's very rusty isn't it? I'm not sure this sword belongs here, it looks very out of place.

using-items-using-a-broken-staff-on-him.player: Have a look at this staff.

using-items-using-a-broken-staff-on-him.npc: Look at this... Interesting... This appears to belong to a cleric of some kind; certainly not a follower of Saradomin, however.
I wonder if there was another civilization here before the Saradominists?

using-items-using-broken-armour-on-him.npc: It looks like the wearer of this fought a mighty battle.

using-items-using-damaged-armour-on-him.npc: How unusual. This armour doesn't seem to match with the other finds. Keep looking.

using-items-using-ceramic-remains-on-him.npc: Yes, many parts are discovered. The inhabitants of these parts were great potters.

using-items-using-ceramic-remains-on-him.player: You mean they were good at using potions?

using-items-using-ceramic-remains-on-him.npc: No, no, silly. They were known for their skill with clay.

using-items-using-a-belt-buckle-on-him.player: Have a look at this unusual item...

using-items-using-a-belt-buckle-on-him.npc: Let me see. This is a belt buckle. Not so unusual - I should imagine it came from a guard.

using-items-using-an-animal-skull-on-him.npc: Hmm, an interesting find; an animal skull for sure. Another student found one just like this today.

using-items-using-the-special-cup-on-him.text: The expert cleans off the mud.

using-items-using-the-special-cup-on-him.npc: Looks like an award cup for some small find. Perhaps it belongs to one of the students?

using-items-using-teddy-on-him.npc: Why, it looks like a teddy bear to me. Perhaps someone's lucky mascot!

using-items-using-an-old-boot-on-him.npc: Ah yes, an old boot. Not really an ancient artefact, is it?

using-items-using-another-ancient-talism.text: The expert has already seen the talisman.

using-items-using-the-invitation-letter-.npc: There's no point in giving me this back!

using-items-using-stone-tablet-on-him-du.player: I found this in a hidden cavern beneath the digsite.
There is an altar down there. The place is crawling with skeletons!

using-items-using-stone-tablet-on-him-du.npc: This is an amazing discovery! All this while we were convinced that no other race had lived here.
It seems the followers of Saradomin have tried to cover up the evidence of the Zaros altar. This whole city must have been built over it!
Thanks for your help; your sharp eyes have spotted what many have missed. Here, take this gold as your reward.

using-items-using-stone-tablet-on-him-du.text: The expert gives you 2 gold bars as payment.

using-items-using-stone-tablet-on-him-po.npc: I don't need another tablet! One is enough, thank you.

standard-dialogue-before-starting-while-.player: Hello there. What do you do here?

standard-dialogue-before-starting-while-.npc: Ah, I'm just keeping an eye on things and making sure nothing untoward happens.
One day I hope it will be.

standard-dialogue-after-completion-of-wh.npc: Ah, [player name], it's good to see you again.

standard-dialogue-after-completion-of-wh.player: Hello there, Thaerisk. Any word on Lucien?

standard-dialogue-after-completion-of-wh.npc: Nothing yet, but we're doing everything we can to find him. I hope he's ready for us, because once we do locate him, we're going to give him quite the bloody nose...
... or at least whatever passes for a nose on a Mahjarrat!

standard-dialogue-after-fremennik-isles.npc: Thank you for leading the Burgher's militia against the Troll King.
Now that the trolls are leaderless I have repaired the bridge to the central isle for you as best I can.

standard-dialogue-after-fremennik-isles.player: Thanks Thakkrad. Does that mean I have access to the runite ores on that island?

standard-dialogue-after-fremennik-isles.npc: Yes, you should be able to mine runite there if you wish.

like to know more about?

steps.text: I... Thank you for the offer. You can't help though. She's gone.

steps.player: What can I do to help?

steps.speaker: Mori
steps.text: I... I don't know...

steps.player: Right. Let's start with what actually happened. Take a moment to collect yourself and then tell me everything.

steps.speaker: Mori
steps.text: Okay... Thank you...

steps.speaker: Mori
steps.text: I'm Mori... I was going to the Library with my friend, Thana. Suddenly, I felt a strange power all through me and then... she... she...

steps.speaker: Mori
steps.text: ...she just died!

steps.player: Just like that? Was she ill?

steps.speaker: Mori
steps.text: The people of Arceuus don't get ill. We're immortal. We have been for a thousand years, ever since the Ascent of Arceuus. This shouldn't happen... This can't happen...

steps.player: The Ascent of Arceuus?

steps.speaker: Mori
steps.text: Yes... A long time ago, our leader, Trobin Arceuus, used the Dark Altar to discover the secret of immortality. He came to us and let us share in this secret.

steps.speaker: Mori
steps.text: The events of that day became known as the Ascent of Arceuus.

steps.speaker: Mori
steps.text: But something's gone wrong... Thana is dead and I don't know why!

steps.player: We should let someone know about this.

options.text: We should let someone know about this.

steps.player: We should let someone know about this.

steps.speaker: Mori
steps.text: You... You're right. We should let the Kourend Council know. Could you help? I don't want to leave her.

steps.prompt: Start The Ascent of Arceuus quest?

steps.player: Of course I'll help.

steps.speaker: Mori
steps.text: Thank you... Could you head to Kourend Castle and let Councillor Andrews know what's happened? He's in charge of the council.

steps.player: Will do. I'll be back soon.
Actually I have something else to do.

steps.speaker: Mori
steps.text: Oh... Okay...

steps.player: I shouldn't get involved.

steps.speaker: Mori
steps.text: Oh... Okay...

a-death-talking-to-mori-talking-to-mori-.speaker: Mori
a-death-talking-to-mori-talking-to-mori-.text: Hello. Have you spoken to Councillor Andrews yet?

a-death-talking-to-mori-talking-to-mori-.speaker: Mori
a-death-talking-to-mori-talking-to-mori-.text: Please hurry. You'll find him in Kourend Castle.

options.text: There's been a death in Arceuus.

steps.player: There's been a death in Arceuus.

steps.speaker: Councillor Andrews
steps.text: A death? Well that doesn't seem right. The people of Arceuus don't just die. They can't.

steps.player: I've seen it with my own eyes. A citizen of Arceuus has fallen. What should we do?

steps.speaker: Councillor Andrews
steps.text: Well I don't really know what we can do. The Arceuus family have chosen to keep their knowledge secret from the rest of us. We have no expertise in this area.

steps.player: So you'll do nothing?

steps.speaker: Councillor Andrews
steps.text: If I could do something, I would. However, I'm afraid this is out of our hands.

steps.player: I see. I suppose I'd better tell Mori.

options.text: Tell me about the Kourend Council.
There's been a death in Arceuus.

steps.player: There's been a death in Arceuus.

steps.speaker: Councillor Andrews
steps.text: I'm sorry, but as I already told you, we can't help.

options.text: Tell me about the Kourend Council.

a-death-returning-to-mori.speaker: Mori
a-death-returning-to-mori.text: Hello. Have you spoken to Councillor Andrews yet?

a-death-returning-to-mori.player: I have. The council won't be helping I'm afraid.

a-death-returning-to-mori.speaker: Mori
a-death-returning-to-mori.text: Oh... I shouldn't be surprised I guess... The council only care about helping themselves.

options.text: Sounds like you don't like the council much.

steps.player: Sounds like you don't like the council much.

steps.speaker: Mori
steps.text: The council are supposed to rule Kourend, but they never do anything for the people. They shouldn't even exist anyway. They were only meant to rule until the last king's daughter came of age.

steps.player: So what happened?

steps.speaker: Mori
steps.text: The council declared her unfit for rule not long after the king died. She disappeared soon after and no one knows what became of her. Now the council are the permanent rulers of Kourend.

steps.speaker: Mori
steps.text: It was a waste of time even going to them. They were never going to care about Thana.

steps.player: What should we do now?
What should we do now?

steps.speaker: Mori
steps.text: Well... if the Council won't help us, maybe Lord Arceuus will. He doesn't show his face in public much these days but he can't ignore the death of one of his own.

steps.player: Good idea. Where can I find him?

steps.speaker: Mori
steps.text: He'll be in the Tower of Magic, north west of here.

a-death-returning-to-mori-talking-to-mor.speaker: Mori
a-death-returning-to-mori-talking-to-mor.text: Hello. Have you spoken to Lord Arceuus yet?

a-death-returning-to-mori-talking-to-mor.speaker: Mori
a-death-returning-to-mori-talking-to-mor.text: Please don't take too long. You'll find Lord Arceuus in the Tower of Magic.

a-death-entering-the-tower-of-magic.player: I need to speak to Lord Arceuus.

a-death-entering-the-tower-of-magic.speaker: Tower Mage
a-death-entering-the-tower-of-magic.text: We're currently facing an issue in the Tower of Magic. No one may enter until the issue is resolved.

a-death-entering-the-tower-of-magic.player: But it's important, there's been a death in Arceuus.

a-death-entering-the-tower-of-magic.speaker: Tower Mage
a-death-entering-the-tower-of-magic.text: A death? This isn't good. The death you speak of may be connected to the issue we are currently facing. You'd better go in.

a-death-entering-the-tower-of-magic.prompt: Are you sure you want to enter the Tower of Magic?

steps.text: The player enters the Tower.

a-death-entering-the-tower-of-magic-over.speaker: Tower Mage
a-death-entering-the-tower-of-magic-over.text: We need to deal with these souls!

a-death-entering-the-tower-of-magic-post.speaker: Tower Mage
a-death-entering-the-tower-of-magic-post.text: Thank you for helping with those souls. You should head upstairs and speak with Asteros Arceuus. He might be able to fill you in on what's happening here.

a-death-talking-to-asteros-arceuus.speaker: Asteros Arceuus
a-death-talking-to-asteros-arceuus.text: Thank you for helping us out with those souls. As you can see, we're facing quite the crisis.

a-death-talking-to-asteros-arceuus.player: I don't understand. What's going on?

a-death-talking-to-asteros-arceuus.speaker: Asteros Arceuus
a-death-talking-to-asteros-arceuus.text: I'm afraid we don't quite know ourselves yet. A short while ago, our instruments detected fluctuations in power from the Dark Altar.

a-death-talking-to-asteros-arceuus.speaker: Asteros Arceuus
a-death-talking-to-asteros-arceuus.text: Before we could do anything, we all felt a strange loss of power, as if the Altar had failed altogether.

a-death-talking-to-asteros-arceuus.speaker: Asteros Arceuus
a-death-talking-to-asteros-arceuus.text: My father was quick to act, using himself as a conduit to channel what little power the Altar had left.

a-death-talking-to-asteros-arceuus.speaker: Asteros Arceuus
a-death-talking-to-asteros-arceuus.text: It seems the loss in power had an interesting impact on our experiments though. Some trapped souls that we were working to free were suddenly released.

a-death-talking-to-asteros-arceuus.speaker: Asteros Arceuus
a-death-talking-to-asteros-arceuus.text: Alas, whatever happened seemed to cause them great pain, making them to go feral. They are now at peace though, thanks to you.

a-death-talking-to-asteros-arceuus.player: Well I'm afraid I have some bad news which is likely related to this. A citizen of Arceuus has died.

a-death-talking-to-asteros-arceuus.speaker: Asteros Arceuus
a-death-talking-to-asteros-arceuus.text: A death? No! My father acted as fast as he could, but it sounds like he was not fast enough. This is a dark day for Arceuus.

a-death-talking-to-asteros-arceuus.speaker: Asteros Arceuus
a-death-talking-to-asteros-arceuus.text: Tell me, who has fallen?

a-death-talking-to-asteros-arceuus.player: Thana. Mori is with her next to the pond.

a-death-talking-to-asteros-arceuus.speaker: Asteros Arceuus
a-death-talking-to-asteros-arceuus.text: Dear Thana, you did not deserve this fate. Thank you for bringing this terrible news to us. I will make sure someone is sent out to take care of Thana and Mori.

a-death-talking-to-asteros-arceuus.player: I still don't understand how this happened.

a-death-talking-to-asteros-arceuus.speaker: Asteros Arceuus
a-death-talking-to-asteros-arceuus.text: Ever since the Ascent of Arceuus, our people have been kept alive by the Dark Altar. Its power sustains our bodies in the same way yours is sustained by food and drink.

a-death-talking-to-asteros-arceuus.speaker: Asteros Arceuus
a-death-talking-to-asteros-arceuus.text: Without the power of the Dark Altar, there's nothing to keep our people alive. The loss in power from the Altar will be what killed Thana.

a-death-talking-to-asteros-arceuus.speaker: Asteros Arceuus
a-death-talking-to-asteros-arceuus.text: The Altar is currently giving out a fraction of the power it normally would. The only thing keeping us alive is my father. His strength won't last forever though.

a-death-talking-to-asteros-arceuus.speaker: Asteros Arceuus
a-death-talking-to-asteros-arceuus.text: If we can't find and fix whatever has caused this loss of power, our people are surely doomed. Now that those souls have been dealt with, we can perform tests both here and at the Altar to try and find the problem.

a-death-talking-to-asteros-arceuus.speaker: Asteros Arceuus
a-death-talking-to-asteros-arceuus.text: Time is not on our side though, and I fear we won't be fast enough.

a-death-talking-to-asteros-arceuus.speaker: Asteros Arceuus
a-death-talking-to-asteros-arceuus.text: Well... There is a secret known only to a few of us. At any other time, I would never dream of telling an outsider.

a-death-talking-to-asteros-arceuus.speaker: Asteros Arceuus
a-death-talking-to-asteros-arceuus.text: But our people's lives are in danger and you may well be the only one who can save us.

a-death-talking-to-asteros-arceuus.speaker: Asteros Arceuus
a-death-talking-to-asteros-arceuus.text: It's believed by most that the knowledge of immortality was discovered by my father. The truth is, the discovery was not his.

a-death-talking-to-asteros-arceuus.speaker: Asteros Arceuus
a-death-talking-to-asteros-arceuus.text: To the west of here, lies the sulphur volcano of Mount Karuulm. Within live the Tasakaal, three ancient beings with power over life and death. They granted my father the knowledge that led to the Ascent of Arceuus.

a-death-talking-to-asteros-arceuus.player: And you think they can help us?

a-death-talking-to-asteros-arceuus.speaker: Asteros Arceuus
a-death-talking-to-asteros-arceuus.text: Their knowledge of the Dark Altar far exceeds ours. If anyone can help us, it's them. Ideally I'd send one of our own, but I have no one to spare. You are the only one who can help us.

a-death-talking-to-asteros-arceuus.player: I'd better not waste any time then.

a-death-talking-to-asteros-arceuus.speaker: Asteros Arceuus
a-death-talking-to-asteros-arceuus.text: Thank you friend. You'll find Mount Karuulm on the other side of Lovakengj. Please hurry.
