a-death-talking-to-asteros-arceuus-talki.speaker: Asteros Arceuus
a-death-talking-to-asteros-arceuus-talki.text: Please hurry to Mount Karuulm. The Tasakaal may be the only ones who can save us. You'll find the volcano on the other side of Lovakengj.

the-tasakaal-first-encounter.speaker: Kaal-Xil-Dar
the-tasakaal-first-encounter.text: Human.

the-tasakaal-first-encounter.speaker: Kaal-Ket-Jor
the-tasakaal-first-encounter.text: Leave us.

the-tasakaal-first-encounter.speaker: Kaal-Mej-San
the-tasakaal-first-encounter.text: Your presence is not desired.

the-tasakaal-first-encounter.player: But I need your help! I was sent by Asteros Arceuus, son of Lord Trobin Arceuus.

the-tasakaal-first-encounter.speaker: Kaal-Ket-Jor
the-tasakaal-first-encounter.text: Arceuus.

the-tasakaal-first-encounter.speaker: Kaal-Xil-Dar
the-tasakaal-first-encounter.text: We know that name.

the-tasakaal-first-encounter.speaker: Kaal-Mej-San
the-tasakaal-first-encounter.text: The name of a liar.

the-tasakaal-first-encounter.speaker: Kaal-Xil-Dar
the-tasakaal-first-encounter.text: They came to us. Two of them.

the-tasakaal-first-encounter.speaker: Kaal-Mej-San
the-tasakaal-first-encounter.text: The brother and the husband.

the-tasakaal-first-encounter.speaker: Kaal-Xil-Dar
the-tasakaal-first-encounter.text: Her time was running out. They wanted to give her more.

the-tasakaal-first-encounter.speaker: Kaal-Mej-San
the-tasakaal-first-encounter.text: We granted them knowledge. To give her more time.

the-tasakaal-first-encounter.speaker: Kaal-Ket-Jor
the-tasakaal-first-encounter.text: But they misused it. And the world suffered.

the-tasakaal-first-encounter.speaker: Kaal-Ket-Jor
the-tasakaal-first-encounter.text: In a way. But it was not meant for that.

the-tasakaal-first-encounter.speaker: Kaal-Mej-San
the-tasakaal-first-encounter.text: Time was what it was meant for. But time still runs out.

the-tasakaal-first-encounter.speaker: Kaal-Xil-Dar
the-tasakaal-first-encounter.text: They put an end to time. They endangered the balance.

the-tasakaal-first-encounter.speaker: Kaal-Ket-Jor
the-tasakaal-first-encounter.text: For every death, there must be life.

the-tasakaal-first-encounter.speaker: Kaal-Xil-Dar
the-tasakaal-first-encounter.text: For every life, there must be death.

the-tasakaal-first-encounter.speaker: Kaal-Mej-San
the-tasakaal-first-encounter.text: This balance is what we serve.

the-tasakaal-first-encounter.speaker: Kaal-Ket-Jor
the-tasakaal-first-encounter.text: For without balance, the world burns.

the-tasakaal-first-encounter.player: You're very confusing, you know that right?

the-tasakaal-first-encounter.speaker: Kaal-Ket-Jor
the-tasakaal-first-encounter.text: Perhaps.

the-tasakaal-first-encounter.speaker: Kaal-Xil-Dar
the-tasakaal-first-encounter.text: Perhaps our knowledge is beyond your understanding.

the-tasakaal-first-encounter.player: Well thankfully I didn't come here for knowledge. I came here for help. The Dark Altar is failing and the people of Arceuus are in danger. I need you to help me find the cause.

the-tasakaal-first-encounter.speaker: Kaal-Mej-San
the-tasakaal-first-encounter.text: The people of Arceuus have had their time.

the-tasakaal-first-encounter.speaker: Kaal-Xil-Dar
the-tasakaal-first-encounter.text: This will restore balance.

the-tasakaal-first-encounter.speaker: Kaal-Ket-Jor
the-tasakaal-first-encounter.text: Why should we help them?

the-tasakaal-first-encounter.player: sigh* It can never be easy can it.
Fine. If you help me save the people of Arceuus, then I will help you.

the-tasakaal-first-encounter.speaker: Kaal-Xil-Dar
the-tasakaal-first-encounter.text: You assume we need help.

the-tasakaal-first-encounter.player: I've done this enough times to know that everyone wants something, even the masters of life and death.

the-tasakaal-first-encounter.speaker: Kaal-Mej-San
the-tasakaal-first-encounter.text: Interesting. Maybe the human is not as stupid as it looks.

the-tasakaal-first-encounter.player: Well I've been known to have my moments.

the-tasakaal-first-encounter.speaker: Kaal-Ket-Jor
the-tasakaal-first-encounter.text: Very well human.

the-tasakaal-first-encounter.speaker: Kaal-Mej-San
the-tasakaal-first-encounter.text: We admit, the Arceuus people do have their uses.

the-tasakaal-first-encounter.speaker: Kaal-Xil-Dar
the-tasakaal-first-encounter.text: Their work with souls has been useful in helping to maintain the balance.

the-tasakaal-first-encounter.speaker: Kaal-Mej-San
the-tasakaal-first-encounter.text: We will help them. But first, you will serve us.

the-tasakaal-first-encounter.player: Excellent. What do you need from me?

the-tasakaal-first-encounter.speaker: Kaal-Xil-Dar
the-tasakaal-first-encounter.text: To the south lies a battlefront.

the-tasakaal-first-encounter.speaker: Kaal-Ket-Jor
the-tasakaal-first-encounter.text: There is a grave there. Within it lies a soul, trapped inside a corpse.

the-tasakaal-first-encounter.speaker: Kaal-Mej-San
the-tasakaal-first-encounter.text: Free this soul. In return, we will provide our help.

the-tasakaal-first-encounter.player: So you just want me to kill a zombie?

the-tasakaal-first-encounter.speaker: Kaal-Ket-Jor
the-tasakaal-first-encounter.text: A zombie is soulless. An empty shell, reanimated by magic.

the-tasakaal-first-encounter.speaker: Kaal-Mej-San
the-tasakaal-first-encounter.text: This is a soul. Trapped in this world, when it should have long departed.

the-tasakaal-first-encounter.speaker: Kaal-Xil-Dar
the-tasakaal-first-encounter.text: Its existence is an affront to the balance.

the-tasakaal-first-encounter.speaker: Kaal-Mej-San
the-tasakaal-first-encounter.text: Which is why it falls to you.

the-tasakaal-first-encounter.speaker: Kaal-Ket-Jor
the-tasakaal-first-encounter.text: Consider it a test.

the-tasakaal-first-encounter.speaker: Kaal-Xil-Dar
the-tasakaal-first-encounter.text: If you pass.

the-tasakaal-first-encounter.speaker: Kaal-Ket-Jor
the-tasakaal-first-encounter.text: We may have further use for you.

the-tasakaal-first-encounter.player: Hmmm. Very well. I'll go and free this soul.

the-tasakaal-first-encounter-talking-to-.player: What did you want me to do again?

the-tasakaal-first-encounter-talking-to-.speaker: Kaal-Ket-Jor
the-tasakaal-first-encounter-talking-to-.text: You'll find it in a grave.

the-tasakaal-first-encounter-talking-to-.speaker: Kaal-Xil-Dar
the-tasakaal-first-encounter-talking-to-.text: By the battlefront to the south.

the-tasakaal-returning-to-the-tasakaal-a.player: I've dealt with the trapped soul.

the-tasakaal-returning-to-the-tasakaal-a.speaker: Kaal-Xil-Dar
the-tasakaal-returning-to-the-tasakaal-a.text: And now we shall help you.

the-tasakaal-returning-to-the-tasakaal-a.speaker: Kaal-Mej-San
the-tasakaal-returning-to-the-tasakaal-a.text: While you were busy, so were we.

the-tasakaal-returning-to-the-tasakaal-a.speaker: Kaal-Ket-Jor
the-tasakaal-returning-to-the-tasakaal-a.text: We have found the cause of your problem.

the-tasakaal-returning-to-the-tasakaal-a.speaker: Kaal-Xil-Dar
the-tasakaal-returning-to-the-tasakaal-a.text: You said the Altar was failing.

the-tasakaal-returning-to-the-tasakaal-a.speaker: Kaal-Ket-Jor
the-tasakaal-returning-to-the-tasakaal-a.text: The Altar is fine, but its power has been redirected.

the-tasakaal-returning-to-the-tasakaal-a.speaker: Kaal-Mej-San
the-tasakaal-returning-to-the-tasakaal-a.text: To a construct, built by a mortal.

the-tasakaal-returning-to-the-tasakaal-a.player: So I just have to go to the Dark Altar, find this device and then destroy it. Sounds easy enough.

the-tasakaal-returning-to-the-tasakaal-a.speaker: Kaal-Ket-Jor
the-tasakaal-returning-to-the-tasakaal-a.text: Then you have what you need.

the-tasakaal-returning-to-the-tasakaal-a.player: What am I meant to be doing again?

the-tasakaal-smashing-the-device.text: You inspect the rocks and find a strange device hidden amongst them. You smash it.

the-tasakaal-smashing-the-device.player: There. That's the device destroyed. The people of Arceuus should be safe now. I'd better go to the Tower of Magic and check.

finishing-up-talking-to-asteros.speaker: Asteros Arceuus
finishing-up-talking-to-asteros.text: Whatever you did, it seems to have worked. Everything is back to normal. You should talk to my father, he'll want to thank you.

finishing-up-talking-to-lord-arceuus.speaker: Lord Trobin Arceuus
finishing-up-talking-to-lord-arceuus.text: You're the one that saved our people. On behalf of all of Arceuus, I thank you.

finishing-up-talking-to-lord-arceuus.speaker: Lord Trobin Arceuus
finishing-up-talking-to-lord-arceuus.text: It seems so. A short while ago I felt the power of the Dark Altar return to normal levels. I was safely able to stop my ritual and let the Altar work on its own again.

finishing-up-talking-to-lord-arceuus.speaker: Lord Trobin Arceuus
finishing-up-talking-to-lord-arceuus.text: Now tell me, what was the cause of this and how did you stop it?

finishing-up-talking-to-lord-arceuus.player: Your son recommended that I speak to the Tasakaal. They had me perform a task for them but after that they agreed to help. They didn't seem to like you much though.

finishing-up-talking-to-lord-arceuus.speaker: Lord Trobin Arceuus
finishing-up-talking-to-lord-arceuus.text: Well that's no surprise. The Tasakaal seem to feel that only they deserve immortality. It's rather hypocritical of them. It clearly didn't stop them helping you though.

finishing-up-talking-to-lord-arceuus.player: They were reluctant, but they admitted that the people of Arceuus were useful to them.

finishing-up-talking-to-lord-arceuus.speaker: Lord Trobin Arceuus
finishing-up-talking-to-lord-arceuus.text: Such is their way. They act superior to us, but the reality is they'll work with anyone if they think it will further their aims.

finishing-up-talking-to-lord-arceuus.speaker: Lord Trobin Arceuus
finishing-up-talking-to-lord-arceuus.text: So how did they help you?

finishing-up-talking-to-lord-arceuus.player: They found out that the power of the Altar was being redirected into a device hidden nearby. I found the device and destroyed it.
I'm not sure, but the Tasakaal said it was made by a mortal.

finishing-up-talking-to-lord-arceuus.speaker: Lord Trobin Arceuus
finishing-up-talking-to-lord-arceuus.text: The Tasakaal view everyone who isn't one of them as a mere mortal, even those of us who have also achieved immortality. That doesn't narrow down the options very much.

finishing-up-talking-to-lord-arceuus.speaker: Lord Trobin Arceuus
finishing-up-talking-to-lord-arceuus.text: This is most concerning though. If someone deliberately sabotaged the Altar, who knows what else they might do. I'll have someone recover the remains of this device. Maybe we can work out where it came from.

finishing-up-talking-to-lord-arceuus.speaker: Lord Trobin Arceuus
finishing-up-talking-to-lord-arceuus.text: For now though, I'd like to once again thank you for your help. Today was a dark day for our people but without you it would have been our end. Please accept these gifts. They are the least you deserve.

finishing-up-talking-to-lord-arceuus.speaker: Lord Trobin Arceuus
finishing-up-talking-to-lord-arceuus.text: Now, can I help you further?

standard-dialogue.player: Hello, The Beast! Why do they call you that?

attempting-to-enter-the-keldagrim-ratpit.text: The large cat near the stairs glowers menacingly at you as you approach the stairs.

attempting-to-enter-the-keldagrim-ratpit.player: I think I had better stay away from the stairs for now.

pre-release-dialogue.player: Sarius Guile? What are you doing here?

pre-release-dialogue.speaker: Sarius Guile
pre-release-dialogue.text: I'm leaving Morytania. It's not safe for me here anymore. Not now Vanescula is gone. It felt only right to come find you and tell you to leave as well.

pre-release-dialogue.player: Leave? I have no intention of leaving.

pre-release-dialogue.speaker: Sarius Guile
pre-release-dialogue.text: I'm sorry, but you don't have any hope against Lowerniel Drakan. You are not strong enough to stop him. The only choice you have is to leave or die.
The Blood Moon Rises quest will become available later today.

starting-out.speaker: Sarius Guile
starting-out.text: I was hoping I'd find you here.

starting-out.player: Sarius Guile? What are you doing here?

starting-out.speaker: Sarius Guile
starting-out.text: As I say, I was looking for you.

starting-out.speaker: Sarius Guile
starting-out.text: I'm leaving Morytania. It's not safe for me here anymore. Not now Vanescula is gone. Before I go though, there's something you need to know.

starting-out.prompt: Start The Blood Moon Rises quest?

steps.player: What is it?

steps.speaker: Sarius Guile
steps.text: Your friend, Safalaan. Lowerniel Drakan has him. He's keeping both him and Vanescula as his prisoners, in preparation for something.

steps.player: Preparation for what?

steps.speaker: Sarius Guile
steps.text: I'm not sure exactly, but all vampyres have been ordered to attend a gathering outside Castle Drakan. Apparently he has an announcement to make regarding the future of Morytania.

steps.player: The future of Morytania? That's not good. I need to get over there right away.

steps.speaker: Sarius Guile
steps.text: And do what? To stand against Drakan... It would be suicide!

steps.player: Maybe, but I'm not abandoning my friend.

steps.speaker: Sarius Guile
steps.text: You remind me of my father. He always believed in the Myreque, even when all hope seemed lost... But the Myreque are gone now, and so is he.

steps.player: They may be gone, but this fight isn't over. There's always still hope. You wouldn't have come here if you didn't believe that yourself.

steps.speaker: Sarius Guile
steps.text: Maybe...

steps.speaker: Sarius Guile
steps.text: So you're really going to go? To Castle Drakan?

steps.player: I am, but hopefully not alone. I still have a couple of friends left here.

steps.speaker: Sarius Guile
steps.text: Then I guess this is goodbye, and good luck.

steps.player: If you're leaving Morytania, do you have a safe way out?

steps.speaker: Sarius Guile
steps.text: Vanescula gave me some money to keep in case of an emergency. I'm paying some mercenaries from Misthalin to help me get out safely. I'll be fine. It's not me you should worry about.

steps.player: If you're sure.

steps.speaker: Sarius Guile
steps.text: [player name], I know this is about your friend, and I'm not blind to what Vanescula is, but... she's always been good to me. If you can help her...

steps.player: I'll do what I can. Now I'd best get going. I need to go and see Ivan.

steps.speaker: Sarius Guile
steps.text: Good luck, [player name].

steps.player: This doesn't sound good... Can you wait here for a little while? I get the feeling I'm going to need to be well prepared for whatever you have to tell me. I'll be back as soon as I can.

steps.speaker: Sarius Guile
steps.text: I'll wait a short while, but don't take too long.

starting-out-in-the-myreque-hideout.player: Hmm... Looks like Ivan isn't here.

starting-out-inspecting-the-shrine.text: It looks like Ivan has built a makeshift shrine to the fallen Myreque.

starting-out-inspecting-the-shrine.player: I have news from Darkmeyer. Apparently Drakan is preparing to make some sort of big announcement to the vampyres.

starting-out-inspecting-the-shrine.speaker: Ivan Strom
starting-out-inspecting-the-shrine.text: So you want us to go there?

starting-out-inspecting-the-shrine.speaker: Ivan Strom
starting-out-inspecting-the-shrine.text: Back to where they died? Back to where we lost?

starting-out-inspecting-the-shrine.speaker: Ivan Strom
starting-out-inspecting-the-shrine.text: He killed them! It was like they were nothing! He killed them, and all I could do was watch!

starting-out-inspecting-the-shrine.speaker: Ivan Strom
starting-out-inspecting-the-shrine.text: And I haven't! I'm not Veliaf! I'm still here! I'm still helping! But I'm not you, [player name]! I can't just go back there... I won't go back there...

starting-out-inspecting-the-shrine.player: I have a vampyre disguise. I can make you one as well. They'll never even know we were there.

starting-out-inspecting-the-shrine.speaker: Ivan Strom
starting-out-inspecting-the-shrine.text: It's not about that. I already have a disguise. I made my own a while ago. It's just...

starting-out-inspecting-the-shrine.player: More than afraid, but I won't give up on Safalaan.

starting-out-inspecting-the-shrine.speaker: Ivan Strom
starting-out-inspecting-the-shrine.text: Alright... Just give me a moment to get a few things together...

options.text: So you're ready to go to Darkmeyer?

steps.player: Are you ready to go to Darkmeyer?

steps.text: If the player isn't wearing the vyre noble outfit and doesn't have it on them:

steps.speaker: Ivan Strom
steps.text: I am, but it doesn't look like you are. You should put on your disguise before we set off. I think I saw it in that chest in the corner.
If the player has the vyre noble outfit but isn't wearing it:

steps.speaker: Ivan Strom
steps.text: I am, but it doesn't look like you are. You should put on your disguise before we set off.
If the player is wearing the vyre noble outfit:

steps.speaker: Ivan Strom
steps.text: As ready as I'll ever be. What about you?

steps.player: I'm ready.

steps.speaker: Ivan Strom
steps.text: Alright... To Darkmeyer then.

options.text: I need more time to prepare.

steps.player: I need more time to prepare.

steps.speaker: Ivan Strom
steps.text: Fair enough.

steps.player: How have things been here?

steps.speaker: Ivan Strom
steps.text: As bad as you'd expect. I'd rather not talk about it.

steps.player: But you're doing okay?

steps.speaker: Ivan Strom
steps.text: Like I said... I'm surviving.

starting-out-lowerniel-s-speech.speaker: Lowerniel Drakan
starting-out-lowerniel-s-speech.text: It has been a long time since I last stood before the vampyres of Morytania. I thought I had prepared myself for what I would see. Yet as I stand here now, I see that I was wrong.

starting-out-lowerniel-s-speech.speaker: Lowerniel Drakan
starting-out-lowerniel-s-speech.text: To see what you have all become... The ways you stand... The ways you dress...

starting-out-lowerniel-s-speech.speaker: Lowerniel Drakan
starting-out-lowerniel-s-speech.text: You disgust me.

starting-out-lowerniel-s-speech.speaker: Lowerniel Drakan
starting-out-lowerniel-s-speech.text: You have become pathetic. Weak. None of you are worthy to be called vampyres anymore.

starting-out-lowerniel-s-speech.speaker: Lord Alexei Jovkai
starting-out-lowerniel-s-speech.text: And who is to blame for that, Drakan? If we disgust you so, surely it is you, our leader, who is responsible?

starting-out-lowerniel-s-speech.speaker: Lowerniel Drakan
starting-out-lowerniel-s-speech.text: Lord Jovkai... I see in my absence, you have grown arrogant once more. You always did take after your father...

starting-out-lowerniel-s-speech.speaker: Lowerniel Drakan
starting-out-lowerniel-s-speech.text: But, I must confess, you speak the truth, for you are all indeed my failing. A failing that today, I will finally begin to set right.

starting-out-lowerniel-s-speech.speaker: Lowerniel Drakan
starting-out-lowerniel-s-speech.text: You see, for a long time now, I have fought to return us to what we were always meant to be, but every time the answer came close, it slipped away.

starting-out-lowerniel-s-speech.speaker: Lowerniel Drakan
starting-out-lowerniel-s-speech.text: Now though... Now the answer is finally in my grasp. Thanks to my dear sister, I finally have the means with which to bring about our salvation. I finally have the means for us to return home.

starting-out-lowerniel-s-speech.speaker: Lord Alexei Jovkai
starting-out-lowerniel-s-speech.text: Home? Surely you don't mean Vampyrium? You would see us return to that wasteland? You would see us return to lives of misery?

starting-out-lowerniel-s-speech.speaker: Lowerniel Drakan
starting-out-lowerniel-s-speech.text: I would see us return to lives of strength! I will take us back to a land where we will live as we were meant to! Not as royalty! Not as aristocrats! No. We will be hunters once more.

starting-out-lowerniel-s-speech.speaker: Lowerniel Drakan
starting-out-lowerniel-s-speech.text: Before you is Safalaan Hallow, son of Efaritay Hallow. Her icyene blood runs through his veins. That blood contains the power to take us home.

starting-out-lowerniel-s-speech.speaker: Lord Mischa Myrmel
starting-out-lowerniel-s-speech.text: We will never follow you, Drakan. Return to Vampyrium if you wish. Take those foolish enough to still believe in you as well if you like. The rest of us will remain here. This is our home now.

starting-out-lowerniel-s-speech.speaker: Lowerniel Drakan
starting-out-lowerniel-s-speech.text: And how long will you last if you remain? The humans here are spent. There is no longer enough of them to feed you.

starting-out-lowerniel-s-speech.speaker: Lord Mischa Myrmel
starting-out-lowerniel-s-speech.text: Then we must find a way to cross the Salve!

starting-out-lowerniel-s-speech.speaker: Lowerniel Drakan
starting-out-lowerniel-s-speech.text: Many have tried and failed. Do you truly believe that you, Lord Myrmel, will have better luck?

starting-out-lowerniel-s-speech.speaker: Lowerniel Drakan
starting-out-lowerniel-s-speech.text: No. There is only one hope for us now, but if you would rather die than accept that, then die you will.

starting-out-lowerniel-s-speech.speaker: Lowerniel Drakan
starting-out-lowerniel-s-speech.text: With the blood of the half-icyene, I have been able to create a portal to travel to and from Vampyrium, but his blood alone isn't enough to transport us all. For that, more will be needed.

starting-out-lowerniel-s-speech.speaker: Lowerniel Drakan
starting-out-lowerniel-s-speech.text: Human blood. Vampyre blood. It makes no difference. The half-icyene is the catalyst. The rest matters not. But one way or another, sacrifice will be required.

starting-out-lowerniel-s-speech.speaker: Lord Alexei Jovkai
starting-out-lowerniel-s-speech.text: And how do you propose to achieve these sacrifices?

starting-out-lowerniel-s-speech.speaker: Lowerniel Drakan
starting-out-lowerniel-s-speech.text: For that, fate seems to have already provided the answer. A blood moon will soon rise over these lands, and it will do so on the exact same night that one rises over Vampyrium.

starting-out-lowerniel-s-speech.speaker: Lowerniel Drakan
starting-out-lowerniel-s-speech.text: And so, on that night, we shall finally hunt again, for at long last, we shall experience the Night of the Blood Moon once more.

starting-out-lowerniel-s-speech.speaker: Lord Mischa Myrmel
starting-out-lowerniel-s-speech.text: The Night of the Blood Moon? You would bring back that festival?

starting-out-lowerniel-s-speech.speaker: Lord Alexei Jovkai
starting-out-lowerniel-s-speech.text: Festival? A night of carnage would be a better description! You can't possibly believe we'll go along with this, Drakan!

starting-out-lowerniel-s-speech.speaker: Lowerniel Drakan
starting-out-lowerniel-s-speech.text: If you will not hunt, you will be hunted. One way or another, the blood needed will be gathered.

starting-out-lowerniel-s-speech.speaker: Lord Mischa Myrmel
starting-out-lowerniel-s-speech.text: You would see us go back to being mere beasts! We will not have it! You are a failure, Drakan. It's time we had a new leader. One who understands who we are now, rather than lamenting over what we once were.

starting-out-lowerniel-s-speech.speaker: Lowerniel Drakan
starting-out-lowerniel-s-speech.text: If you wish for the title, then claim it. You know what the Night of the Blood Moon is. If by the night's end you have the most kills, Lord Myrmel, then you will become our leader.

starting-out-lowerniel-s-speech.speaker: Lowerniel Drakan
starting-out-lowerniel-s-speech.text: Now, I must return to Vampyrium. There is much I need to prepare before the festival begins. The wise among you will begin to prepare as well.

starting-out-lowerniel-s-speech.speaker: Lowerniel Drakan
starting-out-lowerniel-s-speech.text: As a starting point, you may wish to deal with the two humans that stand among you, unless of course you've all become so weak that you can't even do that anymore...

starting-out-escaping-the-vampyres.player: Ivan! We need to get out of here!

starting-out-escaping-the-vampyres.speaker: Ivan Strom
starting-out-escaping-the-vampyres.text: Not like this... Not here! Not again!

starting-out-escaping-the-vampyres.speaker: Ivan Strom
starting-out-escaping-the-vampyres.text: I'll try and teleport us out of here! Keep them off me!

starting-out-escaping-the-vampyres.speaker: Ivan Strom
starting-out-escaping-the-vampyres.text: I'm working on it, but I need more time!

starting-out-escaping-the-vampyres.speaker: Ivan Strom
starting-out-escaping-the-vampyres.text: Just a little longer! I'm almost there!
Ivan teleports himself and the player away from Castle Drakan.

starting-out-escaping-the-vampyres-if-iv.speaker: Ivan Strom
starting-out-escaping-the-vampyres-if-iv.text: I'm not looking so good here! I could use some food if you have any!

starting-out-escaping-the-vampyres-tryin.text: You don't have anything suitable to heal Ivan with.

starting-out-back-at-the-hideout.speaker: Ivan Strom
starting-out-back-at-the-hideout.text: Yes... I'm fine... I'm sorry for... For what happened there.

starting-out-back-at-the-hideout.player: It doesn't matter. I'm just glad you're okay.

starting-out-back-at-the-hideout.speaker: Ivan Strom
starting-out-back-at-the-hideout.text: I guess... I guess we need to start working on an evacuation plan. We need to get as many people out of Morytania as possible.

starting-out-back-at-the-hideout.player: But how? We'll barely get anyone out in time.

starting-out-back-at-the-hideout.speaker: Ivan Strom
starting-out-back-at-the-hideout.text: I know, but what else can we do?

starting-out-back-at-the-hideout.player: We stop Drakan! Stop him before he can begin this festival of his!

starting-out-back-at-the-hideout.speaker: Ivan Strom
starting-out-back-at-the-hideout.text: Stop Drakan? [player name]... I couldn't even cast a teleport spell to escape a few vyrewatch. Besides, even if we could stop him, you heard what he said. He's gone to this Vampyrium place. We can't get to him now.

starting-out-back-at-the-hideout.player: There must be a way. Maybe we could make our own portal there? Or perhaps there's some existing form of teleportation we can use?

starting-out-back-at-the-hideout.speaker: Ivan Strom
starting-out-back-at-the-hideout.text: It sounded like it took Drakan years to work it out, and it only became possible thanks to Safalaan. Even if we could find a way, we don't have the time!

starting-out-back-at-the-hideout.player: Well, how about we use the portal that Drakan's already made then?

starting-out-back-at-the-hideout.speaker: Ivan Strom
starting-out-back-at-the-hideout.text: But would that even work? The whole point of this festival is to gather the blood needed to use it.

starting-out-back-at-the-hideout.player: True, but that's only so he can transport a large number of vampyres at once. He's presumably been using it himself without issue, so perhaps we can as well?

starting-out-back-at-the-hideout.speaker: Ivan Strom
starting-out-back-at-the-hideout.text: Perhaps... Say we're able to do this though. Say we manage to reach the portal and use it to get to Vampyrium. Then what?

starting-out-back-at-the-hideout.player: I've got it! It's like you said: this is all only possible because of Safalaan! His blood is the catalyst! It doesn't matter how much other blood Drakan can gather. Without Safalaan, his whole plan is over!
Here's what we do: We find this portal, use it to travel to Vampyrium, find and rescue Safalaan, and then return here, closing the portal behind us when we do. Drakan would be left trapped there!

starting-out-back-at-the-hideout.speaker: Ivan Strom
starting-out-back-at-the-hideout.text: Meaning we'd never actually need to face him directly... I suppose it could work, but it's such a slim hope...

starting-out-back-at-the-hideout.player: Maybe, but while there's still some hope, even slim, we can't give up.

starting-out-back-at-the-hideout.speaker: Ivan Strom
starting-out-back-at-the-hideout.text: Okay, let's say we do this... Where would we even start?

starting-out-back-at-the-hideout.player: With more help. Drakan didn't quite kill all the Myreque.

starting-out-back-at-the-hideout.speaker: Ivan Strom
starting-out-back-at-the-hideout.text: You mean Veliaf? He abandoned us! What makes you think he'll suddenly help us now?

starting-out-back-at-the-hideout.player: He might not, but we need to at least try to convince him.

starting-out-back-at-the-hideout.speaker: Ivan Strom
starting-out-back-at-the-hideout.text: We'd need to find him first.

starting-out-back-at-the-hideout.player: Indeed. Any idea where he might have gone?

starting-out-back-at-the-hideout.speaker: Ivan Strom
starting-out-back-at-the-hideout.text: I never bothered looking into it much, given he didn't seem to care about checking on me.

starting-out-back-at-the-hideout.speaker: Ivan Strom
starting-out-back-at-the-hideout.text: Last I spoke to Drezel, he mentioned hearing that Veliaf might be in Slepe.

starting-out-back-at-the-hideout.speaker: Ivan Strom
starting-out-back-at-the-hideout.text: Fine. I need to make some arrangements here first, but then I'll head over there. If we end up getting separated, I've left a fair bit of equipment with Old Man Ral upstairs. Speak to him if you need anything.

starting-out-back-at-the-hideout.speaker: Ivan Strom
starting-out-back-at-the-hideout.text: I'll meet you outside the church in Slepe. Oh, and [player name]...

starting-out-back-at-the-hideout.speaker: Ivan Strom
starting-out-back-at-the-hideout.text: Just make sure you've got your expectations in check. Even if we find Veliaf, be ready for him to disappoint us.

starting-out-talking-to-ivan-in-the-hide.speaker: Ivan Strom
starting-out-talking-to-ivan-in-the-hide.text: I'll be heading over to Slepe soon. I'll meet you outside the church there.

the-truth-hurtz-talking-to-ivan-in-slepe.player: Ivan. Glad to see you made it okay.

the-truth-hurtz-talking-to-ivan-in-slepe.speaker: Ivan Strom
the-truth-hurtz-talking-to-ivan-in-slepe.text: And you. So where do we start?

the-truth-hurtz-talking-to-ivan-in-slepe.player: Well, if Veliaf is here, someone must have seen him. We should ask around, and I reckon the pub will be the best place to start.

steps.player: Let's get going.

steps.speaker: Ivan Strom
steps.text: I'm right behind you.

options.text: Are you going to be okay when we find Veliaf?

steps.player: Are you going to be okay when we find Veliaf?

steps.speaker: Ivan Strom
steps.text: I'll be fine. It's not like this is the first time Veliaf and I have had disagreements.

steps.player: I feel like it's a bit more than just disagreements this time... Not to mention, we have no idea what sort of headspace he'll be in.

steps.speaker: Ivan Strom
steps.text: I've known him long enough that I could make a pretty good guess. For so long he tried his best to protect me... to protect all of us.

steps.speaker: Ivan Strom
steps.text: After what happened in Darkmeyer, he finally realised he couldn't, and it broke him. Veliaf often said I was naive, but in truth, I think he was always the naive one.

steps.speaker: Ivan Strom
steps.text: Anyway, it doesn't really matter. I may get why he left, but that doesn't change the fact that I might just hate him for it.

steps.speaker: Ivan Strom
steps.text: As for if I'll be okay when we find him? The truth is that I don't think I'll know until we do, so we may as well get to it.

options.text: I need to do something else.

steps.player: I need to do something else.

steps.speaker: Ivan Strom
steps.text: Alright, I'll meet you back outside the church. Just don't take too long.

the-truth-hurtz-talking-to-ivan-after-he.speaker: Ivan Strom
the-truth-hurtz-talking-to-ivan-after-he.text: [player name]. Shall we get to it?

the-truth-hurtz-talking-to-ivan-after-he.player: Indeed. I reckon the pub will be the best place to start.

options.text: Are you going to be okay when we find Veliaf?
I need to do something else.
Let's head over to the pub.

steps.player: Let's head over to the pub.

steps.speaker: Ivan Strom
steps.text: I'm right behind you.

options.text: Are you going to be okay when we find Veliaf?
I need to do something else.

the-truth-hurtz-talking-to-roy.speaker: Roy
the-truth-hurtz-talking-to-roy.text: Good day, [sir/madam]. Could I interest you in one of our finest Bloody Bracers? It's a local speciality.

options.text: We're looking for a friend of ours.

steps.player: We're looking for a friend of ours.

steps.speaker: Roy
steps.text: And you think this friend might have been here? Well, could you describe them?

steps.speaker: Ivan Strom
steps.text: I'd say he'd be best described as a complete and utter cretin.

steps.player: Er... Yeah, he's a bit of a... grumpy fellow. He's also got black hair and a mustache.

steps.speaker: Roy
steps.text: Ah, yes I've seen him around. He was in here earlier in fact, having a drink...

steps.speaker: Roy
steps.text: Quite a bit to drink...

steps.player: I see... You don't happen to know where he went after he left, do you?

steps.speaker: Roy
steps.text: That, I do not. However, I did hear that there was some commotion up at Crombwick Manor soon afterwards.

steps.player: I suppose that could be worth a look. Thanks for the help.

steps.speaker: Roy
steps.text: It was very much my pleasure, [sir/madam].

the-truth-hurtz-talking-to-roy-talking-t.speaker: Roy
the-truth-hurtz-talking-to-roy-talking-t.text: Good day, [sir/madam]. Could I interest you in one of our finest Bloody Bracers? It's a local speciality.

options.text: We're looking for a friend of ours.

steps.player: We're looking for a friend of ours.

steps.speaker: Roy
steps.text: Like I said, he left here after having quite a few drinks. I don't know where he went, but I did hear that there was some commotion up at Crombwick Manor soon afterwards.

steps.player: Ah, yes. Thanks for the help.

options.text: Let's head over to Crombwick Manor.

steps.player: Let's head over to Crombwick Manor.

steps.speaker: Ivan Strom
steps.text: I'm right behind you.

options.text: Are you going to be okay when we find Veliaf?
I need to do something else.

the-truth-hurtz-trying-the-crombwick-man.player: Locked. We'll need to head through the dungeon.

the-truth-hurtz-talking-to-veliaf-inside.speaker: Veliaf Hurtz
the-truth-hurtz-talking-to-veliaf-inside.text: What do you think you're doing?

the-truth-hurtz-talking-to-veliaf-inside.speaker: Veliaf Hurtz
the-truth-hurtz-talking-to-veliaf-inside.text: Do I look like I need help?

the-truth-hurtz-talking-to-veliaf-inside.player: With how drunk you are, I'd say the answer is yes. How many have you had?

the-truth-hurtz-talking-to-veliaf-inside.speaker: Veliaf Hurtz
the-truth-hurtz-talking-to-veliaf-inside.text: Not enough. Now, if you're done asking stupid questions, would you mind getting out of my way?

the-truth-hurtz-talking-to-veliaf-inside.speaker: Ivan Strom
the-truth-hurtz-talking-to-veliaf-inside.text: Why? So you can run off again?

the-truth-hurtz-talking-to-veliaf-inside.speaker: Veliaf Hurtz
the-truth-hurtz-talking-to-veliaf-inside.text: Run? Does it look like I'm running? Look around you! What do you see!

the-truth-hurtz-talking-to-veliaf-inside.speaker: Ivan Strom
the-truth-hurtz-talking-to-veliaf-inside.text: What I see is a drunk who's desperately trying to get himself killed!

the-truth-hurtz-talking-to-veliaf-inside.speaker: Veliaf Hurtz
the-truth-hurtz-talking-to-veliaf-inside.text: You don't know what you're talking about!

the-truth-hurtz-talking-to-veliaf-inside.speaker: Ivan Strom
the-truth-hurtz-talking-to-veliaf-inside.text: Face it, Veliaf! You can spin things however you want, but the truth is, you abandoned us! You abandoned the Myreque!

the-truth-hurtz-talking-to-veliaf-inside.speaker: Veliaf Hurtz
the-truth-hurtz-talking-to-veliaf-inside.text: The Myreque are gone, Ivan!

the-truth-hurtz-talking-to-veliaf-inside.player: Not quite, Veliaf. Safalaan is still alive. Drakan has him as a prisoner, but we have a plan to save him.

the-truth-hurtz-talking-to-veliaf-inside.speaker: Veliaf Hurtz
the-truth-hurtz-talking-to-veliaf-inside.text: What plan?

the-truth-hurtz-talking-to-veliaf-inside.player: Drakan is using Safalaan's blood to travel to and from Vampyrium.

the-truth-hurtz-talking-to-veliaf-inside.speaker: Veliaf Hurtz
the-truth-hurtz-talking-to-veliaf-inside.text: Vampyrium? What are you on about?

the-truth-hurtz-talking-to-veliaf-inside.player: It's apparently the original home of the vampyres. It seems Safalaan's blood is essential to getting there.

the-truth-hurtz-talking-to-veliaf-inside.speaker: Veliaf Hurtz
the-truth-hurtz-talking-to-veliaf-inside.text: So what? You want to go there and rescue him?

the-truth-hurtz-talking-to-veliaf-inside.player: Pretty much. If we can bring Safalaan back, Drakan will end up trapped in Vampyrium.

the-truth-hurtz-talking-to-veliaf-inside.speaker: Veliaf Hurtz
the-truth-hurtz-talking-to-veliaf-inside.text: You've gone mad! If Drakan has Safalaan, then he's as good as dead! We can't help him now. No one can!

the-truth-hurtz-talking-to-veliaf-inside.speaker: Ivan Strom
the-truth-hurtz-talking-to-veliaf-inside.text: So you'd just abandon him? I don't believe that!

the-truth-hurtz-talking-to-veliaf-inside.speaker: Veliaf Hurtz
the-truth-hurtz-talking-to-veliaf-inside.text: Well, I abandoned you apparently! Maybe I was never the person you thought I was!

the-truth-hurtz-talking-to-veliaf-inside.speaker: Ivan Strom
the-truth-hurtz-talking-to-veliaf-inside.text: You were always the person I thought you were, Veliaf! You tried so hard to be the father I lost, and you know what, yes, you were terrible at it! But you tried, and that was enough for me!

the-truth-hurtz-talking-to-veliaf-inside.speaker: Ivan Strom
the-truth-hurtz-talking-to-veliaf-inside.text: I never lost faith in you! When you lied about Calsidiu, I understood why! Even when you lied about my parents, I understood why!

the-truth-hurtz-talking-to-veliaf-inside.speaker: Veliaf Hurtz
the-truth-hurtz-talking-to-veliaf-inside.text: I never lied about your parents!

the-truth-hurtz-talking-to-veliaf-inside.speaker: Ivan Strom
the-truth-hurtz-talking-to-veliaf-inside.text: I'm not a fool, Veliaf! I know who my mother really was! I know I'm the descendant of Ivandis Seergaze!

the-truth-hurtz-talking-to-veliaf-inside.speaker: Veliaf Hurtz
the-truth-hurtz-talking-to-veliaf-inside.text: [player name]? Did you tell him?

the-truth-hurtz-talking-to-veliaf-inside.speaker: Ivan Strom
the-truth-hurtz-talking-to-veliaf-inside.text: [player name] didn't need to tell me, Veliaf! I worked it out for myself! I was so angry when I did, but I forgave you, because I believed in you!

the-truth-hurtz-talking-to-veliaf-inside.speaker: Ivan Strom
the-truth-hurtz-talking-to-veliaf-inside.text: Maybe you've finally lost your faith in yourself, Veliaf. I'd understand if you have. Truth be told, I thought I'd lost my faith in you as well.

the-truth-hurtz-talking-to-veliaf-inside.speaker: Ivan Strom
the-truth-hurtz-talking-to-veliaf-inside.text: But now, standing here before you, I realise I haven't. Even after all that's happened! Even after all that you've done! I still believe in you!

the-truth-hurtz-talking-to-veliaf-inside.speaker: Ivan Strom
the-truth-hurtz-talking-to-veliaf-inside.text: Now, I'm going to Paterdomus. We need to work out how to reach Vampyrium. The library there seems like the best place to start.

the-truth-hurtz-talking-to-veliaf-inside.speaker: Ivan Strom
the-truth-hurtz-talking-to-veliaf-inside.text: You can stay here and drink yourself to death if you want, Veliaf, but this fight isn't over yet. I trust you'll make the right choice.
Ivan departs.

the-truth-hurtz-talking-to-veliaf-inside.speaker: Veliaf Hurtz
the-truth-hurtz-talking-to-veliaf-inside.text: Right, anything you want to lecture me on?

the-truth-hurtz-talking-to-veliaf-inside.player: Not really. Ivan put it better than I ever could. Now, I'd better get to Paterdomus.

the-truth-hurtz-talking-to-veliaf-again.speaker: Veliaf Hurtz
the-truth-hurtz-talking-to-veliaf-again.text: Go on, get yourself to Paterdomus. No benefit to either of us you standing here talking to me.

the-truth-hurtz-talking-to-ivan-and-drez.speaker: Drezel
the-truth-hurtz-talking-to-ivan-and-drez.text: ... and this land you speak of... surely it can't actually exist?!

the-truth-hurtz-talking-to-ivan-and-drez.speaker: Ivan Strom
the-truth-hurtz-talking-to-ivan-and-drez.text: It seems it does, Drezel.

the-truth-hurtz-talking-to-ivan-and-drez.speaker: Drezel
the-truth-hurtz-talking-to-ivan-and-drez.text: Ivan, please, do not go forward with this plan! I will send word to the King! He will send help, I'm sure of it!

the-truth-hurtz-talking-to-ivan-and-drez.speaker: Ivan Strom
the-truth-hurtz-talking-to-ivan-and-drez.text: Like his mercenaries? How useful have they been? Face it, Drezel, we're on our own.

the-truth-hurtz-talking-to-ivan-and-drez.speaker: Drezel
the-truth-hurtz-talking-to-ivan-and-drez.text: Ah, [player name]! Surely you are not in favour of this plan?

the-truth-hurtz-talking-to-ivan-and-drez.player: Well, it was actually my idea...

the-truth-hurtz-talking-to-ivan-and-drez.speaker: Drezel
the-truth-hurtz-talking-to-ivan-and-drez.text: Oh, Saradomin save us...

the-truth-hurtz-talking-to-ivan-and-drez.speaker: Ivan Strom
the-truth-hurtz-talking-to-ivan-and-drez.text: Did Veliaf have anything else to say to you, [player name]?

the-truth-hurtz-talking-to-ivan-and-drez.speaker: Ivan Strom
the-truth-hurtz-talking-to-ivan-and-drez.text: Well, we'll just have to hope he makes the right choice. Anyway, now that you're here, we can get started.

the-truth-hurtz-talking-to-ivan-and-drez.speaker: Ivan Strom
the-truth-hurtz-talking-to-ivan-and-drez.text: We need to find a way to reach this portal that Drakan has made. I reckon it's a pretty safe bet that it will be somewhere inside Castle Drakan.

the-truth-hurtz-talking-to-ivan-and-drez.speaker: Drezel
the-truth-hurtz-talking-to-ivan-and-drez.text: Castle Drakan?! You have no hope of getting in there!

the-truth-hurtz-talking-to-ivan-and-drez.speaker: Ivan Strom
the-truth-hurtz-talking-to-ivan-and-drez.text: Not through the front door, but I'd be surprised if that was the only way in there.

the-truth-hurtz-talking-to-ivan-and-drez.player: Are you sure? Vanescula once said the castle was impenetrable.

the-truth-hurtz-talking-to-ivan-and-drez.speaker: Ivan Strom
the-truth-hurtz-talking-to-ivan-and-drez.text: But maybe she was lying, or maybe there are ways in even she didn't know about.

the-truth-hurtz-talking-to-ivan-and-drez.player: But how do we go about finding out?

the-truth-hurtz-talking-to-ivan-and-drez.speaker: Ivan Strom
the-truth-hurtz-talking-to-ivan-and-drez.text: Well, I had a look in the library and I found this old journal. Have a read of it and see what you reckon.
If the player has a free inventory space:

steps.text: Ivan gives you the journal.

the-truth-hurtz-talking-to-ivan-and-drez.text: If the player's inventory is full:

steps.text: Ivan tries to give you the journal, but you don't have enough room to take it.

the-truth-hurtz-talking-to-ivan-or-dreze.speaker: Ivan Strom
the-truth-hurtz-talking-to-ivan-or-dreze.text: Have a read of that old journal, [player name], and see what you reckon.

the-truth-hurtz-talking-to-ivan-and-drez.player: So Ivandis set out to kill Drakan.

the-truth-hurtz-talking-to-ivan-and-drez.speaker: Ivan Strom
the-truth-hurtz-talking-to-ivan-and-drez.text: Exactly! He surely must have had some sort of plan for getting into the castle!

the-truth-hurtz-talking-to-ivan-and-drez.player: Apparently this squire hid Ivandis' writings within Paterdomus itself. Any idea what that might mean, Drezel?

the-truth-hurtz-talking-to-ivan-and-drez.speaker: Drezel
the-truth-hurtz-talking-to-ivan-and-drez.text: Blasphemy! That's what it means! This journal clearly can't be trusted!

the-truth-hurtz-talking-to-ivan-and-drez.speaker: Ivan Strom
the-truth-hurtz-talking-to-ivan-and-drez.text: Maybe, but there's only one way to find out. Let's head up into the temple and see if we can find these writings.

the-truth-hurtz-talking-to-ivan-and-drez.player: I can't imagine those Zamorakians up there will just let us start poking around.

the-truth-hurtz-talking-to-ivan-and-drez.speaker: Ivan Strom
the-truth-hurtz-talking-to-ivan-and-drez.text: Well, I'd say they've well overstayed their welcome here anyway, so maybe it's about time we cleared them out.

the-truth-hurtz-talking-to-ivan-and-drez.player: Sounds like a plan! Let's do it!

the-truth-hurtz-talking-to-ivan-and-drez.speaker: Ivan Strom
the-truth-hurtz-talking-to-ivan-and-drez.text: I'm right behind you, [player name].

the-truth-hurtz-talking-to-ivan-and-drez.speaker: Drezel
the-truth-hurtz-talking-to-ivan-and-drez.text: You two be careful up there.

the-truth-hurtz-talking-to-drezel-again.speaker: Drezel
the-truth-hurtz-talking-to-drezel-again.text: I won't be sad to see those Zamorakians gone, but just make sure you both take care up there.

options.text: Let's go and deal with those Zamorakians.

steps.player: Let's go and deal with those Zamorakians.

steps.speaker: Ivan Strom
steps.text: I'm right behind you.

options.text: I need to do something else.

steps.player: I need to do something else.

steps.speaker: Ivan Strom
steps.text: Alright, I'll meet you back in the mausoleum. Just don't take too long.

the-truth-hurtz-trying-to-enter-the-pate.player: Hmm... I should go and get Ivan before heading in there.

the-truth-hurtz-upon-killing-the-monks-o.speaker: Ivan Strom
the-truth-hurtz-upon-killing-the-monks-o.text: Nice job, [player name]. Let's check upstairs.

the-truth-hurtz-talking-to-ivan-upstairs.speaker: Ivan Strom
the-truth-hurtz-talking-to-ivan-upstairs.text: Right, now that those monks are dealt with, we can get to work on finding these writings. Any thoughts on where to start?

the-truth-hurtz-talking-to-ivan-upstairs.player: I'm not too sure, but I do wonder if that journal you found could help us out in some way. I'll give it another read and see what I can come up with.

options.text: Could you remind me who the Seven Priestly Warriors were?

steps.player: Could you remind me who the Seven Priestly Warriors were?

steps.speaker: Ivan Strom
steps.text: Sure thing. During the Fourth Age, Drakan and his vampyres tried to invade Misthalin. The Seven Priestly Warriors led the army that stood against him.

steps.speaker: Ivan Strom
steps.text: The war ended when the seven of them blessed the Salve, right here where Paterdomus was eventually built.

steps.speaker: Ivan Strom
steps.text: It's said that all seven died in the battle when the river was blessed, with them being buried in the mausoleum below.

steps.speaker: Ivan Strom
steps.text: Of course, as it turns out, that wasn't actually true. Ivandis survived the battle. He journeyed into Morytania and eventually died there.

steps.player: And if this journal you found is to be believed, he did so while trying to kill Drakan.

steps.speaker: Ivan Strom
steps.text: Indeed.

steps.player: What about the other six? Who were they?

steps.speaker: Ivan Strom
steps.text: There was Iriandul Caistlyn, Sarl Dunegun, Friar Twiblick, Derygull Templeton, Erysail the Pious and Essiandar Gar.

options.text: How did you find out you were descended from Ivandis?

steps.player: How did you find out you were descended from Ivandis?

steps.speaker: Ivan Strom
steps.text: Truth be told, I'm surprised I didn't work it out sooner. Drezel never hid the fact that he wanted me to succeed him, and he and Veliaf always tried so hard to keep me safe.

steps.speaker: Ivan Strom
steps.text: I always just thought they were trying to look out for me, but eventually I realised it was more than that. That there was something else going on.

steps.speaker: Ivan Strom
steps.text: I searched through the library below and found some information on Ivandis' family. It took some work, but I was eventually able to link them directly to my mother, and to me.

steps.player: Why didn't you tell us that you knew?

steps.speaker: Ivan Strom
steps.text: At first I was angry, but I soon came to understand why. By that point though, there was no easy way to bring it up, and let's be honest, we often had more important things to worry about.

steps.player: Very true.
I'll get to it.

options.text: Could you remind me who the Seven Priestly Warriors were?
How did you find out you were descended from Ivandis?

the-truth-hurtz-inspecting-the-plinths.text: An empty plinth. It doesn't seem to hold anything, or help offer any structural integrity.

the-truth-hurtz-inspecting-the-stained-g.text: The window displays an ornate picture of a man riding a steed of some sort.
The window displays an ornate picture of a man holding a mace high above his head.
The window displays an ornate picture of a bearded man wielding a shield.
The window displays an ornate picture of a woman with braided hair.
The window displays an ornate picture of a man with a Guthixian symbol behind him.
The window displays an ornate picture of a solemn looking woman with white hair.

the-truth-hurtz-upon-completing-the-book.text: The books on the plinths vanish before your eyes and you hear a click come from a nearby desk. Ivan searches the desk and finds something hidden inside.

the-truth-hurtz-talking-to-ivan-after-so.speaker: Ivan Strom
the-truth-hurtz-talking-to-ivan-after-so.text: This is... quite something. Here, you'd better see for yourself.

the-truth-hurtz-talking-to-ivan-after-re.player: So Ivandis started to become a vampyre...

the-truth-hurtz-talking-to-ivan-after-re.speaker: Ivan Strom
the-truth-hurtz-talking-to-ivan-after-re.text: He gave everything to stop them, and that was his reward... I can't even begin to imagine what that must have been like...

the-truth-hurtz-talking-to-ivan-after-re.speaker: Ivan Strom
the-truth-hurtz-talking-to-ivan-after-re.text: In a weird way though, it kind of gives me hope. Ivandis may have died before he could kill Drakan, but thanks to him, we might now be able to succeed where he failed.

the-truth-hurtz-talking-to-ivan-after-re.speaker: Ivan Strom
the-truth-hurtz-talking-to-ivan-after-re.text: So many people have died in this fight. Ivandis was one of thousands. But if their sacrifices can help us succeed now, then they didn't die for nothing.

the-truth-hurtz-talking-to-ivan-after-re.speaker: Ivan Strom
the-truth-hurtz-talking-to-ivan-after-re.text: Now, let's head back down to the mausoleum. Maybe best we don't mention Ivandis becoming a vampyre to Drezel...
The two of you return to the mausoleum.

the-truth-hurtz-talking-to-ivan-after-re.speaker: Ivan Strom
the-truth-hurtz-talking-to-ivan-after-re.text: Veliaf! You've...

the-truth-hurtz-talking-to-ivan-after-re.speaker: Veliaf Hurtz
the-truth-hurtz-talking-to-ivan-after-re.text: Sobered up?

the-truth-hurtz-talking-to-ivan-after-re.speaker: Ivan Strom
the-truth-hurtz-talking-to-ivan-after-re.text: Well, that's one way of putting it...

the-truth-hurtz-talking-to-ivan-after-re.speaker: Ivan Strom
the-truth-hurtz-talking-to-ivan-after-re.text: Veliaf, about earlier...

the-truth-hurtz-talking-to-ivan-after-re.speaker: Veliaf Hurtz
the-truth-hurtz-talking-to-ivan-after-re.text: We'll talk about it later. In the meantime, Drezel tells me you've been working on some suicide plan to reach Vampyrium. Come on, let's hear it.

the-truth-hurtz-talking-to-ivan-after-re.player: Before he died, Ivandis Seergaze set out on one final attempt to kill Drakan. It seems he was aware of a tunnel leading directly into Castle Drakan.
We find this tunnel, use it to enter the castle, take Drakan's portal to Vampyrium, rescue Safalaan, then return through the portal, closing it behind us.

the-truth-hurtz-talking-to-ivan-after-re.speaker: Veliaf Hurtz
the-truth-hurtz-talking-to-ivan-after-re.text: Yup, suicide...

the-truth-hurtz-talking-to-ivan-after-re.speaker: Veliaf Hurtz
the-truth-hurtz-talking-to-ivan-after-re.text: So where's this tunnel?

the-truth-hurtz-talking-to-ivan-after-re.player: Given this was meant to be Ivandis' last act before his death, my guess would be within the caves where I found his tomb.

the-truth-hurtz-talking-to-ivan-after-re.speaker: Veliaf Hurtz
the-truth-hurtz-talking-to-ivan-after-re.text: Alright then, I guess we'd better get going.

the-truth-hurtz-talking-to-ivan-after-re.speaker: Drezel
the-truth-hurtz-talking-to-ivan-after-re.text: Can you not wait a bit longer? I sent a letter to the King!

the-truth-hurtz-talking-to-ivan-after-re.speaker: Veliaf Hurtz
the-truth-hurtz-talking-to-ivan-after-re.text: And I'm sure he'll send us his best wishes in return. Face it, Drezel, as far as everyone in Misthalin is concerned, Morytania is a lost cause.

the-truth-hurtz-talking-to-ivan-after-re.speaker: Veliaf Hurtz
the-truth-hurtz-talking-to-ivan-after-re.text: Truth be told, they're probably right. In a few hours, we'll almost certainly all be dead.

the-truth-hurtz-talking-to-ivan-after-re.speaker: Ivan Strom
the-truth-hurtz-talking-to-ivan-after-re.text: Very inspiring...

the-truth-hurtz-talking-to-ivan-after-re.speaker: Veliaf Hurtz
the-truth-hurtz-talking-to-ivan-after-re.text: Well, if you wanted inspiration, you shouldn't have come up with a suicide mission. Now let's go.

steps.player: Lead the way.

steps.text: The three of you depart for Ivandis' tomb.

steps.speaker: Veliaf Hurtz
steps.text: So here we are. The final resting place of Ivandis Seergaze. I'm not seeing any tunnel anywhere...

steps.player: Let's have a look around and see what we can find.

options.text: I'll make my own way there.

steps.player: I'll make my own way there.

steps.speaker: Veliaf Hurtz
steps.text: Fair enough. Just let us know if you change your mind.

the-truth-hurtz-talking-to-ivan-after-re.speaker: Drezel
the-truth-hurtz-talking-to-ivan-after-re.text: I wish you wouldn't go ahead with this plan, but it seems you've made your decision. Please though, be careful, and make sure you take good care of Ivan.

the-truth-hurtz-talking-to-ivan-after-re.speaker: Veliaf Hurtz
the-truth-hurtz-talking-to-ivan-after-re.text: No point wasting any time. Let's go and investigate those caves.

options.text: I'll make my own way there.

the-truth-hurtz-investigating-the-blocka.text: It looks like there might be something behind this blockage. You might be able to mine through it.
If the player has a pickaxe:

steps.prompt: Mine through the blockage?

steps.text: You swing your pickaxe at the blockage...
...and successfully mine through it.

the-truth-hurtz-investigating-the-blocka.text: If the player does not have a pickaxe:

steps.speaker: Ivan Strom
steps.text: Find anything, [player name]?

steps.player: There's some sort of collapsed tunnel here. I reckon I'm going to need to go get a pickaxe and then try mining through it.

steps.speaker: Ivan Strom
steps.text: You didn't bring a pickaxe with you?

steps.player: No.

steps.speaker: Ivan Strom
steps.text: Even though you knew we were going to an underground cave? Some adventurer you are!

steps.player: Well, I only have so much space to carry things.

steps.speaker: Ivan Strom
steps.text: Good job I brought one then! Just come grab it if you need it.

the-truth-hurtz-talking-to-veliaf.player: Maybe... I reckon there might be something behind that wall over there. I'm going to try and mine through it.

the-truth-hurtz-talking-to-veliaf.speaker: Veliaf Hurtz
the-truth-hurtz-talking-to-veliaf.text: Well, let us know how it goes.

the-truth-hurtz-mining-the-blockage.text: You swing your pickaxe at the blockage...

the-truth-hurtz-talking-to-ivan-and-veli.speaker: Slave
the-truth-hurtz-talking-to-ivan-and-veli.text: They make us refine the daeyalt here. They use it to make more vampyres!

the-truth-hurtz-talking-to-ivan-and-veli.speaker: Ivan Strom
the-truth-hurtz-talking-to-ivan-and-veli.text: More vampyres? But why? Why are they still making more when they're already suffering from overcrowding?

the-truth-hurtz-talking-to-ivan-and-veli.speaker: Slave
the-truth-hurtz-talking-to-ivan-and-veli.text: I'm sorry, but I don't know...

the-truth-hurtz-talking-to-ivan-and-veli.player: Well, you don't need to worry about them any longer. You're free now. Head through the tunnel we came through. You'll find a route leading towards Canifis. Head to Paterdomus once you get there.

the-truth-hurtz-talking-to-ivan-and-veli.text: The slaves escape through the tunnel.

the-truth-hurtz-talking-to-ivan-and-veli.speaker: Veliaf Hurtz
the-truth-hurtz-talking-to-ivan-and-veli.text: We'd better keep moving. It probably won't be long before someone comes to check in on things here.

the-truth-hurtz-talking-to-ivan-after-fr.speaker: Ivan Strom
the-truth-hurtz-talking-to-ivan-after-fr.text: I reckon we're getting close now, [player name]. Lead the way.

the-truth-hurtz-talking-to-veliaf-after-.speaker: Veliaf Hurtz
the-truth-hurtz-talking-to-veliaf-after-.text: We can't be far off now. Stay alert.

the-truth-hurtz-talking-to-ivan-in-castl.speaker: Ivan Strom
the-truth-hurtz-talking-to-ivan-in-castl.text: I think this might be it, [player name].

the-truth-hurtz-talking-to-veliaf-in-cas.speaker: Veliaf Hurtz
the-truth-hurtz-talking-to-veliaf-in-cas.text: This must be it. Keep a close eye out for vampyres.

the-truth-hurtz-praying-to-the-shrine.text: You pray to the odd shrine, and a strange sensation washes over you. You feel that your Drakan's Medallion can now bring you back here.

escape-from-castle-drakan-entering-the-p.player: We've no idea what we'll find on the other side. If we get separated, try to make your way back to the portal.

escape-from-castle-drakan-entering-the-p.speaker: Veliaf Hurtz
escape-from-castle-drakan-entering-the-p.text: That's assuming Drakan himself doesn't rip us to shreds as soon as we arrive...

escape-from-castle-drakan-entering-the-p.player: What a lovely thought. No point in us waiting around I guess. Let's do this...

steps.text: The player, Ivan, and Veliaf walk through the portal.

steps.speaker: Ivan Strom
steps.text: Did it work?
Veliaf vomits.

steps.speaker: Ivan Strom
steps.text: Veliaf?!

steps.speaker: Veliaf Hurtz
steps.text: Eugh...

steps.speaker: Veliaf Hurtz
steps.text: I'm fine.

steps.speaker: Ivan Strom
steps.text: If you're sure...

steps.speaker: Veliaf Hurtz
steps.text: Did something go wrong? This room looks very similar to the one we just left...

steps.player: I don't think so... I reckon we're in another Castle Drakan. I guess Drakan based the one in Morytania on this one.

steps.speaker: Veliaf Hurtz
steps.text: We came through a dungeon to get into the one in Morytania. If this one matches that, then I bet that's where Safalaan is.

steps.speaker: Ivan Strom
steps.text: Then let's get down there!
A venator growls.

steps.player: Wait! Do you hear that?

steps.speaker: Ivan Strom
steps.text: [player name]! Run!

escape-from-castle-drakan-attempting-to-.text: It sounds like those creatures are still in there. You're probably best off not going back in until they've moved on.

escape-from-castle-drakan-finding-veliaf.speaker: Veliaf Hurtz
escape-from-castle-drakan-finding-veliaf.text: I'm fine. Any sign of Ivan?

escape-from-castle-drakan-finding-veliaf.player: Afraid not. I'm sure he'll find us though. He knows the dungeon is the aim and he knows where the portal is as well.

escape-from-castle-drakan-finding-veliaf.speaker: Veliaf Hurtz
escape-from-castle-drakan-finding-veliaf.text: Hmm... Best we keep progressing on then.

options.text: Any thoughts on what to do next?

steps.player: Any thoughts on what to do next?

steps.speaker: Veliaf Hurtz
steps.text: Not really. There's something off about these portraits though...

options.text: Do you think things will be okay between you and Ivan?

steps.player: Do you think things will be okay between you and Ivan?

steps.speaker: Veliaf Hurtz
steps.text: Is now really the best time for this?

steps.player: Well, as you keep pointing out, there's a high chance of us dying here, so we might not get another chance.

steps.speaker: Veliaf Hurtz
steps.text: So you're saying this is my opportunity to clear my conscience and die content?

steps.player: Maybe not exactly how I'd have put it...

steps.speaker: Veliaf Hurtz
steps.text: Well, given we're almost certainly dead anyway, I don't see how it matters anymore.

steps.player: Oh, come on. If you really believe that, why bother coming here at all?

steps.speaker: Veliaf Hurtz
steps.text: Why? Because I failed! I failed to protect the Myreque! I failed to protect Ivan! I made one promise to his mother, and I broke it!

steps.player: But Ivan's still alive! This isn't over yet!

steps.speaker: Veliaf Hurtz
steps.text: This was over the second we agreed to Vanescula's plan! Now all of us are living on borrowed time. Me, you, Ivan, Safalaan... None of us are getting out of this alive.

steps.player: So the only reason you came here is so you wouldn't have to die alone and drunk?

steps.speaker: Veliaf Hurtz
steps.text: Pretty much.

steps.player: I don't believe that, and deep down I don't think you do either.

steps.speaker: Veliaf Hurtz
steps.text: Believe what you want, [player name]. It won't matter soon anyway.

steps.player: Agreed. Let's go.

escape-from-castle-drakan-talking-to-vel.speaker: Veliaf Hurtz
escape-from-castle-drakan-talking-to-vel.text: Stay alert. Drakan could be anywhere.

options.text: Any thoughts on what to do next?
Do you think things will be okay between you and Ivan?

escape-from-castle-drakan-venator-corpse.text: The venator corpse has stitches along one side.
While the stomach presumably came from this venator, the corpse has been stitched up again, preventing you from putting it back. That said, you're not sure why you'd want to put it back anyway.
You use the knife to cut open the venator. You find that the stomach is missing, but in its place are some tongs that were left inside. You take them.
The venator corpse has been cut open. The stomach is missing.
The prognosis for this venator is poor. Putting the stomach back in it is unlikely to change that.
For some reason, you stick the syringe into the venator corpse. You're not sure why.

escape-from-castle-drakan-upon-finding-s.speaker: Safalaan Hallow
escape-from-castle-drakan-upon-finding-s.text: Who... Who are you? What is this?

escape-from-castle-drakan-upon-finding-s.speaker: Veliaf Hurtz
escape-from-castle-drakan-upon-finding-s.text: Vanescula! What did your brother do to him?

escape-from-castle-drakan-upon-finding-s.speaker: Vanescula Drakan
escape-from-castle-drakan-upon-finding-s.text: Good to see you both as well. Now, in case you hadn't noticed, my brother and I aren't exactly on the best of terms right now. As for what happened to Safalaan, you tell me. He's been like this since he arrived.

escape-from-castle-drakan-upon-finding-s.player: It must be because of what happened with Vanstrom.

escape-from-castle-drakan-upon-finding-s.speaker: Veliaf Hurtz
escape-from-castle-drakan-upon-finding-s.text: What do we do with him?

escape-from-castle-drakan-upon-finding-s.player: First, we need to get him out of here.

escape-from-castle-drakan-upon-finding-s.speaker: Vanescula Drakan
escape-from-castle-drakan-upon-finding-s.text: I take it you have a plan?

escape-from-castle-drakan-upon-finding-s.player: There's a portal back to Morytania upstairs. We can use it to escape.

escape-from-castle-drakan-upon-finding-s.speaker: Vanescula Drakan
escape-from-castle-drakan-upon-finding-s.text: And what happens when we're back in Morytania? What happens when my brother finds we're no longer in his dungeon?

escape-from-castle-drakan-upon-finding-s.player: It doesn't matter. We'll close the portal behind us. Without Safalaan, he'll be trapped here.

escape-from-castle-drakan-upon-finding-s.speaker: Vanescula Drakan
escape-from-castle-drakan-upon-finding-s.text: Ah, I see you've thought through this plan well. You have however missed just the one very minor detail.

escape-from-castle-drakan-upon-finding-s.speaker: Vanescula Drakan
escape-from-castle-drakan-upon-finding-s.text: My brother comes down here periodically to collect blood from Safalaan. He must be stockpiling it.

escape-from-castle-drakan-upon-finding-s.player: Then we need to destroy this stockpile. Where will it be?

escape-from-castle-drakan-upon-finding-s.speaker: Vanescula Drakan
escape-from-castle-drakan-upon-finding-s.text: My brother's private chambers are on the top floor of the castle. My guess would be somewhere up there.

escape-from-castle-drakan-upon-finding-s.player: Alright, you two get Safalaan back to Morytania. I'll find Ivan, destroy the stockpile and then follow you.

escape-from-castle-drakan-upon-finding-s.speaker: Veliaf Hurtz
escape-from-castle-drakan-upon-finding-s.text: Leave you here alone? No chance!

escape-from-castle-drakan-upon-finding-s.speaker: Veliaf Hurtz
escape-from-castle-drakan-upon-finding-s.text: And unless you destroy that stockpile, he'll be no safer on that side of the portal than this one. We're staying.

escape-from-castle-drakan-upon-finding-s.player: Fine, but if there's any sign of danger, you don't wait for me. Use the portal and get out right away.
Now, let's not waste any time. Drakan is around here somewhere. It's only a matter of time before he finds us. We need to be gone before that happens.

escape-from-castle-drakan-upon-finding-s.speaker: Veliaf Hurtz
escape-from-castle-drakan-upon-finding-s.text: Best you get to it, [player name]. I'll keep an eye on things here.

options.text: Any thoughts on what I should do now?

steps.player: Any thoughts on what I should do now?

steps.speaker: Veliaf Hurtz
steps.text: I guess you should check the rooms we didn't go into earlier. One of them might give you a way forward.

steps.player: Hopefully I'll find Ivan in one of them as well.

steps.speaker: Veliaf Hurtz
steps.text: Yeah... hopefully.

options.text: Do you think things will be okay between you and Ivan?
Do you think things will be okay between you and Ivan?

steps.player: I'll get going.

escape-from-castle-drakan-upon-finding-s.speaker: Safalaan Hallow
escape-from-castle-drakan-upon-finding-s.text: I don't... I don't understand. What's happening?

escape-from-castle-drakan-upon-finding-s.player: Everything's going to be okay, Safalaan. I promise.

escape-from-castle-drakan-upon-finding-s.speaker: Vanescula Drakan
escape-from-castle-drakan-upon-finding-s.text: Unless you fancy facing my brother, I'd suggest you get a move on and destroy that blood stockpile.

options.text: What do you make of your brother's plan?

steps.player: What do you make of your brother's plan?

steps.speaker: Vanescula Drakan
steps.text: I must confess, I underestimated him. I thought he'd long since given up on... well, anything and everything really. Now I see the reality was far worse.

steps.player: We lost some good people thanks to your underestimating.

steps.speaker: Vanescula Drakan
steps.text: Well, I hope you're not expecting an apology. You all knew what you were signing up for.

steps.player: I see your time in the cells hasn't changed you.

steps.speaker: Vanescula Drakan
steps.text: And why would it have? This is not my first time on the back foot. I survived all those previous times, and I will survive this time as well.

steps.player: If you say so. Anyway, back to your brother's plan...

steps.speaker: Vanescula Drakan
steps.text: Yes, like I say, rather unexpected, though I must admit, it is somewhat inspired.

steps.player: How so?

steps.speaker: Vanescula Drakan
steps.text: When we took Hallowvale, Lowerniel said it would be a new beginning for us, but it only took him a few hundred years to grow bored of that.

steps.speaker: Vanescula Drakan
steps.text: That's when he started lamenting about this place instead. He longed to find a way back here, and for a time he actually found one.

steps.player: He worked out how to get here before? How?

steps.speaker: Vanescula Drakan
steps.text: I don't know exactly. My brother was once entrusted with a powerful artefact. I did wonder if that might have been connected, but the timelines don't add up...

steps.speaker: Vanescula Drakan
steps.text: Anyway, however he did it, it didn't last. He eventually lost his way to get here. After that, he mostly withdrew from our society completely. I thought he'd given up, but now I suspect it was all part of a larger plan.

steps.player: How so?

steps.speaker: Vanescula Drakan
steps.text: I don't think he ever stopped trying to find a way back here, and I think he was already preparing for the day when he'd work out how to do so.

steps.speaker: Vanescula Drakan
steps.text: You saw for yourself how my people responded to his announcement. I think it's fair to say that the prospect of returning to Vampyrium is not one that many take joy in.

steps.speaker: Vanescula Drakan
steps.text: And yet... some might consider it more appealing than it once would have been.

steps.speaker: Vanescula Drakan
steps.text: The overcrowding... The shutting down of the Haemalchemy Laboratory... I think he was intentionally pushing us to the brink. Putting us in a place where his plan seemed like the only option.

steps.player: Hmm... Before we came here, we found a vampyrification lab. We did wonder why new vampyres were being made given the overcrowding issues.

steps.speaker: Vanescula Drakan
steps.text: Yes, especially given my brother's hatred for that process. A process he himself made I should point out. Still, I suppose hypocrisy has always been one of his many talents.

options.text: What do you know about this festival your brother is planning?

steps.player: What do you know about this festival your brother is planning?

steps.speaker: Vanescula Drakan
steps.text: Ah, yes, the wonderful Night of the Blood Moon. It was once the way that the Drakan clan chose their new leaders. This was before the vampyre clans were united as one. Before we became civilised.

steps.player: I'm not sure I could ever describe a vampyre as civilised.

steps.speaker: Vanescula Drakan
steps.text: Well, then you should be glad you never had to see how we used to live. That festival is a perfect example of something that should have remained forgotten, but of course, my brother can't help but cling to the past.

steps.player: So this festival is how your brother became leader?

steps.speaker: Vanescula Drakan
steps.text: Yes. We were a lot more superstitious back then, though a lot stupider might be a better way to put it. We believed that a blood moon was the ultimate representation of power.

steps.speaker: Vanescula Drakan
steps.text: Whenever one occurred, the festival would take place. It was a whole night of killing. The one with the most kills by the end was said to embody the blood moon.

steps.player: Embody the blood moon?

steps.speaker: Vanescula Drakan
steps.text: 'And when dawn comes, one will rise above all, and they will rise as the Blood Moon.'

steps.speaker: Vanescula Drakan
steps.text: Like I said, we were stupid back then, and not overly creative. The victor would be granted the rather uninspired title of Blood Moon. They were the only one deemed worthy enough to lead the clan.

steps.player: And now your brother wants to bring the festival back.

steps.speaker: Vanescula Drakan
steps.text: He'll do anything but accept the truth. All of our problems... they come from him. He will never be the one to free us of them.

options.text: What can you tell me about this land?

steps.player: What can you tell me about this land?

steps.speaker: Vanescula Drakan
steps.text: It's a wretched place. Leaving was the best thing we ever did.

steps.player: Why? What was life like here?

steps.speaker: Vanescula Drakan
steps.text: Well, it was once the case that my people lived in separate clans spread across these lands. Life was short and brutal. There was nothing to take joy in. Survival was all that mattered.

steps.player: What changed?

steps.speaker: Vanescula Drakan
steps.text: A single visitor. We called him the Stranger from Afar. He uplifted us. He showed us that life could be more than mere survival. You wouldn't think it now, but back then my brother was his biggest believer.

steps.speaker: Vanescula Drakan
steps.text: As you can probably imagine, such a fundamental shift in our society caused quite the stir, but also presented opportunities to those willing to take them...

steps.speaker: Vanescula Drakan
steps.text: My brother was one of those people. He set out to unite all the clans as one, with him as their leader. He called himself the Lord of Vampyrium, the first true ruler of these lands.

steps.player: This Stranger from Afar... did he support that?

steps.speaker: Vanescula Drakan
steps.text: More than support it. He enabled it. Make no mistake though, it was not due to any benevolence. He had great ambition of his own, but he needed us to help him achieve it.

steps.speaker: Vanescula Drakan
steps.text: And so, we remained here for centuries after that, enjoying our new lives of culture and civilisation, until eventually the Stranger from Afar returned.

steps.speaker: Vanescula Drakan
steps.text: He guided us to your lands. There, we established a great empire for him, and for hundreds of years, we prospered. Vampyrium became nothing more than a horrible distant memory.

steps.speaker: Vanescula Drakan
steps.text: You see, after all this time, it seems my brother has forgotten something that he once knew better than anyone. Change is inevitable, and those who refuse to accept it, die.

steps.player: I'll get back to it.

escape-from-castle-drakan-talking-to-iva.speaker: Ivan Strom
escape-from-castle-drakan-talking-to-iva.text: [player name]! Thank you! If you hadn't shown up when you did...

escape-from-castle-drakan-talking-to-iva.speaker: Ivan Strom
escape-from-castle-drakan-talking-to-iva.text: Look at me... I don't belong here...

escape-from-castle-drakan-talking-to-iva.player: Yes, and we've managed to rescue Safalaan and Vanescula as well. They're waiting downstairs.
He's... alive. I think for now that's the best we can hope for.

escape-from-castle-drakan-talking-to-iva.speaker: Ivan Strom
escape-from-castle-drakan-talking-to-iva.text: Hmm... Okay. Well, let's head down there then and get out of here.

escape-from-castle-drakan-talking-to-iva.player: Not yet. Drakan has a stockpile of Safalaan's blood up in his chambers. It needs destroying before we can leave.

escape-from-castle-drakan-talking-to-iva.speaker: Ivan Strom
escape-from-castle-drakan-talking-to-iva.text: Okay... In that case, lead the way.

options.text: Any thoughts on what to do next?

steps.player: Any thoughts on what to do next?

steps.speaker: Ivan Strom
steps.text: I'm not sure, but I wonder if there's more to some of these books than there first seems.

steps.player: Are you doing okay, Ivan?

steps.speaker: Ivan Strom
steps.text: I don't know. I'm alive I guess, but I keep letting you down, [player name]. I'm sorry.

steps.player: Don't be. I'm sorry that you have to be here, Ivan, but I'm glad you are. I wouldn't have got this far on my own.

steps.speaker: Ivan Strom
steps.text: I just wish I could be more like you and Veliaf. I thought I could be, but after what happened to the others...

steps.speaker: Ivan Strom
steps.text: The worst part is, I can't even mourn them. After Sani died, and Harold... I felt something. Now though... now I just feel empty. Empty... and afraid.

steps.player: And yet you're still here. Even after all that's happened, you haven't lost hope, Ivan.

steps.speaker: Ivan Strom
steps.text: Yeah... hope. That's always been me, hasn't it. The hoper... The believer... But what good is hope now? What good has hope ever done us? It's just... worthless.

steps.player: No. It's worth everything. It's the only reason we're still here, and it's the reason why I know that no matter what we'll face here, we'll win.

steps.speaker: Ivan Strom
steps.text: You know, you're pretty good at this whole motivation thing. Much better than Veliaf.

steps.player: Well... that's not saying much.

steps.speaker: Ivan Strom
steps.text: He has his moments.

steps.player: That he most certainly does.
Let's go.

options.text: Any thoughts on what to do next?

steps.player: Agreed. Let's go.

escape-from-castle-drakan-talking-to-iva.text: If the player hasn't claimed supplies:

steps.speaker: Ivan Strom
steps.text: I found some supplies, [player name]. Just let me know if you need them.

options.text: Any thoughts on what to do next?

steps.player: Any thoughts on what to do next?

steps.speaker: Ivan Strom
steps.text: I'm not sure. I guess we need to work out how to get to that blood stockpile. Hopefully it won't take us too long. I don't want to spend any longer here than we have to.

options.text: Could I have those supplies you found?

steps.player: Could I have those supplies you found?

steps.speaker: Ivan Strom
steps.text: Sure.
If the player has at least 4 free inventory slots:
Ivan gives you some supplies.

steps.player: Thanks.

steps.text: If the player has less than 4 free inventory slots:
Ivan tries to give you some supplies, but there's four items in total and you don't have enough room for all of them.

steps.player: Let's get going.

escape-from-castle-drakan-talking-to-iva.text: If the player has claimed the supplies:

steps.speaker: Ivan Strom
steps.text: We'd better keep going, [player name].

options.text: Any thoughts on what to do next?

steps.player: Agreed. Let's go.

escape-from-castle-drakan-talking-to-vel.speaker: Vanescula Drakan
escape-from-castle-drakan-talking-to-vel.text: May I suggest you save the reunions for later. We need to focus on getting out of here.

escape-from-castle-drakan-basin-puzzle-s.text: You search the altar, but find nothing of interest.

escape-from-castle-drakan-basin-puzzle-i.text: It looks like something could be poured into this basin. An inscription below it reads: 'To be a river that runs through the body's land.'
It looks like something could be poured into this basin. An inscription below it reads: 'To be a faithful follower that flees the light.'
It looks like something could be poured into this basin. An inscription below it reads: 'To crack with no voice and slip with no legs.'
It looks like something could be poured into this basin. An inscription below it reads: 'To rise without wings and choke all who are there.'

escape-from-castle-drakan-basin-puzzle-s.text: You search the altar and find an ancient symbol. You take it.

escape-from-castle-drakan-destroying-the.speaker: Ivan Strom
escape-from-castle-drakan-destroying-the.text: This must be it.
The player destroys the blood stockpile.

escape-from-castle-drakan-destroying-the.player: There. Drakan should have no way of making a new portal now.

escape-from-castle-drakan-destroying-the.speaker: Ivan Strom
escape-from-castle-drakan-destroying-the.text: Good. Let's get out of here.
A venator appears behind the player and Ivan.

escape-from-castle-drakan-destroying-the.speaker: Ivan Strom
escape-from-castle-drakan-destroying-the.text: Uh oh...
Vanescula arrives, then casts a blood spell that instantly kills the venator.

escape-from-castle-drakan-destroying-the.player: Vanescula? What are you doing up here?
