steps.speaker: Lalli
steps.text: Human call itself Askeladden! It not trick Lalli, Lalli do good deal with human! Stupid human get some dumb wool, but did not get golden apples!

steps.player: I see... okay, well, bye!
No, honest, you're REALLY clever. Why, I could not contemplate a mere chicanery with an advanced intellect such as you currently present.

steps.speaker: Lalli
steps.text: Grrr! Why you insult me stupid human? Me know it are because you jealous of Lalli's huge brain and you try steal apples!

options.text: Can I give you a present?

steps.player: Can I give you a present? Or maybe exchange you something for some wool?

steps.speaker: Lalli
steps.text: Ha! You stupid human! You think you trick Lalli? Me know you want my golden apples Well! You not get them! HAHAHA!

steps.player: Erm... okay then.

the-council-members-olaf-the-bard-talkin.player: Hello there. I understand you managed to get some golden wool from Lalli?

the-council-members-olaf-the-bard-talkin.speaker: Askeladden
the-council-members-olaf-the-bard-talkin.text: HAHAHA! Yeah, that Lalli... what a maroon!

the-council-members-olaf-the-bard-talkin.player: So how did you manage to get the wool?

the-council-members-olaf-the-bard-talkin.speaker: Askeladden
the-council-members-olaf-the-bard-talkin.text: Well, as you know, I am doing the same trials that you are as part of my test of manhood, and that troll is the only one who can get that wool.

the-council-members-olaf-the-bard-talkin.speaker: Askeladden
the-council-members-olaf-the-bard-talkin.text: You might have noticed he's kind of... messed in the head buddy! He's real paranoid about people stealing his golden apples, isn't he?

the-council-members-olaf-the-bard-talkin.player: Indeed he is. So how did you manage to get some golden wool from him?

the-council-members-olaf-the-bard-talkin.speaker: Askeladden
the-council-members-olaf-the-bard-talkin.text: It was easy buddy! I persuaded him he needed a pet to help him guard his apples. A pet that would never sleep! A pet that would never need food, or exercise!

the-council-members-olaf-the-bard-talkin.speaker: Askeladden
the-council-members-olaf-the-bard-talkin.text: A pet that would never need him to clean up its... well, you know, buddy. A pet that would always be loyal to him! A faithful companion for life!
a pet rock

the-council-members-olaf-the-bard-talkin.player: What pet is this then?

the-council-members-olaf-the-bard-talkin.speaker: Askeladden
the-council-members-olaf-the-bard-talkin.text: A pet ROCK!

the-council-members-olaf-the-bard-talkin.speaker: Askeladden
the-council-members-olaf-the-bard-talkin.text: Man, can you believe that stupid troll traded me some of his golden wool for a worthless ROCK?

the-council-members-olaf-the-bard-talkin.speaker: Askeladden
the-council-members-olaf-the-bard-talkin.text: Buddy, I hafta say; if brains were explosives, that troll wouldn't have enough to blow his nose!

the-council-members-olaf-the-bard-talkin.player: Do you have any spare rocks then?

the-council-members-olaf-the-bard-talkin.speaker: Askeladden
the-council-members-olaf-the-bard-talkin.text: Sure thing buddy, although I have to say, I doubt even that troll is stupid enough to fall for the SAME trick TWICE in a row! You can try anyway though!
If the player has the pet rock:

steps.player: So this is the exact same type of rock you managed to sell to Lalli as a pet?

steps.speaker: Askeladden
steps.text: Yup, sure is buddy! That Lalli is stupid, even by troll standards!

the-council-members-olaf-the-bard-talkin.text: If the player does not have the pet rock:

steps.player: Can I have another rock? I lost mine...

steps.speaker: Askeladden
steps.text: Sure thing buddy! I'd say take better care of this one, but it's just a rock! I have hundreds of them! Go wild!
another pet rock

the-council-members-olaf-the-bard-talkin.player: Hello there.

the-council-members-olaf-the-bard-talkin.speaker: Lalli
the-council-members-olaf-the-bard-talkin.text: Bah! Puny humans always try steal Lallis' golden apples! You go away now!

the-council-members-olaf-the-bard-talkin.player: Wait! I have something that might interest you... a pet rock!

the-council-members-olaf-the-bard-talkin.speaker: Lalli
the-council-members-olaf-the-bard-talkin.text: Hah! You think me stupid or something human? Me already got one! Me don't want lotta baby rocks either, so me don't want another one around the place!

the-council-members-olaf-the-bard-talkin.player: Please... all I want is some of your golden wool...

the-council-members-olaf-the-bard-talkin.speaker: Lalli
the-council-members-olaf-the-bard-talkin.text: Stupid human think he can trick me into giving away some golden apples! Hah! Golden apples is all me got to eat, you not get them, no way!

the-council-members-olaf-the-bard-talkin.player: Hmm... So you're hungry? I think I will have the perfect thing for you to eat... I just need to get myself an onion, a potato and a cabbage...

the-council-members-olaf-the-bard-talkin.text: You have a cunning plan to trick this troll. You need your pet rock, a cabbage, a potato and an onion.

the-council-members-olaf-the-bard-talkin.player: Hello there.

the-council-members-olaf-the-bard-talkin.speaker: Lalli
the-council-members-olaf-the-bard-talkin.text: Bah! Puny humans always try steal Lallis' golden apples! You go away now!

the-council-members-olaf-the-bard-talkin.speaker: Lalli
the-council-members-olaf-the-bard-talkin.text: Unless you got tasty food for Lalli. Then I might trade you for it.

the-council-members-olaf-the-bard-talkin.player: Actually I don't...

the-council-members-olaf-the-bard-talkin.speaker: Lalli
the-council-members-olaf-the-bard-talkin.text: Hah! Me knew it! You human just try trick Lalli into giving away golden apple! Me not as stupid as you look!
If the player adds anything other than rock, potato, cabbage, or onion to the cauldron:

steps.text: Nothing interesting happens.

the-council-members-olaf-the-bard-talkin.text: If the player adds a pet rock into the cauldron:

steps.text: You put your pet rock into the cauldron.

the-council-members-olaf-the-bard-talkin.text: If the player adds vegetable into the cauldron:

steps.text: You put [a/an] [potato/cabbage/onion] into the cauldron.

steps.speaker: Lalli
steps.text: It am ready now?

steps.player: Not just yet...

the-council-members-olaf-the-bard-talkin.text: If the player is done adding the vegetables and pet rock into the soup:

steps.speaker: Lalli
steps.text: It am ready now?

steps.player: Indeed it is. Try it and see.

steps.speaker: Lalli
steps.text: Hmm... YUM! That are delicious! Me never know human know to make soup out of stone? It some special stone?

steps.player: Indeed it is. But I'm willing to trade it.

steps.speaker: Lalli
steps.text: Let me think about that, me like to think.

the-council-members-olaf-the-bard-talkin.player: Hello there.

the-council-members-olaf-the-bard-talkin.speaker: Lalli
the-council-members-olaf-the-bard-talkin.text: Your soup very tasty, human! But me still not want trade golden apples for your stone. Me think pet rock get jealous.

the-council-members-olaf-the-bard-talkin.player: I. DON'T. WANT. ANY. GOLDEN. APPLES. ALL. I. WANT. IS. A. GOLDEN. FLEECE.

the-council-members-olaf-the-bard-talkin.speaker: Lalli
the-council-members-olaf-the-bard-talkin.text: Gee, sorry human, all you have do is ask, me not need you to shout. You act like you think Lalli am stupid or something...
If the player does not have the golden fleece in their inventory:

steps.speaker: Lalli
steps.text: Here you go. Hah! Me trick you human! All you got is worthless golden fleece! Me got very rare soup-making stone!
some golden fleece

steps.player: Glad you're happy Lalli!

the-council-members-olaf-the-bard-talkin.text: If the player already has golden fleece in their inventory:

steps.text: You already have the golden fleece.

the-council-members-olaf-the-bard-talkin.text: If the player uses the unspun golden fleece or a regular ball of wool on the unstrung lyre:

steps.text: Nothing interesting happens.

the-council-members-olaf-the-bard-talkin.text: If the player uses the unspun golden fleece on the spinning wheel at Rellekka:

steps.text: Only Fremenniks may use this spinning wheel.

the-council-members-olaf-the-bard-talkin.text: If the player uses the unspun golden fleece on a spinning wheel anywhere else:

steps.text: golden wool

the-council-members-olaf-the-bard-talkin.text: If the player uses the golden wool on the unstrung lyre without 25 Fletching:

steps.text: You need to have a Fletching level of 25 to string the lyre.

the-council-members-olaf-the-bard-talkin.text: If the player uses the golden wool on the unstrung lyre with 25 Fletching:

steps.text: You attach the golden strings to the lyre.
a Lyre

steps.player: I really wouldn't know where to begin playing anything on this...

the-council-members-olaf-the-bard-talkin.text: What can I do for you?

the-council-members-olaf-the-bard-talkin.player: I hear that I can present you with an offering and you will enchant my lyre for me.

the-council-members-olaf-the-bard-talkin.speaker: Fossegrimen
the-council-members-olaf-the-bard-talkin.text: This is true. For a simple enchantment, you may place an offering on my Altar. Can I help you with anything else?

options.text: Present offering of a single fish.

You do not have a raw shark to offer.

steps.player: Nothing, sorry.

steps.speaker: Fossegrimen
steps.text: Do not summon me for idle conversation! Come back when you have an offering.

the-council-members-olaf-the-bard-talkin.text: If the player deposits a raw fish:

steps.speaker: Fossegrimen
steps.text: Many thanks for the offering outerlander. Please accept as a gift the ability to play your lyre...
Fossegrimen has enchanted your lyre so that you may play it.

the-council-members-olaf-the-bard-talkin.text: You withdraw your lyre.

the-council-members-olaf-the-bard-talkin.player: Dor Ray Me So.
Fah La Ti Doh.
La La La La.
De-Doo-De-Doo.

the-council-members-olaf-the-bard-talkin.text: Your lure is perfectly tuned.

the-council-members-olaf-the-bard-talkin.speaker: Longhall Bouncer
the-council-members-olaf-the-bard-talkin.text: You have an instrument now, huh? Go on through the door.

the-council-members-olaf-the-bard-enteri.speaker: Longhall Bouncer
the-council-members-olaf-the-bard-enteri.text: Yeah, you're good to go through. Olaf tells me you're some kind of outerlander bard here on tour. I doubt you're worse than Olaf is.

the-council-members-olaf-the-bard-perfor.text: The following are possible ballads, depending on the player's achievements:
If the player has gained entrance to the Champions Guild:

steps.player: The thought of lots of questing
leaves some people unfulfilled,
but I have done my simple best
in entering the Champions' Guild.

the-council-members-olaf-the-bard-perfor.text: If the player has gained entrance to the Heroes' Guild:

steps.player: When it comes to fighting
I hit my share of zeroes
But I'm well respected at
the Guild reserved for Heroes.

the-council-members-olaf-the-bard-perfor.text: If the player has gained entrance to the Legends' Guild:

steps.player: I cannot even start to list
the amount of foes I've killed.
I will simply tell you this:
I've joined the Legends' Guild!

the-council-members-olaf-the-bard-perfor.text: If the player has level 99 in any skill:

steps.player: When people speak of training
some people think they're fine.
But they just all seem jealous that
my [skill]'s ninety-nine!

the-council-members-olaf-the-bard-perfor.text: If the player doesn't have any achievements:

steps.player: [player name] is my name,
I haven't much to say.
But since I have to sing this song,
I'll just go ahead and play.

the-council-members-olaf-the-bard-perfor.speaker: Olaf the Bard
the-council-members-olaf-the-bard-perfor.text: Wow! That was awesome! You are one of the greatest bards I have ever had the pleasure of watching performing! You have certainly earned my vote! I hope we can duet together soon!
Congratulations! You have completed the Bard's Trial!
As you finished playing you felt Fossegrimen's power leave you...
You feel the musical ability from the Fossegrimen leave you...

the-council-members-olaf-the-bard-subseq.player: So can I rely on your vote with the council of elders in my favour?

the-council-members-olaf-the-bard-subseq.speaker: Olaf the Bard
the-council-members-olaf-the-bard-subseq.text: You have a truly poetic soul! Anyone who can compose such a beautiful epic, and then perform it so flawlessly can only bring good to our clan!

the-council-members-olaf-the-bard-subseq.player: Erm... so that's a yes, then?

the-council-members-olaf-the-bard-subseq.speaker: Olaf the Bard
the-council-members-olaf-the-bard-subseq.text: Absolutely! We must collaborate together on a duet sometime, don't you think?

the-council-members-sigli-the-huntsman.player: Are you a member of the council?

the-council-members-sigli-the-huntsman.speaker: Sigli the Huntsman
the-council-members-sigli-the-huntsman.text: The Fremennik council of elders? I am pleased to say that I am. My value as a huntsman is recognised by my position there.

the-council-members-sigli-the-huntsman.player: I was wondering if I could persuade you to vouch for me as a member of your clan?

the-council-members-sigli-the-huntsman.speaker: Sigli the Huntsman
the-council-members-sigli-the-huntsman.text: You? ... well... I am not totally against the idea outerlander. If you can demonstrate some hunting skills then perhaps I may offer my vote.

the-council-members-sigli-the-huntsman.player: How can I prove my hunting skills to you? I can go kill, like, a hundred chickens for you right now!

the-council-members-sigli-the-huntsman.speaker: Sigli the Huntsman
the-council-members-sigli-the-huntsman.text: Chickens? You think that would impress me?

the-council-members-sigli-the-huntsman.player: Cows then? I can kill cows until, er, the cows come home.

the-council-members-sigli-the-huntsman.speaker: Sigli the Huntsman
the-council-members-sigli-the-huntsman.text: No. The prey I have in mind for you to prove your worth to me is something far more dangerous. Far more difficult. Far more deadly.

the-council-members-sigli-the-huntsman.speaker: Sigli the Huntsman
the-council-members-sigli-the-huntsman.text: I suspect you are mocking me outerlander. You will need to prove your skill as a hunter to me by tracking and defeating... The Draugen.

steps.player: What's a Draugen? Some kind of cheap barbarian rip- off of a dragon?

steps.speaker: Sigli the Huntsman
steps.text: Hmmm. No, the words are slightly similar I suppose, but they are very different creatures.

steps.speaker: Sigli the Huntsman
steps.text: The Draugen is an evil ghost from Fremennik mythology, that devours the souls of those brave warriors who meet their ends at sea.

steps.speaker: Sigli the Huntsman
steps.text: It stalks the coastlines, invisible to all. It brings us bad fortunes, and curses our journeys across the seas. It is also unkillable by normal means.

steps.player: ...Let me get this straight; You want me to hunt an unkillable, invincible, and invisible enemy? How am I supposed to do that?

steps.speaker: Sigli the Huntsman
steps.text: Well outerlander, should you accept my challenge I will show you a special hunter's trick that will help you. Do you accept the challenge?

steps.player: Well, I need every vote I can get in the council of elders, but this certainly sounds impossible to do...

steps.speaker: Sigli the Huntsman
steps.text: Not at all outerlander. The Draugen is indeed impossible to kill, but that is not the same as being impossible to fight against.

steps.speaker: Sigli the Huntsman
steps.text: Every time he takes a Fremennik life, he gains in power, so to keep it from becoming too powerful we hunters hunt it and steal its life force.
If the player does not have inventory space:

steps.speaker: Sigli the Huntsman
steps.text: To defeat the Draugen you will need a special item; I have one to give you but it seems as though your inventory is too full to accept it.
If the player has inventory space:

steps.speaker: Sigli the Huntsman
steps.text: We do this with a special talisman. Here, take it; it will let you track the Draugen while it's invisible, and when you defeat it will absorb its essence.
a Hunters' talisman

steps.speaker: Sigli the Huntsman
steps.text: I want you to track the Draugen, defeat it, and store its essence in that talisman for me. If you can do this important task for my clan, I will vote for you.

steps.speaker: Sigli the Huntsman
steps.text: Take care of the talisman, and see me when you have completed this task.

the-council-members-sigli-the-huntsman-t.speaker: Sigli the Huntsman
the-council-members-sigli-the-huntsman-t.text: Hello again outerlander. Have you managed to hunt down the terrible Draugen yet?
If the player has the talisman:

steps.player: Not yet...

steps.speaker: Sigli the Huntsman
steps.text: Hmmm. Laziness is not a trait that I admire. I suggest you go and do so if you wish me to vouchsafe for you to our council of elders.

the-council-members-sigli-the-huntsman-t.text: If the player does not have a talisman:

steps.player: Not yet... I lost the talisman you gave me.

steps.speaker: Sigli the Huntsman
steps.text: The typical careless regard for valuable objects I would expect from an outerlander such as yourself. Do not lose THIS one.
another Hunters' talisman

the-council-members-sigli-the-huntsman-u.text: If the player is north/south/west/east of the Draugen:

steps.text: The talisman guides you [south/north/east/west].

the-council-members-sigli-the-huntsman-u.text: If the player is south-west/south-east of the Draugen:

steps.text: The talisman guides you [north-east/north-west].

the-council-members-sigli-the-huntsman-u.text: If the player is north-east/north-west of the Draugen:

steps.text: The talisman guides you [south-west/south-east].

the-council-members-sigli-the-huntsman-u.text: If the Draugen moves whilst locating with the talisman:

steps.text: The Draugen has moved elsewhere...

the-council-members-sigli-the-huntsman-u.text: If the player is 3 tiles near the Draugen:

steps.text: The Draugen is here! Beware!
The player engages in combat with the Draugen.
You absorb the Draugen's essence into your talisman.

the-council-members-sigli-the-huntsman-u.text: If the player uses the locate feature on the talisman after the Draugan's defeat:

steps.text: You have already captured the Draugen.

the-council-members-sigli-the-huntsman-t.speaker: Sigli the Huntsman
the-council-members-sigli-the-huntsman-t.text: I saw the entire hunt. Let me take that talisman from you; I would be honoured to speak out for you to our council of elders after such a hunt, outerlander.

the-council-members-sigli-the-huntsman-t.speaker: Sigli the Huntsman
the-council-members-sigli-the-huntsman-t.text: Absolutely outerlander! Anyone brave enough to hunt and defeat the Draugen will be a great addition to our clan!

the-council-members-sigmund-the-merchant.player: Are you a member of the council?

the-council-members-sigmund-the-merchant.speaker: Sigmund The Merchant
the-council-members-sigmund-the-merchant.text: That I am outerlander; it is a position that brings my family and I pride.

the-council-members-sigmund-the-merchant.player: I was wondering if I can count on your vote at the council of elders?

the-council-members-sigmund-the-merchant.speaker: Sigmund The Merchant
the-council-members-sigmund-the-merchant.text: You wish to become a Fremennik? I may be persuaded to swing my vote to your favour, but you will first need to do a little task for me.

the-council-members-sigmund-the-merchant.player: How did I know it wouldn't be that simple for your vote?

the-council-members-sigmund-the-merchant.speaker: Sigmund The Merchant
the-council-members-sigmund-the-merchant.text: Calm yourself outerlander. It is but a small task really... I simply require a flower.

the-council-members-sigmund-the-merchant.speaker: Sigmund The Merchant
the-council-members-sigmund-the-merchant.text: The catch? Well... it is not just any flower. Someone in this town has an extremely rare flower from a far off land that they picked up on their travels.

the-council-members-sigmund-the-merchant.speaker: Sigmund The Merchant
the-council-members-sigmund-the-merchant.text: I would like you to demonstrate your merchanting skills to me, by persuading them to part with it, and then give it to me for my vote.

the-council-members-sigmund-the-merchant.player: Well... I guess that doesn't sound too hard...

the-council-members-sigmund-the-merchant.speaker: Sigmund The Merchant
the-council-members-sigmund-the-merchant.text: Excellent! You will obtain this rare flower for me then?

steps.player: Okay. I don't think this will be too difficult. Any suggestions on where to start looking for this flower?

steps.speaker: Sigmund The Merchant
steps.text: Ah, well outerlander, if I knew where to start looking I would simply do it myself!

steps.player: No help at ALL?

steps.speaker: Sigmund The Merchant
steps.text: We are a very insular clan, so I would not expect you to have to leave this town to find whatever you need.

steps.player: You know what? No. This all sounds like a lot of hassle to me, and frankly I just can't be bothered with it right now.
I'll go get someone else to vote for me.

steps.speaker: Sigmund The Merchant
steps.text: As you wish outerlander. If you change your mind, come and see me again; I am very interested in getting my hands on that flower.

the-council-members-sigmund-the-merchant.text: If the player attempts to give Sigmund other types of flowers:

steps.text: Nothing interesting happens.

the-council-members-sigmund-the-merchant.speaker: Sigmund The Merchant
the-council-members-sigmund-the-merchant.text: So... how goes it outerlander? Did you manage to obtain my flower for me yet? Or do you lack the necessary merchanting skills?

the-council-members-sigmund-the-merchant.player: I'm still working on it... Do you have any suggestion where to start looking for it?

the-council-members-sigmund-the-merchant.speaker: Sigmund The Merchant
the-council-members-sigmund-the-merchant.text: I suggest you ask around the other Fremennik in the town. A good merchant will find exactly what their customer needs somewhere.

steps.player: I don't suppose you have any idea where I could find a rare flower from across the sea, do you?

steps.text: Nope, sorry buddy!

steps.player: I don't suppose you have any idea where I could find a rare flower from across the sea, do you?

steps.text: I wouldn't know about that, outerlander.

the-council-members-sigmund-the-merchant.text: Greetings again outerlander! How goes your attempts to gain votes with the council of elders?

steps.player: I don't suppose you have any idea where I could find a rare flower from across the sea, do you?

steps.text: Not really my affair, outerlander.

steps.player: I don't suppose you have any idea where I could find a rare flower from across the sea, do you?

steps.text: I'm sorry, no I don't.

steps.player: I don't suppose you have any idea where I could find a rare flower from across the sea, do you?

steps.player: I don't suppose you have any idea where I could find a rare flower from across the sea, do you?

steps.text: I never saw anything like that in my store before.

steps.player: I don't suppose you have any idea where I could find a rare flower from across the sea, do you?

steps.text: I never saw anything like that in my store before.

steps.player: I don't suppose you have any idea where I could find a rare flower from across the sea, do you?
