post-quest-dialogue-talking-to-brother-t.speaker: Brother Tranquility
post-quest-dialogue-talking-to-brother-t.text: Your concern is most gratifying. Saradomin be with you.

post-quest-dialogue-talking-to-brother-t.speaker: Brother Tranquility
post-quest-dialogue-talking-to-brother-t.text: Do you want me to take you back to Mos Le'Harmless?

post-quest-dialogue-talking-to-dr-fenken.speaker: Dr Fenkenstrain
post-quest-dialogue-talking-to-dr-fenken.text: After talking with these monks and seeing your efforts to save them...I'm starting to regret my past actions.

post-quest-dialogue-talking-to-dr-fenken.player: Admittedly, most of us don't accidentally trip and sew a bunch of dead bodies together.

post-quest-dialogue-talking-to-dr-fenken.speaker: Dr Fenkenstrain
post-quest-dialogue-talking-to-dr-fenken.text: I know...I think that my time here will be well spent trying to atone for what I did.

post-quest-dialogue-talking-to-dr-fenken.speaker: Dr Fenkenstrain
post-quest-dialogue-talking-to-dr-fenken.text: Thank you for helping me see the error of my ways, [player name].

standard-dialogue-interacting-with-the-g.text: If the Great Guardian is resting:

steps.text: The Great Guardian seems to be resting. You should probably not disturb it.

standard-dialogue-interacting-with-the-g.text: If the Great Guardian's power is not at 100%:

steps.npc: My power level is too low. Bring me guardian stones.

standard-dialogue-interacting-with-the-g.text: If the Great Guardian's power is at 100%:

steps.npc: Thanks, adventurer. I am now fully powered up.

standard-dialogue-entering-a-portal-guar.npc: Human, I need the power of the guardian stones.

standard-dialogue-entering-a-portal-guar.text: If the player has elemental guardian stones in their inventory

steps.text: You should feed the guardian stones to the Great Guardian before making more of them.

standard-dialogue-entering-a-portal-guar.text: If the player has catalytic guardian stones in their inventory

steps.text: You should feed the guardian stones to the Great Guardian before making more of them.

standard-dialogue-entering-a-portal-guar.text: If the player only has polyelemental guardian stones in their inventory

steps.text: You should feed the guardian stones to the Great Guardian before making more of them.

overhead-dialogue-after-reaching-full-po.npc: Humans, I now have the power to close the rift. Thank you, brave ones.
Now, for the final blow. Let the Scar be no more!

overhead-dialogue-after-reaching-full-po.text: The Great Guardian closes the rift.

overhead-dialogue-after-reaching-full-po.npc: Now, I shall rest until it opens once more...

talking-to-bert.speaker: Bert
talking-to-bert.text: Eeee, wha' shall I do! I'll mos' certainly lose tha job...

talking-to-bert.player: Lose your job? What's wrong, why?

talking-to-bert.speaker: Bert
talking-to-bert.text: I w-w-work... over yon sand pit... and weeell... I found... this... hand! T'were buried in't Sand!

options.text: Oh, you found a hand in the sand - that's nice for you.

steps.player: Oh, you found a hand in the sand - that's nice for you.

options.text: Eww a hand, in the sand! Why haven't you told the authorities?

steps.player: Eww a hand, in the sand! Why haven't you told the authorities?

steps.speaker: Bert
steps.text: They's no' wha' they once was. Tha cap'ain o'the Guard spends near all o'the time drunk in yon pub.

steps.player: Oh? The Guard Captain is drunk in the pub you say? That's not good, what will you do?

steps.speaker: Bert
steps.text: Weeellll... do yer think yer could 'elp me?

steps.player: Sure, I'll give you a hand.

steps.speaker: Bert
steps.text: ..... Nae, ye can 'ave the 'and as h'evidence.
Bert gives you a rather smelly, sand covered hand.

steps.speaker: Bert
steps.text: P'raps tha smell will get t'Guard Cap'ain's nose out o'his beer fer 2 seconds!

steps.player: I want no part in this!

talking-to-bert-talking-to-bert-again.speaker: Bert
talking-to-bert-talking-to-bert-again.text: Did ye see yon Guard Capt'n 'bout hand?

talking-to-bert-talking-to-bert-again.player: Not at the moment, but I will be seeing him soon.

talking-to-guard-captain-talking-again-w.player: Sir? I have some more beer for you...

talking-to-guard-captain-talking-again-w.text: You give the beer to the Guard Captain who takes a large gulp.

talking-to-guard-captain-talking-again-w.speaker: Guard Captain
talking-to-guard-captain-talking-again-w.text: Ahh... jus' wha' I need, now, wha' did you wanna know?

talking-to-guard-captain-talking-again-w.player: I've come to report that Bert, the sandman, found a hand in the sand pit.

talking-to-guard-captain-talking-again-w.speaker: Guard Captain
talking-to-guard-captain-talking-again-w.text: Lucky for him, means he can get even more work done.

talking-to-guard-captain-talking-again-w.player: But aren't you going to find out who it ... belonged to?

talking-to-guard-captain-talking-again-w.text: You hand the... hand... to the Guard Captain, he fumbles with it, drops it in his beer, fishes it out and hands it back.

talking-to-guard-captain-talking-again-w.speaker: Guard Captain
talking-to-guard-captain-talking-again-w.text: Oops, No 'arm done. S'prob'ly a wizard, i's always the wizards fault, go ask them, jus' ring the bell outshide the guild and talk to the first pointy hatted ninny you shee!

talking-to-guard-captain-talking-again-w.player: Err... ok, I'll go ring the bell and talk to a wizard then.

talking-to-guard-captain-talking-to-bert.speaker: Bert
talking-to-guard-captain-talking-to-bert.text: Did ye see yon Guard Capt'n 'bout hand?

talking-to-guard-captain-talking-to-bert.player: Yes, the Guard Captain said to see the wizards in the guild.

talking-to-guard-captain-talking-to-bert.speaker: Bert
talking-to-guard-captain-talking-to-bert.text: So why you hangin' abou' 'ere then? Go ring t'bell at t'mage guild just over yonder!
If the player has lost the sandy hand:

steps.player: It seems to have slipped through my fingers!

steps.text: If the player doesn't have enough inventory space:

steps.speaker: Bert
steps.text: Tha's no' surprisin' with yer bag so full, come back when s'not.

steps.speaker: Bert
steps.text: Thank t'gods! I tho' I was bein invaded by undead 'ands from t'sand when I found this'un! Take i' to tha mage guild and ring tha' bell to talk ta someone.

steps.player: Thanks Bert, I'm off to see the wizards, the wonderful wizards of Yanille!

steps.text: Beer soaked hand

talking-to-guard-captain-reclaiming-the-.speaker: Guard Captain
talking-to-guard-captain-reclaiming-the-.text: Go 'way! This pint'sh nearly finished! Unlessh you got more that ish....? Wizards, s'all the wizard's fault...prob'ly that Zavistic one, he'sh the worsht!

talking-to-guard-captain-reclaiming-the-.speaker: Guard Captain
talking-to-guard-captain-reclaiming-the-.text: E're, you left this 'and in me beer!
If the player doesn't have enough inventory space:

steps.speaker: Guard Captain
steps.text: No good if you don' have space fer it in yer invent'ry, come back when you do.

talking-to-zavistic-rarve.text: Speaking to Zavistic Rarve via the bell:
If the player has completed Zogre Flesh Eaters:

steps.speaker: Zavistic Rarve
steps.text: What are you doing...Oh, it's you...sorry...didn't realise...what can I do for you?

options.text: I'm here about the sicks...err Zogres
I have a rather sandy problem that I'd like to palm off on you.

steps.speaker: Zavistic Rarve
steps.text: What are you doing ringing that bell?! Don't you think some of us have work to do?

steps.player: But I was told to ring the bell if I wanted some attention.

steps.speaker: Zavistic Rarve
steps.text: Well...anyway...we're very busy here, hurry up what do you want?

talking-to-zavistic-rarve.text: Speaking to Zavistic Rarve inside the guild:

steps.speaker: Zavistic Rarve
steps.text: What are you doing bothering me? Don't you think some of us have work to do?

steps.player: I thought you were here to help?

steps.speaker: Zavistic Rarve
steps.text: Well... I am, I suppose, anyway... we're very busy here, hurry up, what do you want?
If the player does not have the beer soaked hand in their inventory:
Maybe you should have the hand with you before speaking to Zavistic.
If the player has the beer soaked hand in their inventory:
You wave the hand at the wizard.

steps.player: Ummm... Do you have all your wizards?

steps.speaker: Zavistic Rarve
steps.text: All my.... whatever do you mean...?

steps.player: The Guard Captain asked me to see if you have any... missing... wizards.

steps.speaker: Zavistic Rarve
steps.text: That's silly! No one would kill a wizard... would they?

steps.player: Erm... no...
Well.. maybe, you see Bert found this hand and it might belong to.. a wizard!

steps.speaker: Zavistic Rarve
steps.text: Bert? Ahh yes, the sandman who seems to have been working very long hours recently. Let's see that hand...
You hand it over.

steps.speaker: Zavistic Rarve
steps.text: Oh my! This is most definitely Clarence, my most able student! You must find out who did this!

steps.player: Do you have any input as to the matter at hand?

steps.speaker: Zavistic Rarve
steps.text: Well.... Ask Bert about the long hours he's been working, that sounds suspicious to me. Digging things up at all hours of the day isn't natural.

talking-to-zavistic-rarve-talking-to-zav.speaker: Zavistic Rarve
talking-to-zavistic-rarve-talking-to-zav.text: What are you doing bothering me? Don't you think some of us have work to do?

talking-to-zavistic-rarve-talking-to-zav.player: I thought you were here to help?

talking-to-zavistic-rarve-talking-to-zav.speaker: Zavistic Rarve
talking-to-zavistic-rarve-talking-to-zav.text: Well... I am, I suppose, anyway... we're very busy here, hurry up, what do you want?

talking-to-zavistic-rarve-talking-to-zav.speaker: Zavistic Rarve
talking-to-zavistic-rarve-talking-to-zav.text: Did you find out who killed Clarence yet?

talking-to-zavistic-rarve-talking-to-zav.player: Not yet, but don't lose your head over it.

talking-to-zavistic-rarve-talking-to-gua.speaker: Guard Captain
talking-to-zavistic-rarve-talking-to-gua.text: I don' need a hand drinkin me beer, go 'way!

talking-to-zavistic-rarve-talking-to-gua.speaker: Guard Captain
talking-to-zavistic-rarve-talking-to-gua.text: Talk to tha' hand coz thish face ain't lishtnin'!

getting-bert-s-rota.speaker: Bert
getting-bert-s-rota.text: Wha' info ye find 'bout hand, [player name]?

getting-bert-s-rota.player: I dug up quite a lot about the hand. Can you tell me about your job?

getting-bert-s-rota.speaker: Bert
getting-bert-s-rota.text: Sand! Lots o' sand! Me boss be Sandy o' Sandy's Sand Corp based in Brimhaven on tha isle of Karamja an' I hauls sand fr' there to yon sand pit.

getting-bert-s-rota.speaker: Bert
getting-bert-s-rota.text: I's looong harrrrd hours, bu' keeps me busy, y'know what tha say! 'Idle hands'r Zamorak's tools.'

getting-bert-s-rota.player: So you're employed by Sandy's Sand Corp in Brimhaven. Have you changed your hours recently?

getting-bert-s-rota.text: If the player doesn't have inventory space:

steps.speaker: Bert
steps.text: Yer coul' see fer yerself iffen yer had space in yorn invent'ry, come back when yer do.

getting-bert-s-rota.speaker: Bert
getting-bert-s-rota.text: Nae! See fer yersel', here's a copy o' me rota tha' be held a' head office - yer can looksee iffin ye talk t' Sandy, me boss.

getting-bert-s-rota.player: Thanks for the Rota Bert. I'll go check for the original with Sandy in Brimhaven.

getting-bert-s-rota-talking-to-bert-afte.speaker: Bert
getting-bert-s-rota-talking-to-bert-afte.text: Ey'up [player name]. Did yer see Sandy in Brimhaven 'bout me rota?
If the player has lost the rota:

steps.player: Err, no, I kind of... lost it...

steps.text: If the player doesn't have inventory space:

steps.speaker: Bert
steps.text: Lucky fer yorn tha' I's made a copy then ain't it, I's 'ave been given it to yer iffen you 'ad some space in yer invent'ry.

steps.player: What did you say?

steps.speaker: Bert
steps.text: Is you stupid? I said I'd give ye another but yer bags be full!

steps.speaker: Bert
steps.text: Lucky fer yorn tha' I's made a copy then ain't it, 'ere 'ave another.

getting-bert-s-rota-talking-to-bert-afte.player: No, I'll fit it in my schedule somewhere soon.

getting-sandy-s-rota-talking-to-sandy.player: Hello Sir, do you run the Sand Corp?
I'm [player name]. I'm here investigating the possible murder of a wizard.

getting-sandy-s-rota-talking-to-sandy.speaker: Sandy
getting-sandy-s-rota-talking-to-sandy.text: I don't care about that, I have far too much work to do. Let the authorities take care of things like murder and stop snooping around my office!
Sand seems very keen to get you out of the office, perhaps you should take a look around.

getting-sandy-s-rota-pickpocketing-sandy.text: If the player doesn't have inventory space:

steps.text: I'd better make room in my inventory first!
You felt something but it slipped through your fingers...
You rummage around in Sandy's pockets...
You find a small amount of sand.

getting-sandy-s-rota-searching-sandy-s-d.text: If the player doesn't have inventory space:

steps.text: I'd better make room in my inventory first!

getting-sandy-s-rota-searching-sandy-s-d.text: If the player does not have Sandy's rota:

steps.text: You quickly sift through some of the papers on Sandy's desk and find a work rota for Bert.

getting-sandy-s-rota-searching-sandy-s-d.text: If the player already has Sandy's rota:

steps.text: You already have Sandy's original work rota.

getting-sandy-s-rota-talking-to-sandy-wi.text: You already have the rota, perhaps you should take both rotas back to Bert in Yanille.

returning-to-bert-with-his-original-rota.player: I managed to get a copy of the original rota. Your hours changed a week ago!

returning-to-bert-with-his-original-rota.speaker: Bert
returning-to-bert-with-his-original-rota.text: Nae! Nae! I din't remember tha', bu'... hmmm, aye... tha' migh' be it...

returning-to-bert-with-his-original-rota.player: What? Give me a hand here, I'm having a hard time understanding how you don't remember changing hours!

returning-to-bert-with-his-original-rota.speaker: Bert
returning-to-bert-with-his-original-rota.text: I's all be tha wizard's fault! Tha magic leaks fr'm yon magic guild I tells yer! Tha's why this weirrrrd scroll appeareded a week ago!

returning-to-bert-with-his-original-rota.player: A scroll appeared? Can I take a look at it while you look at the rotas?

returning-to-bert-with-his-original-rota.speaker: Bert
returning-to-bert-with-his-original-rota.text: O'course [player name], le's be 'avin'yon rota and 'ere be tha scroll, yer be takin' it back ta those inferrrnal wizards quick sharp!

returning-to-bert-with-his-original-rota.speaker: Bert
returning-to-bert-with-his-original-rota.text: I be hopin' tha search is goin' well... are tha wizard's owning up ta anythin' yet?

returning-to-bert-with-his-original-rota.player: I've found out a lot and will let you know when it's all over.

returning-back-to-zavistic.speaker: Zavistic Rarve
returning-back-to-zavistic.text: What are you doing...Oh, it's you...sorry...didn't realise...what can I do for you?

options.text: I'm here about the sicks...err Zogres
I have a rather sandy problem that I'd like to palm off on you.

steps.player: I talked to Bert and found something very strange about his hours.

steps.speaker: Zavistic Rarve
steps.text: Oh? Did he kill Clarence?

steps.player: No, but he doesn't remember changing his hours, and his rota and the original that his boss Sandy had, are different!
... oh, and this scroll appeared when they changed - he gave it to me.

steps.speaker: Zavistic Rarve
steps.text: I recognise that type of scroll! It's used in a mind altering spell of some sort. Did you speak to this... Sandy guy? Perhaps he has a hand in this.

steps.player: I took a look around his office. I don't know about a hand in it, I think he has both hands and feet in it!

steps.speaker: Zavistic Rarve
steps.text: Even more suspicious! Here, take this magical scrying orb and get some Truth Serum from Betty in Port Sarim, she owes me a favour, just tell her I sent you if she complains.

steps.speaker: Zavistic Rarve
steps.text: Then you will be equipped to ask Sandy a few questions. Oh Clarence, I will find your murderer!
You exchange the scroll for the magical scrying orb. Perhaps Zavistic can give you even more of a hand to find the murderer?

returning-back-to-zavistic-talking-to-za.speaker: Zavistic Rarve
returning-back-to-zavistic-talking-to-za.text: What are you doing...Oh, it's you...sorry...didn't realise...what can I do for you?

options.text: I'm here about the sicks...err Zogres
I have a rather sandy problem that I'd like to palm off on you.

steps.text: If the player has lost the magical orb:

options.text: What is there to do in the Wizards' Guild?
What are the requirements to get in the Wizards' Guild?
What do you do in the Guild?
I've lost my magical scrying orb!

steps.player: I've lost my magical scrying orb!

steps.text: If the player doesn't have inventory space:

steps.speaker: Zavistic Rarve
steps.text: I'd give you another magical scrying orb if you had some space in your inventory.

steps.speaker: Zavistic Rarve
steps.text: No matter, here, have another and please hurry, whoever killed Clarence must pay!

options.text: What is there to do in the Wizards' Guild?
What are the requirements to get in the Wizards' Guild?
What do you do in the Guild?

steps.player: Can you help me more?

steps.speaker: Zavistic Rarve
steps.text: Bring me a vial and I'll help you a little more.
If the player does not have a vial with them:
If the player has a vial with them:

steps.player: I have a vial here for you.

steps.speaker: Zavistic Rarve
steps.text: Ok, would you like me to transport you to Port Sarim? I'm sticking my neck out a bit helping you like this and can only do it once though!

steps.player: Yes, that would be great!

steps.speaker: Zavistic Rarve
steps.text: Off you go then, break a leg!
The player is teleported to Betty shop.

options.text: No, I prefer using my legs, thanks all the same.

steps.player: No, I prefer using my legs, thanks all the same.

steps.speaker: Zavistic Rarve
steps.text: Ok, suit yourself!

options.text: Talk to Betty about the Hand in the Sand.

steps.player: I've come from Yanille, the wizard says you can make Truth Serum?

steps.speaker: Betty
steps.text: This is true deary, I'll need an empty vial.
If the player doesn't have an empty vial:

steps.player: I'll have to go find one then, I'll be back!

starting-the-quest-talking-to-prince-itz.text: If the player meets the quest requirements:

steps.speaker: Prince Itzla Arkan
steps.text: I've sent word to mother about what happened here, but I've not heard back yet. However, in the meantime, I've devised a little plan for how we might go about dealing with our cultist problem.

steps.prompt: Start The Heart of Darkness quest?

steps.player: What is it?

steps.speaker: Prince Itzla Arkan
steps.text: We're going to go... undercover!

steps.player: Undercover? What do you mean?

steps.speaker: Prince Itzla Arkan
steps.text: The Twilight Emissaries of course! If they are the ones responsible for what is now two attempts on my father's life, their deaths will be swift and brutal.

steps.speaker: Prince Itzla Arkan
steps.text: However, given we're somewhat civilised people, we can't exactly start executing cultists without definitive proof. How do we get that? By joining up of course!

steps.player: You want us to join the cult?

steps.speaker: Prince Itzla Arkan
steps.text: Exactly! Quite a clever plan, if I do say so myself.

steps.player: Right...

steps.speaker: Guard
steps.text: Prepare for the arrival of Queen Zyanyi Arkan!

steps.speaker: Prince Itzla Arkan
steps.text: Ah... This should be fun.

steps.player: I'd love to hear it, but I have some things I need to do first.

steps.speaker: Prince Itzla Arkan
steps.text: Very well. I'll be here when you're ready.

meeting-with-queen-zyani-arkan-to-begin-.text: A cutscene begins in which Queen Zyani Arkan meets with Prince Itzla Arkan.

meeting-with-queen-zyani-arkan-to-begin-.speaker: Prince Itzla Arkan
meeting-with-queen-zyani-arkan-to-begin-.text: Mother.

meeting-with-queen-zyani-arkan-to-begin-.speaker: Queen Zyanyi Arkan
meeting-with-queen-zyani-arkan-to-begin-.text: As I stand here, the healers toil to save the life of the Teokan of Ralos.

meeting-with-queen-zyani-arkan-to-begin-.speaker: Queen Zyanyi Arkan
meeting-with-queen-zyani-arkan-to-begin-.text: Why?

meeting-with-queen-zyani-arkan-to-begin-.speaker: Prince Itzla Arkan
meeting-with-queen-zyani-arkan-to-begin-.text: He wished to return to the Teomat. I advised against it, but...

meeting-with-queen-zyani-arkan-to-begin-.speaker: Queen Zyanyi Arkan
meeting-with-queen-zyani-arkan-to-begin-.text: So you would blame him?

meeting-with-queen-zyani-arkan-to-begin-.speaker: Prince Itzla Arkan
meeting-with-queen-zyani-arkan-to-begin-.text: Not exactly...

meeting-with-queen-zyani-arkan-to-begin-.speaker: Queen Zyanyi Arkan
meeting-with-queen-zyani-arkan-to-begin-.text: Then take responsibility. You were charged with rooting out those who would plot against us. You failed. Why?

meeting-with-queen-zyani-arkan-to-begin-.speaker: Prince Itzla Arkan
meeting-with-queen-zyani-arkan-to-begin-.text: With respect, progress has been made. We believe the Twilight Emissaries to be responsible, but we need to obtain proof before we can act.

meeting-with-queen-zyani-arkan-to-begin-.speaker: Queen Zyanyi Arkan
meeting-with-queen-zyani-arkan-to-begin-.text: How?

meeting-with-queen-zyani-arkan-to-begin-.speaker: Prince Itzla Arkan
meeting-with-queen-zyani-arkan-to-begin-.text: We will infiltrate the cult and gather any information we can. Once we have confirmed their guilt, they will be eradicated.

meeting-with-queen-zyani-arkan-to-begin-.speaker: Queen Zyanyi Arkan
meeting-with-queen-zyani-arkan-to-begin-.text: We?

meeting-with-queen-zyani-arkan-to-begin-.speaker: Prince Itzla Arkan
meeting-with-queen-zyani-arkan-to-begin-.text: This is a task of upmost importance. I intend to lead the infiltration myself.

meeting-with-queen-zyani-arkan-to-begin-.speaker: Queen Zyanyi Arkan
meeting-with-queen-zyani-arkan-to-begin-.text: So you would chase glory like it is gold to be hoarded? You are the heir to Varlamore. It is not your place.

meeting-with-queen-zyani-arkan-to-begin-.speaker: Prince Itzla Arkan
meeting-with-queen-zyani-arkan-to-begin-.text: In Varlamore we lead from the front!

meeting-with-queen-zyani-arkan-to-begin-.speaker: Queen Zyanyi Arkan
meeting-with-queen-zyani-arkan-to-begin-.text: You do not lead at all, boy! You command the Knights of Varlamore. Use them!

meeting-with-queen-zyani-arkan-to-begin-.speaker: Prince Itzla Arkan
meeting-with-queen-zyani-arkan-to-begin-.text: I cannot trust them. We have been infiltrated and our enemies now sit beside us.

meeting-with-queen-zyani-arkan-to-begin-.speaker: Queen Zyanyi Arkan
meeting-with-queen-zyani-arkan-to-begin-.text: You speak of Metzli?

meeting-with-queen-zyani-arkan-to-begin-.speaker: Prince Itzla Arkan
meeting-with-queen-zyani-arkan-to-begin-.text: It could be more than just her. One of my knights was implicated, but another may have incriminated him.

meeting-with-queen-zyani-arkan-to-begin-.speaker: Queen Zyanyi Arkan
meeting-with-queen-zyani-arkan-to-begin-.text: Who?

meeting-with-queen-zyani-arkan-to-begin-.speaker: Prince Itzla Arkan
meeting-with-queen-zyani-arkan-to-begin-.text: There have been suspicions directed at Furia and Ennius.

meeting-with-queen-zyani-arkan-to-begin-.speaker: Queen Zyanyi Arkan
meeting-with-queen-zyani-arkan-to-begin-.text: Then all the more reason that you exclude yourself. Determine who you can trust and send them on this mission of yours.

meeting-with-queen-zyani-arkan-to-begin-.speaker: Prince Itzla Arkan
meeting-with-queen-zyani-arkan-to-begin-.text: And if there is no one I can trust?

meeting-with-queen-zyani-arkan-to-begin-.speaker: Queen Zyanyi Arkan
meeting-with-queen-zyani-arkan-to-begin-.text: Then you have failed as a leader.

meeting-with-queen-zyani-arkan-to-begin-.speaker: Prince Itzla Arkan
meeting-with-queen-zyani-arkan-to-begin-.text: Mother...

meeting-with-queen-zyani-arkan-to-begin-.speaker: Queen Zyanyi Arkan
meeting-with-queen-zyani-arkan-to-begin-.text: Now go. You have work to do. I don't expect you to fail me again.

meeting-with-queen-zyani-arkan-to-begin-.speaker: Prince Itzla Arkan
meeting-with-queen-zyani-arkan-to-begin-.text: Yes, my Queen. May the sun light your way.
The cutscene ends and Prince Itzla Arkan returns to The Teomat.

meeting-with-queen-zyani-arkan-to-begin-.speaker: Prince Itzla Arkan
meeting-with-queen-zyani-arkan-to-begin-.text: It would seem I won't be able to join you on this mission, iknami. Still, I have no doubt you will be successful all the same.

meeting-with-queen-zyani-arkan-to-begin-.player: What do I need to do?

meeting-with-queen-zyani-arkan-to-begin-.speaker: Prince Itzla Arkan
meeting-with-queen-zyani-arkan-to-begin-.text: Head to the pub in Quetzacalli Gorge and ask to rent the basement room. I have a contact who will meet you there.

meeting-with-queen-zyani-arkan-to-begin-.speaker: Prince Itzla Arkan
meeting-with-queen-zyani-arkan-to-begin-.text: One of the only people left that I can trust. They'll fill you in on the details of how you'll infiltrate the Emissaries. Good luck, [player name]. May the sun light your way.

meeting-with-queen-zyani-arkan-to-begin-.speaker: Prince Itzla Arkan
meeting-with-queen-zyani-arkan-to-begin-.text: Nilsal, [player name]. You should head on over to the pub in Quetzacalli Gorge. Remember, you'll need to rent the basement room. My contact will meet you there.

meeting-with-queen-zyani-arkan-to-begin-.speaker: Prince Itzla Arkan
meeting-with-queen-zyani-arkan-to-begin-.text: Good luck.

visiting-the-windbreaker-bar-talking-to-.speaker: Bartender
visiting-the-windbreaker-bar-talking-to-.text: Welcome to the Windbreaker. We've got the best drinks around.

options.text: I'd like to rent the basement room.

steps.player: I'd like to rent the basement room.

steps.text: Like I said, we don't have a basement room. However, I do have a nice big one here on the ground floor that's available. It's 30 coins for the night.

steps.speaker: Bartender
steps.text: Well you know where we are if you change your mind.

options.text: What's with those big gates out there?

visiting-the-windbreaker-bar-resting-in-.player: Guess I may as well have a little rest while waiting for this contact.

visiting-the-windbreaker-bar-resting-in-.text: You lie down on the bed and quickly fall asleep.

visiting-the-windbreaker-bar-resting-in-.speaker: Prince Itzla Arkan
visiting-the-windbreaker-bar-resting-in-.text: Rise and shine!

visiting-the-windbreaker-bar-resting-in-.player: Itzla? Is that you? What are you doing here?

visiting-the-windbreaker-bar-resting-in-.speaker: Prince Itzla Arkan
visiting-the-windbreaker-bar-resting-in-.text: Isn't it obvious? I'm your contact!

visiting-the-windbreaker-bar-resting-in-.speaker: Prince Itzla Arkan
visiting-the-windbreaker-bar-resting-in-.text: Look, I fully appreciate what my mother said. I have carefully considered her instructions, but in this one very specific situation, I have come to the conclusion that they must be disregarded.

visiting-the-windbreaker-bar-resting-in-.player: But you're the heir to the throne of Varlamore... What if someone recognises you?

visiting-the-windbreaker-bar-resting-in-.speaker: Prince Itzla Arkan
visiting-the-windbreaker-bar-resting-in-.text: Well that's why I've covered my face of course. Simple!

visiting-the-windbreaker-bar-resting-in-.player: This seems like a bad idea...

visiting-the-windbreaker-bar-resting-in-.speaker: Prince Itzla Arkan
visiting-the-windbreaker-bar-resting-in-.text: You may well be right, iknami, but that is a bridge we will cross, and then quite possibly burn, when we get to it.

visiting-the-windbreaker-bar-resting-in-.speaker: Prince Itzla Arkan
visiting-the-windbreaker-bar-resting-in-.text: I can see you're still not convinced, so let me be frank. I wasn't lying when I spoke to mother. The number of people we can trust is concerningly low.

visiting-the-windbreaker-bar-resting-in-.speaker: Prince Itzla Arkan
visiting-the-windbreaker-bar-resting-in-.text: Metzli, one of the most important people in the entire kingdom, has seemingly betrayed us. If your suspicions are right, Furia and Ennius are guilty as well. For all we know, there could be even more.

visiting-the-windbreaker-bar-resting-in-.speaker: Prince Itzla Arkan
visiting-the-windbreaker-bar-resting-in-.text: At this point, the fewer people who know about our mission, the better.

visiting-the-windbreaker-bar-resting-in-.speaker: Prince Itzla Arkan
visiting-the-windbreaker-bar-resting-in-.text: The irony is, my friend, that as an outsider, you're actually far more trustworthy than any Varlamorian now. You almost certainly can't be part of this conspiracy.

visiting-the-windbreaker-bar-resting-in-.player: Okay, I'm still not sure if I like this plan, but I see your point. What's our next move?

visiting-the-windbreaker-bar-resting-in-.speaker: Prince Itzla Arkan
visiting-the-windbreaker-bar-resting-in-.text: We need to infiltrate the Twilight Emissaries and confirm their guilt. I've done some digging, and rumour has it that they're on a bit of a recruitment spree at the moment. That's our way in.

visiting-the-windbreaker-bar-resting-in-.speaker: Prince Itzla Arkan
visiting-the-windbreaker-bar-resting-in-.text: The cult makes their home in the Twilight Temple, east of here. I suspect they won't take kindly to us just walking in, but the local shopkeeper here might be able to help us out.

visiting-the-windbreaker-bar-resting-in-.speaker: Prince Itzla Arkan
visiting-the-windbreaker-bar-resting-in-.text: He's been engaging in many a charitable undertaking recently. Food for the poor, potions for the sick, that sort of thing. You'd be mistaken for thinking him to actually be a reasonable person.

visiting-the-windbreaker-bar-resting-in-.speaker: Prince Itzla Arkan
visiting-the-windbreaker-bar-resting-in-.text: Sadly not in this case. The Emissaries accept members from all walks of life, but the vast majority of their recruits are those from more unfortunate backgrounds.

visiting-the-windbreaker-bar-resting-in-.player: Ah I see. They have people like this shopkeeper using charity to attract people to their cause.

visiting-the-windbreaker-bar-resting-in-.speaker: Prince Itzla Arkan
visiting-the-windbreaker-bar-resting-in-.text: Exactly. It is... unfortunate. The War of Betrayal was over a lifetime ago, but many still feel the impacts, especially in this part of the kingdom.

visiting-the-windbreaker-bar-resting-in-.speaker: Prince Itzla Arkan
visiting-the-windbreaker-bar-resting-in-.text: I'd like to think we have made great improvements over the years, but this is a clear reminder that far more needs to be done.

visiting-the-windbreaker-bar-resting-in-.speaker: Prince Itzla Arkan
visiting-the-windbreaker-bar-resting-in-.text: Anyway, it's not something to dwell on now. Let us get back to the more pressing matter of joining a dangerous cult.

visiting-the-windbreaker-bar-resting-in-.player: Right. So this shopkeeper... If I go to him and pose as a potential recruit, your hope is that he'll contact the Emissaries?

visiting-the-windbreaker-bar-resting-in-.speaker: Prince Itzla Arkan
visiting-the-windbreaker-bar-resting-in-.text: Exactly! Return to me here once you've hopefully been successful and we can discuss the next steps.

options.text: Alright, I'll go and speak with him.
The Queen didn't seem very happy with you.

steps.player: The Queen didn't seem very happy with you.

steps.speaker: Prince Itzla Arkan
steps.text: That's parents for you. Do as I say, but not as I do. She was never afraid to get her own hands dirty. Did you know that before she was even my age, she became a champion in the Colosseum?

steps.player: You think she sees herself in you? If so, maybe she doesn't want you to make the mistakes that she once did?

steps.speaker: Prince Itzla Arkan
steps.text: I suspect you are right, but I would prefer to learn from my own mistakes. Every ruler must forge their own path. The people will never follow a leader who cannot stand alone.

steps.player: I suppose that makes sense, but I'm not sure how I feel about you learning from your mistakes while we infiltrate a dangerous cult together.

steps.speaker: Prince Itzla Arkan
steps.text: Fear not, iknami. I am confident that you will probably survive this mission.

steps.player: That's good, I think...

options.text: Do you really think Metzli, Furia and Ennius are traitors?

steps.player: Do you really think Metzli, Furia and Ennius are traitors?

steps.speaker: Prince Itzla Arkan
steps.text: Metzli has always been an odd one. Everyone was always quick to dismiss it as just a little side effect of spending a lot of time with dead people. Now I wonder if she used that to her advantage.

steps.speaker: Prince Itzla Arkan
steps.text: No one cared to pay close attention to her. No one wanted to spend much time around her. She probably got away with all sorts of things without anyone even noticing.

steps.player: But a traitor?

steps.speaker: Prince Itzla Arkan
steps.text: The evidence seems to suggest so. Why else would she have disappeared after the attack?

steps.player: Maybe they captured her?

steps.speaker: Prince Itzla Arkan
steps.text: Maybe, but surely someone would have noticed. People generally don't go quietly when captured.

steps.player: What about Furia and Ennius?

steps.speaker: Prince Itzla Arkan
steps.text: Well their family has of course produced traitors before, but they've never seemed to have much love for old Imafore.

steps.speaker: Prince Itzla Arkan
steps.text: By the end of the war, I think he'd ended up killing more of his own family members than he left alive. Amazing what paranoia will do to a man.

steps.speaker: Prince Itzla Arkan
steps.text: Still, even if they never cared for him, his blood still runs in their veins, and they've never been short on ambition themselves.

steps.player: If they are guilty... what will you do to them?

steps.speaker: Prince Itzla Arkan
steps.text: The same thing we do to all traitors in Varlamore.

options.text: What happens if they try to attack Servius again?

steps.player: What happens if they try to attack Servius again?

steps.speaker: Prince Itzla Arkan
steps.text: He's in the capital now, where I wanted him to be from the start. He should be much safer there.

steps.speaker: Prince Itzla Arkan
steps.text: Still, safer is not safe, especially if we do have traitors in our midst. At any moment we risk someone showing some basic competence and actually managing to kill him properly.

steps.player: So you don't consider the enemy to be competent?

steps.speaker: Prince Itzla Arkan
steps.text: All I'm saying is that if I'd have been the one trying to assassinate my father, I'd probably have done a half- decent job.

steps.player: But if the enemy isn't a threat, why are you here?

steps.speaker: Prince Itzla Arkan
steps.text: What do you mean, iknami?

steps.player: If this isn't an enemy to be taken seriously, why do you feel you yourself need to be the one to deal with them? If they're incompetent, shouldn't anyone be able to handle them?

steps.speaker: Prince Itzla Arkan
steps.text: So you challenge me, iknami? I'm wounded. However, as I said before, I do not feel we can trust many people while we have potential traitors around us.

steps.player: But if they've managed to position some of their members in very important roles, surely they can't be completely incompetent?

steps.speaker: Prince Itzla Arkan
steps.text: We do not need to do this dance, [player name]. I understand that where you come from, there is a certain art to holding a conversation. We do not bother with that here. You may be direct.

steps.player: I guess I just still don't know you that well. If we're about to infiltrate this cult together, I'd like to understand why you think it's important you do this yourself.

steps.speaker: Prince Itzla Arkan
steps.text: I see. I understand your doubts, my friend. I suppose I have a few reasons for wanting to be here.

steps.speaker: Prince Itzla Arkan
steps.text: First, I do truly believe this mission has the highest chance of success if fewer people know about it. While I am not convinced on the competence of our foe, I still do not intend to underestimate them.

steps.speaker: Prince Itzla Arkan
steps.text: Second, I suppose I feel a certain level of responsibility. My father was attacked on my watch. When someone falters, it is their duty to fix it, especially when they hold a position like mine.

steps.speaker: Prince Itzla Arkan
steps.text: After all, a leader who sits by and lets others deal with his mistakes is not someone to have faith in.

steps.speaker: Prince Itzla Arkan
steps.text: Finally, Servius is my father. Our relationship is not a simple one, but he is my father all the same. I would see to it personally that his attackers face justice.

steps.speaker: Prince Itzla Arkan
steps.text: I hope that satisfies you, iknami.

steps.player: It does. Thank you, Itzla.

options.text: I'd better go and speak to this shopkeeper.

steps.player: I'd better go and speak to this shopkeeper.

visiting-the-windbreaker-bar-resting-in-.player: Itzla? Is that you? What are you doing here?

visiting-the-windbreaker-bar-resting-in-.speaker: Prince Itzla Arkan
visiting-the-windbreaker-bar-resting-in-.text: Nilsal, [player name]. Any luck with that shopkeeper?

visiting-the-windbreaker-bar-resting-in-.speaker: Prince Itzla Arkan
visiting-the-windbreaker-bar-resting-in-.text: Keep at it. He's our only way of infiltrating the Emissaries.

options.text: The Queen didn't seem very happy with you.
Do you really think Metzli, Furia and Ennius are traitors?
What happens if they try to attack Servius again?
Alright, I'll go and speak with him.

talking-to-the-quetzacalli-gorge-shopkee.speaker: Shopkeeper
talking-to-the-quetzacalli-gorge-shopkee.text: Hello there. Looking for some supplies?

options.text: I hear you can offer help to those in need.

steps.player: I hear you can offer help to those in need.

steps.speaker: Shopkeeper
steps.text: Well I'm always happy to help those less fortunate than I, but you don't really look like you need that sort of thing.

steps.player: I'm not sure if I should be insulted by that, or flattered... But anyway, you misunderstand. I'm not looking for help myself. Instead I was hoping to do some helping alongside you.

steps.speaker: Shopkeeper
steps.text: Thank you for the offer, but I'm not really looking for help right now.

steps.player: Are you sure? I do also quite like death.

steps.speaker: Shopkeeper
steps.text: What are you on about?

steps.player: You know, end of the world, holy fire, final dawns, that sort of thing.

steps.speaker: Shopkeeper
steps.text: Are you a fool? Keep your voice down!

steps.player: Look, I'm not here to cause problems. I just want to help.

steps.speaker: Shopkeeper
steps.text: You want to join the Emissaries?

steps.player: And a friend as well.

steps.speaker: Shopkeeper
steps.text: You know there are tests you'd need to pass, right? Not everyone can be considered worthy.

steps.player: Fine by me. I love tests!

steps.speaker: Shopkeeper
steps.text: There is a penalty for failing them.

steps.player: Okay, not quite as fun, but I'm still up for it.

steps.speaker: Shopkeeper
steps.text: Well... if you're sure, fetch your friend and then head east to the Twilight Temple. I will send word for them to expect you both.

steps.player: Lovely! Thanks!

talking-to-the-quetzacalli-gorge-shopkee.speaker: Shopkeeper
talking-to-the-quetzacalli-gorge-shopkee.text: Hello there. Looking for some supplies?

steps.player: About the Emissaries...

steps.speaker: Shopkeeper
steps.text: I already told you to keep your voice down! Fetch your friend and then head east to the Twilight Temple. I will send word for them to expect you both.

steps.player: Great! Thanks!

talking-to-the-quetzacalli-gorge-shopkee.speaker: Prince Itzla Arkan
talking-to-the-quetzacalli-gorge-shopkee.text: Nilsal, [player name]. Any luck with that shopkeeper?

talking-to-the-quetzacalli-gorge-shopkee.player: He's going to reach out to the Emissaries and let them know to expect us at their temple.

talking-to-the-quetzacalli-gorge-shopkee.speaker: Prince Itzla Arkan
talking-to-the-quetzacalli-gorge-shopkee.text: Kuani! Let us not waste any time then. I will meet you at the Twilight Temple. You'll find it east of here, on the other side of the Proudspire.

talking-to-the-quetzacalli-gorge-shopkee.player: Sounds good. I'll see you there shortly.

talking-to-prince-itzla-arkan.player: Okay... So what happens now that we're here?

talking-to-prince-itzla-arkan.speaker: Prince Itzla Arkan
talking-to-prince-itzla-arkan.text: It seems this tower is where the Emissaries evaluate possible new members. If we're to get anywhere here, we're going to need to pass whatever tests they might have for us.

talking-to-prince-itzla-arkan.speaker: Prince Itzla Arkan
talking-to-prince-itzla-arkan.text: Apparently, someone called Forebearer Janus will call upon us when it's our turn to be tested. In the meantime, we may as well mingle with these other potential recruits.

talking-to-prince-itzla-arkan.player: You think they might know something of note?

talking-to-prince-itzla-arkan.speaker: Prince Itzla Arkan
talking-to-prince-itzla-arkan.text: Unlikely, but it would be interesting to know why they woke up one day and decided their calling in life was to join a cult.

options.text: This whole place is very fancy.

steps.player: This whole place is very fancy.

steps.speaker: Prince Itzla Arkan
steps.text: Yes, I must admit the Emissaries have a more elaborate setup than expected. They've never been this organised before, nor have their numbers been so great. Something must have changed.

steps.player: Did they build everything here themselves?

steps.speaker: Prince Itzla Arkan
steps.text: Thankfully they are not quite that well put together. The temple here was built not long before the War of Betrayal. It is said that Imafore wanted somewhere dedicated to Ranul that would rival the Teomat.

steps.speaker: Prince Itzla Arkan
steps.text: I'm guessing he was too foolish to realise that the Teomat is equally dedicated to both Ralos and Ranul.

steps.speaker: Prince Itzla Arkan
steps.text: Anyway, the temple was considered an affront to both the Church of Ralos and the Sect of Ranul. After Imafore died, most people were more than happy to see it abandoned.

steps.player: And the Emissaries eventually moved in?

steps.speaker: Prince Itzla Arkan
steps.text: Yes, but only very recently.

steps.player: Interesting... I wonder what the cause was.

steps.speaker: Prince Itzla Arkan
steps.text: If all goes well, we will hopefully soon find out.

steps.speaker: Prince Itzla Arkan
steps.text: We still haven't been called upon yet. We may as well mingle with these other potential recruits while we wait.

steps.player: Alright, I'll get mingling.

talking-to-prince-itzla-arkan-talking-to.speaker: Prince Itzla Arkan
talking-to-prince-itzla-arkan-talking-to.text: We still haven't been called upon yet. We may as well mingle with these other potential recruits while we wait.

options.text: This whole place is very fancy.

talking-to-prince-itzla-arkan-talking-to.speaker: Nova
talking-to-prince-itzla-arkan-talking-to.text: Greetings, iknami. It's good to see so many who are willing to contribute to the Final Dawn. The word of the Augur has changed everything. The time to act is now.

talking-to-prince-itzla-arkan-talking-to.speaker: Nova
talking-to-prince-itzla-arkan-talking-to.text: You have not heard? She is the one who now leads the Emissaries. She has taken this once helpless collective and turned them into the ones who will guide us all to Mokhaiotl.

talking-to-prince-itzla-arkan-talking-to.player: How do you know all this? You're not even a member yet.

talking-to-prince-itzla-arkan-talking-to.speaker: Nova
talking-to-prince-itzla-arkan-talking-to.text: I was once. In my time of need, I turned to the Emissaries, but they were even more helpless than I was.

talking-to-prince-itzla-arkan-talking-to.speaker: Nova
talking-to-prince-itzla-arkan-talking-to.text: Now though, she has changed everything. Now it is my duty to rejoin their ranks so that we may bring about the Final Dawn.

talking-to-prince-itzla-arkan-talking-to.player: I see. Thanks for the information.

talking-to-prince-itzla-arkan-talking-to.speaker: Caritta
talking-to-prince-itzla-arkan-talking-to.text: Hello! You're not from around here, are you? It's exciting to see that even people from outside of Varlamore are looking to join the Emissaries!

talking-to-prince-itzla-arkan-talking-to.player: Well after I heard about all the good work they were doing, I could hardly say no! What about you? What made you want to join them?

talking-to-prince-itzla-arkan-talking-to.speaker: Caritta
talking-to-prince-itzla-arkan-talking-to.text: Well it's our duty of course! The Church of Ralos has become lost, but the Emissaries know the truth. Ximoua will not come to be unless we make it so!

talking-to-prince-itzla-arkan-talking-to.player: So you're quite eager to see the end of the world then?

talking-to-prince-itzla-arkan-talking-to.speaker: Caritta
talking-to-prince-itzla-arkan-talking-to.text: End? Ximoua is no end! It is the beginning! We will all come together as one and bring about a new world! I can't wait!

talking-to-prince-itzla-arkan-talking-to.player: Well I'm glad to see you're so excited. Good luck with the tests.

talking-to-prince-itzla-arkan-talking-to.speaker: Felius
talking-to-prince-itzla-arkan-talking-to.text: Leave me be. I am not here to make friends.

talking-to-prince-itzla-arkan-talking-to.speaker: Sergius
talking-to-prince-itzla-arkan-talking-to.text: I'm not sure I should be here. Maybe all this was a bad idea.

talking-to-prince-itzla-arkan-talking-to.speaker: Sergius
talking-to-prince-itzla-arkan-talking-to.text: I want to help... I want to believe... I really do! It's just all so intimidating...

talking-to-prince-itzla-arkan-talking-to.player: I'm sure it will be fine.

talking-to-prince-itzla-arkan-reporting-.player: I had a chat to some of the other recruits. One of them had something rather interesting to say.
Apparently, the Emissaries gained a new leader recently. They refer to her as the Augur.
I guess there's only one way to find out.

talking-to-prince-itzla-arkan-reporting-.speaker: Prince Itzla Arkan
talking-to-prince-itzla-arkan-reporting-.text: Hmm... Did you learn anything else of note?

talking-to-prince-itzla-arkan-reporting-.player: Apparently this Augur will lead the Emissaries to Mokhaiotl. Do you know what that means?

talking-to-prince-itzla-arkan-reporting-.speaker: Prince Itzla Arkan
talking-to-prince-itzla-arkan-reporting-.text: Mokhaiotl? I'm not my father, so you'll have to forgive my knowledge on this sort of thing, but if I remember right, Mokhaiotl plays a key role in Ximoua.

options.text: Could you remind me what Ximoua is?

steps.player: Could you remind me what Ximoua is?

steps.speaker: Prince Itzla Arkan
steps.text: It is said that one day, Ralos and Ranul will come together, uniting all souls as one. In doing so, they will bring about the destruction of this world, but also the birth of a new one.

steps.speaker: Prince Itzla Arkan
steps.text: Most accept that we cannot predict when this day will come. However, our friends in the Twilight Emissaries don't seem happy with that. They instead believe in something called Tsak Tauli, the Final Dawn.

steps.player: Ah yes, I remember. They see it as their duty to make Ximoua happen. So where does this Mokhaiotl fit in?

steps.speaker: Prince Itzla Arkan
steps.text: When Ralos and Ranul come together, it is said they will do so at Mokhaiotl, the centre of the world.

steps.player: I see. Given that the Emissaries see it as their duty to bring about the end, I suppose it makes sense that they'd want to reach Mokhaiotl themselves.

steps.speaker: Prince Itzla Arkan
steps.text: Well I'd love to know how they plan on reaching the centre of the world. I can't imagine it's the kind of place that you can just stroll on down to.

steps.speaker: Forebearer Janus
steps.text: Itzlan. [player name]. It is time for you to prove your worth. Enter the tower when you're ready.
If followed by Itzla:
If not followed by Itzla:

steps.speaker: Prince Itzla Arkan
steps.text: But it seems we will have to ponder this mystery later. Let us head in and see what tests await us.

steps.player: How so?

steps.speaker: Prince Itzla Arkan
steps.text: It is said that Ralos and Ranul will come together at Mokhaiotl, the centre of the world. It is there that they will unite all souls as one, destroying this world and creating a new one.

steps.player: I see. Given that the Emissaries see it as their duty to bring about the end, I suppose it makes sense that they'd want to reach Mokhaiotl themselves.

steps.speaker: Prince Itzla Arkan
steps.text: Well I'd love to know how they plan on reaching the centre of the world. I can't imagine it's the kind of place that you can just stroll on down to.

steps.text: Itzlan. [player name]. It is time for you to prove your worth. Enter the tower when you're ready.
If followed by Itzla:

steps.speaker: Prince Itzla Arkan
steps.text: But it seems we will have to ponder this mystery later. Let us head in and see what tests await us.

descending-into-the-tower-of-ascension.speaker: Forebearer Janus
descending-into-the-tower-of-ascension.text: Itzlan and [player name], I take it?

descending-into-the-tower-of-ascension.speaker: Forebearer Janus
descending-into-the-tower-of-ascension.text: Good. Allow me to welcome you to the Tower of Ascension. You are here because you hope to be welcomed into our family. We hope to welcome you as well, but alas, not all can be deemed worthy.

descending-into-the-tower-of-ascension.speaker: Forebearer Janus
descending-into-the-tower-of-ascension.text: Here, in the Tower of Ascension, you will demonstrate your intellect, strength, loyalty and ability to sacrifice. In doing so, you will prove your worth to Ralos and Ranul.

descending-into-the-tower-of-ascension.speaker: Forebearer Janus
descending-into-the-tower-of-ascension.text: When you are ready to begin, climb the stairs. Your first trial awaits.

descending-into-the-tower-of-ascension-a.speaker: Forebearer Janus
descending-into-the-tower-of-ascension-a.text: Hey you! You're not allowed up there.

descending-into-the-tower-of-ascension-s.speaker: Forebearer Janus
descending-into-the-tower-of-ascension-s.text: Itzlan. [player name]. When you are ready to begin, climb the stairs. Your first trial awaits.

descending-into-the-tower-of-ascension-s.speaker: Forebearer Janus
descending-into-the-tower-of-ascension-s.text: You have trials to complete, [player name]. Climb up the stairs when you are ready.

descending-into-the-tower-of-ascension-a.speaker: Forebearer Janus
descending-into-the-tower-of-ascension-a.text: Hey! You haven't been given permission to open that!

descending-into-the-tower-of-ascension-f.speaker: Forebearer Janus
descending-into-the-tower-of-ascension-f.text: Welcome to your first trial. The aim is simple: Speak the correct pass phrase to me and you will be allowed to proceed. Let the trial begin!
If the player talks to Forebearer Janus during the first trial

descending-into-the-tower-of-ascension-f.speaker: Forebearer Janus
descending-into-the-tower-of-ascension-f.text: Recruit.

steps.player: About that passphrase...

steps.speaker: Forebearer Janus
steps.text: Do you have it yet?
If the player does not have any of the scraps of paper:

steps.player: Not quite yet, but I'll have it in no time.

steps.speaker: Forebearer Janus
steps.text: We shall see.
If the player has at least two scraps of paper, but not the completed note:

steps.player: Er... Sure!

options.text: What are we meant to be doing again?

steps.player: What are we meant to be doing again?

steps.speaker: Forebearer Janus
steps.text: It's quite simple: You just need to work out the passphrase and say it to me. You may use whatever you have available in this room to discover it.

steps.player: Okay, thanks.

descending-into-the-tower-of-ascension-f.text: You pull a key out of the cultist's pocket.
If the player attempts to pickpocket a cultist again:

steps.text: There doesn't seem to be anything of value in their pocket.

descending-into-the-tower-of-ascension-f.text: You use the key to unlock the gate.

a book and the first scrap of paper

steps.text: You open the chest, but there is nothing of interest inside.

descending-into-the-tower-of-ascension-f.text: If the player unlocks the south-west chest successfully:

steps.text: You unlock the chest and find a poem and a scrap of paper inside.
a poem and the second scrap of paper

descending-into-the-tower-of-ascension-f.text: If the player supplies the incorrect password:

steps.text: That didn't seem to work.

descending-into-the-tower-of-ascension-f.text: If the player has not yet pickpocketed a cultist:

steps.speaker: Prince Itzla Arkan
steps.text: These emissaries here are acting a bit strange... They keep putting their hands in their pockets.

steps.player: Interesting...

descending-into-the-tower-of-ascension-f.text: If the player has received the tower key but has not yet received the book:

steps.speaker: Prince Itzla Arkan
steps.text: We should keep looking for that passphrase.

descending-into-the-tower-of-ascension-f.text: If the player has received the book but not the poem:

steps.speaker: Prince Itzla Arkan
steps.text: Found anything of note, iknami?

steps.player: I have this book that might be of use.

steps.text: You show the book to Itzla.

steps.speaker: Prince Itzla Arkan
steps.text: Hmm... Seems some of the words are highlighted. I doubt that's a coincidence.

descending-into-the-tower-of-ascension-f.player: Do you think you could help me translate some words?

descending-into-the-tower-of-ascension-f.speaker: Prince Itzla Arkan
descending-into-the-tower-of-ascension-f.text: Translate? Well I guess I can give it a go.

steps.player: Silam.

steps.speaker: Prince Itzla Arkan
steps.text: Ah, I recognise this language. It's the language of the Old Ones. Servius did teach me a few of their words, though I may not have paid as much attention as he'd have liked...

steps.speaker: Prince Itzla Arkan
steps.text: This one means... 'West'!

steps.player: Thanks! Could you translate another?

steps.speaker: Prince Itzla Arkan
steps.text: I can try.

steps.speaker: Prince Itzla Arkan
steps.text: Silam? I think that means 'west'.

steps.player: Makt.

steps.speaker: Prince Itzla Arkan
steps.text: Makt? I believe that means...

steps.speaker: Prince Itzla Arkan
steps.text: Er...

steps.speaker: Prince Itzla Arkan
steps.text: 'North'! It means 'north'.

steps.speaker: Prince Itzla Arkan
steps.text: Makt? I think that means 'north'.

steps.player: Uitt.

steps.speaker: Prince Itzla Arkan
steps.text: Uitt? If I remember correctly, that translates to 'south'.

steps.speaker: Prince Itzla Arkan
steps.text: Uitt? I think that means 'south'.

steps.speaker: Prince Itzla Arkan
steps.text: Uitt? I believe that means...

steps.speaker: Prince Itzla Arkan
steps.text: Er...

steps.speaker: Prince Itzla Arkan
steps.text: 'South'! It means 'south'.

steps.player: Takam.

steps.speaker: Prince Itzla Arkan
steps.text: Ah, I recognise this language. It's the language of the Old Ones. Servius did teach me a few of their words, though I may not have paid as much attention as he'd have liked...

steps.speaker: Prince Itzla Arkan
steps.text: This one means... 'East'!

steps.speaker: Prince Itzla Arkan
steps.text: Takam? If I remember correctly, that translates to 'east'.

steps.speaker: Prince Itzla Arkan
steps.text: Takam? I think that means 'east'.

options.text: Thanks! I'm done translating for now.

steps.player: Thanks! I'm done translating for now.

steps.speaker: Prince Itzla Arkan
steps.text: Well I hope it helps, iknami.

descending-into-the-tower-of-ascension-f.text: If the player unlocks the north-east chest and interacts with one of the scraps of paper:

steps.text: You unlock the chest and find a scrap of paper inside.
the third scrap of paper.
You combine the scraps of paper together.
Completed note

descending-into-the-tower-of-ascension-f.player: I think I might have the passphrase.

descending-into-the-tower-of-ascension-f.speaker: Prince Itzla Arkan
descending-into-the-tower-of-ascension-f.text: Kuani! You'd better let Forebearer Janus know.

descending-into-the-tower-of-ascension-f.speaker: Forebearer Janus
descending-into-the-tower-of-ascension-f.text: Recruit.

options.text: What are we meant to be doing again?

steps.player: About that passphrase...

steps.speaker: Forebearer Janus
steps.text: Do you have it yet?

steps.player: I think so!

descending-into-the-tower-of-ascension-f.text: If the player chooses the wrong combination:

steps.player: Moki Koma Ikam.

steps.speaker: Forebearer Janus
steps.text: No, that's not quite right.

options.text: I guess I'd better keep searching.

steps.player: I guess I'd better keep searching.

steps.text: If the player chooses the right combination:

steps.speaker: Forebearer Janus
steps.text: That is correct. Well done! You and your companion may progress to the next trial.

steps.prompt: Begin the next trial?

steps.player: I'm not quite ready.

steps.speaker: Forebearer Janus
steps.text: Speak to me when you are ready to start.

steps.player: I'm ready!

steps.speaker: Forebearer Janus
steps.text: Welcome to your next trial. Here, there is one simple goal...

steps.speaker: Forebearer Janus
steps.text: Survive.

steps.speaker: Forebearer Janus
steps.text: Speak to me when you are ready to start.

steps.speaker: Emissary Ascended
steps.text: I don't know if you'll ever figure this one out!

steps.speaker: Emissary Ascended
steps.text: Struggling? I've seen a lot of people fail to work this one out.

steps.speaker: Emissary Ascended
steps.text: Do you think you've got the intellect to complete this one?

descending-into-the-tower-of-ascension-t.speaker: Emissary Ascended
descending-into-the-tower-of-ascension-t.text: I admit, that was pretty fast. Still, it will take more than that for you to prove your worth.

descending-into-the-tower-of-ascension-t.speaker: Forebearer Janus
descending-into-the-tower-of-ascension-t.text: Are you ready to start the next trial?

descending-into-the-tower-of-ascension-s.speaker: Forebearer Janus
descending-into-the-tower-of-ascension-s.text: Recruit. Are you ready to start?

options.text: Can you remind me what this trial is?

steps.player: Can you remind me what this trial is?

steps.speaker: Forebearer Janus
steps.text: The goal is simple: Survive. That is the only advice I can offer you.

steps.speaker: Forebearer Janus
steps.text: Now, are you ready to begin?

options.text: No, I'm not quite ready yet.

steps.player: No, I'm not quite ready yet.

steps.speaker: Forebearer Janus
steps.text: Speak to me again when you are.

steps.player: Yes! I'm ready.

steps.speaker: Prince Itzla Arkan
steps.text: As am I.

steps.speaker: Forebearer Janus
steps.text: Then let the trial commence.

descending-into-the-tower-of-ascension-s.text: Player enters an instanced fight.
If the player does not have a bandage in their inventory:

steps.speaker: Prince Itzla Arkan
steps.text: It seems some of the boxes have been left around the edges of the room...

steps.player: I'll check them out.

descending-into-the-tower-of-ascension-s.text: If the player has a bandage in their inventory:

steps.speaker: Prince Itzla Arkan
steps.text: I think it's time for a fight! This one should be fun!

descending-into-the-tower-of-ascension-s.speaker: Forebearer Janus
descending-into-the-tower-of-ascension-s.text: Brawlers attack!

descending-into-the-tower-of-ascension-s.speaker: Forebearer Janus
descending-into-the-tower-of-ascension-s.text: Don't go so easy on them this time, brawlers!

descending-into-the-tower-of-ascension-s.speaker: Forebearer Janus
descending-into-the-tower-of-ascension-s.text: Conjurers, aid your brawlers!

descending-into-the-tower-of-ascension-s.speaker: Forebearer Janus
descending-into-the-tower-of-ascension-s.text: Brawlers attack!

descending-into-the-tower-of-ascension-s.speaker: Forebearer Janus
descending-into-the-tower-of-ascension-s.text: It appears your companion has fallen in battle!
Itzla is knocked out, causing you to fail the trial.

descending-into-the-tower-of-ascension-s.speaker: Forebearer Janus
descending-into-the-tower-of-ascension-s.text: An unfortunate fate for your companion on your last attempt. Do you want to try again?

options.text: No, I'm not quite ready yet.
Can you remind me what this trial is?

descending-into-the-tower-of-ascension-s.text: If the player defeats all of the brawlers:

steps.speaker: Forebearer Janus
steps.text: You have fought well... This trial is now complete!

descending-into-the-tower-of-ascension-s.speaker: Prince Itzla Arkan
descending-into-the-tower-of-ascension-s.text: Great work there, [player name]. I wonder what our next trial will be.

descending-into-the-tower-of-ascension-t.speaker: Forebearer Janus
descending-into-the-tower-of-ascension-t.text: Are you ready to start the next trial?

steps.player: I'm ready!

steps.speaker: Forebearer Janus
steps.text: Welcome to your third trial. Before you stand some recently initiated acolytes. However, it seems one of them was not as loyal to our cause as first believed.

steps.speaker: Forebearer Janus
steps.text: Your task is to question all four and determine who the traitor is. I suggest you choose carefully. Good luck.

descending-into-the-tower-of-ascension-t.speaker: Prince Itzla Arkan
descending-into-the-tower-of-ascension-t.text: My guess is that one of them has some beliefs that don't quite line up with those of the Emissaries.

descending-into-the-tower-of-ascension-t.player: So we question them about that sort of thing? I can't imagine they'd be willing to be truthful about that.

descending-into-the-tower-of-ascension-t.speaker: Prince Itzla Arkan
descending-into-the-tower-of-ascension-t.text: They can't be truthful about something they don't know about. Take advantage of gaps in their knowledge - gaps that a true Emissary wouldn't have.

descending-into-the-tower-of-ascension-t.player: You know, it sounds like they plan to kill whoever is guilty.

descending-into-the-tower-of-ascension-t.speaker: Prince Itzla Arkan
descending-into-the-tower-of-ascension-t.text: Shouldn't have joined a crazy murder cult then. Or if they really were committed to joining a crazy murder cult, they should have at least made sure they were actually good at it!

descending-into-the-tower-of-ascension-t.player: Do you not even have a little bit of sympathy for them?
Fair enough. I guess I'd better get questioning.

options.text: What do we know about the Emissaries and their beliefs?

steps.player: What do we know about the Emissaries and their beliefs?

steps.speaker: Prince Itzla Arkan
steps.text: Probably not as much as we should, but what we do know is that the Emissaries believe in Tsak Tauli, more commonly known as the Final Dawn.

steps.speaker: Prince Itzla Arkan
steps.text: Like with Ximoua, the Final Dawn sees Ralos and Ranul come together, uniting all souls as one. In doing so they destroy this world and create a new one.

steps.speaker: Prince Itzla Arkan
steps.text: After that, the two gods separate again, but the souls they united stay within them. The cycle then starts over once more.

steps.speaker: Prince Itzla Arkan
steps.text: The Emissaries seem to consider it their singular purpose to bring about the Final Dawn. Nothing else matters to them.

steps.player: I see. Thanks for the information. Hopefully it will help me work out who this traitor is.

options.text: I still have some questioning to do.

steps.player: I still have some questioning to do.

steps.speaker: Prince Itzla Arkan
steps.text: Good luck!

options.text: Why did you join the Emissaries?

steps.player: Why did you join the Emissaries?

steps.text: If Tenoch is not the traitor:

steps.speaker: Tenoch
steps.text: To do my duty, of course. Ralos and Ranul wish us to bring about the end of this world. Only then will we see the birth of a new one.
If Tenoch is the traitor:

steps.speaker: Tenoch
steps.text: To do my duty, of course. Ralos and Ranul wish us to bring about the end of this world. Only then will we will all unite in Mictl.

steps.player: Who do you worship?

steps.speaker: Tenoch
steps.text: I worship both Ralos and Ranul equally, for in reality they are one. They have been separated for now, but soon they will rejoin once more.

options.text: Tell me about the Final Dawn.

steps.player: Tell me about the Final Dawn.

steps.text: If Tenoch is not the traitor:

steps.speaker: Tenoch
steps.text: The Final Dawn is our destiny. Ralos and Ranul will unite us all and end this world, but in doing so, we will all play a part in forming a new one.
If Tenoch is the traitor:

steps.speaker: Tenoch
steps.text: The Final Dawn is our destiny. Ralos and Ranul will unite us all and end this world, but in doing so, they will grant us eternal life in Mictl.

options.text: Why did you join the Emissaries?

steps.player: Why did you join the Emissaries?

steps.text: If Silia is not the traitor:

steps.speaker: Silia
steps.text: I always knew people were wrong about me. I knew I would serve a higher purpose. I never cared what it was. I only cared that in doing so, I would be serving the will of Ralos.
If Silia is the traitor:

steps.speaker: Silia
steps.text: I always knew people were wrong about me. I knew I would serve a higher purpose. I never cared what it was. I only cared that in doing so, I would be granted a place in Mictl.

steps.player: Who do you worship?

steps.speaker: Silia
steps.text: I have served Ralos my whole life. I am his humble servant. It was he who guided me here so that I may serve his will.

options.text: Tell me about the Final Dawn.

steps.player: Tell me about the Final Dawn.

steps.text: If Silia is not the traitor:

steps.speaker: Silia
steps.text: The Final Dawn is an end, but also a beginning. It is when Ralos will use his holy fire to destroy this world so that he and Ranul can build a new one.
If Silia is the traitor:

steps.speaker: Silia
steps.text: The Final Dawn is an end, but also a beginning. It is when Ralos will use his holy fire to destroy this world. Then he and Ranul will guide us to Mictl.

options.text: Why did you join the Emissaries?

steps.player: Why did you join the Emissaries?

steps.text: If Adrius is not the traitor:

steps.speaker: Adrius
steps.text: To be honest, I wasn't too sure about joining at first. My friend convinced me though. Here we're part of something bigger than ourselves.
If Adrius is the traitor:

steps.speaker: Adrius
steps.text: To be honest, I wasn't too sure about joining at first. My friend convinced me though. Here we have a chance to be granted a place in Mictl.

steps.player: Who do you worship?

steps.speaker: Adrius
steps.text: I've never been one for proper worship, but I believe in the teachings of Ralos and Ranul. I hope those teachings guide me through whatever is to come.

options.text: Tell me about the Final Dawn.

steps.player: Tell me about the Final Dawn.

steps.text: If Adrius is not the traitor:

steps.speaker: Adrius
steps.text: They say the Final Dawn is inevitable. It's the end that we can't escape from. It's a scary thought, but the Twilight Emissaries have embraced it, so I have as well.
If Adrius is the traitor:

steps.speaker: Adrius
steps.text: They say the Final Dawn is inevitable. It's the end that we can't escape from. It's a scary thought, but at least here I have a chance to control my destiny and obtain a place in Mictl.

options.text: Why did you join the Emissaries?

steps.player: Why did you join the Emissaries?

steps.text: If Eleuia is not the traitor:

steps.speaker: Eleuia
steps.text: I wished to see my god in mortal form and serve his will. In return for my service, the Emissaries promised me they could grant that wish.
If Eleuia is the traitor:

steps.speaker: Eleuia
steps.text: I wished to see my god in mortal form and be granted eternity in Mictl. In return for my service, the Emissaries promised me they could grant that wish.

steps.player: Who do you worship?

steps.speaker: Eleuia
steps.text: I am a humble servant of Ranul. It has always been my hope to stand before him and be judged as worthy.

options.text: Tell me about the Final Dawn.

steps.player: Tell me about the Final Dawn.

steps.text: If Eleuia is not the traitor:

steps.speaker: Eleuia
steps.text: The Final Dawn is the will of Ranul. He will show us all that death is nothing to be feared as he and Ralos guide us into forming a new world.
If Eleuia is the traitor:

steps.speaker: Eleuia
steps.text: The Final Dawn is the will of Ranul. He will show us all that death is nothing to be feared. He and Ralos will lead us into forming a new world before then guiding us to Mictl.

descending-into-the-tower-of-ascension-t.prompt: Are you sure you wish to select [member's name] as the traitor?

steps.speaker: Forebearer Janus

steps.speaker: Forebearer Janus
steps.text: I'm afraid you have made the wrong choice. Let's try this again...
The third trial is reset.

Forebearer Janus casts a spell at the member, killing them.

steps.speaker: Forebearer Janus
steps.text: Nicely done. [member's name] was indeed the traitor. You have both done well, but I wonder how well you will work together in the final trial...

steps.speaker: Forebearer Janus
steps.text: Speak to me when you are ready to proceed.

descending-into-the-tower-of-ascension-t.speaker: Forebearer Janus
