finished-work-returning-to-the-alchemist.player: Now listen, what does it all do? Why are you-

finished-work-returning-to-the-alchemist.speaker: Effigy
finished-work-returning-to-the-alchemist.text: Years of devoted work; it's complete!

finished-work-returning-to-the-alchemist.speaker: 'Transmute' The Alchemist
finished-work-returning-to-the-alchemist.text: At last! Our work is complete!

finished-work-returning-to-the-alchemist.speaker: 'Currency' The Alchemist
finished-work-returning-to-the-alchemist.text: I can almost taste the riches!

finished-work-returning-to-the-alchemist.speaker: Effigy
finished-work-returning-to-the-alchemist.text: To the top of the tower, fellow alchemists!

finished-work-returning-to-the-alchemist.player: Why does nobody listen? Best if I follow them, I suppose.

finished-work-talking-to-bonafido.player: I'm really getting annoyed with those alchemists.
Well, I completed the tower and I still have no idea what it does, and then as soon as I tell Effigy of my hard work, he doesn't say one word of thanks and legs it off into the tower!

finished-work-talking-to-bonafido.speaker: Bonafido
finished-work-talking-to-bonafido.text: Well, I'll be a rabbit in da eyes of a fox! Best ya chase after 'im then and get us our dosh! Don't you do a runner, now!

finished-work-talking-to-bonafido.player: Don't worry, I'm not about to let Effigy get away with treating us builders like this!

finished-work-going-to-the-top-of-the-to.speaker: Effigy
finished-work-going-to-the-top-of-the-to.text: It is time, my friends! The culmination of our work is complete!

finished-work-going-to-the-top-of-the-to.speaker: Effigy
finished-work-going-to-the-top-of-the-to.text: A great many years of planning and preparation has brought us here, my fellow alchemists. Now we have... The Tower of Life! We can already create gold, we can already transform matter from one thing to

finished-work-going-to-the-top-of-the-to.speaker: Effigy
finished-work-going-to-the-top-of-the-to.text: another, and now we have the ability to create life itself! We owe much to the power of Guthix, for without the life essence he left below ground, we would never have been able to bring this tower alive!

finished-work-going-to-the-top-of-the-to.speaker: Effigy
finished-work-going-to-the-top-of-the-to.text: It begins! The first day of creation!

finished-work-going-to-the-top-of-the-to.speaker: 'Transmute' The Alchemist
finished-work-going-to-the-top-of-the-to.text: It can talk! A real success.

finished-work-going-to-the-top-of-the-to.speaker: Homunculus
finished-work-going-to-the-top-of-the-to.text: Where me? Skin burn...arrgh...eyes hurt...let me go!

finished-work-going-to-the-top-of-the-to.speaker: 'Currency' The Alchemist
finished-work-going-to-the-top-of-the-to.text: Excellent, it can feel! It's self-aware. This is really a great day.

finished-work-going-to-the-top-of-the-to.speaker: Homunculus
finished-work-going-to-the-top-of-the-to.text: Whyeee cage? Argh...please help me! Graaahhh!

finished-work-going-to-the-top-of-the-to.player: This is terrible, you must do something!

finished-work-going-to-the-top-of-the-to.speaker: Effigy
finished-work-going-to-the-top-of-the-to.text: Ah, it's our helper. Thank you for fixing the tower; we will reward you greatly.

finished-work-going-to-the-top-of-the-to.player: I don't want a reward, just let it go. Can't you see it's in pain?

finished-work-going-to-the-top-of-the-to.speaker: Effigy
finished-work-going-to-the-top-of-the-to.text: Don't worry. It has no soul; it has no worth.

finished-work-going-to-the-top-of-the-to.speaker: 'Transmute' The Alchemist
finished-work-going-to-the-top-of-the-to.text: Yes, it's just an experiment in alchemy.

finished-work-going-to-the-top-of-the-to.speaker: 'Currency' The Alchemist
finished-work-going-to-the-top-of-the-to.text: The creature must be grateful for his creation.

finished-work-going-to-the-top-of-the-to.speaker: Homunculus
finished-work-going-to-the-top-of-the-to.text: You create hurt. Not fair, let me free!

finished-work-going-to-the-top-of-the-to.speaker: Effigy
finished-work-going-to-the-top-of-the-to.text: Yes, be still and quit your moaning.

finished-work-going-to-the-top-of-the-to.speaker: Effigy
finished-work-going-to-the-top-of-the-to.text: You should know your place, adventurer. This is no concern of yours now.

finished-work-going-to-the-top-of-the-to.speaker: 'Currency' The Alchemist
finished-work-going-to-the-top-of-the-to.text: You should be satisfied and leave. Then we can begin our experiments.

finished-work-going-to-the-top-of-the-to.speaker: 'Transmute' The Alchemist
finished-work-going-to-the-top-of-the-to.text: Get out of the tower before it's too late!

finished-work-going-to-the-top-of-the-to.player: They've run away. I must go confront those alchemists downstairs.

finished-work-talking-to-bonafido-again.player: You won't BELIEVE what I just saw!
That tower is... a tower of life! I just witnessed with my very own eyes the creation of an homunculus!
Homunculus! They have found a way of creating life itself, but the creature they have made is not a happy being.
Are you listening at all? This creature is very dangerous, it needs to be stopped! And fast!

finished-work-talking-to-bonafido-again.speaker: Bonafido
finished-work-talking-to-bonafido-again.text: I'm glad you've got the money sorted.

finished-work-confronting-the-alchemists.player: I can't believe what you guys have done.

finished-work-confronting-the-alchemists.speaker: 'Transmute' The Alchemist
finished-work-confronting-the-alchemists.text: Marvellous.

finished-work-confronting-the-alchemists.player: No. Scary!

finished-work-confronting-the-alchemists.speaker: 'Transmute' The Alchemist
finished-work-confronting-the-alchemists.text: That too.

finished-work-confronting-the-alchemists.player: That is one very sad creature.

finished-work-confronting-the-alchemists.speaker: 'Currency' The Alchemist
finished-work-confronting-the-alchemists.text: It'll be alright; it just needs a pat on the back.

finished-work-confronting-the-alchemists.player: Why am I suddenly glad that you're not responsible for sorting out this mess?
Effigy!

finished-work-confronting-the-alchemists.speaker: Effigy
finished-work-confronting-the-alchemists.text: I know, I know. This is a truly dangerous creation, of all proportions.

finished-work-confronting-the-alchemists.player: I hope you learn from this.

finished-work-confronting-the-alchemists.speaker: Effigy
finished-work-confronting-the-alchemists.text: I will, I will. Next time we'll use a stronger cage.

finished-work-confronting-the-alchemists.player: What?

finished-work-confronting-the-alchemists.speaker: Effigy
finished-work-confronting-the-alchemists.text: A bad joke.

finished-work-confronting-the-alchemists.player: I'll just ignore that. So, what about that Homunculus up there? You can't just leave it.

finished-work-confronting-the-alchemists.speaker: Effigy
finished-work-confronting-the-alchemists.text: Maybe you could go have a talk with it?

finished-work-confronting-the-alchemists.player: Why me? You created it!

finished-work-confronting-the-alchemists.speaker: Effigy
finished-work-confronting-the-alchemists.text: Pleeeaaase.

finished-work-confronting-the-alchemists.player: No.

finished-work-confronting-the-alchemists.speaker: Effigy
finished-work-confronting-the-alchemists.text: Pretty please with a cherry on top?

finished-work-confronting-the-alchemists.player: No way!

finished-work-confronting-the-alchemists.speaker: Effigy
finished-work-confronting-the-alchemists.text: I'll make sure you're compensated. You won't be forgotten for this!

finished-work-confronting-the-alchemists.player: Why do I get the feeling I'm doomed to go face that creature on my own?

finished-work-confronting-the-alchemists.speaker: Effigy
finished-work-confronting-the-alchemists.text: Good on you! I knew you would help us!

finished-work-confronting-the-alchemists.player: Oh well. They do say that experience teaches fools.
Hi, Effigy.

finished-work-confronting-the-alchemists.speaker: Effigy
finished-work-confronting-the-alchemists.text: Have you spoken to our wondrously fabulous creation yet?

finished-work-confronting-the-alchemists.player: I haven't spoken to it at all. Give me a chance. And please stop your overuse of adjectives.

finished-work-confronting-the-alchemists.speaker: Effigy
finished-work-confronting-the-alchemists.text: What a hideously, unforgiveable and insensitive combination of dialogue to supply to a friend!

finished-work-confronting-the-alchemists.player: I swear you'll get a knuckle sandwich sometime soon if you don't shut up.

finished-work-confronting-the-alchemists.speaker: Effigy
finished-work-confronting-the-alchemists.text: Charming.

finished-work-confronting-the-alchemists.player: I'm off to talk to the Homunculus.

finished-work-confronting-the-alchemists.speaker: 'Transmute' The Alchemist
finished-work-confronting-the-alchemists.text: Rather you than me. Can't say you look like you'll make it out alive.

finished-work-confronting-the-alchemists.player: Thanks for the support. How about saying something encouraging.

finished-work-confronting-the-alchemists.speaker: 'Transmute' The Alchemist
finished-work-confronting-the-alchemists.text: Like?

finished-work-confronting-the-alchemists.player: I don't know. How about 'You can do it!' or 'That Homunculus is in for a surprise'.

finished-work-confronting-the-alchemists.speaker: 'Transmute' The Alchemist
finished-work-confronting-the-alchemists.text: So, you want me to lie?

finished-work-confronting-the-alchemists.player: Forget it.
Okay, I'm going to go chat with the Homunculus.

finished-work-confronting-the-alchemists.speaker: 'Currency' The Alchemist
finished-work-confronting-the-alchemists.text: Very good.

finished-work-confronting-the-alchemists.speaker: 'Currency' The Alchemist
finished-work-confronting-the-alchemists.text: Could you do us a favour?

finished-work-confronting-the-alchemists.player: I probably have enough on my plate, but go ahead; what?

finished-work-confronting-the-alchemists.speaker: 'Currency' The Alchemist
finished-work-confronting-the-alchemists.text: Could you ask it a question?

finished-work-confronting-the-alchemists.player: Which is?

finished-work-confronting-the-alchemists.speaker: 'Currency' The Alchemist
finished-work-confronting-the-alchemists.text: Does it have any spare cash?

finished-work-confronting-the-alchemists.player: Let me think how I can phrase this...
No.

finished-work-confronting-the-alchemists.speaker: 'Currency' The Alchemist
finished-work-confronting-the-alchemists.text: Oh.

finished-work-freeing-the-homunculus-ret.player: It's okay, I'm here to help you.
No, honest. I helped the alchemists, but I had no idea what their plans involved.

finished-work-freeing-the-homunculus-ret.speaker: Homunculus
finished-work-freeing-the-homunculus-ret.text: Arggh, so alchemist create me now I trapped for experiements. But still I confused.

finished-work-freeing-the-homunculus-ret.speaker: Homunculus
finished-work-freeing-the-homunculus-ret.text: Me see logic, feeeel magic. A mix of the two.

finished-work-freeing-the-homunculus-ret.player: Hmmm. A creature created of logic and magic.
Don't fear. I shall fix your mind!

finished-work-freeing-the-homunculus-ret.speaker: Homunculus
finished-work-freeing-the-homunculus-ret.text: No so sure it is easy to do. No one canna 'elp. Arghhh.
You must now make sense of the Homunculus's mind. Force him to either follow the line of logic or the line of magic.

finished-work-freeing-the-homunculus-ret.player: You tell me that you're confused, so ask me some questions!

finished-work-freeing-the-homunculus-ret.text: Choosing any one of the three options will give three new options in the same order and change the Homunculus' sanity meter. They will eventually loop.

steps.prompt: How can I make fire appear at my fingertips?

options.text: Get some logs and a tinderbox.
With the aid of 5 fire runes.
That's impossible! No one can do that!

steps.prompt: How do dragons breathe fire?

options.text: Not too sure, I've never seen it happen.
With the help of the magical dragonstones!
By ignition of gas in their belly as they exhale.

steps.prompt: What do people do, day-in, day-out?
What could I do with unwanted bones?

options.text: I'd like to think you wouldn't be carrying bones around.
Turn them into bananas or peaches!

steps.prompt: What's the best way to travel?

options.text: I'm not really much of a traveller, sorry.
Run, run as fast as you can.
Depends where you are headed, but teleport spells are a safe bet.

steps.prompt: I hear people whisper of potions...

options.text: Yes, you can make magic potions to boost your skills.
People mix together ingredients in vials. The nutrients will help you.

steps.prompt: How are runes created?

options.text: By harnessing the power of the gods!
Take some essence to an altar and use a talisman.

steps.prompt: Can people move things with the power of the mind?

options.text: Perhaps. I've never seen it myself, though.
Yep, you can use the Telekinetic Grab spell.
Sure. Use your brain to tell someone to move it!

steps.prompt: How can I possibly exist?

options.text: It's a simple case of combining materials.

steps.prompt: Explain those flashing sparks that scared the alchemists.

options.text: You have special powers - no surprise seeing how you were created.
Coincidence - there is a lot of loose metal around.
Yeah, they were cool! Nice one.

steps.prompt: I want to learn more - what should I study?

options.text: Try some Mining followed by Smithing.
That's up to you; depends on what you find interesting.

steps.prompt: If I can reach out far enough I can grab the sun.

options.text: Don't be silly! You'd get burnt!
Can't see why not, anything is possible.
Well the sun is not actually there, it's where it used to be!

steps.prompt: Am I a creature of magic or a creature of logic?

options.text: Everything has a reason, even if you don't know what it is.
Your very existense speaks of mystical forces.

steps.prompt: Which do you believe in?

options.text: I'm too laid back to really care, mate.

finished-work-freeing-the-homunculus-ret.text: When the Homunculus' mind is fixed:

finished-work-freeing-the-homunculus-ret.speaker: Homunculus
finished-work-freeing-the-homunculus-ret.text: That it! Make sense now, thank you!

finished-work-freeing-the-homunculus-ret.player: I decided to root for magic.

finished-work-freeing-the-homunculus-ret.speaker: Homunculus
finished-work-freeing-the-homunculus-ret.text: No does matter which you chose. Me needed organise my thoughts. I see there is truth in both.

finished-work-freeing-the-homunculus-ret.speaker: Homunculus
finished-work-freeing-the-homunculus-ret.text: Now we go scare alchemies - they have been wrong to do this! Although I have life, they mustn't go about this again.

finished-work-freeing-the-homunculus-ret.player: Sounds like a good plan. Can you get out of that cage?

finished-work-freeing-the-homunculus-ret.speaker: Homunculus
finished-work-freeing-the-homunculus-ret.text: Easy. You run down and I watching from here. I surprise right moment.

finished-work-freeing-the-homunculus-tal.speaker: Homunculus
finished-work-freeing-the-homunculus-tal.text: Better. You been mine angel. I now have the understanding I need.

finished-work-freeing-the-homunculus-tal.speaker: Homunculus
finished-work-freeing-the-homunculus-tal.text: Please, alchemists you speak, me appear to surprise.

finished-work-freeing-the-homunculus-tal.player: I'm not sure I understand, but okay, I will go have a word with them.

finished-work-freeing-the-homunculus-tal.speaker: Bonafido
finished-work-freeing-the-homunculus-tal.text: Looks like we're out of a job then.

finished-work-freeing-the-homunculus-tal.player: Oh, I wouldn't worry about it. There are frequently new buildings required around Gielinor. I'm sure your services will be called upon again.

finished-work-freeing-the-homunculus-sca.player: Well, I've sat down and had a good chat with the Homunculus.
The Homunculus is a bit better off now.

finished-work-freeing-the-homunculus-sca.speaker: 'Currency' The Alchemist
finished-work-freeing-the-homunculus-sca.text: Excellent. So we can go back in.

finished-work-freeing-the-homunculus-eff.player: Effigy, I need a word with you.

finished-work-freeing-the-homunculus-eff.speaker: Effigy
finished-work-freeing-the-homunculus-eff.text: You set it free. Oh, please don't hurt me!

finished-work-freeing-the-homunculus-eff.speaker: Homunculus
finished-work-freeing-the-homunculus-eff.text: Me not hurt. Now tell. What you plans? What you do with me?

finished-work-freeing-the-homunculus-eff.speaker: Effigy
finished-work-freeing-the-homunculus-eff.text: Please, we just wanted to experiment. We wanted to create life. There's a dungeon under the tower. Long ago we found a strange source of energy that we believe was left behind by the great Guthix. He used to

finished-work-freeing-the-homunculus-eff.speaker: Effigy
finished-work-freeing-the-homunculus-eff.text: create life with such ease. We realised we should be able to use this powerful substance, but we needed to bring together our magic along with the logical construction of the builders. It seemed through our experiments that

finished-work-freeing-the-homunculus-eff.speaker: Effigy
finished-work-freeing-the-homunculus-eff.text: even magic needs a certain level of rules and laws to work.

finished-work-freeing-the-homunculus-eff.speaker: Homunculus
finished-work-freeing-the-homunculus-eff.text: Bad play with. Naughty men. Go! Go, never return!

finished-work-freeing-the-homunculus-eff.speaker: Homunculus
finished-work-freeing-the-homunculus-eff.text: Me look dungeon, [player name]. Please meet there.

finished-work-finishing-off-talking-to-t.speaker: Homunculus
finished-work-finishing-off-talking-to-t.text: Me do know. Pleased you rescue.

finished-work-finishing-off-talking-to-t.player: My pleasure. So what is this place?

finished-work-finishing-off-talking-to-t.speaker: Homunculus
finished-work-finishing-off-talking-to-t.text: They use essence of Guthix power. Create tower pump this from ground. Make me with godly power. Dangerous.

finished-work-finishing-off-talking-to-t.player: Oh dear, but you're okay now. You have this place to reside in.

finished-work-finishing-off-talking-to-t.speaker: Homunculus
finished-work-finishing-off-talking-to-t.text: Thrank you. For reward you speak me, I makes monsters.

standard-dialogue.speaker: Town crier
standard-dialogue.text: Hello citizen!

options.text: What do you do around here?

steps.player: What do you do around here?

steps.speaker: Town crier
steps.text: I'm a Town Crier. It's my job to let people know of any recent news. After all, there's all sorts of things happening around here.

steps.player: I see. See you later.

steps.speaker: Town crier
steps.text: Until next time.

steps.player: See you later.

steps.speaker: Town crier
steps.text: Until next time.

historical-dialogue-regular-players.speaker: Town crier
historical-dialogue-regular-players.text: Hear ye! Hear ye! Player Moderators massive help to RuneSc-

historical-dialogue-regular-players.speaker: Town crier
historical-dialogue-regular-players.text: Oh, hello citizen. Are you here to find out about Player Moderators? Or perhaps would you like to know about the laws of the land?

steps.player: Tell me about Player Moderators.

steps.speaker: Town crier
steps.text: Of course. What would you like to know?

steps.player: What is a Player Moderator?

steps.speaker: Town crier
steps.text: Player Moderators are normal players of the game, just like you. However, since they have shown themselves to be trustworthy and active reporters, they have been invited by Jagex to monitor the game and

steps.speaker: Town crier
steps.text: take appropriate action when they see rule breaking. You can spot a Player Moderator in game by looking at the chat screen - when a Player Moderator speaks, a silver crown appears to the left of their name.

steps.speaker: Town crier
steps.text: Remember, if there's not silver crown there, they are not a Player Moderator!

steps.player: Thanks!

steps.speaker: Town crier
steps.text: Is there anything else you'd like to know?

steps.player: What can Player Moderators do?

steps.speaker: Town crier
steps.text: Player Moderators, or 'P-mods', have the ability to mute rule breakers and Jagex view their reports as a priority so that action is taken as quickly as possible. P- Mods also have access to the Player Moderator Centre.

steps.speaker: Town crier
steps.text: Within the Centre are tools to help them Moderate Old School RuneScape. These tools include dedicated forums, the Player Moderator Guidelines and the Player Moderator Code of Conduct.

steps.player: Thanks!

steps.speaker: Town crier
steps.text: Is there anything else you'd like to know?

options.text: How do I become a Player Moderator?

steps.player: How do I become a Player Moderator?

steps.speaker: Town crier
steps.text: Jagex picks players who spend their time and effort to help better the Old School RuneScape community. To increase your chances of becoming a Player Moderator:

steps.speaker: Town crier
steps.text: Keep your account secure! This is very important, as a player with poor security will never be a P-Mod. Read our Security Tips for more information.

steps.speaker: Town crier
steps.text: Play by the rules! The rules of Old School RuneScape are enforced for a reason, to make the game a fair and enjoyable environment for all.

steps.speaker: Town crier
steps.text: Report accurately! When Jagex consider an account for review they look for quality, not quantity. Ensure your reports are of a high quality by following the report guidelines.

steps.speaker: Town crier
steps.text: Be excellent to each other! Treat others as you would want to be treated yourself. Respect your fellow player.

steps.player: Thanks!

steps.speaker: Town crier
steps.text: Is there anything else you'd like to know?

options.text: What can Player Moderators not do?

steps.player: What can Player Moderators not do?

steps.speaker: Town crier
steps.text: P-Mods cannot ban your account - they can only report offences. Jagex then take action based on the evidence received. If you lose your password or get scammed by another player, P-Mods cannot help you

steps.speaker: Town crier
steps.text: get your account back. All they can do is recommend you to go to Customer Support. They cannot retrieve any items you may have lost and receive no free items from Jagex for helping moderate the game. They are

steps.speaker: Town crier
steps.text: players who give their efforts to help the community out of the goodness of their hearts! P-mods do not work for Jagex and so cannot make you a Moderator, or recommend other accounts to become moderators. If

steps.speaker: Town crier
steps.text: you wish to become a Moderator, please feel free to ask me how!

steps.player: Thanks!

steps.speaker: Town crier
steps.text: Is there anything else you'd like to know?

options.text: Tell me about the Rules of Conduct.

steps.player: Tell me about the Rules of Conduct.

steps.speaker: Town crier
steps.text: At once. Take a look at my book here...

options.text: Can you give me a handy tip please?

steps.player: Can you give me a handy tip please?

steps.speaker: Town crier
steps.text: Did you know most skills have right click 'Make-X' options to help you train faster?

steps.speaker: Town crier
steps.text: Make your recovery questions and answers hard to guess but easy to remember.

steps.speaker: Town crier
steps.text: Don't use your RuneScape password on other sites. Keep your account safe!

steps.speaker: Town crier
steps.text: If you think someone knows your password - change it!

steps.speaker: Town crier
steps.text: The squirrels! The squirrels are coming! Noooo, get them out of my head!

steps.speaker: Town crier
steps.text: Did you know you burn food less often on the range in Lumbridge castle than other ranges?

steps.speaker: Town crier
steps.text: Players can not trim armour. Don't fall for this popular scam!

steps.speaker: Town crier
steps.text: If you're lost and have no idea where to go, use the Home Teleport spell for free!

steps.speaker: Town crier
steps.text: If you see someone breaking the rules, report them!

steps.speaker: Town crier
steps.text: Did you know? Superheat Item means you never fail to smelt ore!

steps.speaker: Town crier
steps.text: Did you know that at high levels of Runecrafting you get more than one rune per essence?

steps.speaker: Town crier
steps.text: Never lend your items out unless you expect them not to come back.

steps.speaker: Town crier
steps.text: Never question a penguin.

steps.speaker: Town crier
steps.text: Melee armour actually gives you disadvantages when using magic attacks. It may be better to take off your armour entirely!

steps.speaker: Town crier
steps.text: Take time to check the second trade window carefully. Don't be scammed!

steps.speaker: Town crier
steps.text: Did you know having a bank pin can help secure your valuable items?

steps.speaker: Town crier
steps.text: Did you know that mithril equipment is very light?

steps.speaker: Town crier
steps.text: There are no cheats in RuneScape! Never visit websites promising otherwise!

steps.speaker: Town crier
steps.text: Jagex will never e-mail you. Do not believe any e-mails that claim to be from us.

steps.speaker: Town crier
steps.text: If you're stuck on a skill, talk to the Lumbridge Tutors for help and tips.

steps.speaker: Town crier
steps.text: Did you know that you can wear a shield with a crossbow?

steps.speaker: Town crier
steps.text: Beware of players trying to lure you into the wilderness. Your items cannot be returned if you lose them!

steps.speaker: Town crier
steps.text: Never tell your password to anyone, not even your best friend!

steps.speaker: Town crier
steps.text: Be careful when fighting wizards! Wearing heavy armour can lower your Magic resistance!

steps.speaker: Town crier
steps.text: Is there anything else you'd like to know?

historical-dialogue-player-moderators.speaker: Town crier
historical-dialogue-player-moderators.text: Hear ye! Hear ye! Player Moderators massive help to Rune... Oh great, a P-mod! I know all about the great job you guys do, would you like me to prove my extensive knowledge to you?!

options.text: Can you show me the Guidelines please?

steps.player: Can you show me the Guidelines please?

steps.speaker: Town crier
steps.text: Of course, but I can't let you keep it - I've only got a few copies!

options.text: Do you have a copy of the Code of Conduct?

steps.player: Do you have a copy of the Code of Conduct?

steps.speaker: Town crier
steps.text: Oh yes, but I can't let you keep it - I've only a few copies!

options.text: Can you give me a moderating tip please?

steps.player: Can you give me a moderating tip please?

steps.speaker: Town crier
steps.text: Add other Player Moderators to your friends list for quick advice and moral support in-game. It does help!

steps.speaker: Town crier
steps.text: To avoid reporting the wrong player, add an offender to your friends list, switch your public chat to friends and then use your right-click report from there. Easy!

steps.speaker: Town crier
steps.text: Did you know that Free-to-Play P-mods CAN visit the moderator forums, by logging into the regular forums at the top right hand side of the forum screen, despite it saying Members only.

steps.speaker: Town crier
steps.text: Don't be tempted to report anything you didn't see, no matter how much you trust the player who is informing you.

steps.speaker: Town crier
steps.text: Don't eat something messy when on a first date - it won't look good!

steps.speaker: Town crier
steps.text: Don't forget to add the mute if needed, before selecting the report category. This cuts down on those duplicate reports for one player.

steps.speaker: Town crier
steps.text: The forums are the best place to keep abreast of any procedure changes that might not yet be included in the Player Mod guidelines!

steps.speaker: Town crier
steps.text: Got players asking you to unban them or help them retrieve a stolen or hacked account? There's nothing you can do so just send them to the Customer Support Team. If they think you can help, send them to me; I'll

steps.speaker: Town crier
steps.text: put them straight!

steps.speaker: Town crier
steps.text: Have the P-Mod Oracle open in a separate window when playing Old School RuneScape - that way you'll always have the most up-to-date guidelines to hand!

steps.speaker: Town crier
steps.text: If the chat is scrolling too fast for you to see that suspect line you want to double check, just run up a ladder or to a quieter spot to stop the chat screen scrolling. Then you can scroll back and read that

steps.speaker: Town crier
steps.text: suspect line and judge the situation in your own time!

steps.speaker: Town crier
steps.text: If you're a new mod, don't forget to read the guidelines before you log into the game! If you've been a P-mod for a while, why not have another read of them to refresh your memory and to get up to date

steps.speaker: Town crier
steps.text: with any changes you may have missed!

steps.speaker: Town crier
steps.text: If you've got a player asking you questions about P- mods, feel free to send them to me; I can answer questions about P-mods for you!

steps.speaker: Town crier
steps.text: If you get harassed by a player in game, don't take it personally - the player is reacting to your silver crown, not to you!

steps.speaker: Town crier
steps.text: If you notice a player trying to buy something common for an extremely high price, look about and see if there's someone else selling the same item for a much lower price. Chances are they're team scamming. If so,

steps.speaker: Town crier
steps.text: write their names down and send your J-mod curators a query!

steps.speaker: Town crier
steps.text: If you see a player abusing a bug in game, there's no need to report the player, just submit a bug report via the in-game report form.

steps.speaker: Town crier
steps.text: An important part of being a P-mod is to act as an ambassador for the game. Keeping your cool even when faced with the rudest players goes a long way towards this!

steps.speaker: Town crier
steps.text: It's always better to report in secret. Telling a player that you are about to report them rarely makes you a friend, and can often lead to a player being offensive to you!

steps.speaker: Town crier
steps.text: Make sure you log out of the game and the forums whenever you leave your device. Don't allow others to see confidential info!

steps.speaker: Town crier
steps.text: Never answer questions if you feel the answer will breach confidentiality.

steps.speaker: Town crier
steps.text: The P-mod forums are your friend! They're the best place to talk to and meet other P-mods and are absolutely packed with useful advice!

steps.speaker: Town crier
steps.text: Remember, if in doubt, report without a mute! It's very frustrating not to be able to speak if you're innocent!

steps.speaker: Town crier
steps.text: Remember, if offensive language has been completely filtered out then there's no need to report or mute it!

steps.speaker: Town crier
steps.text: Think twice before applying that mute. Will it really prevent further damage from surrounding players?

steps.speaker: Town crier
steps.text: Use the Jagex PMod team if you need to - they're there to help!

steps.speaker: Town crier
steps.text: You'll be amazed how often a bit of humour can diffuse a potentially unpleasant situation, before it becomes too serious.

steps.speaker: Town crier
steps.text: Your J-mods are there to help you. If you ever need their advice, send them a query. They are always very happy to help. Don't be afraid to use them!

steps.speaker: Town crier
steps.text: Your Player Moderator identity must never be revealed on the regular Old School RuneScape forums. However, you're more than welcome to chat about all aspects of being a Player Moderator in the official

steps.speaker: Town crier
steps.text: Player Moderator forums!

steps.speaker: Town crier
steps.text: Is there anything else you'd like to know?

steps.player: No thanks.

options.text: What help do you give to non Player Moderators?

steps.player: You're very helpful to us Player Moderators, but what help do you give to non Player Moderators?

steps.speaker: Town crier
steps.text: Well now, let me see...

options.text: Tell me about the Rules of Conduct.
Can you give me a handy tip please?

battlefield-talking-to-commander-montai-.speaker: Commander Montai

battlefield-tracker-gnomes-tracker-gnome.speaker: Tracker gnome 1

battlefield-tracker-gnomes-tracker-gnome.speaker: Tracker gnome 3

options.text: Can you give me any farming advice?

steps.player: Can you give me any farming advice?

steps.npc: You can buy all the farming tools from farming shops, which can be found close to the allotments.
Applying compost to a patch will not only reduce the chance that your crops will get diseased, but you will also grow more crops to harvest.
Supercompost is far better than normal compost, but more expensive to make. You need to rot the right type of item; show me an item, and I'll tell you if it's super- compostable or not.
Don't just throw away your weeds after you've raked a patch - put them in a compost bin and make some compost.
The only way to cure a bush or tree of disease is to prune away the diseased leaves with a pair of secateurs. For all other crops I would just apply some plant-cure.
Vegetables, hops and flowers need constant watering - if you ignore my advice, you will sooner or later find yourself in possession of a dead farming patch.
There is a special patch for growing Belladonna - I believe that it is somewhere near Draynor Manor, where the ground is a tad 'unblessed'.
Bittercap mushrooms can only be grown in a special patch in Morytania, near the Mort Myre swamp. There the ground is especially dank and suited to growing poisonous fungii.
You can put up to five tomatoes, strawberries, apples, bananas or oranges into a fruit basket, although you can't have a mix in the same basket.
You can put up to ten potatoes, cabbages or onions in vegetable sacks, although you can't have a mix in the same sack.
If you want to make your own sacks and baskets you'll need to use the loom that's near the Farming shop in Falador. If you're good enough at crafting, that is.
Tree seeds must be grown in a plantpot of soil into a sapling, and then transferred to a tree patch to continue growing to adulthood.
You can fill plantpots with soil from any empty patch, if you have a gardening trowel.
You don't have to buy all your plantpots you know, you can make them yourself on a pottery wheel. If you're good enough at crafting, that is.
If you want to grow fruit trees you could try a few places: Catherby, Brimhaven, Gnome Stronghold and the Farming Guild all have fruit tree patches.

Hops are good for brewing ales. I believe there's a brewery up in Keldagrim somewhere, and I've heard rumours that a place called Phasmatys used to be good for that type of thing. 'Fore they all died, of course.

There are many Farming areas out there. I know of Elstan's area near Falador, Dantaera's area near Catherby, Kragen's area near Ardougne, Lyra's area in Morytania, Marisi's area in Hosidius and Alan's area in
the Farming Guild. That said, I'm sure there's plenty more that I don't know about.

steps.player: Can you sell me something?

steps.npc: That depends on whether I have it to sell. What is it that you're looking for?

steps.player: I'll come back another time.

getting-started-talking-to-kangai-mau.speaker: Kangai Mau
getting-started-talking-to-kangai-mau.text: Hello. I Kangai Mau of the Rantuki tribe.

options.text: And what are you doing in Brimhaven?

steps.player: And what are you doing in Brimhaven?

steps.speaker: Kangai Mau
steps.text: I looking for someone brave to go on important mission for me. Someone skilled in thievery and sneaking about. I am told I can find such people in Brimhaven.

steps.player: Tell me of this mission.

steps.speaker: Kangai Mau
steps.text: I need someone to go on a mission to the city of Ardougne. There you will find the house of Lord Handelmort. In his house he has our tribal totem.

steps.speaker: Kangai Mau
steps.text: We need it back.

steps.player: Why does he have it?

steps.speaker: Kangai Mau
steps.text: Lord Handelmort is an Ardougnese explorer which means he think he have the right to come to my tribal home, steal our stuff and put in his private museum.

steps.prompt: Start The Tribal Totem quest?

steps.player: Ok, I will get it back.

steps.speaker: Kangai Mau
steps.text: Best of luck with that adventurer.

steps.player: How can I find Handelmort's house? Ardougne is a big place...

steps.speaker: Kangai Mau
steps.text: I don't know Ardougne. You tell me.

steps.player: Well good luck with that.

steps.speaker: Kangai Mau
steps.text: Let's hope I find some help soon.

steps.player: I'm in search of adventure!

steps.speaker: Kangai Mau
steps.text: Adventure is something I may be able to give.

steps.speaker: Kangai Mau
steps.text: I need someone to go on a mission to the city of Ardougne. There you will find the house of Lord Handelmort. In his house he has our tribal totem.

steps.player: Who are the Rantuki tribe?

steps.speaker: Kangai Mau
steps.text: A proud and noble tribe of Karamja. But now we are few, as men come from across sea, steal our land, and settle on our hunting grounds.

steps.player: And what are you doing in Brimhaven?

getting-started-talking-to-horacio.speaker: Horacio
getting-started-talking-to-horacio.text: It's a fine day to be out in the garden isn't it?

steps.player: Yes, it's very nice.

steps.speaker: Horacio
steps.text: Days like these make me glad to be alive!

steps.player: So... who are you?

steps.speaker: Horacio
steps.text: My name is Horacio Dobson. I'm the gardener to Lord Handelmort. Take a look around this beautiful garden, all of this is my handiwork.

options.text: So... do you garden round the back too?

steps.player: So... do you garden round the back too?

steps.speaker: Horacio
steps.text: That I do!

steps.player: Doesn't all of the security around the house get in your way then?

steps.speaker: Horacio
steps.text: Ah, I'm used to all that. I have my keys, the guard dogs know me, and I know the combination to the door lock. It's rather easy, it's his middle name.

steps.player: Whose middle name?

steps.speaker: Horacio
steps.text: Hum. I probably shouldn't have said that. Forget I mentioned it.

steps.player: Do you need any help?

steps.speaker: Horacio
steps.text: Trying to muscle in on my job eh? I'm more than happy to do this all by myself!

investigating-the-gpdt-depot-investigati.text: There is a label on this crate. It says;
Senior Patents Clerk, Chamber of Invention, The Wizards' Tower, Misthalin. The crate is securely fastened shut and ready for delivery.
You can see the gluey outline from where you peeled the address label off.

investigating-the-gpdt-depot-talking-to-.speaker: Wizard Cromperty
investigating-the-gpdt-depot-talking-to-.text: Hello there. My name is Cromperty. I am a Wizard, and an inventor.

investigating-the-gpdt-depot-talking-to-.speaker: Wizard Cromperty
investigating-the-gpdt-depot-talking-to-.text: You must be [player name]. My good friend Sedridor has told me about you. As both wizard and inventor, he has aided me in my great invention!

options.text: Two jobs? That's got to be tough.

steps.player: So what have you invented?

steps.speaker: Wizard Cromperty
steps.text: Ah! My latest invention is my patent pending teleportation block! It emits a low level magical signal, that will allow me to locate it anywhere in the world, and teleport anything

steps.speaker: Wizard Cromperty
steps.text: directly to it! I hope to revolutionise the entire teleportation system! Don't you think I'm great? Uh, I mean it's great?

options.text: So where is the other block?

steps.player: So where is the other block?

steps.speaker: Wizard Cromperty
steps.text: Well... Hmm. I would guess somewhere between here and the Wizards' Tower in Misthalin. All I know is that it hasn't got there yet as the wizards there would have contacted me.

steps.speaker: Wizard Cromperty
steps.text: I'm using the GPDT for delivery. They assured me it would be delivered promptly.

steps.player: Who are the GPDT?

steps.speaker: Wizard Cromperty
steps.text: The Gielinor Parcel Delivery Team. They come very highly recommended. Their motto is: 'We aim to deliver your stuff at some point after you have paid us!'

steps.player: Can I be teleported please?

steps.speaker: Wizard Cromperty
steps.text: By all means! I'm afraid I can't give you any specifics as to where you will come out however. Presumably wherever the other block is located.

options.text: Yes, that sounds good. Teleport me!

steps.player: Yes, that sounds good. Teleport me!

steps.speaker: Wizard Cromperty
steps.text: Okey dokey! Ready?

steps.speaker: Wizard Cromperty
steps.text: Dipsolum sententa sententi!
(The player gets teleported to the GDPT Depot.)

options.text: That sounds dangerous. Leave me here.

steps.player: That sounds dangerous. Leave me here.

steps.speaker: Wizard Cromperty
steps.text: As you wish.

steps.player: Well done, that's very clever.

steps.speaker: Wizard Cromperty
steps.text: Yes it is isn't it? Forgive me for feeling a little smug, this is a major breakthrough in the field of teleportation!

options.text: Can you teleport me to the Rune Essence?

investigating-the-gpdt-depot-using-the-a.text: You carefully place the delivery address label over the existing label, covering it completely.

investigating-the-gpdt-depot-using-the-a.player: Now I just need someone to deliver it for me.

investigating-the-gpdt-depot-using-the-a.text: You have already replaced the delivery address label.

investigating-the-gpdt-depot-investing-t.text: There is a label on this crate. It says;
To Lord Handelmort, Handelmort Mansion, Ardougne.

options.text: So, when are you going to deliver this crate?

steps.player: So, when are you going to deliver this crate?

steps.speaker: GPDT employee
steps.text: Well... I guess we could do it now...

options.text: Thank you, it's interesting in here.

steps.player: Thank you, it's interesting in here.

steps.speaker: GPDT employee
steps.text: We're the premier delivery service in ALL of Gielinor!
This combination is incorrect.
The combination seems correct!

inside-the-mansion-climbing-the-stairs-w.text: As you climb the stairs you hear a click...
You have fallen through a trap!

inside-the-mansion-investigating-the-sta.text: Your trained senses as a thief enable you to see that there is a trap in these stairs. You make a note of its location for future reference when using these stairs.

inside-the-mansion-searching-the-chest-w.text: Inside the chest you find the tribal totem.

returning-back-to-kangai-mau.speaker: Kangai Mau
returning-back-to-kangai-mau.text: Have you got our totem back?

steps.player: No, it's not that easy.

steps.text: Bah, you no good.

returning-back-to-kangai-mau.text: If the player has the totem in their inventory:

steps.speaker: Kangai Mau
steps.text: You have??? Many thanks brave adventurer! Here, have some freshly cooked Karamjan fish, caught specially by my tribe.
You hand over the Tribal Totem.

steps.npc: Greetings, traveller. Are you interested in any throwing weapons?

steps.npc: That is a good thing.

steps.text: As a member of the Phoenix Gang and after Heroes' Quest:
He doesn't seem interested in talking to you.

steps.npc: Ho, [Fremennik name]! The brave warrior returns!

steps.player: It was a hard-fought battle, but we Fremennik prevailed!

steps.npc: I expect we'll be hearing songs about the 'Slayer of the Troll King' for many years to come.

steps.player: It would be an honour to be remembered in such a way! Thanks.

getting-started-talking-to-ug.speaker: Ug
getting-started-talking-to-ug.text: Ahhh, it no use, I too sad!

options.text: Awww, you poor troll. What seems to be the problem?

steps.player: Awww, you poor troll. What seems to be the problem?

steps.speaker: Ug
steps.text: I love Aga, she so beautiful, she smell so nice, like rotting dead ice wolf!

steps.speaker: Ug
steps.text: But Arrg that... arrrrrg! He together with Aga and he much stronger than Ug. He rip Ug apart!

steps.player: Who is Aga?

steps.speaker: Ug
steps.text: She most beautiful troll in world.

steps.speaker: Ug
steps.text: Ug want to marry Aga, but she with Arrg!

steps.player: Don't worry now, I'll see what I can do.

steps.speaker: Ug
steps.text: You help Ug? You nice, maybe Ug not eat you!

steps.player: Errrr... thanks... I think?
I will go and talk to Aga.
A crying troll who's in love?! This just gets better and better!
Hahahahaha... a crying Troll.
I bet all the other trolls laugh at you!

steps.speaker: Ug
steps.text: Go away, man-thing, leave Ug alone!

steps.player: Hahahahaa!
Well... you're big and hairy?

steps.speaker: Aga
steps.text: Thanks, me very careful about looks!

steps.player: Errr...

options.text: So... how's your... um... love life?

steps.player: (I can't believe I am asking a troll about her love life!!)
So... how's your... um... love life?

steps.speaker: Aga
steps.text: It ok, I with Arrg, he very strong and mighty but sometimes...

steps.speaker: Aga
steps.text: I not know if he love Aga, He say he will show he love by bringing me flower Trollweiss.

steps.speaker: Aga
steps.text: It a very rare, beautiful flower, it very special!

steps.speaker: Aga
steps.text: It grow somewhere in these mountains.

steps.player: (Maybe trolls DO have a romantic streak!)
And Arrg said he would get you the flower?

steps.speaker: Aga
steps.text: He very strong, if he love Aga he will get Trollweiss.

options.text: So... what do you think about Ug?

steps.player: So... what do you think about Ug?

steps.speaker: Aga

steps.player: You know that wimpy, crying... nevermind.
Errr... I've got to go.

getting-started-talking-to-aga-again.speaker: Aga

options.text: Well, got to go... see you.

steps.player: Errr... I've got to go.

options.text: So... what do you think about Ug?

getting-started-talking-to-arrg.player: Ehh, Excuse me... Mr. Troll, sir,

options.text: How did you grow so big and strong?

steps.player: How did you grow so big and strong?

steps.speaker: Arrg
steps.text: Get away from Arrg, puny man-maggot. Or you lunch!

options.text: Your girlfriend said you know where to find Trollweiss?

steps.player: Your girlfriend said you know where to find Trollweiss?

steps.speaker: Arrg
steps.text: Girlfriend? Which one?

steps.player: Errr... Aga.

steps.speaker: Arrg
steps.text: Yes, she good cook and wash but talk too many. Arrg strong troll, Arrg mighty troll, Arrg have many girlfriends!

steps.player: (What a jerk!)
Yes, yes, you're great, but what about the Trollweiss?

steps.speaker: Arrg
steps.text: I no know, I just say to make Aga shut up!

steps.player: So you don't actually know where to find the Trollweiss?
Great...
I've got to go.

getting-started-returning-to-ug.player: Yes, she said that she really wants a certain flower! Trollweiss, I think she called it.

getting-started-returning-to-ug.speaker: Ug
getting-started-returning-to-ug.text: Oh no! Then Ug no chance, Trollweiss not found in years!

getting-started-returning-to-ug.player: Don't worry I'll find it for you!

getting-started-returning-to-ug.speaker: Ug
getting-started-returning-to-ug.text: You no chance, Ug no chance, need someone who live whole life in mountains. Ug no know anyone like that...

options.text: Can I buy some Climbing boots?
How did you find out about the secret way?
Do you know where I can find Trollweiss?

steps.player: Do you know where I can find Trollweiss?

steps.speaker: Tenzing
steps.text: It has been a long time since someone has asked me about Trollweiss.

steps.speaker: Tenzing
steps.text: In the old days Trollweiss could be found all over the mountains, but recently it has been disappearing!

steps.speaker: Tenzing
steps.text: There is one place, where I am sure it still grows, but it is impossible to get to.

steps.player: Nothing's impossible, if you put your mind to it!

steps.speaker: Tenzing
steps.text: Ahhh, the youth of today. So sure of their prowess. But who am I to stop you from walking into your doom, if that is what you wish to do!

steps.player: Spare me with the lectures and tell me where to find this flower!

steps.speaker: Tenzing
steps.text: Well, you will need to enter the domain of the ice trolls! This is an area full of wicked beasts and biting cold. From there you will find a way down a slope to a plateau where the Trollweiss grows.

steps.speaker: Tenzing
steps.text: It used to be easy to get to this plateau, but it is now snowed over and virtually inaccessible. That's global warming for you!

steps.player: There must be a way to get there.

steps.speaker: Tenzing
steps.text: There is maybe one thing...

steps.player: Go on.

steps.speaker: Tenzing
steps.text: If you could make some sort of sled, you could probably get down there but I don't know where that would lead you, as you will not be able to go up the mountain again.

options.text: That doesn't sound like a very good idea to me!

steps.player: That doesn't sound like a very good idea to me!

steps.speaker: Tenzing
steps.text: Pah, who are you to talk? Without me you would never have found the secret path to the plateau!!

options.text: What would I need to make such a sled?

steps.player: What would I need to make such a sled?

steps.speaker: Tenzing
steps.text: Well, I'm no expert. Maybe you should speak to someone who knows more about such technical stuff.

steps.player: Like who?

steps.speaker: Tenzing
steps.text: Why don't you ask Dunstan. He's always helped me with my spiked boots.

steps.player: Thank you very much for the information.
I've got to go.

steps.speaker: Tenzing
steps.text: See you later

steps.player: Hi!

steps.speaker: Dunstan
steps.text: Hi! Did you want something?

options.text: Can you put some spikes on my Climbing boots?

steps.player: I need a sled!!

steps.speaker: Dunstan
steps.text: Haha, very funny! Aren't you a bit old for rolling around in the snow?

steps.player: Yes.

steps.speaker: Dunstan
steps.text: So why do you need a sled then?

steps.player: I need the sled to get to a certain location in the mountains.
No.

steps.speaker: Dunstan
steps.text: Hahahaha.

steps.player: No, I actually still like rolling around in the snow.

steps.speaker: Dunstan
steps.text: Well, I guess some of us never grow up!

steps.player: I need the sled to get to a certain location in the mountains.

steps.speaker: Dunstan
steps.text: Well, since you've helped my family out a couple of times, I'd be glad to build a sled for you.

steps.speaker: Dunstan
steps.text: Let me think...

steps.speaker: Dunstan
steps.text: Yeah, that should do it. I will need some yew or maple logs, a bar of iron and some rope.

steps.speaker: Dunstan
steps.text: I should have my designs ready by the time you have brought me all the materials.

options.text: Is it OK if I use your anvil?

steps.player: Nothing, thanks.

steps.speaker: Dunstan
steps.text: Have you got all the materials for the sled yet?

steps.player: No, I haven't got everything yet.

steps.speaker: Dunstan
steps.text: Well, unfortunately I can't make the sled without all the materials.

options.text: Can you put some spikes on my Climbing boots?
How is your son getting on?
Is it OK if I use your anvil?

steps.speaker: Dunstan
steps.text: Have you got all the materials for the sled yet?

steps.player: Yes, I have all the materials for the sled.

steps.text: Dunstan takes the materials and some of his tools and starts making a sled. After a while Dunstan hands you a finished sled.

steps.speaker: Dunstan
steps.text: Well, here's the sled but it will need to be waxed. The wax will need to both protect the sled as well as smoothen it.

steps.speaker: Dunstan
steps.text: Maybe if you mix some wax with a bit of swamp tar it will achieve the desired effect. You'll also need something to store the wax in... like a cake tin.

options.text: Where can I get wax from?

steps.player: Where can I get wax from?

steps.speaker: Dunstan
steps.text: I don't know. I'm a smith! But maybe you should look for some bees.

options.text: Where can I get swamp tar from?

steps.player: Where can I get swamp tar from?

steps.speaker: Dunstan
steps.text: The swamp of course! It's south of Lumbridge.

steps.player: What else do I need?

steps.speaker: Dunstan

options.text: I am here to kill you!

steps.speaker: Arrg

returning-to-ug-talking-to-arrg-after-de.speaker: Arrg
returning-to-ug-talking-to-arrg-after-de.text: Oh mighty man-warrior, please no hurt Arrg.

returning-to-ug-talking-to-ug-after-defe.speaker: Ug

returning-to-ug-talking-to-ug-after-defe.speaker: Ug
returning-to-ug-talking-to-ug-after-defe.text: Whaaat? Man-thing want to die? Ug no scared of you or your grandmother! Ug show you. Ug go to Aga now.

options.text: How goes your fight with the trolls?

steps.text: We were ambushed by trolls coming from the north. They captured Dunstan's son, Godric, who we enlisted at your request; we tried to follow but we were repelled at the foot of their stronghold.
