commorb-files-playback-solus-observation.text: Solus approaches Lord Daquarius, who is guarded by two Black Knights.

commorb-files-playback-solus-observation.speaker: Solus Dellagar
commorb-files-playback-solus-observation.text: Still festering in your pathetic little dungeon, I see.

commorb-files-playback-solus-observation.speaker: Lord Daquarius
commorb-files-playback-solus-observation.text: I thought you dead many moons past...

commorb-files-playback-solus-observation.speaker: Lord Daquarius
commorb-files-playback-solus-observation.text: You know you are not welcome here.

commorb-files-playback-solus-observation.speaker: Solus Dellagar
commorb-files-playback-solus-observation.text: Now is that any way to talk to a fellow Zamorakian?

commorb-files-playback-solus-observation.speaker: Lord Daquarius
commorb-files-playback-solus-observation.text: You are not a Zamorakian! You worship nothing but your own selfish greed.

commorb-files-playback-solus-observation.speaker: Solus Dellagar
commorb-files-playback-solus-observation.text: Such mistrust of your forgotten ally!

commorb-files-playback-solus-observation.speaker: Solus Dellagar
commorb-files-playback-solus-observation.text: Why did I ever leave these lands?

commorb-files-playback-solus-observation.speaker: Lord Daquarius
commorb-files-playback-solus-observation.text: You left because your own stupidity brought the wrath of the Temple Knights upon you.

commorb-files-playback-solus-observation.speaker: Lord Daquarius
commorb-files-playback-solus-observation.text: Now I ask you a final time before I draw my blade:

commorb-files-playback-solus-observation.speaker: Solus Dellagar
commorb-files-playback-solus-observation.text: I just thought you would like to know that I have returned as your new master.

commorb-files-playback-solus-observation.speaker: Lord Daquarius
commorb-files-playback-solus-observation.text: The Kinshra are not your personal soldiers Solus!

commorb-files-playback-solus-observation.speaker: Lord Daquarius
commorb-files-playback-solus-observation.text: I will not waste any of my warriors in your foolish schemes!

commorb-files-playback-solus-observation.speaker: Solus Dellagar
commorb-files-playback-solus-observation.text: And is that your final answer Daquarius?

commorb-files-playback-solus-observation.speaker: Lord Daquarius
commorb-files-playback-solus-observation.text: Or there will be blood shed between us.

commorb-files-playback-solus-observation.speaker: Solus Dellagar
commorb-files-playback-solus-observation.text: Have you forgotten just who I am?
Solus casts Ice Barrage, killing the two Black Knights next to Lord Daquarius, and leaving him barely alive.

commorb-files-playback-solus-observation.speaker: Solus Dellagar
commorb-files-playback-solus-observation.text: I won't have to remind you of my power again next time!

commorb-files-playback-solus-observation.speaker: Solus Dellagar
commorb-files-playback-solus-observation.text: Make sure you are more prepared to follow orders next time I come to your little Taverley hideout!

commorb-files-playback-solus-observation.speaker: Lord Daquarius
commorb-files-playback-solus-observation.text: I swear... in the name of *cough* Zamorak... I will see you rot for this Solus...
Solus teleports to the Chaos altar in the middle of Varrock.

commorb-files-playback-solus-observation.speaker: Solus Dellagar
commorb-files-playback-solus-observation.text: A shrine to Zamorak in the middle of Varrock?

commorb-files-playback-solus-observation.speaker: Solus Dellagar
commorb-files-playback-solus-observation.text: I assume my reputation precedes me!

commorb-files-playback-solus-observation.speaker: Mage of Zamorak
commorb-files-playback-solus-observation.text: I have no riches, I am but a magical researcher...

commorb-files-playback-solus-observation.speaker: Solus Dellagar
commorb-files-playback-solus-observation.text: My dear fellow, if I wanted you dead, you ALREADY WOULD BE!

commorb-files-playback-solus-observation.speaker: Mage of Zamorak
commorb-files-playback-solus-observation.text: I... I don't know w-what you want Solus, but whatever it is, please, just t-take it and leave, please...

commorb-files-playback-solus-observation.speaker: Solus Dellagar
commorb-files-playback-solus-observation.text: Well I am particularly interested in your brains at the moment!

commorb-files-playback-solus-observation.speaker: Solus Dellagar
commorb-files-playback-solus-observation.text: But you wouldn't want me taking those and leaving, now would you?

commorb-files-playback-solus-observation.speaker: Solus Dellagar
commorb-files-playback-solus-observation.text: I am interested in your research!

commorb-files-playback-solus-observation.speaker: Mage of Zamorak
commorb-files-playback-solus-observation.text: I c-cannot let you have my research, it is being done in order to assist my lord Zamorak...

commorb-files-playback-solus-observation.speaker: Solus Dellagar
commorb-files-playback-solus-observation.text: But he is not here, is he?
The Mage of Zamorak attempts to teleport away, but Solus stops him with a spell that teleblocks and binds him.

commorb-files-playback-solus-observation.speaker: Solus Dellagar
commorb-files-playback-solus-observation.text: You are going nowhere just yet sir

commorb-files-playback-solus-observation.speaker: Mage of Zamorak
commorb-files-playback-solus-observation.text: I meant no disrespect Solus, please do not kill me...

commorb-files-playback-solus-observation.speaker: Solus Dellagar
commorb-files-playback-solus-observation.text: If I killed you then you would no longer continue with your most interesting research!

commorb-files-playback-solus-observation.speaker: Solus Dellagar
commorb-files-playback-solus-observation.text: No, I will be content with simply taking your money sir!

commorb-files-playback-solus-observation.speaker: Solus Dellagar
commorb-files-playback-solus-observation.text: Well, a most productive trip on all accounts!

lord-daquarius.speaker: Lord Daquarius
lord-daquarius.text: What want you, with the Lord of the Kinshra? Speak!

lord-daquarius.player: I am here on behalf of the White Knights...

lord-daquarius.speaker: Lord Daquarius
lord-daquarius.text: Pah! Begone, fool, or prepare to taste my blade!

lord-daquarius.player: Now wait a minute, this concerns a friend of yours...

lord-daquarius.speaker: Lord Daquarius
lord-daquarius.text: A friend of mine? What friend of mine would the Temple Knights show any intere-

lord-daquarius.speaker: Lord Daquarius
lord-daquarius.text: Oh. This... This is about Solus, isn't it?

lord-daquarius.speaker: Lord Daquarius
lord-daquarius.text: Then let me assure you, that monster is no 'friend' of mine - if indeed such a creature even has 'friends'!

lord-daquarius.speaker: Lord Daquarius
lord-daquarius.text: No, that man is certainly no friend of mine nor of the Kinshra.

lord-daquarius.player: So you will help me find him?

lord-daquarius.speaker: Lord Daquarius
lord-daquarius.text: No fool... You and your White Knight cronies are no friend of the Kinshra either.

lord-daquarius.speaker: Lord Daquarius
lord-daquarius.text: I will help neither of you, and I wish you all a slow and painful death.

lord-daquarius.player: You know... I'm sure I could MAKE you tell me where he is...

lord-daquarius.speaker: Lord Daquarius
lord-daquarius.text: Is that a threat, whelp? Do your worst. I care not for my own life, I stand only for the protection of the Kinshra!

lord-daquarius.speaker: Savant
lord-daquarius.text: [player name]? I've been monitoring you. He's telling the truth, so don't try to bluff him by starting a fight.

lord-daquarius.speaker: Savant
lord-daquarius.text: All of our records show that the only thing he will make a stand for is the protection of his men, and he has little regard for his own safety in comparison.

lord-daquarius.speaker: Savant
lord-daquarius.text: You're going to have to find some other way to intimidate him into giving you the information we need.

lord-daquarius-talking-to-lord-daquarius.speaker: Lord Daquarius
lord-daquarius-talking-to-lord-daquarius.text: What want you, with the Lord of the Kinshra? Speak!

lord-daquarius-talking-to-lord-daquarius.player: I still want to know the whereabouts of Solus Dellagar!

lord-daquarius-talking-to-lord-daquarius.speaker: Lord Daquarius
lord-daquarius-talking-to-lord-daquarius.text: Well you will not hear that from me, White Knight dog!

lord-daquarius-talking-to-lord-daquarius.speaker: Lord Daquarius
lord-daquarius-talking-to-lord-daquarius.text: And you can threaten me all you want, I care for nothing in this world save the welfare of my Kinshra brothers!

lord-daquarius-after-killing-a-black-kni.speaker: Lord Daquarius
lord-daquarius-after-killing-a-black-kni.text: Stop! I will tell you what you want! Please... leave my men be...

lord-daquarius-talking-to-lord-daquarius.speaker: Lord Daquarius
lord-daquarius-talking-to-lord-daquarius.text: What want you, with the Lord of the Kinshra? Speak!

lord-daquarius-talking-to-lord-daquarius.player: Okay Daquarius, you tell me the whereabouts of Solus Dellagar right now, or I will put every Black Knight here to their death in front of you!

lord-daquarius-talking-to-lord-daquarius.speaker: Lord Daquarius
lord-daquarius-talking-to-lord-daquarius.text: sigh* I should have known the White Knights would be my ruin once again...

lord-daquarius-talking-to-lord-daquarius.speaker: Lord Daquarius
lord-daquarius-talking-to-lord-daquarius.text: I do not know his exact whereabouts, and when last we met we did not leave... on the best of terms.

lord-daquarius-talking-to-lord-daquarius.speaker: Lord Daquarius
lord-daquarius-talking-to-lord-daquarius.text: All I know is that he left behind some fur when he left, I would expect him to be in an area with furred creatures of some sort.

lord-daquarius-talking-to-lord-daquarius.player: What kind of fur? Dog? Bear? Wolf?

lord-daquarius-talking-to-lord-daquarius.speaker: Lord Daquarius
lord-daquarius-talking-to-lord-daquarius.text: I do not know, I am a warrior, not a zookeeper. It was not bear fur, I know that much.

lord-daquarius-talking-to-lord-daquarius.player: That's it? That's your help? You'd better not be lying Daquarius, or...

lord-daquarius-talking-to-lord-daquarius.speaker: Savant
lord-daquarius-talking-to-lord-daquarius.text: Calm yourself [player name], he is telling the truth.

lord-daquarius-talking-to-lord-daquarius.speaker: Savant
lord-daquarius-talking-to-lord-daquarius.text: I am monitoring your conversation through the CommOrb, his physiology shows none of the changes we usually get when someone lies to us.

lord-daquarius-talking-to-lord-daquarius.player: So this CommOrb thing can work as a lie-detector? That's pretty useful!

lord-daquarius-talking-to-lord-daquarius.speaker: Savant
lord-daquarius-talking-to-lord-daquarius.text: Yes, it is, but back to the task at hand. I suggest you head to the next subject of our observations, he might be more help in locating Solus.

lord-daquarius-talking-to-lord-daquarius.player: You mean that Zamorakian mage in Varrock?

lord-daquarius-talking-to-lord-daquarius.speaker: Savant
lord-daquarius-talking-to-lord-daquarius.text: Yes, he would seem a likely bet. Savant out.

lord-daquarius-talking-to-lord-daquarius.speaker: Lord Daquarius
lord-daquarius-talking-to-lord-daquarius.text: What want you, with the Lord of the Kinshra? Speak!

lord-daquarius-talking-to-lord-daquarius.player: Okay Daquarius, tell me all that you know of Solus, or I will kill some more Black Knights!

lord-daquarius-talking-to-lord-daquarius.speaker: Lord Daquarius
lord-daquarius-talking-to-lord-daquarius.text: I have already told you, I know nothing except that he left some fur behind.

lord-daquarius-talking-to-lord-daquarius.speaker: Lord Daquarius
lord-daquarius-talking-to-lord-daquarius.text: Now leave me and my men be, or it will be the worse for you!

zamorakian-mage.prompt: What would you like to talk about?

steps.player: I am looking for information about a very dangerous man... I believe he visited you quite recently.

steps.speaker: Mage of Zamorak
steps.text: Ah, you mean that accursed Solus!

steps.player: Yes, him. I need to find him and make sure he doesn't come back to these lands.

steps.speaker: Mage of Zamorak
steps.text: You are working for the Temple Knights, correct?

steps.speaker: Mage of Zamorak
steps.text: No, don't deny it, I recognise the magical signature of your Communication Orb, a very nice piece of equipment indeed.

steps.speaker: Mage of Zamorak
steps.text: I will tell you what I know in exchange for it, I believe such a device could be very useful to my research...

steps.speaker: Savant
steps.text: [player name], I've been monitoring your conversation; You can't let him have Temple Knight equipment, he is a Zamorakian!

steps.speaker: Savant
steps.text: Even if we wanted to let the Z.M.I. have access to our research, the built in security magics would destroy it before trading anyway!

steps.player: Sorry, I cannot trade you my Communications Orb...

steps.speaker: Mage of Zamorak
steps.text: Ah well, it was worth a try, but I did not seriously expect you to part with it.

steps.player: Then perhaps you will be willing to trade something else for your information...?

steps.speaker: Mage of Zamorak
steps.text: I have little information, and would give it freely to make sure Solus is... disposed of... but unfortunately I am somewhat... financially distraught at the moment due to a recent... incident.

steps.player: You mean Solus robbed you of all of your money?

steps.speaker: Mage of Zamorak
steps.text: ...Yes. He took a large degree of my research into various things as well, but my research is inside my mind and easily replaceable, the money I possessed was essential

steps.speaker: Mage of Zamorak
steps.text: for my experimentation, and as I have no real skills to speak of, is not so easily replacable...

steps.player: You want me to pay you for information?

steps.speaker: Mage of Zamorak
steps.text: No... not as such. You know of the substance known as 'rune essence' yes?

steps.speaker: Mage of Zamorak
steps.text: A small number of those will allow me to create runes from them, which I may then sell and get myself back on my feet.

steps.speaker: Mage of Zamorak
steps.text: Twenty parts of rune essence is my price for my information. You may take it or leave it...

steps.speaker: Savant
steps.text: Hi [player name], it sounds like a pretty good deal for this kind of information to me, but it's your call. We REALLY need to find Solus as soon as possible though, who knows what kind of damage he might cause

steps.speaker: Savant
steps.text: now he is at large again!

steps.player: Okay, I'll see what I can do.

zamorakian-mage-the-essence-deal.player: So you have information about the whereabouts of Solus Dellagar?

zamorakian-mage-the-essence-deal.speaker: Mage of Zamorak
zamorakian-mage-the-essence-deal.text: I do indeed. My price for this information is 20 pieces of rune essence.
If the player does not have essence:

steps.player: Okay. I'll go get those for you then.

zamorakian-mage-the-essence-deal.text: If the player has less than 20 essence:

steps.player: I have some essences with me, if you would take those...?

steps.speaker: Mage of Zamorak
steps.text: I will not haggle with you on my price. 20 Rune essences, and not a single essence less.

steps.player: Okay, I'll go get those for you then.
I have your essences right here, take them.
Okay, now you have your essence, give me my information.

steps.speaker: Mage of Zamorak
steps.text: Certainly. As I say, I have little information, but the cost was not too dear, was it?

steps.player: Get on with it, I haven't got all day to waste.

steps.speaker: Mage of Zamorak
steps.text: As you wish. As a powerful magician, I could sense his aura once I had encountered him, and it definitely moved East of here when he left me.

steps.player: He went East. That's it? That's your 'information'?

steps.speaker: Mage of Zamorak
steps.text: I am sorry I cannot be more specific, but that is all of the information I have to offer...

steps.speaker: Savant
steps.text: Okay, so Daquarius told us he was probably somewhere with furry animals of some kind, and this mage has told us that he is East of here...

steps.speaker: Savant
steps.text: Any ideas? Frankly, I'm stumped. I just don't have enough information to work out where he might be...

steps.player: Hmmm. Wolf fur... and the East... I know where he is.

steps.speaker: Savant
steps.text: You do?

steps.player: He will be in Canifis. He must be.

steps.speaker: Savant
steps.text: Wow, that's some good thinking [player name]! Okay, let's head there and get him!

zamorakian-mage-talking-to-the-mage-of-z.prompt: What would you like to talk about?

steps.player: Okay, now you have your essence, give me my information.

approaching-canifis.speaker: Savant
approaching-canifis.text: Okay [player name], I'm going to begin a low level scan for Solus now...

approaching-canifis.speaker: Savant
approaching-canifis.text: Hmmm... These readings are very strange...

approaching-canifis.speaker: Savant
approaching-canifis.text: There's... SOMETHING here... You know, I'm sure I've seen readings like this somewhere before...

approaching-canifis.speaker: Savant
approaching-canifis.text: Just give me a minute to cross reference the records in the Library, I KNOW that I've seen readings like this before...

approaching-canifis.speaker: Savant
approaching-canifis.text: GAH! This is infuriating! It's on the tip of my tongue...

approaching-canifis.player: Well, that Zamorakian mage mentioned that he had a strong magical aura, perhaps that is it?

approaching-canifis.speaker: Savant
approaching-canifis.text: No... no, it is something...

approaching-canifis.speaker: Savant
approaching-canifis.text: Oh my! I know what it is!

approaching-canifis.speaker: Savant
approaching-canifis.text: Many years ago the Temple Knights were studying teleportation techniques, and found a strange dimension that was accessed when teleporting..

approaching-canifis.speaker: Savant
approaching-canifis.text: We stopped the research as it was too dangerous to be practically useful, but our initial studies showed that we could use the entire dimension as a kind of scrying glass to see a precise point where we wished to teleport

approaching-canifis.speaker: Savant
approaching-canifis.text: to, then teleport extremely slowly between two points.

approaching-canifis.player: How is teleporting really slowly particularly useful?

approaching-canifis.speaker: Savant
approaching-canifis.text: Well, basically, you are stretched so thinly between dimensions that you effectively become invisible!

approaching-canifis.speaker: Savant
approaching-canifis.text: From your perspective you can see three places simultaneously, and can choose to move between all three at will!

approaching-canifis.speaker: Savant
approaching-canifis.text: Let me give you an example: If you were in Falador castle, and you wished to teleport to Varrock, then you could use this 'slow- teleport' technique to be in both places simultaneously,

approaching-canifis.speaker: Savant
approaching-canifis.text: but invisible to anyone in either.

approaching-canifis.speaker: Savant
approaching-canifis.text: You could also move freely between the two invisibly and then choose which place you wished to end up, simply by concentrating on the location you wanted to appear in.

approaching-canifis.speaker: Savant
approaching-canifis.text: Needless to say, in our line of work this could come in very handy for sneaking around unobserved...

approaching-canifis.player: But you abandoned this research? Why?

approaching-canifis.speaker: Savant
approaching-canifis.text: It is far too dangerous. In my example I only used two places, but in practice there is a third place involved. It is a strange, empty dimension that teleports seem to

approaching-canifis.speaker: Savant
approaching-canifis.text: pass through.

approaching-canifis.speaker: Savant
approaching-canifis.text: Frankly, the human mind isn't equipped to cope with processing so much information simultaneously, and the test subjects started to display... behavioural problems...

approaching-canifis.speaker: Savant
approaching-canifis.text: No, it wasn't: Aggressiveness was highly increased, and there were numerous perceptual faults, hallucinations and the like.

approaching-canifis.speaker: Savant
approaching-canifis.text: We ceased experimentation immediately, there are enough things in this world to haunt a Temple Knight, we did not see the need to create anymore.

approaching-canifis.player: But this signature you are finding is the same as this 'slow-teleport' experiment created?

approaching-canifis.speaker: Savant
approaching-canifis.text: No... it is not exactly the same...

approaching-canifis.speaker: Savant
approaching-canifis.text: But it is close enough to be a cause of concern.

approaching-canifis.speaker: Savant
approaching-canifis.text: Either someone else has found this strange dimension and begun their own research, and reached the same conclusions that we did...

approaching-canifis.speaker: Savant
approaching-canifis.text: Or... We have had a security leak within the Temple Knights and abandoned research has been sold to our enemies!

approaching-canifis.player: Well, I can see how that might be a cause for concern, but right now our priority is Solus, right?

approaching-canifis.speaker: Savant
approaching-canifis.text: Yes [player name], you're right. But if he is using this 'slow-teleport' technique, then that means it is going to be a lot harder to catch him!

approaching-canifis.player: Because he is invisible and in three separate places simultaneously?

approaching-canifis.speaker: Savant
approaching-canifis.text: Exactly. Listen, I might be able to block his teleportation magics using your CommOrb, but I will need you to get close to him, and if we're unlucky then he will end up

approaching-canifis.speaker: Savant
approaching-canifis.text: teleporting to the point away from you instead of appearing in front of you

approaching-canifis.player: Well, we have nothing else to try, right? What will I have to do?

approaching-canifis.speaker: Savant
approaching-canifis.text: Use the 'Scan' function of your CommOrb, if he is in the vicinity it should knock him out of his 'in-between' state, and make him appear.

approaching-canifis.player: So I should try a scan here in Canifis?

approaching-canifis.speaker: Savant
approaching-canifis.text: That would seem best... Savant over and out.

approaching-canifis-talking-to-savant-ag.speaker: Savant
approaching-canifis-talking-to-savant-ag.text: Hello there [player name]. What can I help you with?

steps.player: Hi Savant. Where am I supposed to be looking for Solus again?

steps.speaker: Savant
steps.text: The clue was that Solus is somewhere where you might find Fur, East of Varrock...

steps.speaker: Savant
steps.text: There doesn't seem to be anything unusual about these readings [player name]... Looks like your hunch was wrong. Savant out.

steps.speaker: Savant
steps.text: Negative result, [player name]. Looks like you're barking up the wrong tree. Savant out.

steps.speaker: Savant
steps.text: Scan results are negative, [player name]. Savant out.

steps.speaker: Savant
steps.text: Background magical levels all seem within normal tolerable limits [player name]...

steps.speaker: Savant
steps.text: I don't think this can be the right place... Savant out.

steps.speaker: Savant
steps.text: Checking incoming data...

steps.speaker: Savant
steps.text: Nope, all clear here. Savant out.

steps.speaker: Savant
steps.text: Nope... I'm not picking up anything unusual near here... Savant out.

steps.speaker: Savant
steps.text: Analysis is negative I'm afraid, [player name]. Savant out.

steps.speaker: Savant
steps.text: The background magical levels are slightly above average here, but not enough to signify anything.

steps.speaker: Savant
steps.text: I think you're in the wrong place. Savant out.

steps.speaker: Savant
steps.text: Results are all-clear, [player name]. Savant out.

steps.speaker: Savant
steps.text: Not picking up any unusual readings here, [player name]... Savant out.

approaching-canifis-scanning-in-canifis.speaker: Solus Dellagar
approaching-canifis-scanning-in-canifis.text: What the...?

approaching-canifis-scanning-in-canifis.speaker: Solus Dellagar
approaching-canifis-scanning-in-canifis.text: Well well well! I was wondering when the White Knights would come looking for me!

approaching-canifis-scanning-in-canifis.speaker: Solus Dellagar
approaching-canifis-scanning-in-canifis.text: Well you'll have to be quicker than that, my friend!
(Solus teleports)

approaching-canifis-scanning-in-canifis.speaker: Savant
approaching-canifis-scanning-in-canifis.text: Argh!

approaching-canifis-scanning-in-canifis.speaker: Savant
approaching-canifis-scanning-in-canifis.text: He got away...

approaching-canifis-scanning-in-canifis.player: So what can we do now?

approaching-canifis-scanning-in-canifis.speaker: Savant
approaching-canifis-scanning-in-canifis.text: Wait a second...

approaching-canifis-scanning-in-canifis.speaker: Savant
approaching-canifis-scanning-in-canifis.text: There was another item in the teleport with him...

approaching-canifis-scanning-in-canifis.speaker: Savant
approaching-canifis-scanning-in-canifis.text: Well, I might be able to retrieve it from the slow-teleport!

approaching-canifis-scanning-in-canifis.speaker: Savant
approaching-canifis-scanning-in-canifis.text: It might give us a clue as to the second location Solus is in!

approaching-canifis-scanning-in-canifis.player: Well what are you waiting for? Try and get it!

approaching-canifis-scanning-in-canifis.text: If the item is Greenman's ale:

steps.text: Savant transfers the item to you.

steps.speaker: Savant
steps.text: It's... a beer?

steps.player: I doubt he's getting drunk in hiding...

steps.speaker: Savant
steps.text: That type of beer is only sold in one place that I know of.

approaching-canifis-scanning-in-canifis.text: If the item is Wizard hat:

steps.text: Savant transfers the item to you.

steps.speaker: Savant
steps.text: It's... a wizard hat?

steps.player: So he is improving his dress sense you think?

steps.speaker: Savant
steps.text: I think it's more likely he happens to be in an area where there are many wizards around.

approaching-canifis-scanning-in-canifis.text: If the item is Ear muffs:

steps.text: Savant transfers the item to you.

steps.speaker: Savant
steps.text: It's... ear muffs?

steps.player: Why on gielinor would he be wearing those?

steps.speaker: Savant
steps.text: Well, they are standard equipment for any slayer looking to kill Banshees...

approaching-canifis-scanning-in-canifis.text: If the item is Goblin armour:

steps.text: Savant transfers the item to you.

steps.speaker: Savant
steps.text: It's... goblin armour?

steps.player: Goblin armour? Why would he wear that?

steps.speaker: Savant
steps.text: Well, it must be a place here there is a lot of it around for it to have been caught in his teleport...

approaching-canifis-scanning-in-canifis.text: If the item is Fake beard:

steps.text: Savant transfers the item to you.

steps.speaker: Savant
steps.text: It's...a fake beard?

steps.player: What the...? You think he is in disguise somewhere?

steps.speaker: Savant
steps.text: I've seen this design of beard before... But I cannot remember where...

approaching-canifis-scanning-in-canifis.text: If the item is Bear fur:

steps.text: Savant transfers the item to you.

steps.speaker: Savant
steps.text: It's... fur?

steps.player: Fur? How does that help us find him?

steps.speaker: Savant
steps.text: Well, this is not fur directly from an animal, look it has been prepared for sale...

approaching-canifis-scanning-in-canifis.text: If the item is Eye patch:

steps.text: Savant transfers the item to you.

steps.speaker: Savant
steps.text: It's... an eye patch?

steps.player: Do you think he might be injured?

steps.speaker: Savant
steps.text: No, I think he must be somewhere where there are a lot of people who wear eye patches...

approaching-canifis-scanning-in-canifis.text: If the item is Wizard's hat (Cream):

steps.text: Savant transfers the item to you.

steps.speaker: Savant
steps.text: It's... a hat?

steps.player: How does a hat help us?

steps.speaker: Savant
steps.text: I'm sorry, I don't know. Maybe somewhere where hats like this are common?

approaching-canifis-scanning-in-canifis.text: If the item is Castle wars ticket:

steps.text: Savant transfers the item to you.

steps.speaker: Savant
steps.text: It's... a ticket?

steps.player: I am sure I have seen tickets like that somewhere before...

steps.speaker: Savant
steps.text: Well, wherever it is that you have seen them, I would guess he is nearby!

approaching-canifis-scanning-in-canifis.text: If the item is Fremennik cloak:

steps.text: Savant transfers the item to you.

steps.speaker: Savant
steps.text: It's... a cloak?

steps.player: Very stylish, but it doesn't seem to be his colour.

steps.speaker: Savant
steps.text: I don't think he would have been wearing it... But he might be nearby somewhere that sells this type of cloak.

approaching-canifis-scanning-in-canifis.text: If the item is Toy horsey:

steps.text: Savant transfers the item to you.

steps.speaker: Savant
steps.text: It's... a toy horse?

steps.player: What a weird thing to be carrying...

steps.speaker: Savant
steps.text: Well [player name], bear in mind that it might just be an object that as in the vicinity rather than something he was carrying...

approaching-canifis-scanning-in-canifis.text: If the item is Giant frog legs:

steps.text: Savant transfers the item to you.

steps.speaker: Savant
steps.text: It's... some big frog legs?

steps.player: The frog those came from must be huge!

steps.speaker: Savant
steps.text: I have heard rumours of giant frogs in a subterranean area...

approaching-canifis-scanning-in-canifis.text: If the item is Unholy symbol:

steps.text: Savant transfers the item to you.

steps.speaker: Savant
steps.text: It's... an Unholy Symbol!

steps.player: The symbol of Zamorak? That tells us nothing.

steps.speaker: Savant
steps.text: Yes, sadly there are many Zamorakians in these lands...But it must be somewhere of special significance...

approaching-canifis-scanning-in-canifis.text: If the item is Red Vine Worm:

steps.text: Savant transfers the item to you.

steps.speaker: Savant
steps.text: It's... a worm?

steps.player: Maybe he's doing a little fishing?

steps.speaker: Savant
steps.text: No, this is a very specific worm that is only found in one place...

approaching-canifis-scanning-in-canifis.text: If the item is Banana:

steps.text: Savant transfers the item to you.

steps.speaker: Savant
steps.text: It's... a banana?

steps.player: A banana? How is that a clue to where he is?

steps.speaker: Savant
steps.text: Well, for it to have got caught in his teleport, it must be a place where there are many around...

approaching-canifis-scanning-in-canifis.speaker: Savant
approaching-canifis-scanning-in-canifis.text: [player name], I want you to search for him, and use your Comm-Orb to scan for him if you think he is nearby!

approaching-canifis-scanning-in-canifis.player: Okay I'll head off immediately. Let's hope we're not too late.

approaching-canifis-talking-to-savant-ag.speaker: Savant
approaching-canifis-talking-to-savant-ag.text: Hello there [player name]. What can I help you with?

steps.player: Hi Savant. Where am I supposed to be looking for Solus again?

steps.text: If the item is Greenman's ale:

steps.speaker: Savant
steps.text: The clue was that Solus is somewhere where you might find Greenmans Ale...
If the item is Wizard hat:

steps.speaker: Savant
steps.text: The clue was that Solus is somewhere that has blue wizard hats...
If the item is Ear muffs:

steps.speaker: Savant
steps.text: The clues seem to point towards a place filled with Banshees...
If the item is Goblin armour:

steps.speaker: Savant
steps.text: The clue was that Solus is somewhere where you might find goblin mail...
If the item is Fake beard:

steps.speaker: Savant
steps.text: The clue was that Solus is somewhere where you might find Fake Beards...
If the item is Bear fur:
If the item is Eye patch:

steps.speaker: Savant
steps.text: The clue was that Solus is somewhere where you might find eyepatches...
If the item is Wizard's hat (Cream):

steps.speaker: Savant
steps.text: The clue was that Solus is somewhere where you might find that pastel shaded wizard hat...
If the item is Castle wars ticket:

steps.speaker: Savant
steps.text: The clue was that Solus is somewhere where you might find those tickets...
If the item is Fremennik cloak:

steps.speaker: Savant
steps.text: The clue was that Solus is somewhere where you might find that distinctive type of cloak...
If the item is Toy horsey:

steps.speaker: Savant
steps.text: The clue was that Solus is somewhere where you might find seeds for sale...
If the item is Giant frog legs:

steps.speaker: Savant
steps.text: The clue was that Solus is somewhere that has REALLY BIG frogs!
If the item is Unholy symbol:

steps.speaker: Savant
steps.text: The clue was that Solus is somewhere which has some signifiance to Zamorakians...
If the item is Red Vine Worm:

steps.speaker: Savant
steps.text: The clue was that Solus is somewhere where red vine worms might be...
If the item is Banana:
If the item is Cake:
If the item is a blue cape:

steps.speaker: Savant
steps.text: The clue was that Solus is somewhere where you might find Blue Capes...
If the item is a bone spear:

steps.speaker: Savant
steps.text: The clue was that Solus is somewhere where you might find strange weapons made of bone...
If the item is rune essence:

steps.speaker: Savant
steps.text: The clue was that Solus is somewhere where you might find those strange magical rocks...

scanning-the-second-location.speaker: Solus Dellagar
scanning-the-second-location.text: I warn you, if you interfere with my plans I will see you suffer!

scanning-the-second-location.player: Solus! I am here by authority of the White Knights of Falador!

scanning-the-second-location.speaker: Savant
scanning-the-second-location.text: Okay, I am attempting to block his teleport...

scanning-the-second-location.speaker: Solus Dellagar
scanning-the-second-location.text: Oh, we have a little magical skill do we?

scanning-the-second-location.speaker: Solus Dellagar
scanning-the-second-location.text: Then let's see how you deal with this!
The player is teleported to Camelot.

scanning-the-second-location.speaker: Savant
scanning-the-second-location.text: I should have known he would try something like that!

scanning-the-second-location.speaker: Savant
scanning-the-second-location.text: I'm sorry [player name], I should have stopped him using that spell...

scanning-the-second-location.player: That doesn't matter right now Savant, did you get a reading of where his teleport was coming from?

scanning-the-second-location.speaker: Savant
scanning-the-second-location.text: The spell is still running, wait a moment... There!
Savant transfers the item to you.

scanning-the-second-location.speaker: Savant
scanning-the-second-location.text: I'm not sure how much help in tracking him that is.

scanning-the-second-location.player: More than you might think Savant. This type of cape used to be called the Cape of Champions...

scanning-the-second-location.speaker: Savant
scanning-the-second-location.text: Well I still don't know what help that is, but if you have an idea where he might be you should head there immediately!

scanning-at-champion-s-guild.speaker: Solus Dellagar
scanning-at-champion-s-guild.text: Well now, I am beginning to get sick of your constant interference!

scanning-at-champion-s-guild.speaker: Solus Dellagar
scanning-at-champion-s-guild.text: Or at least I would be if you weren't so laughably easy to escape from!

scanning-at-champion-s-guild.player: He threw some kind of smoke at me or something...

scanning-at-champion-s-guild.speaker: Savant
scanning-at-champion-s-guild.text: Don't worry about it [player name], he may have escaped AGAIN, but I still have him on my tracking spell...

scanning-at-champion-s-guild.speaker: Savant
scanning-at-champion-s-guild.text: Okay, the smoke's cleared, and you don't seem to have been damaged by it!

scanning-at-champion-s-guild.speaker: Savant
scanning-at-champion-s-guild.text: You're lucky I think, readings show it was highly poisonous!

scanning-at-champion-s-guild.speaker: Savant
scanning-at-champion-s-guild.text: Let's see if I grabbed anything useful from him while he was teleporting...
(A random item is given to the player; see Scanning in Canifis section for full list)

scanning-at-champion-s-guild.player: Okay, I'm on my way. This Solus guy is really beginning to get on my nerves!

scanning-the-fourth-location.speaker: Solus Dellagar
scanning-the-fourth-location.text: This is getting very tiresome!

scanning-the-fourth-location.speaker: Solus Dellagar
scanning-the-fourth-location.text: Little White Knight, I command powers beyond your imagination!

scanning-the-fourth-location.speaker: Solus Dellagar
scanning-the-fourth-location.text: If you do not cease pursuing me, I will be forced to use them upon you!

scanning-the-fourth-location.player: You can't threaten me old man...
Dead or alive, you're coming with me.

scanning-the-fourth-location.speaker: Solus Dellagar
scanning-the-fourth-location.text: This charade bores me!

scanning-the-fourth-location.speaker: Savant
scanning-the-fourth-location.text: [player name] I am reading a huge power surge from Solus, be very careful...
Solus casts Flames of Zamorak.

scanning-the-fourth-location.speaker: Savant
scanning-the-fourth-location.text: [player name]!!!
The player wakes up outside Falador Castle.

scanning-the-fourth-location.speaker: Savant
scanning-the-fourth-location.text: I managed to shield you from most of his attack, and bring you back to Falador Castle, but you are lucky I was monitoring, that could have killed you!

scanning-the-fourth-location.player: I don't understand though Savant, you said he could only be in a few places simultaneously...
But he keeps getting away! And he keeps moving around!

scanning-the-fourth-location.speaker: Savant
scanning-the-fourth-location.text: You're right [player name], I don't know how he is doing it...

scanning-the-fourth-location.speaker: Savant
scanning-the-fourth-location.text: But he can't run forever, and every time he tries something against you, I can update your CommOrb to prevent it.

scanning-the-fourth-location.player: So he isn't going to shoot me like that again?

scanning-the-fourth-location.speaker: Savant
scanning-the-fourth-location.text: No, [player name]. I am sorry that I let him hurt you like that...

scanning-the-fourth-location.speaker: Savant
scanning-the-fourth-location.text: But keep chasing him, together we are going to bring him to justice!

scanning-the-fourth-location.player: You're right about that, there's no way I'm letting him get away with treating me like that!
So did we get any clues to his real location from that last scan?

scanning-the-fourth-location.speaker: Savant
scanning-the-fourth-location.text: That's the spirit [player name]! Just awaiting the data to come through...
Savant transfers the item to you.

scanning-the-fourth-location.speaker: Savant
scanning-the-fourth-location.text: It's... a very strange weapon?

scanning-the-fourth-location.player: It's the type of spear used by the Dorgeshuun goblins.

scanning-the-fourth-location.speaker: Savant
scanning-the-fourth-location.text: The who? I've never heard of them before...

scanning-the-fourth-location.speaker: Savant
scanning-the-fourth-location.text: Well, if you know who or what they are, you should go and see them, Solus must be nearby!

scanning-the-fourth-location.speaker: Savant
scanning-the-fourth-location.text: You should probably take a minute to restock on supplies and heal up though [player name].

scanning-the-fourth-location.speaker: Savant
scanning-the-fourth-location.text: I know we can find him and bring him to justice, but we don't want you dying while doing so!

scanning-the-fourth-location.player: Okay Savant, I'll heal up, then go looking for him amongst the Dorgeshuun.

scanning-in-dorgeshuun-mines.speaker: Woman
scanning-in-dorgeshuun-mines.text: Oh thank you, you have freed me!

scanning-in-dorgeshuun-mines.speaker: Woman
scanning-in-dorgeshuun-mines.text: Oh, I am but a poor maiden kidnapped by the evil Solus!

scanning-in-dorgeshuun-mines.speaker: Woman
scanning-in-dorgeshuun-mines.text: But you chased him so hard, that now I am free...

scanning-in-dorgeshuun-mines.speaker: Savant
scanning-in-dorgeshuun-mines.text: [player name], I am getting some strange readings from this 'maiden'...

scanning-in-dorgeshuun-mines.speaker: Savant
scanning-in-dorgeshuun-mines.text: Sorry [player name], I should have spotted his little trick earlier...

scanning-in-dorgeshuun-mines.speaker: Savant
scanning-in-dorgeshuun-mines.text: Are you okay? That looked like a nasty sucker punch...

scanning-in-dorgeshuun-mines.player: Did anyone get the number of that wagon?

scanning-in-dorgeshuun-mines.speaker: Savant
scanning-in-dorgeshuun-mines.text: Don't worry [player name], I am reconfiguring your CommOrb to compensate for any camouflage magics.

scanning-in-dorgeshuun-mines.player: Please tell me you have a reading on his actual location by now, this chasing him around the houses is becoming irritating...

scanning-in-dorgeshuun-mines.speaker: Savant
scanning-in-dorgeshuun-mines.text: No, but every time he escapes you I am shutting down his teleport to a specific area.

scanning-in-dorgeshuun-mines.speaker: Savant
scanning-in-dorgeshuun-mines.text: I think we are on the final stretch now [player name]!

scanning-in-dorgeshuun-mines.speaker: Savant
scanning-in-dorgeshuun-mines.text: I will be able to shut his teleports down permanently in 2, perhaps 3, more scans...

scanning-in-dorgeshuun-mines.speaker: Savant
scanning-in-dorgeshuun-mines.text: Keep up the chase [player name]! We nearly have him cornered!

scanning-in-dorgeshuun-mines.player: Uh... Out of interest, what am I going to do with an insane super-powerful murderous mage when he's cornered?

scanning-in-dorgeshuun-mines.speaker: Savant
scanning-in-dorgeshuun-mines.text: Leave that to me and the Temple Knights [player name].

scanning-in-dorgeshuun-mines.speaker: Savant
scanning-in-dorgeshuun-mines.text: Just follow your orders and continue the chase, and his days are numbered.

scanning-in-dorgeshuun-mines.player: Well okay then, where should I head now?

scanning-in-dorgeshuun-mines.speaker: Savant
scanning-in-dorgeshuun-mines.text: Let's see what we managed to snag in the scan this time!
(A random item is given to the player; see Scanning in Canifis section for full list)

scanning-in-dorgeshuun-mines.player: Okay, I'm on my way – and Solus had better watch out, I am up to here with his annoying tricks!

scanning-the-sixth-location.speaker: Solus Dellagar
scanning-the-sixth-location.text: Well you ARE a persistent one, aren't you?

scanning-the-sixth-location.player: I am here to take you in, Solus. You can forget your little tricks.

scanning-the-sixth-location.speaker: Solus Dellagar
scanning-the-sixth-location.text: Little tricks, you say? Well how about this one!

scanning-the-sixth-location.speaker: Solus
scanning-the-sixth-location.text: Say hello to my little friend! And goodbye to me!

scanning-the-sixth-location-after-the-bl.text: Savant transfers the item to you.

scanning-the-sixth-location-after-the-bl.speaker: Savant
scanning-the-sixth-location-after-the-bl.text: Okay, we have our scan results...

scanning-the-sixth-location-after-the-bl.speaker: Savant
scanning-the-sixth-location-after-the-bl.text: It's some kind of highly magically susceptible rock...

scanning-the-sixth-location-after-the-bl.speaker: Savant
scanning-the-sixth-location-after-the-bl.text: Isn't that the same rock that you gave that Zamorakian mage in Varrock?

scanning-the-sixth-location-after-the-bl.player: Yeah it is, which means I know where he is, and how to get there!
It's a mine for Rune Essence, but there are only supposed to be a few people who know how to get there...

scanning-the-sixth-location-after-the-bl.speaker: Savant
scanning-the-sixth-location-after-the-bl.text: Let's worry about that later; Go get Solus!

rune-essence-mine-ending-the-hunt.speaker: Savant
rune-essence-mine-ending-the-hunt.text: Okay, I've blocked all exits from this place except for Temple Knight teleports...

rune-essence-mine-ending-the-hunt.speaker: Savant
rune-essence-mine-ending-the-hunt.text: I think we finally have him!

rune-essence-mine-ending-the-hunt.speaker: Solus Dellagar
rune-essence-mine-ending-the-hunt.text: Argh! I am so sick of your interference!

rune-essence-mine-ending-the-hunt.speaker: Solus Dellagar
rune-essence-mine-ending-the-hunt.text: I think it is time we end this once and for all!

rune-essence-mine-ending-the-hunt.player: In the name of the White Knights of Falador, and of the Temple Knights of Saradomin, I am placing you under arrest!

rune-essence-mine-ending-the-hunt.text: Savant teleports in Temple Knight rangers.
Solus casts Ice Barrage, killing all of the Temple Knight rangers.

rune-essence-mine-ending-the-hunt.speaker: Solus Dellagar
rune-essence-mine-ending-the-hunt.text: You... You meddlesome... You meddlesome freak!

rune-essence-mine-ending-the-hunt.speaker: Savant
rune-essence-mine-ending-the-hunt.text: [player name], Solus is very weakened, and we don't have any more men to spare!

rune-essence-mine-ending-the-hunt.speaker: Savant
rune-essence-mine-ending-the-hunt.text: Take him out now! This might be your only chance!

rune-essence-mine-ending-the-hunt-after-.speaker: Savant
rune-essence-mine-ending-the-hunt-after-.text: Now that Solus is defeated you should take his hat to Sir Amik to prove that you were responsible.

rune-essence-mine-ending-the-hunt-after-.speaker: Savant
rune-essence-mine-ending-the-hunt-after-.text: VERY well done, [player name]. Very well done indeed.

rune-essence-mine-ending-the-hunt-commun.speaker: Savant
rune-essence-mine-ending-the-hunt-commun.text: Hello there [player name]. What can I help you with?

steps.player: Hi Savant. Where am I supposed to be looking for Solus again?

steps.speaker: Savant
steps.text: You're not looking for Solus [player name], you are supposed to be taking his hat to Sir Amik of the White Knights as proof that you have defeated him.
If the player lost the hat:

steps.player: But I lost his hat...

steps.speaker: Savant
steps.text: I have sent you a duplicate, try not to lose it.

steps.speaker: Savant
steps.text: Go and take it to Sir Amik so that he can make you a full-fledged White Knight!

steps.player: I did it Tiffy! I brought Solus in for capture!

steps.speaker: Sir Tiffy Cashien
steps.text: Had a little help doing it though, didn't you, what?

steps.player: Yes... But I did all the legwork...

steps.speaker: Sir Tiffy Cashien
steps.text: Haw Haw Haw!

steps.speaker: Sir Tiffy Cashien
steps.text: That you did Initiate, that you did.

steps.speaker: Sir Tiffy Cashien
steps.text: Now take that hat of Solus over to Sir Amik, and we can begin to process your application form as a Temple Knight again, what?

steps.player: Okay Tiffy, I'll be back in a jiffy!

completing-the-quest-talking-to-sir-amik.speaker: Sir Amik Varze
completing-the-quest-talking-to-sir-amik.text: You are supposed to be looking for Solus Dellagar!

completing-the-quest-talking-to-sir-amik.speaker: Sir Amik Varze
completing-the-quest-talking-to-sir-amik.text: The insane magician who is loose once more upon these lands? Remember?

completing-the-quest-talking-to-sir-amik.speaker: Sir Amik Varze
completing-the-quest-talking-to-sir-amik.text: You have??? Then you must have some proof of your encounter!

completing-the-quest-talking-to-sir-amik.speaker: Sir Amik Varze
completing-the-quest-talking-to-sir-amik.text: A weapon perhaps, or an item of clothing?
If the player lost the hat:

steps.player: Well of course I do! I mean I did... Look, I lost it okay? Stop hassling me!

steps.speaker: Sir Amik Varze
steps.text: Look, I am very sorry [player name], but if you have no proof of your encounter, I can hardly promote you to be a full White Knight, now can I?

steps.player: Oh man... I think I've messed up... Maybe Savant can help me out somehow? I'd better speak to her.

completing-the-quest-talking-to-sir-amik.text: If the player has the hat in the bank:

steps.player: Well of course I do! I just happened to think it would be a good idea to leave it in the bank for safe keeping.

steps.speaker: Sir Amik Varze
steps.text: Well bring it here so that I can authenticate your claim and make you a White Knight!

completing-the-quest-talking-to-sir-amik.text: If the player has the hat:

steps.player: Well of course I do! I have it right here!

steps.speaker: Sir Amik Varze
steps.text: Well hand it over then, and let's see it!
Congratulations! Quest complete!

steps.speaker: Sir Amik Varze
steps.text: Now that you are a White Knight I should perhaps explain a little about how our system works.

steps.speaker: Sir Amik Varze
steps.text: Sadly we are not as rich as we once were, and there are many White Knights who foolishly lose their combat equipment.

steps.speaker: Sir Amik Varze
steps.text: We do not think it fair to make a profit from our brethren, so we will sell you equipment at cost, and rebuy it at the same cost, but we will only sell equipment to those we consider responsible enough to

steps.speaker: Sir Amik Varze
steps.text: wield it correctly.

steps.speaker: Sir Amik Varze
steps.text: By killing Black Knights, you will increase your reputation with us, by killing White Knights we will obviously think less of you.

steps.speaker: Sir Amik Varze
steps.text: You can check your White Knight reputation level by looking at your quest journal for the Wanted! Quest, or Sir Vyvin will let you know what level you are at when you go to purchase equipment.

steps.speaker: Sir Amik Varze
steps.text: Sir Vyvin can be found in Falador Castle, and he will sell you any equipment appropriate to your reputation level.

steps.speaker: Sir Amik Varze
steps.text: Have fun, and go kill some Black Knights for me!

steps.player: Okay Amik, thanks for explaining!

gqybR2.speaker: Savant
gqybR2.text: Our observation records are classified, you can't go viewing them in unsecure areas. I recommend you secure youself within the White Knights' Castle if you want to watch it.

QCvnBD.speaker: Savant
QCvnBD.text: The clue was that Solus is somewhere where you might find bananas...

standard-dialogue.npc: Yes? Do you have business with one of the prisoners?

standard-dialogue.player: I don't think so. What are they in for?

standard-dialogue.npc: Does it matter? They are criminals.
They will be if they're found guilty.
In most cases, death.

standard-dialogue.player: Ah, nice. Bit brutal though, right?

standard-dialogue.npc: Brutal? Yes. Effective? Yes.

after-the-final-dawn.npc: Adventurer. If you're here to speak with our newest guest, I wouldn't waste your time.
Because she hasn't said a word since she arrived.

options.text: What are you camped out here for?

steps.player: What are you camped here for?

steps.npc: We're looking for Zanaris...GAH! I mean we're not here for any particular reason at all.

steps.player: Who's Zanaris?

steps.npc: Ahahahaha! Zanaris isn't a person! It's a magical hidden city filled with treasures and rich.. uh, nothing. It's nothing.

options.text: If it's hidden how are you planning to find it?

steps.player: If it's hidden how are you planning to find it?

steps.npc: Well, we don't want to tell anyone else about that, because we don't want anyone else sharing in all that glory and treasure.

options.text: Looks like you don't know either.

steps.player: Well, it looks to me like YOU don't know EITHER seeing as you're all just sat around here.

steps.npc: Of course we know! We just haven't found which tree the stupid leprechaun's hiding in yet!

steps.prompt: Start the Lost City quest?

steps.player: Leprechaun?

steps.npc: GAH! I didn't mean to tell you that! Look, just forget I said anything okay?

steps.player: So a leprechaun knows where Zanaris is eh?

steps.npc: Ye.. uh, no. No, not at all. And even if he did - which he doesn't - he DEFINITELY ISN'T hiding in some tree around here. Nope, definitely not. Honestly.

steps.player: Thanks for the help!

steps.npc: Help? What help? I didn't help! Please don't say I did, I'll get in trouble!

steps.player: So let me get this straight: I need to search the trees around here for a leprechaun; and then when I find him, he will tell me where this 'Zanaris' is?

steps.npc: What? How did you know that? Uh... I mean, no, no you're very wrong. Very wrong, and not right at all, and I definitely didn't tell you about that at all.

steps.player: Right... Well good luck with it.
There's no such thing!

steps.npc: When we've found Zanaris you'll... GAH! I mean, we're not here for any particular reason at all.

options.text: What makes you think it's out here?

steps.player: What's Zanaris?

steps.npc: I don't think we want other people competing with us to find it. Forget I said anything.

steps.player: Oh well. Never mind.

options.text: What makes you think it's out here?

steps.player: What makes you think it's out here?

steps.npc: Don't you know of the legends that tell of the magical city, hidden in the swam... Uh, no, you're right, we're wasting our time here.

options.text: If it's hidden how are you planning to find it?
Do you know any good adventures I can go on?

steps.player: Do you know any good adventures I can go on?

steps.npc: Well we're on an adventure right now. Mind you, this is OUR adventure and we don't want to share it - find your own!

steps.player: Please tell me?

steps.npc: No.

steps.player: Please?

steps.npc: No!

steps.player: PLEEEEEEEEEEEEEEEEEEEEEASE?

steps.npc: NO!

options.text: I don't think you've found a good adventure at all!

steps.player: I don't think you've found a good adventure at all!

steps.npc: Hah! Adventurers of our calibre don't just hang around in forests for fun, whelp!

steps.player: Oh really?
What are you camped here for?

steps.npc: We're looking for Zanaris...GAH! I mean we're not here for any particular reason at all.

options.text: What makes you think it's out here?

standard-dialogue-before-lost-city-after.player: So let me get this straight: I need to search the trees around here for a leprechaun; and then when I find him, he will tell me where this 'Zanaris' is?

standard-dialogue-before-lost-city-after.npc: What? How did you know that? Uh... I mean, no, no you're very wrong. Very wrong, and not right at all, and I definitely didn't tell you about that at all.

standard-dialogue-before-lost-city-dialo.npc: We're still searching for Zanaris...GAH! I mean we're not doing anything here at all.

standard-dialogue-before-lost-city-dialo.player: I haven't found it yet either.

first-dialogue-after-lost-city.player: Hey, thanks for all the information. It REALLY helped me out in finding the lost city of Zanaris and all.

first-dialogue-after-lost-city.npc: Oh please don't say that anymore! If the rest of my party knew I'd helped you they'd probably throw me out and make me walk home by myself!

first-dialogue-after-lost-city.player: You know.... I think I'll keep that to myself.

standard-dialogue-after-lost-city.player: Hey, thanks for all the information. It REALLY helped me out in finding the lost city of Zanaris and all.

standard-dialogue-after-lost-city.npc: Oh please don't say that anymore! If the rest of my party knew I'd helped you they'd probably throw me out and make me walk home by myself!
So anyway, what have you found out? Where is the fabled Zanaris? Is it all the legends say it is?

standard-dialogue-after-lost-city.player: You know.... I think I'll keep that to myself.

getting-started-speaking-to-a-tower-guar.player: Hello. What are you doing here?

getting-started-speaking-to-a-tower-guar.speaker: Tower guard
getting-started-speaking-to-a-tower-guar.text: We are the tower guards – our business is our own!

getting-started-attempting-to-climb-the-.speaker: Tower guard
getting-started-attempting-to-climb-the-.text: You can't go up there. That's private, that is.

getting-started-speaking-to-a-wizard.speaker: Wizard
getting-started-speaking-to-a-wizard.text: You'll have to speak with the Watchtower Wizard about that.

getting-started-speaking-to-the-watchtow.speaker: Watchtower Wizard
getting-started-speaking-to-the-watchtow.text: Who are you? Are you one of the new guards?

getting-started-speaking-to-the-watchtow.speaker: Watchtower Wizard
getting-started-speaking-to-the-watchtow.text: Well what are you doing here?

getting-started-speaking-to-the-watchtow.speaker: Watchtower Wizard
getting-started-speaking-to-the-watchtow.text: Oh my, oh my! What does it all matter in the end, anyway?

steps.player: What's the matter?

steps.speaker: Watchtower Wizard
steps.text: Oh dear, oh dear. Darn and drat!

steps.speaker: Watchtower Wizard
steps.text: We try hard to keep this town protected.

steps.speaker: Watchtower Wizard
steps.text: But how can we do that when the Watchtower isn't working?

steps.player: What do you mean it isn't working?

steps.speaker: Watchtower Wizard
steps.text: The Watchtower here works by the power of magic. An ancient spell designed to ward off ogres that has been in place here for many moons.

steps.speaker: Watchtower Wizard
steps.text: The exact knowledge of the spell is lost to us now, but the essence of the spell has been infused into four powering crystals that keep the tower protected from the hordes in the Feldips.

options.text: So how come the spell doesn't work?

steps.player: So how come the spell doesn't work?

steps.speaker: Watchtower Wizard
steps.text: The crystals! The crystals have been taken!

steps.player: Taken?

steps.speaker: Watchtower Wizard
steps.text: Stolen!

steps.player: Stolen?

steps.speaker: Watchtower Wizard
steps.text: Yes, yes! Do I have to repeat myself?

steps.prompt: Start the Watchtower quest?

steps.player: Can I be of help?

steps.speaker: Watchtower Wizard
steps.text: Help? Oh wonderful, dear traveller!

steps.speaker: Watchtower Wizard
steps.text: Yes I could do with an extra pair of eyes here.

steps.speaker: Watchtower Wizard
steps.text: There must be some evidence of what has happened here. Perhaps you could assist me in searching for clues?

steps.player: I would be happy to.

steps.speaker: Watchtower Wizard
steps.text: Try searching the surrounding area. If you find anything unusual, bring it here. Try the bushes - I've read enough adventure stories to know that clues get caught in bushes all the time.

steps.speaker: Watchtower Wizard
steps.text: I will tell the guards to let you past - that way, you can just use the ladder to get in and out.

steps.player: I'm not interested.

steps.speaker: Watchtower Wizard
steps.text: That's typical, nowadays. It's left to us wizards to do all the work.

options.text: I'm not interested in your rantings.

steps.player: I'm not interested in your rantings.

steps.speaker: Watchtower Wizard
steps.text: Hmph! Suit yourself.

steps.player: You wizards are always complaining.

steps.speaker: Watchtower Wizard
steps.text: Complaining? Complaining!

steps.speaker: Watchtower Wizard
steps.text: What folks these days don't realise is that if it weren't for us wizards, this entire world would be overrun with every creature you could possibly imagine. And some you couldn't even conceive of!

searching-for-evidence-speaking-to-a-wiz.player: I've got some questions about the search for evidence.

searching-for-evidence-speaking-to-a-wiz.speaker: Wizard
searching-for-evidence-speaking-to-a-wiz.text: You'll have to speak with the Watchtower Wizard about that.

searching-for-evidence-talking-to-the-wa.speaker: Watchtower Wizard
searching-for-evidence-talking-to-the-wa.text: Hello again. Did you find anything of interest?
With no evidence to show him:

steps.player: No, sorry, nothing yet.

steps.speaker: Watchtower Wizard
steps.text: Oh dear, oh dear, there must be something, somewhere...

searching-for-evidence-talking-to-the-wa.text: With any of the evidence besides fingernails:

steps.player: I have this [robe/dagger/armour/eyepatch]...

steps.speaker: Watchtower Wizard
steps.text: Let me see...

steps.speaker: Watchtower Wizard
steps.text: No, sorry, this is not evidence. You need to keep searching, I'm afraid.

steps.player: Have a look at these...

steps.speaker: Watchtower Wizard
steps.text: Interesting, very interesting.

steps.speaker: Watchtower Wizard
steps.text: Long nails...grey in colour...well chewed...

steps.speaker: Watchtower Wizard
steps.text: Of course! They belong to a skavid!

steps.player: A skavid?

steps.speaker: Watchtower Wizard
steps.text: A servant race to the ogres: grey, depressed-looking creatures, always losing nails, teeth and hair!

steps.speaker: Watchtower Wizard
steps.text: They inhabit the caves in the Feldip Hills.

steps.speaker: Watchtower Wizard
steps.text: They normally keep to themselves, though. It's unusual for them to venture from their caves.

options.text: What do you suggest I do?

steps.player: What do you suggest I do?

steps.speaker: Watchtower Wizard
steps.text: It's no good searching the caves. Well, not yet, anyway.

steps.player: Why not?

steps.speaker: Watchtower Wizard
steps.text: They are deep and complex. The only way you will navigate the caves is to have a map or something.

steps.speaker: Watchtower Wizard
steps.text: It may be that the ogres have one...

steps.player: And how do you know that?

steps.speaker: Watchtower Wizard
steps.text: Well... I don't.

steps.player: So what do I do?

steps.speaker: Watchtower Wizard
steps.text: You need to be fearless and gain entrance to Gu'Tanoth, the city of the ogres, then find out how to navigate the caves.

steps.player: That sounds scary...

steps.speaker: Watchtower Wizard
steps.text: Ogres are nasty creatures, yes. Only a strong warrior, and a clever one at that, can get the better of them.

steps.player: What do I need to do to get into the city?

steps.speaker: Watchtower Wizard
steps.text: You'll need some way to make the guards let you in.

steps.speaker: Watchtower Wizard
steps.text: You could start by checking out the ogre settlements around here. Tribal ogres often dislike their neighbours... In the meantime, I'll throw those fingernails out for you.

steps.player: I won't bother, then.

steps.speaker: Watchtower Wizard
steps.text: Won't bother? Won't bother!

steps.speaker: Watchtower Wizard
steps.text: Perhaps this quest is too hard for you?

steps.player: Shall I search the caves?

steps.speaker: Watchtower Wizard
steps.text: It's no good searching the caves. Well, not yet, anyway.

steps.player: Why not?

steps.speaker: Watchtower Wizard
steps.text: They are deep and complex. The only way you will navigate the caves is to have a map or something.

steps.speaker: Watchtower Wizard
steps.text: It may be that the ogres have one...

steps.player: And how do you know that?

steps.speaker: Watchtower Wizard
steps.text: Well... I don't.

steps.player: Aha! A robe. This could be a clue...

steps.text: old robe

steps.player: Here's some armour; it could be evidence...

steps.text: unusual armour

steps.player: Aha, a dagger! I wonder if this is evidence...

steps.text: damaged dagger

steps.player: I've found an eye patch; I had better show this to the Watchtower Wizard.

steps.text: tattered eye patch

steps.player: What's this? Disgusting! Some fingernails. They may be a clue though... I'd better take them.

steps.text: Fingernails

searching-for-evidence-searching-the-bus.text: Searching the same bush after finding an item in it:

searching-for-evidence-searching-the-bus.player: I have already searched this place.

ogre-investigations-talking-to-a-wizard.player: I've got some questions regarding the tribal ogres.

ogre-investigations-talking-to-a-wizard.speaker: Wizard
ogre-investigations-talking-to-a-wizard.text: You'll have to speak with the Watchtower Wizard about that.

options.text: I am having difficulty with the tribes.

steps.player: I am having difficulty with the tribes.

steps.speaker: Watchtower Wizard
steps.text: Talk to them face to face and don't show any fear. Make sure you are rested and well fed, and fight the good fight!

steps.player: I have everything under control.

steps.speaker: Watchtower Wizard
steps.text: Good, good! I will expect the crystals back shortly then...

options.text: I have lost something the ogres gave to me.

steps.player: I have lost something the ogres gave to me.

steps.speaker: Watchtower Wizard
steps.text: Oh, deary me! Well, there's nothing I can do about it. You will have to go back to them, I'm afraid.

ogre-investigations-toban.speaker: Toban
ogre-investigations-toban.text: What do you want, small t'ing?

options.text: I seek entrance to the city of ogres.

steps.player: I seek entrance to the city of ogres.

steps.speaker: Toban
steps.text: Hahaha! You'll never get in there.

steps.player: I'll find a way, trust me.

steps.speaker: Toban
steps.text: Bold words for a t'ing so small.

options.text: I could do something for you...

steps.player: I could do something for you...

steps.speaker: Toban
steps.text: Hahaha! This creature t'inks it can help me! I would eat you now, but for your puny size.

steps.speaker: Toban
steps.text: Prove to me your might: bring me the bones of an adult dragon to chew on, and I'll eat them, not you.

steps.player: Die, creature!

steps.speaker: Toban
steps.text: Hahaha! It t'inks it's a match for Toban, does it?
Tobans hits and damages the player

ogre-investigations-toban-speaking-to-to.speaker: Toban
ogre-investigations-toban-speaking-to-to.text: Hahaha! Small t'ing returns. Did you bring the dragon bone?

steps.player: I don't have what you want.

steps.speaker: Toban
steps.text: Then you shall get nothing from me!

steps.player: When I say I will get something, I get it!

steps.speaker: Toban
steps.text: Hahaha! Small t'ing has done it. Toban is glad - take this...
The ogre gives you part of a statue.

ogre-investigations-toban-speaking-to-to.speaker: Toban
ogre-investigations-toban-speaking-to-to.text: The small t'ing returns; what do you want now?

steps.player: I seek another task.

steps.speaker: Toban
steps.text: Have you arrived for dinner? Hahaha! Be gone, small t'ing!

options.text: I can't find the relic part you gave me.

steps.text: If the player has the relic part on them:

steps.player: I can't find the relic part you gave me.

steps.speaker: Toban
steps.text: Small t'ing, you lie to me! I always says that small t'ings are big trouble.
You find a stash of gold inside.

steps.player: I think I need a key of some sort.

options.text: I seek entrance to the city of ogres.

steps.player: I seek entrance to the city of ogres.

steps.speaker: Og
steps.text: You got no business there!

steps.speaker: Og
steps.text: Just a minute... Maybe if you did somet'ing for me, I might help you get in.

steps.player: What can I do to help an ogre?

steps.speaker: Og
steps.text: South-east of here der is more ogres - the name of the chieftain is Toban. He stole gold from me and I want it back!

steps.speaker: Og
steps.text: Here is a key to the chest it's in. If you bring it here, I may reward you...

options.text: I have come to kill you.

steps.player: I have come to kill you!

steps.speaker: Og
steps.text: Kill me, eh? You shall be crushed. Guards!
An ogre attacks the player.

ogre-investigations-og-speaking-to-og-ag.speaker: Og
ogre-investigations-og-speaking-to-og-ag.text: Where my gold from dat dirty Toban?

steps.text: If the player does have the gold:

steps.speaker: Og
steps.text: Well, well, the little t'ing has got it! Take dis to show little t'ing is a friend to da ogres. Hahahahaha!
The ogre gives you part of a horrible statue.
If the player doesn't have the gold:

steps.player: I have your gold.

steps.speaker: Og
steps.text: No you don't! If you want to impress me, get da gold I asked for!

steps.player: I haven't got it yet.

steps.speaker: Og
steps.text: Don't come back until you have it, unless you wanna be on tonight's menu!
If the player no longer has the key:

steps.player: I have lost the key!

steps.speaker: Og
steps.text: Stoopid! Take another and don't lose it!
If the player has the key on them:

steps.speaker: Og
steps.text: Oh yeah? What's dat den?

steps.player: Oh yeah, I've got it right here.

steps.speaker: Og
steps.text: Stoopid!
If the player has the key stored somewhere:

steps.player: I have lost the key!

steps.speaker: Og
steps.text: Are you trying to trick me? I bet you got it stored somewhere. Humans always do that.

options.text: Do you have any other tasks for me?

steps.player: Do you have any other tasks for me?

steps.speaker: Og
steps.text: No, I have no more tasks for you, now go away.

options.text: I have lost the relic part you gave me.

steps.text: If the player has the relic part on them:

steps.player: I have lost the relic part you gave me.

steps.speaker: Og
steps.text: Are you blind? I can see you got it even from here!
If the player lost the relic part:

steps.player: I have lost the relic part you gave me.

steps.speaker: Og
steps.text: Grrr, why do I bother? It's a good job I got another part.
If the relic part is stored somewhere:

steps.player: I have lost the relic part you gave me.

steps.speaker: Og
steps.text: Are you trying to trick me? I bet you got it stored somewhere. Humans always do that.

ogre-investigations-grew.speaker: Grew
ogre-investigations-grew.text: What do you want, little morsel? You would look good on my plate!

ogre-investigations-grew.player: I want to enter the city of ogres.

ogre-investigations-grew.speaker: Grew
ogre-investigations-grew.text: Hah! I should eat you instead!

options.text: Don't eat me; I can help you.

steps.player: Don't eat me; I can help you.

steps.speaker: Grew
steps.text: What can a morsel like you do for me?

steps.player: I am a mighty adventurer, slayer of monsters and user of magic powers.

steps.speaker: Grew
steps.text: Well, well, perhaps the morsel can help after all...

steps.speaker: Grew
steps.text: If you t'ink you're tough, find Gorad, my enemy to the south-east, and knock one of his teeth out! Heheheheh!

options.text: You will have to kill me first.

steps.player: You will have to kill me first.

steps.speaker: Grew
steps.text: That's not tricky - guards!
An ogre attacks the player.

ogre-investigations-grew-speaking-to-gre.speaker: Grew
ogre-investigations-grew-speaking-to-gre.text: The morsel is back. Does it have our tooth for us?

steps.player: Err, I don't have it.

steps.speaker: Grew
steps.text: Morsel, you dare to return without the tooth! Either you are stoopid, or wants to be eaten!

steps.player: I have it.

steps.speaker: Grew
steps.text: That'll annoy Gorad lots! Heheheheh! Here's a token of my gratitude: some old gem I stole from Gorad, and an old part of a statue.
You get part of a horrible statue... and one of the crystals!

An ogre called Toban gave me this...

ogre-investigations-assembling-the-relic.text: After handing in one relic part:

steps.speaker: Watchtower Wizard
steps.text: Ah, it's part of an old ogre statue. I'll take that off you - it might come in handy if I can fix it up.

ogre-investigations-assembling-the-relic.text: After handing in two relic parts:

steps.speaker: Watchtower Wizard
steps.text: Ah, it's more of that old ogre statue. I'll take this bit too.

ogre-investigations-assembling-the-relic.text: After handing in the third relic part:

steps.speaker: Watchtower Wizard
steps.text: It looks like you've brought me all the pieces of the relic. It is as I thought - a statue symbolising an ogre warrior of old.

steps.speaker: Watchtower Wizard
steps.text: Well, if you ever want to make friends with an ogre, this is the item to have! Now I'll try to assemble it...
The wizard gives you a complete statue.

ogre-investigations-talking-to-a-wizard-.player: I've got some questions about the ogre city.

ogre-investigations-talking-to-a-wizard-.speaker: Wizard

ogre-investigations-talking-to-a-wizard-.player: I had a feeling you might say that.

ogre-investigations-talking-to-the-watch.speaker: Watchtower Wizard
ogre-investigations-talking-to-the-watch.text: Ah, the warrior returns. Have you found a way into Gu'Tanoth yet?

ogre-investigations-talking-to-the-watch.speaker: Watchtower Wizard
ogre-investigations-talking-to-the-watch.text: Well, ogres dislike others apart from their own kind. What you need is some form of proof of friendship, something to trick them into believing you're their friend.

ogre-investigations-talking-to-the-watch.speaker: Watchtower Wizard
ogre-investigations-talking-to-the-watch.text: Which shouldn't be too hard, considering their intelligence.

options.text: I have lost the relic you gave me.

steps.text: If the player has the relic in their inventory:

steps.player: I have lost the relic you gave me.

steps.speaker: Watchtower Wizard
steps.text: Have you gone mad? I can see you have it with you!
If the player lost the relic:

steps.player: I have lost the relic you gave me.

steps.speaker: Watchtower Wizard
steps.text: What? Lost the relic? How careless! It's a good job I copied its design, then! You can take this copy instead - it's just as good.

options.text: I will find my way in, no problem.

steps.speaker: Watchtower Wizard

steps.text: Stop, creature! Only ogres and their friends allowed in this city. Show me a sign of companionship, like a lost relic or somefing, and you may pass.

steps.speaker: Ogre guard
steps.text: Until then, back to whence you came!
(The ogre guard pushes you back down the hill, stunning you and dealing 3 damage)

steps.text: Well, what proof of friendship did you bring?

entering-gu-tanoth-talking-to-the-wizard.player: I've made it into the ogre city!

entering-gu-tanoth-talking-to-the-wizard.speaker: Wizard

entering-gu-tanoth-talking-to-the-watcht.player: Okay thanks, I'll go and find out.

options.text: But I am a friend to ogres...

entering-gu-tanoth-crossing-the-bridge.speaker: Ogre guard

steps.text: A wise choice, little thing.

steps.speaker: Ogre guard

options.text: Okay, okay, I'm not going to hurt you.

options.text: I want to rid the world of ogres!

steps.text: You dare mock me, creature!

entering-the-enclave-using-cave-nightsha.speaker: Enclave guard

entering-the-enclave-talking-to-the-watc.text: That's great news; let me infuse it with magic...

entering-the-enclave-talking-to-the-watc.speaker: Watchtower Wizard
entering-the-enclave-talking-to-the-watc.text: Here it is - a dangerous substance. I must remind you that this potion can only be used if your Magic level is high enough.

entering-the-enclave-talking-to-the-watc.speaker: Watchtower Wizard
entering-the-enclave-talking-to-the-watc.text: Well, if you can cast Bones to Bananas, or any spells beyond that, you should be alright.

steps.player: That's one destroyed...
That's the second one gone...
There goes the fourth...
That's five! Only one more left now...

steps.text: A crystal drops from the hand of the disappearing ogre. You snatch it up quickly.

entering-the-enclave-killing-the-ogre-sh.text: Searching the shaman robe while already having the crystal:

steps.text: You search the robe, but find nothing. You already have the shamans' crystal.

entering-the-enclave-killing-the-ogre-sh.text: Searching the shaman robe while not having the crystal:

steps.text: You search the robe and find a crystal!

entering-the-enclave-mining-the-rock-of-.text: A crack appears in the rock and you prise a crystal out.

entering-the-enclave-prospecting-the-roc.text: You examine the rock for ores...
The rock has a gap in which a crystal used to sit.

entering-the-enclave-attempting-to-mine-.player: I already have this crystal. There is no benefit to getting another.

entering-the-enclave-returning-to-the-wa.speaker: Watchtower Wizard
entering-the-enclave-returning-to-the-wa.text: Hello again. Did the potion work?

entering-the-enclave-returning-to-the-wa.player: Indeed it did! I wiped out those ogre shamans!

options.text: I had another crystal but I lost it.

steps.player: I had another crystal but I lost it.

steps.speaker: Watchtower Wizard
steps.text: Oh, really? If you got it from someone, maybe they'll have found it again. Otherwise, go and search the place where you got it in the first place.

options.text: I am looking for another crystal.

steps.player: I am looking for another crystal.

steps.speaker: Watchtower Wizard
steps.text: I am sure the cave holds the final crystal. Look for the source of the shamans' power.

steps.player: Okay, I will go and have a look.
I have found another crystal!

steps.speaker: Watchtower Wizard
steps.text: Good, hand it over to me.

reviving-the-watchtower-talking-to-a-wiz.speaker: Wizard
reviving-the-watchtower-talking-to-a-wiz.text: Well, you could ask the Watchtower Wizard for one.

reviving-the-watchtower-talking-to-the-w.speaker: Watchtower Wizard
reviving-the-watchtower-talking-to-the-w.text: Hello again. Did the potion work?

reviving-the-watchtower-talking-to-the-w.player: Indeed it did! I wiped out those ogre shamans!

reviving-the-watchtower-talking-to-the-w.speaker: Watchtower Wizard
reviving-the-watchtower-talking-to-the-w.text: Magnificent! At last you've brought all the crystals.

reviving-the-watchtower-talking-to-the-w.speaker: Watchtower Wizard
reviving-the-watchtower-talking-to-the-w.text: Now the shield generator can be activated and, once again, Yanille will be safe from the threat of the ogres.

reviving-the-watchtower-talking-to-the-w.speaker: Watchtower Wizard
reviving-the-watchtower-talking-to-the-w.text: Put the crystals on the pillars there and throw the lever to activate the system.

reviving-the-watchtower-talking-to-the-w.speaker: Watchtower Wizard
reviving-the-watchtower-talking-to-the-w.text: The system is not activated yet. Throw the switch to start it.

reviving-the-watchtower-talking-to-a-wiz.speaker: Wizard
reviving-the-watchtower-talking-to-a-wiz.text: You will need to speak to the Watchtower Wizard.

reviving-the-watchtower-talking-to-a-wiz.speaker: Wizard
reviving-the-watchtower-talking-to-a-wiz.text: Seriously, he's the one in charge here.

reviving-the-watchtower-pulling-the-leve.text: You need to put the crystals on the correct pillars before the shield will work. All that happens now is a rather unsatisfying clunking noise.

reviving-the-watchtower-placing-a-crysta.text: That is not the right crystal for this pillar; try another.

reviving-the-watchtower-activating-the-s.text: 15,250 Magic experience, 5,000 coins, and a spell scroll

reviving-the-watchtower-activating-the-s.speaker: Watchtower Wizard
reviving-the-watchtower-activating-the-s.text: Marvellous! It works! The town will now be safe. Take these coins as a token of my gratitude. Also, let me improve your Magic level.

reviving-the-watchtower-activating-the-s.speaker: Watchtower Wizard
reviving-the-watchtower-activating-the-s.text: I've given you a special scroll too - it's a new spell. Read the scroll and you will be able to teleport yourself here.
Congratulations, you've completed a quest: Watchtower
