Right, that's all the heroes recruited. I should probably check in with Idria.

forming-a-fellowship-first-recruitment-t.speaker: Cyrisus
forming-a-fellowship-first-recruitment-t.text: Well, this is all quite exciting. It's an illustrious group that you've invited me to join.

forming-a-fellowship-first-recruitment-t.player: We're happy to have you along. You've become quite the warrior.

forming-a-fellowship-first-recruitment-t.speaker: Cyrisus
forming-a-fellowship-first-recruitment-t.text: I suppose I've not done badly. Still, without you, I'd be nothing more than a coward. Thank you, friend. I won't let you down.

forming-a-fellowship-using-the-serum-tal.player: Hey, Idria. I've recruited those heroes. They're all quite keen to take on Lucien.

forming-a-fellowship-using-the-serum-tal.speaker: Idria
forming-a-fellowship-using-the-serum-tal.text: They are not the kind of people to let evil thrive. That is why we picked them.

forming-a-fellowship-using-the-serum-tal.player: So what now?

forming-a-fellowship-using-the-serum-tal.speaker: Idria
forming-a-fellowship-using-the-serum-tal.text: You should check in with Thaerisk. Getting that truth serum sorted is our next priority.

forming-a-fellowship-using-the-serum-tal.speaker: Thaerisk
forming-a-fellowship-using-the-serum-tal.text: Hello again, [player name]. I imagine that snapdragon seed will have grown by now. You should head on up and check on it.

forming-a-fellowship-using-the-serum-tal.speaker: Akrisae
forming-a-fellowship-using-the-serum-tal.text: Saradomin be with you, [player name]. How are things going with that truth serum?

forming-a-fellowship-using-the-serum-tal.player: I reckon the enriched snapdragon might have grown by now.

forming-a-fellowship-using-the-serum-tal.speaker: Akrisae
forming-a-fellowship-using-the-serum-tal.text: Hmm... Might be worth you going and checking on it.

forming-a-fellowship-using-the-serum-tal.speaker: Idria
forming-a-fellowship-using-the-serum-tal.text: Hello, [player name]. How are things going?

forming-a-fellowship-using-the-serum-tal.player: I'm nearly there with that replacement truth serum.

forming-a-fellowship-using-the-serum-tal.speaker: Idria
forming-a-fellowship-using-the-serum-tal.text: Well if you need any help with it, just talk to Thaerisk.

forming-a-fellowship-using-the-serum-tal.player: Hello there.

forming-a-fellowship-using-the-serum-tal.speaker: Druid
forming-a-fellowship-using-the-serum-tal.text: Good day to you. The enriched snapdragon is fully grown and ready for you to harvest.

forming-a-fellowship-using-the-serum-tal.player: Hello there.

forming-a-fellowship-using-the-serum-tal.speaker: Druid
forming-a-fellowship-using-the-serum-tal.text: Good day to you. You should take that enriched snapdragon to Thaerisk.

forming-a-fellowship-using-the-serum-tal.player: Okay, will do.

forming-a-fellowship-using-the-serum-tal.speaker: Druid
forming-a-fellowship-using-the-serum-tal.text: Good day to you.

forming-a-fellowship-using-the-serum-tal.player: I lost the enriched snapdragon I harvested.

forming-a-fellowship-using-the-serum-tal.speaker: Druid
forming-a-fellowship-using-the-serum-tal.text: Not to worry. There was some left over after you were done.
The druid gives you some enriched snapdragon.

forming-a-fellowship-using-the-serum-tal.player: Thanks.

forming-a-fellowship-using-the-serum-tal.speaker: Thaerisk
forming-a-fellowship-using-the-serum-tal.text: Hello again, [player name]. I imagine that snapdragon seed will have grown by now.

forming-a-fellowship-using-the-serum-tal.player: Yes, I have the herb right here.

forming-a-fellowship-using-the-serum-tal.speaker: Thaerisk
forming-a-fellowship-using-the-serum-tal.text: Excellent! I have a regular truth serum for you. Just add the herb to it and it should be ready to go. Given what happened before, it might be best if you administer it yourself this time.
If the player's inventory is full:

steps.text: Thaerisk tries to give you some truth serum, but you don't have enough room for it.

forming-a-fellowship-using-the-serum-tal.text: Thaerisk gives you some truth serum.

forming-a-fellowship-using-the-serum-tal.speaker: Thaerisk
forming-a-fellowship-using-the-serum-tal.text: Hello again, [player name]. How are things going with that truth serum?

forming-a-fellowship-using-the-serum-tal.player: I still need to make some.

forming-a-fellowship-using-the-serum-tal.speaker: Thaerisk
forming-a-fellowship-using-the-serum-tal.text: Well you should just need to add the enriched snapdragon to a regular truth serum. Given what happened before, it might be best if you administer it yourself this time.

forming-a-fellowship-using-the-serum-tal.speaker: Akrisae
forming-a-fellowship-using-the-serum-tal.text: Saradomin be with you, [player name]. How are things going with that truth serum?

forming-a-fellowship-using-the-serum-tal.player: We're nearly there now. I just need to prepare the serum.

forming-a-fellowship-using-the-serum-tal.speaker: Akrisae
forming-a-fellowship-using-the-serum-tal.text: Glad to hear it!

forming-a-fellowship-using-the-serum-tal.player: Hello, Idria.

forming-a-fellowship-using-the-serum-tal.speaker: Idria
forming-a-fellowship-using-the-serum-tal.text: Hello, [player name]. How are things going?

forming-a-fellowship-using-the-serum-tal.player: I'm nearly there with that replacement truth serum.

forming-a-fellowship-using-the-serum-tal.speaker: Idria
forming-a-fellowship-using-the-serum-tal.text: Well if you need any help with it, just talk to Thaerisk.

forming-a-fellowship-using-the-serum-mix.text: You mix the enriched snapdragon into the truth serum. It dissolves immediately and gives off a pleasant aroma.

forming-a-fellowship-using-the-serum-tal.speaker: Thaerisk
forming-a-fellowship-using-the-serum-tal.text: Hello again, [player name]. How are things going with that truth serum?

forming-a-fellowship-using-the-serum-tal.player: I have some right here.

forming-a-fellowship-using-the-serum-tal.speaker: Thaerisk
forming-a-fellowship-using-the-serum-tal.text: Excellent! Given what happened before, it might be best if you administer it yourself this time. Just head into the cell when you're ready.

forming-a-fellowship-using-the-serum-tal.speaker: Akrisae
forming-a-fellowship-using-the-serum-tal.text: Saradomin be with you, [player name]. How are things going with that truth serum?

forming-a-fellowship-using-the-serum-tal.player: I have the replacement right here.

forming-a-fellowship-using-the-serum-tal.speaker: Akrisae
forming-a-fellowship-using-the-serum-tal.text: Praise Saradomin! May I suggest you be the one to give it to the spy this time so we avoid any more... accidents.

forming-a-fellowship-using-the-serum-tal.player: Hello, Idria.

forming-a-fellowship-using-the-serum-tal.speaker: Idria
forming-a-fellowship-using-the-serum-tal.text: Hello, [player name]. How are things going?

forming-a-fellowship-using-the-serum-tal.player: I have some replacement truth serum.

forming-a-fellowship-using-the-serum-tal.speaker: Idria
forming-a-fellowship-using-the-serum-tal.text: Perfect! Let's get it administered and see what this spy knows.

forming-a-fellowship-using-the-serum-sea.text: You search the drawers and find some papyrus and some charcoal.

forming-a-fellowship-using-the-serum-tal.speaker: Shady stranger
forming-a-fellowship-using-the-serum-tal.text: If you think I'm going to talk, you're kidding yourself!

forming-a-fellowship-using-the-serum-tal.player: We'll see about that.

forming-a-fellowship-using-the-serum-tal.prompt: Give the stranger the truth serum?

steps.player: Right then. We've tried this the easy way, so now we're doing it the hard way! Drink this serum or I'll run you through like the dog you are!

steps.speaker: Shady stranger
steps.text: Oh, well, I guess I can cooperate... Down in one, right?
The stranger drinks the truth serum down to the last drop...

steps.player: Okay, it's time for you to talk. Where is Lucien?

steps.speaker: Shady stranger
steps.text: I don't know! I've never even met him!

steps.player: Then who gives you your orders?

steps.speaker: Shady stranger
steps.text: They call him the Dark Squall. He's super secretive! I don't know his real name!

steps.player: I'm going to need more than that!

steps.speaker: Shady stranger
steps.text: Wait! I can tell you what he looks like!
If the player does not have charcoal and papyrus:

steps.player: Alright, let me grab some things to sketch him with and I'll be back.

steps.text: If the player has charcoal and papyrus:

steps.player: Go on...

steps.speaker: Shady stranger
steps.text: He wears a hooded burgundy robe with purple trim and a strange diamond-shaped symbol on the front. Over the top he wears a tan jacket.

steps.player: And his face?

steps.speaker: Shady stranger
steps.text: He hides it with a red mask!
You quickly make a sketch that matches the stranger's description of the Dark Squall.

steps.speaker: Shady stranger
steps.text: That's all I know, I promise!

steps.player: Hmm... Very well.

forming-a-fellowship-using-the-serum-tal.speaker: Shady stranger
forming-a-fellowship-using-the-serum-tal.text: Please... I can tell you what the Dark Squall looks like!

forming-a-fellowship-using-the-serum-tal.player: Alright, let me grab some things to sketch him with and I'll be back.
Right, tell me what this Dark Squall looks like.

forming-a-fellowship-using-the-serum-tal.speaker: Shady stranger
forming-a-fellowship-using-the-serum-tal.text: He wears a hooded burgundy robe with purple trim and a strange diamond-shaped symbol on the front. Over the top he wears a tan jacket.

forming-a-fellowship-using-the-serum-tal.player: And his face?

forming-a-fellowship-using-the-serum-tal.speaker: Shady stranger
forming-a-fellowship-using-the-serum-tal.text: He hides it with a red mask!
You quickly make a sketch that matches the stranger's description of the Dark Squall.

forming-a-fellowship-using-the-serum-tal.speaker: Shady stranger
forming-a-fellowship-using-the-serum-tal.text: That's all I know, I promise!

forming-a-fellowship-using-the-serum-tal.player: Hmm... Very well.
Remind me what this Dark Squall looks like.

forming-a-fellowship-using-the-serum-tal.speaker: Shady stranger
forming-a-fellowship-using-the-serum-tal.text: He wears a hooded burgundy robe with purple trim and a strange diamond-shaped symbol on the front. Over the top he wears a tan jacket.

forming-a-fellowship-using-the-serum-tal.player: And his face?

forming-a-fellowship-using-the-serum-tal.speaker: Shady stranger
forming-a-fellowship-using-the-serum-tal.text: He hides it with a red mask!

options.text: If the player does not have the sketch

steps.text: You quickly make a sketch that matches the stranger's description of the Dark Squall.

forming-a-fellowship-using-the-serum-tal.speaker: Shady stranger
forming-a-fellowship-using-the-serum-tal.text: That's all I know, I promise!

forming-a-fellowship-using-the-serum-tal.player: Hmm... Very well.

forming-a-fellowship-using-the-serum-tal.speaker: Thaerisk
forming-a-fellowship-using-the-serum-tal.text: Any luck with the spy, [player name]?

forming-a-fellowship-using-the-serum-tal.player: He's willing to give me details on a person of interest.

forming-a-fellowship-using-the-serum-tal.speaker: Thaerisk
forming-a-fellowship-using-the-serum-tal.text: Well if you need anything, I'm sure Akrisae can help.

forming-a-fellowship-using-the-serum-tal.player: I've given the truth serum to the spy, but I need to make a sketch of a person of interest.

forming-a-fellowship-using-the-serum-tal.speaker: Idria
forming-a-fellowship-using-the-serum-tal.text: Well if needed, I'm sure Akrisae will be able to help you with that.

forming-a-fellowship-using-the-serum-tal.speaker: Akrisae
forming-a-fellowship-using-the-serum-tal.text: Saradomin be with you, [player name]. How are things going with that spy?

forming-a-fellowship-using-the-serum-tal.player: He's prepared to give me details on a person of interest.

forming-a-fellowship-using-the-serum-tal.speaker: Akrisae
forming-a-fellowship-using-the-serum-tal.text: You'll be wanting to make a sketch no doubt? Charcoal and papyrus are standard equipment in our line of work. There should be some nearby if you need them.

forming-a-fellowship-second-recruitment-.player: Right, I've questioned the spy and he gave me a description of someone called the Dark Squall.

forming-a-fellowship-second-recruitment-.speaker: Idria
forming-a-fellowship-second-recruitment-.text: Dark Squall?

forming-a-fellowship-second-recruitment-.player: Apparently the spy works for him rather than Lucien directly.

forming-a-fellowship-second-recruitment-.speaker: Thaerisk
forming-a-fellowship-second-recruitment-.text: I suppose it makes sense that Lucien would work through a proxy. Still, this doesn't give us a lot to go on.

forming-a-fellowship-second-recruitment-.speaker: Idria
forming-a-fellowship-second-recruitment-.text: True, but we'll just have to work with what we've got. You said the spy gave you a description?

steps.text: If the player has the sketch

steps.player: Yes, I made a sketch of what he described.

steps.speaker: Idria
steps.text: Let's have a look.
You give the sketch to Idria.

steps.speaker: Idria
steps.text: Yes, I reckon we can work with this. I'll arrange for some wanted posters to be put up.

steps.speaker: Akrisae
steps.text: And I'll pass copies on to our spy network. Hopefully we'll have something before long.

steps.player: So what now?

steps.speaker: Idria
steps.text: We have three more heroes that we'd like you to recruit to our cause.

steps.player: Who are we after this time?

steps.speaker: Idria
steps.text: Ghommal, Sloane and Harrallak. All three are members of the Warriors' Guild. Given their nature, we have no doubt they'll agree to join us once you explain the situation.

forming-a-fellowship-second-recruitment-.text: If the player does not have the sketch

steps.player: Yes, and I made a sketch... though I seem to have misplaced it.

steps.speaker: Akrisae
steps.text: You'll need to make another then. We're going to need that sketch if we're to find this Dark Squall.

forming-a-fellowship-second-recruitment-.speaker: Akrisae
forming-a-fellowship-second-recruitment-.text: Saradomin be with you, [player name]. I hear Idria has you recruiting more heroes to our cause. You should speak to her if you need help with anything.

forming-a-fellowship-second-recruitment-.speaker: Idria
forming-a-fellowship-second-recruitment-.text: Hello again, [player name]. Have you managed to recruit those heroes yet?

forming-a-fellowship-second-recruitment-.player: Not yet.

forming-a-fellowship-second-recruitment-.speaker: Idria
forming-a-fellowship-second-recruitment-.text: Remember, you're aiming to convince Ghommal, Sloane and Harrallak to join us. All three are members of the Warriors' Guild.

forming-a-fellowship-second-recruitment-.speaker: Akrisae
forming-a-fellowship-second-recruitment-.text: Hello there, [player name]. I believe Idria has more heroes for you to recruit. You should speak to her about the details.

forming-a-fellowship-second-recruitment-.speaker: Ghommal
forming-a-fellowship-second-recruitment-.text: Can I help you?

options.text: What are you doing out here?
I need to talk to you about Lucien.

steps.player: I need to talk to you about Lucien.

steps.speaker: Ghommal
steps.text: Lucien? Who's that?

steps.player: He's a powerful Mahjarrat who's trying to achieve godhood!

steps.speaker: Ghommal
steps.text: Ah, yes, I remember this name now. Harrallak has spoken of him before.

steps.player: I'm working with an alliance of people who are trying to stop him. We were hoping you would join us.

steps.speaker: Ghommal
steps.text: A chance to put down evil is a chance I will never refuse! You have my support.

steps.player: Great! We've established a base of operations at the White Knights' Castle. Join us there when you're ready.

steps.speaker: Ghommal
steps.text: I will need to make arrangements with Laidee so we have someone to take care of the Guild. Once that is done, I will join you.

steps.player: Okay, great, thanks!

options.text: I'm here to talk about Combat Achievements.

forming-a-fellowship-second-recruitment-.speaker: Ghommal
forming-a-fellowship-second-recruitment-.text: Can I help you?

options.text: What are you doing out here?
I need to talk to you about Lucien.

steps.player: I need to talk to you about Lucien.

steps.speaker: Ghommal
steps.text: I have already agreed to join your cause. I just need to make arrangements so we have someone to take care of the Guild while I'm gone.

options.text: I'm here to talk about Combat Achievements.

forming-a-fellowship-second-recruitment-.speaker: Ghommal
forming-a-fellowship-second-recruitment-.text: When are we going to have this fight? I tire of waiting.

forming-a-fellowship-second-recruitment-.player: We're not ready quite yet, but I'm sure it won't be long.

forming-a-fellowship-second-recruitment-.speaker: Ghommal
forming-a-fellowship-second-recruitment-.text: Good. This Mahjarrat will soon know pain!

forming-a-fellowship-second-recruitment-.speaker: Harrallak Menarous
forming-a-fellowship-second-recruitment-.text: Welcome to my humble Guild, [player name].

options.text: Quite a place you've got here.
I need to talk to you about Lucien.

steps.player: I need to talk to you about Lucien.

steps.speaker: Harrallak Menarous
steps.text: Lucien? You speak of the Mahjarrat?

steps.player: You know of him?

steps.speaker: Harrallak Menarous
steps.text: Oh yes. Many years ago, I was one of a group of heroes recruited by the Temple Knights to help stop his attack on Varrock.

steps.speaker: Harrallak Menarous
steps.text: Not that they really needed us. He was no Zemouregal, and his attack didn't really amount to much.

steps.player: Well I'm afraid he's grown a lot more powerful since then. He's managed to claim the Staff of Armadyl and is looking to ascend to godhood!

steps.speaker: Harrallak Menarous
steps.text: I see... That is disturbing news, my friend. I take it you seek my help in fighting against him once more?

steps.player: Yes. We've formed an alliance that's trying to stop him and would like you to join us.

steps.speaker: Harrallak Menarous
steps.text: My friend, it would be an honour. My sword is yours.

steps.player: Thank you, Harrallak. When you're ready, head over to the White Knights' Castle.

steps.speaker: Harrallak Menarous
steps.text: I will join you there as soon as I'm able.

options.text: You any good with a sword?

forming-a-fellowship-second-recruitment-.speaker: Harrallak Menarous
forming-a-fellowship-second-recruitment-.text: Welcome to my humble Guild, [player name].

options.text: Quite a place you've got here.
I need to talk to you about Lucien.

steps.player: I need to talk to you about Lucien.

steps.speaker: Harrallak Menarous
steps.text: Don't worry, friend. I will be joining you at the White Knights' Castle shortly.

options.text: You any good with a sword?

forming-a-fellowship-second-recruitment-.speaker: Harrallak Menarous
forming-a-fellowship-second-recruitment-.text: Ah, it's good to get going on a real adventure again. The Guild takes up so much of my time these days.

forming-a-fellowship-second-recruitment-.player: You're not apprehensive about the dangers ahead?

forming-a-fellowship-second-recruitment-.speaker: Harrallak Menarous
forming-a-fellowship-second-recruitment-.text: Absolutely, but I positively relish them as well. There's nothing like a bit of danger to get the blood pumping.

forming-a-fellowship-second-recruitment-.speaker: Sloane
forming-a-fellowship-second-recruitment-.text: Ah, hello there, warrior.

forming-a-fellowship-second-recruitment-.speaker: Sloane
forming-a-fellowship-second-recruitment-.text: Ah, but I can see you are already as strong as is possible! Perhaps you have come to me to purchase a Cape of Strength, and thus join the elite few who have mastered this exacting skill?

forming-a-fellowship-second-recruitment-.speaker: Sloane
forming-a-fellowship-second-recruitment-.text: As an additional recognition of your achievement, the Cape of Strength can teleport you to our guild.

options.text: May I buy a Skillcape of Strength, please?
I need to talk to you about Lucien.

steps.player: I need to talk to you about Lucien.

steps.speaker: Sloane
steps.text: Lucien? I've heard the name, but never in a good way.

steps.player: Then you know the danger he poses. He's stolen the Staff of Armadyl and is trying to ascend to godhood!

steps.speaker: Sloane
steps.text: The Staff of Armadyl? I have heard tales of this artefact, but I assumed it to be a mere myth.

steps.player: I'm afraid not.

steps.speaker: Sloane
steps.text: Then it sounds like this evil must be brought to justice. What can I do?

steps.player: Well we've formed an alliance at the White Knights' Castle that we'd like you to join. I warn you though, it could be dangerous.

steps.speaker: Sloane
steps.text: Like my father before me, and his father before him, I live by an ancient code, my friend. It is what led me to the Warriors' Guild and it drives me every day.

steps.speaker: Sloane
steps.text: I will not sit idly by and see evil flourish. Danger is nothing to a warrior who is true to his heart.

steps.player: So is that a yes?

steps.speaker: Sloane
steps.text: If by lending my axe to this quest, it offers a better chance of success, then I will see it through. I will stand with you.

steps.player: Glad to have you with us!
Right, that's everyone recruited. I should probably head back to Falador.

forming-a-fellowship-second-recruitment-.speaker: Sloane
forming-a-fellowship-second-recruitment-.text: Ah, hello there, warrior.

forming-a-fellowship-second-recruitment-.speaker: Sloane
forming-a-fellowship-second-recruitment-.text: Ah, but I can see you are already as strong as is possible! Perhaps you have come to me to purchase a Cape of Strength, and thus join the elite few who have mastered this exacting skill?

forming-a-fellowship-second-recruitment-.speaker: Sloane
forming-a-fellowship-second-recruitment-.text: As an additional recognition of your achievement, the Cape of Strength can teleport you to our guild.

options.text: May I buy a Skillcape of Strength, please?
I need to talk to you about Lucien.

steps.player: I need to talk to you about Lucien.

steps.speaker: Sloane
steps.text: You have my axe, friend. I just need to finish up some things here, but then I will join you.

forming-a-fellowship-second-recruitment-.speaker: Sloane
forming-a-fellowship-second-recruitment-.text: Well, I'm ready and waiting to get going. Do you know how long it will be?

forming-a-fellowship-second-recruitment-.player: I'm not sure, but I don't expect it will be long.

forming-a-fellowship-second-recruitment-.speaker: Sloane
forming-a-fellowship-second-recruitment-.text: Then I shall use this time to train. After all, there's no such thing as being overprepared.

forming-a-fellowship-second-recruitment-.speaker: Idria
forming-a-fellowship-second-recruitment-.text: Hello again, [player name]. Good work recruiting those heroes. I reckon our task force is now complete.

forming-a-fellowship-second-recruitment-.player: Great! What happens now?

forming-a-fellowship-second-recruitment-.speaker: Idria
forming-a-fellowship-second-recruitment-.text: You should speak to Akrisae. There has been a development that he can fill you in on.

forming-a-fellowship-second-recruitment-.speaker: Thaerisk
forming-a-fellowship-second-recruitment-.text: Hello there, [player name]. Akrisae was hoping to speak with you.

forming-a-fellowship-second-recruitment-.speaker: Akrisae
forming-a-fellowship-second-recruitment-.text: Ah, there you are, [player name]. There has been a potential development in our hunt for the Dark Squall, but I am concerned about...

forming-a-fellowship-second-recruitment-.speaker: Akrisae
forming-a-fellowship-second-recruitment-.text: Hang on... did you hear that?
A cutscene begins.

forming-a-fellowship-second-recruitment-.speaker: Thaerisk
forming-a-fellowship-second-recruitment-.text: It sounds like... footsteps? But really small ones...
The camera shifts toward the opposing door.
knock knock knock*

forming-a-fellowship-second-recruitment-.speaker: Akrisae
forming-a-fellowship-second-recruitment-.text: Er... come in?
Hazelmere comes through the door, and casts a mind melding spell to communicate with you.

forming-a-fellowship-second-recruitment-.player: Hazelmere?!

forming-a-fellowship-second-recruitment-.speaker: Hazelmere
forming-a-fellowship-second-recruitment-.text: Ah, I see you're already here, human. Good.

forming-a-fellowship-second-recruitment-.player: I don't understand... What are you doing here?

forming-a-fellowship-second-recruitment-.speaker: Hazelmere
forming-a-fellowship-second-recruitment-.text: Were you not paying attention when we last spoke? We find ourselves on the edge of a very dark future, one where the Mahjarrat deceiver is successful.

forming-a-fellowship-second-recruitment-.player: Lucien?

forming-a-fellowship-second-recruitment-.speaker: Hazelmere

forming-a-fellowship-second-recruitment-.speaker: Hazelmere
forming-a-fellowship-second-recruitment-.text: The Anima Mundi gave me a choice, and I have made it. If this is to be my last winter, then I go knowing the world will live on to see the next.

forming-a-fellowship-second-recruitment-.player: Hazelmere, I...

forming-a-fellowship-second-recruitment-.speaker: Thaerisk
forming-a-fellowship-second-recruitment-.text: Er... Sorry to interrupt, [player name], but would you mind explaining who this is?

forming-a-fellowship-second-recruitment-.player: Ah... yes, sorry. This is Hazelmere, one of the gnomes who created the Grand Tree in the Gnome Stronghold.

forming-a-fellowship-second-recruitment-.speaker: Thaerisk
forming-a-fellowship-second-recruitment-.text: Ah, so you're Hazelmere! I've heard much about you!

forming-a-fellowship-second-recruitment-.speaker: Hazelmere
forming-a-fellowship-second-recruitment-.text: Blah blah blah Guthix blah blah!

forming-a-fellowship-second-recruitment-.speaker: Thaerisk
forming-a-fellowship-second-recruitment-.text: Er... Sorry, I didn't quite catch that.

forming-a-fellowship-second-recruitment-.speaker: Hazelmere
forming-a-fellowship-second-recruitment-.text: sigh* Ipmesi human.

forming-a-fellowship-second-recruitment-.player: Ah, so that's what that looks like from the outside.

forming-a-fellowship-second-recruitment-.speaker: Akrisae
forming-a-fellowship-second-recruitment-.text: Would you care to explain what's going on?

forming-a-fellowship-second-recruitment-.player: Hazelmere can mind meld with other people, allowing him to speak telepathically with them.

forming-a-fellowship-second-recruitment-.speaker: Akrisae
forming-a-fellowship-second-recruitment-.text: Does he not speak the common tongue?

forming-a-fellowship-second-recruitment-.player: It's not that he can't... He just chooses not to.

forming-a-fellowship-second-recruitment-.speaker: Akrisae
forming-a-fellowship-second-recruitment-.text: How bizarre.

forming-a-fellowship-second-recruitment-.speaker: Thaerisk
forming-a-fellowship-second-recruitment-.text: Right... I believe I need to make some introductions. If you'll excuse us...

forming-a-fellowship-second-recruitment-.speaker: Hazelmere
forming-a-fellowship-second-recruitment-.text: Blah blah!

forming-a-fellowship-second-recruitment-.speaker: Akrisae
forming-a-fellowship-second-recruitment-.text: Well that was... interesting.

forming-a-fellowship-second-recruitment-.player: Yeah... that's Hazelmere for you. Anyway, you said there had been a development.

forming-a-fellowship-second-recruitment-.speaker: Akrisae
forming-a-fellowship-second-recruitment-.text: That's right. We had a reported sighting of someone matching the description of the Dark Squall near the Black Knights' Fortress.

forming-a-fellowship-second-recruitment-.speaker: Thaerisk
forming-a-fellowship-second-recruitment-.text: The Black Knights' Fortress? Could the Kinshra really have allied with Lucien?

forming-a-fellowship-second-recruitment-.speaker: Akrisae
forming-a-fellowship-second-recruitment-.text: Lord Daquarius is a devout Zamorakian. I doubt he would betray his god.

forming-a-fellowship-second-recruitment-.speaker: Idria
forming-a-fellowship-second-recruitment-.text: Not knowingly perhaps, but who's to say he knows Lucien's true ambition.

forming-a-fellowship-second-recruitment-.speaker: Akrisae
forming-a-fellowship-second-recruitment-.text: A fair point. Regardless, I sent Silif to investigate, but we lost contact with him shortly after he entered the fortress.

forming-a-fellowship-second-recruitment-.player: I'll go to the fortress. If the Dark Squall is there, I'll find him.

forming-a-fellowship-second-recruitment-.speaker: Akrisae
forming-a-fellowship-second-recruitment-.text: Good luck, [player name]. Don't forget to take some sort of disguise with you. I can't see you getting into the fortress otherwise. Oh, and keep an eye out for Silif as well. He may be in need of support.

forming-a-fellowship-second-recruitment-.player: Will do.

forming-a-fellowship-second-recruitment-.speaker: Akrisae
forming-a-fellowship-second-recruitment-.text: If you want, I can speed things up a bit by teleporting you to Ice Mountain.

forming-a-fellowship-second-recruitment-.prompt: Teleport to Ice Mountain? You can only use this teleport once.

steps.player: No thanks.

steps.speaker: Akrisae
steps.text: Very well. You know where I am if you change your mind.

forming-a-fellowship-second-recruitment-.speaker: Akrisae
forming-a-fellowship-second-recruitment-.text: Hello there, [player name]. Any luck finding Silif or the Dark Squall?

forming-a-fellowship-second-recruitment-.player: Not yet.

forming-a-fellowship-second-recruitment-.speaker: Akrisae
forming-a-fellowship-second-recruitment-.text: We lost contact with Silif shortly after he entered the Black Knights' Fortress, so I'd suggest you start there.

forming-a-fellowship-second-recruitment-.speaker: Thaerisk

forming-a-fellowship-second-recruitment-.player: I'm still trying to find Silif and the Dark Squall.

forming-a-fellowship-second-recruitment-.speaker: Thaerisk

forming-a-fellowship-second-recruitment-.speaker: Idria

forming-a-fellowship-second-recruitment-.player: I'm still working on it.

forming-a-fellowship-second-recruitment-.speaker: Idria
forming-a-fellowship-second-recruitment-.text: Well if you need any help, just speak to Akrisae.

forming-a-fellowship-second-recruitment-.speaker: Hazelmere
forming-a-fellowship-second-recruitment-.text: Attempting to perform a mind meld on this many people would be a needless waste of energy, so I find myself forced to use your rudimentary language.

forming-a-fellowship-second-recruitment-.player: Oh come on, it's not that bad!

forming-a-fellowship-second-recruitment-.speaker: Hazelmere
forming-a-fellowship-second-recruitment-.text: Hmph! How much longer are we going to be waiting anyway?

forming-a-fellowship-second-recruitment-.player: Do you have better things to be doing?

forming-a-fellowship-second-recruitment-.speaker: Hazelmere
forming-a-fellowship-second-recruitment-.text: No.

forming-a-fellowship-second-recruitment-.player: Then don't be so impatient. Maybe try socialising or something?

forming-a-fellowship-second-recruitment-.speaker: Hazelmere
forming-a-fellowship-second-recruitment-.text: Bah! No one here will have anything of interest to say. I'm better off conversing with myself.

forming-a-fellowship-second-recruitment-.player: If you're sure...

steps.speaker: Akrisae
steps.text: Very well. Just enter the cell when you're ready.

the-dark-squall-talking-to-idria-again.speaker: Idria
the-dark-squall-talking-to-idria-again.text: Hello there, [player name]. How goes the hunt for Lucien?

the-dark-squall-talking-to-idria-again.speaker: Idria
the-dark-squall-talking-to-idria-again.text: Don't worry, the heroes will be keeping an eye on things from a distance. They'll move in as soon as they have a positive sighting.

the-dark-squall-talking-to-thaerisk-agai.speaker: Thaerisk
the-dark-squall-talking-to-thaerisk-agai.text: Hello, [player name]. How are things going?

the-dark-squall-talking-to-thaerisk-agai.player: I'm still working on finding Lucien.

the-dark-squall-talking-to-thaerisk-agai.speaker: Thaerisk
the-dark-squall-talking-to-thaerisk-agai.text: Well good luck. I have no doubt you'll be successful.

the-dark-squall-lucien-s-wrath.text: The player, on top of the Chaos Temple, arrives just as Lucien teleports in shortly below them.
Lucien summons an army of Undead Heroes using the power of the Staff of Armadyl. Then, he powers himself up.

the-dark-squall-lucien-s-wrath.speaker: Lucien
the-dark-squall-lucien-s-wrath.text: You... Did you really think that disguise would fool me? You are not Surok... and you are not welcome!

Lucien fires a powerful spell towards the player, who narrowly dodges it. He then fires the spell again, whilst two Elite Black Knights approach and attempt to attack the player. Moving backwards to evade their attacks, Lucien's spell hits the two knights instead, disintegrating them to ashes. Meanwhile, Hazelmere observes the attack from afar.

the-dark-squall-lucien-s-wrath.speaker: Hazelmere
the-dark-squall-lucien-s-wrath.text: The human will be toast if we don't move now. Ready for teleport!

The group of heroes teleport, arriving at Lucien's location. Mazchna and Harrallak move to attack the undead heroes, whilst Sloane and Duradel approach Lucien, who instantly disintegrates them with a spell.

Hazelmere conjures a barrage of crystal spikes, and launches them towards Lucien, who takes no damage from it. Cyrisus and Turael move towards Lucien, but their weapons break upon attacking him. Meanwhile, Hazelmere takes Argento's seed pod out and looks at it as it begins to wilt.

the-dark-squall-lucien-s-wrath.speaker: Hazelmere
the-dark-squall-lucien-s-wrath.text: This decision was already made and was for the best. Goodbye, my friends.

the-dark-squall-lucien-s-wrath.player: Get out of there! He's too powerful!

the-dark-squall-lucien-s-wrath.text: Lucien charges up his spell as Ghommal moves to attack Lucien. As he moves in range, Lucien launches the spell and instantly disintegrate the three heroes. The spell continues moving towards Hazelmere, who accepts his fate and is disintegrated.

the-dark-squall-lucien-s-wrath.speaker: Lucien
the-dark-squall-lucien-s-wrath.text: What wonderful devastation! Now, I have things to attend to.

the-dark-squall-lucien-s-wrath.speaker: Mazchna
the-dark-squall-lucien-s-wrath.text: We must find out where Lucien went! Turael and Duradel must be avenged!

the-dark-squall-lucien-s-wrath.speaker: Harrallak Menarous
the-dark-squall-lucien-s-wrath.text: Getting back to Falador would be wiser. Did you see the way he slaughtered us? That our weapons are useless? How many more would die? Some must survive to report this nightmare!

the-dark-squall-lucien-s-wrath.speaker: Mazchna
the-dark-squall-lucien-s-wrath.text: Such knowledge lost with their deaths... You are right. We have suffered enough for one day. We must retreat.

the-dark-squall-lucien-s-wrath.speaker: Harrallak Menarous
the-dark-squall-lucien-s-wrath.text: [player name], get back to Falador! We're teleporting out now!

the-dark-squall-lucien-s-wrath.player: Hazelmere... Cyrisus... What have I done? Lucien will pay for this!

into-the-chasm-talking-to-the-group.speaker: Idria
into-the-chasm-talking-to-the-group.text: [player name]! Thank goodness you're back. When Mazchna reported in, we feared the worst!

into-the-chasm-talking-to-the-group.player: They're gone... All of them... He killed them, like they were nothing!

into-the-chasm-talking-to-the-group.speaker: Thaerisk
into-the-chasm-talking-to-the-group.text: We thought we knew how powerful Lucien had become. We thought we'd prepared appropriately...

into-the-chasm-talking-to-the-group.speaker: Akrisae
into-the-chasm-talking-to-the-group.text: I fear no amount of preparation would have been enough. We were never going to have a hope against that level of power...

into-the-chasm-talking-to-the-group.player: He can't be allowed to get away with this!

into-the-chasm-talking-to-the-group.speaker: Idria
into-the-chasm-talking-to-the-group.text: But what can we do? It seems we already lack the ability to stand against Lucien, and he doesn't even have the Stone yet! With it...

into-the-chasm-talking-to-the-group.speaker: Thaerisk
into-the-chasm-talking-to-the-group.text: He could bring an end to this world without even trying!

into-the-chasm-talking-to-the-group.speaker: Akrisae
into-the-chasm-talking-to-the-group.text: My friends, we cannot afford to lose hope now. The situation is dire, but one of our contacts recently reported in with information that may help us turn things around.

into-the-chasm-talking-to-the-group.speaker: Akrisae
into-the-chasm-talking-to-the-group.text: Movario has been sighted entering the caves below Lumbridge Swamp.

into-the-chasm-talking-to-the-group.speaker: Idria
into-the-chasm-talking-to-the-group.text: Lumbridge Swamp? There's nothing of value there, is there?

into-the-chasm-talking-to-the-group.speaker: Thaerisk
into-the-chasm-talking-to-the-group.text: Nothing that we know of, but Movario has shown interest in the area before. He wouldn't be going back there now without good reason.

into-the-chasm-talking-to-the-group.player: You don't think the Stone is down there, do you?

into-the-chasm-talking-to-the-group.speaker: Thaerisk
into-the-chasm-talking-to-the-group.text: If there's any chance that it is, then we must make sure he doesn't find it.

into-the-chasm-talking-to-the-group.player: Hmm... I may have an idea. I could use my Dark Squall disguise to approach Movario.
I can find out what he knows, and if the Stone is down there, I can hopefully reach it before he does.

into-the-chasm-talking-to-the-group.speaker: Idria
into-the-chasm-talking-to-the-group.text: It's a risky plan, but I suspect it's the only one we've got.

into-the-chasm-talking-to-the-group.player: Akrisae, do we have any information on where exactly in these caves Movario is?

into-the-chasm-talking-to-the-group.speaker: Akrisae
into-the-chasm-talking-to-the-group.text: He was last seen entering a large cavern filled with some mysterious floating lights.

into-the-chasm-talking-to-the-group.player: I can work with that. I'll head over there right away.

into-the-chasm-talking-to-akrisae.speaker: Akrisae
into-the-chasm-talking-to-akrisae.text: Saradomin be with you, [player name]. How goes your mission?

into-the-chasm-talking-to-akrisae.speaker: Akrisae
into-the-chasm-talking-to-akrisae.text: According to our contact, he was seen entering a large cavern filled with mysterious floating lights somewhere within the Lumbridge Swamp Caves.

into-the-chasm-talking-to-akrisae.speaker: Akrisae
into-the-chasm-talking-to-akrisae.text: Don't forget to disguise yourself as the Dark Squall before you approach him. We need to convince him you're someone he can trust.

options.text: Could you tell me a bit more about yourself?
What do you know about the Stone of Jas?

steps.player: About the heroes...

steps.speaker: Akrisae
steps.text: They will always be remembered, my friend. I've already made arrangements to have statues built in their honour. Everyone will know of their bravery, and their sacrifice.

steps.player: Statues? I think they'd have liked that. Thank you, Akrisae.

options.text: What do you think of Thaerisk?
What do you think of Idria?

into-the-chasm-talking-to-thaerisk.speaker: Thaerisk
into-the-chasm-talking-to-thaerisk.text: Good to see you, [player name]. How are things going?

into-the-chasm-talking-to-thaerisk.speaker: Thaerisk
into-the-chasm-talking-to-thaerisk.text: Akrisae said he'd been seen in the Lumbridge Swamp Caves. There was mention of a large cavern filled with mysterious floating lights.

into-the-chasm-talking-to-thaerisk.speaker: Thaerisk
into-the-chasm-talking-to-thaerisk.text: Just remember, you'll need to disguise yourself as the Dark Squall. That should convince Movario that you're working with him.

options.text: Tell me a bit more about yourself, Thaerisk.
What do you know about the Stone of Jas?

steps.player: About the heroes...

steps.speaker: Thaerisk
steps.text: Lucien will not be allowed to get away with his actions, my friend. We will stop him.

steps.player: So you believe in revenge?

steps.speaker: Thaerisk
steps.text: Revenge? No. However, I do believe in justice. I know some druids would even challenge that, but a world without justice is a world without balance.

steps.speaker: Thaerisk
steps.text: Lucien, and those like him, must be held accountable for their actions. It falls to people like us to ensure that happens. It's the only way the world will stay safe.

steps.player: I just hope we can stop him soon.

steps.speaker: Thaerisk
steps.text: We will, my friend. With people like you fighting for our cause, Lucien has no hope.

options.text: What do you think of Akrisae?
What do you think of Idria?

into-the-chasm-talking-to-idria.speaker: Idria
into-the-chasm-talking-to-idria.text: Hello there, [player name]. Any luck with Movario?

into-the-chasm-talking-to-idria.speaker: Idria
into-the-chasm-talking-to-idria.text: According to Akrisae, he was last seen somewhere in the Lumbridge Swamp Caves, in a large cavern filled with mysterious floating lights.

into-the-chasm-talking-to-idria.speaker: Idria
into-the-chasm-talking-to-idria.text: If you disguise yourself as the Dark Squall, you'll hopefully be able to convince him you're working with him.

options.text: Do you mind if I ask you a bit about yourself?
What do you know about the Stone of Jas?

steps.player: About the heroes...

steps.speaker: Idria
steps.text: They will never be forgotten, [player name].

steps.player: It just feels like they died for nothing.

steps.speaker: Idria
steps.text: I know how you feel, but the sacrifices we make... it's never for nothing. They were willing to stand against a great evil so that the world might be safe.

steps.speaker: Idria
steps.text: That's how I know that Lucien will never win. We fight for something that he will never understand, and we do so no matter the chance of success.

steps.speaker: Idria
steps.text: Because of that, our sacrifices will always have far more meaning than anything he stands for.

steps.player: Thank you, Idria. That means a lot.

options.text: What do you think of Akrisae?
What do you think of Thaerisk?

into-the-chasm-talking-to-movario-in-dis.player: Movario?

into-the-chasm-talking-to-movario-in-dis.speaker: Movario
into-the-chasm-talking-to-movario-in-dis.text: What's it to you?

into-the-chasm-talking-to-movario-in-dis.player: Lucien has sent me to check on your progress.

into-the-chasm-talking-to-movario-in-dis.speaker: Darve
into-the-chasm-talking-to-movario-in-dis.text: Movario! That's...

into-the-chasm-talking-to-movario-in-dis.speaker: Movario
into-the-chasm-talking-to-movario-in-dis.text: Yes, Darve, I can see who it is. Let it be known, Surok, that I am not one of your minions. I will not bow down to your attempts to intimidate me.

into-the-chasm-talking-to-movario-in-dis.speaker: Movario
into-the-chasm-talking-to-movario-in-dis.text: As for my progress, you can tell Lucien that the investigations would be greatly expedited if I weren't subject to all these interruptions!

into-the-chasm-talking-to-movario-in-dis.player: Then allow me to expedite things myself. Time is now of the essence and Lucien's patience is wearing thin.

into-the-chasm-talking-to-movario-in-dis.speaker: Movario
into-the-chasm-talking-to-movario-in-dis.text: You would take over? Preposterous!

into-the-chasm-talking-to-movario-in-dis.player: While Lucien has asked me to oversee your investigations, I am not unreasonable. Believe it or not, I've actually read much of your detailed research myself.
You are clearly an expert in this area, and I am open to letting you continue to take the lead, provided we are able to quickly conclude our work here.

into-the-chasm-talking-to-movario-in-dis.speaker: Darve
into-the-chasm-talking-to-movario-in-dis.text: Looks like we don't have much choice, boss.

into-the-chasm-talking-to-movario-in-dis.player: Now, please share what you know with me.

into-the-chasm-talking-to-movario-in-dis.speaker: Movario
into-the-chasm-talking-to-movario-in-dis.text: Hmph. Very well. Given you have read my research, and given Lucien himself sent you, I trust you know what it is I seek.

into-the-chasm-talking-to-movario-in-dis.player: I do.

into-the-chasm-talking-to-movario-in-dis.speaker: Movario
into-the-chasm-talking-to-movario-in-dis.text: Even with all that I know, I can still scarcely even imagine it! A power beyond even the gods themselves!

into-the-chasm-talking-to-movario-in-dis.player: I am all too aware, but all this means little given you have still not found it.

into-the-chasm-talking-to-movario-in-dis.speaker: Movario
into-the-chasm-talking-to-movario-in-dis.text: Oh, but I believe I have found it. More than that, I believe we are stood right above it.

into-the-chasm-talking-to-movario-in-dis.player: Right above it? Surely you don't mean the chasm?

into-the-chasm-talking-to-movario-in-dis.speaker: Movario
into-the-chasm-talking-to-movario-in-dis.text: That's precisely what I mean. Perhaps now you see the issue that I face. Reaching the bottom will require a significant amount of effort.

into-the-chasm-talking-to-movario-in-dis.speaker: Movario
into-the-chasm-talking-to-movario-in-dis.text: I attempted to recruit some goblins to find a way down, but they proved... inadequate. I fear a gantry will need building, which will not be a quick process.

into-the-chasm-talking-to-movario-in-dis.player: And what about the light creatures? Are they of no use?

into-the-chasm-talking-to-movario-in-dis.speaker: Movario
into-the-chasm-talking-to-movario-in-dis.text: I don't think so... though I suppose they are rather unique. Perhaps I shall study their movements at some point.

into-the-chasm-talking-to-movario-in-dis.speaker: Darve
into-the-chasm-talking-to-movario-in-dis.text: I think Surok has an idea for using them, boss!

into-the-chasm-talking-to-movario-in-dis.player: Allow me to explain. This isn't my first time in these caves. On a previous visit, I found that a special type of lantern with a distinct blue light could attract the creatures.
Once attracted, they'd surround you and carry you to the far side.

into-the-chasm-talking-to-movario-in-dis.speaker: Darve
into-the-chasm-talking-to-movario-in-dis.text: You wouldn't get me in one of those things! Not on your life!

into-the-chasm-talking-to-movario-in-dis.speaker: Movario
into-the-chasm-talking-to-movario-in-dis.text: Shut up, Darve! The adults are talking!

into-the-chasm-talking-to-movario-in-dis.speaker: Movario
into-the-chasm-talking-to-movario-in-dis.text: Did you ever manage to get them to go downwards? To the bottom?

into-the-chasm-talking-to-movario-in-dis.player: No. I assume the lantern isn't bright enough for that.

into-the-chasm-talking-to-movario-in-dis.speaker: Movario
into-the-chasm-talking-to-movario-in-dis.text: Hmm, intriguing! I know of a light spell which might work. If you were to use your lantern to call a creature, I could try and use my spell to send it down to the bottom of the chasm!

into-the-chasm-talking-to-movario-in-dis.speaker: Movario
into-the-chasm-talking-to-movario-in-dis.text: However, that does then pose a problem.

into-the-chasm-talking-to-movario-in-dis.player: Yes?

into-the-chasm-talking-to-movario-in-dis.speaker: Movario
into-the-chasm-talking-to-movario-in-dis.text: Well it would mean you'd be going down first! After all this work, do you really think I'm just going to let you get your hands all over my finds?

into-the-chasm-talking-to-movario-in-dis.player: Your finds? Is that how Lucien would describe them? What do you think he will do if I inform him of your lack of cooperation?

into-the-chasm-talking-to-movario-in-dis.speaker: Movario
into-the-chasm-talking-to-movario-in-dis.text: Okay, fine! Given I have no choice, when you're ready to go down, just attract a light creature. Once you're in position, I'll use my light spell.

into-the-chasm-talking-to-movario-in-dis.player: Movario?

into-the-chasm-talking-to-movario-in-dis.speaker: Movario
into-the-chasm-talking-to-movario-in-dis.text: What's it to you?

into-the-chasm-talking-to-movario-in-dis.player: Nothing, I guess.

into-the-chasm-talking-to-movario-in-dis.speaker: Movario
into-the-chasm-talking-to-movario-in-dis.text: Then be gone, before I set Darve on you!

into-the-chasm-talking-to-movario-in-dis.speaker: Movario
into-the-chasm-talking-to-movario-in-dis.text: Ah, so you've returned. Ready to take your trip to the bottom yet?

into-the-chasm-talking-to-movario-in-dis.speaker: Darve
into-the-chasm-talking-to-movario-in-dis.text: Can we hurry things up? I've got better things to do than hang around these filthy caves!

into-the-chasm-talking-to-movario-in-dis.player: Shut up, Darve!

into-the-chasm-talking-to-movario-in-dis.speaker: Movario
into-the-chasm-talking-to-movario-in-dis.text: Well said!

into-the-chasm-talking-to-movario-in-dis.player: Remind me what I need to do.

into-the-chasm-talking-to-movario-in-dis.speaker: Movario
into-the-chasm-talking-to-movario-in-dis.text: Just attract one of the light creatures using one of those lanterns you were talking about. When you're in position, I'll use my light spell to send you down to the bottom of the chasm.

into-the-chasm-talking-to-movario-in-dis.speaker: Darve
into-the-chasm-talking-to-movario-in-dis.text: I hope that Surok character doesn't come back. There's something not right about him... He makes General Khazard seem normal!

into-the-chasm-talking-to-movario-in-dis.speaker: Movario
into-the-chasm-talking-to-movario-in-dis.text: If you don't like him, be glad you've never met Lucien.

into-the-chasm-talking-to-movario-in-dis.player: Movario?

into-the-chasm-talking-to-movario-in-dis.speaker: Movario
into-the-chasm-talking-to-movario-in-dis.text: What's it to you?

into-the-chasm-talking-to-movario-in-dis.player: Nothing, I guess.

into-the-chasm-talking-to-movario-in-dis.speaker: Movario
into-the-chasm-talking-to-movario-in-dis.text: Then be gone, before I set Darve on you!

into-the-chasm-talking-to-a-cave-goblin.text: If the player is not wearing the Dark Squall's robes or the player has not yet talked to Movario:

steps.speaker: Cave goblin
steps.text: Watch out, surface-dweller! Don't get too close to the edge!

steps.player: What are you doing here?

steps.speaker: Cave goblin
steps.text: Movario's paying us to help him with his expedition. He thin-

steps.speaker: Movario
steps.text: Goblin! What did I tell you about what we're doing here?

steps.speaker: Cave goblin
steps.text: That it's a secret... which means we shouldn't tell strangers about it.

steps.speaker: Movario
steps.text: That's right!

into-the-chasm-talking-to-a-cave-goblin.text: If the player is wearing the Dark Squall's robes:

steps.speaker: Cave goblin
steps.text: Watch out, surface-dweller! Don't get too close to the edge!

steps.player: What are you doing here?

steps.speaker: Cave goblin
steps.text: Movario's paying us to help him with his expedition. He thinks there's something important down this chasm.

steps.player: And how's that going so far?

steps.speaker: Cave goblin
steps.text: Well Ulgon's climbing down to see if he can find the bottom. He didn't reach it last time, so Movario made us get a longer rope.

steps.player: I see. Well good luck.

into-the-chasm-talking-to-darve.text: If the player has not yet talked to Movario:

steps.speaker: Darve
steps.text: What do you want?

steps.player: I'm here to speak to Movario.

steps.speaker: Darve
steps.text: Why you talking to me then? He's right there.

into-the-chasm-talking-to-darve.text: If the player is wearing the Dark Squall's robes:

steps.speaker: Darve
steps.text: Don't think I can help the likes of you! Talk to Movario.

into-the-chasm-talking-to-darve.text: If the player is not wearing the Dark Squall's robes:

steps.speaker: Darve
steps.text: What do you want?

steps.player: Nothing.

steps.speaker: Darve
steps.text: Then get lost!

into-the-chasm-talking-to-juna.player: You mean Movario? Don't worry, I'm trying to stop him.

into-the-chasm-talking-to-juna.speaker: Juna
into-the-chasm-talking-to-juna.text: Are you sure your intentions are pure? Look into your heart. The power Movario and his master seek, a part of you wants this power for yourself.

into-the-chasm-talking-to-juna.player: I promise, my only intention is to stop Movario and Lucien. I won't let them find what they're looking for.

into-the-chasm-talking-to-juna.speaker: Juna
into-the-chasm-talking-to-juna.text: I hope you are right, [player name].

steps.player: About Movario...

steps.speaker: Juna
steps.text: You must stop him and his master. This is a quest that matters above all others.

steps.player: I won't let them find what they're looking for. I promise.

steps.speaker: Juna
steps.text: I hope you are right, [player name].

options.text: I don't want any messages reminding me to return here.

into-the-chasm-arriving-at-the-bottom-of.player: Interesting... Some of the the light creatures followed me! I doubt I'll need that light spell to navigate down here again.

into-the-chasm-inspecting-the-stone-cube.text: You place your hands on the strange cube and the nearby skull opens up...

into-the-chasm-talking-to-movario-after-.speaker: Movario
into-the-chasm-talking-to-movario-after-.text: You've returned! What news of the bottom? What's down there?

into-the-chasm-talking-to-movario-after-.player: Oh, it's very dark down there. I can hardly see anything! It's going to take more work for me to get anywhere.

into-the-chasm-talking-to-movario-after-.speaker: Movario
into-the-chasm-talking-to-movario-after-.text: Well then let me help! Tell me, how do we summon the light creatures? I made one of those blue lanterns, but they still don't seem to come!

into-the-chasm-talking-to-movario-after-.player: I'm not sure. It worked fine for me.

into-the-chasm-talking-to-movario-after-.speaker: Darve
into-the-chasm-talking-to-movario-after-.text: It's that big snake over there! I keep telling you, every time you start enticing one, it does something to them! Why don't you listen to me?

into-the-chasm-talking-to-movario-after-.speaker: Movario
into-the-chasm-talking-to-movario-after-.text: It seems highly unlikely that a snake has that capability. That thing is nothing more than a bloated earth worm! Now silence, Darve!

into-the-chasm-talking-to-movario-after-.speaker: Movario
into-the-chasm-talking-to-movario-after-.text: As for you, what can you tell me about the chasm?

into-the-chasm-talking-to-movario-after-.player: Nothing much. Like I say, it's very dark. Now, I'm sorry, but I've answered your questions. You should let me get back to work.

into-the-chasm-talking-to-movario-after-.speaker: Movario
into-the-chasm-talking-to-movario-after-.text: The impertinence! I'll ask these same questions until I get the answers I need! Now tell me, what's down there?

into-the-chasm-talking-to-movario-after-.player: Oh, it's very dark down there. I can hardly see anything! It's going to take more work for me to get anywhere.

into-the-chasm-talking-to-idria-after-en.speaker: Idria
into-the-chasm-talking-to-idria-after-en.text: Hello there, [player name]. Any luck with Movario?
If the player has entered the chasm:

steps.player: He thinks the Stone is hidden in a chasm deep below the rest of the caves. I've managed to get down there myself, but I haven't found anything of note yet.

steps.speaker: Idria
steps.text: Well then you'd better get back there. If Movario is close to finding the Stone, then we need to find it first.

into-the-chasm-talking-to-idria-after-en.text: If the player has reached the Ancient Guthix Temple:

steps.player: He thinks the Stone is hidden in a chasm deep below the rest of the caves. I've managed to get down there myself and I've found some sort of Guthixian temple.

steps.speaker: Idria
steps.text: Well then you'd better get back there. If Movario is close to finding the Stone, then we need to find it first.

into-the-chasm-talking-to-idria-after-en.text: If the player has found the Stone of Jas:

steps.player: I've found the Stone! It's in a chasm deep below the rest of the caves.

steps.speaker: Idria
steps.text: Well then you need to get back there now and make sure the Stone is safe! I have a party that's nearly ready to support you. We will join you as soon as we can.

into-the-chasm-talking-to-akrisae-after-.speaker: Akrisae
into-the-chasm-talking-to-akrisae-after-.text: Saradomin be with you, [player name]. How goes your mission?
If the player has entered the chasm:

steps.player: Movario thinks the Stone is hidden in a chasm deep below the rest of the caves. I've managed to get down there myself, but I haven't found anything of note yet.

steps.speaker: Akrisae
steps.text: Well keep it up, [player name]. I have no doubt you'll lead us to success.

into-the-chasm-talking-to-akrisae-after-.text: If the player has reached the Ancient Guthix Temple:

steps.player: Movario thinks the Stone is hidden in a chasm deep below the rest of the caves. I've managed to get down there myself and I've found some sort of Guthixian temple.

steps.speaker: Akrisae
steps.text: A Guthixian temple? Curious... You'd better get back there as soon as you can.

into-the-chasm-talking-to-akrisae-after-.text: If the player has found the Stone of Jas:

steps.player: I've found the Stone! It's in a chasm deep below the rest of the caves.

steps.speaker: Akrisae
steps.text: You must speak to Idria at once! She has been preparing a party to support you.

into-the-chasm-talking-to-thaerisk-after.speaker: Thaerisk
into-the-chasm-talking-to-thaerisk-after.text: Good to see you, [player name]. How are things going?
If the player has entered the chasm:

steps.player: Movario thinks the Stone is hidden in a chasm deep below the rest of the caves. I've managed to get down there myself, but I haven't found anything of note yet.

steps.speaker: Thaerisk
steps.text: You'd better get back there as soon as possible, [player name]. We can't let Movario find the Stone.

into-the-chasm-talking-to-thaerisk-after.text: If the player has reached the Ancient Guthix Temple:

steps.player: Movario thinks the Stone is hidden in a chasm deep below the rest of the caves. I've managed to get down there myself and I've found some sort of Guthixian temple.

steps.speaker: Thaerisk
steps.text: A Guthixian temple? This is concerning, [player name]. You'd better get back there as soon as possible.

into-the-chasm-talking-to-thaerisk-after.text: If the player has found the Stone of Jas:

steps.player: I've found the Stone! It's in a chasm deep below the rest of the caves.

steps.speaker: Thaerisk
steps.text: Well then you must get back there as soon as you can! We can't let Lucien get the Stone.

into-the-chasm-the-balance-elemental.text: A cutscene plays. As the player sees the Stone of Jas, energy begins to coalesce in front of it, forming into the Balance Elemental.

into-the-chasm-the-balance-elemental.speaker: Balance Elemental
into-the-chasm-the-balance-elemental.text: In the name of Guthix, what rights do you have here?

into-the-chasm-the-balance-elemental.player: I don't know who you are... or what you are for that matter, but we don't have much time! The Stone is in danger!

into-the-chasm-the-balance-elemental.speaker: Balance Elemental
into-the-chasm-the-balance-elemental.text: The Stone is always in danger. That is why I stand before you, [player name].

into-the-chasm-the-balance-elemental.speaker: Balance Elemental
into-the-chasm-the-balance-elemental.text: I know everything about you, [player name]. I have seen your past, your present and your future.

into-the-chasm-the-balance-elemental.player: Then you must have seen Lucien and his power! We have to get the Stone to safety!

into-the-chasm-the-balance-elemental.speaker: Balance Elemental
into-the-chasm-the-balance-elemental.text: Your duty is noble, [player name], but so is mine: To protect the Stone until a time when, near to death, you are relieved of all duties with the gratitude and blessings of Guthix.

into-the-chasm-the-balance-elemental.speaker: Balance Elemental
into-the-chasm-the-balance-elemental.text: I am not here to help. I wish you all the best, [player name], but I am charged with a singular purpose, and I will now do my duty...
The cutscene ends, and the Balance Elemental begins to attack the player.

into-the-chasm-touching-the-stone-of-jas.text: A cutscene begins, showing the Stone of Jas covered by magical rocks.

into-the-chasm-touching-the-stone-of-jas.speaker: Mysterious Voice
into-the-chasm-touching-the-stone-of-jas.text: I still don't understand, [player name].
V approaches the Stone, and touches it.

into-the-chasm-touching-the-stone-of-jas.player: It was V who first found it, deep below the ice of Lunar Isle. A single touch granted him the power of the gods. The power of limitless creation...

into-the-chasm-touching-the-stone-of-jas.text: The scene changes to the Demonic Ruins.

into-the-chasm-touching-the-stone-of-jas.player: Over the centuries, it changed hands many times. For each person who'd use it for good, another would use it to destroy...

into-the-chasm-touching-the-stone-of-jas.text: The scene changes to the Lithkren Vault entrance.

into-the-chasm-touching-the-stone-of-jas.speaker: Mysterious Voice
into-the-chasm-touching-the-stone-of-jas.text: And the kin?

into-the-chasm-touching-the-stone-of-jas.player: They were bound to it long ago. To use the Stone causes them unimaginable pain, and grants them immense power.

into-the-chasm-touching-the-stone-of-jas.text: The scene returns to the Ancient Guthix Temple, depicting Robert the Strong, Camorra, Tristan, and Aivas facing the Stone.

into-the-chasm-touching-the-stone-of-jas.speaker: Robert the Strong
into-the-chasm-touching-the-stone-of-jas.text: So the only way to win...
The screen fades to black as Robert begins to touch the Stone, ending the cutscene.

into-the-chasm-touching-the-stone-of-jas.speaker: Movario
into-the-chasm-touching-the-stone-of-jas.text: The Stone! After all this time... I've finally found it!

into-the-chasm-touching-the-stone-of-jas.speaker: Darve
into-the-chasm-touching-the-stone-of-jas.text: And look who's here as well! The so-called Lord Surok!

into-the-chasm-touching-the-stone-of-jas.speaker: Movario
into-the-chasm-touching-the-stone-of-jas.text: Yes, quite a clever ploy, [player name], but you should have known I'd work it out. Now, step aside.

into-the-chasm-touching-the-stone-of-jas.player: And let you take the Stone? I don't think so.

into-the-chasm-touching-the-stone-of-jas.speaker: Movario
into-the-chasm-touching-the-stone-of-jas.text: We stand before the most important, the most significant, the most powerful artefact to ever be discovered in Gielinor, and it's all thanks to me!

into-the-chasm-touching-the-stone-of-jas.speaker: Movario
into-the-chasm-touching-the-stone-of-jas.text: With the patience of a thousand men, I have spent my life following the smallest of clues and the slightest of hints to discover only the most minute inkling of its existence!

into-the-chasm-touching-the-stone-of-jas.speaker: Movario
into-the-chasm-touching-the-stone-of-jas.text: So yes, you will step aside, because after all I've done to get here, I have no intention of letting you stop me now!

into-the-chasm-touching-the-stone-of-jas.player: If Lucien gets the Stone, the world burns. I don't plan on letting that happen.

into-the-chasm-touching-the-stone-of-jas.speaker: Movario
into-the-chasm-touching-the-stone-of-jas.text: And what makes you think Lucien will ever lay his hands on it? He may have contributed to my research funds, certainly, but in terms of actual possession, I now hold the cards.

into-the-chasm-touching-the-stone-of-jas.player: You'd be a fool to cross him. He'd wipe you from existence before you could even say a word.

into-the-chasm-touching-the-stone-of-jas.speaker: Movario
into-the-chasm-touching-the-stone-of-jas.text: Before, yes, but now... Now the power of the Stone is in the palm of my hand. Lucien has no hope of standing against that.

into-the-chasm-touching-the-stone-of-jas.player: Except you don't have the Stone yet. You'll have to get through me first.

into-the-chasm-touching-the-stone-of-jas.speaker: Darve
into-the-chasm-touching-the-stone-of-jas.text: No problems! I'll easily deal with you, mate!

into-the-chasm-touching-the-stone-of-jas.speaker: Movario
into-the-chasm-touching-the-stone-of-jas.text: Darve, I wouldn't be too enthusiastic about tangling with our friend here. His strength is... unusual. Surely you didn't...

into-the-chasm-touching-the-stone-of-jas.speaker: Movario
into-the-chasm-touching-the-stone-of-jas.text: Hang on... I detect a build up of energy...
Lucien appears.

into-the-chasm-touching-the-stone-of-jas.speaker: Lucien
into-the-chasm-touching-the-stone-of-jas.text: Movario.

into-the-chasm-touching-the-stone-of-jas.speaker: Movario
into-the-chasm-touching-the-stone-of-jas.text: Lord Lucien! We did not expect...

into-the-chasm-touching-the-stone-of-jas.speaker: Lucien
into-the-chasm-touching-the-stone-of-jas.text: It seems you have found the Stone. Why was I not informed?

into-the-chasm-touching-the-stone-of-jas.speaker: Movario
into-the-chasm-touching-the-stone-of-jas.text: The discovery was made mere moments ago, my lord. Now I need time to conduct research and ensure it's safe to...

into-the-chasm-touching-the-stone-of-jas.speaker: Lucien
into-the-chasm-touching-the-stone-of-jas.text: Silence! Do you not feel that, Movario? It calls to me... my birthright!

into-the-chasm-touching-the-stone-of-jas.speaker: Lucien
into-the-chasm-touching-the-stone-of-jas.text: Icthlarin... Zaros... Zamorak... All of them false! Finally the Mahjarrat shall take their rightful place as the sole inheritors of Gielinor, and I will be their god!

into-the-chasm-touching-the-stone-of-jas.speaker: Lucien
into-the-chasm-touching-the-stone-of-jas.text: Any who stand in my way shall be swept away like the civilisations of old. For those that are lucky, their children shall become slaves!

into-the-chasm-touching-the-stone-of-jas.player: I wouldn't be so sure about that!

into-the-chasm-touching-the-stone-of-jas.speaker: Lucien
into-the-chasm-touching-the-stone-of-jas.text: Ah, [player name], I see you have decided to interfere once again. Commendable, but meaningless. You cannot stop what is to come. Death is all that awaits you if you try.

into-the-chasm-touching-the-stone-of-jas.player: You'll never have the satisfaction of killing me, Lucien. No matter what it takes, I'll make it my mission to stop you.

into-the-chasm-touching-the-stone-of-jas.speaker: Lucien
into-the-chasm-touching-the-stone-of-jas.text: Such arrogance. Do you not realise who you address? I am Lord Lucien of the Mahjarrat, Master of the Thousand Curses. Look upon my works and despair!

into-the-chasm-touching-the-stone-of-jas.player: You can bestow as many titles upon yourself as you like, but before long, no one will even remember your name. You're just another monster, craving a power you'll never have.

into-the-chasm-touching-the-stone-of-jas.speaker: Lucien
into-the-chasm-touching-the-stone-of-jas.text: Are you truly so misguided that you cannot see the truth before you? I hold both the Staff of Armadyl and the Stone of Jas!

into-the-chasm-touching-the-stone-of-jas.speaker: Lucien
into-the-chasm-touching-the-stone-of-jas.text: Not since Zamorak himself has anyone possessed this much power! Nothing will stop me following in his footsteps!

into-the-chasm-touching-the-stone-of-jas.player: You think Zamorak will just stand by and let that happen?

into-the-chasm-touching-the-stone-of-jas.speaker: Lucien
into-the-chasm-touching-the-stone-of-jas.text: He doesn't have a choice. He no longer has any power here. His days are already done.

into-the-chasm-touching-the-stone-of-jas.speaker: Lucien
into-the-chasm-touching-the-stone-of-jas.text: Now, this conversation bores me. My ascension approaches, and I only have room for the strongest as my worshippers. Those too weak to slay even these lowly beasts will certainly not be wanted!

into-the-chasm-touching-the-stone-of-jas.speaker: Movario
into-the-chasm-touching-the-stone-of-jas.text: Time for us to leave, Darve!
As Movario teleports himself and Darve away, Lucien teleports the Stone and summons two Tormented Demons. As Lucien teleports away, the Guardians of Armadyl and Idria teleport in to assist you.

into-the-chasm-touching-the-stone-of-jas.speaker: Idria
into-the-chasm-touching-the-stone-of-jas.text: We're with you, [player name]!

into-the-chasm-talking-to-akrisae-before.speaker: Akrisae
into-the-chasm-talking-to-akrisae-before.text: [player name], you must return to the temple below Lumbridge! Idria and her Guardians of Armadyl have already departed to support you!

into-the-chasm-talking-to-thaerisk-befor.speaker: Thaerisk
into-the-chasm-talking-to-thaerisk-befor.text: [player name], you must return to the temple below Lumbridge! Idria and her Guardians of Armadyl have already departed to support you!

into-the-chasm-talking-to-idria-after-ki.speaker: Idria
into-the-chasm-talking-to-idria-after-ki.text: That was astounding, [player name]! Good work!

into-the-chasm-talking-to-idria-after-ki.speaker: Idria
into-the-chasm-talking-to-idria-after-ki.text: Blessed Armadyl, that was incredible! The Stone must have augmented your strengths. I've never seen anything like it!

into-the-chasm-talking-to-idria-after-ki.speaker: Idria
into-the-chasm-talking-to-idria-after-ki.text: Now, we'd better get back to Falador. Do you want me to teleport you there?

steps.player: Yes please.

steps.text: The player is teleported.

steps.player: No thanks. I'll make my own way back.

steps.speaker: Idria
steps.text: Very well. I'll see you back there.

into-the-chasm-talking-to-the-group-2.player: Not exactly. I'm sorry... I failed. Lucien has the Stone.

into-the-chasm-talking-to-the-group-2.speaker: Thaerisk
into-the-chasm-talking-to-the-group-2.text: Then our worst fears have come to pass. The horrors that he could unleash with it...

into-the-chasm-talking-to-the-group-2.speaker: Idria
into-the-chasm-talking-to-the-group-2.text: That's something he'll never have a chance to do. Yes, this is a dark day, but I don't intend to give up, and I'm sure none of you do either.

into-the-chasm-talking-to-the-group-2.speaker: Idria
into-the-chasm-talking-to-the-group-2.text: [player name], you've helped forge an alliance between the Temple Knights, Crux Eqal and the Guardians of Armadyl. Three very different groups, all fighting for the common good.

into-the-chasm-talking-to-the-group-2.speaker: Idria
into-the-chasm-talking-to-the-group-2.text: We must build on that. We will strengthen our forces, and find new allies to join our cause. When Lucien dares to rear his head again, we'll be ready.

into-the-chasm-talking-to-the-group-2.speaker: Akrisae
into-the-chasm-talking-to-the-group-2.text: Well said. When times are darkest, it is all the more important that we continue to look for the light. The Temple Knights stand ready.

into-the-chasm-talking-to-the-group-2.speaker: Thaerisk
into-the-chasm-talking-to-the-group-2.text: As do we in Crux Eqal.

into-the-chasm-talking-to-the-group-2.speaker: Thaerisk
into-the-chasm-talking-to-the-group-2.text: Rest, my friend. You have well and truly earned it. We will take things from here.

into-the-chasm-talking-to-the-group-2.speaker: Idria
into-the-chasm-talking-to-the-group-2.text: Don't worry, [player name]. When the time is right, you'll be the first to know. I promise you, we will find Lucien. Together, we will stop him.

into-the-chasm-talking-to-the-group-2.speaker: Thaerisk
into-the-chasm-talking-to-the-group-2.text: And the world will be safe once more.
